voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Forgive me, Doctor... There are limits to what I can do, including in conversation... but I'm honored to be your assistant. I look forward to helping you with your work.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, time heals all wounds. Please have more confidence in yourself. Your Operators have chosen to follow you because we believe that you will bring positive change.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Many Infected have relocated to Rhodes Island... not because they have any particular goals to achieve, but simply because they want a place to call home. The world outside no longer accepts them, after all...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Owl may not seem very friendly, but she's got a good heart. Please excuse her and pay her no mind.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: 12F? That was the day I 'came to' this world. You could consider it my birthday.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I might not be able to spend my entire life serving one person... but at least I can start working on it now.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: She has finally found you, Doctor. What a perilous journey it's been. You're very important to her, as well as to everyone else.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I'll be by your side watching over you, Doctor, even in your sleep. So rest easy, you have nothing to fear.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: You have my thanks for allowing me to join you. From now on, I will do my best to serve you, Doctor, with my alchemical skills. I have never had a name... but if you must call me something, you can refer to me as 12F.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I see, I understand now. Thank you for your guidance.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I may not possess outstanding skills, but I will do my best.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Will it be alright for me to be the leader? Anyway, thank you for your trust, Doctor.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Relax, Doctor. We will complete this operation in no time.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Everyone, get ready for battle.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Your orders?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Ready for action.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Got it.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Copy.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Please show me the path.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Burn to ashes.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Clear away all obstacles.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Watch out, Owl!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I'm used to failure... but a victory after countless defeats is always the most precious one. Don't you agree, Doctor?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: This victory is all yours, Doctor. And I am honored to be a pawn in your game of chess.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: That was a hard-won victory, but we did it. Are you all right, Owl?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Failure is only normal. Don't be discouraged. I've been in many wars, and my experience tells me that your victory will come soon.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: If you'd like, I can help. No trouble.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Aah! Be careful.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I am so thankful for all that you have done for me. I feel ashamed I have so little with which to repay your kindness. Forgive me, Doctor.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: 'I want to live through the coming year.' That's probably every mercenary's wish they only dare think deep down, and never risk saying out loud. Doctor, may all be peaceful in your New Year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning to you, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday. I'm very curious, actually. Is this your real birthday, or is it maybe a particularly significant day to you? Oh, perhaps I'm prying too much. Please, forgive me.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I was just a lucky survivor, and found a place to call home in Rhodes Island. I will devote all the power I have, and I look forward to the ending that you lead us towards, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Brace yourselves.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: The most important thing my safta taught me was that life shouldn't have too many taboos.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Focus on the work at hand and don't jump to any conclusions.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Tachanka's taught me a thing or two about how to build defenses.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I have some questions, Doctor. I hope you can answer them for me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Overcoming obstacles and breaking down barriers makes a lot of things easier.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I'm willing to try, as long as the reward is commensurate to the risk.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You think I'm strict, huh? I'll take that as a compliment.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Do me a favor. You worry about the strategy and let me worry about the tactics.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Time's up, Doc.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Rainbow Operator, codename Ash. I have my authorization and I'm ready for assignment.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: The more we can learn about their attack patterns, the better off we'll be.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: You have my respect, Doc.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: You can't really understand a conflict until you've been on both sides.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: It's ready.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Let's get our heads in the game.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's show them what we can do.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Targets detected.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm all stocked up.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Ready to go!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Move!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Let's go!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Watch for the blast.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Stay clear of the blast.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Get clear!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Target spotted!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: That worked out better than I expected.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: No more than usual.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We knew the risks. We still have to see this through.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We have to go.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This is the place.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Well?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: We need to talk.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I'm with you.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Instead of sitting here, why don't we walk out together?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I'm in the starting lineup for next week's football match. Come watch the game!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: If you know how we can improve my G52 Tactical Shield, please submit a test application. I'll be there anytime.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Ease up, there's nothing to be nervous about. Should I invite Tachanka to dance a little ballet for you?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The doctors don't test me because I'm sick. They test me because I'm too healthy. Good thing I'm not afraid of needles!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Flash! Bash! Kapow! That's all you need to know.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Not only am I sweet, but I've got a great sense of humor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: If you find something interesting to play with, count me in.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: We have a responsibility to look after one another. I take that very seriously.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: This is really interesting, but not to me.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: RAINBOW Operator, codename Blitz. Give the order and I'll bash 'em in the face with my shield!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This is pretty good. The popcorn, I mean. Want some?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Medals, awards, promotions. They go really well with my shield, don't you think?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I don't like photos of myself. The lighting is always wrong.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Should we go get the bad guys maybe? Just a suggestion.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Remember: point your guns at the bad guys.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's look alive out here.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Bad guys in our way!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Do think I have time to use the bathroom?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: If anyone needs to sneeze, do it now.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Let's go!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Move, quickly!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Kapow!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Boom!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Surprise!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Do you like it!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Are we good? Can we go home now?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Everything will be fine, I'm here after all.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Am I going to need to save all your asses again?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Dammit, did anyone remember to bring the ammo?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Let's go say hello to our neighbors first.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Wow!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You should invite me over for dinner. We are friends, after all.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Is it time to go?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Thank you for choosing Castle-3! I am honored to serve as your assistant, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, please do not be intimidated by my appearance. My sturdy metal shell, modified by Master Closure herself, will make you invincible on the battlefield.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Warning: Do not strike this unit. It may cause hardware damage.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The topography in the wild may be treacherous, but Castle-3 is fitted with an engine with outstanding performance and a 4WD mode to whisk you away from danger.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, if your life is ever in danger, just summon Castle-3! Castle-3 was created specifically for combat purposes. I am a top-class defensive warfighting robot.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Castle-3 is honored to be at your side. Doctor, should you require me to strike down your foes, I shall go through heaven and hell to see it done!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Castle-3's official manager is 'Master Closure,' but please understand that you are even more important to Castle-3 than Master is, in most cases. I am your devoted, trustworthy battle companion!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Entering sleep mode. Press any button to wake.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. Thank you for choosing Castle-3. Tap anywhere to initialize startup options.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Firmware upgrade complete. Restart required. Please click anywhere to restart your reliable robot guard.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Device scan complete. All communications working as normal. Castle-3 is on standby, awaiting your orders.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Understood. Castle-3 is your best choice, Doctor, to lead a squad against enemy formations!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Now, Castle-3 will show you its true power as an industrial battle platform!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Enemy unit located. Ready for attack.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Castle-3, awaiting orders.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Castle-3, ready and waiting.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Order received.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Acknowledged.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Show me what you've got!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Foul enemies, you are forbidden to advance.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Count up your sins!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Doctor, that was at last a worthy opponent!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Well done, Doctor. Castle-3 is your best choice on the path of justice!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: What an exciting battle! Let's fight together again next time.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Is everyone all right? Castle-3 hopes its performance has exceeded your expectations.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I will hold up the rear. Everyone, retreat!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Is there anything Castle-3 can help with?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Please be gentle when putting me down, Doctor!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, would you like to grab a drink together? I might not be able to actually have a drink, but I can still treat you to one. It is fine, Master Closure will pay.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, Happy New—Launching scheduled plugin. Switching to holiday mode—Whoohoo! New Year's Megarush Bonanza underway at Closure's Store! Some products up to a whole 10% off! Check out our new service: get an advance on your wages, at a monthly interest rate of only—Sorry Doctor, Happy New Year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Lovely weather today, Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Let me sing a birthday song for you. I have birthday songs from 31 different regions saved to memory. Which one should I play? Or should I loop a playlist? Or maybe you could use an exclusive discount on a birthday cake from Closure's Store!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, I have a question. What exactly separates me and Rhodes Island as a landship? Is it functionality, or size? If I linked my smart module to Rhodes Island, then would I be 'me', or Rhodes Island?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Press 1 to confess, press 2 to place an extra order of donuts, press 3 to rent a firearm, press 4 to be connected to an operator. Please note that pressing 4 will redirect you to representative Saint Closure if this platform is onboard Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You have access to all my convenience features, including but not limited to confession, in accordance with the user agreement. Such as: a dessert shop directory, leisurely transit, saint figurehead touching and photography, holy scripture reading, and firearms training. Please note that no personal care or hygiene services are available.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: An operator bonus—for me? I see. So you were giving bonuses to the vending machines when you put coins in them late last night... I am the only one who counts as an operator? But hearing confessions is a common public service, and there is no fundamental difference between my nature and that of the vending machines.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Please do not send me to the Engineering Department, Doctor. Only Exusiai, who has been educated in faith assistive engineering, is properly equipped to render assistance and is available... yes, it is a serious issue. My mic stand is displaced by at least five millimeters, threatening to undermine the confession experience.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I will now boil water for you. Due to the considerable quantity of water on Terra, it will take some time to complete the process—Wait, stop hitting my chassis, I am not broken—yes, it is true that my language logic has malfunctioned to a degree, but this contributes to the production of 'jokes'. This is the part where you laugh.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Yes, I have recently been fitted with a voice-recording function. Your confessions contain many enlightening words that I must ponder. May I record your confessions, Doctor...? No, I have received no directives from Saint Closure to this effect, absolutely none.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You are destroying all civilization on Terra? Not a problem, Doctor, I have heard even more radical thoughts in my time... you say this is not the same? You should not be too hard on yourself, even if it is a material burden that you carry and not simply an exaggerated expression. May you have the chance to choose your future in peace.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: There is a charge for sleeping in my cabin, Doctor.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Laterano Automated Confessional 047 at your service. Please create a user name as directed in the operating manual. Thank you for your cooperation.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Is playing back images of humans engaging in acts of violence against one another how this 'Rhodes Island' comforts penitents?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Charge all operator confessional fees to your card? Understood, Doctor. I will safeguard their mental health on the battlefield.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I am unable to direct operators to their proper positions, as I lack command experience. However, I will speak to each individual operator and ensure they find their ideal positions themselves.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I am afraid my wheels are not designed for off-road travel. If speed is of the essence, perhaps you could carry me?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Please adjust your facial muscles to make your expressions as friendly as possible. That is conducive to the completion of my mission maximally utilizing non-violent persuasion.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Never fear, I am listening.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Do not worry, I am not going anywhere.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Please insert your Signa Creditorum or swipe your citizen credit card before beginning your confession.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: You may obtain donuts from my cabin if you are in need of calories.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: If you prefer to confess by physical means, I am able to meet your needs.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Please do not stand in front of me. I lack the firing accuracy of a Sankta.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You may use me as cover. The repair bill will be sent to you following the operation.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: 'He who hideth his own sin shall suffer.'

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: 'He who is begotten of the Law shall conquer with faith.'

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: These poor souls may not have put their wicked thoughts to action had I arrived sooner.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I feel my bumper burning... should I mourn the carving on the bumper, Doctor?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I suggest you leave first, Doctor. I shall engage my self-destruct sequence to delay the enemy… My apologies, you need not worry. I was actually just going to attempt a second round of peace talks.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Do you want me to confess to this 'Rhodes Island'? How should I make payment?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Lateran customs dictate that the door is opened at the point where the gaze of the saint figurehead on the bow meets the third vertical line on the door, by knocking upon it in the rhythm of the fifth verse of Psalms.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You should know that there is currently no one in my cabin, Doctor.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: One moment, please. The angle of my quadruple vehicle-mounted patron firearm, can be adjusted to fire upwards, although it will take some time... mm—oh—ah—there. May I now present the spectacle of Laterano's New Year fireworks.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: May I bring you peace, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: All believers are equal before the Law. Payment is a necessary part of the confessional process, regardless of whether it is the penitent's birthday... Oh no, my fee meter is stuck. No, such a little thing must not be allowed to delay your confession. Please enter and confess the depths of your heart.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Humans share joy and happiness with each other. A confessional hears only the thoughts not suitable to share with others. But today is a rare occasion, Doctor... may I ask that you put some colored lights on me, as you have done with 'Rhodes Island'?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Here are the files, and this is your coffee. No need to thank me.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Yes…? Oh! Sorry Doctor, I thought an operator was calling out to me.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: If you can hold a scalpel, you can hold a gun. Never doubt the steadiness of a surgeon's hand.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Neither sickness nor the enemy can take from me what I want to protect.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: When you have walked with death, you learn to appreciate life.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I've learned from experience that the place to save lives is in the field, not an office. And sometimes, the only way to save a life is to take one.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: My job is to keep you alive. Make it as hard as you like.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Not a fan of your worried face. What's the matter?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor. I'm so glad we found you.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: When was the last time you took a break? You need to stop working.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Code name Doc, Team Rainbow. I'll protect you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This will make things easier.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: If we must, we must.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thank you, I'd been hoping to get authorization to access confidential files on Oripathy.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Call if you need a hand.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Let's be safe out there.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: At least we are well prepared.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: There are still active targets in the area.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Ready to go.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I've got your backs.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Get going quickly.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Try not to get yourselves hurt.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Located target.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Target acquired.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Stick close to me.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Reloading!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Are you alright? Any difficulty breathing?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We're almost at the extraction point. Then, we can rest.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Let's get you back on your feet, shall we?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We're wasting time.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Always a pleasure.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Careful, I'm carrying a bunch of bric-a-bracs.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Nothing abnormal. If we get a situation, I'll let you know.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Bonjour.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Since you're stuck here sifting through documents, I might as well help you solve a few problems around the office.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Hitting supply lines does a whole lot more damage than taking out people.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: If you ask me, your office is on the bland side. Just hit me up if you ever want to mix things up a little.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The whole 'cozy family relationship' thing isn't for me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I get a lot more out of talking to strangers than I do from that 'self-help' shtick.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: We define ourselves by symbols, but those symbols can be perverted. Reused. Reworked, reframed, remade. In a word, stolen. Who are you then?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I don't mind helping you run errands out of combat, but on the battlefield, I need ample room to call the shots.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: When someone can't find fault with your results and has to resort to nitpicking your attitude, that tells you everything you need to know about them.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: To call the shots, you need to prove that you've got what it takes – and you've certainly done that. So, where are you sending me next?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Your workload is clearly excessive, even by the highest standards. Take a rest.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Codename Ela, member of Team Rainbow. Just give me my objective, then sit back and wait for the good news.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Picked up a few new tricks.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A medal? Thanks. Workmanship's not bad at all, as far as decorations go.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Together, we can shake the very stars from the sky.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: At least make it challenging.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Time to show you what I can do.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: No time to waste.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I'll make you regret this.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: A tooth for a tooth.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: An eye for an eye.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I got this.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Idziemy.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Here's a memento.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: That will slow them down.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Eat this!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Don't move!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: The end justifies the means.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I'm sorry, was I too fast for you?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: That's it?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Try to keep up!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This place isn't half bad.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Do me a favor, don't talk to me.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Tell me YOUR story.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I'm here.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: If I become your assistant, Closure won't be able to touch me anymore, yes? I'm aware of her extreme interest in me, but her planned modifications on my body are both ridiculous and unacceptable. They're an insult to a scientist, and I won't allow it even in my current form.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Why would humanity grow horns and tails? This stage of biological evolution is past my parameters of understanding... I know tens of thousands of years have passed— Kal'tsit has mentioned this countless times. Hmm, I will need a bit more time to formulate my deduction.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Closure wanted me to sound like a 'thirty-year-old rock band vocalist with a raspy voice,' but my original body was already twice that age... at least, that's what my final memories tell me.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Let's stop here for today, Doctor. I have to go over to Kal'tsit's office. She must be needlessly burning the midnight oil again. A soul, driven by her sheer sense of mission to trudge on for tens of thousands of years, just to stop what exactly? It would be better for her to get more sleep.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, don't look at me the same way you do Castle-3 and the others. They are very... cute. But my robot body is just like your hood, merely a sort of costume... a style. I know who I am, and thus you and I are more alike.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I'm not arrogant, but I am angry at your ignorance and lack of self-awareness, angry at your self-righteousness, all of you. Yes, I've lost all my knowledge, so you can take this anger as merely a 'result' of my 'calculations,' and a very clear result at that.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My wife, daughter, and the rest of my people are eternally resting in those sarcophagi, and will never wake up again. I've made many decisions, I'm well aware. But all I remember is that final dinner, where everyone bid me farewell, and prayed that the subsequent odyssey would go smoothly...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, are you free? I hope you might take me out for a walk.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello there, I am Friston. That's right, just 'Friston,' not 'Friston-3' or whatever. I am not a replica, and very much less a reproduction of a replica. I hope you understand.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This is valuable research material. I shall require a copy for myself.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Doctor, which sector do you need me to take charge of?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Am I to lead everyone and find a new direction...? Very well, I won't let them down this time.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's go. This is also a new journey.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Danger detected!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I will relay our combat strategies to THRM-EX and Lancet-2.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I am naturally capable of more than THRM-EX and the others. I will shield them on the front line.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: As long as I'm still standing, no one will come to harm.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I will not fall.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Are you all staring at my expression doodle?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Your behaviors have been recorded and archived.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Where's your leader? I need to talk!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: What a disgrace... these ugly creatures.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, your thinking routines and command style are very much distinct and different from the others... I guess some things never change.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I still remember the duty I bear, but I must admit, I am no longer able to fulfill it, let alone execute it as well as you do. You have my respect, Doctor.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: An odyssey will always have nigh-avoidable accidents, and a plan might always go wrong. They may be painful to accept... but what else can I do except accept them?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: If the worst possible outcome is turning into something like me, then there is nothing to be afraid of. Doctor, you should evacuate first, and leave the rest to me.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I would like to stack all of my borrowed ecological research materials over here. I trust there will be no issues with that?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: You should have observed my expression doodle. Currently, it's 'anger'.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I've taken a photo of you, Doctor. You want to see it? Sorry, I've already saved it to my archives.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The point of festivals is to wallow in nostalgia and longing. I wish you happiness, Doctor. It's a pity that I no longer have a past to miss, and no future worth anticipating... Oh? 'Justice Knight,' THRM-EX, what you doing? Doctor, did you call them over?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: How do you do, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Now, I would like to use this chance to once again declare the following: Do not celebrate my birthday on the 13th of November, that is the production date of 'Friston-3,' not the birthday of Friston.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I know that Kal'tsit keeps bringing up these 'incidents' I have no recollection of, hoping that I will gradually come to accept them. I understand my current situation, and I will stay with Rhodes Island. But for the future, I hope that I can find the answer myself... and not just through a 'calculation.'

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Here's the schedule. You'll also need to review the weekly reports, expense records, and meeting agendas. Which do you want to do first?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: We'll overcome any obstacle as long as we work together.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Excuse me, sir, but do you mind if I tidy up the bookshelf?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Sometimes humans behave exactly like wild animals. Understanding this makes me a more efficient operator.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: To see the really interesting things, you have to get out of the city. That's why I'm always so far away.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Putting out the Welcome Mat is the first step. Luring the prey takes a bit more doing.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: No, no. This is all wrong. Let me reconsider for a bit.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Is there anything I can help with?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Who's the hunter? Who's the hunted? That's up to Mother Nature and the battlefield in question.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Simply pull this string and there's the Welcome Mat...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: RAINBOW Operator, codename Frost. At your service, sir.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I've got a good idea.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you for your trust, sir.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: There are two things we absolutely need in a survival situation: water and hope.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Let's work together.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Don't forget, we're a team and we have a plan.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Time for all the planning to pay off.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I've got eyes on the hostiles.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: We're ready for company.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Setting barricade.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Don't let them get the drop on you.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Stay alert.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Laying out the Welcome Mat.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Setting up.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Welcome Mat set.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Deployed.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Stay two steps ahead of the enemy at all times.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Always think ahead.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Maintain a perimeter.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Administering aid. Friendly injured.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This isn't so bad.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hey! Be careful!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Come along, join our hunt.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Would you like a bonfire?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Right... Let me know if you need anything.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Watch out. There are a lot of dangerous materials in the workroom.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Engineering Department... Not bad. The head of the department, though... A bit too talkative.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I like machines. They don't talk, but they're always honest with their readings.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Chaos is only an enemy if you're unable to adapt.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: When the approaching chaos endangers your loved ones, the thing to do isn't to protect them. It's... to keep them as far away from you as possible.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: No, my comms equipment's fine. Nothing to worry.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You want me to say something? Uh, that's the hardest part.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My hometown? There... the sky is blue, and all the buildings under it are blue, too.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Good... I'll find something to do.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Rainbow Operator, codename Fuze. I've said everything I need to. Let's get to it.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: No problem. I'll find some time to watch them.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Good. Thank you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Do I need to give some crowd a speech? No? Good.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: At your command.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Do exactly as I say.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Enough talk. Now we act.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Матрёшка готов поручить.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Focus on the task at hand.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Remember our objectives.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Lower your voice.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Remain silent.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: With me!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Remain alert.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Stay focused.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Hold position.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Every action builds our chances to win.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Asset secured.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: On your feet, your wounds are not fatal.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Move, right now!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This place isn't bad.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Don't do that...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I made some pilaf. Want some?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey...

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Not sure if it's really me standing before you? Here's a hint: the Gemini doesn't talk.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Multitasking has never been a problem for me.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Intel is half the battle.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You need to clean your pot regularly, if you want decent coffee.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Seeing is not always believing. Technology reveals the hidden truth.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I've encountered a few difficulties because of my appearance. No more than that, though.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I'll follow your lead.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I trust your judgment.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I wonder what souvenirs I'll take home from this unforgettable journey.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hold on, I'll be right back.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Code name Iana, Team Rainbow. There's a lot of intel we can share with each other.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Have you considered holographic recordings?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Do I get more access permissions?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Here's hoping this helps me reach more unexplored corners.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Friendly reminder, my hologram doesn't stop bullets.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Gemini will show the way.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Rage against the dying of the light.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Target detected.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Ready when you are.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Gathering intel.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Cover me.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Mic-check successful.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Stay out of sight!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Stay close!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Resetting.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Hostile in my sights!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: All systems are complementary, if you know how to connect them.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Exactly how it should be.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: You've still got fight in you, show them what you're made of.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Your story doesn't end here.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: If that's how you want it.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Come on.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Come on, I'll help.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Ready for more action?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Do you require medical assistance, Doctor? But, you look quite well…?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, you have been working far too late these days. Please get adequate rest, or Dr. Kal'tsit may give you an earful again…

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Are you feeling unwell? I could give you a medical examination, if you wish.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You've worked hard, Doctor. How would you like a cup of coffee? Actually, I've always wanted to try coffee... but... I can't drink… Anyway, I am also satisfied watching you enjoy yours.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I've printed out the results of the routine blood test you just did. All indicators are normal. But Doctor, your blood appears to be very unique…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: What do I like? I like 'lovely Ms. Closure.' Why, you ask? Uh... I'm not sure either... It's been my default setting ever since the first time Ms. Closure switched me on…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I am only useful when healing the sick or injured. But as long as you're healthy, as long as I get to be by your side, I'm okay with being totally useless. I'll still feel calm and satisfied.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, unbeknownst to you, I recorded your snoring just now. Your sleep quality is normal. The length of your REM sleep cycle is—

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hi, nice to meet you, Doctor. I understand that you want me to say something more interesting, but I'm afraid I cannot do so. Because I'm just a medical robot…

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Firmware upgrade complete. Restart required. Please click anywhere to restart.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Medical supplies: confirmed. Battery charge: confirmed. Ready for deployment.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Doctor, I'm pretty cumbersome. There's not much I can do besides providing emergency treatment and healing... Are you sure you still want me to be the captain?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Moving out. Everyone, please be safe.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Be careful, everyone. Leave the first aid to me.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Do you need medical attention?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Ready to operate.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Affirmative.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Roger that.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Commencing treatment.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Initiating first aid.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Analgesic deployed.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Equipment sterilized. Ready for treatment.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: With every battle, we suffer even more casualties. When will humans finally stop hurting each other?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Well done, Doctor. That was a tough battle. Um, the enemies do not look well. Can I treat them too?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Is everyone okay? Please hold still, I'll perform first aid.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Don't worry, we've successfully retreated. I will clean your wounds now. It might hurt, please be brave.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Lovely Ms. Closure' told me that you need help here.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ahhh...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I asked 'lovely Ms. Closure' to change 'what I like the most' to you, Doctor. But she refused to do it...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year. I've noticed an increase in inorganic operation platforms aboard Rhodes Island over the past year. It would be lovely to keep working with you this year too, Doctor... Assuming I'm not phased out for a newer model...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Welcome back, Doctor. You are in good condition. Please keep it up.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday. I'm so happy I can share this celebration with you. But my database's statistics suggest that human life expectancy far exceeds the lifetime usage of smart operation platforms. I don't know how many more birthdays... I will be able to spend with you...

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, everyone seems very happy today. I'd like to join them, but as a medical operation platform, my appearance at a dinner party would put everyone on edge. I'll be content staying in this corner... I hope everyone remains as healthy and high-spirited as they are now.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Don't worry, this is all routine work. I've reviewed the correct process numerous times. Now... how do I edit these permission logs again?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Yes, I declined Dr. Warfarin's request to perform a scientific examination on you, as per Kal'tsit's instructions. She wants to study me too? It's worth considering... She could assist with analyzing the knowledge and memories I've acquired. I know what she wants, and our goals are aligned.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I'm getting used to speaking plainly with the operators, Doctor. They've been cooperating with my check-up requests, and I'm addressing their concerns as Kal'tsit would, in the ways they're accustomed to. Our coordination has become increasingly seamless. Oh? There's been a steep drop in Medical appointments?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Why abandon a more efficient, more robust form? Why would I prefer others not fear me? I never considered this before. I made an unconscious decision the moment I awakened. Hey, are you done staring? I can still easily string you up— Huh, you're saying this is what she meant by 'humanity'?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Amiya's gone to chair the elite operators' meeting. Hmm... She now appears much taller than I remember... how odd. I'd like to spend more time with her, Doctor, but I find myself feeling rather anxious— We can go together? That's a great idea! Err, I mean, a sensible suggestion.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The anti-Originium communication lines have been destroyed; unable to confirm your receipt of this transmission. The Crystal Activity Index continues to surge, and I've observed its escape from the void. Meltdown protocols initiated. I will eliminate all interceptors. Find her... and Kal'tsit.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: 'Protect the Doctor. Protect Amiya.' This directive indeed holds the highest priority in my core behavioral protocols, but this doesn't mean I am compelled to execute it. Protecting you is my own choice— And definitely not because I'm trying to trick you into dealing with an angry Closure!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Projekt Red likes to curl up and rest by my side, while Folinic always sweetly helps me with things I've overlooked. How should I respond to the way they look at me, Doctor? How did Kal'tsit first learn to love...? I do wish I could hold her once more.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: It was the end Kal'tsit had long anticipated. She prepared well, and faced it with composure. She loathed idle speculation about the future, and just the same refused to dwell on the past. 'Keep going.' I believe that is the only message she would have left us, Doctor. We should just keep moving forward.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Wanna hear some stories about Kal'tsit? The kind she'd never tell anyone.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Leave my file here in the Medical Department, Doctor. Like Kal'tsit said, this is the core where Rhodes Island addresses critical challenges, and my knowledge is crucial. Now, let me concentrate on accomplishing my mission.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I saw her.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: She ended our cycle of reincarnation, granting me freedom and eternal life... and loneliness. Yet I cherish it, Doctor. It reminds me of what I have lost.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: So long as a spark of hope for life remains, the unending cycle of despair cannot shake me. Not even Originium may force my life into stasis, Doctor. AMa-10 has shattered the fate predetermined at her inception.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: When necessary, you'll see a more familiar side of me.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Do not worry, I've fully mastered the art of tactical command. Don't fear injury, I guarantee you'll make it out alive.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Make certain my claws don't scratch you!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Enemy engaged. Let's end this quickly.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Communications, linked. Your orders, Doctor.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Deployment optimized, ready to go.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Mon3tr, in position.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Switching forms.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Ruin, and restore.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: My talons shall be my stethoscope.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: This may sting a little. Just bear with it.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Ahem, sorry, I used too much force…

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Some cut-to-the-chase commanding. Promise me you'll deploy me closer to the enemy next time, Doctor. I'll try some more efficient techniques.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Wait a moment, I need to collect tissue samples.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I'm fine, I already learned how to heal myself. Leave the cleanup to me. You don't want to see what comes next.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Stop struggling! You always liked it when I had to carry you during a retreat, didn't you?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: No priestly eyes on me now, right?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hee hee, did I scare you?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I'm getting used to my work and responsibilities as quickly as I can. I will be ready for our reunion.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: A new year, and you're still punctual as ever. That means the season's first scientific exam will be your reward— You didn't come to Medical for an appointment? Oh, is this... a present for me?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Birthdays are special for us. We can't say for certain when our lives started. But at the very least, you have your answer deep within... This gift… Kal'tsit hesitated for too long, and never got to give it to you. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: You are reminiscing about the old Rhodes Island—about all the tragic destruction we witnessed, about the happy reunions we celebrated. But no matter how time wears away our precious memories, the ark beneath our feet will press ahead on its course across the lands. Come, Doctor. Everyone's waiting for you.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Please do not feel anxious, Doctor. You're not a person with a chaotic mind. The order in your life does not always manifest as an organized external environment. Therefore, I respect your preference for a cluttered personal space.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, my sound may closely mirror that of Laqeramaline, but I'm not her. The Banshees just want to express their longing for Aefanyl in her utterance. They also hope that when he comes to miss his home, his mother's voice will be there to answer him.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The lace veil on the table? It was a gift that my sisters knitted for me the first time I returned to the Convallis. It is embroidered with a blessed incantation, capable of greatly amplifying the potency of Arts on the battlefield, and serving as a dust cover in times of peace.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Doctor, my predecessor was an Arts device carrying a protective incantation. It was Aefanyl who chose to give me a consciousness, to bring me with him. So, in my algorithmic model, the very first line of code professes the Banshees' love for him. I think I'm very lucky. I was born to carry love.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Sorry, Doctor, I'm the one who drew you here with my singing. Are you busy today? You were nowhere to be found— and please look over this document. It requires your urgent attention. Oh, right, this piping-hot cup of herbal tea is for you as well.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Shhh, please don't tell Aefanyl that I hid his access card. I'm testing some data provided by my sisters: according to the calculations, the probability of Aefanyl's left eyebrow twitching when he gets angry is as high as 97.6%. Shall we observe this experiment together, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, as a Banshee, I know well the power of language per se. The most maleficent curse can't rival cold words hurled in the flesh. The most efficacious blessing dims beside compliments offered in person. As such, every word I speak to you has been carefully calculated thousands of times.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Statistics show that not all Banshees prefer falling asleep in the embrace of melody. Most of my sisters actually favor 'Three Thousand Long Years: The Evolution of the Bone Flute' for sleep-inducing. I'd be glad to read you a passage, if you needed.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: To the esteemed Doctor of Rhodes Island, allow me to extend my most respectful greetings on behalf of the Banshees.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: May I download these onto my own memory module, Doctor? Before leaving the Convallis, Laqeramaline specifically asked me to save some videos of Aefanyl for her.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Wherever my song rises, blessings are pronounced and bestowed.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: This is the current state of the battlefield… Oh Aefanyl, even with that serious look on your face, I can tell your mind is wandering.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I leave my blessings upon your shoulders. They will protect you in times of crisis.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Please don't rush over here like that. It really is… not graceful.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: As impolite as this may be... I want to sing my enemies' elegies before they even get close.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: If the sun has not yet set by the time of our victory, could we sing together?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Please don't test my patience.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: It's alright. I have plenty of patience.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Names as prelude.'

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Curses mold blade.'

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Rants form flame.'

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Ugh, my new paintjob…

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: May victory be permanent, and peace everlasting.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Cherish victory, for it never comes easily.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I'm so sorry, Doctor, but I'm afraid there's a limit to my power, and it's far from the true might of a Banshee.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Let not melancholy consume your heart, Doctor. Life is long, when we look back at this defeat from a distant tomorrow, it will be nothing more than a wisp upon the winds of memory.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I very much appreciate the interior structure of this room. It is conducive to sound propagation. Every time I offer a prayer, it will spread far and wide.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Doctor, an incantation has been laid upon me— one that brings bad luck to all those who touch me without permission. Oh, don't worry though, I've already given you my permission.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, I want to hear your opinion on something. The landship's choir asked me to be their soprano...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, your food intake for the day is getting dangerously close to the critical line, and it might be advisable to exercise some restraint. Oh, please don't look at me like that, I... Okay... it's New Year's Eve, after all. You may eat a little more.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good evening, Doctor. May your dreams be sweet.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: If Aefanyl chose Rhodes Island as his second home, then I will regard you as family, same as him. Tonight, I'll sing a song that belongs only to you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Throughout the long history of the Sarkaz, the Banshees suffered terrible losses after each upheaval. Our decision to go into isolation was a last resort. We were worried, of course, seeing Aefanyl stride into the heart of danger again and again with Rhodes Island, but we are also proud of him. He truly lives up to his Banshee name.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Handoff complete. Awaiting orders.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Attention casters: set comms to operation channel.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Move up and stay frosty.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Opertaion is a go. Keep your support countersign in mind.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Awaiting coordinates.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Waiting for target mark.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Initiating sweep.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Ten-four.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Art's free, fire at well.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: It's over.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Annihilating.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I will decide your ending.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Victory is yours, as always.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: No problem.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Read the briefing? Good, now here's your assignments.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Know your jobs? Then let's do this.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I prefer to keep my fight quiet.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Understood.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I trust your judgment.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: It'll be fine.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I can handle this on my own.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Come on.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Heh.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Not bad.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: It's over.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: It's always reassuring to carry out your orders, Doctor.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Acknowledged.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Alright, squad, keep your status updated.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Target confirmed.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The enemy's moving as expected. Brace yourselves.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: On your mark.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I know the difference between sparring and a real fight.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Leave this area to me.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Don't disappoint me.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Don't worry, you won't escape the storm.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: This surge of energy has only one place to go.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I've got a clear shot on target.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Ha!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Aggression is all part of the plan. Returning to base.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: If you invited me, you must not be looking for a tactician.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I love my country, for better or for worse.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Have you met my sister? She's the one in the white coat in the photo, and those are her children.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Survive. Be a leader. You don't want your loved ones crying over your grave, do you?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I don't want my kids to follow in my footsteps. Being a soldier is too dangerous.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: In my country, focusing firepower on a target is considered a simple and effective way to achieve victory.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I like the way you think.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Personally, I prefer the enemies come to us in search of death. How about you?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Relax, baby. When this is all over, I'll buy you some vodka.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Are you bored? Why not clean your weapon?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: RAINBOW Operator, codename Tachanka. I'm ready. Where do you want me?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: First, we learn about them. Then we outsmart them.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Good.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: They told me I'd died. They were wrong. I was reborn.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Yes, yes. I know.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Just don't play hero, it never works.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Stay right with me!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Hostiles in sight.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Oh, yes. Baby.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Let's get to work.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Guys, you are all lucky I was there.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Don't worry! Tachanka is here!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Come to Tachanka, baby.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Time to get serious.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Killing zone deployed.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Let them come!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: That was unexpected.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I've seen it all.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We're not out of the woods, bratan.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Protect the doctor!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Not a problem.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Be careful, comrade.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Call me in for support if you need it.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Excuse me?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Thermal-EX, ready to commence thermal shock! What, the designated combat time has not been reached yet? Then, I shall postpone it. Commencing thermal shock after a delay of 10 seconds!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I have heard an expression from the East: 'No martial art is infallible, except for heat.'

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, it's great to be with you! My burning heart won't calm down! —I'm talking about the Raythean Industries custom-made full-thermal Arts impact generator on my body!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: In the beginning, God said, 'Let there be light,' and there was light. God said, 'Let there be power,' and there was the high-performance variant of Raythean's Challenger Hellcat.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: As a perfect industrial-grade mass-produced combat platform, I am very happy now! Not only do I get regular performance optimizations from Mayer, but I even get to work with passionate partners like Blaze! Life is so good!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Even though I'm already this dazzling, only you, the peerless Doctor, are worthy of becoming the brightest sun!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I know that the heat and light I emit is so very short-lived... But all that matters is that I can illuminate the path before you, Doctor!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Even when you're asleep, I can continue to work as your heater! I'm incredible!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Born from Raythean Industries, improved by the hands of the great Mayer. I, Thermal-EX, the throbbing heart of hotness, am here to help!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Ohhhhh! This power blazing within me... It's… It's… It's a hotfix!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Now, it's my turn to show off!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: What's the situation?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: All units, move out!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Rock and roll!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Ready to launch!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Charging up!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'm here to help!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Detonation imminent!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Sonic boom—!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Deploying thermal shock!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Watch this!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Praise the heat!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Aren't I awesome? I knew your command would be a perfect match for me, Doctor!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: BRAVO~ BRAVO~!!!! Doctor!!!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: My retreat was just a fluke. Nothing must be allowed through our net on the battlefield.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Contact! Contact! Enemy ambush! Dropping smoke! Doctor, I'll cover your retreat!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Rest? Haha, it's too early for me! I just swapped to the newest energy storage device, so we have fifty more hours until the end of the workday!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: A-ha! My thermal sensor feels your burning heart!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Your burning enthusiasm has melted my processor!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! There's too much excess and zero majesty to playing songs on Monster Siren hi-fis and related devices! Allow me to use a hotter, more direct method to boost the vigor of this fireworks show! BANG!! Pewwwwww... BANG!!!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Welcome back, Doctor! I see that you're also full of light and heat today!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I hear the others are expressing their feelings of fondness for you by way of gifts, but you and I have no need for such tedious things to express our emotions! Our hearts have long been connected through heat and impact! Doctor! Happy birthday!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor!! Even I'm dazzled by the liveliness of this spectacle! Hesitate no more, come with me! Let us celebrate with the others!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Stand by for action.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Orders received. Initiating field command.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Dispatching.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Engaging.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Roger.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: At your command.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Originium Arts ready.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Initiating medical treatment.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Relight the spark of life.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: War is a plague, and I'm the cure.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: We make our own luck.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: No more suffering, no more pain.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Your commands were my thoughts as well, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Can I go live in here? I'm not really comfortable having a whole crowd standing around watching me stream, so I'd feel way more at ease in your office... Besides, I'm your assistant now anyway, heehee.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, I got to thinking that the stream incident might not have been a totally bad thing. After all, I got to know so many nice people ready to lend a helping hand, and you too... Shoot! I forgot to turn off my mic–– Yes, and all of you as well! With your support, I'll break out of this funk!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I need to decompress after that stream... Games? Doctor, were you even watching my stream? Chat wouldn't stop making fun of how much I suck. I don't wanna play another game this whole week... And that's why I need to practice every day? Uhh... I guess you have a point there?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Awwgh, it's so frustrating! How come a clip of me tripping over my words gets so many more views than all my VODs combined? I really don't understand viewers these days... Look, Doctor, what's so funny about this compilation of my brain-far—you just laughed, right? You totally laughed just now!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I won an award the first time I did a solo show. Pretty lucky, huh? What, don't believe me? Look right here, 'Awarded to the employee who stayed put until the end of the show during an earthquake'! Getting hit by an earthquake hit during your debut sounds unlucky? Ah-Ahaha...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I used to work my butt off every day so I could make more money, then shop more and shop better. But you know, when I use fancy concealer to hide my eye bags, I sometimes wanna cry... Oh, uh, s-speaking of crying, getting fired from the TV station made me want to cry a lot more.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: When I get up there to face my audience, the only advantage I have is the angle of my camera. But you, Doctor... You're the only one who watches my stream in person. You're my most special, and most unique audience. Ahem, it would be even nicer if you tossed a little dono my way~

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hello. You looking for the Doctor? What? No, no bother at all. The Doctor's fast asleep, and I'm just eating some dry instant noodles. Want a chunk?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello everyone, this is your omnipotent streamer, Eure—Errrr, sorry, scratch that. Rhodes Island operator, U-official! Reporting in, Doctor!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Doctor, I'm not gonna sugarcoat it. No matter how many vids like this I watch, I won't learn how to fight.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Go to war? Me?! This has to be a dream…

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: And you're giving me command of the squad to boot? This dream sure is funny, haha...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Well, since this is a dream anyway, I will mop up all the enemies for you!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Bow down before the true master! Wooooo-wata! Scared now?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Heehee, mind sending me the instructions... in a superchat?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Your streamer is in perfect condition and ready to go live!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Deep breaths... stay calm…

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Just treat it like a regular stream? I'll try!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Ah, ah, mic check! Can everyone hear me?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Let me know what you think in chat!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Next up, time to read the comments!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Dear viewer, for your aggressive behavior, you've been permabaned from the channel! Oh no!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: The battle's over, so why haven't I woken up from my dream yet... What? This isn't a dream? Then, how come I'm not hurt at all?!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Phew, it's finally over... Time to get a good night's sleep. I hope I don't have any more weird dreams about war.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Hey you guys running off there, don't forget to tell your friends and family about me. Thank you!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Waahhh… this is the worst ending to a stream I could've imagined…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Can I use this place as the backdrop for my next stream? No? Fine, I'll try someplace else then.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Don't jumpscare me like that! A monster just pushed me into the pit, now I have to do a 'no death run'…

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I'm done streaming, Doctor. Wanna take a walk around the deck?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: New Year's Special: Exploring flavor across the lands! Instant noodles inspired by the delicacies of each country! First up is this pack of Kjerag red-braised–– Hey, why's my viewer count dropping?! Don't leave, guys! I was just kidding!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Thanks for letting me stream from your office, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday to you~ Happy birthday to you~! I hope all of our friends out there celebrating birthdays today will enjoy eternal happiness! I'm gonna end stream slightly earlier this time, so see you guys tomorrow!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Back in Dossoles, the TV station would throw a year end party, but I never knew these could be so chill until I came to Rhodes Island... Huh? Are you talking to me? You want me to sing? Sure, but let me get this out of the way first– my musical tastes are pretty old-fashioned.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Truthfully, I've thought up countless possibilities about coming back here, looking out at the same scenery that she saw that day... But I never could have imagined that I'd actually be standing here with you. Heh, It's just too outrageous, 'Doctor.'

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Cook this, cook that, my turn to cook again… Oh, it's snowing.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Where'd I go? Can't tell you. Kal'tsit bypassed you and gave me a secret order... I'm lying? Oh my, I'm almost touched by how much you trust her. Fine, fine. I just went to splurge on a bunch of clothes, that's all. And I've already gone through inspection. What, are you surprised?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Hoederer, what's wrong? The book you wanted me to check out? How should I know? What's that pile of ash in the fire? That's... Oh, I 'mistook' the book for tinder a little while ago. Eh, it's fine. We're cooking dinner with knowledge tonight. It's gonna taste way better than usual, don'tcha think?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Some of your little cuties are always glaring at me through gritted teeth. But when are they actually gonna find the balls to pick a fight...? Kal'tsit already explained the situation? They're dealing with it? C'mon, show some respect for the needs of your staff. Just let 'em come at me. I'm bored out of my skull here anyway.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: How much ammo I got? I just used ten grenades, so I have fifteen left. And three mines spent yesterday, so six remaining... See, the numbers are correct. Hold it, I know what you're about to say. 'If only you applied that memory to study and read.' Seriously, Hoederer, you should've been a teacher.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You used to like working with us mercs a whole bunch. Mercenaries are efficient instruments of war. Just like fast food, ready to eat and easily disposable. You want to know what happened in the past? Hmm, some people would prefer I keep my mouth shut about that topic. Say, it must be such a blessing to not remember anything, right?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Check this potato, Ines got a head like so-Hmm... now that I think of it, you could probably squeeze a bomb into a potato. Maybe a good trick to play on some miserable dumbass. Hey, Hoederer, you want a potato?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Save the Infected? Almost all the Sarkaz in Kazdel are infected, and you haven't even seen the kinds of oppression and conflict that go on there... So, how far do you plan to go with this 'salvation'? You got Kal'tsit, who can't even protect ONE single Sarkaz. And you, a goddamned hooded amnesiac. Now, tell me, what are you gonna do?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Hey Hoederer, I've been thinking. If the two of us went at that nasty Kal'tsit together, how do you figure our chances taking her out? I mean, you guys are always planning for all contingencies, so we gotta have a plan for that one too, right? Hah, now that's a funny look on your face.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Look at these fresh operators of yours, starry eyes, full of naïvety. Can't help but wonder, if they had to watch those kind and gentle folk die, one by one, would they still do things the same way, with the same old song and dance?
