Hey, I'm not trying to look down on anyone. I'm just reminding you, don't just go twisting her ideas into some stupid little joke.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Hey Ines, maybe you should try to learn a thing or two from that {@nickname}. There's not a whole lot of people who could get away with using you as bait. I mean, you only figured it out halfway through. Me? One look at you and Hoederer's faces had my in stitches! Makes me wanna gift the Doctor a potato next time.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Hey you, ever noticed those little thingies Amiya wears? You do know that Kal'tsit is keeping stuff from you, right? Man, I thought you were super smart and observant and good at getting everyone to trust you, considering you don't remember a thing. Honestly, it's kinda weird that you can even trust other people. Makes me wonder what those two jerks would say if they saw you like this.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: My name... my name... Hey, Hoederer, you're always reading books, so why don't you come up with a name for me? Theresa said I should come up with a new one... Wait a second, what's with all those books? Pick a name myself?! Go to hell!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: This place sure does get all kinds, huh? A lot more weirdos here than before. Oh, don't get me wrong. I don't give a shit what they're thinking. But I gotta say, Amiya's doing a pretty good job. At least she's working hard to become more like a certain someone, and I can't say I hate that.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: 'Hoederer, if you've got a death wish, just say so.' 'Ines, trust me. My head's reserved for just you, okay?' That's how your lovers' spat went last time, Ines. I'm just giving you my best impression. What? You mad?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, since nobody's ever mentioned this to you before, I'm pretty curious how you'll react when you start to remember what happened— Don't give me that confused look. For now, just remember this name: Theresa. Yeah, Theresa.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: As soon as I'm done cooking, Ines always makes me help put up the tent, then Hoederer always drags me somewhere for recon. After that, there's always some kind of strategy meeting... Huh? Hey, Hoederer. Nothing. I was just talking about how I'll come collect your corpses when the two of you drop dead.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Somebody's got it easy. Never thought there'd come a day when the {@nickname} would be napping here completely defenseless... The past doesn't bug you at all, huh? Sleeping like a baby…

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Haghhh... I'll get some sleep before my next mission...

voices.title: Onboard

voices.text: My rings look different? I couldn't hide it from you, Doctor... You're right, one of them broke. But it's okay, Dr. Kal'tsit helped me switch it for a new one. Did... that have something to do with when I blacked out, you ask? Doctor...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Yes, another ring of mine broke. Dr. Kal'tsit says no material could stand against such intense emotion. But even though this ring is broken, I still want to keep wearing it. It's both a restraint and a blessing. I'll make good use of it.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I still have a lot to learn as leader of Rhodes Island. I hope you'll be there to guide me on our path to the future.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: In this whole operation, we gained no commercial profit at all, and we gave so much... But there are many things you can't weigh in terms of business value. Rhodes Island was never a company born exclusively for profit, and this land needs more than just physical medications.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Doctor, Blaze invited me to an event she's organizing. It's to celebrate our return to the landship, and a lot of elite operators will be there. Will I be joining them for drinks? No, of course I... Doctor, you and Dr. Kal'tsit are always looking after me, so you should know I've grown up a bit, but not that much.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Maybe it's just wishful thinking, but I hope Rhodes Island can be like a second home to everyone.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Chernobog's Reunion... it's over, and is there any more point to denouncing what they've done? Think of the people who trampled them, abused them, massacred them... hatred breeds hatred. That was something that should've never happened in the first place.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I've come to understand more and more how difficult it was for Theresa. What should I do? I think... I'll go and see Kazdel, as it is today. W will stand with me. And... there'll be more, others, in the future… Yes, I'm feeling more confident now.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Making it this far has cost us so much. Sometimes, I can't help but ask myself... is it really worth it?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Once, there was a Sarkaz betrayed, who walked this land bent on vengeance, only to cast his own life into the cycle of revenge. What I can't understand is, he'd already settled on his own end before he drew his sword. In his rage… he settled on death, with a clear mind.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I touched and felt Theresa's every emotion. She was full of love and hope... for this great land, the Sarkaz, the people by her side, and herself. But all of it came to a sudden end, along with her life. She was holding onto so much sorrow... and so am I.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Sometimes I remember where I came from... It was cold, and the air smelled of rusted copper. Rhodes Island is a cozy place in comparison. I'll do everything I can to protect our home.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Death should be carved into our memories, never to be forgotten, no matter who brought that death about, nor who was brought to. Our mistakes will never be right... those scars should always remind us, warn us how frail we are.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Dr. Kal'tsit has seen so much death. She was forced to watch many of her loved ones go, one by one. It's just... too painful. I've grown up now, so I can shoulder more responsibility for her. She doesn't have to walk alone anymore. Doctor, I want her to know that we're here for her.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Hehe… Dr. {@nickname}, let me tell you something: I picked up the violin again.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Even now, they still sometimes come to mind. Misha's gaze, FrostNova's roars, Patriot's cries... Ace, Scout, and so many operators sacrificed their lives for a single belief. But the Infected all across Terra—what is it that they've died for?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I expected as much... Thank you. Oh, Doctor? Do you want to talk with 'Civilight Eterna' too? Alright, come over here, don't be nervous... Just like this, feel the flowing energy. Feels like she's holding your hands, right? You'll get along well, I'm certain of it, and I always have been.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: We've still got a long, long way to go, Doctor. This might be a journey without an end, but as long as you're with me, we'll be okay.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor... recently... have I been a little less like myself? The nameless anger that rises up, time and again... is that mine? If so... no, even if so, I won't give up. I will protect you, Doctor, by this sword.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, I can feel your guilt, confusion... and sorrow. But you shouldn't be trapped by your past. This is what Theresa and I both wish for you. We still have lots of work to do. The one who ignited the flame of hope may no longer be with us, but the fire still burns. Babel never truly fell.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: There's still lots of work that needs to be done, Doctor. We can't afford to have you resting.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, are you okay? Do you need to rest a little? I'll help carry you. Don't worry, I'm doing fine. So long as you're rested.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, are you well-rested? If you're still feeling tired, you don't have to force yourself to work. I'm here, after all.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm so glad you're back, Doctor. Now we can walk this path together, me with you, and you with me.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor, it's so good to see you. My appearance? Um, please don't be afraid... I can explain this. But don't worry, Doctor. Whatever happens, I won't ever let you come to harm. I swear it.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Don't worry, Doctor, this is another one of my powers. I still can't heal every injury I see.... but I'll keep you safe. I'll protect the ones I love.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I see... thank you, Doctor! I've learned so much from you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: 'If the fight is unavoidable...' This is what the person I most trusted once taught me.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Could I use all my different powers in the same fight? Oh, Doctor. I was just talking to myself.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm so excited to fight by your side again, Doctor!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: What I saw that day... the despair stuck in my throat, hopelessly trying to scream... I want to bury it all deep inside my mind and never let it out…

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Got it.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Got it.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Yes, I understand.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I won't let you down.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I shoulder the wrath of so many others.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I can feel so much sorrow… so much sadness…

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Operation commencing!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Operation commencing. Let's go!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's keep moving forward.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Incoming! Get ready, everyone!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Incoming! Ready, all members!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Fighting... is the only option here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Amiya here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Amiya here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'm right here, Doctor.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: This sword thirsts for revenge... I won't permit it.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'm here, Doctor.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Got it!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: My sword is cloaked in Chi Xiao's shadow.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: This staff is bound to my thoughts.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Roger.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Madam Ch'en's swordsmanship... flows within this weapon.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Mine and Theresa's emotions... I'll manifest them here.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I know what you're thinking.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Drop your weapon!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Love will heal our scars.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Everyone believes in me...

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Your thought, your Arts, I can cut them.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Tears will bathe new life.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Are you afraid of me?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: 'With what do I answer your failure of justice?'

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Nostalgia... won't slow my steps.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I hear... someone crying?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Do not... make me angry.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: 'Through the grim perils of the longest night, we shall breach into the promised dawn.'

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: No matter how difficult the mission, we can handle it as long as you're here, Doctor. I've never doubted you.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, thank you for always supporting me. Our battles will only get harder from here, but we can't give up.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I don't want to lose anyone else. I'll carry on this fight, for every sacrifice, and all those still alive.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We may have achieved a perfect victory, but we still can't let our guard down.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: How long do we fight? How long until the flames of anger on this land die down...

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The flames of hatred still spread. I'll try to extinguish them, no matter... how many times it takes.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Well done, Doctor! You must be exhausted. Be sure to rest when you need it.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, good job. Let me handle the clean-up.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I've made a few slips... No, it's not your fault, Doctor. I could have done better here.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'm fine... Get it together, everyone!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: ...What happened? This shouldn't have...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I won't let anyone hurt you, Doctor. Hold onto me, and don't let go, okay?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: You want something to drink, Doctor?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Phew... we can take a little breather now, right?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I'm so glad to be home.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh? Doctor?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Whuh, Doctor...!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Yes, Doctor?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Ehehe...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, could you... hear me out for a bit? Is that okay?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, do you have something to say?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! Please make sure you get lots of rest today... Y-You've already worked for the better part of the day? Did I get here too late? Sorry...Blaze just asked me to get my height measured... Oh, you're just joking? Thank goodness.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: For a brief moment, I could hear a voice growling deep within my heart: The suffering on these lands is eternal, and nothing can be turned around in such a short span of time... No, I refuse to accept that, Doctor. I trust that our journey and our fight are meaningful.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Where's that form...? Hmm... I'm looking for a financial statement from Closure. Where did I put it...? Right here! Oh, it's a summary report from HR... Which reminds me, I haven't checked the new purchase order yet either... Doctor, I won't make it to the party. So I'll wish you a happy new year right here. Ahem-hem: happy new year! Oh? You want to stay with me?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Welcome home, Doctor!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Welcome home, Doctor!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Welcome home, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, if you can remember even some of your past... That would make me really happy. Right, I'm still not very good at the violin, but... since you're the only one here to listen, there's a song I'd like to practice. A sort of nostalgic song.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Does it feel strange at all to celebrate a birthday that you don't remember? Does it... feel like... that's not you? It doesn't? Thank goodness. Doctor, I'd like to take out my violin and give it another try. Perhaps this time I won't break any strings.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Do you want me to... play the violin like before? I didn't get to sneak in much practice... Oh, the time we have to ourselves just gets shorter and shorter these days... But luckily, I know your favorite tune by heart, and I'll never forget it.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I remember the names of those who've left us, and I can still feel the lingering fear, rage, and pain of battle. But if I'm to give a speech in front of everyone, I want to tell a story of hope instead. Doctor, I'm a little nervous... Could you hold my hand, please?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: There is no avoiding pain if we are to end the vicious cycle that is hatred. Nevertheless, I believe there will come a day when I can set down this blade. Doctor, until that day comes, I'll protect you at all costs. I only hope that... it won't be you who gets hurt.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Another year has passed, and Rhodes Island is still sailing onwards. Doctor, tonight was just so wonderful I wish I could hide it away, deep in my mind. Thank you for staying by my side. We'll spend this very same day next year, together.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Eh, how come work at the Engineering Department here is even more exhausting than Blacksteel? Good thing I've got some easy paperwork for a change of pace. Lemme start with this one. Umm... Hehe, sorry I bothered you, Doctor. I've got work to do, so I'm heading back to Engineering.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, you should've told me you dropped something behind this shelf. Look at you, wriggling around on the floor all day. Alright, get up. I've got specialized tools I use to carry bulky, heavy engineering equipment. We'll move it aside and grab your stuff. Do you have earplugs, though? It's probably gonna hurt your ears when I tow around this heavy-ass metal shelf...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Be brave, Laura. If you want your work to go smoothly and advance your career, you gotta take the plunge. Think about your future... Think about your dreams... Ah! What are you doing behind me?! I, I'm fine, it's just... I gotta get an injection tomorrow. I'm... I'm trying to get myself ready.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: If you ask me, the most annoying part of engineering projects and experiments is the funding! Even when you get your hands on it, you still have lots to worry about. Everything I do costs money, and every monthly account statement is red as hell, and my budget's always like toilet paper! Speaking of, how much funding can you give me next month? I gotta start planning early.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My whole family lived in a single basement room when we first moved from Bolívar to Columbia. The space under my mother's bed was my first 'engineering lab.' I made lots of weird trinkets there. But I also got smacked just as much, heheh.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The power plant is like the heart of a nomadic plate. During my years in the field with my team, I've basically been its primary physician. Either I'm giving it all I got to recover its pulse, or... I'm pronouncing it dead when there's nothing more I can do.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Hey, hey, Doctor! Down here! Look at me! I've got good news. Our engineering project just had a major breakthrough. Don't stand there like a bump on a log. Come, let's sit down, I'll show you... Oh my gosh, I'm sorry, I forgot to wash my hands. I got a handprint on your coat....

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Nah, don't worry. My kneecap's not hurt. I just have a small crystal there, so I hide it with a band-aid. I know there's no need to hide it here, but I'm used to it. You know, Doctor, sometimes I wonder, If I'd met you guys before Blacksteel... Never mind. We don't have time for what-ifs.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, you give everything you've got, even when there's nothing in it for you, just like Jessica. I'm not nearly as selfless as you guys, but I know when to be grateful. I won't let you down or squander the money and trust you two invested in me. I promise.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Falling asleep right on your desk... and your hair blocking your eyes like that. Hmm, guess I'll leave you this bone-shaped hairpin.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Pleasure to meet ya! I'm the engineer Blacksteel sent here on exchange. Just call me Almond. Are you the Doctor Jessica's always talking about? Let me get a good look at you. Hmm... You seem fine and... Normal, I guess?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Now this is interesting. I never thought you could use engineering machinery like that.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Oh, you shouldn't have. It's all a part of our contract. I'm just doing my job so… Hold on! What did you just say...? Invest · ment?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Aw, come on. you can drop the act. I've worked on so many projects with Rhodes Island's Engineering Department. You're not here just to nitpick, are you?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: You need my tech on the battlefield too? No problem!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I used to lead an engineering team, but now a combat team…? Alright, let's do this. Everyone, listen for the whistle!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Woo! I just got a new idea. Better write it down as soon as the fight's over.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Careful now, 'cause you won't escape once my little friends catch you!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Need me for something?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: You need anything, I'm your girl!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: It's all just like the blueprints. Peerrfect!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Even without a blueprint, I'm adaptable enough to work it out.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: All parameters set. Fire!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Sheesh, why are you so heavy?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Get over here!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Oh shoot, my grappling hook's stuck! Sorry for tripping you!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor! Once we're back, be sure to check my blueprints! I can't just let you go when you've got such a great mind!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Good work, Doctor! Want a cookie? Too tough to chew...? Hmm… I think it's fine…

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I would've liked a more perfect finish, but these results aren't so bad.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Laying down smoke! Doctor, we'd better fall back while the enemy can't see us!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: The wiring in this room's terrible. Who did this? I'm gonna sort everything out here line by line.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Wai-wai-wait! Don't push! You'll mess up all the cables in my backpack!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: No · touching · my head!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, why you suddenly have three heads...? Now I gotta make four more sets of... uh... ear plugs, for the player that's gonna be your birthday gift...Wha? I had too much to drink? Don't be silly! Franka tried to get me to drink a whole big-ass mug, but I only had a-a teeny tiny little bit!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I'm all set, Doctor. Ready to start working whenever!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I got you a set of puzzles for your birthday. You'll find out what my present is if you manage to solve it. Sounds like fun, right? Hmm... How come you look like you've figured it out already?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Every day I've spent on Rhodes Island has been very fun, but since I started having fun, it's been hard to get absobed in my work like I did at Blacksteel. Er, how should I put it? Blacksteel feels more like a place for work, while Rhodes Island is more like... hehe, you know, home.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: All my tasks must relate to the sea or Iberia. Huh? You have too much work? Okay, I'll make some time to help you out.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I have to get back to my handcannon practice once I'm done with my work here. Rhodes Island has shooting lessons? No, I'll pass. An inquisitor's handcannon isn't your normal firearm. It's not better aim you need to fully master it. It's an indomitable will.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: It's been bugging me, so I really have to ask. Is Skadi like that when she talks to you, too? Like... Does she always say only the bare minimum, nothing more? Huh? No? She's actually very sentimental? Wait, are we really talking about the same Ægir?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I make the other Iberian Operators nervous? To fear the Inquisition is to fear the law. Isn't that only natural? Unless... Some of our Ægirs have their reasons to dodge my gaze. I'll make it clear now. I can't promise I won't fight them.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: 'For Iberia's prosperity, for Iberia's defense, and for Iberia's orderliness and integrity, I shall raise my sword and my light!'—I may not be an Inquisitor anymore, but I know very well that my duty remains the same.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The scriptures tell us the light of an Inquisitor's lantern is the light of faith within our hearts. It wasn't until I saw my master's last ray of light that I truly understood what this means. When an Inquisitor lays down judgment, her ruling should be based not on law, but instead her own heart.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Um... Do you have any old Iberian records? Any that can still play? I brought my master's record player... I know it's silly to dwell in our past glory, but I really want to know what Iberians could have been.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The truth felt like it swallowed me whole when it happened. Was I wavering? Crumbling? Despairing? No, I couldn't feel anything... until I killed another Sea Terror. I finally realized that I fought only because I wanted to live. Isn't that just like Iberia today?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: All I did was sprain my shoulder on my last mission. The bite wound the mission before that's almost all healed up, too. Stop selling me short! I'm pretty jealous of those Ægir hunters power... Hmph forget it! When I get back... Um, you said I could go to the Rhodes Island ball. That's a promise, right?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: We're still in deep water, and you managed to fall asleep in a blink of an eye? It makes me wonder if I should be jealous... Fine, you can have your rest for now. I'll be waiting here.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Irene, Inquisition Messenger of Iberia. Are you the Doctor of Rhodes Island? It seems the Ægir hunters really trust you... Do show me how special you are as we work together in the future.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hm... Are these all your operators? Is it just me or do some of them seem like an actual security risk? Alright, fine. I will try my best to focus on their combat techniques…

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: What I need is Rhodes Island's power, not a commendation. But… I mean... this ribbon looks nice… Okay, I'll take it.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: It doesn't matter if Iberia faces ferocious tides or heavy storms. I will never back down, and my blade will never waver again!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Perfect. I've been very curious to see how Rhodes Island carries out its missions.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I thought it would be years before I could lead a team alone... I won't disgrace my master.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Follow my light. Watch out for the tides and mist.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The most dangerous enemies are usually masters of disguise .

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: See the light of my lantern? I'm right here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Don't step into the shadows.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: My sword will respond the instant I spot the movement.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Locked and Loaded.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: My light will purge the vice!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: My blade will cleave the tides!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: My eyes will find the truth!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: My heart will be the judge.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: The tide still comes in. We can't let our guard down yet. Hm...? I'm smiling? What? Is there a rule that you can't smile after a victory?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Is this how you command the Ægir hunters too? Seems like the victory that the arrogant doctor promised might actually be plausible.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Letting even a single enemy slip by could crumble our line of defense! Hurry, give me the order! Let me eliminate the threat!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: An Inquisitor must never yield in the face of evil! But I also made a promise to my master. I can't die here. Not yet.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: You have a pretty big ship here, but it's not nearly as roomy as an old Iberian flagship.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Sea Terror?! Oh, it's you.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Didn't you promise to show me around? If you were going to disappear the moment things got busy, you could've asked me to help.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: New Year's already? The tides draw even closer to us now. Sorry, it's hard not to think about that. On the flipside, we can count ourselves lucky for being able to walk the lands this upcoming year, can't we?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, there's new movement on the tides. We need to talk.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy Birthday, Dr. {@nickname}. Because of the situation in Iberia, I've never had the breathing room to celebrate someone's birthday, but you gave me this moment of reprieve, and I have to put it to good use. Here, pick your favorite piece of music. We'll start with that.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: You want to cure Oripathy? After I saw for myself what Iberia... No, after I realized the threat the sea poses to us all, I started to think... it may not be all that unrealistic.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: What? You think this work is going to do itself? Hmph! There's no such fairy who'd finish somebody's work off while they go dozing off. Forget your wild ideas and get your nose to the grindstone, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I and my companions will often receive children who come to the castle. Of course, on occasion we'll have a good and honest adult come lodging, but that sort of person is few and far between.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I came to find a girl named Mabel. Ah, twenty years ago she was a girl. She's a woman by now. ...Codename? How would I know what her codename is? But I know for certain she's here, without a doubt!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: If there's nothing to keep us, then let me take my leave. I'm still quite busy. I have an appointment with the children being treated here, and I'll be telling them stories today.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Children are much better off compared to adults. Children are much more innocent. They have fine qualities. They are the most valuable, cherished thing upon this world.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: A beloved rag doll, a pretty flower, a storybook turned until its pages are worn... Children who've come to Wonderland have left much to the castle. Things they believe are precious, that they haven't much way of keeping safe themselves, all can be put into our care.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Now come wisplight and lamplight, come light up the way~ Come to our little tea party to stay~♪ Here come the guards, and they dance and sing for us, carrying scissors to chop-chop away♪ I sang this song about my friends to entertain the children with me. Learned the words? I shan't sing them to you again.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I know. Mabel's no longer with us. You called her Bluishsilver, didn't you? I've seen records... asked after her with her teammates—her tale is so sad. How strange. Though this is the time we'd set, I can't help but feel I was too late...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: 'Wonderland,' 'Slumberland,' 'the Cradle'... have you never heard these names before? Oh, you poor soul. Had no-one ever told you any bedtime stories? ...Sigh. Oh, I suppose. Close your eyes, now. I'd rather not, but let's have you see for yourself, just once.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Oh, really! How do you fall asleep somewhere like this? And the files are all still at sixes and sevens! ...Fine. Seeing that you work so hard normally, I'll help you just this once...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Iris, Master of the Castle of Dreams, Keeper of the Cradle. As per our agreement, I've come to return something a guest once left to the castle... How strange. Why can I not find her?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: How barbarous, though it does have its merits.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm the master of a castle. If we're to talk promotions, I ought to be giving one to you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Right, then! You'll see first-hand the full power of the Master of the Castle! Fairytales uphold such purity, such beauty, and they owe it only to their protectors' sufficient strength. Is Rhodes Island not like this, too?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Oh, fine, I suppose.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Listen to my orders, now. Agreements made are not to be violated.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I will lead you all to the proper place.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: And those are the people we're driving off, then?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Right.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Don't push me.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: The air is quite thick here.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Hmph! I'll help you just this once.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Would you all like a bedtime story too?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: You shan't pass!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Impertinent!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Seeing dreamland, now?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: How's that? I've driven them all off, now!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: So this is the taste of victory. Yet... I wonder why I can't feel happy about it...

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Hmph. They've run off by themselves. Doesn't that sort things?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: What's going on? Did you fall asleep?! Quick, with me, out of here!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What a strange place. Is there no larger bed anywhere?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ah—my fan! Give that back!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Careful, there, don't ruffle the headdress... yes, quite, comb just like that...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Another year has gone by. As time passes like this, I always feel a little frightened. The children will grow up gradually, year by year, but I have to wonder, is that a good thing? Doctor, is growing up... something good?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good day to you, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Are you awake? Do you remember what you dreamt of? An unending sea of iris flowers, a dance at the castle, fireworks under a starry sky. Didn't you feel as though you'd rather not wake up? Those scenes are meant to be reserved for the children, but I can make an exception for you, just this once. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: By all rights, children are meant to be the hope of our land, yet Oripathy spells such early ends to their lives. Lives I can never even save... I can only hope to protect their fledgling dreams as best I can. That is my ideal, and why I must walk with Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I can be your assistant, but is it okay if I do some craft work here?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, if you like excitement, you should probably stay in Siracusa for a while. You won't enjoy it so much after that.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Considering his personality, sometimes even I wonder why no one's beaten Chiave to death yet.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Doctor, are you interested in DIY? See, the three of us actually design and make our own weapons and outfits. You could join us sometime, if you want.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: After cleaning up Chiave’s messes so many times, I’ve realized something: If you want real power, you’ll need to rely on more than just violence.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: In Siracusa, most people my age just want to join a famiglia, but there are plenty more who would rather live an honest life instead. Sometimes, I think those are the strongest of us all.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: (Yawn) …Oh, sorry, Doctor, I didn't get much sleep last night. Rhodes Island is way too safe. It's taking some time to get used to.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Chiave, Broca, and me. The three of us are like brothers, and we've done all kinds of things together. But, sometimes, I really wonder if this really is the life for us.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: To tell you the truth, I wanted to be a public servant when I was a kid. Up until my dad made me pick up a weapon for the first time, that is. I don't mind drifting around with the other two, but I always felt like I was missing something, and I know what it is now. I wanted to become as strong-willed as you are, Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor... you're asleep? You sure live a comfy life, heh? I'm pretty jealous.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. I'm Aosta. It's thanks to you that the three of us are still alive. If you don't mind, please let us work here for the time being.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Maybe we're still alive only because of a stroke of luck…

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, is Rhodes Island really a pharmaceutical company? I've got the feeling that we might just be able to take over a Siracusan city if everyone here put themselves to it.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I think I might just be able to live the life I've always wanted at Rhodes Island... Doctor, could I apply to open a DIY shop here?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I hope this isn't going to be too much trouble.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll give it my best shot.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's avoid any unnecessary fights.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Guess we don't have a choice. Let's get this taken care of.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'll go.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Yes?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Take them all down?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Let me give it a shot.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Hello.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Farewell.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Time to put an end to this.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Tsk.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, do you enjoy challenging yourself so much?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I got all of them. I just hope they're worth it.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: A few of them got through, but I think we'll be fine.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, you go on ahead. I'll clean up the mess here. It's my speciality, after all.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I'll just walk around, then.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: I can walk, Doctor.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: How are things going, Doctor?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: New Year's used to be the three of us hiding in a small room, scraping together a table of assorted dishes to, at the very least, eat something together. And that's all. I never imagined having such a lavish New Year's celebration as this… Don't worry, Doctor, I'll keep an eye on Chiave and make sure he stays out of trouble.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I've never given a gift before, so I'm not sure what you might like… Is there anything in particular you want? Just give me an hour, I may DIY it for you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Oh, Doctor, I got a lot of orders for props tonight. Did you notice? A whole lot of the decorations hanging around are my creations… Ah, don't worry, I enjoy this festive atmosphere well enough. Would you like me to make you some too? Free of charge, and I'm sure you'll be pleased with the results.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You need me for something? Hah... Look at all these papers on the desk, each one filled with words. Just the sight of them makes me want to cut them up!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Hfph—haah... Leave me alone. I'm trying to feel my new technique. Aren't techniques meant to be conceived, you say? Hmph, not for me. I just need to quiet down and feel it with my heart. When the time comes, my technique will naturally unfold on my blade.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: That ninja... She may evade your eyes, but she cannot fool my senses. I know not what she schemes, but I can promise you I shall not engage her here and now. However, if I find her trying to harm my master... You won't be able to stop my blade.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Who says my eye sight is poor? Heh! This medical report is utter nonsense. If you doubt me, send your strongest, swiftest warriors, and as many as you want. Have them attack me from any direction all at once. If they can make it anywhere close to my body, I'll accept defeat.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: It hurts my head to hear righteous principles. Especially when those hypocrites go on and on like preaching scriptures. Hmph, the principles in their mouths are just fancy garbage. For benefit, they will stab even their family in the back. These shameless cowards, my katana will slice them apart!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I've seen winters like that many times. The snow would turn red the moment it hit the ground. My enemies were everywhere. Lying, sitting... I never saw their faces, nor did I care to. My face and chest felt cold, but my hands gripping my blade were warm. Tsk, why am I even telling you all this? Just forget what I said.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Um? How many times have I told you? Don't stand in front of me all of a sudden! What? You wanted me to see you better? You're a strange fellow. I don't need to look at you to know it's you. You think I would just let anybody come this close to me?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Dr.{@nickname}, you remind me of my master when you get serious. I suppose it's because… both you and her compel yourselves to go forward in chase of a grand, ambitious goal.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My master had me come to Rhodes Island for some peace and quiet, but there is no peace to be had as long as the flames of war rage in my homeland. Nonetheless, as a commander, you have my respect. {@nickname}, I am under your command. Together, we will take to the battlefield, and I shall slay everyone that stands in our way as your blade!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hmm… The air here is nice and cool. Hey you, move over a bit. Let me lie down for a while too.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Akafuyu, samurai, the strongest you'll find. Worrying about my katana? Haha, unlucky for you, I carry it with me wherever I go. You better keep your distance if you are scared.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Oi oi, I'm already strong enough. Stop wasting my time!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I don't need anyone's approval. However, I appreciate your gesture, and will repay the favor with my katana.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Heh, if those guys were here, we'd be out drinking and celebrating. How about this, Dr.{@nickname}. YOU come with me! We'll drink till we drop tonight!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Let's get going already. My katana is starting to rust.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Now we're talking! All of you, with me!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Now! To battle!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: No matter who, I shall slay them by my katana!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I've been waiting to slay.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Off to the front!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: You will feel my blade!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Now… I strike!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Come one, slay one! Come a thousand, slay all!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Not only your head, I will cut your will to fight!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: My katana knows its targets.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Where are the foes actually worth fighting?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Hardly a challenge. I barely broke a sweat.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Some enemies got through? Impossible. There's no way I didn't see them.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I won't run away. My blade has not failed me, I can still fight!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What a small room! Don't keep me waiting in here for too long! I might just draw my katana!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmph... You see, if you were my enemy, I would already have sliced you in half.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Come on, let's get ourselves all the ale and meat!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, and why so late to rise? I'm already back from my training. Let me tell you, think of a wish. On the first day of the new year, make 1,000 sword swings. Then that wish will come true. Do not ask whether it's true! It's real, as long as you believe it.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Yo, Doctor, how about some katana training together?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Oh? Today's your birthday, Dr.{@nickname}? Haha! Come, I'll take you for ale and meat! Honestly, why stay quiet about a day so important? Hm? You wonder what I would've gotten you if I knew? Well, need you ask? Better ale and even more meat!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Never have I asked you what we fight for, yes? Stop, no need for an answer. Words are the least reliable of all. I only care that you've considered the question, and considered it well. Lead us forth on a just path, Doctor, and I assure you my katana will be sharp enough to cut through all.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: No problem, Doctor. I've got your back.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: How do I aim while I'm skating? It's real simple, want me to show you? Here, put your hand on mine.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Way back when, I, like a lot of my friends, took pride in being different. But after I became infected, I realized that alone wasn't cool. Life isn't something that you should let a little bit of Originium dust control, you gotta take charge yourself.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: An old cop taught me how to shoot with a crossbow, and his daughter taught me how to skate. As for how to put the two together... that's called being self-taught.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Don't get me wrong, skateboarding is just one of my hobbies... and the first way I had to really find myself. The real exciting part comes after that though, wanna hear?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Why'd I want to become a combat operator...? Doctor, what do you think is most important for us giggling and laughing 'street gangsters?' Of course it's freedom. I'm willing to fight for freedom, so that's why I'm fighting for Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I have a lot of regrets about becoming Infected, such as the graffiti mural at the park that I left half-finished. Also, I can't eat any more of that old cop's secret-formula onion rings, huh? That's about it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I came to Rhodes Island with the mindset of getting my illness treated. Thought it'd be some stuffy place that reeked of disinfectant where everyone would be confined to their rooms... But man, I was surprised to find out, even though tagging isn't allowed inside the ship and all, that Ethan guy... Actually, nevermind.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I found a way to express myself through donut hamburger combo meals, skateboarding, and hip-hop competitions. How 'bout you, Doctor? If you get burnt out, you should come kick it with me and Vigna. We'll just... hang out. Hanging out is in our DNA. Gotta respect it.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: If you're tired, just go rest. I'll be here.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Aciddrop, Operator. This skateboard here is a piece of registered equipment, yeah. If you have any problems, just give me a holler.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Damn, that's cool.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion, huh? Thanks. The last time this happened was when I just won the Crab Cup, huh?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: That old geezer originally taught me to use a crossbow so I could protect myself from the chaos on the streets. Who would've thought that one day, I'd be using it to protect the freedom of the Infected?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: You got it.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Teamwork's an important part of scoring as well.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's go.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Enemy sighted.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm right here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: C'mon, how do I deal with these guys?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Now this is some exciting stuff.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: That's some sweet terrain.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Jump!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Time to show off a bit.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I'm over here~

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Kickflip, then kick ass.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Good work out there, Doctor... Oh, can you come with me to get a couple screws switched out after we get back?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The moment when you overcome a challenge is always the best feeling, right?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Should we chase after 'em? If you ask me, I can still catch up.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Ugh... Can't believe I messed up such an amateur move...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This bit of wall here looks pretty suitable... Uh, I didn't say anything.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Wahh!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Wanna head down to the canteen together? If I don't make any mistakes on this trip, promise to treat me to some juice.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Oh, Doctor, Happy New Year! We've got a block party in a bit. Why don't you come show off your moves? You could give breakdancin' a shot? It ain't that hard, I'll teach ya!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: You're still working? Let's go get some exercise outside. Wait, you volunteered for overtime? Doctor, ain't no point in workin' this much. Life only begins once you clock out! C'mon, what do you wanna eat? It's on me.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I used to skate to ditch class n' get away from the adults. Then, it was to lose the cops when I was out tagging. I said I did it in the name of freedom, but thinkin' back, I guess that was kinda selfish. We fight harder for other people's freedom than our own, don'tcha think? Like what we're doin' here.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Don't bother checking, it's me. We've got a situation, so I swapped schedules with your other assistant. Don't worry, you'll get used to this.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: That HR op wants me to take a break? Hmph, I know she means well, but I won't rest until she's willing to take a break herself. One of S.W.E.E.P.'s functions is to take care of her work while she's out. We might as well keep things as they are. What's S.W.E.E.P. established for? You don't need to know.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Don't trouble yourself trying to figure me out. Even the old you couldn't manage it. Remember, it's my own choice to vanish from your sight. With my duty fulfilled, I won't be interfering with Rhodes Island's future plan. But when you need me, I'll be there.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Amnesia is a convenient excuse. You're the only one who knows if you are faking it or not. But since you've taken Rhodes Island this far, true or not, I won't question you. I'm watching you, Doctor, same as ever.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: When we face Theresis, that will be our final curtain call. What about the future? No point in playing with hypotheticals. W, Hoederer, Closure... Those who witnessed Babel's struggle still stand united with Rhodes Island. They are the future.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: When people talk about Her Highness, they treat her like the unattainable future of the Sarkaz. But to me, she is who she is. She trips over her dress, she intentionally 'forgets' certain meetings, she gives me hugs. Pass over that 'Theresa'? I wouldn't hesitate to do so.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Back when I was wandering the wastes, I didn't fear the dark of night. It scared me less than the sandbeasts biting my toes. Even now, seeing them still makes me feel kinda nervous. It's fine, no harm in letting you know.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Mercenaries, spies, nobles, convicts... Rhodes Island these days is far more complex than back in the Babel times, and the threats are greater too. It's natural for you to worry. How would the old you have handled it? Doesn't matter. This you knows what to do.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: S.W.E.E.P. never expressed any opinion on the Chernobog operation. Saving you was a unanimous decision by Dr. Kal'tsit and the elite operators. I didn't kill you back then, because I needed time to observe you. In view of the present, my judgment seems correct. Doctor, don't disappoint me.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Fate. I've pursued it, confronted it, and finally strangled it to death. You've done the same.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Ascalon, it's my only name. Call it a code name if you like. But if you want to update my file, you'll have to speak to Dr. Kal'tsit first.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: The training paid off. Not bad.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: S.W.E.E.P. was established as an independent unit. It's out of Rhodes Island's structures from the very beginning, so this framework doesn't apply to me. You have a new approach? I appreciate the recognition, but those of us in the shadows don't care for glory.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: It's not time yet. Only the darkness can shroud all the filth. Doctor, when the day comes that Rhodes Island no longer needs S.W.E.E.P., I'll come to you, and take it.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Go right ahead at any moment. I'll be there.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I've assessed the risks. I'll lead the team on this operation.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Keep track of my position. I'm ready to strike.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Engaging. Go!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: No one knows my name.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: They only remember my blade.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: No one can see me.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I got this. Focus elsewhere.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Follow me into the shadows.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Right behind you.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You've stepped into my domain.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Meet me, meet your death.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Confidence of our companions is earned. The road ahead is perilous, these victories are precious.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Limit the enemy's choices, forcing them into unwitting traps. A familiar style... Hmm... you really don't remember anything? Sooner or later, you'll have to face yourself, so think carefully. Bear in mind, this time, I'm ready to correct your mistakes.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The ones who got away will be useful, when the time is right. Don't chase them too hard, Doctor.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Keep moving ahead with confidence, and don't look back. Seeing me again means you're safe.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I know where to go. I can handle myself.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Try again if you dare.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Tired? No, it's peaceful here.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It's not easy to celebrate New Year's in Kazdel, where you always face unpredictable threats. That's why I cherish the changes we've seen at Rhodes Island over the years. Thank you, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: With a foot in the darkness, the light becomes clearer. You want to see? No, you don't belong there.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: The party is too loud, so you came out for some fresh air? I've been here all along, you just didn't see me. Your safety is the most important thing. And in such a mixed company, reducing my presence makes the mission easier. Oh, and happy birthday, I didn't get a chance to say it inside.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Babel is history. Her Highness has shown that that path has no future. And while Rhodes Island's future is even more challenging now, you have ever more companions. I have no doubt that Rhodes Island is on the right path.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I drew up the work schedule for you. Please kindly follow.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: How to make a celestial globe is a secret, but as we know, anything can be on the table for a fair price. I'd be happy to reveal my trick of the trade as long as your price is right.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Observing the stars everyday makes my neck sore. Wonder if the medics would have any suggestions for that... What, Miss. Warfarin is the physician on duty today? Um... I'll check again another day.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Astrology is learning about the present and the future from celestial alignments. It's not quite divination, but with the same result. So, would you like to give it a try, Doctor? It's free of charge!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: 'Similar genes, among blood relatives, causes, uh, reverberations of Originium...' I can barely understand a word in this work of an occultist. Doctor, Can you interpret the medical report for me?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Ever since my Oripathic infection, the stars have diminished their responses to me. I must find a way to reverse it before I lose all my power. Otherwise I'l… Could you help me, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You want to know more about the organization I'm with? Sorry, I took an oath not to divulge anything, and it's not for public knowledge, anyway. If you're curious, just think of it as a completely neutral community.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Sometimes, I envy Astgenne...  Ah, guess I should call her Elena now. She has everything I'm missing... But like you said, Doctor, we relied on each other because we complement each other, that's why we're sisters.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: As the nights bid us farewell, so do the starlights fade and quell. If this is the end that awaits us ahead, I should be picking up something more meaningful to do. Such as? Umm... Doctor, do you mind me waking you up every morning?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: The tea's ready, Doctor. Time for a little break.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Astesia, astrologer, reporting for guard duty. I'm yours to command, Doctor.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: No report after viewing?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion medal? How exquisite. I'll treasure it well.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Stars shine bright, bearing witness of our past nights.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'm over here, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Let me be the guiding star for all.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: There's no turning back now.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The stars will light our way.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Ready for action.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Is it my turn, Doctor?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Don't panic, Astesia. Do it like you usually do.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Time to prove myself.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Defend with me, steadfast Taurus.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Lend me your wings, avians among the stars!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: The serpent has brought about your end.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: The light of stars shall be my blade!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: So this is 'our' power, a power even the stars failed to foresee...

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Fantastic results, Doctor. But don't overwork yourself, be sure to rest up well.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: If I put in more effort, maybe the outcome could be better…

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'm dead on my feet... but it's not time to quit yet

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Let me see... Yes, the layout's good. The furniture won't attract any unwanted spirits this way.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: W-Wait!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: W-What's that... something on my face?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: A year's outset, and the start of another cycle. Before the stars fade in their response, would you like to try making a wish to them through me?  Today is the day wishes most easily come true, you know. Come, take a look at my celestial globe...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday. Your present is in the box before you. Whatever delights you will surely delight me too. Now, close your eyes, say the name of something you like, and then open it.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I appreciate Rhodes Island for being there for me and my sister. The pain Oripathy exacts on my body, is far from surpassing the doubt I have in my own life of study... but the Medical Department is still helping me to find out why I'm losing my power. So there's still hope for everything, isn't there?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: No problem. I've done all of this before, and I won't have any trouble handling it, but let's be up front, Doctor: If you come to me in the evening with a stack of documents and tell me to sort everything out that night, chances are that you might not get what you want.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Research is actually kind of a pain. Sometimes, you go all in on your research. Other times, you have to spend time going over progress with somebody else. You need to know your specialty like the back of your hand, and you also need people skills. If I wasn't already decent at both, my head would've exploded a long time ago.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My sister Astesia is really good at our family's chicanery, but she only ever uses it to help people. To think there would be such a pure, kind-hearted shyster running around... Oh, Doctor, don't tell anyone about this! Please, I'm begging you! If she finds out I told, Astesia will whap me upside the head!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Rhine Lab? Hmm... Sorry, I don't really want to talk about them right now. If that place were really so great, I wouldn't have asked for a transfer to Rhodes Island, right? Okay, break time's over! Back to work!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm the one who got infected, but then even Astesia... *sigh*... You probably can't tell, but she's actually pretty depressed. Enough is enough, I gotta do something to help her.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Columbia's technology keeps advancing, and as a researcher, I can almost see that future I'm looking for. My dream is right there, and I'm going to make it come true.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Our family's... well, how should I say this? My parents are the old-fashioned type that like to order people around. They don't care about your opinions, only the joy of being in control. It sucks. That's why I haven't been back home since college. Now they can't stop me from studying the stuff I like.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: There are those who help because they really want people to have a better life, but there are also those who help so they can use people as stepping stones. Doctor, you know how to tell the two apart, don't you? It's easy. You just need to look at the way they smile.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My dad's kinda famous back in the city, and our names are a little peculiar, so I thought I'd give myself a new name to get away from all that trouble. But feel free to call me whatever you want, Doctor. We're friends, don't sweat it.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Yes, this is the Doctor's office. Yes, the Doctor is resting right now. Please call back later.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Researcher Elena Urbica of Rhine Lab. A pleasure to make your acquaintance. We're supposed to call each other by codenames here, right? No problem. In that case, call me Astgenne. It's simple and easy to remember.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I don't think I've seen a problem like that before. Gotta take notes...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: What a pretty medal! Let me help you pin it on. Hm? How come you're the one wearing it instead of me? Isn't this commemorating your good eye for people?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Let's join together and break the shackles, Doctor! The future is unfolding right before our eyes!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Hello, everybody!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Hold on a sec. I'll finish reading the team leader's messages in a jiffy.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: All charged up and ready to go.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I'll show you the power of technology.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: How about here?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Alright.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Acknowledged.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Miracles don't just drop out of the sky.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Computations complete.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I'm not gonna sit here and wait for my demise.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: My lightning will illuminate the starry sky!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: You had even the finest details under control. You must be a professional.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I knew everything was going to be okay.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Everything's under control~ Just a little scuffed, that's all...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: No way... How could my calculation have...?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Let's see how far this is from my workstation...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ahh?!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Oh, Doctor! What a coincidence running into you here! Why don't we go shopping together?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Hm, that's another year, come and gone. It's time to come up with new plans. No, it's not really that much work. All you have to do is make a wish and keep it in mind. Your first wish of the year is always the easiest to fulfill. Give it a try.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. Need a hand?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday! Come, come! Here's my present for you. Crack it open~ What do you think? This music box is great, isn't it? Hehe~ Doctor, you know when my birthday is, don't you? I'm expecting a surprise when the time comes. It's a promise~

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Time to get up and stretch a little, Doctor. All that trouble won't go away just because you spend a couple more minutes grinding away. Come on, share a dance with me and move your body. Don't worry, it's not hard. Just take my hand, step forward. Right... Right, like that. Does it feel like your body just lightened up some?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: If you've got something to say, spit it out. I ain't got all day, you know?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Eep! You idiot, touch my tail again and I'll smack ya into next week! And you best forget whatever sound you just heard, or I'll make ya forget, the hard way.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: This ol' door I have here? Can't you tell? I made it myself, it's multifunctional. Hands off if you know what's good for ya, or you might get yourself killed.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Gotta say, scabbin' a lift on this big ol' ship gets me to places faster than my own two legs. Besides, you lot are headin' all over the shop anyway. Mm, yeah, I guess I've changed my view towards you guys a little.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Don't lump me in with Magallan. I ain't no pro explorer, just someone trampin' it around the lands chasin' thrills. Trailblazin' for the benefit of others? Ha, do I look that noble?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: What am I doin' this for? The danger and the thrill, mate. What's life without a little craziness, eh?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Magallan? I met her at the Black Flow. That tiny, overzealous videographer girl made that adventure the noisiest one yet. But I gotta admit, the li'l ripper's got some real chops.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Friend? Pfft, who needs that? I'd much rather be a complete jerk and keep things simple: you don't like me, and I don't like you. On second thought, I could use a drinking mate tonight... Oi, you in or what?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My Oripathy? Yeah yeah, I know it's bad, but as long as I ain't bothering no one, how I deal with it is my business. To me, it's real simple: dying on a journey seems like an alright way to go. You can try to save me, if you think you're all that. Do your worst, Doctor. Bet you couldn't if you tried.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Sleeping, huh? Good time to make some noise. Ahaha!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Alright, so here's the deal. I'll be out exploring for most of the year, but you still need to pay me full wage, and keep a dorm room for me. Think you can accept—Wait, you agree? Ha! You must be off your rocker.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Whatever. Guess I learned some self-defense.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Me? 'Honorary Captain of the Rhodes Island Expedition Team?' The hell?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I can't promise I'll do any good for Rhodes Island, that's not my style. But I can promise you this: if there are any mysteries on this land you want uncovered, then I'm your gal.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Teamwork? Give me a break…

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Ugh, Doctor, If you wanna make my life hard, just say it to my face.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: If you can't keep up, just find something to keep yourself busy.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Ugh... What a pain in the proverbial.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Yeah, yeah.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Fine, fine.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Sure, sure.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Righto, mate.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Suck it, loser!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Here's a door for ya!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You're pathetic as hell!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Piss off already!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I've braved savage winds and waves. This is nothin' but smooth sailing.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: This sucks. I was hopin' for an adventure.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Enough, mate. Let's call it a day.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Ugh... Am I supposed to say 'there there' now...?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Time to head back to the dorms for a kip.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh?!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Oh right, gotta take a trip to the Doctor's office first…

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Ahh crap, I forgot it's New Year's. Shouldn't have come back. I hate huge crowds like this... Even those Archosauria we came across in Sargon weren't this rowdy… Huh? Wait, wait! What're you grabbing my hand for? Let go! I'm going back to my room!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Got nothin' better to do again, eh?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Fine, fine, whatever! Take this and get out of my face! What kind of person are you, asking people to give you a present? Gah… Alright, mate, you got your gift. Now shut up, and get out!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Damn. And I thought New Year's would be the only special holiday here. Didn't know you got another one. Guess I picked just the right bloody time to come back. Shh-sh-sh, hold it right there. You want to talk, fine, but we'll talk over drinks. Otherwise, keep your trap shut.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Greetings, Doctor. You're glowing today. To see you so well... it's all I could ever hope for.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I prepared an antidote to nullify the effects of any common poison. I'd like you to take one dose before every battle. Do you mind?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Actually, the toxin in my body is an ingredient in some high-quality medicines. That's why Dr. Kal'tsit needs me in her lab a lot.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Hmm, why do you keep staring at me... You mean, it's because my eye color is special? Is that a compliment, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm the one our enemies fear the most. After all, who wouldn't want to kill me before I can torture them to death with my poison? What really worries me is that my teammates might think the same…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Why am I staring at this cake? Actually... I baked it to share with everyone, but no one wanted it... Would you like to try it, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, you're always wearing the same outfit. How about I choose some new clothes for you? I think I have pretty good taste. Oh... it's a uniform? So you can't change it? Okay…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I'm 'toxic'... so people prefer to stay away from me. But now I have you by my side, Doctor, and I'm really, really happy.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My body isn't that different from everyone else. I may be 'toxic,' but nothing bad will happen if someone touches me. Doctor, if you can prove this to everyone, then maybe they won't always keep away from me. Could you... hold my hand out there?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor? Oh, already asleep. Gotta find a blanket to keep the Doctor warm...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Nice to meet you, I'm Blue Poison. I'm sure Dr. Kal'tsit must have told you about me. In that case, it'll be up to you to decide how to use my 'toxic' powers.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I think I hear the sound of toxic liquid boiling, like music to my ears.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you so much... I'm so glad I get to help out in all these battles. It's like a dream come true.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I used to hold back and hide my 'toxic' self, but now I've accepted what I am, trying to move forward to change my fate. I have you to thank for helping me make this shift, Doctor. You have my sincerest gratitude.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Great. I'm good at supporting assaults.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'd be much better off supporting the others. Wouldn't want my poison to harm you, Doctor...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Everyone, there's no need for you all to stand so far from me...

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I prepared a 'gift' for you. Like it?
