voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Awaiting your orders.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Please don't be scared of me.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Don't worry, my poison is not contagious.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: My toxicant is ready.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: My toxins will slowly burn your life away...

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Are you hallucinating?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Honey to me, poison to you.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Poison kiss.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Use poison to fight the evils and crimes... Isn't that ironic to you?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I've got a poison to melt away all these remains in an instant. Want me to show you?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Good, finished before my clothes got dirty.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: How ridiculous. Feels like I killed myself with my own poison...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Resting when you're tired helps you focus on your work.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: D-Did you just touch me? C-Can you do that again? Please?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Well there, Doctor, Happy New Year. Although, given what day it is, won't you take your uniform off? I was assuming you'd put on something new, but maybe you just don't pay much attention to your appearence.  It's a little frustrating—I have no idea what would be a good gift for you.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday. A dessert from me—please, take it. And if it's okay, I'd like you to give it a taste right now. What is it? Everyone's watching? I don't see the problem. You're a regular whenever I make snacks, aren't you?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I am a 'toxic' person, but I still have a place of my own here... It makes me so happy. The operators might still be slightly scared of me, but that's it. They don't reject me that much. Just give it enough time, and the relationships between us will be fine, won't they?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: So, just like the big corporations' office workers, even you have a bunch of deskwork to do. That's quite a lot, too. Do you need any help?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I never imagined the Radiant Knight would take up employment anywhere. Rhodes Island is a mysterious company.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Knights may be able to climb back up after they fall, but the Infected don't have such kindhearted options available to them.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: *Cough*... My weapon seems to be acting up, *cough*... Which way is the workshop? That way? Thank you. *Cough*.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: If the knight nobles were able to fulfill their vows and responsibilities, the Infected wouldn't have found themselves so oppressed. But... those nobles... the Kazimierz people would rather sign contracts with those big security companies than trust those knight nobles to protect them from crime and violence.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: They tell me my family met its downfall because I got infected, that I am to blame for everything. Hmph, just what you'd expect from the knight nobles. They're all good-for-nothings who know only to bully the weak.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Justyna likes to use titles when she talks to me... Why is that? Is the word 'Ashlock' that special to her?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Sona and I met each other during a team melee match. That was a tough battle, but we reached an understanding and worked with each other as soon as we met. At the very end, she took all my points with her sword, but then apologized to me right away... That's how we started working together.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: If I can't go back home anymore, then all I can do is find the way forward with Sona and the gang. Heh... Becoming an Infected knight hasn't been kind to me, but at least we have the chance to fight. It doesn't matter what miseries the future has in store for us; I'm sure it'll still be a much brighter place.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Be sure to get enough rest. The break after a match is just as important as your daily training.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm 'Ashlock' Greynuty of Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub. Thank you for taking us in.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: A coordinated assault? Yeah, they work well with each other.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Is this a medal to prove my qualifications? Oh... Sorry, I still don't have all of Rhodes Island's rules down. Thank you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: 'When the cannon fire rings through the air, victory is already within sight.'

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I will follow your orders.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You need me to take charge? Okay.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Good hunting, everyone.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Get ready. The enemy's coming!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Yeah.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Your orders.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: It's not like the knight competitions. You can't pause a battle when someone gets injured.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: The match's starting now.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Reload!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Cannon fire is just the first step.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Strengthen your defense! Forward!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I will win this match!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Wonderful. So this is the art of command. You've opened my eyes.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Looks like you're good at commanding team battles.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The more points you lose in the arena, the less likely you are to win.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: *Cough*... Is this... my fault...?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Good thing my equipment doesn't take up too much space.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: A present from a fan? It was sent to you? Sorry for the trouble.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Sona should still be asleep, Iwona's at the training grounds, and Justyna's standing guard up on the watchtower. As for me... I haven't figured it out yet. Doctor, what would a normal Rhodes Island operator do on this day?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Do we have any missions today?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday. Here's... no, actually, forget it. Giving you an autographed postcard as a gift just feels too arrogant, my apolo— You don't mind? Oh... thanks for that...

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I used to believe that, in looking for a better way to help the infected, we need to cast our sights beyond the border of Kazimierz, but the situation there turns out to be... even more complicated. And we won't get to the bottom of it unless we learn firsthand ourselves. Still, I'm ready to face all of it. Send me out on missions, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: That device you're holding seems to be in poor shape. Would you mind if I take a look at it?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Hey, Ansel. Cardigan looks good today. Anything I can help you with?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: We have a squad of very interesting people, especially Melantha. She always seems to be hiding from me, but I can sniff her out.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Cardigan, what are you doing? You look so happy.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Not every Laterano has the right to use guns, rare weapons that they are. In my hometown, we're pretty good at making knockoff gun parts. The crossbow crafting industry is also on the rise. The result is what I have here - a crossbow with a tactical rail attachment.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Would you like to try some of my handmade sweets? I'm kind of ashamed that I can only make 25 types of desserts. It feels like I've disgraced the Laterano people.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: What's wrong with my halo? I don't know why, but it seems to have deviated slightly. According to Dr. Kal'tsit, it probably has something to do with my abnormal hippocampus.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Instead of watching you from afar, I feel much better standing by your side, Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, you strike an impressive figure, even when you rest like that.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: My name is Adnachiel. I'm a Sniper from Laterano. Although I'm not yet certified to carry a gun, I can match the veterans with my crossbow!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Put me to good use and I'll be more than happy.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you very much for the promotion.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: We will be fine.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: If anything breaks, bring it to me. I may be able to fix it for you.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: It's time to go. Are you ready?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Let the hunt begin.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I will follow your orders.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: You better run away soon.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Okay!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Gotcha!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Locked on!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Everything went just as you planned, Doctor.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We have the Doctor's orders to thank for this.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Our operation was a success, but something feels a bit off...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'm so sorry...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This place has a great vibe.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor? I'm so happy to be with you!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Just like here, everyone would get together on this day to celebrate in Laterano. Some friends would even come visit just for the occasion, and see whether my halo was righted yet. Well, it's a shame I wasn't able to get my own gun before I left, but I guess I clicked with the crossbow anyhow. Slick of me, right?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: May the Lord bless you, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I've learned how to make fifteen more desserts this year, and though that's a long way off from how many desserts Laterano has, it should be enough for you to choose your birthday cake. I'd lean towards a fruitcake or a raspberry mochi—sweet and delicious in spades.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, nothing's made me happier than getting to work with you so long. I can't count how much you've cared for my squad members over the past year. Whichever way you guide me, Doctor, that's the future I'll sprint for.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Why do I keep my weapon right here? I said it before, you need a stable working environment. Anyone who wants to bother you will have to ask my little friend first.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Rhodes Island is a nice place. Everyone follows the rules and goes about their business, like an idyllic island paradise isolated from reality.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, those students over there, are they all from Chernobog? Middle schoolers from that city...? I see, I need to observe them a bit more.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Were you the one commanding at Chernobog, Doctor? Then you also must have seen the state of things there. How are you able to sleep at night, after all that? I can't get it out of my mind… I just can't…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I've done well...? No, I haven't! I've achieved nothing, I even fled my homeland. A girl like me never does good… Uh, stop that. Why are you patting my head...?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Who needs my protection? Who can I protect? I've been asking myself, since that nightmare... Back then, I saw the malice in people's hearts, it was... it was pouring out all over the place. It drowned the whole city... Under those circumstances, maybe justice no longer means anything, it no longer exists.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Something wrong with my hair? It's... a little messy? Well, it is what it is. I had to cut it myself when I fled the city... Don't give me that look. It's just hair, it'll grow back eventually. Relax, okay?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: This device belonged to my father, a police officer who dedicated himself to protecting the public each and every day. I can understand, same as my mother. We've never blamed him. It's just that... Doctor, all that my father did, was it really worth it?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Those people, the civilians, their faces were so twisted. They looked just like the murderers who destroyed our city. But they were the people my father and I were supposed to protect. Doctor, what is actually just in this world? What should I do...? I just don't know...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: So sleepy... But I can't afford to... fall asleep…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Thank you for rescuing me, I pledge my life to you. There's not a lot I can do, but if you find some way for me to be useful, please let me know. Codename...? Ummm, just call me Absinthe.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: What's the point of watching this stuff?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: There's no need for a promotion. Rhodes Island does enough for me… I-I have to take it? But, well… Okay... Thank you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I still haven't figured out what justice really is. But you told me before that my beliefs mean something... You might be right. I-I want to believe.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Understood. I'll go get ready.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Whoever the squad leader is, what's the status on the... Huh, it's me?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Don't get cocky. Move out!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Halt! Suspicious individuals thirty meters ahead… It's those guys again.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: This time…

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Copy.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Raid drill! Hands on your head! Don't move!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: This time... I must!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: No sudden moves!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Stop right there! No tresspassing!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: This is your last warning! Surrender or get shot!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Why does it always end up like this…?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: If only you were there back then, maybe things would've turned out different…

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission complete. Doctor, you're not injured, are you?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Do you think any of them were from Chernobog?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: It's a panic, we've lost control! We have to retreat now, go!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This terrace... if enough snow built up on it, you could jump off like this and have a great time. Hup!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Wha-What?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Oh, Doctor. Are you thirsty? Come, let's find something to drink.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Papa always used to work this holiday. He wouldn't come home until very late, so my mother and I would wait for him. If I got too tired, I would sit by the window and watch the snow. By the time the sign on the other side of the street was buried, Papa would be home... Doctor, thank you. I'll be fine by myself.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Are you alright? Need something to perk you up?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I don't know how you spend your birthdays, but my mother always baked this cake for me. It's my favorite, and she taught me how to make it... Back home, I never thought a day like this would come... Do you like it, Doctor?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: People say that what's past is past, but is that really true? I feel like some things, you'll always carry with you, but even so, you have to keep moving forward.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I've done a few accident writeups before, but this lot's important. Reckon you'd better check them for yourself. I don't skive off, do I? I've changed these bulbs here. How's that? Makes reading clearer now, right?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doin' delivery in the outback takes a lotta guts, but even the toughest truckie's got things they avoid, like those metal crabs poking holes in your tires. Me? Since I joined Rhodes Island and quit driving, it's none of my business. Speaking of which, I saw a broad here's keeping those crabbies as pets!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: It's kinda stuffy in here, reckon I should crack a window? Ever wondered why truckies hang their arm out? Comfort, sure, but also cos the wind tells stories. Sounds iffy? Thunderstorm's on its way—wanna bet on it?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: This gizmo goes everywhere with me. Designed it myself, still a work in progress. I was set on 'Nutty' for a name, but Potlid's not a fan. You're better at this stuff than I am, got any ideas?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Give us a spin, Nutty! Take a gander, there's a tire repair kit, a jack, and a remote-controlled spray gun! Nutty can solve anything you throw at it. Huh? What if there's no vehicle? Ah, I was considering installing an engine…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Looking for me? Didn't go far, just popped to Engineering for a tick. Closure's been promising to upgrade Nutty's voice module, but she's always busy. Thought I'd swing by and see if I could lend a hand. Cause trouble? Not likely!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Wouldn't believe I was a miner once, would you? Wasn't for long, but the feeling lingers. One swing of the pickaxe, and you're gamblin' with a cave-in or a strike—pure luck. Luck's not fair, and you sure can't count on it, but sometimes it's all you got.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Wanna tuck into my lunchbox? Yeah, it's Potlid's cooking! Got a good nose on you, huh? I was coughin' so much last week she's been seeing to it that I get pear stew every day. Who's the kid now, right? She's so mature, makes me feel bad. You get moments like that too, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Autumn and winter mornings bring a pea soup fog to the road. All I could do was switch on the fog lamps and push on through. Was only when my ute got out of the fog that I could wipe the sweat off and check that Potlid was still asleep. Lucky? I reckon so.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Sleep tight, I got your back.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor, just call me Lanns like before! Sure, I'm on a break from the outback, but I brought my tradie skills with me. See, here's my Artificer creds. Intern? Huh! Becomin' fully fledged is just a matter of time.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Frame rate's stable, colors are real vibrant too. Crazy good display tech you got here… Huh? Combat skills? Oh, I know how to sneak up on someone and whack the daylight's outta them!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion already? Feels like I just finished up my intern days! Hah, I getcha, Doctor. I'll keep at it, maintenance and combat both.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: You taught me a loose screw can cost a war. I might not really see how it goes down like that, but I'll make sure every single screw is tightened down. This sort of work? You can count on me, Doctor.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: No wukkas. I'm Alanna of the Barrenlands after all. What's that mean? You'll know soon enough.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll take the wheel, you take a breather.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Hold on tight now, things might get rough.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Get 'em in their heads!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: My turn now?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Ready to go anytime.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Deploying device.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Dang it, sprained my leg—Just joshing, mate.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Come on, Nutty!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Nutty, high-power mode!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Think you can dodge this next trick? Wanna bet?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Beep—beep! Terminus, everybody off!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: That was rough, Doctor! I thought you'd got yourself winded again.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: All in one go! Good load of combat data this time, too. Thanks heaps, Doctor.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We did pretty good already, so just let them go, yeah?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Come on, make a run for it!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Don't know if I can have a snooze here without all the clinkin' an' clankin' around me.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Alright, what are we betting on this time?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Take a squiz at this electric welding torch I just got! Wanna give it a go? Slow down, goggles on first.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Fancy a bevvy, Doctor? We got a tradition of drinkin' ourselves silly on New Year's Eve. I can deadset leave a whole bunch of truckies legless... Huh? Drunk drivin's bad? Nah, this ain't beer, it's carrot soda!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, lemme know if you wanna go for a ride, yeah?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: There're so many days in a year, you gotta save one for yourself. Even the most hardworking diggers can't stay down in the mines all the time, right? So, let's get you out of your office. I'll even take you out for a spin after your birthday party's over, how 'bout it?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: When we'd just arrived here, I told Warmy Rhodes Island was like a big big transport. She was really excited when she said 'So the Doctor's just like you, a truckie at the steering wheel!' Haha, she's not wrong there. Your work decides the direction Rhodes Island sails, Doctor. Well done, mate.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, have you ever considered some more... practical ornamentation for Rhodes Island? Such as monastery brewing casks, perhaps…?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Landen Monastery's clerics form no normal clergy, you know? Rather than prayer, we're much more about taking up arms to defend Laterano... That's how it goes, but our finances have been in a sorry state these past few years. The justice of guarding others with the faith we harbor—surely the Lord permits us that.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, do you have any interest in beer or bread? Landen Monastery Fermented Goods Contest CCCLXXVII first-place winner, at your service! No need? Ah, alright... Truly, I want our soft, springy bread and fragrant beer to be known across all of Terra. That would do wonders for our revenues!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: E—Exusiai? The legend who blew up her alma mater seventeen times in three years? I never thought she'd be here at Rhodes Island... She does seem to have some learned business experts at her side, but the risk of an explosion while rebuilding the Monastery... best not for now.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Different kinds of arrows entail different uses. There may be plenty of capable archers amongst my sisters, but I don't boast when I proclaim that I'm the only one able to adapt multiple combat modes at once! Heheh! At least, out of my year I am!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: It was only once I left the Monastery that I realized my arrows may do more than defend the Curia. They can aid so many Infected, beset by injustice... I'm very proud, but occasionally I'll remember the days gone past, where I simply drew my bow, and loosed. Now, every arrow has become so much more weighty.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: So as to rebuild the Monastery, my sisters have left to seek cooperation across all of Terra. Landen Monastery, age-old guardian of Laterano, is now a dispatch agency... If only those old men would grant a little more funding. What kind of an excuse is 'better to have a nun trained than a fund gained!?'

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Rhodes Island is a far cry from Laterano, mingling the breadth of diversity in vision and ambition together. It's truly remarkable. Doctor, you must consider coming to the Monastery to teach after you retire. Issues of faith? That'll be no problem! None of us will mind.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: At the start of spring, we'll prune the overgrown vines, and then open up the cellar come evening and retrieve the wine. The moment the setting sun catches through our glasses, we'll down them in one gulp. Ceremony? No, it's just a custom of ours. Life and faith became one long ago, and we don't want to lose it, that's all.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I feel like I heard bells... mm, just my imagination.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Cleric of Landen Monastery, Operator Archetto. Today on, I'll be in formal cooperation with you, for the rebuilding of the Landen Monastery famed far and wide! Doctor, if you would, please look over these contract terms!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I see, so this is how Rhodes Island's operators fight! Truly, they're exemplary!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? My greatest thanks. Hm? I seem at peace? Of course. When you spend five years partaking in commendation ceremonies for outstanding clerics where all peers are absent due to hangovers, these things don't get to you much.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Another promotion? Hmm... all the companies outside seem to strongly emphasize a hierarchical structure. Well, seeing as my excellence has been commended, might Rhodes Island be interested in establishing a long-term cooperation agreement with our Monastery?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Rhodes Island may see for itself the distinguished tactical prowess of Landen Monastery.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Cooperating with my Sisters, everyone always drowned each other out... but under my command, things may be a little terser. I'll do my utmost.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Arrow nocked.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Enemy sighted.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Your orders.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: What arrow should I use?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I've found our prey.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: May the Lord bless us.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Draw. Aim. Loose.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Feel the bowstring tremble…

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Gospel, gather at my fingertips...

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: My bow has three choices, and the enemy three hardships.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: 'Long may the Monastery's bells sound.' This is a prayer for victory. Though we've already won!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Now that I joined in this battle, nobody will think Landen Monastery's just an ornament of Laterano, will they?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Errrr… Please allow me the chance to remedy this! This is my mistake, and in no way represents the Monastery!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Were battles beyond the walls... always so cruel?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's too stifling in here. There's near to none of the Monastery's sunshine!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh—is something wrong?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Ah, Doctor, I've been thinking whether I should invite you with me to come see Laterano. Perhaps you'd have more interest in the Monastery then…

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Hm, there may be plenty of Lateran citizens here, but everyone's natures and backgrounds are so at odds with each other. I just want to find a fellow countryman I can calmly pray and toast to the New Year with, but... they're all so…

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: May the Lord bless you, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. This is a special day of great importance, and I offer you my most heartfelt prayers. May the bell sound to hold sickness and misfortune at bay, and may faith light your way. Also, I'd like you to accept this gift from me—an exquisite copy of a business contract, with all to gain and naught to lose!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: A good business partner is one thing, but a companion with whom you can uphold your faith is far more valuable. The weight of drawing one's bow for justice... I am sure all people of Rhodes Island can understand it. Long may the bells sound, that we continue to fight side by side, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: The files are in order. Is that all we have to do today? Good, then why don't we talk about the operation the other day, Professor?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Try not to come too close when I use Arts, okay? ... You won't? Whatever suits you then.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Why am I calling you 'Professor'? Because I'm actually learning quite a lot from you: where to assign personnel on the battlefield, how to command, among many other things… What more reason do we need?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Here, you can have this. Some sort of candy, I think. No need to thank me. I got it from someone else anyway. Couldn't care less.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Sankta using staves is a rare sight to see, you say? Those fanatics on a non-stop shooting spree must have left you with a bad impression with their 'pews' and 'bangs.' Not all Sankta use guns as their weapons. At the very least, I don't like them.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Rather than sharing a single secret, we should exchange our secrets with each other. That's how you build a strong, equal relationship. So if you want to learn any of my secrets, you better come up with something just as saucy for me, Professor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: There are no Infected in Laterano. Once a Sankta contracts Oripathy, he is immediately exiled. But even if you become Infected, no matter where you are, you still enjoy all kinds of privilege as a Laterano... You just don't get to set foot in your homeland again, that's all.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My parents' will left me with quite a bit of trouble, and it was really a hassle to get it taken care of. If it wasn't for that uptight executor making things difficult for me, it all could've been much easier... Oh, whatever, it still went according to my plan.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I want to capture a few people to try out some new Arts in our next operation. I can't...? Alright, fine. It's a shame, but if that's what you say, Professor, maybe some other time, then. Eh? Not this time, and not ever? Geez, don't be so uptight.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Are you asleep? People who fall asleep at work get their faces drawn on, you know...? Just kidding, I know you're awake.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Codename Arene, officially joining today, it seems. So you are the Doctor... I hope we'll get along, Professor {@nickname}.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Studying tactics? Sounds kinda interesting.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: This doesn't seem all that different than before. Or are you going to teach me some tricks of the trade, Professor?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, you aren't testing me, are you? Alright then, I'm just getting in the mood. Okay, starting right now, whatever happens is going to be our own little secret.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Okay, I'll follow your orders.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: So actual combat for my next assignment? Okay, let me think about the deployment...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: As long as we achieve our goals, it doesn't matter if the process is a little rough, huh?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Welcome. I've been waiting.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: My turn?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: No need to rush.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Not a bad position.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I can do whatever I want, right?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I've given my warning.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Does it hurt?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Tell me. How are you feeling right now?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: That's not a bad scream at all.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: That went far better than I expected. I shouldn't have thought so little of you, Professor.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: That was just as expected. No surprises, even a little boring.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: A few slipped past. Should I go after them? Strategically speaking, I don't recommend it.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: This is quite the bad situation... You know what the appropriate course of action is now, right?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Isn't there a closer room to the Professor's?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: We have some time to spare. Why don't we review our last mission, Professor?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Professor, I've learned a new trick. You can come closer this time. It's not dangerous. Put this piece of metal on your hand, then just very lightly... Look, it turned into a small firework. How about that? It's just as good as the noisy ones outside, right?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You look tired. It's okay if you sleep a little longer, Professor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Prof. {@nickname}. As you can see, I'm not too fond of overly complicated ceremonies. I hope you're not so into loud parties, either, since I'm planning to celebrate in more meaningful ways with you. Right, I mean just the two of us.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Professor, when you steer Rhodes Island, what do you weigh and consider? Enemies, friends, what we need to do, what we mustn't do... There has to be a line that we cannot cross so that we don't lose ourselves. Am I right? I see...

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: The neat little circles on that page? I didn't draw them. I wouldn't doodle on your documents.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: W-Wait, Doctor! Don't open that lid! That's a device I use to make bubbles... Sorry, I'm not laughing at you for getting all bubbled up. I-I just like seeing a bunch of bubbles together! Really! I'm not lying!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Sorry, Doctor. I didn't have the detergent-to-aroma formula under control. Um… I made some changes to it, and the aroma might linger in your nose for a very, very long time. You might smell it every now and then for the next two weeks...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I put on a bubble show for the young patients at Medical today. What kind of show? It's like this... There’s a big, big, big bubble with a big, big bubble inside. And then the big, big bubble’s got a big bubble. And Bubble’s inside the big bubble. Oh, that last one is my partner, Bubble, not a normal bubble.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, my family's formulators aren't quite like the others in our industry. Our peers try to create aromas that remind users of a certain beautiful moment in their memories. But my family, we work to suppress the worst, most terrible smells in their memories.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: All this time, I've thought that aromas by themselves couldn’t eradicate stenches. The most important thing is to open the windows and let the foul air out. Otherwise, the aroma and stench blend together, and that would just be a different, disgusting smell.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I'm cleaning the room right now, and you came at just the right time, Doctor. Would you help me wipe the light tubes up top? They're a bit too high, and I can't reach them, even on a ladder. Yeah, there's a small black spot just a little to the left... Ah! W-Why is that black spot flying?!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, I brought some shampoo my family made onto the landship. It's from a small workshop, but we source all the essential oils we use from plants in nature. Like this lemon-scented one. We used lemons taken from my family's backyard, where my grandmother planted a lemon tree the year I was born.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: There was a chaotic time where murders were a daily occurrence in Siracusa, and my family served as 'cleaners' charged with clearing out the aftermath. We left that line of work a long time ago, but every now and then, we still remember the thick stench of blood that seemed to overpower everything else.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Oh no. A bubble floated into the room and landed on the Doctor's nose... If somebody goes in there and thinks the Doctor's got a snot bubble, that wouldn't be good…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. I'm Logistics Operator Aroma. Would you open your hands like this? Don't worry... I just thought that with how nice and bright the sun is today, it would be perfect to put a bubble reflecting a rainbow onto your palm.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This will make a very useful reference. I never knew detergent could be used like that.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, I will pass on your encouragement and feedback to my family. I'm pleased that you like our products so much.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, I'm humbled that my family's products are so well-liked by the operators here... Huh...? A manufacturing cooperation with Rhodes Island? Can we really?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: How convenient. I want to test out my new bubbling formula.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Remember to cover your noses. The aroma this time might be a little intense. Don't let the smell get you sneezing.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I put a sign here— Wet floor. Be extra careful.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The smell here reminds me of something really scary.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Detergent formula tuning complete!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Bubbling equipment ready to go!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: These bubbles won't burst so easily.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Remember to give your honest feedback on our products.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Bubble richness, up to standard!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Bubble dissipation speed, perfect!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Bubble expanding power, excellent!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Stain removal efficiency, impeccable!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Hm... smells a lot more refreshing now.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I like this new ingredient. It's effective, and it doesn't harm your skin.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Looks like we'll need a stronger stain removing formula next time.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: What a stubborn stain...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Doctor, n-no, I know it's polite to look at the person you're talking to... I-I'm not looking out the window. It's just... the water stains on the glass are making me really uncomfortable. I really want to wipe it.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ah! Please don't do that. I almost splashed some of the soap I'm holding on you.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Watch out, Doctor! There's soapy water all over the floor. You could slip if you aren't careful.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The New Year calls for new vibes, Doctor, so I put a small plant on your windowsill. I collected a bunch of lemon seeds from my family's kitchen and planted them. This is the one that grew the best.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You should go take a walk, Doctor. It's not good to stay in your office all day.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Perfume? Why would I give you perfume? Hehe, your scent shouldn't be covered by any other smell, Doctor. It’s natural and pleasing, much more so than any perfume I could mix.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Every time a patient at Medical passes away, the clothing they wore gets sent to me to be washed and stored until their family comes to retrieve it one day. Some are picked up soon after, but others... still haven't been picked up even after a long, long time.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I made a really strong brew with our new coffee machine. Wanna try? You can only have one cup a day, though. Don't want you up all night!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Being a Messenger isn't easy. Both the sender and the receiver might have some big ideas, and who knows if some shady secrets get inside your bag. If you're too absorbed in getting yourself moving, you could still end up in a pit for what you get yourself into.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My mother was from Higashi, so my name doesn't sound very Siracusan. A lot of people ask me if it's even my real name, so I decided to use Angelina as a codename too.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Good morning, Dr. {@nickname}! Yeah, I'm off to send out some documents. Dr. Kal'tsit says my skills could come in super useful in battle... but compared to fighting, I kinda prefer taking letters where they belong!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I actually don't know if I'm a good fit for Rhodes Island... I mean, a lot of really heavy stuff happens here, I'm not sure I can handle it. Croissant's always comforting me, but I am still not sure about myself. Do I really have what it takes?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I don't feel lost anymore. At the end of the day, it's more than a simple identification with you or Rhodes Island. If I can leap across the gaps between skyscrapers as a Messenger, then I know I could  bridge the gap between the Infected and Uninfected as an Operator!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Memories are precious. I always remember that the Infected, just like us, look forward to a better tomorrow. I don't know anything about your past, Dr. {@nickname}, but I promise to help you recall.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, don't be shy, come closer! That's right! Three, two, one, sorridi! See? It's a photo sticker of you and me. The perfect souvenir, right? I guess it's also a token of… some of my feelings, haha.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The view from the deck is great. Especially for stargazing! See that lone star over there? People say that one day, its companion star will appear, and then they'll embrace and dance together. Still... how long does it have to wait for the other one to show up? And how long do I have to wait... for the star to wink back at me?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Umm hmm~♪ Mmm, maybe the coral lipstick suits me more.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Ciao! I'm Angelina Ajimu, a Messenger from Siracusa. Just call me Angelina. Am I cool to call you Dr. {@nickname}?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: The battlefield is a cruel place... but I'll try not to let you down.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Since you trust me, Dr. {@nickname}, I'll have to work much, much harder than I usually do! Like, Siracusan Messengers always say: 'A slow Messenger gets caught by the wind.'

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I've made my decision. As long as you're still working to help the Infected, Dr. {@nickname}, I'll follow you. You've come so far, done so much... now it's my turn to do something for you.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: In work or in battle, I'll give it all I've got!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I might not be the best, but I'll still do what I can.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Everybody, please be careful!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: When will all these conflicts ever come to an end…

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Okay~

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Hm?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Gently lan~ding.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Ehee~

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Feeling you're gaining some weight?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: We will overcome what confronts us.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I've got a magic touch on this.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Ever wondered how it feels to float in the air?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: We only grow stronger after getting into a wolf's mouth, right?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We all worked hard for this. You'll cherish this victory, won't you Dr. {@nickname}?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Well, even I lose a letter sometimes...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: The more difficult the situation, the harder we have to try!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This place is like home to me!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Woah!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: My hair looks nice? Heheh, I've got a secret for that.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: {@nickname}, Happy New Year! The first letter I'm delivering this year is a New Year's card for {@nickname}. I hope my feelings of joy make their way to {@nickname}, heheh.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Morning, Dr. {@nickname}!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: {@nickname}, close your eyes... Keep this a secret just between the two of us, okay? Hold my hand tight now... Do you feel floaty? Look, {@nickname}! Don't the stars seem closer?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: When I left home and came to Rhodes Island, I left behind my old friends and the life I knew too. I've grown up a little now, but... I'd be fooling myself if I said it wasn't hard. Doctor, I still believe it's all worth it. Because right here, I've found a star to call my own.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, it's time for your injection. Oh, um, are you alright?! Are you scared of needles?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Like Dr. Kal'tsit is always telling you, Doctor, you really need some exercise. I'm new here, but you still need to listen to my advice.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Cardigan! We've told you, if you move like that when you strike, you'll wind up getting hurt.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Good grief... Doctor, you need to take care of yourself. You can't make us do it for you.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Are you worried about my health after so many night shifts? You shouldn't be. My race has a unique way of producing hormones, which allows us to handle night activities better. So I can hand my shift over to Hibiscus at just the right time.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You must stop with the midnight snacks. Don't go bringing up my eating habits. I eat at night because of my race! Yes, it's a racial trait!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I'm Ansel. It's a little embarrassing to admit, but I chose to become a Medic because I've been sickly since I was young. But now that I'm an Operator, I'll make sure not to burden you. So please treat me just the same way you treat the others.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I know everyone does what they can. But I heard from Dr. Kal'tsit that Steward and Melantha's conditions aren't looking too good... My job is to make their lives as easy as possible. Doctor, let's redouble our efforts, together.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Adnachiel, could you ask Cardigan to settle down for a moment? The Doctor is resting.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Ansel, a medical intern. I'll be assisting with surgery and internal medicine, among other things. I look forward to working with you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I hope I didn't cause you any trouble.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm glad that you care so much for the wellbeing of us Medics.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Ready whenever.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Medical support should be the top priority for any tactical squad.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Alright, all medicine has been prepared.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Injections ready. Prepare for battle.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: First aid box is ready.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Awaiting your orders.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Ready to heal!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Please hold on!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Clear!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Your medication is here. Take it!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Phew, thank goodness I brought enough medicine. Please don't worry.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I was very impressed by everyone's performance. It was fantastic.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Please hold on, I'll treat your injuries right away.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We've sustained injuries! I need to get the wounded to the rear. Cover me!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I'm checking on the medical supplies here.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Whoa, Doctor, please don't mess with me!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, I'm very glad that you like me.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The Medical Department actually gets busier around New Year's. People hurt themselves setting off fireworks or gorging on food... I get wanting to indulge in the holiday spirit, but you need to keep yourselves safe too. You know how to take care of yourself, Doctor, don't you? Very well. With that, I wish you happy new year. May you spend the year without that kind of visit to Medical.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good day, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, good evening. It's just past midnight, so I think it counts as your birthday. Happy birthday to you! I got you a cake, but my advice is to wait till tomorrow to eat it. Oh, come to think of it, does this make me the first to wish you a happy birthday?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I only came to Rhodes Island at first because no other place would accept my resume. It seems more like a kind of destiny now. All of A4 are maturing, and I can't fall behind, Doctor. The good news is, test results show my health condition has gotten a lot better over the last year.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'm sorry, but the pen scratching you hear is just me engaging in shorthanding... to put it another way, I'm helping myself to think. I'm busy with Joint Marine Corps affairs, so I'm afraid I can't help you tackle your paperwork.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: It's been difficult explaining how my launcher works to the Sankta operators, and when I asked them about their guns, their eccentric answers only confused me more. Hm? I shouldn't lose heart? You're overthinking it, how could I be discouraged from just that? The reason I'm here is precisely for the sea and land to understand each other.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Coffee, tea, cocoa... These land stimulants have a novel taste to them. They're not very effective, but it's fine. This way I get to try many types of them. How many cups have I had today? This is number eight. The Seaborn swarm is still on the move, and HQ may reach out at any time, so I have to stay alert.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Doctor, there's no fresh information from Ægir on this sketch board. These wavy lines and small squares are just my thought process. As for what they mean exactly, it's very hard to explain. Hm? If this part means 'signal strength'? You... can read it?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Unfortunately, I didn't manage to become an Abyssal Hunter, but that's not the only way Ægir fights the Seaborn. We have the Hunters, the Waterway—and many more in the future. My current position dictates I no longer be affiliated with any projects, but that does not imply my duties are lighter, even in the slightest.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Our nation is not a machine, but an organic system. The gears do not spin on their own, yet every single cell, even if it loses the system's protection, will fight to the end for the organism's survival... This is what I defend and firmly believe in, nothing more.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Irene invited me to a ball last time, but I'm unfamiliar with the way land dwellers dance. I thought a direct refusal would be rude, so I didn't answer at all. Yet, it seemed to make her even more disappointed... Um? I can dance however I want? Then I'll join them next time. I may shoulder heavy responsibilities, but there's no harm in engaging in appropriate and beneficial recreation.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Drop the act, I know who was just in here. As long as you're not the one he's contacting—no, even if it is you— Nah, forget it, I've already neglected my duties by not reporting him immediately, not to mention our current situation. Anyway, I'd like you to tell him this for me—he may be a genius, but he is a terrible mess as a teacher.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The Abyssal Hunters have returned, surprisingly, and the Waterway has been opened somehow. Those are certainly not what I expected as watchman, but they are gratifying enough. Doctor, I stand here now watching over you as well, and look forward to seeing how you'll transform this war.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, contacts from Ægir will be here anytime. If you're not awake by then, I will inject you with a nerve activating solution. Oh, I will try to wake you up first.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I'm glad to meet you on land. We're fighting the same war, and that is why I stand before you now.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I'm adapting myself to land-based warfare and combat styles.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm grateful for your recognition. The promotion ceremony has ended, right? Perfect, I have some new Joint Marine documents to look through together.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Praise in a perilous time often means even heavier responsibilities. I'm prepared, Doctor.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'll intercept the tides. It is Ægir's duty to keep them off the land.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll synchronize everyone with our battle plans promptly. If there's anything you find hard to understand, don't worry. Ægir guarantees your lives are the paramount priority.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Our fleet is in position. I'll guide us to our designated spot.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Hmph. Detritus.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Toxic finspine launcher, ready to fire.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'm in position.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Please gather behind my shield.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: The air is so dry... no, it's nothing.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Don't misunderstand, you're not even threats to me.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Be glad you're only facing the Sea Patrol, not our regular army.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Did you just beg for mercy? Couldn't hear you over all that shelling.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Requesting more firepower—Gah, I'll do it myself.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Your results surpassed my expectations, even in such difficult circumstances. Do you have time to tell me what was on your mind? There are some parts of your plan I still don't understand...

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: An exemplary show of command.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: This result... isn't entirely unacceptable. Only, the enemies we let go, may not necessarily let us go in turn.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I take it you're just having a bad day, but our enemies hope you stay like that for good. You need to pull yourself together.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I still have Sea Patrol work to deal with, so I can't always be at Rhodes Island. If you need anything from me, raise a request and I'll get to it promptly.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Casual chats aren't my strong suit. Find someone else to talk to.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: If you really want to know how I think while writing shorthand, I can explain it to you.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: You people flip through this printed product every day or month, treat it with great importance, and even celebrate when you switch it out for another... Can I have a look? Oh... it's called 'paper calendar'? Hmm... so land dwellers celebrate the first day of every year. I will record this in my cultural exchange notes.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Reporting in, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, for you. Wait, why are you using it as a coaster? Doctor, they're not shorthand scribbles, I wrote an earnest birthday message, so I'd appreciate it if you would actually read it.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I had lots of worries before I came ashore. My concerns have been validated, yet I feel even more confident. Why? Because I see a universal tenacity shared by land and sea. You face Catastrophes as Ægir fights the Seaborn—we will never surrender.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I hope you're not a pain to deal with like Monica, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Monica sure has a weird taste. Did you know she thought about using things like Seer or Baker as her code name? Incandescence sounds about normal now, yeah?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Skadi and Specter are Ægirs, like me. Whenever I see them, I feel like… You know, my heart starts racing. Geez… If this is what I think it is, maybe I should dress up…

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: To be honest, I wasn't really interested in coming to Rhodes Island at first. After all, Monica was the one you hired, and I'm just her bodyguard. But then she didn't need one anymore and finding a new job gets my tentacles all tied in a knot, so I decided to tag along and take my chances here.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Monica and I lived together back in Iberia. Taking care of someone as unorganized and impulsive as her was a pesky chore… But she was the best option I had. I don't get along with my family and she was the one who took me in.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The Inquisition used to give me loads of trouble for my crossbow. They'd disassemble it, inspect the structure, and then give me a tongue-lashing for modifying it to look like a rifle. Yep, I know my weapon gives people the wrong idea, but I don't care. The Inquisition eventually gave up and just asked that I don't go scaring people with it. Heheh.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, Rhodes Island doesn't have any restrictions on their operators making friends, right? ...No, um, I just wanted to make friends with those Laterano folks. I've always loved Laterano's guns ever since I was little, so I tried to emulate one when I made this gun.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You know, my Mom once told me that something happened to me when I was little, but I can't remember it for the life of me. Mom doesn't seem too eager to tell me, either. Meh. I'm doing fine now, so I guess it mustn't have been a big deal.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I gotta hand it to you, Doctor. Taking care of Monica alone takes everything out of me, but you have to take care of so many operators… Anyway, let me know if you ever need help. You know, you're not the only caretaker around here.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Your work-rest balance is all out of whack, just like Monica. Alright… where's the blanket…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I used to be Monica's... Err, I guess it's Incandescence now... Anyway, I used to be her bodyguard. She finally found herself a proper job now, so I'm free to do other stuff. That's all. Hope we get along well.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: So this is how the pros do things...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Before I came, I thought to myself, a security guard at a pharmaceutical company would be pretty chill. And if I didn't make the cut, janitorial work would also be fine. Not gonna lie, I'm starting to regret my decision a bit.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Honestly, I never thought I'd achieve something like this... You know, getting stronger wasn't on my list before, but this feeling isn't half bad. Thanks, Doctor.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Time for the mission? Got it.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm leading? Mm... I'll try my best.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Hope we don't find trouble.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Shoot, here we go again.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Ready to move.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'd like to listen to some music.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Enemy unaware, for now.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: The visibility's pretty good here.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Breath… Focus…

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Hello. And goodbye.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: That person's pretty fashionable…

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: So many enemies. How annoying.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, want some candy? You can relax now. I'm spent, too.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I'll double-check to see if we missed anything.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: That's good enough, right? Saves us both the trouble.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Let's go, Doctor. I've secured the retreat route.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Guess I'll take a look around first.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hey...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, is there anything I can help with?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. This is my first time celebrating with so many people, and it's not bad at all. Oh, speaking of which, I was supposed to write a letter to Mom before I left, but I totally forgot. Gotta write one now.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, want some candy?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday! Here's your present. I bought Monica one, and it worked really well, so I got you one, too. The bane of you people with messed-up work and rest schedules: an ultra-mega alarm clock. Fail to follow a schedule and you'll get an alarm loud enough to cause a tsunami.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I never had many plans for the future to begin with, and I never thought I'd come this far. Looking back, I made the right decision to come here with Monica... How do I see the future now? Hm... Man, what a question. I got nothing.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Any work today? If it's nothing urgent, let's put it off till later.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: My Arts detect nearby creatures, and this auxiliary device even amplifies the ability. Sounds great, right? That's why the Garrison Team sent me to patrol the city, in case any students were trying to climb the walls and skip school. I gotta admit, they sure know how to put people to work.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Just for the record, the so-called secret of Laterano or whatever? I don't know a single thing about it. I'm just after the easy life. The less I know, the better off I'll be, don't you think?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Hmm? Isn't that guy over there from the Notarial Hall...? What? He wants to make sure I'm 'fulfilling my obligations?' Dear Lord! I pay my taxes on time every month, okay? Anyway, just give me a whisper if he's looking for me. I need time to run and hide.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I was really bored, so I went down to the bridge to chill out… Err, I mean, I wanted to enjoy the scenery. But everybody was looking at me like I was there to assassinate somebody. Man, they really take me for a killer? As if I'd ever want a job like that. Way too much trouble.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My old brass would always drone on about 'defending the glory of Laterano with your life' and blah blah blah. But that kind of stuff is so boring. I hated how dead-end my life was back then. Working with Rhodes Island is way better. You give me something more practical.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: My hair's a little messy? Meh, I forgot to deal with my bed head. It's not like I have a mission today... Aww, this sucks... Can you tell me if my braid is crooked? It feels kinda weird. You really oughta have a mirror in your office, you know.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Here, I got you a cake. So, what do you usually do during your breaks? You really should take a lap around the city, get yourself some fresh air, don't you think? If you're worried about your safety, just grab an operator who can go 'pow pow' on any baddies who pop up, and you're set.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Wanna watch a movie? We're almost done with work anyway. How about... this romance about a princess and a wanderer from afar? Wait, I need to hang up my do-not-disturb sign. Wouldn't want someone walking in with a pile of documents.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Break time. Now, what should I do...?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Ambriel, sniper, from Laterano… Alright, that's introductions out of the way before they give me a headache. Here, I just opened this pack of chocolate pretzel sticks. Want one?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Man, how long is this video…? Is there no option to play all of them at once?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Much obliged. Oh, speaking of which, do these promotions come with a salary increase? There's something I've been looking at…

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thank you very much. I've been with Rhodes Island for a while now, right? Before I knew it, I'd gotten a whole lot out of this, and made some good memories too.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Woah, my teammates look pretty capable this time.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Just a heads-up for you, my tactics are a little unorthodox.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Ready? Let's get going.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I hope we can wrap this mission up before dinner.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Let me finish this choco stick first.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Sniper platform, deploying~

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Auto-calibration in progress.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: There you are.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Well, well, well, somebody's no good at hiding.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Wide-open spaces are dangerous, y'know.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I'll send you home.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: You always win big like this, Doctor. You're really something!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Not a single shot wasted - perfect.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Not the prettiest victory, but a win's a win, right?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: The number of targets is still increasing, and they're about to launch an attack. Doctor, let's get out of here...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Doctor! Time to restock the pretzel sticks in the vending machine!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I hear some new clothes came into the store? Doctor, come check 'em out with me!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Huh? You're goofing off here too? Alright then, come take a seat. I feel kinda peaceful, sitting on the bridge, watching the busy people run all over the deck. But why is it so empty today? Kinda straaange... Wait a second! Today is New Year's?!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Yo.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, got this for you. 'Cheez-Pack'd Butter Flavor Cheese Snaps.' It's a limited-edition, definitely not my extras—okay, I admit it. I bought a little too much. Soooo my savings are dry. Anyway, why don't we hit the streets together next time? I'll make it up to you with something good when we do.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: You want to know what I've found at Rhodes Island that's so 'practical'? Um, obviously, seeing a different sunset on the bridge every day, and the feeling of using this gun to do something good. Pretty cool, yeah? Just kidding. Alright, let's forget all this complicated stuff. I'm gonna nab some pudding from the canteen!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Yo, Doctor! Is it time for my shift? Hmm? I suddenly popped up out of nowhere? Nope, just got here.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: C'mon, man, I worked with you on my background check. And I told you a million times: My last job was with Reunion, sure. But I wasn't mixed up in any of the criminal stuff. No guilt here!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: If there's one thing I really hated about Reunion, it was the food! If you can even call it food… My team mostly got by on rock-hard black bread. I had to throw it in a pot and simmer it into stew every time. Those people were just brutal on their stomachs.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You must've run into Reunion's 'Wraith' guys a whole bunch of times, right? I was one of those. They sent me to scout stuff, never did any fighting. I used to place bets on who would or wouldn't get seen as a way to deal with the boredom. Thinking back, I guess that was kind of rough on the other guys.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: What did I do before I joined Reunion? I was playing hide n' seek with the Infected hunters, duh. With my sneaky little power here, they went home empty-handed every time, haha… But all I could do was hide. And that wasn't gonna help change things for the Infected.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I joined up with the underground because I wanted to help other Infected. But over time, I got jaded, then I stopped being a good guy... Well, at least my hands are 'clean' again. What do I mean by that? Hehe, that's enough questions, friend. Never you mind.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Look, camouflage Arts are really complicated! First, you gotta actually know the compisition and texture of your surroundings. Then, you memorize the shape of every crack in the wall, and all the colors of all the soil and every tree. If you don't have those down, even your nerves will get you popping out, and then it's only a matter of time until you're made.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You were the only one in the office, and your snacks disappeared as soon as you turned your head? Wow, that's weird. Why don't you leave it to me? I'll solve this mystery and bring the thief right to you. Yep.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: So this is a map of the operating area? Let's see… Wow, you're really something. Your strategies are so clever, no wonder Reunion always got their asses handed to them. Okay, I'm moving out!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hm? The door isn't locked?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Where am I? Right in front of you! You can call me Ethan. How did I get in here? Haha! Can't answer that one yet.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Where was I? C'mon! Right over there! Look at the top left of screen. Top left corner!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Haha, I told you before right? You won't regret putting work into my hands.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Yo, Doctor. Make sure you remember the little guys like me. I could die in some battle somewhere and nobody would even know I was gone. So please, remember where I am!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: The wall moved, right before your eyes? Naw, you're exaggerating, definitely.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Eyyy! I'm the captain now, so you'd all better listen up!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Don't panic if you suddenly notice a missing squadmate.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Time to fight? I gotta hide first!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hey, over here!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: What's the plan?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Let's dance.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Good spot here.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Get 'em! Get 'em good!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Violence can't solve all your problems, but it can solve you!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Haha, you can't see me!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Feel like you're gonna faint?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Are we done fighting? Ahh, I'm beat!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I worked pretty hard. You saw me, right? Right?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: So what if they got away. Just let 'em go.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: You should go first, at least I can grab their legs.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Nice room you got here. Let's see what sticks out the most.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh, you found me.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Hey, wanna go for a stroll?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Bluh, this weather's so nasty my blood's freezing up! That's what gets Savra like us the worst, the cold! Yo, Doctor, turn up the heat a little. C'mon, I'm here to say Happy New Year, don't get mad! Ooh-hoo-hoo, lemme get a nice, hot bowl of soup ready. Gotta fill it with mushrooms and meat...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey, Doctor, somebody looks happy. Did something good happen?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: You're saying you got a present but never saw from who? Huh, that's crazy, must be some paranormal stuff going on here. Why don't we go check the monitors... Hey, wait a sec, you know I'm not for real, right?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Ahh. You know, being an Infected, it's cool to get stable work here. I can even get some little hobbies too. I must've been pretty great in my past life to deserve all this—nah, wouldn't be Infected now, if I was. Man! Forget it, I'm gonna help out with the decorations!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Greetings, I'm here for my shift… That's a peculiar look on your face. Do I seem so unreliable?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: We don't throw ourselves into battle because we want to. We just have a stronger will to survive than most. If you understand, that alone would be enough.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Zima, the girls, and I all came from different schools. But all the students in the city knew the legends of General Zima. Doesn't that sound cool? Literally. Zima is Ursine for 'winter', you see. Hm, yes.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: How did we escape from Chernobog? Hmm... you really don't want to know. Sometimes the truth is better left untold.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Oh? I'm reading a mystery novel… As a matter of fact, it taught me some lessons that proved useful in getting me through that terrible time.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My favorite books? Hmm, I enjoy topics like politics, economics, and dialectical materialism… Baking magazines and stuff like that are nice too.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Home? My hometown? Obviously, we can't go back there. You know as well as I do that there's nothing left of it. Even if we rebuilt Chernobog, I still…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Rhodes Island is safe. And there are so many books here in your office... If I could, I'd really prefer to stay here…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: What will I do in the future? Hmm… No idea. My books don't have an answer for that. I hope someone will give offer me one, someday…

voices.title: Idle
