voices.text: Such a twist is beyond my imagination. 'Every last one of the passengers on this train, you're all murderers!'

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Istina. I'm still a student, but I was recruited for my ability to use Arts… Yes, it is rather strange for a student to serve here, isn't it?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: You want me to be stronger?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Do you feel like you understand me better now? Naive, you're far from really knowing me.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Now that you've offered me such recognition, I will reveal my true power. Allow me to demonstrate by reducing this office to a fine powder… Just kidding. There are too many precious books here. I would never do something so awful.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Understood.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Hmm… The team is somewhat different from what I imagined.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's show our determination, earnestness, and boundless passion.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: May the star of victory shine upon us.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What is it, Doctor?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Go ahead.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I have a distaste for war.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: It seems we must fight.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Come at me.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Please, no need to rush.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Let us take it slow.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Time to teach you a lesson.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Why do they fight... even when it may cost them their lives? What do they gain from it?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, if you have to commend us, now is the time.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Those enemies who fled... We probably won't see them again.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Neither our numbers nor our efforts were sufficient…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: A secret room, where, shall we say, interesting things happen.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What?!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: It's too noisy here, I'd rather read in the Doctor's office.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: No, I, I'm not honey-drunk, Sonya just poured me a, a little, but I just felt I should convey to you, a, Happy New Year... Er, are these Sonya's flowers? For the New Year? Why is this flower, burning hot to the touch…

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. This hardcover is my gift to you—Ah, well done, you've discerned without so much as a flip that it contains not literature, but cake. No, I wasn't at all hoping to see you scoop up a handful of icing…

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: 'The Silver Branch', 'Mathematical Theory of Originium Arts', 'Superpropositional Logic'... Hm? I'm going through the books I've read this year. Suspense fiction has its merits, but dipping into all manner of knowledge is comforting, in a sense. It lets me believe, undeniably, that I am moving forward.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor! Was it me you wanted? Or did you want me to find Enya for something?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I can't just pop up anywhere I want like I can back in Kjerag, Doctor. So if you want something delivered for you, you'll want someone else.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor! Is your belly empty? I've learned how to use Rhodes Island's kitchen, so I can put something together for you.... ah, but I can only do Kjerag food for the time being. Hmm... how about some cheese fondue?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Enya... Enya? Doctor, have you seen Enya? It's about time we return to Kjerag, and with all the things that need her attention, she has to come with us. Just where has that girl scurried off to now...?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: 'Prayer that will be found, devotion that will be rewarded...' If anything that convenient truly existed, I'd like to see it myself. Me? I'm hardly even perfect knitting sweaters—how could I grant anyone's wishes? Oh, but if you'd like a blizzard, that's something I can do for you.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: In a certain way, Enya and Enciodes are the same to me. Both siblings want to change Kjerag, after all. But if I had to say why I'm so much closer to Enya... it's because she became my Saintess. Not Enciodes.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, next time you visit Kjerag, would you like to see the view from the peak of Karlan? Standing at the summit above the clouds amidst the mountains, seeing the sun once again is a heavenly feeling. You'll love it—ah, but there is the chance you'll freeze to death before then. Tricky, that...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Enya's attitude towards her brother, well... I'm sure you understand—the opposite of intimacy isn't hatred, but indifference. And she likes to say as much, though it's not actually quite that bad between them. That said, in time... I have no clue at all.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The world outside sprawls vast and far, Doctor. But I've come to realize something. It's like people are the same no matter where you go. The palette of emotions outside does not differ from what I have seen in Kjerag. It truly is a fascinating thing, though just as dull too.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Oh, my, your sleeping posture is terrible... I'll run you a bowl of water. You can wash your face as soon as you come round.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor... shh. I came out in secret with Enya. Make sure Ensia and the Karlan Trade people don't find out, or things will get messy for her.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: *Sigh*. No matter how advanced our weapons get, combat is still so barbarous...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Oh! A promotion...Well, I've come here with Enya quite a few times now...

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: The Rhodes Islanders by and large seem to know who I am now. Which means I can get a little closer to them, right...? Oh, can't I?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Oh, won't you want me leading, Doctor?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll see you all safely through.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Anyone we've left behind?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Let me quell the enemy!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Dear me, I’m not done readying yet!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Let's assist others, shall we?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Don't you fret. No matter the environment, I can 'see' them just fine.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: No need for mercy on the enemy, correct?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: You thought I couldn't see you?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I'm aimed at you, you know?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You didn't think it'd come from this angle, did you?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You're not getting close to me that easily, you know?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, you can't be overzealous in challenging your limits, or you might hurt yourself.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: What a splendid job, Doctor! You make me want to pat you on the head~

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Now, now, it's alright. These are fine enough results, aren't they?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, fear not. I'm here.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Let's see, here's... whereabout is this?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh?!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, would you like to go on a walk together?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Oh, so this holiday's far more widespread than just a Kjerag celebration. No, I don't think it's too strange. I just feel like once one holiday's over, you blink and the next one's already here. How curious. Still, any reason to be happy's a good reason. Doctor, would you like some cheese fondue?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor! Did you sleep well last night?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Come have a taste of this cake I made, or maybe blow out the candles and make a wish first? Oh, and put on this medicinal garland, it'll bless any children to live a hundred years free of ailments! You're not little anymore, you say? Heheh, Doctor, what are you telling me.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Without even noticing it, I've racked up an awful lot of visits here with Enya. I must say, Doctor, I'm gradually starting to understand why Enya loves to scurry over here when she's free. You see, this is a place full of interesting, adorable people. To where will you lead this sailing ship? I'd love to see for myself.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Fragmentation mines deployed. None may interfere with your work or rest, Doctor. You can focus on your duty.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I am well aware that Rhodes Island has its own specialists in countering infiltration, sabotage and assassination. I know not who is behind these, but they are operating covertly in every corner of this landship. My mind is just playing tricks on me? Negative, Doctor. My mind does not play tricks.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I serve the Laterano Notarial Hall, so I rarely live in Laterano. But even if a Laterano citizen lives in other city-states, most of their rights and privileges still depend on the support of the Hall. In my case, for example, my work has less to do with the living, but more with those at death's door.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The control system is denying you access? Please allow me to check it. Mm, it appears to be a front-end crash caused by inputting an erroneous command. It has nothing to do with the framework and can be easily solved. Doctor, please feel free to ask me if you have any similar issues in the future. I understand machines better than I do people.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: There are many Sankta at Rhodes Island who also use a gun. They will not fire at one other in the face of the law, but I am different. If necessary, I will not hesitate to fire upon my fraters. Of course, there is hardly a need for that, because my fists are sufficient to deal with most of them.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Do not worry about the Notarial Hall. They are all reasonable people, and the agreement I signed with Rhodes Island is also in line with their protocols, so they won't make things difficult for you. As a matter of fact, Doctor, I think you are well suited for notarial work yourself. They always welcome foreign employees.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I have a distant relative who had great musical talent ever since she was a child. Contrary to what others expected, her gift led her onto a tumultuous path. Fortunately, she seems to hate me very much, because I cannot see the illusion she creates, nor understand what emotion means to people.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Private disputes are more frequent than public conflicts, as chaos is the norm over order. I have seen much more people who fired upon me at first glance than those who opened their doors to welcome me. But it matters not, for I can complete any commission, whether it is to kill a living person on behalf of the dead, or to create a dead person on  behalf of the living.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Being treated as an aberration is normal to me, because I cannot understand other people, nor do I have any desire to deal with them. On the contrary, talking to you is quite interesting to me, Doctor. Neither you nor the Notarial Hall has denied me because of the way I live. You make me feel at ease. Thank you.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Rest is necessary, Doctor. Take your time and rest well.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Well met, Doctor of Rhodes Island. I am a Laterano citizen who signed a clean-up agreement with your company. Here is my certificate. You require to know my name? You may call me Executor, if you insist.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: There is value in referencing these battles.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you. I have already prepared all the ammunition I need for the next battle. If the situation worsens, please allow me to use heavier firepower. Promotion? I have already thanked you for that.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Another promotion? I understand, there must be an infiltration operation that requires me at the heart of the enemy. If that's your wish, then I have no objections. You have no such a need? You are just promoting me? Why's that?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: The law won't enforce itself. It needs executors.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I am not good at working with others.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Departing.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Objective: eliminate all enemies.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Let's begin.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Your request has been confirmed.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Victory is an illusion.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Only the law is the truth.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: My bullets always find their targets.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I carry out the wills of the dead and the living.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Maximizing firepower.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: All is permitted when called by necessity.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Mission completed. All contracts successfully fulfilled.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission completed.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission completed. Defects in the result.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Mission failed.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Do not worry about me. I have no need for stable residence.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: I am confused.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: How can I help you, Doctor?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, a pile of fireworks is amassed on the deck. There would be severe consequences if someone decides to use them for vadalism. For your safety, I will return to inspect— No? Roger that, I respect your decision. Just for the record, such tactics as raised may be applicable in our next operation.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, please exercise caution.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Like others, I have prepared a gift for you. However, given I do not grasp the associated connotations, I am unsure whether my imitation of this formality may displease you. I may need to rephrase as follows. Would I be allowed to do something that makes you happy today?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I execute every assignment from Rhodes Island stringently, as I do with instructions from the Notarial Hall. However, when contrasted, your assignments better reflect my efficiency. No, I have no intent of comparing partner organizations. I simply mean to say that you are a truly outstanding commander.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You can keep me in the shadows. My KIA status comes in handy, so no running your mouth about me being here.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: ...I'd put down that tray, if I were you. It's one of W's 'wake-up calls' she makes for all of us. The woman's brain's like those wilds around Kazdel, taken by her overgrown madness by the year. And anyone who trusts a lunatic like her... Heh, is probably just as insane.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: There was one who hoped to flee the war, but only ended up sinking deeper and deeper into its quagmire. Heh, Pathetic, isn't it? But that's exactly how we live. We either give up and resign ourselves to death, or... we kill this very way of life.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Your eyes aren't deceiving you. Yes, it's a sewing kit. A needle drinks as much blood as a sword, in the hands of a merc. Besides… it's a tall order to look decent on battlefield, and a smart cookie like you should know that well, right?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: On the northern side of Kazdel... is a birch forest. Those gray and white trees wither in the frigid wind, then struggle to regain their vitality the following year. But when the last trees died, they had no idea that spring would never come back.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: 'For all the people to fall into peaceful slumber?' Not half bad for a fancy dream of yours. I only hope people could have a chance to struggle on in the face of war and death, and perhaps after that, some energy leftover to hold a grudge. That is why I'm signing this agreement with Babel… with you, Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Those faint lights out the window... They're campfires in the wilderness. W says I like campfires? Hehe, that's because the shadows under the fire don't lie. I see myself in them.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: A merc who lived her life staring death in the face, but chose to die for a pipe dream in the end… Sounds like a bad joke, doesn't it? But if you had to make sense of it, the merc probably hopes her death could be more than a sneaky battlefield tactic. That's all.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My eyes tell me that this ship, that doctor, Her Majesty, and you... have all changed. W thinks you're too good of an actor. She doesn't want to admit it, but she's changed a lot too. It's not like there's anything we could do about it anyway. The shadows beneath our feet keep getting longer and longer.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: ...Your dreams are a lot more peaceful than I expected.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Ascalon showed you my files. Messenger or mercenary, you ask? Doesn't matter. I'm not after your life for now , 'Doctor.'

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Are you sure I need to watch these? Back in Kazdel, you used to lead my people.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Hmph, great. Even in the middle of a war, you people still insist on these goddamned ceremonies.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: For us mercs, life is war, and war is life. The only escape is death. Our struggle will never end, as long as we live.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Getting this crew together wasn't easy. You better make them count.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: W, on my team? Whatever, I'm just wondering what crap she's up to this time.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's see... Which insect is falling into my trap?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The shadows are trembling.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I know what to do. Don't order me around.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Don't keep me waiting.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Picked out your bait yet?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'm listening.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: You can't hide your fear.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Nothing can mask the scent of despair.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Better watch your step.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I will sink your corpse into shadow. No one will find it.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: You always win, just like the old days. But this time, your joy is real.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Take a breather and tally up your losses. Nothing worth celebrating here, we might be dead in a second or two.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Wow, you kept everyone alive. Congrats.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: ...An arm, an eye, or maybe something else. More than enough to trade for a few enemy heads. Or, would you rather bear the price of failure? Tch, suit yourself.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: 'Rhodes Island'... This landship sure has gotten a lot brighter.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Not the safest way to say hello.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: If you want to make small talk, Hoederer's your guy. Or... I guess you'd rather stand here in silence with me for a while.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: ...A New Year's gathering? Choosing a specific day to get together is basically begging the enemy to ambush you. I... Well, whatever. Tell Hoederer I'm going. I have to keep an eye on W, in case she decides to do something stupid again.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Ascalon forced me to take this 'bodyguard' gig. Pick your jaw up off the ground, Doctor. You'll be seeing a lot more of me for a while.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: For us mercs, getting older isn't a thing to celebrate. You pick up more scars, and your value goes down. If there's anything worth celebrating, it's the fact that our victories were able to buy us another year.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: You've tied so many different kinds of landmines together, and you can barely keep them from exploding. Now that's something I have to hand to you. Rhodes Island is a whole lot crazier than any band of mercs I've ever known.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Why is this office so damn cold?! Hey, you there! You okay with me using that for kindling?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Oh, How much did you say this book costs? Haha, pricey. Call me Mistress Ifrit and I'll give it back to you.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Huh? You want me to read this book? I hate it when people try to tell me… It's from Silence? Really? Urgh... Wha-what does this word mean here?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I hate it when you white coat creepers stare at me... Yeah, I mean you! What'cha looking at? Go stare at something else!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Um... Okay, fine. No more scaring people with fire.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Back off! You... Why are you coming at me like that? You wanna strap me to a lab table too?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Saria's here? I want to see her— Silence says no? C'mon, what's the big deal? Just take me to her and keep it off the record!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Why are Silence and Saria arguing all the time? I don't get it... Hey! You gotta know how to get them to make up, right? C'mon, just tell me… I mean, please...?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I don't care what you think of me, but you'd better be nice to Silence. When she wants something, you go get it for her! Do that, and your wish is my command.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You little...! You've got guts to ignore me and slack off like this!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: You stand before the almighty Ifrit! Hmph, Silence says Rhodes Island's a nice place, but there's nothing I hate more than you white-coat science creepers... I mean, except Silence...

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Stronger...? Hmm, that means my flames can burn brighter, right?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: What's this? Promotion Manual for Rhodes Island Operators? Guess I'll give it a peek... What the hell? So many rules even after I get promoted? Nah-uh, pass.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Haha, that's right! I don't give a damn about all those rules. But, if you say you're counting on me, then that's all the words I need!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Yeah yeah, I heard ya.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm the captain? So, just do like Silence would, right?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Hey! They made me the captain, so I'm the one calling the shots here!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Yo! How 'bout another barbecue!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hey!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Too slow!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Let the world BURN!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Hellfire, locked and loaded!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Does it hurt? I bet it does!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Hahaha! Keep screaming!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Shriek all you want! Nobody cares!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Get in the line of death!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Weak, you're all too weak! I am invincibllllle!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Why don't we torch all the trash into kindling? It'll be nice and warm!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Nothing but cinders left now. I could've handled this all by myself!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Damn you... You made a fool out of me!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What kind of place is this? Huh?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: The hell are you doing here?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Heheh, you're nicer than I expected. Wanna hang out?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: New Year's? Hah, no sweat, Silence taught me about New Year's forever ago. You celebrate all of last year, and make your resolutions or whatever for next year! My resolutions? Hey, what's with the homework? Silence said I don't have to do any today! Beat it!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You need something?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Feast your eyes on the great Ifrit's handmade chocolate cake! Silence taught me, and I got it right on the first try! I know, I know, I'm the best! ...Wh-What the hell? How come it melted?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: What's the deal outside today, why's it so noisy? Whoooa, there's a party! Is there a barbecue? I'm really good at barbecue, everyone should come eat mine! Which means, it's time to stoke the fire… What? We're not doing it on a charcoal grill? Boring! Where'd my grill go? Shaw confiscated it? Arrrrrrgh—

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You need my help with your mountain of work? Haha, I'm not sure if I should be intervening in Rhodes Island's internal affairs though...? It's no problem? Uh, really?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Our laws are incapable of perfectly solving every dispute. There are many situations where even the saints can't help. I must admit, I have a deep respect for people like the bishop from that monastery, considering the problems he faced. Too bad I don't have such lofty faith.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Was that Arene earlier? Now when did that punk learn some manners...? You taught him? Wow, now that's impressive! I guess even a devious boy like him is still just a boy. Easy enough to trick him onto the right track... Huh...? You didn't trick him?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Yo, Doctor! Ambriel and the others are doing a dessert potluck, and I'm bringing donuts. Mind helping me taste test? Okay, so what do you think—Whoa whoa, slow down on the water! It's too sweet and greasy? Strange, I thought the sugar level was just right...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Don't get me wrong, Doctor, yes, I was elected as 'a representative of the Notarial Hall', but that's just because everyone's curious about what magical place could  Federico endorse, and they needed someone out to take a look for them. In other words, they picked me to come take a look-see here. I've got no say on any matters relating to the Notarial Hall, so don't ask me about that sort of thing, okay?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I'm lucky I was born a Lateran. No, Doctor, our good fortune does not lie in our halos, but in our material abundance and strong state. You have an ideal Rhodes Island of your own? It's not easy, chasing your dreams, but... good luck I guess?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Take note of your posture, keep your crossbow aimed straight ahead, turn your body slightly... Yes, just like that, and then pull the trigger! Wow, bullseye! Very nice! Oh no, no need to thank me, I just helped correct your posture, that's all. You're very talented, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Come sit over here, Doctor. I have something to discuss with you. There's a bunch of Sarkaz I know, and they're pretty good in a fight, so if Rhodes Island ever needs a few helping hands... Haha, yes, I'm not eager to make trouble for myself, but... Well, I might be going too soft, but why not consider it?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I thought you might have found this business annoying, so I dealt with it in your place, and here's the mission report. The scene was something of an eyesore, so I didn't attach any photos. I executed every last name in your notes, no exceptions.   What's with the look, Doctor? Do you feel unwell?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Oh, Doctor, you're awake… What? Please don't tell Dr. Kal'tsit and Amiya you were napping at work? Ahaha, what napping?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Liaison from the Lateran Notarial Hall, Insider. Here's the paperwork for our collaboration. May I ask which office I should be heading to next? I'm making my first impression here at Rhodes Island, so I want to do this perfectly.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Let's see... Ezell is still so merciful in battle, huh... Sheesh, Federico is the exact opposite!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion? Thank you for your affirmation, Doctor. However, does this mean I'm going to have to handle even more difficult work in the future?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Many thanks. I will report that Rhodes Island intends to deepen the level of cooperation with the Notarial Hall... Wait, this is a personal commendation for me? Haha, what an honor.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Got it. You've determined that use of force is required in the current situation, and I'll trust you on that.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm in charge? Alright then, I would like everyone to act freely as they wish. And everyone is responsible for their own actions.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Firearm, check.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I wish everyone could just calm down, before I raise my gun to settle things.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Alright, mission accepted.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Bullets may be fast, but they aren't always so quick to solve disputes.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Chill, everyone, I'm just here for a few questions.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: If you insist on being so stubborn, then... prepare for execution.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I'm actually better at wrestling than shooting. Makes the cleanup easier.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I'll give you some time to cry out in pain while I adjust my weapon.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I was really hoping it wouldn't turn out like this.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: In our current situation... A complete sweep would be the most efficient solution.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I knew I was getting into trouble coming here, but thankfully I've got you, Doctor. I wouldn't have figured out how to resolve such a complicated conflict by myself.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Alright, time to pack up my gun. Mission complete, Doctor. We achieved victory just as planned, so there shouldn't be any post mortem work required, right?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: What, did some of them escape? Ah, I had one eye closed while aiming my shots, so maybe they happened to be out of my sight.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: It's clear we need to overhaul our plans.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: You have such good accommodation here? This place is top-notch in all the foreign posting I've had.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Haha, Doctor. You're not scaring me that easily.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: It's nice to occasionally get some rest in places like this corridor. After all, most of Laterano's benches are found only outdoors.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! A new year usually comes with a multitude of troublesome incidents, and I don't know how Rhodes Island deals with... Why aren't I back in Laterano to work right now? Ahaha, foreign missions are also very important, you know.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You can take a break first, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, what would you like for your birthday? One of the occasional tasks I get is to help people return unwanted gifts. Instead of making things so troublesome, it's better to just outright ask the recipient what they would like, don't you think?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Hmm, the atmosphere calls for a serious talk, does it? Alright, I'll be serious, Doctor, I wasn't actually that curious about Rhodes Island compared to the other executors, but now, I really admire your capabilities. Moving towards conflict instead of avoiding it is definitely not easy.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Mhmmmm... Hm? Did you say something? No, I'm not ignoring you. I'm just... thinking of something else.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I... I've always been alone, so I'm not good at making conversation. It did cause much trouble when my travels began. Some people feared me, one even conned me out of my luggage. Things were difficult, but not entirely hopeless. As long as I have my staff, I can work, so I won't go hungry for too long.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Life in the lighthouse was hardly dull. The seas are always changing. However, my teacher said that only by seeing more of this land, could I guard a small corner of the seaside. She then drove me out of the lighthouse. That's how I made my way here.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Blue Poison gave me a new pair of gloves. Pretty, aren't they? She also said the material is modified. Now it can better prevent poisoning from accidental touches. Actually, It happens so often when I'm around my poison-wielding friends... I feel that I may have built up an immunity.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I used to gaze into the sea every night. No one in town knew what we were seeking or guarding, and my teacher never told me. All I know is that, where there is darkness, there must be a lighthouse. I will stay watching, until that day comes.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The light you just saw… Some call it Originium Arts, but my teacher says it's the power from our hearts. With light to guide them, even those who sail in the foggiest nights will brave the raging tides and find their way to shore. That is why I will do my best to protect this light.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: My tail has a beautiful color? Mhm, thank you very much. You may touch it if you want. Despite the color, it's not poisonous.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Could you hold my staff for me, Doctor? My hair's getting too long. I want to arrange it before it gets tangled up. It might take a while, but I'll be able to better support you on the battlefield.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I'm starting to realize that people can be like lighthouses… Some can even shine farther and brighter than any of them... like you, Doctor. Would it be okay if I stay beside you for a little longer before I go back?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You don't need me to keep watch while you sleep? Yes? You want me to take a nap, too? I-I'll try...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. My name is Aria… Uh, sorry, I mean Indigo. I used to be a lighthouse keeper... Um, apprentice. Now my position is a Caster, but... also an apprentice. I really look forward to learning from you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Are these techniques for fending off enemies? My teacher taught me a little, but I didn't know you could do this.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: What…? A promotion? A lighthouse needs only one keeper. Is that... not the case here?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I can do even more…? Indeed… my light shines even farther now... Thank you, Doctor. I will keep doing all I can.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Indigo at the ready.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Very well... I'll keep this light up. Please be careful not to wander off.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Follow the light, please.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: If you insist on stopping us, then we have no choice but to defeat all of you.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm all ready.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: The seas are roaring.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: My staff's getting warmer.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: The light grows.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: These enemies do not compare to the seas' ferocity.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I shall stand guard, until daybreak.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: The fear for light, comes only from the evil within.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: If you wish to flee, then follow this light.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: With such power, perhaps we won't need to fear the arrival of that day…?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Thank goodness. Another night of calm sea.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: S-Some enemies got away? I see. We must alert everyone.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, this way... Don't be afraid. It doesn't matter how dark the path up ahead is, I'll light it for you.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's okay. I'll be fine by myself.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh... Doctor, you're tangled in my hair. Please be careful; tripping and falling can be painful.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Would you like to stay here with me...? You know... The night watch won't be as dull with company.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: To the ocean, every day is the same with its ebbs and flows. As its watcher, I feel the same. I read that the ocean used to be gorgeous at night, with moonlit waves that danced as if wearing silvery capes. It's a pity we can't see that anymore. If we could go back in time, Doctor, I would love to see it with you.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, would you like the light to be brighter?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here… a cake for you. Blue Poison taught me how to bake it. I've practiced plenty of times, so it's sure to taste great despite its looks. The gloves? They're for food hygiene, Doctor, not because the cake's poisonous, trust me.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: When my teacher sent me away, I couldn't see why. She had taught me everything she knew, yet she still said I wasn't ready. It only became clear after I came to Rhodes Island. Anyone can guard the lighthouse, but to face all that follows once the light is lit requires great knowledge of this land.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: If you got enemies about, just scream. I'll keep ya safe.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Where's that kid gone off to? Y'know, her... the really tanned shorty who's always trailing our Master... 'Morgan' is her nam- Oi! Stop right there!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours, we keep it real that way, yeah? You treat me with respect, I'll do the same for you.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Seems our Majesty's really into your place. Don't see that every day, seeing as we're never anywhere same for long.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Work or what have ya, you've gotta have guts!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Whoa, whoa, chew before you swallow, mate! HEY! SOMEONE BRING US MORE MEAT! This girl's got an empty belly to fill!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Bleeding Morgan... she might seem like a layabout mostly, but she's our tactician when push comes to shove. Gets the job done. Gets on my nerves otherwise, though, and she loves it. Tch...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doesn't she look brilliant, like a liege with a hammer in hand? I'm even more keen to see the look of her holding a sword, though.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Out with it! Don't beat around the bush, just say it: who do you want dealt with?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Tch. look at you spacing out like an idiot... Your own bloody fault if a tiger bites you.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Indra. I don't have any of those weird crazy powers -- I let my fists do the talking. Nice to meet ya!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Niiice, this is good stuff.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotions are great, almost as great as fighting is!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Don't be afraid. I'll protect ya.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Where's the battlefield?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: So, who's in the market for a walloping?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Mind your own sodding business and let me be!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Come on! Show me what you've got!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Oi!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Get on with it, plod!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Haha!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: All right, it's my turn!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: You bastard!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Nothing can stop me!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You're dead meat!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Give it up!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: That's the stuff! That's what I call a kick!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: You don't go home happy without some bloodshed!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Tch, we've got some who fled. Bunch of cowards.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Not bad... But I'll get you back for this!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What's this room about? More of a squeeze than anywhere I've been.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oi! You got a bleedin' death wish?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: C'mere, lemme get my arms around you! Yes, I mean hug you!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Ooh! Gotcher end-of-year bonus? Haha, I must be due for one too, scrapping so much on your behalf! You and me, we're fellows now, no two ways about it! Get up, I'm taking you out for food!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: What's up, Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Hah, it's your birthday today, then. Here's a prezzie: these brass knuckles. They're the tiger's choice, get all your average muckers done and dusted! You should learn to watch yourself too, I say. Can't always count on me being there when you're in danger, right? Still, if I'm around and anyone picks on you, their arse is good as kicked!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Vina trusts Rhodes Island. That's why I take orders from you, no hesitation. But you listen here, Doctor. You need to feel the weight of that trust. Else I'll make you feel it, even if I need my fists to do it—and I don't mean wanting to scrap with you. But you just keep what I've said in mind.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, I'm putting the flowerpots here. The scent from these clears the mind. It'll help you sift through those documents, guaranteed.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I used to have to collect plant samples for my employer whenever he barked the order. Give me a scarcely-traveled rainforest and I'll head in happy. Thing is, once our specimens started growing in people's hydroponic pots, and then protected areas, and then test farms... Well, that's where the trouble began.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I was in the Convalescent Garden, and I saw the plant almanac Perfumer's compiling. Lots of gaps, no way to fill them in as of yet. See, a good plant hunter fills the blanks with their 'prey.' A great plant hunter not only does that, they also get the author to leave them plenty more new blanks.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I've been to Acahualla plenty. The residents there, Tiacauhs, I believe the name is. They're good people. They'll be frank with you, straight with you. It's just, two things I can't stand: one, they force me to go wrestling when they get drunk, and two, they keep judging my tail... is it really that thin, Doctor? My tail?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: This handsaw was custom-made for me by my mother while I was still in school. Never thought I'd be using it again after I got infected. Thanks to that employer of mine, hiring plant hunters. He let me continue doing what I loved... even if he's the same bloke who fired me out of paranoia in the end.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, this is the plant that got me fired. No monetary value, so you can imagine... I told my boss I forsook my assigned target for this bit of shrubbery, and he thinks I'm having him on somehow... But listen. I discovered this 'un. I gave it its name. And nothing could matter more than that.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: To make a 'scarecrow,' you need a whole lot more than just straw. You also need a variety of tough, poisonous, and insect-eating plants, Originium Arts, as well as my dad's techniques to sew everything together... Tch, leaked my trade secrets again. Doctor, remember not to tell anyone.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You're right, I am in fact used to keeping a cold, stoic persona in front of strangers. After all, your average plant hunter doesn't usually get into interpersonal conflict with a standing army. It's more often absent-minded guards with fixed salaries. Overpowering your opposition by putting on airs can actually ensure your safety, funny enough.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, this is my very first time making a 'Scarecrow' for someone else. What d'you think? Uncanny resemblance, right? If danger's ever afoot, this can help—oi, slow down, don't touch those vines, else they'll—Hrm. It'll let go of your arm naturally after a short while. Trust me.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You were just trying to chat with me and I wasn't responding? Ooh, um, see, I was DEFINITELY, NOT using a 'Scarecrow', tooooo skive off work. Honest.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I need a job, and being a pharmaceutical company, surely Rhodes Island won't turn down an experienced plant hunter. And the plant hunter in question is none other than... Y'what? I just need to sign here, that's it? No fibs?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hang on! I think I saw a very rare shrub. Might even be a new species! Where was this video taken?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: There's a beautiful medal... but the design's a bit dull. You considered adding some plant motifs to it?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Never mind contending with people. I prefer exploring the wilderness, delving into the rainforest, living among the plants... Want to come along with me next time, Doctor?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Can we settle disputes some other way that's not direct conflict?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: All I can assure you is everyone returns safe. I cannot guarantee victory like the others can. Are you SURE you want me as squad leader?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: If this conflict truly is necessary, I suppose there's no way around it.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Good bit of bravery in you to stand as my enemy.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Chop-chop with the orders. I'll make 'em regret showing their faces.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Chop-chop with the orders? I can see them coming...

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Dead branches and rotten leaves! I'll sweep up in no time, just you watch.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Bunch of ten-a-penny weeds. Nothing I'm interested in.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: The harder on the outside, the softer on the inside.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Plant looks risky, who can tell. Plant looks safe, you're in for hell.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Never assume the simple days will last.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: ...Uh-oh. Time I dropped a 'Scarecrow'!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I never thought I'd be getting the best of that vicious an enemy... At this rate, you think we could be off somewhere more dangerous for sample-collecting?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: There we go, enemies dealt with, now we can show ourselves the door and leave.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: A few of 'em got away... They're not coming back, are they?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Stay alive, Doctor. You won't have a future to count on otherwise.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: If I want to help improve Rhodes Island's plant diversity, where do I apply?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: If you can't tell the difference between me and a 'Scarecrow,' I think the vines might've poisoned you.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Hmm... Where should I go to collect samples next time?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: As you can see, I'm giving a Scarecrow a new change of clothes. Back in my quiet little hometown, families would all give their scarecrows a fresh bit of kit at the start of each year... Not sure what the cultural significance of that was, but the most important thing is, don't let the fowlbeasts get too used to seeing the same getup. Fowls, they're smart little buggers.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning, Doctor. I watered the flowers in your office for you.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I've been thinking for a long time about what to give you, and finally decided I'd let you choose yourself. Here, take a seed from my palm, any seed. Plant it, and see what kind of flowers you get blooming eventually.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: When I observe plants in the wild, sometimes I'll think, what if the ones that live for hundreds or thousands of years sense the passage of time too? How long would their experience of one year be...? Whatever it is, I'm sure it's not like mine. It always feels like each year passes by in a flash.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Did you call me here for a new hunt? No? Gah…

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: This claw pendant? It's a symbol of revenge. The Ursus mercenaries who hurt my people treat these things as dogtags, so there's no mistaking them.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: A beast took my left hand when I was hunting. Luckily, a mechanic gave me a prosthetic limb, so I can draw my bowstring again.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: There was a time when I would've turned anyone who mocked my scars into a pincushion! But if you ask me now... Well, people like that aren't even worth the trouble.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: If you're ever facing a difficult decision, let your instincts decide for you. Your body won't lie—This is what I've learned after a lifetime of hunts.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I've been living alone ever since my village was wiped out.  So, I… I'm still getting used to being around people... But since you trust me and give me important work, I swear I'll return the favor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Ehh, a pebble got stuck in my prosthetic finger...? Darn it, I'm going to need a mechanic to fix it... N-No, I don't need you, I can handle this myself!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You'll make sure I don't ever lose anyone else? Hmph. Big words. But I'll see for myself if you can back those up.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The doctors here offered to get rid of my more recent scars, but I said no. I want to keep them. They're proof of my work here... You, you understand what I'm getting at?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You're sleeping? Looks like this one can fall asleep almost anywhere. Well, that's a trait we hunters share…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Vermeil, hunter. You won't regret giving me work.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Can I take another look at that?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you, but... are you sure it's okay to promote someone like me?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I don't really care about stuff like Oripathy or 'the rest of my life.' Right now, the happiest thing I can imagine is fighting by your side.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'm here.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You want me to be the captain? Am I... really cut out for the job?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The big game hunt is about to start!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: You don't seem to understand your situation here. You've fallen into my trap.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'll go ahead.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Give me the order.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I can smell the game on the wind.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll be waiting here.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: You'd better start running, or there's only one way this ends.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Don't underestimate the people of the wilderness.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Watch where this arrow goes!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: This arrow will find your throat!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Strong game is still just game.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Nice. If you were born in Siracusa, you would've been a great hunter.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The target got away. I'm going after it.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We can't let it end like this…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This place has walls and a roof… that's enough for me.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Wha?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: ...My plans for the day? Help you with missions. Shoot at enemies. Use up all my arrows. Finish the mission. Eat dinner, go to sleep. Simple enough.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Everyone's celebrating New Year's... It was never this easy in the wild. We got a little cured meat out, ate a few berries we had stored, and that's how we celebrated surviving another year. Maybe it wasn't worth celebrating...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Ah, it's you.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: This cloak's for you. I learned to make this back with the other hunters. If you get lost in the wild one day, that hood you've got isn't gonna save you from sandstorms. Obviously, I'd rather be there with you to protect you, if I could.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I never forgave any of my old enemies, and I'll never forget those who showed me kindness. The old Lateran guy's dead, but there's still Rhodes Island. I have a clear reason to fight with the time I've got left.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Pages of truth torn and lost, blood of friends spilt and chilled... Will you stop that ever-writing hand, if such scene is in you eyes...? I see. I shall assist you in your undertaking.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Oh... It's dark outside. My apologies, I must have misled you. Rather than having fallen into slumber, I was merely too immersed in reading. You need not wait by my side in such silence. Could you find your own  light? Allow me to illuminate it for you.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: We and the Sami are alike? No, we merely hide among them. Our foresight and the Sami's divination are two pathways to the future, and neither side has fully accepted the other... Worry not, Doctor. The reproach I have suffered is not important. I humbly urge you to facilitate the cooperation between us all.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You seem worried that I'll have a difficult time adapting here. But in my eyes, this metal cave is not at all dissimilar to our dwelling. You perceive the flow of fate via the shadows projected on the cave wall, while we have gazed into labyrinthine darkness since our birth. That is the only difference.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Yes, I am gazing at the Sarkaz tracks beneath your feet, but please do not let this bother you. I shall not be prying into your affairs, for the Cyclopes have long turned their attention away from Kazdel. My cooperation with Rhodes Island looks to the threat from the north, and this is my position within your fate.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Is your interest really piqued by this note? You may read it, by all means. But it cannot foretell one's fate. The shapes that prophecies take are not set in stone, therefore keeping records is forbidden to us. In spite of this, I have written these words and fragments. Please view these as... lies that I must make, no matter the means.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: No, no... Please, do not say that... Typhon's life is unrelated to any prophecies. I saved her in the heat of the moment. She is unaware of the cause, nor is she curious about her fate. And it is my wish to never lay eyes on her future.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The wind pays no heed to where each snowflake falls, as it is plenty accustomed to the sight of melting snow. On the icefileds, it sees the ravines sculped by fate... I ask you to understand us in that way. However... As I gaze at you here, I cannot help but feel a hint of sadness.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: This is all my own choices. I would do whatever it takes to fulfill the prophecy that must be fulfilled, no matter the cost. When the day comes, you may loathe me. And so, allow me to offer you my apologies in advance. Would you perhaps think that... Sorry, please, pay me no heed.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: It is still snowing.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: You look the same as I saw you before... Sorry, please pay me no mind. I am a Cyclops from the caverns of the Sami mountains. With the impending darkness in my sight, I seek your cooperation. Please, call me Valarqvin.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: No matter how much you gaze into the past, there are no more possibilities to be seen there.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: My mission will never change, no matter the time. Even so, you would go through the effort to prepare a promotion ceremony for me? You have my thanks.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: A dark fate looms over the lands in silence, only for the occasional flash of lightning to tear it briefly asunder. It is in those moments when the foresighted see. Likewise, it is in those moments that warriors seek to wager their lives.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: As foretold.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: This ray of light may be dim, but I ask all of you to follow it.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Avoid becoming engulfed in snow, as were the fates of many.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I have no intention of setting my eyes on you.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Please accept my advice.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I am here.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Please deliver my visions to the masses.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I have received enlightenment.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: May the lightning tear chaos apart.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: May the blizzard cleanse life and death.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: May the mountains prolong our fates.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: 'We gaze, from the beginning to the end.'

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Fate is always heartless.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: With your axe and wit, you have left your mark on the icefield. Now, we can continue our journey forward.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Are you still concerned? Fate will bring back to you the enemies who escaped.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Please... do not stand before me... No, just allow me to take a moment of rest by myself.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I thank you for arranging for me a place of respite. Alas, I am afraid I cannot make use of it often.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh... That's awfully childish of you.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: This place… is quiet.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The passage of time is vague in our eyes. To us, the most distinct thing might perhaps be the length of time between each droplet of water dripping in the caves. You think I am not one to celebrate holidays? You are mistaken. Like ice-cold frost water, these moments keep me clear-headed and rouse me from our dream.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: May you advance without hesitation, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I cannot offer you my best wishes against my will. On a day like this, we would best take our own paths. May you follow your will and live on. I shall wait for you in the future I see.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: A prophecy about Rhodes Island? My cooperation with you has lasted for some time now, and my answer to your question remains the same as the reason I sought your cooperation in the first place: We see doom often, but we also see what follows in the wake of such doom.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hm? You want to watch me forge weapons? Sure, but be careful not to get singed.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Only weapons that don't see use go undamaged. Therefore, a spotless weapon is actually a terrible sacrilege.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Nowadays, weapon and equipment manufacturing is all modernized. Traditional craftsmen lose their livelihoods because of it. Times change. Those who can't keep up get left behind... that's only natural.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Firearms… these weapons will change the world completely.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My right leg? Oh, It's no big deal. You know, all craftsmen make mistakes.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Thank you for giving me a chance to show what I can do.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You saw my name engraved on some equipment? Well, no need to mind that. Probably has nothing to do with me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Steel and bronze form the bone, and then…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: If me and my hammer can still be of use to you, I'm honored.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: They're promoting new drinks at the bar... What should I have today?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Vulcan, that's what everyone calls me. I can do maintenance on your weapons, if it comes up. The equipment I need for the forge is listed here, in this blueprint.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hmm… I'm feeling inspired. Gotta start the blowers. It's time to work.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A skilled craftsman is crucial to a military organization. I see you understand that well.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Keeping your weapons in good condition is the best way to keep your people safe. You agree with me? Seems I made the right choice joining you.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I just want to focus on my work.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You're making me the leader…? If you insist… Still, I'm much better at designing and producing weapons than giving orders.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Can I stay behind and work? No?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Hopeless imbeciles...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Yes?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'm on it.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Ready and waiting.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Armed up!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Let the fires rage!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I don't need healing.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Your weapon will shatter under my next blow!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Please bring me any enemy equipment you find. I want to know what they're making now.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A victory, just as planned! This is why we need high-quality equipment for our fighters.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Please submit damage reports for all of your equipment. I'll work on repairs when we get back.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: My skills are still lacking…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Do you have a furnace here?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Argh...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Any equipment you have in mind? I can try making it for you.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. A moment please, I'm working the forge. In our trade, we believe that the flames must burn bright over the new year, so that we'll be able to craft strong equipment.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I'm not precisely sure what to give you as a present, since you don't need weapons. But the bar has been mixing some new drinks lately, and they've still got the ones I like. So how about I buy you a drink?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: People at Rhodes Island are beginning to understand the wonders of weapons. I was used to being alone, but now I get a few regular visitors... not that I mind. It's kind of fun, actually. Sometimes I even feel like a few more would be nice.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I can choose my own workplace? Thank you, I'll have the documents over shortly! Hmm, was the Convalescent Garden this way... or that way? Sorry, I'll still need you to show me the way after all…

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: My grandfather told me how wild roses used to grow all over behind the town. White ones, red ones, out in the mountains and fields... Children loved them. Dignitaries took pride in them... But I never saw any. Perhaps he just wanted to trick a naughty child into going to sleep...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The sunlight through the glass, the town's humid air, the aroma of petals and soil... Those were what made naps special for me, alone in the afternoons. No one would ever bother me—at most they'd quietly leave behind their coin, and take what flowers they fancied back home. At least, that's how it was until the tragedy.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I was bringing some seeds back, and Lena was smiling at me the whole time. Why...? Oh, I didn't even notice I had dirt on my face! I feel like when I get busy, I start letting all sorts of things slip my mind. Has it been this way? Well... I used to never have so many worries in the first place.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I don't think me stepping onto the front lines was an act of bravery. My time in the Self-Salvation Corps wasn't that dramatic either. My hometown's gone and I had nowhere to go. All I could do was carry on my friend's last wish, and never look back. Isn't that what war's all about?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Do you think flowers can grow once more, in steel and soil's gaps? Ever since I saw again what that city of iron's become, the question has been bothering me. Maybe Rockrock was right—I'd better take a bag of seeds back home after the war dies down... You don't think we'll be waiting too long?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Excuse me, Doctor, I'm not getting in the way of your sunbathing, am I? I like it here too... The portholes might not be that big, but their sunlight's enough for these flowers to grow. What do you think? It worries me when a place feels lonely, so I took the initiative to decorate the room with them.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, watch out for the thorns on the stems! It's not that I don't want to pick them for you, it's just that they haven't reached the peak of their beauty yet. Hm...? You'd like to help me take care of them? Oh, no problem. Do you need me to teach you how?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: To be honest, my greatest wish would be to return to my hometown, and rebuild my greenhouse. Doctor, are you laughing? I'm guessing you—think I should have loftier dreams...? No need, you say? Heheh, I suppose. Well, not that this'll be easy either, seeing as my hometown's rubble now.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Take a deep breath, Doctor. The scent of roses will put your mind at ease.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Greetings, Doctor. Vendela reporting in. Um, what did Rockrock write for me next, I can't remember... Never mind! Please take this flower, I insist! Its meaning is good luck.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: The method's a perfect fit. You prune leaves and branches the same way.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Then may I request a bigger room? No... It's not that I can't get used to it. I just have more and more roses in my room, and they need more sunlight... Okay, maybe the same goes for me.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Don't worry yourself about these entangled thorns. They're just trying to protect me.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'll try my best to help everyone out.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Everyone, please follow where the petals flutter.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Don't be afraid of the thorns. They are here to help us.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I won't allow them to trample apart this land!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Ugh, there's a bad scent in the air.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Will it really be possible to plant seeds here?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I like these high places. They have plenty of sunshine.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I heard someone tried planting sunflowers on the roof? Not a bad idea.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Watch out for the thorns.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Bloom forth!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Pay attention to where the petals fall.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: What blooms, must also wither.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Do you see the dew shimmering on the petals? Such splendid scenery in the morning light… We wouldn't be enjoying this if not for you.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Scything, uprooting... It sounds cruel. But if we want to deal with the weeds competing for nutrients, then I think there's no other way, Doctor.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: While on the front lines, I caught a glimpse of an unforgettable field of flowers, blooming with vigor and vitality. I was always curious where their nutrients came from. Now, I think I know…

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Their petals... have crumbled away.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Cold and isolated... Is this the sort of atmosphere you prefer, Doctor?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh! Did you want to buy some flowers?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Eep. You knocked the flower out of my hair.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! Oh, the gift in front of everyone's room? That's poinsettia. In the past, I'd leave a bouquet at each and every doorstep to celebrate New Year's Eve... I didn't want this beautiful custom to disappear because of that incident.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You spotted it, Doctor? That's a new variety I've been breeding. Do you like it?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, these little florets are for you. They grow all across the outcrops and pastures of my homeland. Even when gales level them flat, all they need is a little bit of sunshine, and they'll bloom forth again with renewed vitality. Isn't that just like us Victorians? Thank you for everything you've done, and happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I was going around the greenhouse collecting all the fresh buds, when it suddenly struck me how long it's been since that tragedy. Do you think I'll be able to rebuild my greenhouse back home? I know you might not have all the answers, but somehow, seeing everyone brimming with confidence... just puts my heart at ease too.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, you've managed to keep your room clean. Not bad.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Water is the core ingredient of life. I've talked to Miss Closure about improving Rhodes Island's water purification system. I hope that my research can be of help... so I don't have to worry about the water being dirty anymore.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: This is Leaf, a Bionic Seadragon that I produced from a prototype design passed across my family. In addition to auxiliary combat functions, he helps out a lot in my daily life, such as pouring water, lifting heavy things, and so on.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Glaucus and I agreed that we'd conduct our automation engineering experiment at about this time. Doctor, if you're interested, want to come take a look?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: These reserve water cannons were originally made for industrial usage. In addition to shooting pressurized water, they can also release high-temperature steam. Please don't touch them haphazardly; they're not like Closure's little buggies.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: These high-level combat data materials are based upon my own summaries of the combat situation. Doctor, please read them carefully for the sake of future battles. After that, there are a few operation-related experiments I'd like to perfect that I will need your help on. I trust that you won't turn me down?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I occasionally go to Perfumer's Convalescence Garden to relax. The aroma there can really wash all your stress away, and it's a very effective way of relieving the fatigue from research. Doctor, how about we head there together and give it a try next time?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I definitely do not talk to my Bionic Seadragons when I'm alone! I only gave him a name to help distinguish him more easily!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Thanks to your compassion, I've recently become more accustomed to having you around, Doctor. And apart from Glaucus and some other research colleagues, I can't say that about many people.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Peace and quiet is best.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, I'm Weedy from Rhodes Island's Engineering Department. I've heard of your name a long time ago, so I hope we'll have a productive relationship from now on. Ah, if you want to shake hands, please use your gloved right hand.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hmm, I didn't expect these to be this helpful.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: After my promotion, can I get another upgrade to my personal room?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thank you for acknowledging someone as frail as I am, Doctor. I'll continue to work hard for the sake of Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Do I have to go?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Please listen to my instructions!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Attack!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Everything is as we planned. To battle!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm right here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: My equipment is ready.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Leave it to me!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Leaf, let's do our best!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Fire!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Lock down the enemy! Attack!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Out of my way!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Haah!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Everything's a piece of cake, as long as we employ the proper tactics.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Don't underestimate the importance of engineering!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: ...After I head back and adjust the parameters of this device, this won't happen again.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Leaf, cover our escape!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Has this place been cleaned before?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: H-hey!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, is there anything I can help you with?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, stand still and don't move a muscle, let me inspect you. Hmm... no dust on the bottom of your clothes, and your shoes are clean. That's good. Oh, wait! Your shirt collar is so wrinkled. You are not going to attend the party like that, right? Go back and sort that out, I'll wait here for you.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: How do you do, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
