voices.text: Doctor, have you seen Leaf? Her signal suddenly dropped, and my terminal indicates she's somewhere around your office—You thought she was a present and put her away? The present wasn't her, it was the box on her back! Also! How were you so sure I'd give you a present?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I work as an undurable scientist yet want to step onto the battlefield, but Rhodes Island has actually satisfied my headstrong requests. Whether in the lab or the field, I'm always asking myself: Isn't there more I can do? I'm very greedy after all, when it comes to the pursuit of scientific value.

operators.name: ヴィーナ・ヴィクトリア

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: A Dublinn spy, one of Caster's lackeys, the leader of the workers, plus Wiš'adel... Fancy that, a full house? In any case, I take it I can rest while you handle my business? Since you did let me tuck myself back onto the ship.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: What's this? It's one of those healthy meals they hand out outside the training grounds. 'Help yourselves', they say. What's that look for? It tastes good enough, better than the emergency ration handouts in Londinium by a country mile... Tell you something I know better now, Doctor. It's bloody hard, as it were, to keep a city's worth of bellies full.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My sword here has enough legends to fill a storybook. Even my teacher had his version to tell, flourishes and all. Yet, people only seem to remember those who wielded the sword, not the ones who forged it first... I won't stand for that, Doctor. I'll be there to tell the stories of the unsung heroes.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Sometimes, after a night of dotting Is and crossing Ts, I'll climb up onto the roof of Westhaleg and watch the sun come up. Down in the street, there'll be costermongers hollering, workers delivering goods. On occasion, you'll spot my boxing gym mates, all hungover. A few of them'll look up and see me, and we'll wave at each other. I love this city a lot, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: All this regalia's from an old friend. It's not the lightest thing ever... I'll tell you what she taught me: If you've got a noble 'calling' that pisses you off, then go on and get loud about it. Give it hell, and hold nothing back. I can't argue being Speaker now weighs on my shoulders, but my spirit will stand tall, and I'll have her as my witness.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: 'Victoria'... I know to a lot of people, it's not me that sticks out, it's my name. But so what? The things they're so desperate to scrounge from me are the things I'm off to smash to bits. It's in my power to force that through their heads, sooner or later. The fight's only just started.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Alright, I've been coming back aboard a bit much recently, I admit. Mm-mm-mm, I'm not skiving. It's just hard to meet some of the people here otherwise. Delphine's dead set on calling it 'diplomacy'... And I don't just drag you along as a safeguard, Doctor. I have to be honest, I do want to learn a little more from you.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My face? Just a blister, nothing big, helped Indra and the lot in a fight as I was passing through Norport. Heh, even the ones challenging our turf don't come half as strong as they used to. I've seen babies punch harder than... My clothes? Oh, flip, I forgot to change into my casuals!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Can you believe it? A simple trick like that and Dr. Kal'tsit's got the whole Glasgow Gangers on Rhodes Island. Wait, you knew all along? Haha! Come on, no need to dodge. There! A playful rap on the head, that's how we boxers respect our opponents after a match is done.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Wake up, Doctor, you've got tons of business to sort out still— hah, finally I get to tell someone else that.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor, to be clear, this is not official business. What it is is two old friends, reuniting now the war's over. And about my old files... I think I'll finally fill in my name. Vina Victoria. No more hiding from it.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Can't help feeling the itch... I might go and file for time off with Parliament.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I lost a lot of mine, on the way back home. Parliament awarded them all these posthumous medals, and I still don't know who to even give them to... We weren't told how heavy glory weighs. I came out knowing.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I know clear as day what's up ahead. If I'm the only one left at the end of this all, so be it, I won't hesitate. But in my heart, drinking with her best mates until we drop in the sunset, that's the happy end to the story of Vina, the story of the Siege.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I fight alongside you once again, Doctor, with a sword that's not just for show.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll adjust my combat style to fit you all.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Recon, strategize, deploy… then, the siege.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I've been through crueler fights.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Finally I can limber up.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: It's the frontline for me after all.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Wish I didn't scare you.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Get up! There'll be no bending of the knee!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I forbid your retreat.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Who says you can't hammer with a sword?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Negotiations are useless here.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Violence too, is an effective means.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: My teacher was right. With each step forward, I still learn something new from you.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Getting to lump you with the thinking work feels bloody refreshing. It's been forever since I had a stress-free scrap!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The most precious lesson war taught me was this—there's never an absolute best-case. Regret is its own kind of mercy, and that goes for us and them both.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Not time to give up yet. Follow me, I'll bring you all home.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: ...Really calms you down here. Think I'll get my forty winks.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Um. My cape... you're stepping on it.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Eh? Did you say something, Gawain?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, if you're wondering about the prezzie pile in the cafeteria, that's from Londiniers all over. They had their local branch send them in, as thanks to Rhodes Island. Not one person who's alive will forget what we paid... Happy New Year, and do have a butcher's around the city when you can.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I always feel a bit awkward gamboling about Rhodes in this outfit. Need me to change back?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, if you'd like to accept these! Here we've got a well-wishes card from Morgan, here's some handmade boxing gloves from Hannah, and here's a medal engraved by Dagda... Hold on, where's mine? Oh, flip, I left it at the gym! Wait, it's your birthday today and you forgot?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Ever since that upheaval, Rhodes Island has been on every central nation's watchlist. Each future step you take might well cause new turmoil, but clearly you lot have set your hearts on something. Doctor, when Rhodes Island is in its most crucial moments, Londinium will be there to aid.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hm, by the way, may I ask who was your previous assistant? No, I'm not snooping or anything. It's just... There's not much I can do for you here, besides offer my quiet thoughts on the occasional poem.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I see what you're hiding behind your back. Be at ease, I know very well that Leithanien needs a citizen to heighten her glory in foreign lands. Kazimierz, on the other hand, needs a scandal-plagued knight of self-professed purity. Both are as plain as day. Besides, that issue of The Red Wine is outdated. Their kinds never run short of personalities to gossip over.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The wind can get very strong up on the decks. Perhaps you should change into something warmer. Me? I'm just dressing this place up as a certain city of greenery and shade in my imagination. The one where the gentle breeze blew from lands unknown, and the blacksmith's rhythmic hammering sounded the passage of time... Those days were brief. So brief, they are worth remembering.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: 'Droste' is my mother's maiden name. It is a common name with no place in the spires. How long would you stay in an alley full of marigolds, Doktor? Very few would grace their proses and stanzas with these forbidden blossoms, but they're really beautiful... To be honest, I'm surprised you actually remembered my full name, Doktor.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Poetry is charming as a respite from grammatical convention. It is a search for the most fitting of expressions in the most irrational.  The Candle Knight, who upholds virtue, and Viviana, who loves poetry... I have been a contradiction since the very beginning.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Tales about foreign lands usually end with the traveler returning home. I was always preparing to return to Leithanien, but even after having experienced so much, my truest imp ression of the place remains in the candlelit books on those dark nights. I've seen the people I wanted to see, and I've made my choice.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Look. What is it the candle lights here? Our faces? Lines of poetry that no one reads? Or the dark and mired path ahead of us? I guess you've always been able to see them, even without my candlelight. Right then, rest your eyes upon me. Don't let the light distract your gaze.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I returned to that small, dark chamber in the spire and spoke to the little girl within. I told her that she will endure a lifetime of slander, suffer regrets that cannot be undone, and be trapped in a cycle of endless pursuit and loss… Yes, farewells feel the same as a dream. Do you find me, as I am in this moment, real enough?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: 'If you and I were notes from one stanza, on which instrument are we strung? And what player has us in his hand?' Oh, I knew you would come. Have you finished reading the poems I gave you? Let me guess. I couldn't possibly share the image of your beloved, and it must lie within the most uplifting cantata.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Mein Tag war heiter, glücklich meine Nacht.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Greetings. Margaret told me about you.  It's a shame we didn't have a chance to meet in the Grand Knight Territory… They called me 'The Candle Knight' at the time. You can call me Viviana, Doktor.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Watching my own fights through a screen... For a moment, I thought I was still in Kazimierz.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Are you going to grant me a title as well? There's no need for that, but it probably won't matter anyway. This place is no arena.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Can I interpret this as... your hope that I will stay?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I, Viviana Droste, shall wield candle and blade to win victories in your name.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Um, truth be told, the General Chamber of Commerce's spokesmen kept complaining that I didn't care much about my own matches.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let us move. A timely departure paves the way for an early return.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Moonlight barely laid upon the breezy parterre, yet you've witnessed the entirety of autumn?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I listen, to this passing silence.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I wait, for that belated serenity.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: This is no arena. No scars will be remembered or awarded.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Leave. This is my last suggestion.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Why obsess over rhymes? Poetry is woven with the thread of ideas.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: 'Pale roses,' pale minds.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Alas, but tying your legs together won't make you fly.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Let time rest upon this unlit night.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Tired already, Doktor? Me too. The last time I had such an unforgettable bout was that match I fought in Kawalerielki.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Doktor, you're right. Words that shake one's soul always come from within the storm.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Even the most uninspiring poetry may contain a few lines that tug at our hearts. Despite the regrettable techniques employed, I can't help but approve of the writer's expression.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doktor, accept this temporary lapse in creativity and remember how this moment feels. I'm still looking forward to the completion of this sonnet.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: No bathtub...? Never mind. Just a little joke.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmm, who is there? Whatever. I already knew it was you.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doktor, if the candle goes out, I can't say for sure what might happen next.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Every year, my father spent the New Year with the nobles of the territory, and everyone who lived nearby were given their rewards. That was when I could finally speak loudly in my room. No one was ever there to notice me, and I paid no mind to the boisterousness outside, either... I was still young, but I still remember.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hmm, Doktor, what are you muttering there? I won't force you to recite any poems. But you have read them, have you not?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Come read with me, Doctor. Ever since I came here, I've rarely found myself so agitated that I couldn't read. Oh, right. If you find any books that interest you, please feel free to take them when you leave, even though you gave me plenty of them... Happy birthday, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: People often say that the era we live in has no need for poetry. They claim it cannot provide leisure, and it is loathed for certain men's pretentious elegance. But there is someone who once proved to me the value of 'reminders.' In that case, I wish to walk with you to remind this era, with a candle, and a poem.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hey, hey! I'm watching a rock concert, Doctor! Stop blocking the TV! Just missed the best part thanks to you!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You get people who say things like 'fight the power' and 'be yourself.' But for us Sarkaz, that's just life.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I like bands... no, I LOVE bands! As a guitarist myself, I know every beat, every chord is important. I gotta practice on and on, day and night. That's the only way to give the audience the ultimate face-melting solo!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I'm going exceptionally harsh on you, given I've been so nice to everyone else you say? Well, isn't it only natural? Those who shoulder the responsibility of management like you need more than their self-discipline to do their job, Doctor. I have high standards for myself, and I think it's only right for these standards to be applied to you as well.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Oh, Doctor, your old flame really was no good at housekeeping. Look at all this 'trash' she left behind. I'm in a good mood today, so I'll clean up after her.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You heard? Ines and Hoederer are actually gonna open a shop in Kazdel. I know the places they've been looking at, they're all shitheaps. But I guess my li'l revenant here could help mop the floors with his party tricks? His opinion? Lemme ask. Oh, he's fine with that.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Oh? From up here, you can see Terra really is round. Look, Originium's almost covered the whole thing. Wow, how lucky are we? We won't have to worry about running out of it. Not gonna marvel at your masterpiece, Doctor? C'mon, cheer up, at least we still have time to do something about it.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Theresa and Amiya... Both of them love gazing off into the distance like that. I went and had a look myself, but there's nothing special out there. What are they always staring at? I'm gonna figure it out someday.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Steam Knights, Royal Guards, Spire Casters? Originium sure is something, able to copy all those losers. Hah, right on cue. Hey, you old fossils, weren't you screaming about vengeance all those years you were stuck in the Furnace? Well, here's your chance. Don't tell me you were all just talking shit.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I haven't had a day of peace ever since I picked up this grumpy hunk of scrap metal. Can you imagine what it feels like to have an old, undying geezer babbling on about the past, right into your ear, day in and day out? Oh, you do? Well, well, guess misery loves company, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Are those... Feranmuts? Huh, never thought I'd see a live one. If Hoederer was here, he'd definitely take the chance to babble on and on and on about them, then Ines would tell him to stop giving useless lectures with that sharp tongue of hers... Hmph. Give me a sec, will you? I'm gonna kill one, give you the chance to duke it out down below.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: You wanna work with my team? Do I look like a girl who'd fall for the same trick twice? Yeah, yeah, save the explanations. You know what you did. But be warned, my mercs pick their own roads now. While I'm gonna take out the scumbags who dare treat us like pawns. Should I start with you, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Hey, why're you easing up on the firepower over there? Elite operators? Ugh, she really knows how to twist the knife. What, want me to give you some time for a high-five sesh with your old pals? Hmph, not like you even have hands. If you lose your nerve, oh right, no nerves left, how about—You'll do it yourself? Y'know, once we're done here, it wouldn't be so bad to let you yap for a bit.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: How many Sarkaz mercs just like me has Her Highness seen? Does she really remember all their names...? Whatever. Mine is the only one she picked herself. Oi! Say my name, Doctor. Wiš'adel. Not some codename picked out of a pile of stiffs anymore. It's. My. Name.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: You killed the most important person in my life, and now, it's my turn to go kill yours. That'll make us even. What, thought I was gonna say something nice? You'll have to forgive me, all the nice girls are dead. You mad? Good. That's the only thing keeping us alive.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Tch, how dare that little bunny bossing me around. She thinks I'm gonna go along with it and be her errand girl, just 'cause she gives me that gentle look? Drop it. No one can be a second Theresa. Even that bunny does have some... some... Whatever. At least Rhodes Island's still moving, and all the naive dumbasses haven't died out yet.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Stop grumbling, Doctor. It wasn't my idea to turn you into a soul and stuff you into a gun. By the time I got there, you were the only one left alive, and only barely. It's cramped in there? Well, be a good little cannon, and once we take back the ship, I'll move you into something a little roomier. How's that sound?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You seriously think we're getting along? Wanna guess what it is I'm holding right here? Hmph, relax, it's fear you're gonna bear for what you did. Wouldn't be much fun to cash this thing out that easy. So, when are you gonna let your guard down again, Doctor? I'm really looking forward. To. It.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: That little bunny gave me this bottle of nail polish before it all went down, said the color really suited me... Never thought I'd be reduced to sharing a sob story like that with you. What a tragic life I lead. But, whichever way you look at it, you're still alive, and chatting with you's much better than chatting with a bunch of tombstones.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Evil spirit'… is the current you still qualified for that title? Doesn't matter how mysterious the soul boxed up in your little frame there is. You're a lot more... honest, than I thought. And I'd much rather put up with an idiot, than waste my time with scum.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Surface signals are gone, and our way out's cut off. In other words, whatever comes next, I'll be facing it down with you. Can't think of anything scarier than that. I'm gonna have to take a page out of Hoederer's book and write a memoir of my own. I'll call it: The Two Crises of Terra: Originium and the Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You can sleep when I'm around, huh? How about we make sure you don't ever wake up?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: This area all clear? Ahh... I think I'm gonna find someplace to take a nap.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Wiš'a... del. I sign my name here, right? Her Highness says this name means 'wishing for a home.' I don't make wishes, though. Huh? My handwriting sucks? Screw you, who are you to judge.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: We're finally here, Doctor. Is this ship floating out in space supposed to be an old haunt of yours? What, feeling anxious? Well too bad, you don't have a choice. 'Wiš'adel', here to destroy your Originium project now that it's running wild.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record

voices.title: Promotion 1

voices.title: Promotion 2

I'll send you an invite to the show. It's gonna be one for the ages, I gua-ran-tee.

voices.title: Promotion 2

voices.text: I'll make you shriek so loud the stars'll hear you.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Trash the mission briefing. I know what you want.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll carve my name onto every little bit of Originium out there.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Poor little guy. It's your unlucky day.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Get yelling, Doctor. Your friends are waiting~

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Now now, wait in line. We got plenty for everyone.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Look at you all. Destroyed half the world, but you never figured out how to beat me.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Always so focused on the ground. But have you forgotten... to look ABOVE?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: C'mon, let's see what tricks you jackasses kept up your sleeves.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Boom! Who says there's always a countdown?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Too bad, so sad. Not even ashes left.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: What a thrilling battle. Now what does this Doctor standing next to me think, looking out over the battlefield? Nah, save it. I'm not all that interested.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: The further we go, the quieter you get. I know, I know, you've got other ideas about the out-of-control Originium she left behind. I'm just wondering... She hurt you so bad you ended up like this. Is she really worth it?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Do you like my nails? Guess what I used to paint them.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Hmph, that's how we do it, and that's how we're gonna keep doing it until this stupid never-ending Originium's all bombed to bits! Then, I'm gonna go home and get some sleep for once! Home... Hah, gonna have to rebuild Kazdel.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: You're not happy with the results, Doctor? How about we blow the whole place up, burn everything for a bonfire? Wouldn't that light you up? No? Shame.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Hmph, whenever I remember these monsters are just a bunch of shitty rocks, I can't find the energy.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: That was pathetic, Doctor. We might just die here today. It's what we deserved, right? Hahaha— You scared? Then follow me close. Step only where I step. Otherwise... Today might actually be the end.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Congrats. You win, probably. But you're about to see me really go wild.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: If no one's gonna do anything about this door, I'll just fix it myself. Hey, revenant, get the hell out here and start working.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Damn, how's this space station manage to be even bigger than stupid Rhodes Island? Ughhh.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Finally ready to die?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Still as curious as ever, I see, even out here.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: What's up? You bored? I got some fun things we could do. But don't blame me if you end up— dead.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Well, it's down to the two of us again. Am I still thinking about killing you? Hah! Good to know you haven't lost your sense of humor.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: New Year's? You even celebrate the New Year? Hehehe. Oh yeah, you know I love to party. I even left gifts for everybody, all in your name, Doctor. And soon, things will be a blast... literally.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: If you hadn't mentioned what day it was today, I'd've forgotten what it was like to celebrate a holiday. Take this, a shell-case flick, my treat. Get mad, then go give those rocks over there a treat of their own. Haha, it's settled then. Hey! A Happy New Year to you, my Originium friends! Bang!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Oh joy, there's your face again, Doctor. What a great start for the day.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: We didn't die today. Makes it a pretty good day, I'd say.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Oi! Why are you bumbling around me all this time? Were you…expecting something? Pfff, maybe take a look under your desk? Cut the blue wire. That hint is my birthday present to you. Real thoughtful of me, right?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Once this is all over and we're back at Rhodes Island, you can make yourself a giant birthday cake, and everyone'll be there to cheer for you. I'll cheer too, and ease up on the sarcasm, just so you can enjoy a proper happy birthday. How's that, managed to claw back a bit of yourself? Huh? Sing you the birthday song? Drop dead.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: No matter what, this place's never gonna be Babel again… You know, I hate morons who can't stop nagging about the good old days. So why don't we talk about what to blow up tomorrow?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: After everything we've been through, you're still thinking about that landship? If Her Highness and the little bunny were still around, what would they be thinking about? Hmph, of course I remember what day it is today. Today's a good day, whether you're keen to throw your life away or to put an end to everything. Get ready, Doctor, we're heading out.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Please, leave all these reports to me. I take great delight in indulging myself in records and documents.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: That Suzuran girl I turned down just now, I wonder if I've been too harsh on her... She was kind enough to invite me to her tea party, but socializing isn't really my forte…

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My body is frail, frailer than most others'. To die a young death, to forsake all my pasts, then to be born anew… 'Rejuvenation'… such is the cruel fate of mine…

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Memories dissipate as spumes on shore. The pains, the joys, the pasts I don't want to let go… nothing will be there as I look back.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Though my memory fails to serve me, I can still sense the unspeakable flowing within my blood. Stay away from the sea, Doctor. It'll be a nightmare devouring us all. It is… fear itself.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I do wonder sometimes what 'mortality' is to those with true longevity, like Dr. Warfarin and her people. For them to shed not a tear when bidding farewell to the departed, is it only because theirs have long run dry?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, could you take these flowers to the children in the ward, for me? Yes, just like always, place them by their bedsides… Thank you, for helping keep this secret.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, come quickly, we need to find Closure! It seems Thorns and his companions have burst a water pipe open in the corridor, and Weedy is furious now! I'm soaked to the skin... Um, I seem—like I'm enjoying myself? Wh-What do you mean?!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Every time I watch a film, I keep the ticket stub afterward. These leftover vestiges always serve to me as a reminder, even if the contents would be lost to me... Doctor, could you come watch a film with me? I'd like to preserve the time I've passed with you, too.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Sleep sound, Doctor... By the time you wake, will you have forgotten about me?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Code name… Whisperain. A roving doctor, nothing more. If possible, please take me as a traveler lodging under the eaves in rain. You needn't pay me much mind…

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: In the face of such fierce combat, I worry... I wouldn't be able to survive.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you very much. But I hope you treat me the same as always...

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Those sorrows I could not wash away with one death—I always feel like they're strands, wisps, winding about my skin... Doctor, you've come to forget the past too—could you maybe understand this feeling?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Please leave the assistive work to me.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm the leader...? That's a little…

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Please keep with me. Don't go too far.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Please be careful, everyone. Protect yourselves and stay safe.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Very well.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Injections are ready.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Come to me if you get wounded.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Let me dispel the pain.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Disinfection comes first.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Do not be afraid.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: My treatment will not hurt.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I know this scent of death well.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Sleep tight... May the rainfall shelter all dreams.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: This is how their story ends. Tragedies, one following another...

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Leave the pursuit for later. I'd like to see everyone treated first.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'm sorry, I could have fulfilled my role better…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Such a peaceful place this is. I can hear the patter of rainfall.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: You startled me…

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: D-Don't move, please! Something got my hair…

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Elysium, Thorns, please stop blowing your noisemakers, quite a few operators are already staring at you... Ah, Happy New Year, Doctor. The New Year at Rhodes Island truly is so vigorous... Was I ever this happy to celebrate in the past? I'm afraid I no longer remember.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: What will we be doing today, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Amnesiac as you are, you still haven't forgotten the meaning of this day, which tells me a lot. In that case, would you like to keep the stub of a movie ticket with your birthday on it?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Please, allow me to sit out here on my own. It doesn't feel quite right being a part of this ship's commemoration day, given that I don't know when I might depart... That being said, I will always remember the sound of rain pattering on the deck. There's little else like it.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Some burdenbeasts won't drag themselves to work until they're whipped. But you're different, Doctor, you're way smarter than a beast, isn't that true?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor. Just to put any little misunderstandings to rest, let me say this now. Maria might call me her aunt, but that's only because I'm higher in the family. I'm still young. I'm not much older than her. And, I'm still not married. Clear?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: A spat between me and Dobermann...? Oh, don't worry, she's a top-of-the-top instructor, I know that. We've just had a bit of a… bit of a difference on how we like to train our people, that's all.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: There's plenty at Rhodes Island who pack personality AND strength. You could pick anyone, turn them into competition knights, and have every eye in the room on them... Well, maybe let's not stir that pot.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, can I borrow you? I just want you to help me carry some things. What things, you ask? Well... Hmm... all sorts of random things I buy when the mood strikes me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My injury...? Well, I'm not setting foot in that arena ever again, and I've long since learned to get along with my right hand. So let's not worry yourself, okay? Or maybe... you're just being polite, Doctor? Tiptoeing around saying I can't fight at operator standards, huh?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: My little Maria, she just runs away to the Engineering Department any time she's free. Such a headstrong girl she is, I never know what to say. Where did I go wrong that she ended up like this...? Well, whatever. Compared to forcing herself to arm up and do what she doesn't want to, life is better this way.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Hm…? Oh, Hello, Doctor. No, I've just been feeling a little empty. Margaret never needs my fussing, Maria's found what she wants to do here, but... what about me...? Oh, gosh, what am I saying? Don't you worry about me, Doctor. I'm fine.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, we don't get along half bad, but you don't just lie there and leave it all up to me, not in your wildest dreams. I hate danger plenty, but layabouts leave a bad taste in my mouth. Though, when your back's against the wall... Well, we can talk about it then!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Someone's easygoing, eh? Alright then, I'll let you nap for ten minutes.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Ahh, this is Rhodes Island, is it? I'm Whislash Zofia. As a former competition knight of Kazimierz, trust me when I say I'll whip your operators into shape.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I've never even heard of fighting like this before!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: So this is a Rhodes Island promotion, then...? Good. I don't pay much attention to my wages, but getting paid for my effort feels nice. Thank you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Hmm, thinking about it carefully, the pay here is not bad, life is good enough, and I get to see Maria and Margaret all the time. Staying here as an instructor sounds like a great choice.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Let's see who you've got on this one.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Alright, I'll lead the team.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Get ready, everyone! We're moving out!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: You all know your job? Alright.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: My time to shine.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: About time, Doctor.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Assess the situation first.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Whislash Zofia, attacking!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Do not underestimate me!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Perfect chance!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You won't be able to withstand the whip!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You're finished!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Honestly, I was going to have a word with you about taking such a dangerous mission, but since you tied things up so beautifully, I'll just let it slide…

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I can tell you're a perfectionist... Well, nothing wrong with that.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We won, and that's enough, no? Let's not obsess over it.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, don't just stand there! Follow me!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Well, this interior's got taste!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What?!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, you've got to focus on your work.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Since Margaret left Kazimierz, we haven't had a chance to spend New Year's together. So, I'll have to go all-out for today's banquet… Oh, Doctor, would you like to join the Nearl family feast? You're cordially invited.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: How do you do, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I got you a little gift. Sign right here. It's not a big plot, but I picked the location with care. The scenery is gorgeous. You could build a villa, or garden or something… What? Why are you looking at me like that? Is land not an appropriate birthday present for a friend?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I've met all sorts of fascinating little guys at Rhodes Island. The light in their eyes when they train is the same as I see in Maria's. I'm eager to see them transform into capable fighters. And until that day, I'll keep whipping them into shape. Oh, make no mistake, this is my duty, not a hobby.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: What kind of ambience do you prefer when you're working? Of course, my music can't directly alleviate the busy state you're in, but I'd feel terrible if it couldn't make you more comfortable…  or content.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Do you hear the music? It is a concerto resonating with countless individuals' emotions—we play distinctly solo, yet as a harmonious whole. What a magnificent possibility.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: This next concert is for Amiya. I really am curious... what would she see in me if I were allowed to touch her emotions? Oh, that look on your face... are you worried? Then, why not come along... and confine me to your side?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: The Tower of Revelations, the Notarial Hall, the Sunset Chapel, and finally, the chapel square—the halos over our heads are extinguished, yet the city remains illuminated as always. Please hold here, Sankta. And tell me, is Laterano not more connected to the rest of this great land, and less dissimilar?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: 'Music is the order you dig out of chaos.' That's what my Leithanian teachers taught me, but they've all since died in silence or lunacy. If it were me... I would tell my students, 'Music is a flowing will, a language of self-expression.'

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The Sarkaz are singing, and the Sankta play the accompaniment—who is this funérailles for, you ask? The nomadic monastery guides everyone it receives back to their homes, irrespective of life or death, irrespective of race or identity. Join in the chorus, and speak no more of this meaningless question.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I can tell your fingers are still stiff. It seems you're not yet used to learning this way. Don't be nervous, I'll guide you... Oh? What's the matter, Fede? Are you going to greet me with a mine or an electric fence this time? If you'd like a music lesson, the Doctor and I will oblige.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: What is that vast, deep-blue expanse? The ocean, or the distant cosmos? Is it your origin, or your destination? Is it 'evolution', or the sum of all perfection and imperfection that you've carved throughout this process? You Many, is this your true voice? Life deserves a voice.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I'll never stop performing, even if you, Doctor, are the one who asks me. Trauma is one thing, but freedom is another. My life is the same as the others, it will simply come to an end if I stop in my tracks.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I am listening... Fear and trauma persist nevertheless, but the strong will overcome them, while the weak find their own ways to fight—with no need to follow a Pope or a Lord of Fiends. In the face of 'calamity', all will play their own songs.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: No matter how powerful one's spirit may be, there is no way to vanquish the inevitability of death. If there is meaning in life, if there is really something out there that can fight against chaos and nothingness... it has to be every emotion that I'm feeling right here and now, and the melodies they'll turn into.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Are these possibilities inherent within 'empathy'? It has no personality, yet is able to suppress and manipulate human emotion—why did It ultimately choose to build a mechanism as singular as 'empathy' for the Sankta...? The music... why has it fallen silent?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I'm watching... the clouds. Water accumulates above and in excess before turning to rain. Mother made just as natural a choice when she decided to leave. But father still refuses to accept it, even now. What about you, Doctor? Will you also refuse to listen to the truest self... that lies within you?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Yulia, the Witch King, Cora, Emmanuel... The audience will forever remember the sound of this cello. Do you still recall her words when your mother first taught you to play this instrument gifted by your father? 'Arturia, Mamma wishes you the most peaceful sleep, every single night.'

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Working with you is actually quite dull to me. Yes, because I don't want to, and can't play your music. So I've curbed my expectations of you, for I fear that when this emotion bursts in resonance along with my strings, you will turn to a grotesque collection of variegated fragments in my arms.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: While 'Calamity' and the gathered crowds are both distant, a Sankta sounds lonely strings in this deserted monastery—is this to be my end...? Arturia, would you acknowledge life's meaning, even in its fleeting nature, if you were to return to that rain-soaked cemetery?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Let me be your personal musician. Let me... feel my way around your mind. How elaborate are your ideas, and how terrifying is your rising willpower? I will of course be captivated by your music when it blooms into its ultimate form; and at that moment, what I will perform for you... shall be myself.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, can you believe Fede is still asleep? Now, here I am with my cello, and here you are in front of me—it would be a shame for you to miss what I've just experienced. Give me your hand—Yes, right on this string. Let's create this harmony together.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Rest well… I don't need to mix any 'illusion' into this lullaby. Your dreams... are already colorful enough.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: How beautiful... Humans are both the afterglow, and the sky that harbors it.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I should have introduced myself by playing some music for you. Unfortunately, I've been forbidden from doing so for the moment. Let's start with a codename, then. You may call me... 'Virtuosa.'

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm connected... This is the Movement that does not yet exist.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I've no interest in these means of inflicting harm. Do you mind if I wander about for a bit?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Not a single note shall fade.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: You've come to understand me more and more, even without the sound of an instrument to connect us. And yet... just how am I supposed to share this joy in my heart with you?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: The future I envisioned has been set in stone, Doctor. It simply has not been elucidated yet, which is why I shall move towards it.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Whenever I touch the strings, the surrounding emotions all flow into me, through my fingertips, surging up into the sky and down into the ground. Did you hear it too? The cry of life in its truest form... How astonishing, how beautiful.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: In that future, we are each other's audience.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: What audience have you picked for me today?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: If the musical movement were not inherently prescribed, why do we adhere so rigidly to its interpretation?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I don't often play with accompaniment, but I can try to match the others' voices.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: A single cloud among countless others, dances with the wind and descends with the rain.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Notes fall into memory, and a melody resonates in the mind.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: We advance to every last corner of Terra.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: What tones are your souls in?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Won't you open? 'Tis a visitor rapping at your heart chamber door—

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: The concert may begin at any time.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Let us lift our instruments.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: What would you like to hear?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Let us hearken.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: A solo, to you.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Behold, the symphony of countless voices.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: An improv, from us.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Behold, the consonance of innumerable souls.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Ecstasy as bright as gold.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Play towards the setting sun.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Suffering will come to rest.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Sing with the cosmos.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Liberty and sunlight all around us.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Embrace the regrets, if you have any.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Feel your own self, to your heart's content.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Feel each other, to your hearts' content.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: War itself is unworthy of a performance. But I will listen to every voice on the battlefield, from hero to refugee.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: We are unforgettable.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Over already? Your victory doesn't need to be embellished by my music. I'd much rather... perform for you a piece inspired by that cloud passing overhead.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We stand side by side. No calamity or unknown shall shake us.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Guilt, doubt, fear... this surge of emotion rising from the battlefield will follow them, accompanying them to their graves.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Joy, fluke, or mourning? We accept it all, so long as it is sincere.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: The performance ends, and the audience scatters. After such a conclusion, how long can the strings continue to vibrate?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, I have awoken.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What a beautiful sunset. It would be even more romantic if there were music swirling around the deck.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Listen to the breeze in the corridors. This vessel has its own true voice as well. What of yourself?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: These strings are vibrating... for you.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Doctor? You have a pretty good sense of rhythm. 'Calamity' will not strike so soon, meaning you still have time to pick up a percussion instrument.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Hmm? Have I been lurking in this corner for a long while? There's a tune lingering in my head, and I refuse to go to sleep before I can express it.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: What are you trying to do? Even if I am not allowed to play, I can still make music resound within your mindscape.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The New Year's concert is about to begin. No, I'm not a part of the performance, this is a gift the children have prepared for you. I'd much rather be on the sidelines, recording the joy blooming across your face and the children's when the music begins.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! We can create a moment of shared emotion simply by circling an ordinary date on the calendar—look, people have always possessed the potential for 'empathy'. Though it is a far cry from the grandeur of the Movement, I am now fully convinced of its existence.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Sometimes, I too prefer to avoid the crowd, far away from all the sounds, just to feel my own self... and to feel you as well.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Since music cannot supersede language, Doctor, there's still a lot for the two of us to talk about.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Is it the pain or joy of the past that you think about this time of year? Tell me, and let me transform the blotches of your mind into reality through music... as long as you allow me, of course.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor... did you already listen to the entire piece behind my back? Though it was but an impromptu session, it contained all the thoughts I had while waiting for you, as well as the emotions that should be expressed no other day but today. Since you didn't miss it, tell me—what did you hear from it?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The end is approaching us. If you too believe that the emotional bonds between people help resist despair... the symphony I scored with Rhodes Island will certainly play.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, the possibilities that Fede and I perceive differ entirely, but the constant is that you remain here at Rhodes Island. If you are the single leitmotif that remains unchanged across countless variations... how could I bear to stray too far from you?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Thirty-two, then thirty... three? Oh, Doctor? Wait, where was I? Hmm, I've been away half an hour? No worries, almost done. The fiftieth document from the left... one, two... don't worry, I'm the best counter at my escort association.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: In this line of work, encountering odd clients comes with the territory. There was this one time when I was hired to escort a gentleman, he insisted I carry him on my back down a muddy road. I agreed, but said only after terminating our escort contract, because I couldn't defend him while carrying someone on my back.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, take some of these. My family came by during their escort job and brought me some treats from back home. What? We're under attack? Wait, you mean... them? Uh, hey, don't smoke on the landship. Put your shoes on and mind your manners! Don't glare at people like that! Ahem, Doctor... let me introduce you to my family.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I'll ask the local bandit boss about the situation here. No, we're not exactly friends, but we sort of pay this toll of theirs. Does that sound like we're in cahoots with the bandits? Hahah, it's just a way we can both make a living. Nobody wants unnecessary bloodshed, if we can help it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I got the crystals on my hand from a highwayman. His legs were shaking and I thought I could talk him out of it, but his mind was made up. When I discarded his Originium explosive, we both got caught in the blast. In the end, I left him some money for his sick child's treatment. As for my own condition, I got used to it long ago.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Not every bandit manages to make the move to an honest escort life. Some have walked the way of the bandit for too long to change, many of them were aunts and uncles who watched me grow up. I couldn't look them in the eye when I had to show them out, but people must keep moving forward, right?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: What are you eating? Give me a bite; I haven't eaten yet. Ran into a righteous volunteer on the way, he was collecting relief funds for his hometown that got hit by a Catastrophe, so I gave him all my money. A scam? Maybe, but I don't need more money than I can spend, and I can always sock him if it turns out he was lying. It's not like I'll ever starve with you around.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My swords? This one was given by my adoptive mother. The other was hers—she threw it in my face the day she left. The blood was everywhere. I had tried to convince her to retire from banditry and join the escort business, but she saw it as a betrayal. People... when goals differ, they are quick to call it treachery. She raised me, after all.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Once I no longer have to worry about the escort association, I want to go wander the jianghu, to see what's out there. Want to come along, Doctor? Where to? Haven't thought about it yet. What matters is wandering free like a fowlbeast, traveling only with my two swords, drawing them at the first sign of injustice, and drinking and singing to my heart's delight.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Want some dried plums, Doctor? I always eat one when I get sleepy on the night shift. A piece of green plum with no sugar added works better than pinching my thigh. Haha, look at your face! You look like the plum just bit you.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: You're the Doctor of Rhodes Island? I've heard so much about you. I sign this, and you'll be an official friend of Windscoot. Any help you might need, just— er... no, I know how to write my name. It's—where do I sign?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: My eyelids, they're stuck... Doc, just step on my tail. It's fine, just stomp!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Just like when I wore my escort association's badge for the first time. Gotta keep my head bowed and tail tucked. I won't let you lose face, Doc!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: There was this time I picked up a cloudbeast on a solo escort mission. We traveled together for a while. But just before entering the city, I set it free, afraid customers might see it and think I was soft. Now, I suppose I wouldn't be afraid to keep such a companion.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Three bulkies, twelve mid-sized… all set. Huh, why is there one more here? Did I count wrong?.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Everyone, keep an eye open, your sword at hand and uniform on. Safety first.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The fortune stick reads 'very lucky'! Only took one, two... five draws to get it. What a good sign! Let's go!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: They've got guts, coming at us like this. Don't they recognize our banner? Guess we're in for a fight.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Just tell me which one to cleave.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Just tell me where to go.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: In position. Awaiting your command.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Give the signal and I'll do it.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Don't pick a fight if you're not prepared to get punched.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: A few broken bones would be a good lesson for you.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Want my goods, none; else my life, one. Come and take it if you dare!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I've already drawn my swords. You can beg for your life after we've fought.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: We're friends for life from this day on, Doctor. One word from you and I'll rush to your aid, even if I'm on the other side of Terra—that's a promise.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The goods are intact, and everyone's unhurt! Ahhh, damn it!—I've dreamed of having such a reliable escort leader as you, Doctor.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Look at him run! He even lost his shoes, hahaha! As long as the goods are safe, that's all that matters. Bandits never forget an ass-kicking. Next time they hear our association's escort chant, they'll stay far away.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'll keep them at bay while you go get backup. Want my goods? Over my dead body!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Oh, it's nothing, just a habit. Always make sure a room's safe before going in. Well, the facilities are secure, but the personnel are a bit... mixed. However, if you trust them, I'll consider it safe.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Come on, come on—argh! Almost caught that Burderupt! Oh, er, yes, this terminal is normally used for taking inventory, but there's always a way to install games. Keep it a secret, will you?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Haha... you're allowed just this once. Ears are my weakness, after all.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! Yeah, I'm preparing to set out. This is the peak season in my line of work. It's nothing. On the contrary, it's a good omen to get busy on the first day of the New Year. Hope we both have a prosperous year, Doctor!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor. Yeah, I just finished training. I'll help out once I've cleaned up.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Cut the crap, just stew it. The Doctor and I are friends for life, we'll have nothing but the finest birthday food! Stew the entire cystybeast! Hey, our usual bowls aren't fit for the Doctor. Find a smaller one, just enough for one catty of rice!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: We developed several new routes last year to deliver goods for Rhodes Island. Those rascals were so busy they had no time to cause mischief, but they looked much more spirited and energetic. Better life to chase, more glow on face, as it's said. Hahaha... All that's to say, we look forward to your continued support for our business this year, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Are these the documents you need to mail? Alright, let me check them off.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: There's a letter for you from the Lungmen slums, Doctor. A former patient? Your expression tells me pretty much exactly what's in this letter.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I use this sword to fight beasts that slip into the village, as well as bandits and thieves. For beasts, it's just a matter of driving them away. But people,  it's hard to keep them from going astray.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: There are villages that don't even appear on maps, relying on Messengers to communicate. I used to follow the ones who came to my village around, and even learned my first words from the stuff written on envelopes. But I had to grow up before I learned how much those few words meant.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I once went back to the village where I grew up. All I found was a few abandoned huts and fields. The people who lived there probably found new lives in the cities. But sometimes I wonder, if I had worked harder, would they have stayed?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: You know, I haven't been to that many places. I've wandered between the mountains and cities, and seen people suffering from hardship, helplessness, and stress... This is a vast land, but how many people live in its nameless corners from birth to death, with no one ever to know they existed?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The villagers didn't kick me out when they learned I had Oripathy, but still I couldn't go back to my old life. No, getting infected was my own responsibility. It'd be too full of myself to say I got Infected to help people.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I'm still looking for the young man's family. My words were too harsh... I didn't know his name, even at the very end of it. Superficial as it might have been, he came down for a taste of our harsh lives and recorded it. There's meaning in that.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I've seen many people wait at the village entrance, hoping for a letter from their families. I've seen all sorts of emotions on their faces when they opened the letters. Messengers carry little slivers of people's lives. That's got nothing to do with me, and everything too.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: What a beautiful sunset. The weather tomorrow should be fine and clear.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hi there, Are you the Doctor that's in charge here? I heard I could get treatment for Oripathy in exchange for work here... Oh, right, just call me Wind Chimes. It's a name that represents hope.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I'd rather not get into fights while making deliveries...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: All I did was carry out my duties as a Messenger... Anyway, leave it to me if you have a job like that again. I won't let you down.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Many more people are waiting for hopeful news. Doctor, let's walk this path together.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: As long as there's a destination, there's a way.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll make sure everyone arrives safely.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The road is long. Walk slowly.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Get out of the way.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm ready.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Ready to go.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Bare mountains, dirt n' dust... all familiar sights.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: A long path through tall mountains… Stay alert.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Leave now and I'll act like I never saw you.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I never wanted to point this blade at anyone.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: There are people waiting for me.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Don't keep pushing down the wrong path…

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: No matter how far the destination, you will get there one day, as long as you keep moving forward.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I'm happy to bring news of victory, but I would rather avoid conflict like this.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The goods are still here. Let's hope those who ran away will learn and repent.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Let's rest and regroup. We can take back what we lost later.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's good to have a place to rest.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Careful, I just got back and I'm covered in dust…

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy holidays, Doctor. I would love to invite you to villages of my homeland, if there's a chance... We open up the granaries at the end of the year, and celebrate it with spirits that we brewed in the autumn... Scenes like that are rare these days.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Letter for you, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. This bowl of chang shou mian is a recipe from my hometown, just drizzle them with some scallion oil, and add some stir-fry... simple to make, but lingers on the tongue. Did you like it? I'm glad. Here's to your good health for another year.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: People who live in the distant corners of the land are often forgotten, but what Rhodes Island is doing has helped many of them. I want to thank you for that, Dr. {@nickname}.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I get oil on me real easy, so I don't clean my apron often... There's some on my face too? Uhh, I'll go get it off.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, I don't know if this is offensive to ask, but... say you start things out with a mindset that gets people to live in peace with the Infected. Do you ever feel like your effort is in vain? What do you do, in times like that?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I consulted with my profs and sent a lot of resumes out close to graduation, but got no reply. I was told later how a lot of spots and big companies  are fixed in advance, and not for students with no background like me. So the day I got Rhodes Island's hiring invitation, I thought it was some employment scam.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Doctor! I ever tell you about my club at college? We used the funds from the school to buy new machines on the market, tear 'em down and reassemble 'em. Learnt a lot of new stuff that way. Is Rhodes Island about that too? Check this one out! It's smoking right now, sure, but it's got new functionality.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I helped out at my parents' factory when I was a kid. Lots of stuff you've just gotta count on pure manual labor for. I've gone over all the notes the vets at Engineering lent me. If we can pass all this new tech down to my parents, we can save 'em a lot of effort.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My parents saved hard for a good school when I was a kid. I had classmates clowning on us for being poor, so I was dead set on learning something, showing them who's boss. They might still be living a cushier life than me, but nowadays, I just focus on myself.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, Rhodes Island is all real passionate folks. Saying they wanna make me clothes, they wanna gimme a haircut, and then they drag me off to show me around their own stalls. What do I do...? H—Hug 'em? Got it. I'll go try right now.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, I've never had a boss like you before. Ones I met before were all money-grubbing owner types, so... y'know hugs have really worked out. Can I hug you? C'mon, here we go!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I used to feel like this world was unfair, no matter where you went, and no one could do a thing to change it. But here, poverty or infection, none of that discrimination exists, and everyone gets rewarded equal to what they put in. Doctor, pulling this whole thing off...it's incredible.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You out? Real quiet... Woof! —Ooh, awake now, Doctor?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Nice meeting you, Doctor, I'm Windflit, new Operator at Engineering. You said you saw ability in me? Real thankful for that.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Effort is the root of progress. Regular review lets me realize a lotta issues I overlooked before.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I really love Rhodes Island's standards for promotion. No unfairness about 'em.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Getting to this level of endorsement makes all my previous effort really kinda pay off. Doctor, Rhodes Island truly is a company worth sticking with for a long time.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I've got no combat experience, but I'll give it my best shot.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm not circling you all because I wanna. You're all too scattered apart. It'll be dangerous.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Can't let 'em bully us. Let's go!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I wonder if these guys have their own problems too...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: All ready.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: When do we get going?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: No need to worry.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I can do this.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Woof!!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Device set!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: What is it you guys fight for?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Still coming closer?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Phew... Each new battle teaches me a lotta new things. Maybe one day, I can finally get my own issues figured out.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, how was my equipment this time? Real useful, right?!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Let's forget chasing 'em, maybe they've got their own problems. They chose to run, so no need to corner 'em now.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Ugh... how did this happen...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Real spacious room. And real clean.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh? Was that my ears?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I welded together this little metal doll kinda thing to look like you, hahaha...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Never got to really celebrate when I was a kid. Have the right conditions now, but it's not with my family. Just need to make a bit more cash, and then I can ask for a couple days off and go see 'em again without worrying about my salary. That's my New Year's resolution.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, wanna play Ultimate?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor~ I'm not all that good at picking, is this kind of cake your thing? C'mon, let's have another hug.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: This really sells Rhodes Island as a loaded place. Is everyone gonna be able to finish all this food off? Not gonna be nice to waste it. Ooh—is that Kay over there? Not—Not gonna hold her back?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Coming, coming! Warmy coming in with warmth! Huh...? Sheesh, Doctor! No calling me a little potlid like Lanns!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, do you smell that? Hehe, it's the smell of my sweet pear and vegetables soup, slow cooked to perfection! I said it before, I'm gonna cook the best meals to cure everyone's Oripathy! Huff, huff—It's not so hot anymore. Give it a try, won'tcha? If you don't, everyone else will eat it right up!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Rhodes Island is such a big, biiiig transport, and it has a kinda different furnace than the one at the factory... Oh, I just went to the engine level. The boiler man there thought I was lost and took me back up. I was fine down there, though. I'm used to the heat.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Come, Doctor. Hurry up and eat. No need to worry about me. It cheers me right up to see people enjoying their food. Aw, you still want to share with me? Okay, I'll clean this plate! Om nom nom... Wha? You were just picking out things you don't want to eat? Well alright then.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I made this bracelet from bottle tree leaves. I can keep them fresh for a short while. Hehe, didn't think my Arts could be used like this, did you? Oh, Don't worry, it'll only be for a short while. I won't keep it going for too long, or they'll get tired, too. We should let them be. The withering will come slowly.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Dad liked to collect the carrots we had left to carve into small animals. Doctor, do you think Ray will like this carrot sandbeast? Ah! I think I carved a little too deep. I'm still not very good at this, not like Dad. If only he'd taught me a bit longer...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, look! The lady at Medical gave me a plaster with pears on it! Rhodes Island has so many Infected. It's the same back home, but we didn't live so well. And I had nowhere to go... Doctor, Is it a bad thing to be an Infected?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Deep in the pitch darkness, those warm breaths slowly got colder...' That's how Ray told her sandbeast stories. I've heard the workers saying stuff like that ever since the accident. They were kind of hard to understand at first, but I know what they mean now.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Yeah, it hurts a lot when my Oripathy flares up. And I'm worried I could go out of control, too. Huff... Hufffff... Doctor, want to try a bite of stewed pear? It doesn't cure Oripathy, but it's sweet. When life's all hard and bitter, we need something sweet! Hehe, does it taste good? Alright, I'll take this to Lanns now.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor? Are you feeling warmer? Have a good sleep now. I'm right here.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Nice to see you again, Doctor. Do you miss Billy stew? I was just heading to the aft kitchen with Lanns— Hey! I'm not a little potlid. Don't call me Potlid!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Whoa... Did you command all these battles, Doctor? You're amazing…

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I-I got promoted? Does that mean I can ask Closure to buy some more authentic ingredients?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thanks for your recognition, Doctor! I'll do what I can to bring even more warmth to the people! Um... Actually, what I mean is... I'm glad I can help out!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'm all set.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Huh? I'm the head chef today?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: S-Slow down... Wait for me!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: They're not part of a good breakfast!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm here to help.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Fire up the barbie.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Light and gentle…

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: This place feels a little too cool…

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Sparky spark, hop n' jump!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Little flames, shake n' dance!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Roast their tummies!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Shh, it's burning quietly.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Everyone did such a great job... I'll make a big stew to reward them!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Hm—Smells so good. Today was another huge success!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We spilled a lot out of the pot. What a shame...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I wasn't paying attention, it's all burnt...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This room's so warm… Hm? You can adjust the temperature with this panel?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huff—huff—Didn't burn you, did I?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I'm not— Okay, if it's what you want to call me, Doctor, then no worries. I am a little potlid.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! Do you want to go up to the deck to watch the fireworks together? Uh... It's not Arts. It's real fireworks. Everybody at Rhodes Island pitched in to make it happen! Shh—Do you hear that?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, are you eating good today?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Lanns and I made you a carrot cake...! You've already got lots of cake from the others? Then... Huh? You could eat a few slices and share the rest with Amiya and Savage? That's great! I'll light some candles!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: When I was still small, I had so, so many wishes, but Dad only ever wished for me to grow up happily... Now I understand. I need to be happy first, then I'll wait for my other wishes to slowly come true. Doctor, you need to make sure you'll be happy during this new year onboard Rhodes Island, too.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, are you ready to work? I won't take no for an answer. C'mon. 3, 2, 1, start.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Nails are part of a girl's appeal. Gotta take good care of them.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Why do I call myself Utage? Well, it's not that complicated. It means 'Party' in Higashinese, and I just wanna live my life like it's a party every night. If I'm in a good mood, everything else is gonna be okay.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You already saw it, Doctor? Well, that's too bad. Now the only way out is for you… is to come with me and use this two-for-one coupon.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1

Anyway, enjoy the happiness you've got in the moment, that's what matters most!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant

voices.title: Talk 1

Ah, look at me, carried away by my emotions again. I say it's high time we set aside the nonsense and look forward. Now, You be careful too, Doctor.
