voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You should see how Gladiia trains. It could almost be called self-flagellation. I once reminded her that in the depths of the abyss, maintaining your sense of direction is both more difficult and more important than increasing your speed. Yes, of course my navigational skills are better than the other Hunters,

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: There's no point in staring at it. Ægir's musical notation would be unfamiliar to you land-dwellers. I make it a habit to compose a song before battle, and I ask my teammates to memorize it. Once the battle is over, they are to sing it with utmost accuracy. The Seaborn have no taste for artistry, so it has proved a useful test.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Sargonian, Iberian, Rim Billitonian... During my short time on the land, I have learned several languages. The Seaborn are willing to communicate with other kinds for the sake of their evolution, while humanity uses whatever excuses it can to divide itself. We should be ashamed of ourselves.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: There are many ways to foster unity. Perhaps you could blame your collapse on a common foe, or open up a waterway that changes the tide of war, or maybe send a disgraced, fallen man into exile... Hmm. This really is the only value I can bring to the table.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The Seaborn issue is already out of our control. If a single waterway or several battles could annihilate them, I would not be here seeking your cooperation. I should be off now. Stay in contact... Become one of them, then uncover their fatal weakness from within... this is the only way.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: No need to arrange a meeting. I have already ascertained the status of the other Hunters. Please continue to monitor their health, and help them keep their heads clear. I will return and check. As Ægir's first Abyssal Hunter, I hope that I will not be its last.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You are very forward-thinking with your vision of the future of gene therapy, but right now, discussing anything other than the Seaborn or the Hunters is a waste of our time. Doctor, they continue their endless march onto dry land, but the answer lies deep in the abyss.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The Hunters will lose awareness if deprived of water, but they need only return to the sea to awake their past. How about you? What opportunity would you need? What did you forget, and why did you forget it? You have been to the depths of the abyssal sea, you are connected to all this. I need you to recall, Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You are dreaming. Which part of yourself do you speak to?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: We meet again. This method of contact that you are imposing upon me, is it Rhodes Island's standard treatment, or perhaps it is you trying to confirm if my sense of self has already begun to change… Hmph. Ulpianus, Abyssal Hunter.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: You must think carefully on what you base your battle plans upon.

But now, I wish to mark this occasion with you—the tides have not yet broken free of the ocean, and ruination has not yet arrived in full.

voices.title: Greeting

voices.title: Birthday

voices.text: Before you leave, I am responsible for protecting you.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, I'm looking for a way to quickly increase the charge my body can carry. Look for an operator who uses electricity? That makes sense, I'll try it.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Go to Leonhardt if you need ore identified. I'm no good at this.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The boss lady of Rhine Lab frowned when she saw me, as if I was some kind of pest. What a pain. When did I ever do anything to her?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My ears are standing up? Don't worry, *bzzt*, it's just the static, and it actually feels pretty good. It'll, *bzzt*, come down on its own after a while.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: It took me two years of scrouging and going into debt to buy this baby. If not for its value, the Cautus profiteers on the black market would've thrown me away onto some mining ship. The fact that I can have a comfortable life today is all due to this little electricity-leaking guy.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Oh, there you are. How about a fresh, chilled piece of salted edamame? Don't want it? You've gotta learn to appreciate this kind of food. Here, eat it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Leonhardt's too noisy and causes too much trouble. I prefer hanging out with you. What? He got surrounded by the Medical Department staff for pulling too many pranks on them? He just doesn't know what's pushing it too far, and I don't think he's ever going to learn. Tsk, I'm going to take a look. Doctor, want to come with me if you're free?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I protect Wright because we've been together ever since we were little. Something happens to him, I pay it back, and vice versa. But as for us, we haven't had such a long and stable relationship. Don't think you can get close to me just because you helped bandage my wounds, got it? ...I said the same thing last time? Tsk, damn it.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Huh?! Oh... it's you. It's nothing, I'm just lying here to recuperate. If you want to rest as well, I'll make space for you.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Catastrophe Messenger bodyguard, Ayerscarpe. Pleased to meet you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Very professional. Worth learning from.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Haven't I been getting overpaid recently? A promotion? Oh, I see. Thank you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Being a bodyguard is not about defense, but rather control. Control the space around the target and eliminate all threats. Shall I prove it to you?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Squad joined, awaiting deployment.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Begin the operation at your own pace.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: No abnormal changes detected. The squad can begin moving.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Target located. Move out!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Ah.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Awaiting your command.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Device, activate.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Let's get to work.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: It's over!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Your life is mine!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: The best defense is a good offense.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: There is no winning or losing. Only life or death.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Good job controlling the entire situation. Hmph. Congratulations.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We made good time. We should get going.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I'm willing to believe that letting that person through was part of your plans.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Don't worry about my injuries. Just make sure you get back safely.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I'll leave the arrangements to you. I have no demands.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Don't touch my ears.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You look troubled. What's on your mind?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I can think of a flashy Cautus who'll go out today to sing and dance, then pass out somewhere. Yeah… about time he crashed out. I'll go pick him up and then head off to sleep. See you around, Doctor. Happy New Year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Is there something you need?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here, salted edamame. What are you looking at? You think I shelled them for you? I eat pre-shelled ones sometimes, too. It's a different texture... Why do I still eat entire pods? Just a force of habit. Get to eating yours. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I've saved up quite a bit of money this year. Since coming to Rhodes Island, Leon and I have more stable incomes. He hasn't said anything, but it's a while since I got him anything. No point letting the money sit there. What should I buy? Doctor, do you have any suggestions?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, anything I can help with?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Ahhh... A hot shower every day is a blessing... After I got infected and had to move all over the place, it was hard for me to take a hot shower. Besides, the food here is decent. Oh, I just love Rhodes Island!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: 'April'? 'April' is a song about spring. The lyrics describe the feeling of lying on the grass on a warm spring day, looking up at the sky and letting your mind wander. Wanna hear it, Doctor? I'm sure you'll love it.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Strange, where's my lip gloss...? Oh, right. I lent it to Rope. Nah yeah, I was gonna teach her to do makeup. She's a fine looking girl. I bet she'll be even cuter after a little sprucing up.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Back in Rim Billiton, the companies promise a pension for the Infected, but you only get scraps in the end. And it's hard to find a job... Good thing I decided to try Rhodes Island as soon as I saw the ad. I feel appreciated around here.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: After I got infected, people started asking me things like 'what's an Infected wearing such bright colors for' and 'what's an Infected listening to music for'... And my answer's always the same: 'It's what I like.'

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Back in Rim Billiton, I was a professional hunter. I had to keep the beasts away from the city and sometimes escort company people. But… after I got Oripathy, I lost my job and had to hunt on my own for a living. It was real rough…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My parents died in a mining accident when I was little, and I grew up on a company pension, so I was always real grateful to the company. I figured getting Oripathy was my own dumb fault... But there's more to it than that, isn't there, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doing something for the Infected... I never thought about it before. I mean, it's hard enough to keep yourself alive. But after coming to Rhodes Island, I decided I wanted to try to do something not just for myself, but for everyone who suffers like me.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, if you wanna nap, I can lend you my earplugs.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Gosh, Rhodes Island has great pay and benefits… Oh, sorry, Doctor, I'm just a little shocked. My codename is April. Nah yeah, it's the name of my favorite song.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Wow, the professionals here are really something.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Wha? A raise...? Oh, it's not that I'm disappointed, I'm stoked! It's just been a long, long time since anyone told me I was doing a good job.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Back in Rim Billiton, I liked to sit on the roof and listen to my music while I watched the whole city go by. Now, I can see even more from the bridge of Rhodes Island. I'd call that a silver lining after getting infected, Doctor.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: All righty!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Follow close now, everyone!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Here we go!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Earphones on, let's get started!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: My bow is ready!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Who's the target?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Nice visibility.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Leave it to me.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Let's put on some Billy Bounce.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Now this is a good rhythm!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I've got a lock on you.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: This one won't miss!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Such a tough battle! Doctor, need some slow music to calm your nerves?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Didn't miss a single one.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, a few got away, should we chase them?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, go, I'll cover you!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: No matter how much I wander around Rhodes Island, it still feels so big.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Hmm, the Doctor should be in the office right now...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Around this time of the year, I was usually in the wilderness all by myself, trying to get warm by the campfire, watching the fireworks in the cities far away. That's usually how I found out it was New Year's. Exciting enough, but I'd rather be counting down with everyone else. Happy New Year, Doctor. Keep looking after me this year, yeah?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, wanna hear some tunes?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I'm here to hang out! What do you want to do today? Karaoke? Shopping? Oh, I know a place where you can try archery. They even give out prizes for their contests. I'll shoot a few arrows, and whatever I win with my pro skills, it's going to be your birthday present!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Getting infected didn't make my hunting any worse. But the company still fired me for catching Oripathy. I'd say it's their loss, but to be honest, joining Rhodes Island was a stroke of luck for me. I only hope other Infected out there can be just as happy.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Professor, I've finished all my Catastrophe studies notes. Do you have any more I could read?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Huh? What? Why do I call you 'Professor'? Well, you're an expert on Catastrophe studies, so you're like a professor, right? Aren't we all supposed to address our superiors with respect?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Pardon me? Please say that again? Oh, you're wondering why I'm hard of hearing? Well, I got infected with Oripathy back when I was doing research near a volcano...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Besides completing the tasks you give me, I have to go to Dr. Kal'tsit regularly for checkups. The doctor said my symptoms are pretty serious...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I have to work hard to finish the research my parents began! I want to prove that their work was meaningful, and that it could maybe even change the world!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My parents... they've passed on. A pyroclastic flow hit them when they were conducting studies near a volcano... I have to pick up where they left off and finish their research, no matter what!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: My playmates? I'm pretty friendly with Mousse and some others, so I don't feel lonely at all! If possible, I'd love to start a book club with them too. Could we hold our club meetings in your office, Professor?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Dr. Kal'tsit told me... I'm losing not only my sense of hearing, but my sense of sight too. …Well, what else might this disease do to me?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: How could I tell you were behind me? Because I could feel your warmth! My eyesight and hearing aren't as sharp as they once were, but my other senses are still the same. Can't bring me down this easily, you know!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Professor! Oh... You're asleep...?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Eyjafjalla. My career before joining Rhodes Island was in the field of volcanology. I'm a bit hard of hearing due to my Oripathy. I just hope I won't be a burden to you, Professor.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Please teach me all you can, Professor.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion? Really? I'm so happy to have your approval, Professor!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: My mother gave me these little lambs. They're cute, aren't they? Huh? They're scorching hot? Be careful! You have to put on oven mittens before touching them!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Understood, Professor.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Don't forget to prepare emergency supplies as well as weapons!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: We can take care of ourselves, Professor. You just focus on giving orders.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Stay safe, everyone.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Professor?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Please give your orders, Professor.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'll be careful.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: All the best!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Temperature is stable!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: This may be a little hot...

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Watch out for fires.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: How's that?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I'm so glad you're safe, Professor...

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Why must our world be enveloped in strife?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Is everyone okay? Anything I can do?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Ow... It's... It's okay... I'm fine...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This room makes me feel safe.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Eek! You startled me, Professor!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Thank you, Professor, for helping me become a stronger person.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Professor! Everyone's happily prepping their presents and decorations, and so many operators have come to talk to me. I can't hear them clearly all the time, but when I see the looks on their faces, I'm sure they must all be very warm words. Professor, I wish you that warmth, too.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning, Professor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Professor, do you know there's a cake that's both named after and inspired by volcanoes? It's called 'lava cake.' I asked Gummy and Mousse, and they taught me how to make it. When you cut it open, the chocolate inside comes spilling out. Here's your cake, Professor, Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Thank you for everything you've done for me over the last year, Professor. I'm delighted to be here with you. There's still so much I don't know about volcanoes and Catastrophes. Before I get to the point where I can't continue my surveys and research, I'm devoting all my energy into this. That way, I can live with no regrets.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'll be your assistant today, Doctor... I will disclaim. I have absolutely no secretarial experience. Thus, so I'm not hindering you, I will be doing nothing at all.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You'd like to see Leithanien, you say? Heh, it's a fine place. The Empresses regard their subjects like their own children, the healthy regard the Infected as brethren, the faces of the people brim with blessing—lies? That's true, they are lies. Contemplate visiting Leithanien again once you can sit through the whole game with a straight face.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Routine health inspections? Allow me a moment to ready my—hold on, isn't Hibiscus the one on duty today? I'd rather avoid her if I can. I'm sure I needn't explain why... I'm not frightened of her! I'm just not quite prepared for—could you amend my timeslot? Thank you!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Please relay to the Medical Department that my headaches and physical condition are no matter, and no cause for such alarm. There's nothing to examine—what? They're already expecting me? They've even made the consultation room available? I... You tell them that my headache has flared up and I'm not going anywhere—ugh.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Social etiquette of Leithanian nobles? Hah, it's an endless subject. Shaking off commoners, spreading rumors of other nobles behind their backs—not to go on, but it all demands a cheek I find slightly hard to conjure myself. You'd best consult an expert, not me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: There'll always be a cohort eager to associate me with the previous Graf Urtica. I can't blame them though, I simply wish to live as a regular Infected. Abhorring inequality ... You say I'm faking to be common? Whatever you say. Even if I am faking, I prefer to keep it that way till the very end.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You noticed as much, Doctor? Indeed, I like to repeat what others have said in times of stress... it's the safest method I—no—Graf Urtica has of buying time to think. So long as he doesn't speak his own mind, he won't bear blame for what he says.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: It's Hibiscus on duty again—should I reschedule my examination? Nein, never mind. I'm deeply grateful for your help in avoiding her days, but I can't hide forever. Even after so long, I still close my eyes and see the wretched misery of that concert... perhaps it's time I face it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Evening on the deck reminds me of the spiretop in Urtica—it had just as fine a breeze. I used to fantasize there how happy life must be, down on the ground. I only understood later that up there, freedom was the one thing stripped from me, while so many in the land had, save for freedom, nothing at all.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: No issue dozing off in this sort of place? Hmph, I suppose it's times like these when the assistant does the work. Pain in the neck—agh, I'm misspelling. Never mind, never mind. Let's find out what music's on the Doctor's headphones...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I extend my sincere gratitude to you, Doctor of Rhodes Island. Thank you for sheltering an insignificant down-and-outer. If such mediocrity as even mine can benefit Rhodes Island's cause, then I couldn't be more relieved.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: A very fascinating recording. Hm? I don't say that with irony. Nobody ever thought to buy video tapes for Graf Urtica save for himself, and he couldn't leave the spire.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion? Allow me to decline. No, not for lack of necessity, but of knowledge of who is being recognized. Is it myself... or the Witch King's remnants lodging within me?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Graf Urtica fears his ego's engulfment by the Witch King, yet has to employ powers inherited from the tyrant. But now, he is dead. Now, I am first and foremost an operator of Rhodes Island, and only after that am I the Witch King's botched replica. That suffices for me—that suffices.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: This power is not mine. However, Rhodes Island has need of it, so I will employ it to its fullest.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I hate it when I'm ordered around without rhyme or reason, but ordering others sits just as badly with me.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Prolonged casting makes my headaches flare up, and I even hallucinate if I'm unlucky. Let's make it a Blitzkrieg, shall we?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I am at your command.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Stronger dynamics?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Faster tempo?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Careful of music on the battlefield, especially when you face a Leithanian.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: The performance will begin soon, but it seems our audience can't contain themselves?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: As graceful as three-four.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: As startling as a tritone.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: As doleful as a clarinet.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Gah! Get out of my head!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: If you're lacking an appreciator to applaud and call for encore, then allow me to fill the role. Congratulations, Doctor.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Is it over? Very well, I need somewhere to rest for a moment before my headache gets any worse.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: An unsatisfactory performance'... No, it's fine, it's just something I often heard not so long ago. You can ignore it.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We can hardly call this ending good. Are you the one who just got a headache, not me?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This place might be far from a Leithanian spire, but I still prefer the feeling of standing on solid ground.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Agh, here it is aga—huh? It's you, Doctor? That wasn't the headache?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, if you want to learn an instrument, I'd say ask someone else. A lot of my understanding has little to do with myself.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I'm not omitting myself from the New Year celebrations for any special reason. I'm just not accustomed to that sort of harmonious atmosphere... You'd like to invite me to perform a song? Forget it, my music would be a horrible match for this mood.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: How did you rest, Doctor? I used to love staying up myself, until one time I went a full night without closing my eyes, and had splitting headaches for a week after... It was a horrifying experience.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Would you like to listen to a dark, terrifying, head-splitting Birthday Variation?—I'm joking. Happy birthday, Doctor. Sheesh, there's no need to be *that* surprised. Can't I joke every once in a while?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Every day passed at a crawl in Urtica, but now a year's silently flown by since coming to Rhodes Island... It feels like time's sped up. I imagine that's just proof life is more blessed now.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hey, leader! Got some work for us?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Leader, how about we throw a party? We can play some hip-hop and eat apple pie. The best life is the party life! No party, no life!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Locked and loaded, ready for action! What's the objective today, Leader?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Some people believe money can buy anything. But, uh-uh, that saying doesn't really apply to me. Wealth won't make a lick of difference to where my targets end up.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My first wish: more guns! We angels all have a patron firearm, a special gun we grow up with, but owning just one gun is kinda lame. I want eight more!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My second wish: get someone to turn off this light over my head!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I've always got Texas covered, that's why she lives so carefree. So obvious it goes without saying, right?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: If you ever run into an angel with black horns oozing ominous vibes, please tell her for me: I've never forgotten her.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Us Penguin Logistics girls ain't so bad, right? What do you say, leader? Wanna come be our boss? Hehe, just kidding.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Oh Lord… is this another soul for us to save?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Password: 'Long live the Penguin Empire.' So you're the client? Call me Exusiai. I'm nothing like that Lupo ice queen. I'm always down for some fun!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I'm lovin' this feeling!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thanks for the promotion, leader.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Leader... No, savior, I swear on this gun in my hand, I will protect you until the day of reckoning.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Squad combat? I'm very familiar with that.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You've got a good eye. No one makes a better leader than me.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's go! Take them all by storm!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Relax, I already called dibs on the most lucrative real estate in Hell, to share with all of you.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: All right!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Is it my turn?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Follow me!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Let me double their trouble.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Divine judgment!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Rock n' roll!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Barrage!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Apple pie!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Perfect! Let's keep up the momentum and charge on!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: May my hail of bullets bring you eternal peace.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Victory is a heavenly melody. Alright, let's go home and grab some beers!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Life is like a gun, sometimes it just jams. Don't get discouraged, leader, we'll get'em next time.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Wowee! I love this place!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Leader, wanna try out my weapon?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Leader! The party's about to start, Employee Performance Competition Night's over, and I'm not dead last! Here's your booze and apple pie. Let's heat ourselves up to the hip-hop beat, and set this firework tower to the sky~ Here we go! Three, two—BANG!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Sup, leader!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Leader, c'mere, c'mon! Welcome to your birthday party! Turn out the lights and blow out your candles! Oh, but remember, even as the candles go out, my halo will shine on you in the dark. Never worry that you'll lose your way—the angel's Blessings will be forever at your side.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: We are led in differing directions. But by your power and wisdom, you may guide us on our journey together. Should the soul in you that protects us be a constant, we too will open a brand new path for you by our souls of honesty and ardor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Uh... w-where should I stand? O-oh, you want me to sit? Then... where should I sit?

voices.title: Talk 1

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: After I became an Infected, I thought for a bit that my career and my life were both over. Rhodes didn't just rein in my illness, but also gave me a fresh start. Standing up again in dire straits is exactly what the hero does, right? Doctor, Let's climb back to the top, together!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You want me to be your accompanist? Sure thing.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Whether in harpistry or archery, my skill is second to none in all of Minos. Look, this is the medal I won in Hymnic archery. Beautiful, isn't it? Proof of my skills as a harpist? Several troupes have asked me to accompany them, and that tells a story, don't you agree?... What!? You! You... Ahem... You may as well be seated, then. I will have my harp do the talking.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Minos is a land of Romance. Day in and day out, you can see philosophers debating, warriors competing, and actors rehearsing grand epics. I will say though, our food and drinks are exquisite. They're enough to elicit an abundance of joy and make one act unreasonably if indulged too liberally... How do I know? As if I'd tell you!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Tragedies are the most dazzling gems among our grand epics... or so I'd like to say, but Pallas's story deserves the most compassion. There is no greater humiliation than for a hero to remain unsung. 'There must be no flaws in a hero's mythos?' She said that? I simply cannot agree.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: From Minos to Bolívar, from Columbia to Leithanien, each place has its own scenery and its own romance. The same uniqueness, however, cultivated endless enmity and conflict across the world. But just as roses do not lose their beauty simply because they have thorns, this great land is equally worthy of love.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Even the mightiest hero cannot win a war alone. Just as an epic must be passed down to be meaningful, a hero must stand with others to even become a hero. In the past, I always felt as if something was missing from my journey. That 'something' has been found since I came here.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The Supreme One spread an incurable disease across the land, and the Healer was banished for opposing Him. The Healer, stripped of the power of divinity, descended to alleviate humankind's suffering through knowledge... Oh, this isn't Minos mythology or anything, it's just a story I made up.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Is this instrument a bow or a harp? Both. The techniques behind the two are similar, both requiring discipline and elegance. Like this, gently place your fingertips on the strings, and thoughtfully acquaint yourself with the vibration from your fingertips. Want to give it a try? No, no, not like that. Give me your hand, I'll teach you.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: What am I reading? A volume of Victorian love poems. Shall I read some aloud for you? Come on, there's no need to be bashful. Love and courage are one and the same. They're the blazing flames that burn through our souls, a light true that one should not shy from. Come on, Doctor, let's read some poetry together.

voices.title: Idle

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: So this is Rhodes Island? At last, at the very end of this trudge... No, All of this was ordained by fate, so I should be saying, it's about time! You can call me Erato. Is Pallas here, may I ask?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: A shock that I still have so much more to learn about team combat...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Rankings? Promotions? No, no, these trivial things have no place in the full picture when heroes cast their eyes over the rising horizon. But, I will accept this accolade as proof of our mutual trust.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Should I celebrate this occasion by playing a song, or no? In fact, let me take a moment to think about what to say... Ahem... In the name of the Twelve Heroes of Minos, I, Erato, dedicate my bowstring to thee, and my harp shall accompany thee into the ages.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Another year, huh...? Though I am still unfamiliar with Rhodes Island's customs, the importance of ceremony cannot be understated. If there is no ceremoniousness to counterbalance the atmosphere of levity, the occasion is forgotten easily. Anyway, Happy New Year, Doctor. As a present, I'll play a song for you. What would you like to hear?

voices.title: Greeting

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: In mythology, every hero's birth is accompanied by a strange phenomenon. For example, the once-in-a-century blooming of a flower, or a falling star... Just what happened on this day, years ago? It must've been a spectacular sight. Happy birthday, Doctor. Go ahead and make a wish.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island is a place right out of mythology, a hall of champions where people from all over the world come together to fight for a common cause. I wish to continue to witness the story of Rhodes Island as it unfolds. Surely, we shall compose the most grand of epics together.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Feel free to assign any work to me. I have a lot of experience as a second-in-command.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: This communicator transmits signals over long distances, it's a powerful tool for keeping teams in touch. My Arts even amplify the signal, ensuring that communication between teams goes unimpeded. Honestly, battlefield communication is a job that was practically made for me.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Lost? No worries, tell me where you wanna go. Um, to get there, first go up the stairs on the left until you reach the fourth floor. Then turn right, and after passing the third fork, make a left. Go down a floor, then proceed to your left. It's directly across from Closure's #3 Engineering Room. How's that? Aren't my instructions clear and concise?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Thorns and I have reached an agreement: Next time, neither of us will hold back, and a victor will be crowned. I'll be sure to defeat him by a landside... What? Rhodes Island has an explicit ban on personal fights? You misunderstand, I'm only talking about chess. Loser has to shave his head, what say you to this bet?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: To be honest, I'm not used to being someone else's assistant. But since my captain relies solely on me to deliver her orders, I have to stay on the squad to support her. Oh, that's just between you and me, by the way. For both our sakes, don't ever tell her what I just told you, okay?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: There's no overstating the importance of communication on the battlefield. And of course, the one facilitating it is the first to get targeted. But don't worry, as long as I'm here, I'll make sure your orders are smoothly transmitted to all combat personnel.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, you came right on time. Actually, there's something bothering me. Why does everyone prefer looking at a map over asking me for directions? The captain says my glib tone gets on people's nerves. But that can't be, I always treat everyone with perfect kindness, wouldn't you agree?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: On the battlefield, few things are more important than morale. Do you see this banner? As a vanguard, just lifting it is enough to fill everyone with courage. Wait, Doctor, you didn't seriously believe that, did you? I was just joking, this thing's actually a communication device.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, you've earned my trust. There's no need to be so humble. I know I'm a good judge of character. How about I call you my comrade-in-arms from now on? My captain and I used to be like oil and water, but look at us now. I believe that, much like her, you will eventually be moved by my sincerity. No? The captain sent you a letter complaining about me? What?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, the files over here are... Hm? Already asleep? Well, even if it's just me, you really shouldn't let your guard down like that.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: 3rd Combat Squad, vanguard and communications specialist, Elysium, reporting in. We've always communicated through electronic means, I do believe this is our first time speaking face-to-face, Doctor?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record

voices.title: Promotion 1

voices.title: Promotion 2

voices.title: Birthday

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island's a lot busier now than when I first arrived. We keep finding more and more trustworthy companions, and I think I'm not the only one drawing complaints anymore. I'm deeply moved, so I painstakingly edited up an audio reel of everyone being drunk at last year's party! I hope it gets some enthusiastic reactions!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: {@nickname}, compared to the old ones, today's battle are too relaxed and juvenile. They are weak. Weak enough to make weapons rust. And once a warrior's weapons rust, death soon follows.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Life is but a brief flicker before the vast maw of annihilation. Cherish that view of the sunset while you still can, {@nickname}.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Practical exercises? Nah, I'm not interested. While Rhodes Island boasts many powerful warriors, squandering one's physical strength on a game is wasteful. Only on the edge of life and death does the clashing of swords have value.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I'm not concerned with the plight of the Infected? Hmph, don't misunderstand me - fighting in vain is what I hate. No enemy worth spilling my blood has come forward, and that's all there is to it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Rampant slaughter liberates your inner instinct, 'teamwork' only robs you of it. What 'trust' and 'strategizing' buy you are nothing but illusions of security. And these illusions, {@nickname}, will one day cost you your life.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: This blade ran through two crown princes, and this other one slew three generals. In our chaotic world, anything can happen. I don't know who will claim my life, but on that day, I sure hope it'll be more exciting than when I took these lives.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Shining, huh? A pity, she could have been a worthy adversary. But after she got pulled into that mess with the 'Confessarii,' I bet she felt her blade had been besmirched. Hmph, Swordsmen without faith in their swords are beneath mention.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: {@nickname}, you remember that battle, right? After killing all the ambushers, I led the survivors and charged straight into the traitor's fortress. I was the only one who made it out alive. How did it all start? Oh, you know the answer to that. I've seen you before, and my memory is very good.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: {@nickname}, help me fetch those seeds in the cupboard, won't you? Thank you. Yes, I'm actually quite fond of flowers. No matter how brilliantly they blossom, their petals must wither and fall into the wind. When will the petals wither next, Doctor?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Vigilance can keep you alive, {@nickname}.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: We meet again, {@nickname}. Don't worry, I understand the situation you're in now, and pose no threat to you. I shall be your blade, so use me as you see fit, Doctor.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: The skills a great warrior needs are those which defy recording.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion? What? So you actually care about these rituals now?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I have no concept of what it's like to be Infected. Perhaps Rhodes Island can help me understand. I don't care, but if you have your own considerations. Fine, I'll hear them out.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Ahh, I've longed for a hurricane of blood.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I've been a captain before, and it didn't end well.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I will bathe in their blood.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Let's begin.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Do not interfere.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Mind your own business.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: So, who shall be my opponent?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Will it be you? Or maybe you?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: The blade brings the flame.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: The bone falls with blood.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Whose name will you cry as you pass?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I don't give a damn.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Did this battle satisfy you?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A weak enemy proves nothing. Search for a worthier battlefield.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: A dedicated opponent will prove to be a worthy adversary in the future, let them do just that.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: The rest of you, go. It has always been my job to destroy the pursuing enemy.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's pretty quiet here.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Yeah?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You're just in time, I find myself in need of a whetstone…

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Time never ceases to pass. If you make no progress at this stage in your journey, then as a wizened tree does, your hours will rot away, and lose any ability to meet the coming spring. Happy New Year, {@nickname}, and don't forget your own goals.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Not bad, you're still alive.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here is a flower I grew. Take it. You don't need to assign it too much meaning. All I hope is that before you greet life's withering, you come upon a time in which you blossom at full might. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I think of what reasons brought me to Rhodes Island, Doctor, and there is only you. I allow you to use me as your blade, but in kind, you provide me amusing prey and durable whetstones. But don't disappoint me. For if you do, I cannot guarantee that someday this blade will not point at you.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Wasting me on tidying up papers? Hardly the most brilliant of plans. Why squander a pair of capable hands? Pass those charts and tables over, I'll reorganize them for you... And, as I'm already in your seat handling this headache, let's have you rest for a bit, alright?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Little Garnet here is just an elaborate Arts creation. Whether taking lives or saving them, it allows me to shed less blood and do the job with a little less mess. But in the end, it's nothing more than a crystal of blood. Well, aren't you fascinated? Here, you can play with it for a while... Oh dear, why are you pulling away your hand?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I've taken care of those tasks—effortlessly, I might add. No need to thank me. That would give the impression I've exerted myself over such trivial matters. Incidentally, when will that bunny start asking me for help directly, instead of using you as her messenger? Rest assured, I won't scare her like I did before.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The sisters refused my visit again. They still find me... disagreeable. I've never claimed Rose Riverside's Canoes to be a harmonious family. As we can perceive the rhythmic pulse of each other's hearts pumping blood, the trust between us needn't rely on sentiment.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: No, no one else is here. I was just chatting with Laqeramaline—or rather, with the incantations woven by the Banshees, reminiscing about the riverside landscapes I've traversed. Who doesn't like to take something precious as a keepsake, to hold in place for a loved one?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Some sisters have never seen this landship with their own eyes. Some imagine it to be an egg woven of countless blood vessels; others see it as a ghost formed from communication data and electrical cables. How do I know their imaginings with such clarity? Good question. How indeed?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I won't tell a soul, so tell me: the one who just entered the office and the one who came in earlier, they have a rather... sensitive connection, don't they? Look at your furrowed brow... I'm not angling for intelligence, I'm genuinely concerned about you. Do be careful not to get caught up in emotional entanglements.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Rejecting the kindness of others is terribly rude, wouldn't you agree? Some people, when they notice changes within themselves, want to break away from the past. But me? I will always remember the most intimate moments I've shared with each of my friends. These memories aren't fabricated, so why would one arbitrarily deny our friendship?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Indeed, my interrogations are truly gentle. As long as enough blood flows, I can thoroughly sift through a heart and excavate all the secrets I wish to know. A pity, though, that you and your blood are simply too precious. Do strive to live on. The day you lie mortally wounded on death's door, I'll be there to see you.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hmm... Pulse is steady. Not dead, just asleep.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Codename, Entelechia. It's been quite a while, battlefield commander of Rhodes Island—Don't feel bad that you've forgotten me. No one can know every single one of our Canoes.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Can a recording on a machine be more truthful than a memory bubbling from one's heart?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I should 'promote' you too, shouldn't I, as a token of appreciation? Why don't I purify the blood in your body, see if you can become a pure Vampire… Relax, you're not a mixed-blood Sarkaz, and unworthy of a torture you could not endure.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Ah, a medal... Have you thought it through? I'm rather fussy when it comes to gifts and the ones handing them over. The vows between Canoes come first, so I can't do much for Rhodes Island... But if a friend has a personal favor to ask, I don't mind lending a hand at times.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I don't mind escorting this many people at once.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Take care not to let your blood run dry.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Every drop of blood whispers.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I prefer a clean floor, so I'll grant you a death without shedding blood.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Oh, you have an indecisive side too?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: If you need to calm down, I can slow your heartbeat for you.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: At moments like these, Little Garnet shines most brilliantly.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Don't get me wrong. I don't like the smell of the battlefield.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Gush forth from your heart.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Part ways from your flesh.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Fall back into death.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Oh dear. Don't choke on your own blood, now.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Fine work. I will preserve this moment within my memories.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Can you feel your blood racing? Do you find this scene beautiful? If you're satisfied with the battle's outcome, then I haven't come here for naught.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: So long as they bleed, they cannot flee.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Go already. Do not dwell on this mess, nor let it scar you. The aftermath is mine alone to handle.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: A familiar sight. As I suspected back then, no one can alter this landship's mechanical design.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Does it feel nice, having your blood run backwards?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I would like to bestow upon you a little gift. Say, an Arts enchantment on your pen nib, the same I use on Little Garnet. How does that sound?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: How rare to see everyone in the mood to celebrate a holiday, rather than to mourn someone. It's also rare to see a banquet hall prepare a seat for a Vampire. The sisters of Rose Riverside have spoiled many a banquet before. Whoever said a dinner party isn't the perfect hunting ground for intelligence?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: If I were a commander whose life is either the target or concern of many and more, I would learn to tread a little lighter, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: A new birth is always a bloody affair. Some sisters choose to commemorate the day they killed an archenemy as their birthday; others pick the day their blood was purified and they became pure Vampires. How about you? Since coming to this great land, the blood you've shed and the pain you've endured… how much do you remember?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Farewells are difficult, so we must strive to minimize our partings. This isn't my personal conviction, but it was the reason Rose Riverside rallied behind Theresa, and why I support you now. Very well, present your year-end retrospective. I find solace in hearing memories unfold.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, do all these files need to be filled out by today? It's just, with this much left... so be it, I'll help you out. If we sort this out together, it shouldn't eat into our break hours.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: When I decided to violate orders and act independently, I was expecting a severe reprimand. What I never predicted was that Mr. Executor would recommend me here…

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, do you know if there's anywhere to borrow storybooks here? Operators at the Medical Department have asked me to care for the children under treatment, and I'd like to read them a tale or two.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The Notarial Hall employs more than just field executors; there's plenty of civil service posts. I actually aspired for one in the first place, but when it came to the evaluation, I accidentally... um, collapsed a few rooms in the examination venue, which got me put in my current position.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I don't rue leaving Laterano; it was my own choice. There's so many places I'm still not familiar with, but I feel that being able to see the breadth of Terra like I am now is more than worth it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The Sankta ability to perceive each other's states of mind is common sense to us, not something that needs real elaboration. But I'm sad to say, at some point, I suddenly realized I lost that reciprocation with my own people. It wasn't any physical disease, I just... began to think.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Stop, Doctor! Phew. You took the wrong cup—that's the espresso I brewed for myself, with no sugar. Yours was the one next to it. Sorry, I assume it was too bitter? ...It's fine, it tastes great? A—Alright, I'm glad you like it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, could you lend me your comms device for a moment? I usually turn my comms off after work, and don't get any messages. ...There we go, I've granted you emergency contact privileges. You can get in touch with me whenever for whatever, this way.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You seem to be having plenty of fun. Yes, I can tell. Joy, sorrow, anger... emotions can propagate between all of us, regardless of what city or race we come from. When you're happy, it's no wonder I can sense it too.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, are you still awake? It's just a little longer now. We can be on break once this work's done. Here, I have your coffee.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, I'm a dispatch at Rhodes Island via a transfer agreement with the Notarial Hall. A codename? Let's think... You can call me Enforcer. Here's the files pertaining to the agreement. I'll be counting on you to show me the ropes.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Brilliant. It'll be quick for me to adapt to this combat style.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion... Is this going to impact my specific working hours?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Maybe it's immature of me to approach things this way, but every step I've taken up to today is of my own choosing, and I'm satisfied with that. Doctor, thank you so much for watching over me all this time.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: A new mission? Understood.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: If we run into any contingency situations, I will independently judge how to proceed.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The sooner we're out, the sooner we're on break.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Do we have to compensate for damages incurred in combat?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: By your order.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Enforcing.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: This battle is by no means out of animosity.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: We all simply have differing viewpoints, no more.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: This is as far as you go.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: A struggle with an ideal to support it is far from meaningless.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I will hear you all out afterwards.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Be careful not to fall from here, everyone.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: They have what they uphold, and we have ours. Thank you for the willingness to realize, Doctor.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission complete. Good work, Doctor. Let's take a good break once we're back.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The ones who ran—did they give up? Or, maybe...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: No need to be so dejected. We can still try again.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: So these are the renowned Rhodes Island dormitories? Very... well, frugal.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Careful! You could've spilled the coffee.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I wear eyemasks while I'm on break, so I can only tell you all apart by your footsteps. Was that just now... the Doctor?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: This is my first time welcoming in the New Year somewhere beyond Laterano. There's still plenty of places I'm not used to, but I've tried so many things I never tried before, and that... feels pretty good. Happy New Year, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Want some coffee, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday. It seems you've already gotten plenty of cakes today. So, here's my present—a mug of premium coffee. It is totally devoid of sugar, but if you taste carefully, you can pick out a fruity, caramel sweetness... Doctor, is something wrong? Doctor?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: There are so many fellow Sankta aboard Rhodes Island. The sympathy might be missing, but I can see the joy and blessing on their faces as plain as day. Is it because they've all found a goal worth devoting themselves to here? If so, Doctor, I'll appreciate any future guidance you have for me.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'll make the arrangements. Just leave it to me.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, I certainly hope my teammates won't cause any trouble while I'm here working for you... Aagh, the more I think of it the worse this headache gets...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: An ordinary job, a peaceful life. That's all I ever wanted.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Yeah, it's not that I don't get along with the other A6 members... I just get a little headache whenever I see them...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My group members just bump into new troubles every day. There is the anti-social one, the never listening one, the awfully stubborn one… Just when will they ever settle down and work?...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I don't know how I ended up on this team either. All I wanted was an ordinary life. Why did I end up in charge of these... problem children?! Wait a minute, Midnight is a grown man!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Popukar... gotta pat her on the head. Catapult... gotta tie her up. Spot... never make him mad. As for Midnight, just knock him out. There, Doctor, now you know the proper protocol for dealing with Team A6.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I made a cake for my teammates. Wanna take a slice, Doctor? Everyone in A6 just love fruitcakes. They really are a bunch of kids, aren't they?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Not much time left. Done with your work for the day, Doctor?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Captain of Reserve Op Team A6, Orchid, reporting in. Are you the Dr. {@nickname}? I look forward to working with you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I learned a lot from this video. I'll keep it in mind for sure.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you so much. I'll work hard to improve my skills from now on and strive for better results for you!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'll complete my mission to the best of my ability.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Please follow the tactical combat manual closely, everyone. Thank you for your cooperation.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The battle has begun! Be careful, everyone!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Please make sure you follow every detail on the plan. Alright, everyone, now spread out!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Go ahead.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Here.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Orchid, ready to move.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Just as planned.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Target locked!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Stop them now!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Out of my way!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Oh come on, I already have enough work to deal with!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Well done, Doctor! Impeccable leadership even against such a tough opponent.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A perfect job! Looks like we can have a good rest today.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We need to work harder next time.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Is everyone okay? Let's get out of here!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Oh, What a noisy place...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What do you want...?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Huh?! Overtime again?! Ugh, I knew it...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Popukar, listen, I want you to sit still on the couch... Catapult, what are you doing—they just hung the streamers from that window! Midnight, for heaven's sakes, get down from the fireworks pile! Ugh, all of you! Stop messing around, NOW! Or nobody's getting a New Year's present! NOBODY!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Greetings, Doctor. Let's start today's work just as planned.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Present time. I picked out a color-changing lipstick, one that goes from transparent to light pink. Even if you aren't in any makeup, it'll give you some complexion. I wasn't sure what kind you'd like, so I went the one I use, a fruit flavor. How about you give it a try...? No, no, Doctor, no licking once it's on.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I've been so busy with work, I wouldn't even have noticed another year vanish in a blink. Forget anything else, I have far more patience than I used to, honestly. Have they grown up? No, they're still the same loud brats as ever. But at least they're doing much better now. Look at this—they made me tea after hearing I had overtime.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You can hand me whatever work you want, as long as I'm capable of handling it. After all, I'm here to let you catch your breath, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: My sickness isn't that bad. It hurts once in a while, but I can take it. Doctor, I'll continue working, be sure of that. I don't want to let anyone down.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I think… I ate them all. Eh...? Those were your snacks for the week? I'm so sorry... I can make you some cheese fondue for your afternoon teatime.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I still can't help but bow whenever I meet Master SilverAsh and the Saintess in the corridors, even though they tell me that at Rhodes Island, I should treat them as coworkers. I'll try, somehow.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I... wouldn't make a good explorer. I want to protect much more than explore. Driving the posts in, building a home. People as tenacious as you always need someone to watch your flanks, right? That's who I want to be, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Master SilverAsh says that Kjerag can't forever rely on Kjeragandr, let alone another country. One day I hope to stand against the blizzard with this shield, for the sake of my family.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I have dreams of snowy mountains all the time. Dreams of... running across lakes frozen deep. But my home isn't just snow and ice. Grass covers the valleys, and trains weave swiftly between the slopes. Those, too, form the Kjerag of my memories.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: ...I'm always asleep when you come to see me? No, I'm not feeling unwell or anything. It's a habit; I work for days at a time, and the moment I lie down, I fall into a long, deep sleep. But just call my name, Doctor, and I'll wake up straight away. Don't worry about me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, have you ever seen the aurora? When I was a student, I saw it just once in the northernmost tundra. It was very soon after I got sick, and I had to say goodbye to the survey group. If I can ever go back... would you come see the aurora with me?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doct... you can have my jacket, okay? You'll catch a cold, sleeping somewhere like this.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor, I'm Aurora. My boss Closure talks about you a lot. I promised her I'd protect you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Is this... a record from the battle in Lungmen? So this is another way you can use shields... I've learned a lot.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Captain Sharp's assessment... is so high? And you agree as well? I... I'm so happy!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Could I send this medal home? I want my mother to know, I might be sick, but not everything looks bad. I have made my way.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: A field mission again? I'm with you, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You want me leading? I... I'll work to follow Captain Sharp's example.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Aurora, moving out.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: You there, stay back! Don't come any closer.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Doctor, give the word.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Awaiting orders.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Appropriate terrain for me.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Don't even think of coming through.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: The snows of my home... are with me.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Snow, be what boils my blood.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Snow, be what freezes their blood.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Snow, be what warms my family.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I'll become stronger than I was, to make your victories easier.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Stay back, for just a second... I'm too icy now. Let me just rub a bit to warm up... good, that's better! Alright, now it's safe to high-five!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Next time, I won't let a single one escape.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, we have to retreat! Can you still move? Get on my back... no, I'll carry you!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's so hot in here...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: M-My cookies are gonna spill!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Are you heading out? I'll be your bodyguard.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, Happy New Year. I hope the snowflakes that cover the land this year can be gentler and warmer than before.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You're looking well, Doctor. Just say if you need anything.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Sit here and wait for me one moment, okay? Shield output adjusted, and... Look! Now it's snowing inside your room! When the snowflakes melt in the palm of your hand, doesn't it feel so wonderful? I've always been wanting another chance to see the snows of Kjerag with you!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island has alleviated my Oripathy, and given me a great job, so by all rights, I shouldn't be asking for anything more... but, Doctor! If you'd be willing to take a look at this proposal for improving the dormitory refrigeration and air conditioning, I'd be very, very thankful! You—You accepted it? Really?!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, I'm leaving the landship tomorrow, so I tidied up your office. I put your daily necessities on your desk, and sorted everything else into the cabinets. You can refer to the notes I made whenever you take or return something, so you'll remember where they are.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Hm? You're talking to me? No, it's just, I only saw you a few times from a distance during our Babel days, and we never had a conversation. I saw you on the deck once. A gust of wind almost blew your coat away , so I wanted to remind you to wear more layers, but in the end... I didn't have the guts to  approach you.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor! Sorry, I should have mentioned not to touch my weapon. I'll apply some ointment for you, and you can keep the rest too. It was made for situations like this anyway, and it's pretty good for burns. What about me? It's fine... I've been used to its heat since long ago.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Doctor, why are you always giving me these toys? What? Because I have a baby face? Hahaha, I'm much older than you think. But you do remind me of the first toy I got as a boy, it was my mom's sword. When she gave it to me, she also said it was time I learned to be a man.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I grew up in Kazdel. It sounds like I had it easy, but I'm sure you know it's hard for a couple to raise a child there. They probably burned all the luck they had to let their boy grow up safe and sound.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Too many things happened in Babel, so it's best you don't pry. Nah, I'm not running from the past. I simply think people naturally forget the past if they choose to keep moving forward. To hate, forgive, or to do neither, none of it matters.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, someone asked me to give you this letter. She used to be in Babel's assault squad, but now she's back in Kazdel working as a smith. You can't make sense of it? Let me see... Man, there's so many spelling mistakes... Alright, so she's asking... how you are... Saying you should eat more... And wishing... you're still with all your limbs?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: One year, everyone was celebrating a victory here in the canteen. We were both there, but with a group of people between us. People leave, scatter, and now only we two are left at this table. Oh, don't be upset, Doctor. Please, don't be upset. It's alright if you don't remember, at least I still do.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You're... oh, it's you, Doctor. I've had a bit too much to drink... Y-You're awful clever, could you tell me something? Why do I have to see so much turmoil... and change? Shouldn't our eyes... be filled with nothing... but our loved ones?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Sorry to wake you, Doctor. I shouldn't have barged in like that. The weather's been getting colder, so I... just wanted to make sure you stay warm.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Maybe you don't remember me, Doctor? I used to work for you a long time ago. Odda. That's my name.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This training method is pretty good. I remember how recruits used to be sent straight to the battlefield, they would've more or less learned how to fight, if they managed to survive.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thanks, Doctor. I'm always anticipating your approval.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: That's great... you don't exchange heads for rewards here.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Live on, so we can see each other again.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Don't come too close to me, the flames might sputter.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The steam has dissipated.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I'm sorry we had to meet here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: This blade has gone through countless whetstones.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: This hammer has gone through many years of tempering.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'm here.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I see them.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: The dead, I will remember.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: The living, I will protect.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You won't take what I've got now!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: My childhood is LONG GONE!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Thank you for lending me your luck, Pops...

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Let's go back, Doctor. I'm craving a huge cup of ice water right about now.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Anyway, we won.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, no matter how things turned out, it's over... let's go back.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Doctor, should I turn up the air conditioner? Sorry, my body gets so hot, it's even heating up our surroundings.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Whoa! Your fingers are so cold!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Ah! Please don't touch my tail. It broke off once, and it doesn't feel good if people touch it.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, I know a new year means new expectations. But... I've long since stopped wanting anything more than not losing what I've got now. That's my biggest hope.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Don't forget to eat and drink water regularly, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I got some biscuits from Kazdel for you. I guess you could say they're a local specialty? We always eat them on our birthdays. Yes? You bit into something hard? Oh, it's just a tiny piece of shrapnel. Probably flew in while they were being made. It's fine, just toss that bit away and eat the rest.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: There was a time when I got myself somewhere high up all alone, thinking I'd see a different view above Kazdel that wasn't just the usual smoke and fire. But even when my eyes were hurting from the smoke, I still couldn't see anything. Unlike the past, today I can see a different sight with you on the landship— a sky so pretty and blue.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hello! It's my shift now, Doctor!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: What does my 'Cardigan' codename mean? Ahh, It's actually the name of my clan. It's a family tradition to use it as a codename.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Wow, I found one of my people on another team! I've got to invite her to hang out with me sometime!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I was born in the north of Leithanien, a place full of snowy forests. Oh, that reminds me, I can teach you to ski, Doctor!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: A lot of people say stuff like 'it's a Defender's job to hold her ground,' but that's such an outdated concept. Speed is what you need! This is the age of maneuver warfare! Mobility is the key to victory!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: *Sniff sniff*... I recognize that perfume, it's gotta be Melantha! I hope we can become closer friends... 'Cause then we'll be able to work better as a team!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Hehe, I really enjoy playing with kids. Back in my hometown, I took my brothers and sisters sledding every year. I really miss it! Oh, speaking of sleds... I wonder if Adnachiel can make one for me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I have plenty of things I don't like. Oripathy, for instance... But there's no point in worrying too much. I would rather live my days in happiness! Plus, I've got you with me, Doctor!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Woof!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Heeellooo! I've never been in such a big mobile facility before! I'm so excited! Merry of the Cardigan here. Are you the Doctor?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Ehehe, thanks!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Yay! I will keep fighting hard for my next promotion! I'm sure it will come in time!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Awesome! Finally, my time has come!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Ansel! Come on! I promise I won't lead everyone on a wild-goose chase!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Formation ready! Advance to the objective!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Let's go! ...Steward, what was I supposed to do next?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: There's no hesitating in battle!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: All right!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Understood!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I will protect us all!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Aha!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Your attacks have no effect!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I knew we could do it. Right, Adnachiel?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Yeeaaah! A flawless victory!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Thanks, Medics! You saved my life...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Ughh... Sorry, Ansel...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Steward, what should I do next?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Woah! Roller coaster—!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Melantha? Huh? Why are you here, Doctor?!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
