voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! I wonder why there's no snow outside. And after I spent all that time getting my sled ready… When will I ever get to rocket down the slopes straight into a snowdrift like I did when I was little?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I'm right here, Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Yay! Happy birthday, Doctor! Hm, something smells good. You got a gift from Melantha, didn't you? What a scent! Melantha taught me how to make perfume, actually, do you want to try with me?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I promise I'll be more careful, I won't break anything! Sorry… Honestly, my salary won't even be enough to cover the damages if I keep breaking things… heheh…

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You pulled an all-nighter, and you're still not done? Sheesh, what should I do with you...? How much do you have left? I'll help. You should get some rest. And work on your time management.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I can confirm we've received this shipment of medicine without issues. The quantities are right. As for the payment, could you please let Kal'tsit know I'll take care of that pain-in-the-neck mission for her.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Count Hohenlohe, some call him the Hyacinth Count. The way I see it, he's quite a handful with that personality of his. I'm serving as huscarl to this Leithanian noble, on account of some trouble. What trouble, you ask? Hm... Let's keep this a secret for the time being.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: That little one... Her codename here is uh... Beeswax? Looks like she tripped in the hallway again this morning. Can she really cut it? She sure knows how to keep her sister worrying.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Rhodes Island provides what the count and I need. In return, I take care of Rhodes Island's troubles in Leithanien. This is what you call a win-win situation, isn't it? Come, shake my hand. This is the beginning of a beautiful friendship, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The Leithanians' research on Arts has far exceeded my expectations, and their architecture, music, and education... All are worthy of study. One day, I will bring all this back home. Yeah, and I might bring something else along, though.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The longer we acclimate to an environment and the different people there, the harder it will get for us to free ourselves, and eventually we'll be made to fit its mold... Don't you agree, Doctor? Well, that's not going to get me tied down here. Not unless I allow it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I'm sure the nobles think of me as an odd thorn in their side. No matter. I don't mind. Though I'd rather keep all this trouble a secret from Beeswax. It's too dangerous... Now that I mention it, I can't quite stop worrying about you, either.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: If it's at all possible, I'd rather stay out of the nobles' bickering. Do you know how much I have to worry about each and every day with all the chaperone work and missions on my plate? Maybe I should talk the count into letting me hop over here full time. I'm relying on you to keep me under your wing when the time comes, Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: My little sister sometimes talks in her sleep. This one time, I even caught her talking bad about me. Heheh, Doctor, do you know what you said in your sleep the other day?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, you must be the Doctor? I'm Carnelian, huscarl to Count Hohenlohe... Oh, I'm just a normal operator here at Rhodes Island. Kindly refrain from frivolous conversation with my little sister, won't you?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I see. These are tactics worth studying.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: There is no need, but I appreciate your kind gesture. Thank you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: You see, I find myself worrying about a vast number of people and things, and that number is growing by the day. It's been a while since I was able to do as I pleased, but since you're up for it... Let's put on a show.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: This is not part of our agreement, but fine. I'm happy to help.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Don't worry. I'll bring everyone back, safe and sound.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Follow the plan, everyone!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Elegance and etiquette are the way of nobility. Not mine.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: As you wish.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Between a refined combat style or something more direct, which do you prefer?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: It's been a long time since my blood boiled like this.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Greetings... Let's forgo the bothersome formalities and get this thing started.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Gnaw them to shreds and drink their blood!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Crush them, beat them to a pulp!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Careful! Don't get torn to shreds so quickly!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: My oh my, what a pitiful sight. Why are you covered in blood?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Nothing to worry about then. That was easy enough for you.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Okay, mission complete, and right on time, too... Are you hurt, Doctor?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Calm down. Just leave the rest to me. They won't get away.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Fall back, now! Don't panic. As long as I'm still standing, no one will touch you!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Just as I thought. I can relax better in a room without much decoration.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh... Watch out. My horns could get you.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: What's wrong? Are you tired? Get some rest. You've worked hard enough already.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: My horns look especially good today? Thank you. It was my little sister who insisted on giving me a cornicure. I might as well assume that such things bring good luck for the new year. Having experienced a variety of customs, people's feelings when praying for new beginnings are always similar.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: More work today? Don't spend the whole day sitting, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I am not one to play the sycophant on such occasions, but I'm willing to offer you a gift as a friend. This gramophone is for you, and when next I travel between Rhodes Island and Leithanien, I'll be sure to bring back some records.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island is a partner that keeps its promises, but true partners need connections deeper than contracts. No, Beeswax has grown up, and her relationship with Rhodes Island is her own business. What we are discussing now is between you and me.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Yeah, yeah, I get it, you deserve a nice rest in your off time. But you gotta get your treatment right now.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Huh? You want me to be gentle and caring? That's nurse stuff, pal. I'm a doctor, from top to toe. That means healing. Treatment. Don't waste my time with the fluff.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Strange, why does Dr. Kal'tsit keeps telling me to 'be nice to patients'? She's been doing it ever since I got here.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Your average doctor's biggest concern is keeping herself safe. Mine, on the other hand... it's getting my patients to stop being scared of me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Treatment time, ears open! Eyes on me! Hands up! Don't move!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctors and fighters... life-savers, life-takers. People think we're polar opposites, but I think we're one and the same—we both sacrifice.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Huh? I didn't beat anyone up, I just wanted to say hi. Watch, lemme demo... I initiate physical contact, and that's how I get closer to people, see?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I'm kinda missing my homeland... I chose to be a medic myself, but it's crazy it all turned out the way it did. Life sure took me down some wild paths, huh?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor... you and I are both travelers on a lonely road. I guess that's why we understand each other so well.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: What the... you're asleep, huh? Heheh.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Medic Operator Gavial. First things first... Don’t judge me by the way I look. Got it?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Tch, I thought we were gonna have combat class.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Everyone's so scared of me treating them... You're the only one who accepts me for what I am. Thanks for that.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: All right, no more fooling around. I'll be serious from now on.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Leave the rear to me. Go show what you're made of!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: All right, get in line, everyone!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: All right, ladies. Let's keep it cool.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Coming!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Let's begin.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Where do you need me?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Ready to heal!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Who needs healing? Come over!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: If you want treatment, you gotta come closer!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Don't get yourself killed, dummy!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Come on, get it together!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Hang in there, I'm coming!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Meh, pushovers. I wasn't even breaking a sweat.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Man those guys were weak. I regret not giving 'em a few whacks with the staff here.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Have you guys never taken emergency response training courses?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Darn it... I'm not giving up yet!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Let's see if there are any interesting people here!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hey, knock it off!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You want me to just nod and listen? No. Freaking. Way.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Finally, New Year's! The croc doc is in and she says today's a rest day! Speaking of, they really celebrate New Year's peacefully out here. I kinda miss the Acahualla-style ceremony. Kal'tsit probably wouldn't approve holding it here at Rhodes Island though...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday to you, Doctor. Speaking of, I oughta give you a little present... Let's take this opportunity to give you a full, thorough physical exam!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: You want my thoughts on what being a Rhodes Island doctor's been like? Nothing too special. Whether punching enemies into submission or using my staff to make patients listen, there's always a sense of accomplishment. It was my choice and I made it, so there's nothing to waffle over.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Don't you just need me to push some papers around? I do this stuff all the time, piece o' cake.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, hurry up and check out my new video. You're gonna love it.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Yeah, that's the icon. Mind clicking on it for me? And if possible, can you click that icon next to it? Hehe, thanks a bunch.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Raw footage! Ideas! Plotlines! I can't think up any content! I'm gonna lose subs......

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm just an amateur explorer. I only plan to take a few shots and then come right back, so I won't be gone for long. Besides, how could being outdoors be as cozy as chilling in my room?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The folks in the Medical Department must've put some weird ideas in your head again. Look, I admit, I get weird impulses every now and then, but I promise, I'll never cause you any trouble.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: My unique skill is video editing. Did you wanna do a Rhodes Island promo, Doctor? Got a plan for me? All righty, let's take a look. Hmm... Rhodes Island precautions, balanced diet videos, fire safety videos... What the hell are these?!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My instincts are telling me, there's a terrible Feline approaching, Doctor. Don't let your guard down. The moment you're distracted, they'll jump out of a dark corner and smack you to the ground in a single swipe of the paw. Eh? They won't?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The joy of living together with everyone, and the thrill of finding new things to film go hand in hand! It is for that reason I decided to become an operator, so I can share my happiness with you.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Time to quietly sneak in a photo op. Mm, just one.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: 'Sup everyone, this is the Click Channel! Eh? I'm not allowed to take footage of the Doctor's office? Fine...

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Let me do the filming next time.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion? Sweet! Let's take a group photo to celebrate the occasion, Doctor!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Relax, Doctor. This happens every time I get excited, but there's nothing to be afraid of.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: 'Sup, everyone!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Leave it to me!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Doctor, you'd better not forget anything~

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Let's see what interesting things can be filmed this time~

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Over here!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: By your command.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Fly, my drone!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Let's get to work!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Fire!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Move aside!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I see you!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Hey, smile for the camera!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: That was a sweet clip I just got! Make sure to come by and watch it after you return to the ship.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Wonderful! We can just use this as a real-time battle record!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I was too caught up with filming that someone slipped through.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: My lens broke...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: My video studio's about to open!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Wah!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Hey Doctor, lemme show you something good!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Oh! I just got a new idea. Hold on, where's my camera? Anywhere I can set up a tripod? Doctor, help me test this out! When the fireworks go off, you look out the window. I'll take a picture of your eyes—

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hiii~

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, have you heard of montages? It's when you mix a bunch of different shots from different scenes together. I sometimes catch you commanding when I film my battle records. Ta-dah! Doctor's Commanding Highlights in Ultra HD! It's your birthday present!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor! It's true that at first, I joined Rhodes Island just to make some money for the road. But now, I'm never gonna leave a company that doesn't charge me for drone repairs! Even if there are a lot of big Felines here! I'm—Ahhhhh! Is that Blaze?!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Please don't take all that artistic license for reality. Putting a doppelganger to use takes a lot of energy, and it won't happen for odd jobs like this.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I imagine the few Higashi professionals here at Rhodes Island hid their backgrounds from you. If needs be, I can investigate for you—I guarantee any information you get will be the absolute truth.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I've worked for Rhodes Island for ages now; I know the ins and outs of everything. If you have any questions, I can always help—hm? What is today's special at the cafeteria? I... have no idea... I'll go investigate.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: When you're out gathering info, the right clothes can avoid you a lot of hassle. For example, these—once they're all coordinated, you can seem just like a Victorian student taking their first steps into society. In another outfit... I'll demonstrate sometime else if we get the chance.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Zzz... zzz... what a peaceful day... no bothersome cases, no quarrels in the street, and nobody to disturb you even if you sleep in... it's a shame moments of rest are always so short. Come on, Doctor, what do you need me to do?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Since birth, I was meant as a hidden blade in the hands of others. Infiltration, tracking, luring, they became as natural as breathing to me. Being able to use these abilities on the way of right... ha, I never did imagine that. Thank you, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: After the lord passed away, the young master set up a company with the family property. He tore up his oath too, signing contracts with us instead, and just like that, the famed ninjas were completely made over as white-collar workers. As for why I quit... I think I didn't take to sitting in an office, haha.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Dietary habits in Victoria are surprisingly close to those at home. I realized, ever since then, that maybe one day the people of Terra could lay down their prejudices and work hand in hand. But considering the... emm, unique ways they have of cooking locally, I still have some reservations.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: When I was young, my father drilled 'that which you should, you must' into me, and I always thought he meant I should do everything for myself. But after going from Higashi to Rhodes Island to Victoria, I came to see it anew. Distinguishing what I should and what I must, what to give and what to take—that's the true meaning of it.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You're thinking about something, aren't you... carry on, I won't disturb you.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor. Rhodes Island Branch Operator, Kazemaru, aboard from today on.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I see... There's still more progress I can make on myself.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Watch, just take the corner of this origami and ever so lightly—pull! And now it's just like a real beast cub. I just wanted to show off a little something to you, and I hope it turned out nice.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Ever was my family's forte to be protean, and by this piece of paper, all that lives is imitable. Watch now, Doctor—Mimesis!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'll see to the role I should.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Am I going to be leading? Oh, wow... I'll value this chance, you can be sure!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Off we go!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Target visible. Beginning pursuit.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: All ready.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Danger? As if I should fear it.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Beginning assignment.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Success is inevitable. No need to leave it to chance.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Wind, rise!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Fall!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Elusion!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Shadow!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Under your command, I've been far too spoiled.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission complete. Good, no tracks left behind.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: You've noticed how serious I was during the fight? Well—they weren't very friendly, after all.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Flee Doctor... ahead of me...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Nmm, I'd love to relax~

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What is it?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Ah, Doctor, this is for you! I just finished folding it.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: In the New Year's passage, may I offer my sincere blessings to you, Doctor. Um, no, I was just pondering a little. My time's finally become my own. The old me wouldn't have had the faintest idea how to allocate it. Now, though, I know just what I'm putting my efforts towards.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello to you, Doctor~

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday. For you, Doctor. Put this paper flower under your pillow, and it'll turn into a real flower the next morning. Just like our first meeting, it's both real and fake, it all lies in your hands.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: First shinobi, then salarywoman, and now an intelligence reconnaissance officer in disguise, I wonder what my next job will turn out to be. Ah, Doctor, I don't mean I'm leaving Rhodes Island! I'm just thinking, with all the curveballs life will throw at us, we should all tackle the now as best as we can.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: We got a lot to do today, Doctor. So how about we play some games first? Isn't getting nice and relaxed the best way to prepare for a hard day of work?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Aw, I feel so lazy today for some reason! Maybe because Midnight isn't around? I love watching him chat up girls with that flashy smile of his. It's especially fun when the girls turn him down! Totally makes my day.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, you know who's the most reliable in our group? Oh, you can't guess? It's Spot! He might be quiet, but he's very reliable. So why don't we get him here to offer a hand? After all there's so much work for only two of us, don't you think?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Aw... Ms. Orchid yelled at me again today. She's such a nag! Must be work getting into her head and stressing her out. She should learn from me—I have the perfect balance between working hard and playing hard!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Hey, where's Dobermann? She's out on business today? Yay, finally! I can slack off all day now, wonderful! I'm gonna go get some snacks first. Doctor, you want some chips or popcorn? I'll grab a bag for you!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Uh, Popukar, sweetie, please listen to me, I'll do anything you say, okay? J-just put down the chainsaw! Oh no, she's out of control! This is the worst! Doctor, run! Run! We gotta jump out the window! Yeah, the window! Follow me!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The town I came from... the mayor was a tyrant, a fat cat with no heart, no sympathy. Drove the townspeople nuts. I hated him too, so I blasted open his vault and handed out all the money I found to the townies. Now that was a good time!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I don't care what anybody thinks of me—it's more important that I just enjoy every day doing what I like. My life belongs to me, so I alone decide what I do. Isn't that right?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor's asleep? Well, can't interrupt a beauty nap. Guess I'll go out and have some fun.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Reserve OP Team A6, Catapult, reporting in! Hey, I can tell you're hella different from that stuffy old bit—I mean, that esteemed, honorable instructor Ms. Dobermann. Right? Like it's obvious!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: ...Ahhh, that was a nice nap.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Hehe, I finally finished basic training. Wait, what? Dobermann will keep overseeing the newbies, even AFTER their promotions? You gotta be kidding me! No—

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: It's not time to head out yet, right? Let me hang out for a bit longer...

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm the captain? Haha~I've been waiting forever to hear those words!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Aw man, where did I leave my ammunition belt?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Ugh, I hate fighting. But what else can I do?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What's up?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Whatever you say.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Safe landing!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Time for business.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Watch how I get them with one shot!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: You're all gonna fly!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: What an awesome formation! You got some great tactics, Doctor. And it all went down perfect!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I love commanders that lead us to victory! Just like you, Doctor!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Relax, I set a whole bunch of traps right where the enemy's gonna be running. What? They didn't step in any of them? No way!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Oh shoot! Hurry up, Doctor. We gotta move!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Psst, care to take a peek and tell me if Dobermann's in there?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: You can't catch me! ...Oh, you can.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, you're an awesome leader!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor! Quick! Stop what you're doing! We don't get to take time off for new year's everyday, and you're just commiting a crime letting your works trouble you. Get out of your room, and let's have some fun!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor! I'm right here!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I guess getting old isn't something you should feel optimistic about, but it's still worth commemorating the day a new life was born. Gimme a minute, let's celebrate with something from my secret snack cache.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I don't like working, but Rhodes Island isn't so bad. Instead of evil landlords, you have comrades you can trust to have your back, and that's enough for me. Say, if today's special, does that mean I get the day off?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hello, Doctor, I'm on duty today... Oh, sorry, my blade got stuck in the doorframe…

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Back home, the soil goes more and more barren every day, and we don't harvest enough to feed ourselves. Most people can't make a living, so they have to become mercenaries to survive. They'll do anything, as long as it pays.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: They said my blade was too dangerous and wouldn't let me into the kitchen. I just wanted to help, but as soon as I tapped that cutting board with my blade, it split in two... Umm... should I pay for it?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Every time I bask in the sun, I can't help but get a bit sleepy. But don't worry, I'm on guard... Keeping you safe... I won't fall... asleep... ZZZzzzzz…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I have standards in my line of work: Don't harm the innocent, don't get bystandars involved… To be honest, it's hard to stick to them…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I'm lending you this necklace, take good care of it. It's a protective charm. No, I can't give you my blade. Just remember to keep the charm with you when I'm not around.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, I need you to look me in the eye, and don't move. Come on, hold still... Hmm… Good, you're not the type to use people for evil. I can tell.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Honestly, I don't remember much from when I was little. My teacher raised me, and taught me to use a blade. He told me my parents got mixed up in a fight that got them killed. When he found me, I was clutching this blade and wouldn't let it go, even as it dug into me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: She who wields a blade will always look to duel, and she who takes a life will eventually become a notch on the blade of another. Maybe one day, I'll meet an end like that... When that happens, Doctor, I hope you'll be there to witness it.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I'll stand guard. You can rest easy.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Cutter. Just an ordinary mercenary. I have Oripathy, so I'm looking to trade my skills for treatment. Hope this blade's good enough to get things done for you... Yeah, that's about it.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Nice moves! Didn't know you could use a blade like that.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Freedom's the only treasure I have, besides my blade. If you're willing to protect it, I'll listen to you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: A mercenary's blade isn't a toy that never sees bloodshed, it feeds on it. Maybe one day, I won't be able to control it anymore. But don't worry, at least for now... it works for you.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Got it. Joining the team.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Understood. Can I select my own teammates?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Be ready. And make sure you don't get any innocents involved.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Your blades all sharp?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Got it.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I can wait.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: The battlefield is a graveyard.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: All I need to do is wield my blade.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Quiet.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Don't look back.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Look me in the eye.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You're too slow.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Maybe one day, there'll be something my blade can't cut. But that day isn't today, and it certainly isn't these guys.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Phew... All done, just as specified in the contract. Need to take a look?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: They've lost their will to fight. Not my targets anymore.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Go, Doctor, go as far as you can! I'll... hold them back.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: My sunny spot… Ahh, so warm…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Uhh, don't pull on my ears.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Wanna go sunbathing together?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: To a happy and healthy New Year. Mm, gotta live your best life every day, and get plenty of sunshine. Basically, I'll try to keep looking out for you, within my means anyway. Happy New Year, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Oh, you're here, Doctor. Got any work today?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday. I got this cake while I was out on a field mission a week ago. I did really wanna make it myself, but I don't have the right to use the kitchen just yet... I'll keep fighting hard, so I can treat you to a cake I made myself next year.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I want to be a principled merc, but it's actually hard to do it alone. Just like a ship without a point of reference, you get lost real easy. But here at Rhodes Island, I can rest easy. I can trust I'm doing the right thing.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor! Do you want these files here? A Liberi lady just taught me how to use a printer! Look, I even learned how to print on both sides! This needs to be single-sided? Uh-oh, sorry! I'll print it again!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: My mother has gotten a lot better. That time, even divination showed a dark future. If not for the medical equipment we got from the explorers, she might have left us... Since then, I decided to go out into the world. I hope to bring more equipment like that back to the village.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I'm really grateful to Magallan. We've only met a few times during search and rescue operations, but she put me in touch with Rhodes Island after hearing my situation. And she's an incredible lady. Not many people dare to explore the ice fields like her. Even people in our tribe seldom set foot there. It's a place that's feared and revered.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I'm part of my tribe's rescue team, helping people who accidentally wander into the bog, or get lost in the snowstorms. That's how I met a lot of explorers from Columbia. Woah, Doctor, how did you know they always compliment my tail?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I never thought I would leave the tribe and come here. I was never interested in things from the outside world. But that shiny medical equipment blew me away. They went against our divination. That's a miracle to me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The explorers told me things I've never heard before, about 'corporations', 'timetables', 'entrepot'... we don't even have these words because we've never had a use for them. But I learned them quickly, thanks to my conversations with the explorers.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Can I see the future like Gitano? I suppose I could divine your future, but I'm not great at it. If you really want me to tell your fortune for the day, let's see... Okay, it says... the stars will fall from the sky, and eggplant must go on top of rice.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, Accounting says my 'reimbursement claim' has been delayed. What does 'reimbursement claim' mean? Sorry, but there's still so much I don't understand about paperwork…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor! I'm back from my field mission! We delivered some equipment to my tribe and taught them how to use it. Turns out aunt's leg pains were caused by bone spurs. Now that we know how to treat it, she won't have to rely on my cousin's Arts to relieve the pain.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Oh, the phone is ringing! What did the Doctor say I should do in this situation… Okay... He-hello? Um, nice to hear you. This is the Doctor's office.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I forgot to ask the Perro man what I should call you. I only learned the word 'company' from the Columbians. Do you have a name? Oh, just 'Doctor'? I can do that!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Is this one of your technologies? How do you manage to record everything like that?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, is this what you call a 'contract'? It's very difficult to understand. Do I have to sign it? You say if I don't sign it, I'll be forced to work day and night by a cruel boss? But Doctor, you are not cruel… What? What do you mean don't be so sure?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I won't make a fool of myself like before, Doctor! You've helped me so much. My mother's getting better, and my tribe is learning to use Rhodes Island medical equipment. I hope I can do even more for them in the future.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Don't worry, I've been on a lot of rescue operations.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Everyone, follow my orders and don't run off on your own.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Begin rescue operation!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Make sure you're well-prepared. That's the foundation of a successful rescue.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: A new rescue objective?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I have the map here.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Don't worry, help is on the way.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Please save your strength, we will get you out!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Rescue targets identified.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Rescue location confirmed.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Formulating a rescue plan.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Don't worry. You're going to be fine!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I was nervous, but my experience really came in handy!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A well-planned and well-executed rescue operation, our target has been brought to safety.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The victim was injured… Don't worry, I'll ease the pain for you.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Over here! We need backup!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Oh, so this is where I'm supposed to use this 'access card.'

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, you don't really want me to divine your future, do you?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor! My mother divined Rhodes Island's future to thank you. She'll tell you the results herself. She also asked me to give you this, a feather that's only given to the strongest warrior or wisest sage among our people.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Boo! Did that scare you? Not at all? Aw, I used to spook lots of people in the snow.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I've been practicing tsoavttsomav iednijn (divination with my mother). Do you want to have your fortune told again? Maybe start with easy questions, like how big you'll grow this year. Apparently, I'm going to grow a lot!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I used to be scared of contracts and paperwork, but I can handle those now. My tribe has started calling me the 'oavdos unna rájadusásj' ('Wonderful Little Messenger'). I heard Magallan set a new record. People with dreams just don't stop.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You give Kafka the work that needs doing, Doctor, and then I pass it all on... okay! This's just like how underground gofering goes!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Seeing as you're my friend now, Doctor, you can ask me for anything. Oh, but, apart from lending you my shears.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Rhodes Island's fulla all sortsa people I never met before. Everywhere I go, I sees what I wants. Hm? You're wonderin' WHAT it is I want? That's a secret, y'know. Secret.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Hmm... still can't read your eyes. They're calm as a lake... But there'll come a day when I get your number, Doctor, just you wait!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, Silence kicked me out againnn! Hard times for a Kafka, sob, sob... huh? I started it by messing up her experiment? Aw, nerts, Silence got to you first... eh-hem, well, good talking, I'm just gonna mosey on out now!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Well, until I can get what I want, I guess I'll lend you a hand. Just lending it, though, okay?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Story goes, I used to live in a real maaad kinda city, dealing with bad people alla the day. But then I came landship-side, and everyone's been some kinda nice with me, even givin' me snacks and all! Mm-hm, and that's why I like it here at Rhodes Island!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: ...Y'know the secrets everyone tries their best to hide? They're like monsters, hidden in the dead shadows, waitin' for their chance. Beautiful... and dangerous. That's exactly why I do my darndest to collect them! Doctor, don't you got anything for my hoard?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, if you've ever got a problem, we can always call my 'friends' from Columbia in to help. Though you don't really gotta. One Kafka'll sort out all your troubles head to tail!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Bet you think I'm goofing off right now, Doctor. But I ain't.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Whatcha need me for...? Hey, hey, wait, no bean-spilling, not in front of everybody! Just treat me like a normal gardener, okay?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Just gotta figure what they're aiming for, and I can draw up some counterplans. C'mon, ain't I a wiz?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Seeing as you really need my power, Doctor, just c'mon and say it. Be like Kafka here, all serious and open, yeah?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Gardenin' or fightin', I didn't start doing either for compliments. But having my own efforts get noticed by you and the rest, well, that makes a Kafka real happy.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Wonder what we can harvest this time?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Just leave it to me. I guarantee you're all in for a fun time!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Ah, thinkin' sucks... I guess I'll be listenin' to you, Doctor.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Look at all these naughty li'l saplings. Ain'tcha cute... sit tight and Kafka'll trim ya up.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Kafka, roger!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Right here, I guess.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Hm-hmmm.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Watch your eyes... I see all your weakpoints in 'em.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: You're all just hedges who know how to walk.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Lemme break ya right there.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Kafka knows you're scared. Tremblin' li'l bare branches.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Smooth sailin' just like always, Doctor. Alright, makes a Kafka wanna go get 'em!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Man, were those enemies pushovers. If I'd known sooner, I coulda saved a Kafka some effort.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Hmm, guess I gotta be more careful with the pruning next time.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Whaddaya doing, Kafka... you can read their plans, can't you?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Where's Silence's lab, again?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: ...Whaddaya think you're doin'.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, Kafka here wants to deck out your office with some bonsai. Don'tcha worry, I'll make 'em look real good.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, let's build us a snowman! First we roll up two big snowballs. We make the hat kinda round, then we do the clothes reaaal long... Ta-dah, one 'Doctor,' made to order! Oh, I dunno though, feels kinda sad seeing a Doctor all alone on the deck!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: What work you got for me today, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, birthday cake for you! See the flowers around the outside? Pure bespoke craft by Kafka hands. Careful you don't lose count counting 'em all, heheh! C'mon, yannow fine work like this ain't no sweat for me and my shears. Not that I got anything against working up a sweat for my best bud—hey, whoa, whoa, paws off! No eating yet! You admire the freakin' thing first!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Yannow, I've been here long enough to see all you Rhodes Islanders are real good people. And nothing gets me more heated than good people getting bullied. So if there's ever any bad guys you just can't handle, you drop me a line. A Kafka's always saving some secret sauce—what, no need? Fine. You're the boss, boss.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, watch your hands. If you aren't careful around my weapons, you'll get hurt.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Here are the instruments I used to play. There aren't too many of them, but the gems on them are very valuable. Sell them, and they should cover my medical fees... Once my debt's cleared, I'd like to go back to living on my own. Would that be alright?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I've seen pets kept around your hospital here, and you have a training room. I've seen some of the children you're giving intensive care in the wards. 'Instructor?' 'Professor?' My previous savior brought me to those with the same title, and look how I ended up.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: This? This is my lyre. I may be better with other instruments, but I like playing this one most. Listen. Such an airy, lingering timbre, and the hand moves so beautifully when playing. But when you fully lose yourself in the melody, the knife concealed inside will... I'm sorry, I got carried away.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, do you intend only to treat me here? Strange. You really don't need me to do anything? I can't trust kindness with no strings attached. Let me do a little something for you, okay? I'm sure you'll be satisfied, no matter the task—But, you must share with me your motivations.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I remember coming back from my first fulfilled mission when I was young, weeping and throwing up, scared I didn't do well enough, that I would starve to death in some forgotten corner, unknown to anyone... No longer do I fear these things. Thanks to the days with Rhodes Island, I now know how it feels to be truly alive.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The Originium on my arm... it hurts terribly, but it's much more manageable by now. I know none of the physicians, but I can tell how sincerely they're working to save me. Doctor, once my illness has stabilized to a point, can I... stay here?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: A lot of my past mistakes were made out of fear. I was scared—I felt that if I didn't listen to them, I was dead. But after catching Oripathy, they threw me out there to die. I should have been terrified at that moment, but instead I was... relieved. The sun shining on my face—it was so warm, it really was.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, could you take me with you on your next field mission? I want to know the reasoning behind your every decision. Why did you save me, a stranger? Just what does my life mean to you...? I want to figure you out, just a little clearer.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: All the ones before you would sleep with one eye open, when I was around. Do you... trust me that much?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: So you're the Doctor from Rhodes Island...? Thank you for what you did. I'll pay for my treatment in time. Otherwise, I'd like to be on my own for now.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I'm a fast learner, don't worry.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: So this is how it feels... to hold my life in my own hands.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: This isn't the first time someone saves my life. But, if I had a chance to get back to those barrens, a chance to weigh up what's behind those helping hands again, I would choose to starve to death there. Doctor, I've been thinking... how nice it would've been, if you were there offering your hand instead.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I trust your judgment. You won't lead me astray.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: If I make any mistakes, please point them out to me.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Things are different. I don't want to hide myself any longer.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: It's them, right?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What is it?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'm listening.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: In time, I'll find the right place for myself too.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: This is the position, right?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I'm aware of what I'm doing.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I know what it is I want.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I obey my own heart.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You've gone astray.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: That's one more step in the right direction, isn't it?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Someday in the future, I'll have as clear a direction as you do.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We have a few runaways. A little like I once was.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: This isn't happening, don't abandon me... Doctor, where are you?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Are you interested in my instruments? I can teach you how to play.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ah! Doctor... that's dangerous.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: If I leave someday, you'll send me off, won't you?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Such pretty fireworks... I used to think they were too far away, but here I am today, watching them lit below me. A single firework's just a tiny little thing, but there it goes, flying into the sky, blossoming into flowers so bright. Doctor, is that something I can aspire to?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I heard the sound of your footsteps, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: So today's your birthday... I don't even remember my own. Does my record in Medical note what day I was saved? I want that day to be my birthday. Doctor, I'll spend the day with you, so when my birthday comes, would you spend it with me?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: They told me I was meant to be an assassin, twisted my life onto a path it never should've taken. But they never even gave me a reason, and I did far too much I never should have done. You've given me a new lease on life, and I'll be sure to use it well.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Ehi, Doctor, got anything fun to do?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Tsk, goddamn peppers... I gotta find a way to make them disappear from the canteen forever.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I heard Yanese got some old sayings similar to 'Catch the moment'. Heh, the line I like. Don't you think it suits me very well? The future? Meh, I'll let Aosta chew on those sorts of things.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Oi, Doctor, don't just sit there all day. Why don't we have some fun, like… remodeling your whole office?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Aosta once said I wouldn't live long like this. At the time, I told him, what's the point of long life if I can't do what I want?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Fight for what you want, snatch what you like. I don't know the meaning of the word 'Surrender'!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I think up what to do, Aosta thinks up how to do it, and Broca makes sure we get it done together. That's how we've always gotten by, and it's how we ended up here.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, what are you doing all frowny-faced over there? If there's anything weighing on you, just lay it on me. I'm good at that sort of stuff.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Say, Doctor, if someday you decide to quit running Rhodes Island, why not come along with us? Chiave doesn't take orders from anyone, but in your case, I'll make an exception.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Ehi, Doctor... You fell asleep? Whatever, I'll be back later.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Yo, are you the Doctor? Hello, and well met. The name's Chiave. Starting today, I'm your goon!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Whoa-ho-ho... Hey Aosta, check this out! Give me a moment and I'll be even stronger than these guys!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Huh? Promotion? What do you mean?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Incredible. There are just too many interesting people here at Rhodes Island. How am I supposed to just stay in my seat? I've gotta get stronger and stronger!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Ha, here we go!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Listen up, everyone, I have a plan!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Haha, let's go make some noise!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Just gotta knock 'em all down, right?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Still not my turn yet?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: C'mon, don't make me yawn.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I can't wait any longer!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Haha, I'm gonna end you all!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Take this!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Hey! Why are you running?!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Yeah, yeah, you've all done a great JOB!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I'm on FIRE!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Hah, now this is the fun stuff!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Ah. Where's the challenge in that, Doctor?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Huh? I left a few? Never even saw 'em.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Shit, for real?!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: ello, bruthas and sistahs!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What is it?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Yo, Doctor, you're in a pretty good mood.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor! Aosta, Broca, and I have a new New Year's plan. Heh heh, once I tell you, you're in on the game. We're going to swap out all the chocolate sauce in the canteen for Siracusan meat sauce, then— Huh? Doctor, where are you going?! Don't you tell Dr. Kal'tsit!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Ehi Doc, did you have a good meal?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Ehi, Doctor, Happy birthday! Ta-dah— Check out this model car. I made it myself. It's yours now. Truth be told, if the conditions were right, I would've built you an actual car. Well, I guess that's a promise. Doctor, come visit me in Siracusa sometime and I'll trade this for a real car.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island's got all these heavies, plus smart people like you. One day, someday, I'm gonna do something big that'll rock the whole world! At the very least, I'll do it before I die! Uh, I should try to stay alive...? I guess you're right, haha…

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Alright, Doctor, your tarot card for today is...

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Would you like to learn more about your future?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Bear it in mind that excessive reliance on unfathomed power will eventually backfire on us.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Tarot cards aren't divine, all-seeing tools. Instead, we use them for guidance when we feel lost.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Destiny is like the world we walk upon—no one can escape it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Humans might never be able to escape this world... but we can change it. Our actions belie endless possibilities.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: There are countless topics for which you can consult the tarot, the most common one being your luck in card games. To change it, however, you must be brave enough to change your fate first.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: We have a ritual among diviners that's all the rage these days. We call it the 'Hand of Fate.' Would you like to try it?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: It's a divination taboo to do readings concerning death. But I don't believe death is the end—it's the beginning of something new.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Dreams can often enlighten you in strange ways. If you have an enlightening dream like that, you'd best remember every detail, Doctor.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Following the guidance of the arcana, our paths have finally converged. Nice to meet you, Doctor.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I feel inspired now.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I'd already foreseen this promotion in my crystal ball. Heheh, just kidding.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: You want to know your destiny, Doctor? Too bad, I can't help you. I'm not the one to share it with you, for the fate forbids me to do so.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Wait a minute, let me predict the results of this battle.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Well then, let me pray for everyone.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Fate is a fickle thing... only the victorious will be forever revered.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I can see the outcome. Victory belongs to Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: A very wise choice.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: My turn.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Draw a card.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Do not resist your fate.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: The tower of void.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: The flying chariot.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: The Emperor's scepter shall break.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: All will fall before the Priestess's might.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Will fate have us in a chokehold… or will we turn the table?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I have moved all of them to the graveyard.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Time to reshuffle the deck.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Impossible... this isn't what I saw in the cards...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Bad omens seem to lurk inside this room. May I use my powers to help you manage them?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hm? What can I do for you?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Want me to do a reading on your future? All right, please give me a minute.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy new year, Doctor. I bet you are eager to learn your fortune this year from me, aren't you? I have, truth be told, stolen a peek into it. My divination was reliable, as always. Still, only by unveiling the fate's mask with your own hands will you discover what lies beneath, don't you agree? No need to worry, I will be there to help you.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, you're blessed by the winds of luck.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. As my birthday gift for you, I will answer any one question from you about the future. Yes, anything will be fine. I would like to remind you though, that I don't offer this knid of chance everyday, so think twice before you ask.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: There's no preordained path where one shall walk, nor predestined fate which one shall suffer. And everyone on Rhodes Island has proved that many, many times. Here, Doctor, Peek into the crystall ball. As long as your heart is not shadowed by the clouds, you will see the light of hope at the end of the haze.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: A little fowlie says you want me for your job supervisor? You asked for it, then. No bunking off.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: What's that? Bit of a din? Sorry about that, treacle. We work as we chat, we do. Say, did Feist ever mention? I can't sing a lullaby to save me life. We're all out building Londinium, keeping it going day and night, and meanwhile our little ones are nodding off to the clinking of our hammers.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You don't believe it, do you, when I say the kids here can't get enough of me? I talk about me metalworking, that's all, and they gawp like I'm straight out of fairyland. Got a few Sarkaz eyeing me like a ghost, too... Bet you anything they saw what we could rustle up in Londinium.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Rummaging scrap from the tip, forging a thing or two out of it, it's pretty run-of-the mill. Plenty of us did that for fun during job training, I know I did. You hammer down at first and 'BANG!', and you think to yourself, heaven almighty, what if someone hears me? But soon enough, you're going hammer and tong just to get it finished. See, now you know how we felt making the walkers.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Our Speaker's got a gorgeous name, you know, Vina Victoria. Right pain of a signature! I can see her practicing now. She asked me one time, get this, 'do you want a seat in Parliament?' But I think I'd rather stay in the factories, keep an eye on the kinds of acts she's signing in. She bloody well knows we're watching.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Treacle, I've nothing to hide. You'd find it crap too, having to shelter in your own city. The first step was working with everyone I could. Get them to safety, made more arms in secret, more munitions to fight back. Carried on until every factory was in on it. Luckily, some people did us a massive favor with their agendas. Reunion, you know plenty about them, right? I want to hear.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I need to thank you, Doctor, you did more than I ever guessed. If the airship hadn't fallen, we wouldn't be here now having tea. And while we're at it, I appreciate you not calling an old foundrywoman a 'war hero' for driving a walker. Let's be clear: us workers never wanted to be fighting the war.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Pardon me boy Feist. He's got inventions on the brain, and not much in the way of people skills. Got a bit of a ways to go. Lucky he's still alive to invent Londinium something new... That's not what really matters, though, I just thank the stars he survived at all.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I'm getting on. Even without the Oripathy, my time's coming up, and I'm fine with that. Mind if I have a smoke...? Odds are, I'll be gone before I can hammer out the Londinium I remember. So be it. For each of us old bastards that kicks it, the city's frees up for a youngen.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Don't nod off here. If you want good rest, you sleep when you're meant to. Do things when you should, keep it to a rhythm, alright, treacle?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Save your hospitality, Doctor. I'm only checking in me grandson here. I'll park myself in your office for a bit, give him time to hide all his gadgets… Huh, don't constipate yourself either, just say the word if Rhodes Island wants a favor done.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Doctor, how many of you made it back safe and sound?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Now what's the point in decorating this old rust bucket? I suppose she could bang out a shinier medal for you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: The war had us Londiniers all hammering away on the same line. It might be over now, but we're still thick as thieves. You've won the trust of a good lot, and I think you can imagine their power.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: The old machine's getting on a bit, but she still runs as fine as ever.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Sure. I'll be watching this lot.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Keep your wits about ya. Even a factory machine can bite your finger right off.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Nothing to fear. We're here now. We're standing firm. We will win.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What do you need?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Got the ol' girl ready to work.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Here as planned.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: What? We've got secret tunnels of our own.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Brighter on the furnace!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Get that steam rising!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Cover your ears!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Victory to every Londinier!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: They say quenching makes or breaks steel, but without all the hammering first, you'll never get the good stuff. Haha, not half bad, Doctor.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The grander the machinery, the tighter the little parts need to mesh. All credit to you, Doctor. You know how to make a squad tick.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The most precise tools aren't free from error, and sometimes we have to accept defects. Don't look back, Doctor. What matters is planning the next step.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: *cough*, *cough* *hack*... Did you really think it through, eh?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Whoo… Is all of this your little Closure girl's nonsense?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Need a hand with something?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doesn't smell of motor oil here. I'll have to get used to that.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It's rare to hear the factories go quiet like this in Londinium. Even the snow can fall without being melted by steam. War's over now. Even if the snow's not as white, I'm sure people can feel that it's a fresh start. For those who have made it through the war, there's no better blessing than that.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Don't stretch yourself too thin, Doctor. I've spied with my little eye, Amiya worrying for you.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: What, you think I didn't bake this cake? It's a little fancy-pants, but I'll have you know, it's me who does up all of Feist's birthdays. It's like working a machine: practice makes perfect. So, happy birthday, Doctor, and thank you and your lot for looking after me boy.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Time's the most honest thing there is. Your manifesto won't prove anything. The tracks you leave on the earth, that's what matters… Not that you need me teaching you. I see that part of you, Doctor. The part that's always here to stay.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: All done now. Um… do you mind if I read my manga here?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: A-ah. I'm just not cut out for real life relationships… On SNS, all I gotta do is send a request to make friends. Reality is such a nightmare.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Utage was my classmate in middle school, and the one who introduced me here. We're… friends, I guess, but Doctor, be warned, riajuus are terrifying!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Eh? Why send messages when we're face to face? Uh, cuz, you know, it's easier that way…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Back in Higashi, I saw Koga election vans on the street a bunch. Their representative is kinda hot... Um, but I don't understand much about that whole side of things, so usually I just voted whatever.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My family says that we all came out of the sea onto dry land forever ago, and that's how we settled down. Would I wanna go back into the sea? Mmnn... honestly, I don't really care.  As long as they don't get Oripathy, life's pretty good in Higashi.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: There's some trouble lately. I hear things between us and the Kougon guys up north are getting heated again. This sucks... I wonder if their latest games will make it through…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Um… Doctor, do you think my hobbies are weird or anything? When I was young, the other kids would make fun of me, calling me gross and gloomy. Hmph. Who cares what they said, I certainly don't.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctoooor! I'll lend you this game, this manga, and this CD! They're masterpieces that I handpicked, so once you go through them, we'll be otaku buddies for life! We will have so much to talk about. If you're into other genres, just say the word. Better yet, just come over and pick something you like.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Not now, pal, I'm busy right here! Just one more hit... one more hit and he's down! Perfect! Got the rare drop!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Kirara. Nice to meet you... Uh… um… If you don't need anything else, can I leave?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Wow, that's cool… Uhhhh, the ultimate's name's kinda cringe though.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? As in a job promotion? Ugh, a middle management job is gonna kill me.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I just want to thank everyone for, uh, sticking by me all this time. I realize that, uh some things are better… said in person than by text... So, um, I guess... Tha-that's all I want to say! Thank you!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: If you want a support, maybe I can help out… I guess.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: ...Huh? Me? Captain? Really? Are you serious?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Alright. Begin quest.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Ah. Look over there. Enemy came right out of the tall grass.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Whuh? Started already?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Hfff... ha…

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Oh boy, I'm kinda nervous.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Woah, the mangas do not lie.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Feels like I'm smurfing here.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Just like this, right? Okay.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Give me five minutes.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Wait… That move was pretty awesome, huh?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Uso! I've seen no-damage runs, but this is on a whole new level!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission Accomplished. Phew… it's done.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Aaarrnngh, missed, darn. No save scumming in real life. I guess…

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: That's it, time to remake.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: If it's an option, I'd like to just stay in my room forever…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Whah! Aaaahh, wrong button... this round is lost.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Oh, hey, Doctor. What? Got an action game you want me to take over?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: First off, please do not invite me to anything today without a good reason. Nothing's wrong, it's just…urgh, you wouldn't get it—the terror of having to say Happy New Year to strangers at a party. Besides, I've decided to just dorm it up and play games all day. You're always welcome by the way, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good stuff in the login rewards today.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy Birthday, got you a dedicated pager. Just press this button and mine will light up. It also works vice-versa. Hehe. This way, you can reach me whenever you want a game buddy! Um, friends do this with each other, right? This is, like, a normal friend thing?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: As an Infected, I get to live a stable life, and I can still read manga and play games outside of work… I never thought a fantasy like this could come true. Maybe there are more dreams that I can make real… Say, Doctor, let's take on the world, together.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'm to assist you? One moment, then. I'll go and change into more appropriate uniform... What? No need?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I'll be honest, even now I'm not used to life with my mask off—it always feels like there's something missing from my face. Still, it seems I can operate freely in daylight now. Please, give me more daytime missions, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The combat style the Felynes have taught me is like nothing I've known before. Unbroken strings of attacks as a defense, swift evasive maneuvers, different styles combining to achieve completely differing effects... Even though I've been training day and night, I still can't say I've mastered it.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: These clothes have your attention, Doctor? They confused me just as much when I first put them on—they have a startling defensive capacity, despite their obvious design. How it's achieved is completely beyond me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: There's a strange force in these dual blades. They attack with thunder, but without the use of Arts... Is it the materials that cause it? I was definitely more proficient with my old katana... but when it comes to protecting us all, I'll shy away from no weapon.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The Felynes never cease to mention monsters even more fearsome than Rathalos—the kind that could bring about Catastrophe-scale disasters with the flap of a wing. If Rhodes Island ever faced such a threat... no. After all we've been through, I wouldn't fear an enemy like that anymore.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Though I've changed my loadout and gained new skills, I'm still the same Yato you know. Just give the order, and I'll take on whatever role Rhodes Island needs of me, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Noir Corne's always been this way, fussing over minor details, dragging down the mission. Still, I admit he's occasionally helpful... okay, a little more than occasionally. The point is, I don't hate him.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Operators are often worried about the way I do things, wondering if I'm putting myself in harm's way. Honestly, the concern's unnecessary. Thinking too much on my situation would only slow me down, but when it comes to what my friends are going through, trust me, I will care.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: It seems you need some rest, Doctor. You can try this, if you want. It's a Felyne blend of a remedial plant they call Sleep Herb and some kind of mushroom. I hear it works very well, sleep-wise.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hey, Doctor. That's right, it's me. Op Team A4 Captain Yato, back and reporting in. As for where I got all this new equipment, you have the whole story from me in the mission debrief.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hold on, I had notes on the locale. Let me find them...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Whatever role I'm in, I'll bring everything I have.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Another medal for me? I'd love to wear them, but I don't think this outfit has anywhere for them to go. Still, thank you, Doctor.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Leave it to me, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Alright, it's in my hands now. The success of our mission is assured.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Target confirmed. They won't know what hit them.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Op Team A4 Yato in position.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Standing by…

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Finally, am I up?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Engaging.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: So that's our target?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Hnf! Haah!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: That all you got?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Flurry!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Fight or flee, it's no use!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: We owe this victory to your fine command. I still have a long way to go.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Take victory as a whetstone to hone the cutting edge.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Was this your mercy? Understood.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: This falls on me. You make a retreat, and grant me one more attempt.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I'd like more dangerous or challenging work, but if these are your orders, I'll gladly accept, Doctor.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What is it, Doctor? Intrigued by the materials for this outfit?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Oh, hey, Doctor. I guess I'm not used to dropping the mask after all.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: UNUSED

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey, Doctor. You're the same as ever. I wonder if I'm any better than I used to be?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Could you drop me from field missions for the day, if that's alright? Noir Corne says he's got plans, see...

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: UNUSED

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: It's not the duty of a guard to stand here and do nothing. Why don't we chat a bit?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: With perfect positioning and a suitable environment, my letters will arrive just fine. After all, it's my job, right? I need to do well to survive.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Are you hungry? If you want something to eat, just say the word. I can't compete with Matterhorn in the kitchen, but I can at least cook a decent meal.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The comms equipment here at Rhodes Island is way too good. At this rate, I'm going to lose my job...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Anything else you need? Just don't keep me on the line for too long.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Huh? There's a faint smell on the letters? No, you must be imagining things.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I owe my life to Master SilverAsh. If necessary, I would do anything for him.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You want me to transport... all these? That's a lot, Doctor! Come on, I'm not a miracle worker!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Seems I'm no match for you. I suppose it's time to retire my business smile for now... *Ahem*... I'd like to show you my true face, from now on.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, there's a new message for... Ah, never mind.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Esteemed Leader of Rhodes Island, your ally—Courier of the Snow Realm—is here at your service. If you get into any sort of trouble during your contract with Master SilverAsh, just snap your fingers and I'll be there.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
