voices.text: Whoa, that's an incredible job well done.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: You'd save a lot of trouble if you sent me onto the battlefield.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: As a Messenger of the Snow Realm, I'm sure to appear whenever you need me.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Leave the scouting to me.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I won't blemish the name of the Snow Realm.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Too bad some people just can't live and let live.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: They'll pay for what they've done.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: At your service.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Your orders.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Mhmm.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Forwards!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Attack!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: How's that?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Haaaghh!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Speeding up!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I'll bring news of our victory to Rhodes Island right away!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Let's grab a nice dinner after we clean up the battlefield. My treat!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Anyone injured? I've got medicine and bandages.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Let's get out of here first. Here, this way! Hurry!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I'll greet my roommates and neighbors first.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: How can I help?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Alright, I'll whip up a meal for you later.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, I've brought you some food from Kjerag to celebrate the New Year. They're still warm, so would you like to try...? Are they to your taste? D—Don't eat so many! The beastmeat isn't that easy to digest!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Call me whenever you need me.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! I have a present for you. You'd like to open it now? How about guessing what's inside first? Mm-hm... Correct, it's a scent sachet! I hope when you're carrying it around, you can feel as though I'm by your side.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: It was Master SilverAsh's choice to partner with Rhodes Island, but I believed in his decision. And my days at Rhodes Island have proven not only how right he was, but also how trustworthy you are.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Last time I was an assistant, I think I was still thirteen or fourteen, treating people with my mum. Of course, I can do much more than hand out herbals and sing well-wishing verses now. If you need my help, ask away! Don't be shy.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I think I've seen a few new faces this time after returning to Rhodes Island. Dr. {@nickname}, how does it feel to have more and more people under you? Do you feel that brimming and bursting vitality? We always say back home, rage against death with new life.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Rhodes Island Bridge-Climbing Competition? Dr. Kal'tsit shut that down midway, didn't she? Citing lack of safety ropes for all the contestants and so on. Well, I wasn't that likely to win it, and the look on Dr. Kal'tsit's face was a much greater sight to see anyway.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You look put out with all these reports on your desk. Don't worry, if there's any danger, I'll know it by the scent. But! If you just don't want to work, I can't help you there.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Of course it's much easier to gather intel when you're a lone operator. But every time I'm in the country, I pick a bag full of berries while I'm free, and I think to myself, maybe I want someone to share with after all. Otherwise, I've got no one to tell me how great I am at picking.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: You get the sense I served from how I work? You only got that impression from seeing my files. Service members come in all shapes and sizes, too. Some only like to read and research their comms tech, some spend all day dreaming about going on holidays in the city to see idol concerts...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, you might be covering your face, but I can tell you've perked up a lot more compared to when you came back from Chernobog. But if you spend the whole time under this low of a ceiling, your mind'll get dull. Head out onto the deck every now and then. Get some fresh air. It's good for you.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: When I looked after the ill back home, I ran across a couple Infected calling themselves 'Reunion'... and then I got into a fight with them. I can't stand it, seeing those children with firelight in their eyes lost in all the pointless violence, about to burn themselves through.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Those who depart us receive the land's forgiveness, and rest in her embrace... but some people go too quickly, the roots of the forests of their homes unable to hold onto their hands. Was that not like me, being so serious? You really should've seen me when I worked back home.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Not sure if the Doctor's a light sleeper... I'd better stand watch quietly.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor. Call me Quercus. It's the first time we've met, but the intel on your desk about northern Victoria is straight from me... What, even you're going to tell me my reports aren't standard?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I wish I'd learned all this a little earlier.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: What's this promotion come out of nowhere for? My candied fruit must make a strong impression.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: In my hometown, you had to make a choice with Originium Arts. Whether to terrorize others, or to aid them... The result of my greed was that I couldn't commit properly to either. Even so, would you still have faith in me?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: As long as it's your decision, I'll have no objections.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: It's a major responsibility.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Shouldn't we consider marching routes other than on the ground?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The more defined a battle's goal is, the clearer tactics become.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Will the land shake with fury, or display her mercy?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: If you're still hesitating, I can give some advice.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I will stand guard here.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Beginning collection of battlefield information.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: The land will forgive all in the end, but not now.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: The wind blows through; the leaves tell stories of those who sleep.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Arbor, reach your hands to me.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I remember your face as well, now.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Wow, incredible! I've got the urge to snap a formal salute just to show my respect.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: That was a perfect operation! Once we're back, dinner will taste even better.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: They can't be running far. Do you plan to pursue?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: It's alright, let me organize the retreat. I leave our next counterattack to you.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It always feels a little hard to catch my breath when I'm shut in here for long.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh? Are you as much of a prank-lover as all those kids?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You want to hear me sing? Do you know who our songs are sung for? Usually, it's for the gravely ill.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! I've brought candied berries, canned home-style sandworms, and some rose-filled flower biscuits, all specialties from Victoria. Pick out what takes your fancy, Dr.{@nickname}? My homebrewed fruit wine's done fermenting too, so you'll want to taste as soon as you can, or else your share will be gone before you know it!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You're back here in your office again, Dr. {@nickname}. Have you refreshed your body and mind well?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Dr.{@nickname}. One look at the floral mess on your desk shows me your operators don't speak the language of flowers. Doctor, would you like to know their meaning? How about I give you a flower of my own here, and you listen carefully?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: New buds break through the soil, and tender flowers blossom from vines, while those branches that have grown shelter and surround them, protecting them from the elements. Whether Rhodes Island, or back home, that is always what I hope to be—like the branches, a shelter for the young children.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'm not so good at desk work, but if all you need is someone to stay by your side and help you arrange your tasks and schedule... I can give it a shot, perhaps.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: This pocket watch? My father gave it to me before he left home. It's nothing fancy, but it keeps time if you keep the movement and dial maintained… Uh, Doctor, is there anyone at Rhodes Island who can fix watches?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Out in the field, you can leave the cooking to me. That's what they had me doing back in the Columbian barrenlands. I can't promise, you know that, it's gonna taste very good… But at least it won't give you a stomachache.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Back when I was with the Pioneer Team, the company left us undersupplied, and we did not take that sitting down. We ended up escaping into the barrelands. That's when I got this scar on my eye. It's not a disgrace, but it's not a badge of honor either. It's just the kind of bad luck that us regular Columbians deal with all the time. Mine's just a little more obvious than others.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Planning your time and planning your life couldn't be more different. When you're eking out a living, you've got no choice but to use every last second. Even when you space out, you have to keep an eye on the clock. On the other hand, to plan out your life, you need enough time to think and feel. Those aren't contradictory. It's just the second one's more of a luxury to most people.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Is my sword heavy? You bet it is. But I need a heavy one to protect my friends and defend our overdue freedom. The truer the weight I carry is, the mightier I can wield it... And when I'm hurt, it also comes in handy as a walking stick.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: When my mother died, I didn't even get to mourn her. I had a huge pile of medical debt waiting for me to pay off. Why did I join the Pioneer Team, and why did I become a merc? It's not like I had other options. But I came to Rhodes Island after giving it serious thought.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: A free mercenary only takes a mission she thinks is worth the time. There was this one night when I was sitting by the fire, affixing some beast teeth to my sword. My friends were sleeping, and the only sound in the air was my watch ticking away. Time is always on my mind, but that was the first time I really felt its passing.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The mercenary crew I joined was doomed to disband, sooner or later. Without a clear goal and strict discipline, you can't survive in the wilderness… Maybe only an organization like Rhodes Island can really protect what's beautiful out there. I'm thankful that I could come here.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, if you don't need anything from me, I'll just zone out here for a bit... Feel free to talk to me anytime you need me.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. I'm Quartz... I think I'm on time.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I wish our squad could've fought like this back there.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thanks for your recognition, but remember to tell me if there's anything I can improve on.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Rhodes Island's promotion process and standards are pretty transparent. That's not easy to do.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Hope I can help.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Don't worry. I think my decisions through.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I propose we begin our operation at the top of the hour. It'll be easier to keep track of time.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Hide, and make sure to put out the cooking fire.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Doctor, I'm in position.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Sheathe my weapon for the time being? Then my sword…

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Perfect timing!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: A bit late, not a big problem.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Time your strike. It's more important than brute strength.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Keep your distance. I only want to strike the enemy.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You're staring at my eyepatch, it reveals a lot.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Take this!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: When every phase of the mission proceeds with watchlike precision, victory is assured.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: This is worth celebrating... When we get back to Rhodes Island, we won't have to eat my cooking anymore.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Even the most accurate of watches isn't always accurate. Don't be so fixated on perfection

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Sorry, Doctor, we had a few problems with the plan because my watch is broken. Go, and leave the rest to me.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This is much more comfortable than a tent in the wilderness... Will someone stand watch at night?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh, Doctor. What's the matter?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Let's space out together, Doctor. We can chill for as long as we need... No need to watch the clock like we used to.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, Happy New Year. Hey, do me a favor and watch the length of your New Year's speech. Everyone is waiting to cut the cake.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. Careful. You almost bumped into my sword.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Here's a pocket watch... Of course, it's not my own. And it's not one of those collectibles the Columbian businessmen like. You may not need something like this to show off, but you can use it to check the time.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: If I hadn't come across Rhodes Island, would I still be wandering the wilderness by myself, or would I have returned to the city to face the music...? I don't know, but I don't need the answer, either. I stand with you and Rhodes Island now.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Here I am! What should we play, baseball or board games? Oh, you're working?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Where was I born, you ask? Well, umm...no idea. But that doesn't matter, right?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Hello, Professor Rhodes Island! Wait, am I calling you by the right name?...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Hm, what's my assignment today? To capture some long, sleek animals?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Hey! Don't knock on my backpack! Oh, sorry, I'm not mad, I'm just worried. If you're not careful, you could hurt your hand! Here, let me show you how it's done.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: If anyone dares to hurt you, I'll smash them with my baseball bat. Oh, uh... so... there really are people who hurt you? Um... actually, I'm not that good at fighting, hehe…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I love spending the whole day just walking down the street. I get to watch the people, enjoy the sunshine, and then… lose my way!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You've been treating my sickness, and you gave me a place to live... you're really so kind...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, are you my big brother? Or big sister?... Well, does't matter! I'm not leaving you, even if you throw me out! It's not like I can walk far anyway.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Oh, the Doctor is busy. I'll just play by myself then...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hm? Where am I? Who am I?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I can make myself super tough! It's my only special skill!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion? What's a promotion?... Whatever, let's play for a bit longer! You and me, together!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: New position or not, I don't really care. All I want is to be by your side every day. Can you grant this tiny wish of mine?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I've got lots of friends here!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Everybody, let's go!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: We'll be fine if we stick together!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Everyone, let's play!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm here~!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Doctor!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Ora ora!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Hey, dummies, bring it on!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Muda muda muda muda!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: C'mon, show me what you got!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: This is my playground!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I won't back down!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Was that tough? Didn't feel much different from any other battle.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Homerun!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Safe!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Aww... struck out…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Just don't throw fireballs at me, okay?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Wow, fun!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Hey Doctor! Can we play a little bit longer? Just a little bit!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy new year, Doctor! I'm looking for the place I was first found. It's somewhere around on the deck. Was it here… or there?... Hm? Why am I looking for it? Because I was actually having a cozy nap when you guys found me. The sunshine was so warm... And I want to take a nap like that again! Hehe...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Heya! Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Hey, hey, Doctor! Happy birthday! These are for you: this baseball bat, these mitts, and this baseball! Come on, let's play!... You still got work to do? You're working on your birthday? Can't you take a day off? Aww…

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Hehe, they're all busy having fun outside! I'm gonna pack up my bag a little, then get out and return with cool stuff loaded on my back! What's in my bag? A baseball, pair of mitts, and… Doctor, just between you and me, and promise to keep it from the Medical Department—I also got some snacks in there!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hello, Doctor! You hungry? Heehee, I heard your stomach growling from a mile away! It sounded like thunder!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: My shield? I can lift it easy! One, two, lift! Hehe, see? Oh, Relax, Doctor. I'm not gonna drop it or anything. You don't have to stand all the way over there.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The bad guys who destroyed my hometown are gonna pay! I'll smash them with my frying pan!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Zima says she'll protect me, but I'm not a baby! Me and my shield kept everyone safe before we made it here! It's not a shield, it's a vault door? No it isnnnn't! I can't believe you're calling it that!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, you wanna taste my cooking? Hehe, you can try it soon. I've already asked Closure if I can work the cafeteria! Just waiting to hear back.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Tadaaah! Here comes Gummy's specialty: bacon and eggs! So, do you like it? It's tough to get the heat right when I'm out in the field, but most days I can make it perfect!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Me and the other four weren't always together, you know.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Why am I always so cheery? Umm, actually... After the things we've seen, it's hard to be cheery... But I really want my friends to forget about all that awful stuff. So I need to pull myself together and smile a whole bunch to make that happen!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I... I miss my parents, and I do want to find them. I think about them all the time... but if I leave now, I don't think I could do anything by myself... So... Doctor, could you please teach me how to fight? I don't want everyone to think of me as some kind of kitchen girl!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Are you sleeping, Doctor? Hmm, maybe a bit of reading here would be okay, I guess?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: My name's Gummy! You must be the Doctor. Thank you and everyone from Rhodes Island for helping us! I don't have any special skills, but I'll do what I can as good as I can!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I can feel my power surging! I might even be able to lift you up, Doctor!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I'll become a three-star Rhodes Island chef after the promotion, right? Just kidding! Hehe.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I want to do much, much more besides cooking! I don't know if I'm strong enough to do everything you want me to, but I'll give it my all!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Gummy, ready to go!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Что?! You're making me the leader?!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Just wait for us to get back, Doctor!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Nope, I'm not scared!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Let me do it!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Pick me! Pick me!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'm ready to fight!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll protect everyone!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Try some of my specialty!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Here's something yummy for you!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Anyone hungry?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Push forward, team! Ura!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: The bad guys should just give up! With the Doctor on our side, they'll never beat us!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I didn't want to have to do that… but if we don't fight, the bad guys will get us!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We won, and that's what matters! It's a good thing!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Ughh… did anybody get hurt…? Doctor? Is the Doctor okay?!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Wow, what a big room! You could get so many people in here!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ahahahahah!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, I know my food tastes great, but don't eat too much of it! You'll get fat!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, I've been busy all day today in the kitchen. Zima went out to do something early this morning, and Rosa's still busy decorating the hall. Even though we all promised to make New Year's dinner together... Istinaaaa! You can't set off fireworks inside!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, you want something to eat?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Afternoon, Doctor... a big crowd kept me in the kitchen late last night, I had to make cakes in all different flavors... But I got the tastiest one I made right here. Happy birthday, Doctor! Say aahh—

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor! Come try the piroshki I baked! They're even tastier than before, right? Heheh, I'm growing up too, you know. And then Mama and Papa, and Zima and all my friends won't have to worry about me. I'm going to get even stronger!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'll be quietly modifying the Raythean Franker over here. You can focus on your work. I won't disturb you.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Why does everyone always keep their distance from Blue Poison? I don't get it... She and I are both special? Umm, alright.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Anything you want to say, Doctor? No? Okay. I'll be here. You can chat with me anytime.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I always lose my appetite when the dorm is too hot... Oh, don't worry about it. It's a family thing, I'm not actually complaining.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Why did I come to Rhodes Island? If I could run as I pleased on these legs, I wouldn't have left my homeland.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Vulcan and I have a similar distaste for 'old things,' but I still think we have fundamentally different philosophies.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: So, Doctor, Blue Poison says I always seem to be hiding something. Do I really give people that impression? Sometimes? How…?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: It's not that I don't want to talk, it's just that I never got my way much before. So I'm not used to speaking up. Hope you won't take it the wrong way, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Two memories stand out to me. One is the first time I ran with this exoskeleton. My eyes went wide and all was right with the world. As for the other... That would have to be right here, right now at Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Umm? When did the Doctor fall asleep...?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Operator Glaucus reporting for onboarding. So… may I go back to my room now?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hmm… Okay, I see. I got it now.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I named the weapon, actually. Maybe it represents what I really want in life... Huh? Did they just announce my name for promotion?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Trust in others… Well, I don't know what to do to make them feel trusted, but I'll keep trying.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Everyone, remember your grounding measures.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: What? I'm the captain? Did I sign up without realizing it?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I wonder what interesting things we'll find this time…

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: EMP, ready to fire.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hm? You call for me?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Fully charged and ready to go.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: The feeling of standing on dry land…

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Landed, safe and sound.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Maximum output!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Can't worry about accidents now…!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Amplifying microwave frequency!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Time to fall!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: No hostile movement detected. Please check your status, team.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: No active enemy signals. EMP disabled. Nice work, team.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Some enemies have escaped. Should we give chase?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: EMP disabled. We'd better call for backup quick.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: No problem, just need to find that screw first…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh… sorry, my mind was wandering.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Mind taking a walk with me, Doctor?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, Happy New Year. Present? I haven't thought about it... Oh, actually, I've been hoping to get a fair allowance for battle damage... but I've never had the guts to raise it with Dr. Kal'tsit.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning to you, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday. I have a compass here from my collection. It's for you. Technology keeps marching on, but some stuff still keeps a classic form factor. Isn't that wonderful...? Oh, sorry, I got a little off-track. Anyway, may you never lose your way, on your forward course.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Being able to run again is such a blessing—I'll never forget what Rhodes Island has done for me. Now I want to help everyone by my own power too, but it still seems like I get in the way more than anything... I'll keep on trying, though. So that someday, I really can be of help to you all.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You want me at your side to see if Rhodes Island can live up to the talk. Hmm... Alright then, so long as your security doesn't give me too much trouble.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Life in the Truckers Mutual Aid Association? We drive, we deliver, we drink, we mess around and have a good time. Nobody bares their fangs in Nuova Volsinii... But as my mentor once said, the Fangs will never truly disappear.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: At first, I couldn't get used to pizza and spaghetti. My mentor was the one who taught me to mix finsauce into spaghetti, and replace the salsiccia on pizza with bacon. Had to find a way to fit in with the wolfpack, she said. So, I've eaten like this through all my years in Siracusa. Why? Because it tastes alright.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Truth and Justice... That's the book my father used to read to me when I was little. He even took me to meet the author, who was later imprisoned by some duke, died in jail, and was buried in a mine. Pretty awful, no? But that's how things were, at the time.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My father said that Sergei would become the greatest of all scientists, even if he was born in Ursus. I thought they were friends, partners, and kindred spirits... Yet Sergei stabbed them all in the back. He deserved to die, but I also doubt whether the blame was his alone.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Where did I learn to fight? From my mentor. She taught me to turn hatred into power, but not to hate. She taught me to fight, but not to step onto the battlefield... What a strange 'wolf' she was. Too bad I didn't figure out her final lesson sooner.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Director Kal'tsit, Dr. Kal'tsit. No matter what hat she wears, she's still her same, cold-blooded self. Yet, I do find it believable that she didn't betray my father. Maybe she's not as ruthless as she looks, after all. Hmm, what do you think, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: In all the time I stood behind Talulah, I watched her crush dream after dream, morphing into our very own tyrant... That was my mistake, and one I will not make again... Kill her? No. What I want is to tear off the tyrant's crown.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You've united many under your banner. This is familiar to me. I've stood with such people, and also against them... But do beware, leaders like you are known to make grave errors. When you do, I'll look you dead in the eyes, and I won't hesitate—Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: She learned her song by snow, she learned her blade by rain… She learned to show her courage, by fire that swept the plain… She learned to topple crowns, by all the silent pain... Oh, you're awake. No, it's nothing. Just a Siracusan nursery rhyme.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Crownslayer. It's a name we both know well, so let's keep it. Maybe one day you'll come to understand its true meaning.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Old combat records? Got anything with me in it? Come on, let's give it a try. I won't lose this time.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Alright, alright. Enough with the formalities already. I couldn't care less about your little medals and ribbons. Do you take me for some general or noble? Or, would you prefer I test my blade on them?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Rhodes Island chose to trust me, so I'm willing to return that favor. Acceptance speech? Wait, you people aren't really expecting me to give one, are you?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Just give me a target. My smoke will be their grave.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Lead a squad…? Alright. I'm actually curious how you Rhodes Islanders do things.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Move out. Watch the smoke, and don't get separated.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Contact. Everyone, spread out!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: My old methods still work.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: My knife hasn't dulled.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I strike from the smoke.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll slay the crown.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Drink deep of the suffering of the deceased.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Taste the fury of the forsaken.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Hate. It's all you deserve.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Weep. Those will be your last words.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Very well. I'm honored to be part of this victory.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Sound strategies, and outstanding execution. No wonder your operations are so efficient.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The necessary lives have been taken. Mission accomplished.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Smokescreen deployed. Retreat, we'll find another chance later.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Not sending me out on a field mission today? Suit yourself.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Y-You can see me? But, I threw down a smokescreen...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Take off my mask? I'd rather not. Hehe, hard to breathe with all the smoke, right? I keep it on for a reason.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Never imagined I'd be welcoming the New Year on Rhodes Island. But here I am, with all of you… Looks like we've changed a lot. Happy New Year. To you, and to Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Have you been on the ship all day, Doctor? Uh, Me? No, I just happened to be behind you. It's pure coincidence.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: That crown on your head... It's just a prop the operators made for your birthday? Happy birthday to you then. Hehe, don't worry, I won't slay this crown.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Infected or otherwise, there are so many on this land who yearn to live freely and with dignity. Some of them have failed, but so many more are still pressing on. May you continue to move forward with them, Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Reporting in, Doctor! Patrol completed. Nothing out of the ordinary!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I'm starving. That battle really took a lot out of me... You say you've got something to eat? Just for me? Whoa... It's… it's an apple pie! Thanks a lot! It looks great!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Everybody here at Rhodes Island calls me 'Tiny,' but it really doesn't bother me. The boys back on the force always teased me the same way. Hey! Don't pat my head! Or rub my ears! Or squeeze my cheek for that matter!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Doctor, I might not make it to training on Wednesdays or Fridays... Right, I need to be out there helping the civil corps to keep the peace and catch the bad guys! Wh-waht? I have an important mission on Friday?!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Rhodes Island has lots of strong Operators, but there's no one who can match my speed!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Time flies, Dcotor. We've been working together so long. I will never forget anything we've been through. But we can't stop now! We have to keep striving for that bright future, don't we?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I just bumped into Skadi in the hallway... Doctor, you think she's cold and distant, don't you? She's actually very kind. Really!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Compared to everyone else, I'm pretty ordinary. I don't have any superpowers, or spectacular achievements to brag about... But I don't need magic or claws to make the world a better place. I can do that with my own two hands! But before that, we still have to eat well.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, you always worry so much about your people, but you never remember to take care of yourself. You can't do that! No matter what dangers you may face, I promise I'll be there to hold your hand! Definitely, you have my word!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hmm? Why do you smell so good, Doctor? You're definitely hiding something tasty, aren't you?!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Mounted Police Officer Grani, here to answer your call for help! Fear not. From this point forward, I will protect you!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I see. That's another thing I should watch out for. Got it!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: An elite promotion medal? For me? Thank you, Doctor! I'll hang it up with my police medal!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Since the day of my first mission, I've been leaning on this lance to get back on my feet. As long as I grip it tight, my heart will brim with the courage it needs to protect the people and their dreams.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Shall I go scout the battlefield?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You're making me the captain? Okay. I'll protect the whole squad!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: All right, let's bring home a victory!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Your crimes stop here!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Leave it to me!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Sure!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: In position.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Moving out!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: My lance will clear a path!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Set! Ready! Charge on!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Only one comes out on top when the lances are crossed!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: My battlefield extends well above the ground!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: If you look to harm those under my protection, you'll have to go through me first!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Nice! That was an excellent fight! You all did splendidly!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, please stay close to me. There may still be some enemies around.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Damn it... I can't let myself fall here!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Anyone need help here?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Careful!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: If we get the chance, I hope we can see the world together, Doctor.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! It's been another year, and the energy at Rhodes Island gives me the drive to do more things to benefit Terra. Can't do it on an empty stomach though. What are you guys having? Smells good.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I've tried this a few times with the other operators, and it's super fun! Come, get on my back. Ready? 3, 2, 1... go!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: This lance has been with me for a long time. People say I don't use it to its full potential, but I only hope that justice is served wherever my lance can reach. I won't lose to anyone as long as I know I'm fighting for justice.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Aaaahhh! You want me to stay by your side? I can barely keep my heart in my chest!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Fascinating...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Don't mind me, just continue with your work.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Hmm? What am I looking at? Why, you, of course!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: If that's what you ask, Doctor, I will do what it takes to become stronger.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Heheh... You don't need to worry about any ambushes or assassination attempts. Because I'll aaalways be here with you.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Are you finally... a little bit interested in me now? Well, I've always been a big bit interested in you.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Thanks for taking such good care of me these days. By my knighthood of Kazimierz, I hereby pledge to repay your kindness with my life—huh? You're not used to me talking this way? But I'm an honest-to-goodness knight. Surely I can improvise a speech or two.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Ever since I was taken away to Kazimierz, it's rare for someone to be so kind to me. So, if you don't mind, Doctor... I, Gravel—no, I Senomy, on my honor as a knight, shall serve you always at your side.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: When I'm here with you, don't you feel your heart racing?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Mmmwah. Hm? What's wrong? Your face is beet red. That's just how I say hello. Don't think too much about it. Anyway, I'm Gravel, a knight of Kazimierz. It's a pleasure. Heheh.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Are you the one who comes up with all the Rhodes Island's battle tactics, Doctor? Oh~ that's even more intriguing.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: You think I'm doing well, Doctor? Yaay!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: This means you need me, doesn't it? Heheh.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: You want to go together? Hehe...

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Oh~ You chose me!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I'll come with you~

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Hehehe...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Any orders for me?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: This is the place~

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Surely a good spot.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I am your shadow.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Hehehe...

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You really think you'll get away?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Gather up, my rats!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Of course the Doctor's tactics are flawless~

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: My blade hasn't even been stained red yet... hehe...

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Run all you like, Let's see how far you can get.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Sorry... did I... mess up again...?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Hmm, looks like there's a lot of good hiding places here in this room~

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hehehe...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Yes. I'm right here, always and forever.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Give me your hand—mmmwah—hm? What are you so surprised for? Kissing the hands of those we've sworn to protect is how us knights of Kazimierz celebrate the New Year, you know. You've never heard of it? Sounds like you need to pay a little more attention.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: How are you today, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: How daring of you to tear open a gift package with no sender, Doctor. With that little caution, trouble's bound to come knocking sooner or later~ Actually, rather than being on my toes all day as your bodyguard, how about I just open these up for you, hm?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, does it ever keep you up at night... that you might never find any trace of your past again? Whenever I step out onto Rhodes Island's deck, I wonder, would walking away from here bring me any closer to my forgotten memories?... Say, Doctor, don't you know you're supposed to console me, when I bring down the mood like this?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Uh... Doctor, you really need to work out more, you know.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Everyone's really nice here at Rhodes Island. Too nice to prank. Oh, is it time for lunch? I'll help!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Mountaineering's not just a hobby of mine, it's my career! You heard me: career!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The hoop on my leg? Oh, you mean what it's for? It's just for decoration. I've got this crystal over here, see. Wanna touch?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My brother sent Matterhorn to look after me, didn't he…? Ugh, why can't he just come out and tell me what he's thinking? It drives me mad.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I've always wanted to climb the holy Mt. Karlan, and I've only wanted it even more since my sister left us and became the Saintess. So Doctor, train me more, yeah? So one day I can reach the peak of Mt. Karlan and bring my sister home.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: When it comes to Mountaineering, I won't lose to anyone! No one knows these tools better than me. They make great weapons too!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Yeah, Oripathy really changed me. But if I keep wallowing in self-pity, that wouldn't be like me, right? So, no matter what lies in wait in the future... I should continue working hard on my chosen path.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Ah, it's snowing... We Silverashes can't go back to the way we were... I get that. Everything's changed. Only the snow is the same—the same snowflakes that I watched falling back home.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctoooor? Doctooooor! Heeeey! Fine, if you're just gonna sleep, then so be it. Bye-bye!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Cliffheart, and I live to conquer the peaks! It's nice to meet you!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hmm... what a novel experience!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion? Wow! Let's celebrate with some cake. Look, I grabbed these from Logistics. It's fine!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Well, well, you really know what you're doing, Doctor! That's right, I'm really talented. You'd better use my power well!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: All right? I'm feeling motivated! Time to climb all the way to the top!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Eh? You want me to lead? This is all so sudden...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Say goodbye to the reckless Cliffheart. I'm taking things seriously from here on out.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I'll show them what I can do!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Here!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Over here?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Leave it to me!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'm raring to go!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I'veeee got yoooou!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: My hook never misses! I've got this!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Amateurs are doomed to fall to their death!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: For the Silverash name!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: There ain't no mountain too high, no situation too bleak!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Of course we won with me around!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Wow, they sure are good at running away!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Dangit... I messed up...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's so warm here... I'll hang out over here for a while!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: W-wait! Whuah!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I'm gonna teach you all about Mountaineering next time, Doctor! You'll love it, I promise!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year! Look, Doctor, I've prepared all this Mountaineering gear for you. Let's go! Huh? It's still midnight, you say? It's fine! We need to set off earlier so that we can catch the sunrise at the peak.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Mornin', Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Speaking of which, lemme have a look at what my brother gave you! Aww... he's still into this pricey boring ornament stuff. Zero times as practical as my present. Anyway, check this out, Doctor! A choice set of climbing equipment, just for you. Once the weather's good, let's go scale some mountains!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: My brother and sister are still butting heads, but their relationship's smoothed out a bunch, I can feel it. Gotta thank you for melting the ice between them, Doctor. But still, I really wish hanging around home was as chill as being at Rhodes Island…

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, it's such a nice day, so can't we take a little nap?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Hmm...? We're about to leave? But I just got up... Wait, is this the Doctor's office? How'd I get here?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Why am I always squinting? Because I don't want anyone to see my eyes. Nope, nobody~

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I'm really careless and get hurt a lot... But Hibiscus heals me every time, so I'm not afraid of getting injured. Oh gosh, that 'Curing Cuisine' of hers though, I'm terrified of it...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor! Someone left 10 alarm clocks by my bed! Who would do something so awful?!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, let's play a game~ Put an apple on your head and we'll start~

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I'm always looking for fun things to do as a way to ease the pain of my Oripathy, I guess. Plus, I love seeing other people smile~

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: One day, our journey with Rhodes Island will come to an end, and hopefully we'll all get to have a warm, neverending dream, lying in the sunshine~ That's my number one dream~

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Can't believe the Doctor's a heavier sleeper than me...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hi-hiii~ I'm Kroos~ I might be inexperienced, but I'll do the best I can~

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Thank you so much!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion~ What a lovely dream~ Huh? I'm not dreaming?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Umm, where's the rally point?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Huhhh~? Fang would make a better captain than me!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Listen, everyone~! Stay calm~

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Why can't everyone try to get along...?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Sure!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Let's take it slow~

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Mmhmm, I'm listening~

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I won't sleep on the job~

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: There you are!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Heeere I aaaaam!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Take aim!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Phew, that was tough...

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I think we did alright!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Hmm, I guess this was a bit of a letdown...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: S-sorry... I'll fight harder next time...!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Can I get my beauty sleep in here?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ughh...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Hmm, have I matured?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor Happy New Year! I'm really sleepy already, so I'm just wishing you a good year ahead of time. How was that can I gave you, tasty? If you liked it, I could give you a few more.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor~ *Yawn*...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Fang! You're awful! Doctor, don't be scared, come with me. Hmm? What are you crouching for? There's no water bucket on the door. Pff, your chair's got all four legs too. No hot sauce in your cake either. Heheh, Doctor, Truth is, I haven't pulled a single prank at all! That's what I'm fooling them about!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: It's so fun having everyone together like this. Not a care in the land except what's coming up next and what eats there are. How nice it'll be if every day was like this. Oh, the light show's starting? Let's get moving, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hi, Doctor. If you need anything, please tell me...  Um, I assume you still remember my code name...?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doc-Doctor, hi... Um, I just checked the Medical Department's power grid, and taking some files around while I'm at it... No, nobody's forcing me! I mean, they take such good care of me, it's the least I can do for them...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I decided to learn electric Arts just so my friends back in the slums could have some light, just so the nights would be a little less miserable... That pitch black, it's really scary. And the kinds of people who live in the dark, they can be scary too...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: These Originium generators here at Rhodes Island are amazing... You know, if we had anything like them back home, we wouldn't need to live in the dark all the time, like life without light is normal.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My mother taught me the basics of Arts. She told me I use Arts just like she did when she was younger, but I'm also as sickly as she was... If she were still alive, I'd hope she could come with me to Rhodes Island...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, before I got the training from you, all I could do with my Arts was light up one little room. But now that little spark has turned into something that can help lots of people...! Thank you so much!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Huh? A current anomaly in Miss Mayer's storeroom? W-why is it her again... What? Dr. Kal'tsit wants more cables for her lab? And another outage in Ifrit's room? Waahhhh... Doctor, help meee...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Zzz... Wha? Doctor...? Ah! Sorry! I wasn't napping! I, um, I was... Oh, is this Medical?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, are you going out again...? Okay, I know. I'll wait here for you... Um, Doctor, please hurry back...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Whoa...! Aaaugh... Static electricity. Gave me a jolt...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: H-Hi. My name is Greyy. I'm kind of an electrician... Erm, th-thanks for taking me on...!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: C-could you pause it for a minute? I-I'm taking notes…

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Okay, I'll take it to... Huh? It's, it's for me...? Really?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Hehe. Doctor, I shall light the way for you!... Um, sorry, just got too full of myself...  But I actually mean it...!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Everyone, I'm here to help...

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm the Captain...? O-Okay! If that's your wish, Doctor!...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let me handle the logistical support...!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Doctor, I see the enemies rallying...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'll try my best…

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I should be able to do it...!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Slowly, and carefully...

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Can't tiwst my ankle now!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Stop being evil!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I won't let you hurt my friends...!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: T-Take that!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: An electric shock c-can really hurt...!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, we've done a wonderful job...! Cou-Could we go home now?...

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We-We won, Doctor!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, the ones who ran off... We won't see them again, will we?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Err... Doctor...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What am I doing today?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Whoa…

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, you're really tall... I-I wonder when I'll get to be that tall...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Well, er... there's a fireworks show coming up, and I was wondering if we could watch it together. Yes, I like fireworks. They're so small, yet so bright and colorful, shining over the land...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, you're back!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here's my birthday present for you, Doctor... Um, I didn't have the money to buy anything nice, so I made something myself... a candle that won't be blown out. May it light a corner of your room and never go out.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor... I've been studying electrical engineering in depth lately. It's a little tough... but I'll work hard! I want to illuminate more places for Rhodes Island, and for everyone... I, I'm sorry, I'm getting ahead of myself, aren't I?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Please leave for now. Any disruption during my work hours is not permitted. Should there be any offense, I appreciate your understanding.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: To stop people from conducting foolish and meaningless deeds... At least you and I have that goal in common. Given your rich experience, I am certain you are well aware of how fervently most humans court their own destruction. That said, until the time the others are fully prepared, it would be all futile, no matter how much you rack your brains about the sea.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Please inform your operators to avoid any physical contact with me or my weapon after a battle. Intense exercise raises my surface temperature. If someone were to complain about being scalded, I would hate to feel guilty.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The language I use is overly polite...? Hm, I'm still getting acquainted with the language used on the land. But, besides, in my humble opinion, it would not be in your best interest to see me being impolite.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: As Abyssal Hunters, we must fulfill our responsibilities. To abandon the sacrifices of the past would be an unforgivable act of betrayal.  That being said, how many Hunters can I still save other than Specter and Skadi? Even if I were to rescue another Hunter who survived by sheer luck, the fear may have crushed them whole long ago. Their future will be fraught with nothing but agony.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Do you like to sing? What about dancing? Would you like to dance with me? It doesn't matter if you don't know the steps. I will teach you. Poetry, art, music... You must never forget these things. They are proof that all humans once lived beneath the starry night sky. Through these arts, and upheld by us, humans become eternal. Come, let's dance.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Kal'tsit encouraged me to seek your help, though I still remain skeptical of its utility. The technology of land dwellers is primitive compared to that of Ægir, yet the average mental state is even more problematic. Fear and cowardice seem to pervade most of you. Honestly, I cannot imagine how you people would face 'that.'

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The air here is dry. Fighting on land sometimes feels sweltering. Uncomfortable as it is, this is still better than being surrounded by the dead bodies of my comrades... I remember how the sea was littered with shreds of corpses. Their deaths etched onto your brain, and the stench lingers on your tongue whenever you open your mouth. Yet you cannot hang your head.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Do you think we can form an alliance? We may not even be counted as the same species. Kal'tsit is far older than me. The burden she carries is beyond anyone's imagination, but it is also a burden you must face one day... You must get stronger, strong enough to fear no loss. I will watch you by your side.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hmph...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}. I am Gladiia, the officer in charge of Rhodes Island's Ægir affairs. We will have many opportunities to collaborate in the future, but please see me as an outsider. I am not worthy of your trust yet.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I see. Your tactics and equipment match your kind's development progress.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A new contract? While I appreciate your recognition, I already have many important missions demanding my attention. The matters you assigned will have to wait. I apologize, for the inconvenience..

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: War. The concept of victory doesn't exist in a war that revolves around the continuance of a species. The only conclusion it can lead to is the destruction of the opposing side under the night sky. We Abyssal Hunters put our lives on the line to fend off and delay this fate. Unwavering, unrelenting, and without any regrets.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'll join this training as your squadron's aide.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: This seems to be a low-intensity battle. Allow me to use it as hunting practice for your operators.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: You are slow like you're caught in an undertow. I will slow down and wait, try to catch up.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Considering the level of this battle, allow me to save my strength.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Speak your mind.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: As you wish.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Who's the prey?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll manage them right away.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Watch out. The currents will pull the weak into the abyss.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Have I granted you the permission to run away, my prey?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Just a second, then this lance will pierce your heart.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Playtime is over.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Survive. That's the only rule you must follow.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: An archetypical victory. One day, you will be able to defeat all feeble creatures that come your way.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Better hope that the fleeing prey won't share information, so you still have a chance to savor the rest of your life at ease.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: How mediocre.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I appreciate the sentiment, but I'm perhaps more comfortable staying in my own little cramped dwelling.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Please respect the land's etiquette, Doctor, or perhaps discourtesy is more your thing?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Best be careful. By nature, my kind are all monsters.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: And so another year has come and passed. How far has our plan come? Has the sea engulfed more land from the coastlines without us even realizing? Rhodes Island's operators celebrate the New Year. Let them. As for us, the more we know, the more we must judge our own actions.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Greetings, Dr. {@nickname}.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: If we are to suppose the birth of a life is worth celebrating, said life must first possess notable value. Take my hand. This dance will be a special one. You may well consider it my endorsement of you. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: A species faces many threats in its survival. Under my assessment of dry land, I might equate Rhodes Island's intrinsic work to that of my Hunters. Dr. {@nickname}. It is yours to gather the weight of your decisions.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I looked after the stockbeasts in Dahuang, so I'm looking after you here, of course. You'll have to listen to me, work hard, and rest on time. Let's see... It's rest time now. Let's head out and have some fun!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Of course I know what the stockbeasts are saying. The beastlings in Dahuang always talk to me about things like what kind of snacks they want or who they like, and I sneak them a little help. This apple? A stockbeast asked for it, obviously. I'm just tasting it for them, making sure it's sweet enough.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Zuo Le is Candlestick, the Record Keeper is Inkbrush, that blinged out guy is Megaphone, and you're Wisehead. I also know a Tall Shades and Smiley Sharpshooter! Oh, and Amiya is the best! We made a promise to come up with a better nickname for you together.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Shu made me this fowlbeast whistle, and whenever I wanna tell the stockbeasts to go home, I give it a blow. Sometimes, when Dahuang feels empty, I sit down on the street corner to play it. People come and go, and my whistle's my goodbye and hello.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Dahuang's operas are sung in different dialects. That commemorates the farmers who came to our rescue a few centuries ago. They were from all across Yan, farming here for generations. They're why Dahuang fields are so fertile and prosperous now. I'm really proud that I can play the accompaniment on my flute here every year!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: When I first stood on the terraces, I could only see the aqueducts, but after the farmlands were raised, I could see the edge of the city, and now that Shu brought me here, I can see the horizon from the top deck. Megaphone tells me that Baba and Mama will come back someday, but when, exactly?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Could you draw a line over my head...? I'm not standing on my tiptoes! I'm not stretching my neck out, either! Are you done? Let's see. See? I told you I got taller! Maybe I'll be taller than Xiaohe next year! Let's see how tall you are. Minus your hood and shoes, you... come up to my shoulders!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: When I'm in a bad mood, I sometimes go to the embankment to play my flute. There's a woodcutter there who yelled at me every time, but he always quieted down as soon as I played this song. He even hummed along. That was the first time I saw him smile! Like I said, I'm really good at the flute.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The farmers say that the stockbeasts live by following water and grass. Fowlbeasts fly freely in the sky, but they always eventually land in the fields. I know what that means now.  Everyone has a field to call their own. Rhodes Island is your field, and you are the fowlbeast that will come back to land, isn't that right?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hm... You fell asleep...? You really fell asleep...? Hehe, have this coat then. Have a good dream. I'm off to have some fun!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Shu brought me here to hang! I think I wrote my name on a document she was supposed to sign...? She said it was fine, though. Now that I've signed it, I get to come here to hang out all the time!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: ...Wah! I'd never fall asleep in class, Laoshi...! Huh? It's you.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I developed a way to train stockbeasts to identify foods based on their smell. The Tianshi Bureaus gave me a medal for it. It doesn't have a serial number, but it says how amazing I am! And now I have this one you gave me. I'm putting them next to each other.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I got taller again, right? By the time I'm as tall as you, the people of Dahuang will definitely have cultivated the seeds they want. When that happens, I'll invite you to come sit with us in the fields. The rice flowers are gonna look even better then!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Is it time to do pest control again? I'm the best at catching these nasty little things!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Trust me. I know I can do it extra good.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Listen up, get your boots on, and tread lightly!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Everybody ready?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Qui-Qui-Quick! The pests are getting away.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I saw them hiding in the bushes there!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Nice. They didn't see us.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: None of you are getting away this time!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Hah, I got you!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Come any closer, and I'll whap your heads with my flute!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Not so fast now, huh!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: And don't ever come back to our fields!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Come on, let's go! We need to hurry and tell Shu. She's going to be so happy with me.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Next year, the year after, and the year after that... One day, the whole of Dahuang will live without fear of Catastrophes or pests, and we'll have stack our harvests as high as Heaven for Shennong.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: It's okay. We've been through Catastrophes much worse than this. This one's just a little setback. We'll work harder next season!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We're in trouble... I'll go get the Tianshi to help us!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I want to sneak out when the landship docks. Can you keep it from Shu?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: These buns aren't for you to grab!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Have you learned to play the song I taught you?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Here. A multigrain fragrance sachet! It's made by blending some grains and medicinal herbs. Keep it on you, and you're guaranteed peace and good health for the rest of the year. And you should definitely have a bowl of multigrain rice with multigrain beer. The farmers always tell me how good the multigrain beer tastes, but when I took a sip—It was so spicy and bitter!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I have the basket ready. Should we head to the fields to catch mudfins together?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I made you a bowl of noodles. Give it a try. I remember when I was still a kid, Shu always made me a bowl of longevity noodles for my birthday. An entire bowl made up of a single noodle. She always added a fried egg over easy too. I think this one might be overcooked, though. It might... have turned into a bowl of gruel.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I saw Rhodes Island splitting the sandstorm and sailing here. It felt just like the first time I saw Dahuang protecting the fields and overcoming the Catastrophe with its newly-built buildings. As long as everyone works together, no matter if it's a Catastrophe or anything else, there's always a way, right?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'm sorry, Doctor. This girl's sick today and nobody's to take care of her, so I brought her along. She's quiet and really well-behaved. Besides, she can fold a paper napkin into a lily. Dear, why don't you give the Doctor these flowers? You'd make the Doctor very happy.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Come out! I can see you, you know—oh, Doctor! I'm so sorry! I thought you were one of the kids playing hide-and-seek. Why are you hiding in here? Oh, someone is trying to drag you back to work? Well, I don't think this box is big enough for you. I could help you with my tail, if you wanted.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Yes, this hymn is an arrangement of a Bolívarian folk song. You can tell? It's quite different from the original. Does it matter, though? Everyone loved it when the arrangement made its way back to Laterano.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Why is there an axe behind the saint's statue? Oh, I think I left it there after cleaning up some bandits that got into the abbey. I have to put it away before the children see it. You mean, sacrilege? Of course not. Our Lord would approve, if He knew of the wicked deeds they did.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I always knew Laterano well, but it was only when I heard a gravely wounded nun singing hymns on her deathbed, with no trembling in her voice, that the black-and-white image of Laterano turned vibrant, and our Lord's grace dawned on me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The first time I came to Laterano, it had suffered a calamity attack, a broken city filled with broken souls, hardly the image of paradise. Was I shaken? I guess I was, but nobody ever said that faith is only for that which is perfectly flawless.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Aurela should not have spoken to you like that. Allow me to apologize on her behalf. She's not easy to get along with, and I wouldn't even call her a good person, but we all need 'bad friends', for the sake of our worst thoughts and emotions, things that I would never show to a good person like you.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Let the ancestors' legacies lie forgotten in my mind. It's enough to pick up a few tidbits from time to time as tales to tell the children. What I really want to remember, well, is the excited looks on the children's faces when I talk with them... and the smile on your face right now.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: What was taken from you? You try your best to suppress the wrath in your heart, but I can still sense it, so intense it could destroy everything. No, I'm not afraid, Doctor. Release it, and it will energize you, pushing you forward, until you take back everything that was yours.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Sleep, Doctor. There's a wicked creature out there in the night, clad in feathers and scales, that hunts children who stay up too late, impaling their hearts with its sharp spiked tail. What? You say you know her? I... I just made that up...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Gracebearer, a nun from Bolívar. Give me your hand, Doctor, and our Lord shall grant you His blessings.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: They should be more decisive... this will only create complications.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you for your generous donation. Your name will be etched into a century-old monument, with that of the abbey's founder.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I really appreciate Rhodes Island taking these children in, and away from Bolívar. They deserve some light and warmth at the end of their lives.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I would be delighted to join your team, Doctor, but... I'm hoping you will stay away when I'm fighting. Maybe you wouldn't mind it, but to me, you're too good of a person to have to face that.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: No... don't make me take even more of them, Doctor.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I'll come back at the appointed time... or an hour late. I'm Bolívarian, after all.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Do not fear. I'm just bringing you to your predetermined end.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: ...Very well. You have my axe, if you need it.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Don't worry, Doctor, I have my axe here.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: There are certain things I must handle personally.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'm not the one who will regret letting things get to this point.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Close your eyes. I don't want to scare you.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Cover your ears. This might get loud.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: No need to scream. It's all over.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Shh... it'll be okay. Everything will be okay.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I was lucky. I didn't encounter any enemies—the blood on my skirt? Oh, I must have tripped and fallen. Don't worry, it's just a scratch.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: It's done, Doctor. Let it go.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Turn around and find someone else, Doctor... I don't want you to see me covered in blood.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Go back. Sleep well. Everything will be alright by the time you wake up in the morning... Go. Back.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: How did you find me? You followed the singing? I was humming while working alone. You've never heard me sing… Well, one should not sing the same songs alone as with others.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh, it's you, Doctor. Don't sneak up on me like that again.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I sneaked some extra sugar beneath your bread when we took Communion just now. Did you notice?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
