voices.text: Would you like a bowl of cream soup? It's an honor to have you—oh dear, don't do that, children! Oh, look how they spilled soup on you... I'll get you a change of clothes. Hm, looks like all I have handy is a nun's habit... do you mind?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: May the Lord bless you and keep you.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I know it's rude to get drunk at someone else's birthday party, but it's been a long time since I've been able to drink to my heart's content like this. No need to worry about the children, no need to worry about shells falling on our heads out of nowhere, and no need to worry about what may come tomorrow.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Am I imagining things, or is there something sealed away in your mind too? Something chaotic and complex, no less than the knowledge passed down through generations of K'uk'ulkan... Promise me, Doctor, that whatever it is, you will not allow it to take control of your life and replace it.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Fine. At least I can get a break from the dusty air outside, if I stay here with you.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I don't shy away from sensitive discussions about the Infected? That's true. They're obviously different from us. But they also have the right to seize hope, just like us. So they don't need me to do anything special for them. That's equality, isn't it?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Blaze is too reckless sometimes. I know she's strong, but… What? You know how to handle her?  Forget it, I'll ask Amiya what I should do to get along with her after we get back.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I was just speaking objectively. If you don't want to be discriminated against, then you shouldn't expect special treatment... What, she went back to her room crying? Look, I feel a little bad about it, but is someone that fragile really operator material?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Rhodes Island is changing, Doctor. Maybe you don't feel it, since you're the reason it's changing, and not everyone is so annoyingly outspoken as I am. Anyway, I do appreciate the direction Rhodes Island is moving.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I used to prefer long-distance missions, like I was running away from Rhodes Island. I'll admit that was a little ungrateful, considering Rhodes Island adopted me. But now? Hehe, if you still have operators who like splattering blood all over the place, maybe I'll apply to serve in some faraway place again.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, would you sometimes feel afraid? Catastrophes, Originium, Oripathy, and the Infected? Hm, I'm still plagued by nightmares even now. But these days, I have Amiya, and idiots like that Blaze. I guess I'm not as afraid as I used to be.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Why are you called 'Doctor?' No, I'm not trying to get you to remember anything, it's just that title makes me very... wistful. Looking at all the Infected around you... Brings to mind a little bit of the past.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I've known the whole time. When my mother brought me to Rhodes Island, she'd already lost her mind. I didn't feel the pain her inner conflicts caused her, but I can relate to it, because I relied on that obsession to get me to where I am today. Only now, I've found a new direction... I want to find her, and I want to save her.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You shoulder the future of Rhodes Island. And with the burden of that responsibility, you can't be so lackadaisical.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: So you're the Doctor? Amiya told me about you. I'm GreyThroat. Please don't disappoint me.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: For efficiency's sake, speed up the playback. I'll still be able to see it all clearly.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Even now, I'm still on bad terms with a handful of operators. My promotion might spark controversy, just a reminder.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Whether Infected or not, we all choose to walk upon this land of our own free will. And so we must all work hard to survive, right?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I prefer working alone.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Whether or not they'll listen to my orders is another matter.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: A panoramic view of the battlefield.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I just have to rout them, right?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Too slow.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'll get going then.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Can the others keep up?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Such slow movements.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I see them. Too bad they don't see me.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I'm skilled enough to resolve this.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Don't worry, their sights are totally empty.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: We won't see many victories like this, since our power is limited.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I have no talent to speak of. So as a crossbowman, I can't let an enemy within three meters. Not even a corpse.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The medics should stay behind to tend the wounded. I will chase after them, considering I'm used to working alone anyway.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Watch your flanks. I'll cover our retreat.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I've been here for years, but I rarely wander around inside…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh?!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Aren't you afraid of upsetting the Infected operators if they see you with me all the time?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Dr.{@nickname}. Where's Amiya? She's setting up the party tonight with the others? Then I'll just wait here. Blaze is looking for me? Did she already see the gift I left on her desk? I—I'm worried she's going to say something cheesy again. I'm leaving.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Dr.{@nickname}, this is my birthday present for you. Unfortunately, it's a little rough, since I used a little gap in time when the kitchen was free to make it. Though, a few operators did help me, and I think I rescued one of them before...

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: You still have a lot to do, don't you? Blaze understands me because we fight together, but it's not as if any two people, or groups, who disagree will have a similar chance. I'm very lucky... which is why I need to be more responsible—until the day when we can all sleep soundly.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: This here Croissant guarantees yer safety, no matter where yer headin', Baws! Oh, 'n payment's upfront! 'Member that!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Make a buncha money workin' yer butt off! We can't be livin' in no poverty, after all!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Yer kiddin'! All yer people got such shiny gear on 'em! Lemme have a touch too!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Boy, I sure love orderin' new gear! Feels like I bought enough stuff to fill the whole depot! This what they call a 'shoppin' addiction'?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Every month there's more 'n more bills to pay... 'n that's why I sell some stuff I find on the side! Everythin' I got is cheap 'n high quality!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Move this, lift that. If we gotta be haulin' things, might as well pick some easy-to-use and yummy-yummy stuff!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Baws, Baws! Found this here heckin' tasty thing lyin' around, ya want a bite? Ya ask me, the only thing second to gud gear is gud food!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Baws, c'mere a sec, wouldja? Take a gander at my wares! From fancy clothes 'n everyday items to office supplies and gear, ya name it, I got it! Buy in bulk 'n I'll give ya a discount!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Baws, I gotta thank ya! With all them referrals, I can buy everything I ever wanted! Yer the best, Baws! Love ya lots!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Aw shucks, gotta tighten my belt again this month...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: The name's Croissant, and by golly yer in luck, Baws! Won't find nobody as good at their trade as I am! I'm strong, don't break easy, 'n if ya hire me right now, I'll give ya a 20% discount!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I reckon I'll get more work if I get stronger!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank ya kindly, Baws, fer helpin' me find such a nice job.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Baws, Baws, I made good use of that there bonus ya gave me! Check it out, I don’t got myself some new gear. All the better to keep ya safe!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Leave the defense to me!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Listen up, y'all! Let's do this here mission nice and cleanlike!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: We'll be back with the best results ya ever did see!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Well lookee here. The bad guys're comin' to donate their gear!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What can I do ya for?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Time to try this here new gear!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: H'all righty!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Here we are!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: End of the road!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Ya ain't gettin' through me!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: THUNDERCLAP!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: That ain't gon' work on me!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Ya reckon the enemy dropped a treasure chest or somesuch?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Yeehaw! Mission accomplished!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Dagnabbit... the enemy got away! That ain't good for my rep…

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Aw, shucks… First I lost the fight, and now my wallet…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Ya got any treasure chests hidin' 'round here?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Baws, Baws, got any nifty stuff on hand? C'mon, I wanna see!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Baws! The Penguin Logistics girls're countin' on yer business. And my hammer and shield'll keep yer goodies safe wherever they need to go. Hehe, if'n ya trust me enough, feel free to cut out Emperor and send the job straight to me!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Howdy, Baws!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Shhh! Rise n' shine, Baws. Get'cher clothes on! We gotta move before the others wake up. Texas's got the engine runnin', and Exusiai's talkin' about a champaign buffet with all the rubber bullets we'n shoot. Relax, Baws, we know a thing or two about birthday parties.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Even yer most carefully-laid plan ain't gonna carry you outta the swamp when yer all stuck in it. That's when ya come lookin' fer the unstoppable force! Hold the shiny equipment! That's the reason Rhodes Island n' Penguin Logistics're like two peas in a pod! Here's to keepin' that unstoppable force rollin', Baws!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Oh, thank you so much, Doc! Why am I thanking you? Heehee, because you just signed… MY PAID LEAVE APPLICATION!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I used to be a troublemaker for hire. People PAY for my epic pranks. The coalition government, the Singas, True Bolívar. I don't care who I work for. Sometimes, I even work both sides. I take care of one job on my way to one place, and the other on the way back. Jajaja! All that ruckus, it was glorious!!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Here, some corn bugles. Want some? No, no! You can't just throw them in your mouth. Where are your manners? Give me your hand, let me show you. First, you put them on each of your fingertips like that, then—Om! Hehe! Thanks for the food!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You call this a weapon? Hahaha, that's so funny. I call it 'Twirly-twirl.' It's a toy my mama made for me. You can throw it out like this, and then it comes back. What? It's too destructive? That's the fun part.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I've been pretty playful ever since I was a kid. I had enough tricks up my sleeve to turn the tables on the bullies, even pulled a few dukats out of them sometimes. I mean, come on, you need a thrill like that to really feel alive. But here you are, working your butt off all day long. Aren't you bored?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Can't hear the rain in here at all.... You know, Doctor, back when I was a kid, rainy days meant I couldn't go out to play. All I could do was stay in mama's workshop, helping her count screws, and listening to the pitter-patter of rain on the sheetmetal roof... But I don't mind days like that. You surprised?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: A Liberi dude who calls himself a hottie, a Vulpo car mechanic who does things his way, and my fellow Bolívarian with the huge appetite. Just where did you find all these fun people? I knew I made the right choice joining you guys.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Before I left home, I had a huge fight with mama, all because I caught Oripathy. I have my ways to keep from being a burden to my family, but mama… she hugged me so tight, she said she'd sell everything in the house to get me treated. I've never wanted to admit it, but I guess my life really is miserable.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You know what 'can soccer' is? It's my favorite game! Just take a can out of the ditch or whatever scrap heap, then play ball. Oye wey! What's that look on your face? We may have been poor, but there was plenty of fun to be had. Don't believe me? Come try for yourself!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: If you're that tired, how about you hand me all your top-secret documents and get some rest?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Caper, or whatever you wanna call me. Just standing here already proves I'm tough enough, right? You're my boss now, so make sure I don't get bored. And be ready for my surprises.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: You saw that move of mine? Hahaha! Their reaction was so funny.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: All the officers I know are so desperate for promotion, they do all kinds of dirty infighting. So I assumed getting promoted had to be super fun. Hmph, turns out it's no big deal.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I guess only my mama would be happy to hear I got promoted... It's all the same to me. But If I get promoted high enough to order you around… Heehee, then my head is full of ideas.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Finally giving me a real fun job?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Alright, everyone, don't overdo it! Of course, that doesn't apply to me!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Come on, come on! Let's go!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Twirly-twirl, it's time to play!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: My turn now?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: What you waiting for? It's gotta be me!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Think you can catch me? That's hilarious!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: What should I play with you guys?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Go home to your mama!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Watch out—Here comes Twirly-twirl!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Watch me cut your pants to scraps!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Watch me cut all that hair on your head!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: That was such a thrill! Can we do it again?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The No.1 rule of playing a master prank—is to be a prank master first, haha!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: That's it? I haven't had enough fun.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, you go on ahead! I'm gonna play with them some more!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Doctor? Where did my luggage go? You didn't hide it, did you? Pff... Hahaha, just messing with you. I ain't got no luggage.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Whoa~ Need me to keep what you just did a secret?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Try touching my ear. I promise, no surprises... Sike!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Before, I always had dinner with my mamá on this day. She always got off work earlier than usual to make me these big fat tacos filled with meat. It's only on this day of the year that I get to eat so much meat... Hey, don't just listen. Eat up.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, enough work. Let's play!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Look at you. Is today some kinda special occasion? Hehe, you look so funny when you're disappointed. Alright, here's my gift for you. You can probably figure out what it is, right?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, I'm outta here tomorrow. I really didn't expect to be here for so long, and that I wouldn't ever get tired hanging around you. Rhodes Island's such a fun place. Don't you ever let it get boring. Where am I going next? Haha... A field mission! See ya!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hm...? What should I do? Just put these papers in this box?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, are you working? Can I watch? Yay! Here I come, sofa.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I'm super strong! Forget one bad guy, I can take on a hundre—Uhh, maybe a hundred is a bit much... But ninety-nine is no problem! Um-hum!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I found a bunch of these little bottle things in some room, and the sauce inside tasted pretty good. Spicy? Umm... a little. But it's really yummy! Want some, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My den is right here. Doctor's den is above my head, and Vulcan's den is on my left... Okay, got it! One more time? Um, sure. My den is above my head, Doctor's den is on my left, and Vulcan's den is right here!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Whoa… So this is where I started ? Oh, oh, then how far did I go? And where did you catch me? You can find it all on this map?!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: So hungry... My tummy's been grumbling for hours. Can we go to the canteen yet?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I don't know much about Arts, but when other people try to use my weapons, they can't make all those cool sparky things happen. Anyway Doctor, don't worry. As long as I'm here, the bad guys can't hurt you. And I can tell who the bad guys are.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Bad guys usually come in groups, and I don't always have friends around. But the more weapons you have, the more power you have. Am I right? So, can I get another hammer for my bag? Or a javelin! They're super useful! No…? Hmph! But I need it!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor's snoring sounds funny.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: You seem pretty nice. They call you 'Doctor,' right? My name is Ceobe, but if that's too hard to say, you can also call me Kay. I'm staying here from now on!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I'm watching! I really am!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: This little button is for me? Alright, I'll put it on. Hmmm... Done!  Do I look cool?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: One's not enough, two gets the job done, and three is for safety. As long as I bring the right weapons for the job, I'll take out every bad guy I see!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'm all ears, Doctor!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm in command? What's a command?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Are we gonna eat goodies when we get back?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Phew... Alright!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Loud and clear!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Leave it to me!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: See you later!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Ha-yah!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Let's go!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Dadadadada!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Stay still, my prey!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: With your brains, my job is super easy! You're the best, Doctor!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: All you need is a little bang, bump, pow! And they're done!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Are you hurt? Should I wrap your ouchie?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Hurry! Run! Before it's too late!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This thing's super fluffy. Lying on it's gonna feel great!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: I'll bite you!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, can I follow you around?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Today a holiday? Does that mean I don't need to do anything? Then I wanna stay here the whole day! Vulcan baked a lotta Kay-shaped honey biscuits, and I brought them with me. Hm! Doctor, eat up! Or I'll eat them all!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor! Mhm, that's a proper greeting, right?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Today's the Doctor's birthday, this is the Doctor's cake. I can't eat it before you, I must wait! But there's so much fruit on top, and icing, and jam... Doctor, when are you going to blow out the candles? They said once you blow out the candles, then we can start eating it!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I used to go hungry all year round, and I was really happy when I could just sleep safe and sound. Now I have a warm bed every day, so I'm happy. Oh, and it would be even nicer if my room could have all these snacks like yours does, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Here are the documents. If that's all, I'll be going... The stain on that sheet? Oh, that's, uh... I guess I did spill something when I was having a couple of drinks last night. Haha... Damn, I put it in the middle of the stack, how'd you catch it...?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Do cultured folks like you even drink? Come, come, let's take a swig together, okay? Climb the hills in the dark, cross the desert in a storm. Now we gather in the oasis, drinking all the finest booze… Hehehe, oh, my friend, let's return to our homeland…

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Why are you all wrapped up like that on such a warm day? You'll be drenched in sweat. Hey you! Yes, you! Why don't you take off that jacket? A true warrior isn't afraid to show the results of hard training!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: 'Operator'? No, I'm a warrior of Rhodes Island. Don't worry, it's not because I can't let go of the past, but because I want to defend the present. I'll train new warriors for you... same as I was taken in and raised back on the sands.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I once took in some war orphans. They begged me to teach them how to use a sword to get revenge. I agreed, and they succeeded, but at the cost of their lives… Many years ago, the chief taught me that the sword is only for protection.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The war took the lives of everyone in my tribe. My friends blocked blows with their bodies, and the chief's blood dripped onto my head... Me and the other children set out on a path of revenge. I'm the only one left. No one and nothing else. Only me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The mark I'm drawing on your forearm? It's a 'bite mark'. Look, I have one too. The chief carved it into my skin herself. She said that those who have undergone the trial of blood and pain become the bravest warriors. The mark brings us strength.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I've taken plenty of hits both in battle and in the mines, but not many left marks. I used to think I was lucky, but now I wish I wasn't. I want the scars to help me remember certain people and things. Death brings back nothing, you know. I have to stay alive, and carry them myself.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Is it snowing on that peak...? Ohh... Guess what, Doctor? I had a dream last night about sleeping in the chief's arms when I was first taken in. She stroked my forehead gently, and her palm was like the sun-scorched sand, warm and rough. They've never seen the snow. Now I see it for them.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: It's a beautiful day out there. I had a good nap, and a good dream, for once.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I choose to stand here, and so the land beneath my feet is my home.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: No need, I'll grab my weapon and shield and head to the training grounds.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: It's a warrior's duty, no need to thank me... Wha? Blushing? Of course I'm not blushing. How could you even tell I'm blushing through my tan?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thanks, Doctor... I'll take this medal back to my homeland. The spring there has dried up, but it will continue to bless me, and they will know that I'm still fighting.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Love, friends, hearth. That's what a warrior lives for.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Warriors! Your courage will bring glory.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Don't eat too much before a battle, unless you want to throw it all up.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Now we fight!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm well prepared!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: My sword is honed.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: You're not getting past me!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I see them.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Victory or death!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: We will defend our home!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: The enemy will never see our backs!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Raise your weapons and shields! Not one step back!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: This is the home that we defend. This is where they die.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The invaders' swords cut their own throats. An end they deserve.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Haha, it is an honor to die defending my home.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: My homeland, my friends, my love... they're all waiting for me.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: The heck? No alcohol here...? Huh? What's that in my mug? It's just some b… umm... bubbly barley juice.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hey! Hands off.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Hahaha! Oh, I hate being tickled…

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The strongest liquor for the bravest warrior. This one is mine, Doctor. If you really want it... devour this whole roasted game, and you'll be our hero for the day!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Yo, Doctor, you sure you don't need to sun a bit?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I made this drinking horn out of the sands of my tribal homeland. A new warrior blows her victory horn after her first battle, celebrating her arrival into the world.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: It's hard to describe what I felt when I first saw Rhodes Island sail by in the distance, the rumbling of the ship and the tremor of the sands... it's like my chief was whispering in my ear: You've found another place worth fighting for.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: The Ark does not have the resources to maintain unnecessary, extended communications. But there will be no restrictions on transmissions between the two of us. Keep the channel open.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, please sit. I'm just here to give you a physical examination, so relax. If there are any irregularities, please tell me in full. Meaning? We'll set aside what it means to Rhodes Island for now. To me, the meaning it holds is quite significant.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: With the Originium held back by the curtains Rhodes Island has drawn, mankind was able to build the Ark and drag out its feeble existence. Yet the pressures of survival cannot suppress greed and desire. Every faction's leader yearns to become the administrator who holds all the keys. I understand that you pity them for their predicament, but you must decide based on your own judgment.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I will conduct scientific examinations on you at regular intervals, recording your vital signs and state of consciousness. No other personnel have this authority. If anyone wishes to conduct an examination on you, you have the right to refuse. Do you understand?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Inactive Originium solidified and accumulated, while redundant information piled atop itself in layers, giving us a new home. Only because you were there by our side could we delay the awakening of the arrogant master of all creation. All those who survived rely on your aid. They are all very appreciative, and so am I.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Medical is the core Department of Rhodes Island. Theoretical research and practical treatment both require medical talent, and the need for medical staff on field missions is always growing. Please remember that in the time to come, you will need to recruit ever more Medic Operators.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The people of today may still remember what trees looked like. That is why they can point to Originium clusters and call them an Originium Forest. But when we can no longer conceive of trees and woods, the word 'forest' will forever disappear from our languages. If things continue that way, 'these lands' will cease to exist as well.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I'm sure, on a daily basis, you interact with many Operators. When you converse with them, you must be alert for any speech that attempts to influence your will. Remember to preserve your ego; at necessary times, I suggest you seek my help. Of course, for you... I should be unnecessary, shouldn't I?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Originium soared through the skies and seized the twin moons, its clusters dispersing into the universe like spores, contacting and assimilating both the living and the dead— This is what is currently happening outside of Terra. Originium is swallowing everything into its body and incubating an all-encompassing chaos. But Terra can still be saved, and only because you remain by our side.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Amiya has left to eat with the young Operators. She is a child too, and you should accompany her as well. These lands have no mercy on the basis of age, but children will always be our unvarying hope. I very much admire this notion of... a certain someone's.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Under the curtain weaver, symptoms of Oripathy have faded into history, yet mankind continues to voice its dissatisfaction. The old order did collapse, but the minds of man remain narrow. Amiya must still go hither and thither to unite them. While she is now an excellent leader, you are still the only one she can rely on.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, do you ever doubt the meaning in your own existence? I do. Life upon these lands is tremendously tenacious. It evolves to suit a unique niche, often finding nurtured tameness and confrontation futile. What is our destination, Doctor? I believe you will find an answer. I can only persevere in that belief.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: We can no longer draw meaningful lessons from past experiences. The answers to our questions come not from our collective pool of knowledge, but from innovation and imagination. As you are more proficient than I in those aspects, there is no need to seek my advice on every single matter. Your insights are more important than my opinion here.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Don't spare too much worry for me. Rhodes Island shouldn't be so fragile that one person's departure would leave it unable to proceed on. What is it? No, it's only a slightly hyperbolic supposition. No matter what, I thank you for your concern, Doctor. But more than myself, I am concerned for you.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You already know how 'death' functions for me. So there's no need to worry about the damage I take. Instead, you should pay more attention to your own condition. The sarcophagus cannot heal the trauma wrought by extreme stress and exhaustion. If there is anything you would like to say, I will listen.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The path along which Amiya grew into Rhodes Island's leader was considerably troubled, and the sacrifices we've made bear testimony to that. From the faintest glimpse you caught in that stretch of the past, you may gradually come to understand the meaning of it all. You can make your own choices, Doctor... someone once told me that.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I can hear the crystal clusters surging. The Originium tides will soon dissolve me... Don't give me that look. Take care of Amiya and the city. We can continue to work on those problems the next time we speak. Well, then... see you again, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My hope? It is to protect yours and Amiya's hopes, Doctor. Though our definitions of 'protect' have nothing in common, it's an oath I will never abandon. I will be standing here with you, until the very end. We are unable to forget the past, but a different future may await you.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Scanning... The atmospheric oxygen level is still decreasing... No, let the Doctor rest. I will check it out.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Are you awake, or still in a dream?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: The anti-Originium communication lines have been activated... Signal received. Come in, Babel. This is Kal'tsit, exploring the former Leithanien region as planned. No coagulation point found as of yet. What about you, Doctor? What's the situation there?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor, my appearance here indicates that the situation has turned for the worse. You must concentrate on continuing to accomplish your mission.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Experiences from before the crystallization age are for reference only. Do not overly rely on them.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Not bad.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Formalities are no longer necessary between you and I. You need only keep your promise to maintain the Ark's safe course.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: With strength comes fragility. Such is the principle of all living things.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Mon3tr, these tattered lands will one day need you more than ever. Now, with your own voice, say hello to the Doctor.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Mon3tr and I will protect everyone. Especially you, Doctor.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I will correct any flawed decisions that occur during exploration.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I will see to them.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Mark the area you need explored. I will arrange for the rest.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Now you need only devote yourself to operation planning.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: All units, double check the status of your anti-Originium equipment.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's go.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Stick to the plan. Do not throw your life away for nothing.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: You know the plan. Move to intercept.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What's your plan?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What's the situation?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I will synchronize the battlefield data.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Optimize your deployment.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Executing battle plan.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Arrived at designated position.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Mon3tr.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Mon3tr, with me.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Never let your guard down before the enemy.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Mon3tr.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Suppressing Originium activity.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Perform your task.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Follow my orders, Mon3tr.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Awake.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: On my mark, prepare to counterattack.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Go ahead.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: How much time do we have left?  I see… I trust your judgment.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Make sure a video record of this battle is properly cataloged.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: All units, proceed according to plan. I will hand the report to the Doctor.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Mon3tr, collect tissue samples.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: You should be more careful. We can't afford even a single loss.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Assess the risk coefficient of those fleeing, as well as the possibility of a reprisal attack by enemy forces.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: All personnel, retreat to safe zone. Comm permits are transferred to you for now. I will sort out the situation before us.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Secure evac route. Prepare to operate!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: The facilities are fairly well-maintained.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: How is the infrastructure project here developing?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Seems you are still very fond of your little tricks.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What are you doing?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Have you ever imagined a future where only you remain?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You seem to have grown used to your own work and responsibility. You've become much like a leader.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Holidays may not provide much joy to anyone anymore, but there is not much left to commemorate. Do not let Originium take away these precious memories too. These are the best wishes I can offer you.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It is once again the New Year. I only hope that you will find a suitable manner with which you can enjoy this brief holiday logically. Additionally, I wish that you will enjoy this upcoming year in good health, and won't spend too much time in the infirmary.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: There is still much we can do, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I will return to the Ark tonight. I hope to see you through the anti-Originium curtain, just like in years past.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: So this is the day you've chosen, is it? I won't ask you about the significance of the date. You are free to keep the answer to yourself. I only hope that your choice will serve to give more meaning to Rhodes Island's existence. Of course, if you would like, I can offer you my well wishes, too. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The lights of Rhodes Island once illuminated the night sky, and everyone aboard celebrated throughout the night, both on the bridge and in their cabins. Those were the good old days, yet now our operators can only shut off their electricity and drift to sleep even a moment sooner. All the effort we put in today is to allow civilization to shed light upon the lands anew.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: It is not for anyone to tell you what the significance Rhodes Island carries is. Neither should you be bound by your unreachable memories. Instead, the current you must find that answer yourself. There will come a day when you'd decide Rhodes Island's course. I trust that your decision will bear responsibility to the ideals that we discussed.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Am I really going to be helpful? Um... alright, if you say so...

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Hmm... your hair is close to coming out of your hood. If you've got the time, remember to give it a trim.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I can't use anything like a compass. No matter what I do, they all end up pointing at me. *Sigh*... I had no clue as a child, so I tried to use them to find my way home... Now that I think about it, I'm lucky I have a sense of direction.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You wanna touch my ears? Of course, touch them however you want... but people usually only do it a tiny bit. Why? Heheh, you'll find out if you try, won't you?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My Arts are... how do I put it? They affect a lot of things, but because they don't have a form, it's hard to grasp them properly... if I can get a handle on their nature some day, I might be able to live a normal life.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Static electric pulse theory says... okay, okay, I see. I just need to apply my Arts Unit, and start the antistatic equipment up, and that should... Yagh! That's not working at all. Where did I mess it up...? Here? Alright, once more.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Welcome~! Oh, Doctor! You finally decided to get your hair sorted, then? Good, sit down. Today, I'll be your... That's right, it's a salon in here, you're not imagining things. Um, don't go! This is my speciality, trust me, please! You won't regret this, I guarantee!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My dad told me I should pick up another craft in addition to Originium Arts, so this is what I went with. It turns out the only hair I can't fix is my own... Okay! How's that? Are there any bits you want fixed? None? Heheh, I thought as much. Alright, I'm finished for the day, then.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Before I got Infected, I was actually in really good shape. I got second place in a cross-country race! Once my Oripathy's a bit better, I want to start training again, and carry the gold medal back. Can I ask you to present it to me, Doctor? Heheh, then it's a promise.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: The circuit's grounded... okay, now my hair shouldn't poof out. I'll have a break while the Doctor's asleep.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Finally made it here... nice to meet you, Doctor. I'm a new Operator onboard, Goldenglow. I look forward to working under you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Mmgh... it still doesn't really make sense. Maybe I should visit my Instructor and see if she can help.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: There's no tingling feeling, is there? If not, we should be fine. Okay! I'll accept this medal from you graciously, Doctor. Thank you!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor! Stay away from here! I just need a—a-are you alright?! Are you hurt anywhere? I took all the protective measures, didn't I? Why...

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Is there really a use for me on the front?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Doctor, are you sure I should be the captain?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I've got this, I've got this. I can do this!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: There's enemies?!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm so tense...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Can I really do it?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Now's the time to help everyone out.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll do my best!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Get away from me, please!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Stay back!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Yaah!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Keep a good distance—there!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Huh? Oh—no, it's nothing! Let's get going!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I managed to help a little, didn't I? Heheh.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Phew, we're finally saved. Are you hurt?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We were so, so close...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I need to keep away from the electronics...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hwah!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Could you help me comb my hair down? Thank you so much, Doctor.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! My family sent me all of this stuff. This is bread my mum baked, these biscuits are from my oldest brother, and my sister cured this meat—she's eighth-oldest. I think that's mostly it. Don't be shy, let's tuck in together! ...Eep! Did I accidentally shock you again, Doctor?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hope you have another good day today.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: If today was my birthday, I'd be on a sofa at home with my brothers and sisters. We'd be eating and drinking and playing until all end up falling asleep and waking up the next day. But never mind that, you're the star for today, Doctor. Do you want a new look? Well, how about I trim a new hairstyle for you? Mm-hm! Great, let's do it!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, look, I can control my static away from my staff now! Maybe with a bit more time, I'll be able to master my Arts. Then I can hug my mum all I want, without having to worry about shocking her! Mm-hm, I need to keep at it!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You have to clear all these documents on your desk? Gosh, that's a lot. How about a short break, honey? Tired as you are, a refreshing drink ought to help.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: What would you like to order tonight? Some ribs, maybe fried fowlbeast? I recommend the ribs with red wine, or the fowl with a glass of sparkling water Hm? You want both? Only if you can finish it all, darlin'. I wouldn't want any to go to waste.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I met an interesting guy in Tkaronto who claimed to be the president of the Columbian Chiromancy Association. He was all about palm reading, and insisted on teaching me a thing or two. Unfortunately, I'm not a believer —Why not? Heh. Because for all the nonsense that came out of his mouth, his furry paws didn't have a single crease on them!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Davistown is a mining platform. It gets really cold in winter, but the warmth of its residents kept my diner open for more than a decade. Unfortunately, social ties alone couldn't save the iron mine, and it eventually became a Blacksteel training platform. Well, nothing I can do but wish them well. Hope they don't tip the whole thing into a ditch.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: It's in great condition, but I haven't actually used this weapon much in the past few years. A steak knife is enough to settle a dispute. How? Simple, if it's sharp enough to cut a steak, it's sharp enough to cut other things... Wanna see it in action?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I've seen automated mining platforms. I know it's just a matter of time until those industrial monsters phase out Davistown. But I still can't forgive the profiteers. They never give it a second thought how they're selling more than just the platform, it comes with the lives of everyone on it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Something bothering you? Need a drink? I learned what I know out in the Columbian wilds, so my drinks aren't exactly stylish, but they pack a punch... Don't look at me like that, hon. We can just chat if you don't want to drink.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Jessica was so gloomy out on the frontier, but she still worked her hardest, day and night. Poor girl wouldn't even admit she was tired when anybody asked... I'm glad to see she looks so much better now that she's here at Rhodes Island with you by her side—Oh, hold still, hon! Your neck and shoulders are stiff as a board. Of course it's gonna hurt when I press down on them like this.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I made a bet that I could drive us from the frontier to Tkaronto in one night. Wanna come along? You ride shotgun, I'll drive. Either I win, or we'll just park the car somewhere and watch the sunrise, play it like we spent the night chasing the dawn.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, wake up. You'll get a stiff neck if you sleep at your desk. Lay down on the sofa, I already put out a blanket.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. Jessica and I are here to get medical help for our infected Pioneers. She talks about you all the time, so I think we'll be good working together.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hmm… This looks like more trouble than breaking up a fight in the diner...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A company promotion is a wholly new experience for me... thank you, Doctor.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I'm not trying to protect anything, I just want to experience as much goodness as I can, leaving no regrets behind. But, if someone were here to do badness, I wouldn't hesitate to empty my magazine.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I still prefer the conflicts you can settle with a steak knife.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll assign jobs like I would in the kitchen. Everybody okay with that?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: If you feel nervous, think about what song you want to sing at the party afterwards.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I smell something unpleasant burning.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What kind of 'drink' can I fix you?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Who do you want me to target?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Got a clear view here. Hope they don't got the same.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Relax, I'm almost done reloading.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Want a drink? It's on me.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Too bad, I've got you now.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Ready to surrender? No? Sorry about this, then.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Ever stick a hot knife in butter?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Well done, Doctor. This drink is to you.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission complete, easy peasy.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: They're no threat anymore. Just let them wander off into the wilderness.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Don't worry about me, I'm just covering your retreat. I've seen worse.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Sometimes I miss the days I spent riding a burdenbeast out into the wilds.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Careful, you almost spilled the drink.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Want a slice of this freshly baked meat pie?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I hung up a dartboard in my diner one New Year's Eve. Anybody who beat me could get something on the house, or if they lost they'd to order an extra drink for every extra dart... Wanna guess how quick I sold out of booze that day?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. What can I get you today?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Remember the bet I told you about? That's your birthday present, if you're down for it. But in the meantime... enjoy this glass of 'Wild Sunrise'. Happy birthday, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I've been looking around, seeking out all kinds of scenery since I left the city I was born in. There are only two places that have made me consider stopping, Davistown and Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Make the most of everything, hm? As you've given approval, I'll do my very best to provide you all additional joint effort and technological support necessary, within our agreement's scope, of course. Fortunately, assistant work was my exact vocation.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Rhodes Island's ambience is more assuaging than I'd imagined, at least personally speaking. After all, you typically feel medical firms would be nothing but dour to almost insipid researchers. Not to even start on your armed force to keep the Oripathy-related technologies and personnel safe.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: In my time at Raythean, I took part in several project teams, but they mostly bored me. Obviously, one can't complain about their technological prowess, but if all it is is fulfilling orders to quota, without attempting to inject a little inspiration, doesn't work become just too dull?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You seem somewhat mindful of my manner of speech. Hmm, if possible, I'd like if you could bear with it. My last project team, whether superiors or juniors, all took up overly polite address that only sent communication efficiency to rock bottom. It posed a headache to me too.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: True, work calls for strict treatment, and serious accomplishment. But after work is over, you also need to understand keeping a balance and relaxing, which is what lets you adjust your own state and achieve glowing results next time in your work. Do you believe so, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Have you heard the observation that though many find satisfaction in neat, orderly things, there's a set that feels apprehension in a space holding the same qualities? Yes, every time a rest day passes and I return to a work station that's been tidied up, I feel suffering.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: A pileup of overdue reports and files just won't do. The paper shredder? No, Doctor, don't tell me you wouldn't want to try this environmentally-friendly corrosive, able to turn a ream of paper to pulp with a dropper's worth. There's no use? That's true. How about I launch a project to develop a papermaking machine utilizing this pulp?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The impression you give may not seem quite like my project manager at Raythean, but there's some similarities. However, saying this with a wide open heart, you as a superior outstrip that unpredictable, outlandish black box of a crackpot project-intending plan-addled trickster genius by miles.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Both Raythean R&D projects and working together with you have been delightful experiences. I'm finding myself torn between choosing, and I don't mean it as a pleasantry. Perhaps, you'd mock my greed? But people like us might just all be greedy. What's your view?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Only when you have finished everything at hand can you rest carefree and firm-willed. At this rate, I'm worried you'll... heh, whatever. With this little left, I can figure it out for you without any worry.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello there, Dr. {@nickname}. Raythean Industries liaison, Corroserum. I'm sure you saw the relevant contracts and forms, despite your busy schedule. Now then, do share any upcoming workflow arrangements.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals Inc.'s battle records are more interesting than I expected.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: You've raised your evaluation of me? Thank you, this'll be good grounds to include when I apply for another tour here.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: True, it's worth taking joy in a project's smooth progress, but the evaluation you've given me, in my opinion, seems to have already outclassed my resume. That is to say, do you have further expectations of me, even greater than this?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Ah, another assignment perfect for testing weapons. Of course, I'm very pleased to be working with you, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: This is an anti-corrosive coating spray, with no toxic side-effect on the human body at all. Given you were all willing to sign the disclaimer and participate in this test, I sincerely hope none of you become collateral damage due to irregular operation in this weapon's test.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The holiday's always over in the blink of an eye. Well, then, let's get to work.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I'll be troubling you to make these test targets fall in line a little with our work, Doctor.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Do you have any additional directives?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: You can order me for anything you'd like.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Timed just like your simulation.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: The stressful test phase is now beginning.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Can I make sure none of you will surrender just yet?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I have an extra project here that needs all your cooperation for testing.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I'd like to ensure you all persevere until I can gather enough data.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Of course. This is part of work, too.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, this has thrown a slight wrench in things. After all, you've obtained combat results beyond expectations, and made it marginally more difficult for my assessment of weapon performance limits to be universal and objective. I'll have to increase the quantity of test samples to ensure accuracy... was that in your plans too?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A pleasing result. It seems once we return and I finish collating this data, I'll have some spare time for free movement. Well, then, do you have any free time coming up, Doctor?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Not too ideal in terms of results. Deployment tactics still have room for optimization. Don't you think so, Doctor?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Let's not feel down, Doctor, you will find a solution to break this deadlock. After all, you'd like the reports we'll be writing to be worth more than scrap paper, wouldn't you?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Is there anything I'd be able to help with?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: I wouldn't trouble you with a matter this small.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor? I assume you're there.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I'm very glad I don't have to confront those nightmare piles of annual reports here at Rhodes Island. It seems quite a few Operators have requested advance leave to visit family at home? Well, then, do you have any upcoming plans for this provisionally idle time?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: It's nice to see you, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I apologize, Doctor, I'm currently working. If you wanted to chat, you'll have to wait until I'm on break. Oh, yes, I left your birthday present on your desk early this morning—if that's what you wanted to talk about, I'd be very happy to sit down with you at dinner this evening.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I originally came to Rhodes Island to test weaponry and nothing more, but your command never ceases to demonstrate the importance and value of people. I've certainly learned very much from it... So, the idea of formally joining Rhodes Island may be a decent one. Doctor, can we have an honest chat about your terms of employment for any job-hoppers?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You want me to help you sort these files? Alright... And double check the numbers too? Sure, leave it to me.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Wow... There's a lot of people heading up on deck... What? Someone jumped off the bridge and they're organizing a rescue? But I didn't see anything like that when I was flying... W-Wait, they might be looking for me! Ohhh no, I've gotta clean up this mess! How am I gonna explain...?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Have you ever seen the land stars, Doctor? When I was flying over the frontier, the scattered bonfires were like stars sprinkled across the wilderness. Animals migrate to find a new place to live, but those Pioneers... I wonder if they dream of a nice, warm home?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Yes, this is a monitoring device. l'll stick it onto a fowlbeast, and then adjust the rhythm of my breathing to the data it sends over. That way, I won't disturb the flock while I'm flying. Ah, sorry, I'm babbling again... Umm... Any other questions, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: As a kid, I was really scared of the featherless monster fowls in the stories. They were always snatching up children. Even hearing the chirping of a real fowlbeast got me shaking. But after the first time I got plucked off the ground for real, after I got to see the whole land from above, I was never scared again. Um, you don't believe I got carried off by a fowlbeast? B-but it really did happen...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I learned some painful lessons on my first test flight. I lost my balance and almost flew straight into a cliff. It's all thanks to my glider that I survived. There's nothing left of it now, only these tattered strips of blue and purple. But I tie them on before every flight.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Once, I had an Originium slug pulled out of its shell and plopped down right in front of me. Can you guess who gave it to me? It was a mother fowlbeast hen. She decided I was one of her chicks, but I never saw her again once I left the forest... Well, I'll try to finish the slug soup, it's the least I can do.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I record my voice, so I can play it back to the fowlbeasts and get them to slowly see me as one of their own. 'Gah gah' means 'look at me', 'Ah-kah' is 'run away'… Hehe, it's all guesses, really, but you learned them pretty quick.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: That's the entire pre-flight checklist. Come on, Doctor, I'll be taking you up for a quick loop around. Don't worry, no need to be scared, I'll hold you tight the whole way through. Eh? Ah, uh, no, wh-what I mean is... We'll be strapped together while we're flying, so you can relax. I'm not going to drop you.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, this file... Oh, you're asleep? Go ahead and rest up, then. I'll come back later.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor, I'm Operator Contrail. Nice to meet you—you remember seeing a photo of me flying with a fowlbeast flock in the news? I-I'm glad you remember me…

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: On my next flight, I'll try this super-tricky barrel roll…

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thanks, Doctor... I love the medal. I'll hang it up with the pendants showcasing my successful test flights.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: 'Though it may fall a hundred thousand times, a chick still yearns for its first flight.' I've loved those words ever since I first read them. Doctor, do you think... I've grown?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Okay, I'll fly echelon.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Alright... I'll navigate then.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I'm not afraid.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Let me check the wind direction first.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Propulsion units and emergency ejection equipment, check. All systems go.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Ready for take-off.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: In the pipe, five by five.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: All units, watch for my signal.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Turbulence incoming.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: On me, stay in formation.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Brace yourselves, cumulonimbus ahead.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Is that fog...? Oh, just condensation on my glasses.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: A perfect flight record... Next time, we can try somewhere even further.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The two long white plumes up in the sky...? Yeah, those are mine.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Looks like there's still room for improvement... Maybe I should add a multi-speed pursuit module.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: It's okay, Doctor... Anyone could run into a storm. Let's rest up for the night and try again when the weather clears.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: The setting sun, some floating feathers, a sea of clouds stretching out into the distance... No, not a painting, it's the view out the window.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh, Doctor. Go right ahead…

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: There's a black cloud in the corner of the test flight photo? Th-That's my tail…

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: You're looking for peace and quiet on the deck too, Doctor? I'm still not too good with crowds, so I wrote all my New Year's greetings down on cards. I didn't have any other plans tonight, so I was just gonna stand here and look up at the night sky... Sure, we can look together.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I don't have any test flights planned for today, Doctor... You just wanted to chat? Alright, you've got my ear.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: This multicolored, feathered wobble doll... It means you should live life to the fullest and never give up. Huh? No, I'm not saying you should get all round and, and, and plump like this, and I'm definitely not saying you're too stingy... Ummm, I'm sorry, I'm bad at picking out gifts... Oh... You were joking? You're teasing me again, Doctor...

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Starting from Columbia, twisting and turning all the way to Rim Billiton. Rhodes Island's following a long and windy course, just like a migratory fowlbeast. I'll be your wingman, but more than the destination, I'm excited for what I'll find along the way. You too, right, Doctor?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Since you summoned me, you must be eager to feast your eyes upon my elegant dancing form, right? Uh...? Help you move the luggage...? Hey! I didn't come here to do manual labor!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You're such a weak and ineffectual leader! How could you be so fragile? If it wasn't for the sorrowful tears Amiya would then shed, I'd convict you right here, right now!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You don't even know what conviction is? Now prick up your ears! The art of conviction is an assassination technique created by the first Conviction master, who combined traditional dance moves with ancient fighting techniques. And now, standing before you is his third-generation successor!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Conviction is not some barbaric fighting technique! It's an artform where beauty and ideals are poured into the fist, then delivered through the fist straight into the heart! Now you know!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: This art is the crystallization of hard work and great insight. When people ignore the true value of art and use this sacred product as some sort of game, Conviction will descend to right all wrongs.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Do you not revere in awe my aestheticly perfect image and overwhelming pressure? Then you're unworthy of your place on the same team as your savior! Ughhh! Con! Viction!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I'm actually someone infected with Oripathy, an incurable disease?! Curses... is this my destiny? Is this the fate of all who wield the Conviction Punch? Hey, why are you all looking away! I'm clearly telling you a sad story!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You also wish to become Conviction? In that case, chew upon this question! 'You're standing at a junction in a railroad, with a train full of Durin people approaching. The junction splits off into two tracks, one upon which several artists with meager artistic achievements are...'

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You don't even have the gumption to answer the easiest of Conviction's dilemmas! You have no artistic talent! Taaaaake this! Conviction - Second Style!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: ...Hoo! Hah! No, wait, wrong move. Let's try again!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Conviction. I shall use this name, with all the faith it entails, as my code name. You ask what my talents are? I'm a master of the deadly and beautiful art of conviction! Now shiver in reverence!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: An opportunity like this to become stronger is readily taken!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Ahaha, a promotion! The day when Conviction's hidden powers are released is not far away!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: This sensation... it feels as if my artistic accomplishments have deepened, but also like something is welling up inside me...!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Due to my tendency to sometimes convict teammates, it would be safer for me to work alone.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: At last, your conviction arrives!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Your judgement is nigh!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Now, count up your sins!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: On my way!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: All right!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Here I stand!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: You think you're a worthy opponent?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Con—vict!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Haah!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Hmph!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Back down!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: History is written by the winners… This is the doctrine of Conviction!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: How about it! Aren't you awed by my heroic majesty-- Hey, wait up! Don't leave me behind!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: It's fine. This victory might not be the most gorgeous, but it'll still serve us well.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Ugh... the magnificent Conviction must never allow such a blunder…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's going to be another dilemma for me to convict this room…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Woahh! What are you trying to do this time! I'll teach you to behave!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy! New! Year! I bring Rhodes Island a dance most rich with the fragrance of Art. Enjoy with bated breath! All will receive a baptism by my gorgeous fistwork, and gain life anew!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Oh, if it isn't the Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Your office entrance is all filled with finely-wrapped boxes! I've convicted each and every one of them! Now partake in this gift from me: Soldiers Assemble: Barrage Fortress! The Firestorm Update!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Even beside those who don't understand art, those who misrepresent art are the vilest! The despair, the drowning despair! To think that penguin's music should find so many worshippers—that it should earn Number 1! Who was the contractor for that showdown? I will! Con! Vict!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: No problem. Leave it to me. While most of my work may be outdoors, I still need to handle thick stacks of paperwork. Once it's done, I'm hoping for a little reward... perhaaaaps, a short vacation?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, did you receive the report I submitted? Oh, this hair is a strand from the tip of my ear. I deliberately slipped it into the report to test whether you'd read it thoroughly. I'm glad you noticed.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Watch out! You didn't cut your hand, did you? I forgot to warn you that the wire is extremely sharp. You must be very careful when touching it. Though dangerous, it's incredibly versatile in the wild—perfect for climbing, tying things down, towing, and... dealing with some uninvited guests... oh... never mind.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I brought back a bag of nuts I collected on my recon mission, all pre-shelled. Don't worry, I've sampled every variety, and they're guaranteed to be crisp and delicious. Oh, except for one particular nut, which might leave your mouth temporarily numb. How might you pick out that one? Pure chance.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I was once a Youth Scout, with a camp nestled in a beautiful park. I believed that was the essence of camping, until... I ventured into the real wilderness. I learned a harsh lesson: when every choice is life or death, you don't get the luxury of maintaining appearances. Life might afford poetry, but survival demands ruthless pragmatism.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The records are wrong.I was born in the wilderness, and my adoptive parents brought me to a nomadic city to raise me there. As for my biological parents, their faces have long faded from memory. Still, occasionally... two indistinct faces appear in my dreams. Do they belong to them? I can't tell.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I just saw Jessica in the hallway. She looks much more confident now. No, she didn't recognize me. My work doesn't involve direct interaction with coworkers, which means few at Blacksteel are even aware of my existence. That's why I was surprised when you took the initiative to talk to me, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, I received the ID badge you sent me... but, I apologize, I can't keep it on me. My work demands absolute secrecy, and any form of identification is out of the question. Speaking of which, you'd be shocked at the secrets I've managed to uncover just by blending in as an unremarkable traveler!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, would you sit with me for a moment? I've always understood that my duty is to scout ahead and blaze a trail. Still, despite my meticulous planning, there are times when most of my people don't come back. It seems, no matter how hard I try, it's never quite enough.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Don't you feel cooped up staying indoors, Doctor, especially when you finally got some free time? How 'bout we go for a walk…? The sunlight out there is just perfect.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. I'm Surfer from Blacksteel Worldwide's advance recon team. My primary duties involve intelligence gathering and pre-mission reconnaissance. If you possess any pertinent information, please, don't keep it to yourself.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Mind if I take some of these with me? They'd make an excellent remedy for cabin fever on those rainy days when I'm confined to my tent.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Twice the vacation days, double the salary... Achoo—oh, hi there, Doctor! No, no, I wasn't saying anything just now.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Guess what, Doctor? Yesterday, on my way back here, I saw a brilliant red sunset. A good omen that today would be a lucky day. Sooo, have you come bearing good news?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Adding me to this wilderness mission was a wise choice. Trust me, Doctor, I'll ensure your safe return to the landship.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: The wilderness is far more complex than most imagine. If you want to accompany me, you'll have to abandon those romantic notions about camping first.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Alright. We pitched the tent. Now we have a base camp from which to go anywhere we please.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I'll go solo. A large group might provoke hostility from the locals.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'll go gather some dry branches. We must have a campfire lit before nightfall.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Water's not far. Stay put, and I'll fill the canteens.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: *Sigh* I never expected to encounter so many people on this trip.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Hello, I'm here for a brief survey. Don't worry, I won't overstay my welcome.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: They came just in time; our provisions are running low.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: *Sigh* They ruined the night. What a waste of this gorgeous scenery.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Forgive me, I woke up on the wrong side of the sleeping bag.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Excuse me, can we hurry this up? I really don't want my meal getting cold.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Have you burnt this scenery into your mind, Doctor? We'll head out like a shooting star, but this memory, right here, right now, will endure for you to reflect upon over and over again.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Everyone gained from this trip. And my gain is everyone's satisfaction.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The terrain ahead is not in our favor. Continuing this advance is not advisable, Doctor. We should stand down.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, though the journey may not have been entirely satisfying, we must ensure no trash is left behind.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Really? Are you going to confine me to this windowless room for so long? I must have done something to upset you, then?

voices.title: Tap
