voices.text: Hmm...? Oh. Want some canned soup?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Go get some rest. I'll take the night watch.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Looks like this year will be no different from last year. I'll visit some old places and some new, meet some old friends and make some new, and handle some old tasks while taking on new ones. The good news is, at least this time, I won't be alone on the journey.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: When was the last time we saw each other... a month ago? It's a joy to see you in good health, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: No, no, no, Doctor, this map isn't THE birthday gift. What you need to do is mark a location on the map, any one will do, and I'll take you camping there. I'm sure the breathtaking canyon views will help you relax.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Sometimes, the farther the destination, the fewer provisions I load. In the wilderness, packing too much means a heavy burden; a light pack is the key to success. I've carried a lot for a long time: as the weight on your shoulders grows heavier, and the road ahead remains infinitely long, how will you ultimately reach the end, Doctor?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: File organization is one of my fortes! Uhh... What are these? Data charts and theory analyses...? Seems very complicated, unlike the romance novels I read. Doctor, have you read any Victorian literature? Just between the two of us, I share my name with the protagonist from my favorite work.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I used to believe the Infected would understand if I smiled at them, but I was wrong... Before I smile, I should put myself in their shoes to learn their pain, and that goes for all those who are oppressed.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Now that I've talked to Amiya and the Doctor, I can understand why she, an elite operator... and the rest of Rhodes Island made that choice.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: It's a little embarrassing to say... but I really admire Bagpipe. It doesn't matter what she has been through, she takes pride in the fact she was once a Victorian soldier. Oh, please don't get the wrong idea. I still love Victoria, and it is this love that drove me to leave my homeland.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: It wasn't easy to lose the Dublinns. I talked to the girl called Reed afterwards, but it doesn't seem she remembers me. I suppose... that's a good thing for her. Should we get the chance, I would love to have a chat with her about poetry and novels. Oh, and it would be lovely if we became friends.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I have every step of Trooping the Colour memorized by heart, but I still have a long way to go to truly carry the banner's weight and find the way forward.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: It takes a little time to care for my hair. I know merely keeping up appearances isn't enough, but I see this as part of living diligently. Doctor, your hair's kind of messy. Would you like me to fix it for you?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: If the day comes that you must face those countless fearsome enemies, I will stand by your side.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor... if we had met before that incident, I'm sure I would've found myself relying on your help. But I can't well wait forever for someone to tell me what righteousness is. At the very least, on this journey we walk together, I wish to be an ally you can count on.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, when I see you here like this, it reminds me of the days I spent lazing around in the Rhodes Island offices... the sunshine, the card games, and my friends... It really brings back memories.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: You must be Rhodes Island's commander? Operator Saileach, reporting in!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Oh, could you stop for a moment, please? I would like to take notes.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I was... disappointed in them. And so I threw away all the ribbons and medals I'd ever earned. But Rhodes Island is different. Thank you, Doctor. I accept this award.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Even now, the blinding light that fended off the darkness still shines in my dreams, though I am still far, far away from her.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: May my banner protect all those who are innocent before my eyes.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: My friends, as long as we stand together, there will be no evil we can't overcome!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Follow me. Forward!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: If battle is unavoidable, I will not allow my weaknesses to get in my way.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Phew... I'm ready.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Your orders, please.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: It's my duty to stand here.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I will not back down.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Can't you hear the children's cries?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Can't you feel the cities crumbling away?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You've never ever noticed the hideous grins of conspirators.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Could you ever imagine… friends turning against each other, and homeland fading into nothing but memories?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I simply want to defend the people's right to live, and it doesn't matter if they are Victorians or Infected.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: You showed me that even weeds struggling to grow in the ruins can stand tall. Thank you.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I can only hope they will come to understand their injustice.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, this time, I'll stay. Hurry and take the others to safety.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Phew... I reckon it won't be easy to slack off once I become an actual staff member here?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Eh? Oh, hello!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Are you tired? I've baked some scones. Please, sit down, have some tea, and tell me what's on your mind.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Here's some trifle, pudding, and carrot cake... Oh, is it too much? Sorry, I've been a little nervous for the whole morning. Before I knew it, I'd already made this much... Hehe, let's just say I made you all these desserts to thank you for everything you've done. I hope you can spend the year surrounded by sweetness.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey, Doctor, you look cheerful as always!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: This Victorian poetry anthology is one I always used to read, back in County Hillock. Now, I'm giving it to you. Oh, there's one passage I really love—'Old Sunlight hugs tight all the town in her bosom. Old Moonlight bends down with a kiss to the wild.' The feeling you give me is, really, just as warm as that. Heheh, have a happy birthday, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I may have left the military, but my honor and calling are things I won't lay aside. In future, I'll return to where my duty lies. Please, don't worry. The memories we've made, the ideals we've borne together at Rhodes Island, they will always be carved upon this ensign, to be forever by my side.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, these are your tasks for the day. Yeah. A whole pile of work. Let's get to it.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Is Ifrit making trouble again? Sorry. I'll discipline her later.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Zzzzz… Sorry, I was taking a nap… I'm still not used to working during the day.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: My reasons for quitting Rhine Lab? So much happened since I signed on, I don't even know where to start…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Have you ever heard of a woman named Saria? Like me, she was once a scientist at Rhine Lab, and she was one of the people responsible for the creation of Ifrit…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Our biology research at Rhine Lab went so far as to implant Originium Shards into living bodies… Sorry, we'd better change the subject.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Saria? You mean she's here at Rhodes Island too? Is she here for Ifrit…? After she walked out on us like that, why would she come here right now…?!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I will not allow Ifrit to see Saria. Please trust me, this is for Ifrit's own good…!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Are you trying to cure Oripathy too? I heard that you were involved in the development of medical technology at Rhodes Island. Heheh… you must be looking forward to a breakthrough, as a researcher yourself.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: …Asleep already? All right. I'll handle the rest of the work.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Olivia Silence, an Originium scientist from the Rhine Lab Medical Research Institute. My hope is to rid the world of Oripathy… even if it means risking my life in the process.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I will make good use of this new power.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Is my medicine effective? Wonderful. This news brings me even greater joy than my promotion.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, I am looking forward to the day when the world is finally cured of Oripathy. In fighting and studying with you, I think that day may not be far off.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Understood. I'll focus on support.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Come on, team, let's fight with all our might.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Originium… Are you to blame for this battle?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Observe and determine the form of Infection. Such data will be useful for research.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Doctor, let me do it.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: No abnormality detected.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Concentrate.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Stay calm.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I'll heal you.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: No need to panic.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Deploying.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Support incoming.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: In order to defeat stronger enemies, must we make further use of Originium's power…?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Medical team, please take tissue samples from the Infected, we need to see the composition of the Infection in this area.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: All wounded personnel, please remain calm. The medical team will get to you.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: …Now is not the time for despair. We must withdraw immediately.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This room… Ugh… It's like it's designed to make me sleepy!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, you're kinder these days.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Have you seen Ifrit, Doctor? They're shooting off fireworks outside, so I'm a little worried… Yes, I'm going back to the lab after I put her to bed. No, I haven't forgotten what day it is. This is just how I want to welcome the new year. Oh right, happy New Year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good day, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, I have a proposal for your review: a new medical drone model. Oh, and I've heard it's your birthday. I didn't mean it like this, but hopefully you find it a practical gift.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: There's no lack of ambition and idealism in the field of life sciences… I myself was drawn by those ideals before I found my true calling. But thanks to Rhodes Island, I now know what I'm researching and fighting for.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I shall come! Doctor, so long as I am here, thou mayst be at ease in thy work!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I grew from childhood in the monastery. Though I could recite the texts from heart, I never fully understood their inner meanings, and my old head priest and the other great masters gave explanations from which I could comprehend even less. Doctor, thou art of learned stature. Mayst thou be able to teach me?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Rhodes Island truly lacks none for novel machinery... hm? Doctor, underestimate me not. I may begin clueless, but I am no contrarian to the times. If I do not know how, then I need only learn. My personal music player even holds some songs of the good Miss Sora within it.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: So as to evade Catastrophe, I once accompanied my old head priest and fellow monastery apprentices over mountain and valley. My head priest spoke that Catastrophes were the wrath of the gods. Yet, I have never witnessed one by my own eyes. I am somewhat curious.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I am not a true monk, merely raised by the monastery. At my departure, Saga was the name my old head priest gave to me. Its meaning is of high mountains and rugged roads. And only when I left the monastery, did I come to know how the world was no straightforward thing.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I swallow hardship, and fear not fatigue, yet there is still one thing I cannot assent to. My master spoke that all living beings are equal. The Infected are people all the same, people only fallen ill. Why can they not be permitted to live?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Ho-ho. I may have only erred upon a Rhodes Island recruitment spot at first, but whether the food or the beds, it is all of great quality, and the pay pales not. I truly have stumbled upon a wonderful place.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: When I left the monastery, I had thought that entering society would involve no more than dealing with pests, ridding some despots. I had never dreamt it would be so treacherous as this. There are times I do not even know what I draw my blade for. Doctor... I do not understand.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I still puzzle over much in my heart, but I have understood at least that some answers I must seek myself, and some thoughts I must think through myself. Doctor, until I have sorted it all out, I wish to continue my training by thine side. Pray, allow me this!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor... ho, thou art quite skillful to fall asleep sitting. In that case, I shall meditate for a while.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Thou art the Doctor? Hail and well... ah, ought not I be more serious at times like these? Ahem—my name is Saga. I am a wandering monk. Should there be any place thou mayst need me, refrain not in sending me!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Ho-ho. To think such strategy does exist in the world. My horizons have broadened.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A raise? Splendid! I have been watering at the mouth to try the deluxe set at the cafeteria for quite some time, yet have been embarrassingly out of pocket... today, I am finally able to feast!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Dear head priest. In my heart yet is wild disarray. The ways of this world I still cannot see through, nor cut down. Though I am fortunate to have met with great people, and with their guidance, there will come a day in our turbulent mortal world where I cut through to the heavens!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I shall come!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Am I the captain? Not a problem!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I shall go!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: My blade cuts only evil!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Takuan-zuke... hah! I am right here!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Leave this to me!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I am here!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Who dares be rash!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Sever all desires!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Cleanse the six senses!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Natto gohan!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Aburaage!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: 'Twas truly an arduous trial. I have gained greatly for it.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: As expected of the Doctor! Alone, I would surely have let quite a few through.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: My head priest spoke that one must have a merciful heart, and I believe that this suffices, more or less.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, go quickly! Leave the rear to me!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What is this scent?!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What-ho?!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Call, and I shall surely come running.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Ah, Doctor. Happy New Year. I am writing a letter. My travels have kept me away from the monastery for some years, and I have grown used to my current life. Yet at days like this, I can't help but miss head priest and the other disciples. Perhaps it is time for a visit.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, hast thou eaten? An unfilled stomach will surely leave thee powerless at work.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Today is the day thou camest into this realm. It is of two meanings—to be delivered into it is to be born, and to transcend likewise is to be born. Once my head priest told me that should one be capable of understanding the realm to be of void nature, in doing so they come of it. However, I believe it is not a realm bare and empty, but a self at ease and free in being that is truest to the message.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Head priest once said, 'for that which must be done, act despite the impossibility.' I used to think it was a simple statement. After all, there were no tasks that could not be done, only those that should and should not be done. But as my travels continued, I realized it was a profound truth, worthy of acting upon for my entire life.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Heheh, Dr. {@nickname}, What can I do for you today?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Combat missions take up most of my job, where I just havoc around with my hammer... It feels nice to get to sort files like this every once in a while.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: When I worked for RIM Billiton, I was in charge of a lot of things: mining ores, doing geological surveys with electromagnets, all kinds of stuff. Hmm... sounds like a mouthful, right? To put it simply, I smashed what blocks the way and kept digging down!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Amiya has a lot on her shoulders. If only I could help share her burden a little... And perhaps yours too, Doctor. Don't hesitate to let me know if there's anything you need help with!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Providing cover, trailblazing, area denial... I might not be able to literally shield my teammates like the Defender Operators, but I can still protect everyone in my own way!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Did... did I manage to keep everyone safe?... *Sign of Relief* I'm so rapt... Please, Doctor, from now on, let me stay with you and Amiya!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, want a cabbage veggie salad with mushroom pies? Yep, I made three servings! Yours, mine, and another for Amiya. She loves the pies I make!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The running backs on the football field are unstoppable. They just keep charging forward in spite of everything, all to clear a path for their teammates. And then they just fall down and leave it to everyone else to finish the job. Isn't that sort of like what I do? It's very cool! I hope I don't have to get tackled though.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, as long as I get to stay with you and Amiya, it's enough for me. Memories belong in the past, while the future is waiting for us to color it in. Amiya and I will continue to create more memories with you in the days to come!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, seems you've got some time to spare... Then let's go get groceries for tea tonight!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Savage, from RIM Billiton, reporting for duty! The moment I got the message from you and Amiya, I rushed right over to see what I could do. Huh? You don't remember anything? Strewth!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Ooh, I see. Uh-huh… I totally understand it now!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I feel a lot better taking orders from you, Doctor. I won't let you down!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Don't worry, Doctor. No matter how many enemies there are, as long as you're with me, I'll smash 'em all!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Savage, in position!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Everyone, follow me closely!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Begin the attack!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Target located. Attack!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm ready!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: What's next?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Leave it to me!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: This one's mine!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Haaaa!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Mjolnir-3, full power!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Piece of cake!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Incoming!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Hmm, guess no mission's too difficult for us!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: What? It's over already? Easy-peasy!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: ...I'd give my performance a C.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: It's too dangerous here! We have to fall back!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Huh? You're really trusting me with work this detail-oriented?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmm? Nnngg?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: All done with work for the day!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! And also to you, Amiya, my little beaut~ Here's to the year you grow tall as a tree. And Doctor, here's to... augh, well, here's to a lighter workload! No more overtime!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Yahoo~ Doctor! Good morning!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I remember you used to love—oh, I bet you don't remember yourself, do you? Oh well, I'm sure you'll still love this butter and pulled-meat pie! It's the taste of a happy life. Amiya's words.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I'm a little dazed all of a sudden, seeing everyone at Rhodes Island so happy. After all we've been through, just having you and Amiya here, safe and sound, is already more than I could ask for. I'll be with you from here on out, fighting to preserve this happiness.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I've checked your schedule. Isn't it time you took a break? If you'll excuse me.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Evolution is the law of nature. But Rhine Lab attempted to tamper with this law, even to take control of it. What a foolish endeavor…

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: As a researcher, have you ever participated in some experiments you probably shouldn't have? No? That's good.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Don't you think it's too noisy at Rhodes Island? Everyone should be quiet and focused during work. You should enforce discipline on your subordinates.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My true power has nothing to do with first aid. However, I have slightly adjusted the operation of this power to accommodate it to your command.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: You think Calcification Arts only makes organisms weaker? You're wrong. I can condense calcium into a tough enamel. The enemies can try as they want, but no one can break my shield.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You've seen me arguing with Silence? Yes, we do that a lot... Sorry for causing trouble for you and Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Please tell Ifrit on my behalf, 'No matter what happens, I will protect you'... Meet her? No, I'm not ready for that.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Even in the most desperate of situations, one must stand fast to be a symbol of strength for the people they hold dear. That is where I draw my line and how I live my life. You'll do the same, won't you?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I'll go back to my room if there's no further assignments.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Saria, formerly of the Rhine Lab Medical Research Institute Experiment Team. As for now... I need Rhodes Island's help to bring the astray back to the orthodox.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: What are you doing?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Good, you must continue motivating your subordinates with your ideas if you hope to maintain influence over them.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Promotion? I don't want any special treatment. But for Ifrit's sake, I do need your help to correct all those twisted laws and rules.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I am within my rights to oversee and bring up my own opinion on your command.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Send me the operation briefing, I will review it.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: All operators must maintain strict discipline.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Are they the ones who caused such destruction and started all this conflict?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: It's my turn.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Suppress them.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Forward.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Vermin.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Just who are you weaklings going to stop like that?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: This will be over soon.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Solidify.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Yielding is not an option.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Your tactics appear modern, yet the ideas behind them are primitive at their roots. Just who are you?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: All must return to the existing order. None may disobey the rules.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The routed enemies may be calling for reinforcements. We must not drop our guard before we find the last of them.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Where did I go wrong...?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This room has interesting decor. I'd be more fond of a futuristic style, though.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hm? What?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, you might do a bit of research into the past in your free time. You will find many a thing of great interest.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Life is the accumulation of maturity. Hone yourself well in the coming year, {@nickname}.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, are you well?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: According to the rota, you have a workday today. I'll tell any operators who come with gifts to wait to celebrate until you're done with work. The gifts, I'll accept on your behalf and place at the entrance. I'll be placing my present among them as well. Happy birthday, Doctor. Time to get to work.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The founding of regulations and traditions symbolizes that they might be broken, and it is not my job to judge nor to punish, but simply to see disorder rewound to order and chaos returned to organization. The road is a challenging one, but I won't be stopped.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Forget it. I'm almost retired, and it's about time I enjoyed some leisure... there's no end to work. How about you stop shutting yourself in here and go outside with me for once? It's a fine day out there.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: The young man at the front desk gave me a huge cake. Good thing a few kids passed by, and they got through the whole thing pretty quick. Take it home? No, there's only me at home, and I wouldn't be able to finish it before it spoiled.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Why ask about His Holiness? I can't tell you much. We never quite saw eye-to-eye from a young age, though we managed to work together for decades because we shared the same devotion to the Holy City. Even today, I wouldn't say we're much more than acquaintances... but then, perhaps the fact that we're not friends is precisely the reason we've been able to tolerate each other for so long.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I was delighted when Fia said she wanted to become a gun-knight. Nothing makes you prouder than your child wanting to take up your mantle. She being a Liberi was no obstacle at all, smart and hard-working as she is. And I would have done anything to make her dream come true. But kids grow up, people change...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: There were lots of friends I tried to convince to stay, but failed. It was only a long time later I realized it wasn't because of me that they left, but because of Laterano. The city's glory is like the sun, its brilliant radiance suffers no stars. But it is the duty of the stars to shine upon the night where the sun does not.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Laterano has been turned on its head. The old Law is gone. But I still have faith in the Holy City, and in the ties that bind us to one another. Otherwise, why would those who left the Holy City return to defend it together with me... right, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I heard Fia made some friends here. Does she get along with the others? She's got a sharp tongue, but deep down she's hiding a heart of gold... I guess it's my fault for making fun of her too much when she was little. But then, where's the fun in raising a child, if you don't make fun of her?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: What a tear-jerker. I should've picked a comedy for movie night. How embarrassing, crying my heart out like that in front of you... the tear glands get so much weaker as you age, you know. Say, am I imagining it, or are your eyes even redder than mine are? Come now, no need to fight the tears.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: This letter? Oh, it's nothing, just word that an old friend has passed away. I personally escorted her out of the Holy City when she contracted Oripathy, many years ago. I don't even remember what she looked like, how awful I am. I wish I could've seen her one last time, even if it meant getting punched in the face.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Feel free to lean against me if you're tired, though I'm not exactly soft. This suit is almost as ancient as I am. It's gone through quite a few major overhauls, but it's still a... reliable partner.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: A pleasure to meet you, Doctor. You know me as Fia's grandpa, if you've heard of... the Sankta Miksaparato... I really regret letting Fia fill out my recommendation form.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: That was one wild shot from Fia. Reminds me of when I was young.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: What is WRONG with your medics?! Do they think I'm a child? A medal just for cooperating with medical personnel? Shouldn't that be common sense? And… what're they giggling about?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: You see all these medals? That Vampire told me to come here to claim my prize. I can't guess what you're going to give me. Another medal? Is it a 'collect twenty to get the grand prize' deal?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'll help, but you'd better sit down with me for a mug of mead once this is over.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Why do I feel like I'm taking a bunch of kids out to a picnic?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Why does this suit of armor feel like it's gotten tighter, especially around the waist? Thankfully, my gun still feels the same as it ever has.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: What are you doing standing there? Come at me! And don't expect me to give you your last rites!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Good, a chance to try out my new hip.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: My bones will get rusty if I don't exercise.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'll hold this ground all on my own.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Don't underestimate these old bones.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I will not fall.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: You will not fall.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: No one will fall.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: No one will touch that which I defend.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Blood? No, I'm not hurt. Just a loose tooth that fell out. Lucky, spares me a visit to the dentist.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: No need to thank me. I hardly broke a sweat.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Are we done? We should go home, then. If we didn't do bad, then I say we did good.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'm fine. I've been in worse pickles before. Come now, don't look so sullen. Maybe a bit of ice cream will cheer you up? My treat.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Anyone in the mood for some classic Lateran soap operas? They're pretty good up to the point where you fall asleep.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Take it easy, you'll shatter my old bones.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: A little pot of tea, a big plate of raspberry pie. Let's sit down and talk.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Don't complain about me being late. What's half an hour more or less? Have you any idea how long I waited for Fia to bring you folks to see me in Laterano? Besides, I still need to fix my hair since it got crushed under a helmet all day.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I brought some pastries. You can share them.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I heard it's your birthday. So I brought a vintage from my cellar to join in the fun... Oh, no need to be so polite. A bottle doesn't compare to a good time spent with friends.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The people by your side will leave you someday, Doctor, but they're never truly gone. They are the stars adorning the sky that is your life when you look up at night; distant though they may be, the light they leave behind for you will never die.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I... can take care of some basic tasks, but your assistant should be able to take on a large share of your work. That may be… beyond my abilities.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Prejudice is common between peoples. Before I came to Rhodes Island, I actually thought people outside of Sami left the womb with weapons in their hands... That's not a joke, Doctor. I really did.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You're still bothered by the cold? Hmm... Sometimes, I feel like you're needier than a newborn. Hold your hands out then... Haah... Feel better? You're welcome. Give me a moment, I'll fetch you another blanket.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Yes, I know this is a general education course meant for children. But a shaman's calling is to master all forms of knowledge, whether metal or wood. And my knowledge of the South probably isn't much greater than a local child. So a course like this suits me just fine.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Fighting is not in Sami nature. But, if you do not become the hunter, then you can only be the hunted. This is true whether facing the elements, the demons... or the people of Ursus. It's the law of nature.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I respect you, and so I give you my word. As long as I am aboard this iron ship, I will not trouble the people of Ursus. But when in Sami, I hope you'll turn a blind eye to... some of my actions. There is always a price to be paid, even if it falls to Ursus rather than a particular individual.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: My friends here at Rhodes Island made this outfit not long after I arrived. I was still a stubborn rockhorn back then, unwilling to accept even the slightest bit of kindness. Now... I'm probably not so inflexible. Even the coldest ice melts in the spring sun.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Tribe cannot go on without a shaman. It was painful to part with the branches of my family tree, and let go of the responsibility of protecting my tribesmen. It used to be my only wish to remain in my ancestral home, accompanying the long-withered tree. But now, that is not possible anymore...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: One crystallized eye is enough to turn a woman into a monster. The Southerners use Originium to command metal to move, yet fear that it will grow upon their bodies. Alas, what deadly weapons indifference and fear have become. Though they leave no wounds on the body, they instead bleed the spirit dry.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I wave a twig… for a fresh and healthy year...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: She was born under the tribe's santalla tree, so it became her identity, her codename, and a part of her life. Now the outcast returns to the tribe, regaining the right to use her name. She will commit herself to her new leader.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: They do not yet comprehend the enemy's cruelty…

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: May the generosity you've afforded me plant the seedlings of joy within your heart.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: The curse cannot extinguish the pain in my heart. Since it is conquest that Ursus craves, then let them be conquered by nature.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: What do you wish for the battlefield to become?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Protect our teammates, and victory will be ours.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Look into the distance, and be mindful of your feet. Nature has already warned you of the changes.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The hunter... and the hunted…

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Did you have need of me?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Your orders?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: As you wish.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: We shall begin.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: The withered tree demands sacrifices.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: The wild wind plunders your warmth.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: The deadly cold sends its regards.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: The eyes of Sami witness your end.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Perhaps in your eyes, nature is just another tool.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: You are the true hunter.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: War is like nature, full of variables.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: The blizzard approaches. We should go.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: My room, my domain…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Is there anything I can do for you?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: In Sami, there is no food sweeter than honey. Is this... candy? Hmm... Oh, so sweet!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Flames represent destruction, but also contain vitality and warmth. The wither and decay has been burned away, and a red light spreads across this land. Regardless of what difficulties you may face in the future, please do not forget today's vision of passion.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I am here, by your side.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Congratulations on completing another annual cycle of your life, Doctor. This should be the day when your strength is most abundant, so if there's anything you'd like to achieve, now is the time to start.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Many tribes prepare to leave their homeland behind and go south, whereas many warriors bade farewell to their loved ones and are making their way north. The Sami people seem to be splitting in two, never to see each other again. I cannot change this, but all I hope... is for everyone to be safe and sound.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor of Rhodes Island, I hope you fully understand that any extraneous information you provide to me will influence my evaluation of our cooperation... Of course, you can also use this as leverage in your negotiations.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I use this set of counting rods for accounting. It's a gemstone trading tradition dating back several centuries. You merely set it down like this, then... Ahem, I could show you how to use it, but I normally set it down just to let visitors know I'm busy. Besides, it's faster to use a calculator.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Your company's Engineering Department is very interested in my clockwork fowlbeast, and so I made a batch without surveillance functions. This one is for you... A hobby of mine? Hardly. It's a traditional craft in my family. There was a time when our work was unrelated to gemstones.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: That's true, I took over the gemstone trading post when I was fifteen. For three hundred years since the day the first set of scales went up, the one who stands behind the counter has never been important, much less his age. Visitors need only see order.  Are you perhaps questioning my abilities?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Are you... reading my medical report? Pardon me if this is inappropriate. It's true that I often injure myself with no rhyme or reason. Some say it's because of a family curse, and my life will be as short as the previous overseer. Still, I lived to see those gemstones returned, and that is more than long enough.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The caravan that is now disappearing into the golden sands will reach the markets I shall build anew. Once the commerce network is built, the settlement will grow stronger and stronger... Another 'City of Radiance'? No, I would rather it grow naturally. What happens in a hundred years will have nothing to do with me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Come here, little cutie. Give this can of meat a try. You'll love it, that's right... Uh... No, it's not right! Doctor, since when have you been here? I'm afraid I shouldn't be taking care of your operators' companions. Could you please help get this slumberfoot away from me?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Oh, my apologies. It's been an exhausting journey. I think I fell asleep— Hold on, you needn't have someone take me to the lounge. You were inspecting the cargo manifest. I had nothing to do and so... You want to tell a story to relax? Something about snow? Oooh, very well.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Trading necessitates weighing your bargaining chips as well as the human heart. After a few rounds of back-and-forth, I already have a good picture of the other party's heart. I feel honored to be able to partner with Rhodes Island, but what do you perceive when you see me...? If you believe this heart will one day grow wings, I shall want for nothing more.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Still asleep? The sands of time are flowing away one grain after another, even if you care not for the gemstone scoured with it.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I would like to thank Lady Anat for facilitating this partnership, but contrary to what she said, I am no longer the gemstone trading overseer of the 'City of Radiance'. All I have now is the codename known to the merchants, 'Sand Reckoner'.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: A pharmaceutical company cultivating its own bodyguards? Impressive.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you. If you choose to award medals to make our agreement more ceremonial, I shall prepare a few traditional Sargonian gifts. Do you prefer gold or silver?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I had a dream. I saw my clockwork fowlbeasts taking flight without returning to me. In the end, I stood in front of a long river empty-handed, yet... I couldn't help but feel relieved, knowing they would roam the skies free, knowing where to fly.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I weigh gains against losses, good against evil.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Judging by the security forces I've met, this team holds its own.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The clockwork fowlbeast has taken flight.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I shall not make deals with war and disaster.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What is it you are weighing?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: If there is anything you can't see clearly, you can ask me.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Treasures always lead to conflict.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Lives are always used as leverage.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I'm afraid your value is not as high as you imagined.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Can you offer nothing more?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: They who dwell in darkness will be punished.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: What heavy souls…

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Sands gather and disperse, life blooms and withers... You always pick the most difficult among the countless cycles. This is a priceless masterpiece, and I am honored to be its witness.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I do hope they will receive the forgiveness they deserve.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Do you wish to know their whereabouts, or the best terrain for a frontal counterattack? On this battlefield, there is nothing that I cannot see.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: No need to be disappointed. With a few more weights, the scales shall be balanced.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I cannot say I agree with post-Crystal Age aesthetic sensibilities.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Do you know how many fingers I've cut for disrupting the scales?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Do you have any thoughts on my electric head-bobbling cloudbeast figurine?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: This is the New Year. The beginning of the changing of seasons, and the day everyone purchases gemstones in hopes of improving their luck. If you need any, I can pick a few for you... You prefer one like mine...? Yes... perhaps starting this year, I should allow myself a little wish.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, remember to wear some more clothing— Um, my apologies. In the desert, the temperature can vary wildly between night and day. This is our customary greeting to visitors.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: In the past, to ensure that balance was not lost, the overseer was permitted no trusted aides. That's why I never had any time, even if I wanted to celebrate some special day... But if you have any worries, I am willing to lend you my assistance. You have my best wishes, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: My family's atonement is a secret, and as such, no one has ever asked me how one is to wash away the whole of Sargon's golden sands. Rhodes Island chose a similarly long-winding road. It is seeing you doubted by others that made me reexamine myself, after which I learned from your experience.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hm? Did I not explain that you were forbidden to enter without my express permission, after knocking? Oh? This is your office? You're working? Then have I not come out of my room to work as well? What is the meaning of 'your office'? Get out! I'm still sketching it out.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hm? Did I not explain that you were forbidden to enter without my express permission, after knocking? Oh? This is your office? You're working? Then have I not come out of my room to work as well? What is the meaning of 'your office'? Get out! I'm still sketching it out.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You want to see my painting? You may. For you, I could even give you the painting. But if you like it, I won't give it to you. You don't like it? Huh, then you wouldn't want it anyway. This is who I am. Deal with it.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You want to see my painting? You may. For you, I could even give you the painting. But if you like it, I won't give it to you. You don't like it? Huh, then you wouldn't want it anyway. This is who I am. Deal with it.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Haa… I'm trapped on this ship. If anyone asks, you tell them so, and you do not let them into my room. I'm taking up space? I'm refusing to perform my operator duties? Hello, I am Dusk, the great painter trapped in this room.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Haa… I'm trapped on this ship. If anyone asks, you tell them so, and you do not let them into my room. I'm taking up space? I'm refusing to perform my operator duties? Hello, I am Dusk, the great painter trapped in this room.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I'm not going out. Don't try to make me go out, I don't want to go out. I no longer care for the world outside. Do I dislike it? I like it fine. The mountains and rivers, the flowers and feathers, the pools and forests, the common folk, young and old, I could paint forever, I could watch forever, and yet, I will not go. It does not hold my interest forever.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I'm not going out. Don't try to make me go out, I don't want to go out. I no longer care for the world outside. Do I dislike it? I like it fine. The mountains and rivers, the flowers and feathers, the pools and forests, the common folk, young and old, I could paint forever, I could watch forever, and yet, I will not go. It does not hold my interest forever.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I loathe the word 'taste.' What gives these people the confidence to demand something good just as they open their mouths to lock the gates to others? It is unbecoming. If you are satisfied, you are satisfied. Should you enter, you must not bar the gate. Do you see the twin moons thinking only of themselves?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I loathe the word 'taste.' What gives these people the confidence to demand something good just as they open their mouths to lock the gates to others? It is unbecoming. If you are satisfied, you are satisfied. Should you enter, you must not bar the gate. Do you see the twin moons thinking only of themselves?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: An opportunity to watch me paint in earnest comes but once in a lifetime to one in ten thousand individuals. 'When the time comes, the strength of heaven and earth are one.' Ch'i, bone, shape, color, method, pouring out as a vast river, fine like the shadow of mountain bamboo, such is my brush, and it will not stop.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: An opportunity to watch me paint in earnest comes but once in a lifetime to one in ten thousand individuals. 'When the time comes, the strength of heaven and earth are one.' Ch'i, bone, shape, color, method, pouring out as a vast river, fine like the shadow of mountain bamboo, such is my brush, and it will not stop.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I took the time to partake of some contemporary works. Films are not bad, they are like paintings. The good ones all have a unique strength of character, with form, and with decent meaning. Right, poetry and painting have a legacy. Do you have time to help me burn Nian's mountain of garbage? She is denigrating the very concept of cinema. Please.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I took the time to partake of some contemporary works. Films are not bad, they are like paintings. The good ones all have a unique strength of character, with form, and with decent meaning. Right, poetry and painting have a legacy. Do you have time to help me burn Nian's mountain of garbage? She is denigrating the very concept of cinema. Please.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Food? Oh, thank you. Hm, where does this drink come from? It's good. Quite good. But I feel like it's missing something. You want to know what I usually eat? Then close your eyes. Ah~ You feel nothing, yes? That's because if you don't look, the food in my paintings does not exist.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Food? Oh, thank you. Hm, where does this drink come from? It's good. Quite good. But I feel like it's missing something. You want to know what I usually eat? Then close your eyes. Ah~ You feel nothing, yes? That's because if you don't look, the food in my paintings does not exist.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Take a look at Nian's carefree expression. You know the truth, don't you? She cares quite a bit about our lives, and our deaths. As for me? I may not get along with the wretched scribbler, but neither of us care much. When people die, the paintings remain. When I die, my work remains.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Take a look at Nian's carefree expression. You know the truth, don't you? She cares quite a bit about our lives, and our deaths. As for me? I may not get along with the wretched scribbler, but neither of us care much. When people die, the paintings remain. When I die, my work remains.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Dreams are like unto life, like unto the scroll. One sleeps this sleep, will one sleep for millennia?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Dreams are like unto life, like unto the scroll. One sleeps this sleep, will one sleep for millennia?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Oh? {@nickname}? Another contract? Very well, please don't bother me again after I sign this one. Here... I should tell you here and now: I, Dusk, do not give out my paintings. Not to anyone. And I don't take commissions!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Oh? {@nickname}? Another contract? Very well, please don't bother me again after I sign this one. Here... I should tell you here and now: I, Dusk, do not give out my paintings. Not to anyone. And I don't take commissions!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hm? A swing of an axe becomes rivers of blood. Do you mean... you want me to paint this?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hm? A swing of an axe becomes rivers of blood. Do you mean... you want me to paint this?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Why use a sword? There is a reason. 'With an inkstone sheath, one may learn the annals. With a brush sword, one may paint the celestial.' Is it true? Naturally, I speak off the cuff.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Why use a sword? There is a reason. 'With an inkstone sheath, one may learn the annals. With a brush sword, one may paint the celestial.' Is it true? Naturally, I speak off the cuff.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Ahh, to make it this far with me... I should paint you a scroll. But be careful! Do not get caught up within it. The world I paint is much more fascinating than this one. How many have been lost, since ancient times? How many have escaped?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Ahh, to make it this far with me... I should paint you a scroll. But be careful! Do not get caught up within it. The world I paint is much more fascinating than this one. How many have been lost, since ancient times? How many have escaped?

It's like partitioning a tiny dot on a scroll, thinking what to draw here, what to draw there, coming and going full circle, living and dying in exhaustion. But whatever. A moment of laughing and feasting is valid enough, I suppose.

No, the decorations on the wall were me scrawling randomly, and I didn't draw them just because Closure asked me to. Once again, I don't take commissions.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Our meals used to be fairly nice in the past... but the quality's gone downhill since we joined Indra's group.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I had a dream... a dream where the sun rises, and in the distance beyond the horizon... there was my hometown. The place I might never get to return to, ever again.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Before I knew it, I'd gotten accustomed to this drifter's life... It's a strange thing. In the past I never imagined this was how I'd end up.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Gawain and company? I wouldn't say they ran into me, more like they picked me up off the streets.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I used to stand side by side with Indra's team when we fought in the streets of Victoria... Looking back, I suppose it's a fairly fond memory to me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Stay on your guard! I know you've done the best you can, but there may be unknown dangers beyond our abilities.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: If we're ever put in a tough situation... then I may well act on my own motives. And if it comes to that, Doctor, I hope you'll join me too in... no, never mind for now.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hm? You fell asleep?... I wonder if you ever dream of your hometown, too.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I've passed the strength test, right? So assign me some missions. Don't let this hammer get too bored. My codename? They call me the Siege. Curious name, but it's got a nice ring to it.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record

voices.title: Promotion 2

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It's like I can hear an all-too-familiar chime again... I hope the new year's sun will be enough to tear through the hazy Londinium skies.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Oh, it's you, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I look back fondly on the way I used to celebrate this sort of thing with Indra and the gang. We'd drink ourselves half to death, right on the street, and make a racket to match, but that doesn't seem so appropriate now... Still, I've got some lollipops on me. Want one?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, as a leader, do you ever find yourself confused too? Do you feel the same heavy burden when your choices can impact the fates of so many? I'm not one to flee from my duty, but there is so much that requires careful consideration... I may want some guidance from you.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: 'Please give any tasks that require doing directly to Lens.'

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: 'Miss Scene is the simultaneous champion of the Nature and Still-Life categories in major photography competitions. If anyone is willing to wait, the probability of winning the Portrait category will also increase significantly. Doctor, do you want to be a model for Miss Scene?'

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: 'Detecting that the Doctor's patience is fading. Commencing conciliation sequence — there is only less than half an hour left before Miss Scene completes the shooting. Please hold on a bit longer.'

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: 'The Zalak next door is looking for Miss Scene again. Though she hasn't laughed yet, I can tell she's very happy.'

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: 'Truthfully, Miss Scene originally wanted to work as a full-time photographer for a giant photographic equipment company in Columbia, but she ended up as an operator here anyway. According to Lens, it may be because the other party asked her to take pictures that she didn't want to. Indeed, Miss Scene is very picky.'

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: 'Doctor, are you trying to get Miss Scene to laugh again? In actuality, she is already laughing, but if you want to see it, you'll have to wait, and wait, and wait... and continue waiting until the curvature of her mouth becomes perfect. This process will take time — I can't tell you in exactly how many minutes, but it all depends on how the lass is feeling today.'

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: 'Lens has long been waiting for someone who can understand Miss Scene, but now there are many people in Rhodes Island who are willing to interact with her. This makes Lens very happy, and I wish that one day Miss Scene can find someone who can replace me.'
