voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: 'Miss Scene is not well-suited for a lively party like this. She would be at a complete loss. Therefore, Lens will have a drink with her here. Would you like me to help you with anything? Lens's music database has been updated with three new songs. Please press the button here to select one!'

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Although I know this is beyond the scope of an assistant's duties, I would like to tidy up your desk for you before work. Something as simple as stacking your books into a neat pile helps manage one's inner biases and distractions. Would you like to try, Doctor? Don't worry, I'm here to help. Why don't we start with this little mountain of documents?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Why do I have all these bottles of ink on my desk? Are you an ink enthusiast too? Hehe, of course you can borrow some. I have Ceramic Gray for dignity, Feldspar Gray for simplicity and Cloud Gray for elegance. Which are you most partial to...? Oh, they all look the same to you...? Well, I do have some ink the Logistics Department gave to me. Let's get you started with that, shall we?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Baizao fare is defined by delicacy rather than dearness. The lingzhi mushrooms used in Fortune Soup need three years to mature. Tea leaves need prior removal of stems before they can be made into a bowl of tea soup rice, which imparts a light sweetness to the final dish. Whether a meal is frugal or abundant should not change the feeling with which you cook it. Whether your life is poor or rich should not change the feeling with which you live it. That is the bone and soul of Baizao.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Blaze is spreading rumors that I deal in ancient texts? Aww, this is but a collection of historical records. I simply cannot bear to see them lost in the long river of time. Ballads, proverbs, poems, even accounting ledgers. They all harbor secrets between their lines... Hmm...? Doctor, what was that you were hiding just now? Don't worry, I won't conduct any research without permission. Soooo, what is it you're hiding?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The first time I challenged my superior was over his demand to soften a satirical poem into something more pleasant. Yet to what degree is the truth distorted in the name of this pleasantness? How many narratives massaged? How many people... The chronicles of history cannot be a curated collection of comfortable tales.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The Yanese delight in leaving our mark on history, to accomplish great things worthy of record. But what did Father think? Did he ever feel regret? I cannot say. But how could one label him insignificant? A man like him is not mere marginalia or interlinear space… he is the very page upon which history is inscribed.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You are full already, Doctor? No, you're not. Here, try a Laobing. It's a beastmeat pancake of Yang nature, and best paired with bamboo shoot and lily soup for Yin. Oh, and these seasonal apricot blossom pastries are an absolute must! Haha, I'll chronicle today thusly: 'Springtime wandering with a companion, our bellies full, bathed in apricot blossom shadows, sharing wine beneath rustling branches'. That is true refinement.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My relationship with Blaze isn't nearly as harmonious as you say. She's far less well-behaved with me than she is with you. I've apologized to her. After all, she could have led a peaceful life. What did she do? It was a forehead flick. With such force as to leave you dazed for hours. But thanks to that, I've found the courage to maintain our relationship thereafter.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Grandfather cherished his garden, though the two persimmon trees he nurtured bore fruit perpetually astringent, fit only for drying. We would wash the harvest, then spread them out to dry, finally dusting them with a sugar coating as delicate as freshly fallen snow. The sweetness would mask the bitterness, deceiving the tongue, rendering them unexpectedly palatable... Ah, what a pristine snowfall.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Perfect, what a flawless moment… each of us working quietly, our focus undisturbed. How about we go for a warm meal and a break? Say, in two hours' time?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Oh, I've already been introduced? Please, don't believe a word Blaze says. The girl still insists I'm a folk singer. I am Xingzhu, a historian of Baizao. If you happen upon any intriguing ballads or proverbs, I'd be delighted if you would share them with me.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: How very educational. I've learned something new today.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: This medal in my hand represents your recognition that more than casualties are worth recording on the battlefield. At times, there may also be primroses in full bloom.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: There is a saying I am fond of that goes: the unofficial history is built verse by verse, lyric by lyric. When I think about how I myself will be a verse in the mundane saga, I find it pleasing.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: A spot of field research? How wonderfu—*cough* I will keep safety in mind.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Bring forth all your prowess. My pen shall stand witness.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: It's a golden opportunity to gather folk material myself. Is there anything I should take note of?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: *Sigh* One cannot discuss ice with an insect of summer. However shall I explain this to you?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Very well. I'm on my way.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: The road ahead is bumpy. Do take care.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: A glance is all I need to comprehend.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: There is much to be recorded.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: My ink and pen may never rest, my stack of papers put to test.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: A humble scholar's duty is all I claim, the way of life that leads not to shame.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Cross mount and river, night of gale and snow, all blankets any whisper of my home.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Here, some poprice candy. Just a little while longer, okay?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I can finally breathe easy. Why don't we get something to eat, Doctor, once you're finished with work? I said after work. The hawker stalls aren't going anywhere.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Hmm… Let me ponder how best to commend your exceptional leadership. Yes, a Compendium of Extraordinary Talents would undoubtedly be less vivid without your story.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I've already meticulously documented the physical characteristics of the escapees. Would you prefer to handle this immediately, or take a brief respite first?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I don't think you need to be bolstered by those 'rallying' folk tales right now. Here, this should do the trick. Delightfully sweet and sour, isn't it? Feeling a bit better now?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: May I ask how to get to the archive? Oh, so it's not in the dormitories... Then could you please tell me where the library is?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh my! Please, keep the jests in moderation…

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: There was a girl, with words so sweet, who stole two chops of burden-meat. She made two biscuits, oiled them neat, then gorged so much she had to bleat: 'Oh! Ouchie-Eek!'…

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I used to detest the clamor of the new year, but now, I find myself with rather more complicated feelings, sitting alone in this courtyard. So I ended up writing a poem on the wall. Instead of wallowing in misery, I would rather whimsically spill my ink. Are the splashes not like silent fireworks, Doctor?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Have you eaten yet, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Oh, Doctor, I dropped my notebook at the noodle house. I need you to come along with me and—Why do we need to go together? Look, ah… erm… well… Sorry, I meant this as a birthday surprise, to offer you a Yanese longevity noodle. It's remarkably challenging for one who despises dishonesty to tell such white lies.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, we have a tradition of gifting each other books on commemoration days at the academy. I thought long and hard about what you needed before deciding on this: 'Calligraphy: From Amateur To Adept'—It sounds like homework? Nonsense. Just one page a day, and you'll learn to love the tranquility of mastering your strokes.

operators.name: シヴィライト・エテルナ

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I still remember this conference room. This seat… was it reserved for Theresa? No... I have no need for it.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Theresa is no more. This body, this vestige before you, is but a program that exists within the 'King of Sarkaz.' My form and my presence are the result of Amiya's emotions. As much as I may remember everything from the past, please do not mistake me for Theresa herself.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I will stay by Amiya's side, accompanying everyone here at Rhodes Island. Though, this hardly makes up for all the lost time... Doctor, I'm not a program in the same sense as PRTS. See? You might not be able to feel my body temperature, but I can at least smile.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Rhodes Island has strode beyond war, and should now re-embark on her intended route. For starters, how about optimizing our logistics? There are several conference rooms that can be freed up and converted into sickbays... You'd like my personal opinion? Doctor, allow me to remind you again, I am not Theresa.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: 'Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals Inc.'... registered to Amiya's hometown... And these medicines... They were all developed by Kal'tsit... No, I have no regrets. Babel has fulfilled its duty. Rhodes Island will continue to sail, and continue to alleviate sickness and pain. If Theresa was here, I'm sure she would have been pleased.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Never have I regretted any of my decisions. We did everything we could have done, and bequeathed hope unto the future. Time will close wounds, love will mend scars. When the long night ends, Rhodes Island will usher in the light of dawn. Though many have left us along the way, I will remain here and bear witness to the ending.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Amiya still looks so thin and frail. For a girl at this age, maybe she should be a bit taller? All these days, has she been eating well…? How she so wished to see Amiya as she is now, to watch her grow for just a bit longer. Her wish should have been granted...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Kal'tsit still refuses to speak to me. When she poses questions to this crown, she avoids looking me in the eye. 'The King of Sarkaz' remembers her past. While I can sympathize with her loneliness, I cannot free her from her shackles. Perhaps one day, Doctor, you can help her find meaning in her existence, as her companion.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, you carry such guilt within your eyes. But you ask, is one's memory sufficient to define who they are? You have lost your memories. I merely inherited all of hers. How are we to settle what happened so long ago? Doctor, go and spend some more time with Amiya and Kal'tsit. None shall linger in the past, except her.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Are you weary, Doctor? Then, go ahead and rest. Everyone has the right to fall into peaceful slumber, and you are no exception.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: ...I'm here.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: …Did I just see Amiya fighting?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I still remember every medal I distributed with these very hands. These ceremonies are also commitments. Rhodes Island will never give up on her ideals, let sacrifices be in vain, or forget about those who've traveled with her. Even now, we remain on the same course we originally charted.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I know, there are still many people who need me. Don't worry. This time, I'm not going anywhere.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Will you lead us to victory once more, Doctor?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I will stand alongside the warriors of Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Warriors of Rhodes Island, may you all return victorious.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I can hear the sorrow within you all.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Doctor, I have faith in your command.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: It's okay. I am with you.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Amiya, get behind me.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I am right here. I will always remain with you.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I will remember each and every one of you.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Your ideals... are equally worthy of respect.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Keep striding forward. I shall be at your side.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Don't cry. It will all be over soon.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: There shall come a day... when we can strike alight the flames that burn away all decay.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: You always make the perfect calculations so that everything falls into place just as you planned, don't you?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Without you, our casualties would have been far worse... Thank you, Doctor.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We will be able to move beyond this pain and suffering. Rhodes Island will not stop here.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: A new security system? Will it still recognize me?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Boo! Did I scare you?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I'm watching you, Doctor.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Rhodes Island is a lot livelier than it used to be. Though there's still so much unfinished business, this moment of peace is precious nevertheless. Doctor, can you give these storybooks and toys to the children for me? It's something Theresa always used to do.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Program initializing. Accessor: Dr.{@nickname}.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. How did you used to celebrate this day in the previous world? It must've been a scene full of warmth and happiness. I found one such song in 'Civilight Eterna.' Would you like to listen to it? Before that, Doctor, may you never be alone again in the journey ahead.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: 'Rhodes Island.' This very name fills one with warmth and comfort. Surely, tender memories will rush forth as soon as you speak these words. I hope that Rhodes Island can continue to carry forth the hopes and expectations of countless people, and in the future, become home for many, many more.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Need me to make you some midnight snacks, Boss?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Here you go, Boss. And this. You mentioned it before... Everyone says I have a good memory, but I don't know.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: When I'm off… I practice cooking. Not just seafood. What do you like to eat, Boss?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Errr… Boss, is it usually on me to find something to talk about?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Boss, if you ever want to see a Lungmen night market, I can take you. It's fun... but not exactly safe.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Boss Lady Kal'tsit gave me special permission to use Rhodes Island's supply channels. Now I can try some new stuff. Any requests, Boss?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I had Officer Hoshiguma on me for a while, for a couple of reasons... But I know she was just looking out for me, same as the neighborhood aunties and uncles.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I've been told that with my looks, my good memory and knife skills, I was born to be a villain. I don't like that, and I've struggled to find a proper way to change myself. But after coming to Rhodes Island, I realized I should just live my own life.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Boss, do you think there's any way to put my memory to good use...? I never thought about it before, but it would be nice if I could help.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Bo... Oh, you're asleep. I'll just keep reading then.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hey, Boss. I'm Jaye. Officer Hoshiguma said I'd be better off working here, so here I am. I know seafood, I can cook, and I'm pretty good with a knife. I think I can help.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Oh... so cooking and warfare are pretty alike…

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Boss, does this mean I can expand my stall a bit more?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Boss, I figured it out. If you just treat the enemy like fish, then fighting is a lot easier.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I forgot to close up…

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I know how to lead a fishing crew.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Hm? We're going?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: That's a lot.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Yeah?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Right here.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'll try.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Ughh...

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Scale.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Gut.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Clean.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Slice.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Boss, did we just do something special?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Boss, is it... is it over?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Boss, should we go after them?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Boss, I think we should probably run.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I don't know if there's a suitable place to set up my stall…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Boss, I wonder if you have any food preferences...?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I used to always have to close up the stall late, but now all of a sudden it's a holiday. Can't say I'm used to it... Boss, you want some late-night chow? I'm a little hungry myself. I can cook something for us both.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey Boss, you're looking good today.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: It's your birthday today, Boss. Big day. I always remember it, but I'm no good at presents... How about I make you something to eat? Whatever you want, I'll whip it up.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: When Officer Hoshiguma said I should come to Rhodes Island, I was ready to work my hands to the bone. Then I realized, I may not get paid as much as I thought I would, but the work's also easier than I thought, so I guess it balances out... I'll keep doing my best, Boss.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hmm, is this the Doctor's room? Painfully sterile. Reminds me of Sargon's monotonous hilly terrain. Wouldn't hurt to install a game console, would it?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Dr.{@nickname}, I feel something resonating between us. Weird, right? Is it because we both have so much untapped potential? But you've forgotten your past. Feels like freedom to you? Or just another level of pain?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I take greater pride in natural wisdom than indoctrinated knowledge, Dr.{@nickname}! With Rhodes Island on my side, both you and I will grow ever-closer to the Great Truth. Hey, don't avert your gaze. Oh, are you feeling a touch... embarrassed?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: 'I wish to bridge the gap to the other side.' That was once a code phrase used to contact me. The bridge connects two lands, transferring wisdom and imbuing power... Hey, let me finish. Turning away mid-sentence? How terribly discourteous!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Rhodes Island is home to some folk devoid of aesthetic sensibility. A disguise isn't just a superficial layer, but an art of meticulous refinement. Without careful cultivation, one merely appears... disheveled. You think my clothing looks tattered? Ha! You simply fail to comprehend my nuanced style...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Do you believe weapons have souls? The things they've experienced, the hands that have wielded them, and the reasons they've been swung... No! These aren't souls. For a weapon, any belief or meaning is externally imposed. Tell me, are we the weapons, or are we the ones imposing souls onto others?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: A genius? Do such beings truly exist...? In Sargon, most craftsmen appear to me as mere apprentices still learning to walk, tinkering with metal. Yet, walk long enough, and even they may traverse the entire path.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Do you need my help refining a weapon? My skills are best kept hidden under a bushel. 'Enabling universal weapon access is tantamount to creating war'—this self-imposed shackle I must bear. Or... do you seek the key to unlock chaos across the land?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You know who I am? And my past? No, you don't, and you shouldn't. I maintain anonymity precisely to bury the past behind me. Forget it all, and let this skin I've shed sink into the depths of the deserts.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I don't mind this kind of peace and quiet.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I know precisely what you seek, Doctor of Rhodes Island! Your thirst for truth and power is palpable. And I, Sesa, am willing to bestow that very strength upon you... Woah, hold on! Don't throw me out! I'm here to apply for a position!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This weapon's output... I see…

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: ...You wish for greater power? Don't draw any unnecessary attention before the time is right. Otherwise, it'll be waaay too dangerous.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: 'The bridge connects, the ammunition embodies wisdom, the weapon expresses will, and harmony manifests equality.' Do you wish to shatter the misty veil obscuring the Truth? Perhaps I can lend you a touch of power... just a little bit.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: The 'bridge' yearns… for those weapons in your hands... May I take a closer look?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Let me guide you... Just apply this oil to the bolt slot of your crossbow. Make sure you apply it evenly.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Cohorts, it's time to show the results of our efforts. Just remember, handle the weapons with the utmost care.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The battlefield destroys both weapon and wielder.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: My arm is trembling...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Set me free! I'm supposed to yell that now, right?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: At long last...

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Doom, shall descend!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Free the weapon from its shell...

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Souls! Resonate as one!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I shall be your doom! I'm allowed to say stuff like that, right?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: How can you ever understand the suffering of the victims?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Such agony inevitably accompanies a fierce battle, but the weapon in hand never lies. It sings of victory!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: You are a bit too dependent upon my powers. Speak no more, same deal: a cup of black tea with two sugar cubes.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: To escape the malediction of a weapon is, for both sides, perhaps a blessing.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: No matter how far we run, the weapons will lie in wait, until the day they eradicate us.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: The Great Truth demands an equally great space to house it! Wait, no, I don't need a room this big...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Watch out! I... I'm still not able to fully control my powers!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Wanna hear a story? I know many old tales.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: A brand new year already. When will the day finally arrive that we brush with the truth... My tone's off? Right, I'm still rehearsing. Stop it, I know, I'll see you at the party soon.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Since today is your birthday, I shall share a secret incantation. Speak it, and you may unchain my true power... Actually, never mind. Dr.{@nickname}, you already know exactly what I'm capable of, don't you?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I understand your craving, on this day of retrospection, for ancient tales from the golden sands of Sargon, and truths that belong to the future... Hey now, don't go. I truly wished to share these stories, even if I failed... Never mind. Care for some tea?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I-Is there anything I can help with? Just say the word and I can do it.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Franka and Liskarm are so incredible! I really admire them. I want to become as great as they are someday. I can... I can do it! Will you help me, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Um, I heard word that Vanilla's here too? She was in my squad when she first joined Blacksteel. We went on missions together! She's become such a reliable Operator now... but I'm still just me...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, do I come off as... spineless? I know I shouldn't let people walk all over me... I'm trying to change...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Sometimes I feel like I'm back in Blacksteel, even after going through so much with Rhodes Island. I'm not the old me anymore, either... it's weird. Is it because I miss how it was back then? No, no. I don't miss the person I used to be, I know that for sure...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Hard work doesn't mean anything without results. That's what I think at least! That's why I don't want anyone to see me training alone. Having you, though... it's really comforting when you're with me, for some reason.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I pulled a muscle training a couple days ago... but don't worry, I-I'm okay! Urk...! I won't let this get in the way of you or anyone at Rhodes Island, Doctor!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Freeze, hands in the air! Oh, did I scare you? I'm sorry, it's just Franka told me to be bold and assertive, and I only wanted to try it out... I'm really sorry...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Everyone at Blacksteel and Rhodes Island is so amazing and talented. I know I'm nothing compared to them... but, still, just every once in a while, I really like it when I get compliments...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor... Doctor? Are you sleeping? I'll clean your desk up for you, then...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Um, are you Dr. {@nickname}? Nice to meet you. I'm Jessica from Blacksteel Worldwide. Sorry... I'm really bad at introducing myself...

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This seems a lot more effective than training by myself.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor... I'm... I'm so happy you're honoring me... Just... let me cry it out for a bit, I'll be fine...

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Ah, Doctor, does this mean you think I'm a great Operator? Thank you so much for all your help. You were by my side all the way...!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Just give your orders and I'll carry them out!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I won't let you down!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Stay focused... look straight ahead.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I'll definitely prove myself this time!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Standing by...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Haah?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Ughh...

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: All right...

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Y- you'll pay for that!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Freeze!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Not one step backward.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I'll show them what I can do!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I'm going to climb to the top of the mountain. I won't stop halfway!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I... I really did it? I managed to protect everyone by myself?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I could do better. I can't get complacent just because we won!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Requesting medevac! I dragged everyone down... it's all my fault! Sorry! I'm sorry!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I wonder if the people at Rhodes Island are nice...?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Where are we going...?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I can do a little cooking...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Uh... S-Sorry, Doctor. I think I pushed myself too hard. My hands won't stop shaking... But I can hang these balloons on my own, no problem! Alright... Happy New Year, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning, doctor...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Sorry… I can't make anything myself, so I had to buy you a gift… It's too expensive? It could pay for a whole month of training? B-But isn't that pretty normal for a gift?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Back at those Blacksteel ceremonies, when we all got to meet the really highly-decorated mercs, I would find myself wondering if I could ever match them… But since coming to Rhodes Island, I'm always thinking about how much I'd like to go on the really tough missions with the senior operators.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'll protect you, as I've promised. But...it'll take some time before I can read all the words on these documents... Don't worry, I'll get there.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You have to be prepared, out in the wastelands. Always carry flint for starting fires, a weapon for self-defense, and fabric to use as a water filter... no flammable items in the office? But, what if there's a power outage?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Shifu taught us how to fight, how to avoid Catastrophes, how to farm and store food. Now we don't have to drift around in search of water and pasture anymore... Just like you, Doctor, Shifu seemed to know everything. I can't be like you and my Shifu, but I can protect you, so you can help people.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Whenever the tribe is on the move, everyone worries whether we'll find a good place to settle down. But people in nomadic cities don't seem concerned at all... Maybe for them, they're not moving in search of a new home, but drifting with the home they have?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Oripathy is not a rare sight in my tribe. We only think the stones that grow from the skin, they look like the stones we dig out of the earth… There are already so many things that can kill you; why persecute someone for a disease?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The name 'Anasa' means 'one without roots.' My people say that if you have no attachments, there's nothing that can trouble you. But everyone I've met since I left has something that they are attached to. Me? You mean I'm the same, in how I want to repay my debt? Hmm...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: My name comes from the first Yanese poem my Shifu taught me. It tells of a cloud, 'Yun' in Yanese, that has been drifting for a thousand li, raining across the land, until it finally finds a mountain to rest upon. 'Jie' is the end of that long journey. After all, 'everyone should have a place to call home.'

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: That martial arts master is here too... I thought he was cold and heartless, but now I kind of understand him... a man who has lived for so long and traveled so far can only carry so much. That must be what Shifu thought as well.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Sometimes you see the clear night sky after a Catastrophe has passed in the distance. Wind blows toward the horizon, and the stars seem so close you could touch them. A bonfire keeps the beasts away, while singing keeps you warm. The wastes are dangerous, but they are not terrible.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Are you retiring for the night? I'll stand watch.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: My birth name? Doctor, you understand the Anasa language...? But I would rather continue to use the name 'Jieyun.' Shifu gave me this name, and I like it.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: The reasons to fight never change much.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I still have a lot to learn after leaving the wastes. I'm willing to do more, if you trust me to. As the Yanese expression goes: a promise is worth a thousand taels of gold.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I haven't thought much about what I will become, but Rhodes Island could become home to many. Thank you, Doctor.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Yes, I will complete the task you gave me.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Stay close. The wastelands are a dangerous place to get lost.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: We're bringing everyone home, safe and sound.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The wind and sand don't cover all tracks. Something's not right here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Yes, I remember your instructions.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'll go.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Remember those poplars, and you'll always find your way.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll pile some stones here to mark the trail.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Would you give up after a loss?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: You have invaded someone else's home...

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Your families will be sad if they never see you again.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: A few more cairns on the barrens.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Will anyone remember them when all this is buried beneath the sand?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: If I could learn from you, Doctor, I could protect my people's lands.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Shifu says it isn't important whether or not you achieved what you set out to do, but whether you gave your best without running away. We've done well, Doctor.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Don't worry, I remember the way that we came. There's time to retreat.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I'm used to the darkness... oh, there's the light.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Be careful, Doctor. You don't want to be mistaken for an attacking beast.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I recognize your footsteps, Doctor.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: For us, the new year isn't a fixed date. It starts when we see the first sprout of spring. Then we drink, sing and celebrate.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Would you like to go out for some fresh air, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: This is the seed of the 'Tree of Life and Death.' Flowers appear on its branches in every state of its life cycle, from bud to bloom to decay. None of us can escape the cycle of life and death. Every day is precious. Happy birthday, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The Anasa are used to the cycle of life and death, but here at Rhodes Island, I see many struggle to say farewell to those they love. Home is where you find someone or something you can't let go of... I think I'm beginning to understand...

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: There are no security risks in your room, and you can work with peace of mind. I'll stand guard at the door to help you turn down any unnecessary busywork.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: The automatic door here is broken? Let me have a look. Hm… Haaaaah! Alright, Doctor, you're clear to go ahead and carry on with your work. I'll contact the maintenance staff.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You want to learn more about Minoan culture? I see, I'll put together a report for you. No, that's not information I can cover in just a few words. I must report it to you in detail.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Mercenaries must always update their pool of knowledge. If you can't keep up with the newest information, you could end up falling into the hands of enemies using the new methods, so there's absolutely no room to slack. I hope you understand this, Doctor. Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: What did that Minoan girl in the garden do...? My head feels strangely empty, it's like I'm completely relaxed… This doesn't... seem normal to me. Doctor, I need to rest. I'm sorry, I'm out of service as your bodyguard for the time being…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Hoooooo, HAH! Looks like I'm in pretty good shape today, maybe it'll feel even better to exercise a bit with the reserve operators. Oh, it's Hell Week? Alright then, I'll have to bug Dobermann again and get her to find a place for me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Corinia was built on the scales of merchants. Everyone there wants to squeeze as much as they can out of everyone else. But, people in the other city-states are a lot more interesting. I had all kinds of fun back when I was guarding them. The feeling was a lot like what I get with you, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You need to train properly, Doctor. Not exactly, stretching and walks are light exercise. What I'm talking about is real training. It requires a full range of intense exercises, as well as a healthy diet to burn fat and build muscle. Oh, you're fine with that? Good, let me see your results then. Don't be like last time—Hey! I'm not done talking yet, get back here!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Finished that one too? Want one more bowl? No problem. This is the first time I've made a complete meal. Usually I just fill my belly with some rations and don't cook much. Here's the last portion. When you're done, you'll exercise just like we agreed. That's the whole reason I learned to do this.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Relaxing with a nap? Hehehe, this is a real luxury.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, my new employer. I am Sideroca, a Corinian mercenary. My paperwork is all done. You can count on me.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: These clips are only good for reference. Keep your eyes open in a real battle.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Each badge is a symbol of trust. I'll accept this.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I'll use my sword to cut down all threats to you. You have my word.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: At your service.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll pass on your orders.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Don't worry, I'll keep an eye on the team.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: We're starting.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Approaching the destination.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Let's see what you all can do.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: This is where you stop.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Let's turn this around!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: And stay down!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Hooaahh!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I'll show you how a Minoan fights!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Seeing how you command, I feel like my protection might be a little redundant.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: What matters is you're alright. Let's get ready to head back.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: You had to suffer through that because I was careless. I'm so, so sorry.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: No matter what happens... I have to get the Doctor safely back to base…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's too messy here. I'm going to have to give it a good cleaning.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What's the matter?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor! This training was your idea! Why are you running off? Get back here!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, Happy the New Year. We can put your workout regimen on hold for today, but you still have to do some basic exercise. Also, I may have prepared a meal for you, but that's not an excuse to sit here eating the whole time—are you listening to me, Doctor? Doctor?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Nothing out of the ordinary!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I had this sapling brought all the way from Minos to celebrate your birthday. Find somewhere to plant it. I hope the joy of growth and new life will reach you in your thoughts.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The more I see of you, the more you unsettle me. Instructors Dur-nar and Dobermann are sharp, no doubt. They're no mercenaries, but still show such attentiveness to their employer. Doctor, I have a few questions I'd like to ask you, in order to better complete the missions you assign me...

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Greetings, Doctor... Is there anything you'd like to discuss?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You look quite pale... You say your chest hurts? Don't overwork yourself, please get some rest. Don't be afraid, I'm right beside you. Everything will be okay...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You've seen my healing Arts somewhere before?... That must have been your imagination. Yes, our memories do deceive us on occasion…

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: 'Confessarius?' Where did you learn this word? My apologies, but I'm afraid I cannot continue this topic.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: We Sarkaz combined our inherent Arts affinity with the power of Originium to develop new healing Arts,  we've been doing this for quite some time to succour those who drag themselves in the mire.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Now, you ask? Now we have nothing left. That war bereaved us of all hope.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Who is Nearl to me? Well... She's a travel companion, and I trust her with my very life.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: There are those who will sacrifice their all to deliver others from their pain. And Nearl, she is just the kind.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Once upon a time, I followed someone who shone bright as the beacon of hope, until wicked machinations took the light away. But this time, the incandescence will cease nevermore, even at the cost of my life...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: This quiet… it reminds me of my time back home.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Shining, the roaming medic. I look familiar to you? It is possible our paths have crossed.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: The power to merely heal wounds... is not enough.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A medic's hand cannot reach all those in need.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Yes. I must be more than a medic—I will live on as a guardian. As has always been my goal. Doctor, please bear witness to my oath.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: To the battlefield, are we not?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: A battle for our own delieverence, is it not?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: War, ever inevitable.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: May the war grant us the redemption we seek... or will it?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Let's begin.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Yes, I'm listening.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Flourish, or perish.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: 'Tis but a flash in the drift of time.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Your life is mine to protect.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Fear not.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Grief, ever echoes in our souls.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Agony, ever etched on our hearts.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Our wills and spirits are ever burning against the fiercest enemies.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: No matter the sins, all will fall to ashes with lives at the end of time.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Return not to the battlefields. You will find no redemption here.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Victory and loss... are insignificant moments in an endless cycle.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I will be fine, so long as I have a quiet place to be alone.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Yes? What is it?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: It's been some time since I've known such serenity. I can even hear your heartbeat.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Fireworks... beautiful. I used to be one buried in research, pitting myself against death, lingering about the battlefield, and no more. Now, I have myself a moment of rest in which to gaze up at the night sky... Life's turns truly surpass anyone's expectations.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: How are you feeling today, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: The day of your birth, is it? When a young life leaves the womb a newborn babe, the happiness and the hope in that moment will dwell in them, as well as their loved ones, for ages to come. Doctor, it honors me to the core, that I may celebrate a day so special alongside you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Chaos still arises without respite across this land, and the most we can do is save the wounded. The peace Rhodes Island has brought me is one I've never chanced to feel before. But, Doctor, the road ahead still stretches afar, and those oldest dreams of mine, I still continue in the wake of.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Beep-Beep. Understood. Classification program initiated. Now sorting the Doctor's documents. Will you want any snacks during work? Justice Knight could pick some up for you from the cafeteria.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Ever since Closure and Mayer installed a human voice patch, Justice Knight's functionality as a smart assistant has gone right up! Being able to use natural language logic really has improved communication so much when helping out my masters.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Justice Knight's master, the Wild Mane Knight Iwona, found Justice Knight in a scrapped state. She rebooted and fixed this unit. Ever since then, Justice Knight've been in charge of her and her partners' everyday lives, as well as supporting them on missions.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Doctor... why does my master say things to this unit like 'Justice, you're too noisy these days. Go play somewhere else if you've got nothing to do!'? Beep-Beep…Beep-Beep... Justice Knight doesn't understand.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Everyone in Pinus Sylvestris is incredibly hard-working, always putting meals off so they can train their knightly skills. There has to be a day where their bodies won't keep up. None of them have time to fetch their lunchboxes, so it's all up to Justice Knight to bring them over.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: A low battery? Sorry, this unit is not sure if any of my functions will be of help to you... What? it's the games console that's almost out? Please get this wire plugged in straight away!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Beep-Beep. Doctor, you discovered Justice Knight's secret. Justice Knight has no other choice but to take firm action in order to protect the secret... Master? You'll allow Justice Knight to keep tending to the plants in the Convalescent Garden? Thank you, Doctor. You now have unlimited access to all services of Justice Knight!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Beep-Beep, Beep-Beep. Apologies, Doctor. Justice Knight always forgets to disable the automatic timeteller feature.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Beep-Beep, Beep-Beep-Beep, Beep-Beep…Beep! ('Justice Knight,' glad to be reporting in along with everyone from Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub... Justice Knight will be of great use to you all!)

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: These are very useful resources for this unit. Justice Knight will apply to Miss Closure for installing even more new functions.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Justice Knight, all ready and set!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Are you leaving command to Justice Knight? It might be a little challenging for this unit right now…

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Justice Knight, setting off!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Beep-Beep. Justice Knight will provide you all with proper and timely support!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Justice Knight, all good to go!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Justice Knight, requesting to attack!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Beep-Beep. Locked onto target.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Beep-Beep. Justice Knight is now in position.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Juuuuustice!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Viiiiictory!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Fiiiiight!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Spiriiiiit!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Beep-Beep, BeepBeepBeep-- Sorry, Justice Knight got too worked up. Doctor, master, Justice Knight has made it!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Possiblilites of new function development detected! Justice Knight, awaiting for orders to return to Rhodes Island!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: There is still room for improvement. Anyway, we won! Congratulations, Doctor!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Please don't... throw Justice Knight... away again...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Beep-Beep, Justice Knight has plenty of things to do here.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Beep-Beep! Don't treat this unit like that… Negative!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: The washing machine... doesn't seem too hard to use...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, can you see the countdown on the screen? Three... two... one... Happy New Year! This year, Justice Knight will focus all her heart on doing even more for you.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Nice to see you, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: 'Beep-beep.' Doctor, your takeout is delivered... Yes, Justice Knight has brought you your birthday meal from the Rhodes Island Cafeteria. Scan of ingredients inside packaging: Inedible items, paraffin wax, Acid Originium Slug; edible items, butter, fermented flour. Scan results: safe.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Since the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub joined Rhodes Island, their lifestyles have transformed. Accordingly, all of Justice Knight's functions are being upgraded to follow. Justice Knight will ensure that she remains a useful operation platform.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, let me help!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, you've been sitting there for a while, that's really unhealthy. Come do some stretches with me! Exercise and recover your energy. That way, you'll be able to work better.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, Doctor! She's here at Rhodes Island! Ah, her codename should be Dur-nar now. Anyway, she's really amazing! I've only ever seen her in recruitment ads before! She's also a really good person! She gave me so many snacks, ehehe.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Doctor, I'm actually pretty lithe for my age, you know. Let me show you a standing backflip! Watch!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: This gun? Oh, it's a gun-type Arts... Arts something. Ah, right, Arts Unit! I applied for one out of habit when I came here, but I still prefer my fists over Arts.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Even though I know I'm very lucky, I only realized how badly other Infected are doing after coming to Rhodes Island... Doctor, what can I do to help? I really want to help them!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: ...Hm? Ah, Doctor! I'm writing a letter to my dad. Eh, I haven't introduced my dad to you yet? He's a really amazing policeman, you know! Let me tell you how great he is!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Actually, it was my dad who suggested Rhodes Island. After he found out you could treat Oripathy, he pushed really hard for me to be able to come here. I don't really want to be away from him, but I know that he'll be happiest if I live a healthy life.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You're really reliable, although dad is still better. Yup, you're now the second most reliable person in my heart! Hehe. Ah, Doctor, I talked a lot about you in my letters to dad. He said he really wants to meet you!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doc——! Ah, Doctor's asleep. I'll have to be quieter...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor! I'm the new operator, codename Jackie! I used to be an auxiliary police officer in Columbia. Let's get along!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Amazing... It feels even more amazing than dad...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Eh, am I being promoted? Wow, that's great!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I've learnt a lot living at Rhodes Island... Maybe I can even catch up to dad one day! Doctor, I'll continue to work hard. Please guide me well~

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'm here!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll work hard!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's do our best!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Mission start!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Doctor, is it my turn?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Warming up complete!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Leave it to me!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Time for me to show my power!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Grit Those Teeth!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: You shall not pass!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Don't look down on me!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I'll do it in one go!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I thought we were gonna lose a few time, but we actually won in the end. Doctor, you're amazing!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, Doctor, I've worked hard!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, want me to chase after them?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Sorry, Doctor. If only I'd put in more effort...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's so big inside!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ahhhh!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Hi, Doctor~

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, Happy New Year! This New Year, I'll be celebrating right here at Rhodes Island. Hehe, I've already written to dad, explaining how I'm learning to stand on my own, and how Rhodes Island is a place he can trust. Um, I do feel a bit lonely sometimes. But celebrating with my fellow operators makes up for it!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Ah, it's Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor! Happy birthday! My dad always taught me birthdays are best spent doing something kind for others. So I'm thinking, how about we head to the kitchen? We can help the logistics operators with today's grocery delivery. Hehehe, who knows? We might just stumble upon some exciting surprises!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: 'Walk a mile in someone else's shoes before extending a helping hand.' Now I get why the Infected I met before didn't want to accept help or even talk much. I've learned a lot at Rhodes Island. When I return to Columbia, all this will help me become a better police officer.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: There are no evil spirits around you, so can I go now?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Memories carry fate, and your fate has come to an abrupt end. That's why the evil spirits no longer haunt you, but I can still clearly see their traces... Doctor, don't just blow off my words... It's for your own good.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: If you need someone to talk to, you can always talk to Morte here. Don't worry, Morte is here to help. When you fall asleep, all your problems will be resolved.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Those emotions that make people want to cry are just food for Morte, so that's why I don't really cry. Is that bad?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The true face of the curse? Do you want to see what's inside Morte? Can't... at least not for now... That'll hurt Morte as well, and yes, those who hurt Morte will writhe in pain. I'm serious.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The checklist is still missing a few items: balls of yarn, used buttons, fresh apples, soil from Laterano, crushed cathode-ray tubes... Doctor, help me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Here, this apple's for you. It's just a leftover from a ritual, and I don't like letting things go to waste... Why are you thanking me? I just said it wasn't specifically for you... Hey, what, stop patting my head... Ah, whatever.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Because Morte is here, I have no need for emotions. But when everyone praises me, I feel a bit weird... And Morte doesn't want to take those feelings away, and it's scary... It's totally fine? Really? In that case... I guess it's fine.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, here you go. It's a clone of Morte, so make sure to keep it on you at all times... A curse? N-no, Doctor... If you take it, it'll be as if I'm always with you... Is that okay?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Swing low~♪ Sweet chariot~♪ Be devoured by your dreams~♪

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: My new name is Shamare... and this is Morte... As for the other things... it'd be best if you don't find out. Like Morte said, it's for everyone's sake...

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: These things won't help with the ritual...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Stuff it with cotton, sew shut the mouth. Plug up the ears, and cover the eyes... There, a new doll is done.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Morte has no need for a ritual like this, but... I... I'm really happy. We'll both do our best.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Work? Got it.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: If only they could be as obedient as Morte, that'd be nice.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Morte, it's time to go.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Today's fortune is... Oh, that's really bad news for you guys.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What's up?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Everyone's ready.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: It's time to play, Morte.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Your resentment, I'll take it all.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Go forth, Morte.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Rest at ease, and allow the land to embrace all.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Who is it?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You won't be going home.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: The evil spirits, they're all gone now.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A predestined victory, just as they whispered.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Someone may have escaped, but it doesn't matter. Morte has already ensnared their fate.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Curse... you...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This place... reeks of evil spirits... Not bad.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What's the big idea?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Do you want to sew something with me? Morte's also very happy...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, I saw you leave the office. There's many people outside today... New Year's? It's so noisy, what are they all doing? Morte doesn't like holidays like these. Can you make a talisman with me? If you put an apple stem inside, it can help you avoid curses.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor, and, uh...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Give me your hand. Put your finger here, and make a sign like this... Got it, Doctor? This is a curse. From now on, if you ever get bullied by anyone, you can make them hurt a lot all over. Me? Mm, I'm not going to use it a lot, I'm just teaching it to you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Fur, shiny pebbles, sweeties, spice, and most importantly, draw on a smile... Doctor, I learned a new way to make dolls. It's really cute? Uhm...

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, might these be the books and documents you were looking for? No, no need to thank me, I'm simply glad to be of help. How would I have known what you needed? Heheh. That would be... secret.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Phantom and I certainly have... our similarities, in what we've been through. Though now he pursues the truth, I only wish to be far removed from it.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor. About that lady who came to borrow your books... was her name Mint? She seems to be curious about a great many things. Curiosity in excess usually invites disaster, you see, and I have my reservations.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: It is quite the relief you were with us last mission, Doctor. I find myself dazed by the sight of you when you command. As if something crosses past the curtain of night and the stirring stars, leading your way...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Dance, music. Both soothe the soul, twin arts calling on us to focus and follow. But at times, too great a fixation can be our undoing. Such stories were already far too plenty where I formerly lived. Even I... am no exception to the rule.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor? What are you standing there for...? I see... you overheard me talking with someone...? Cease with the jests, please. There is no one here... but me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You wish to learn of the Crimson Troupe's affairs? Of course, I know of them all. But take caution, Doctor, for should you stray like they from the proper path... or come near to too many of them, you may be taken hold of. And that is not, whatsoever, desirable.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Here you are once more. Please, sit. Be reassured that I will not drive you out. So, what's the matter this time? Could Hibiscus have made another healthy meal? Or is Sideroca bound to whisk you away for training again?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My stories are hackneyed, bereft of novelty. Likely, not as engaging as you imagine. You would like to hear them nonetheless? Very well. Then I will tell you tales... but in exchange, Doctor, would you grant me a request?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor. Doctor? Beg pardon, I know I should not disturb your rest... but it is far too still here for me to fully be at ease.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I envisaged the scene in which we would formally meet, Doctor, and this very moment brings it to life. Operator Shalem, pleased to make your acquaintance.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: At times, I do feel the battlefield and the stage resemble one another, in ways.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion, did you say...? Ah, I'm sorry, it just startled me. Thank you for your acknowledgement, Doctor.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Unlike him, still wreathed in his struggle, I had long since fled the past, never to concern me again... yes, Doctor, so I once hoped.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Worry not, coordinating with others is a strength of mine. So long as nothing untoward happens...

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I may lack for power, but I will do all that I can.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Everyone, follow me, please.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: See those on the stage... knowing nothing of their fates.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Fret not.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Their future is clear to see.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I hope we may resolve this peacefully.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: To kill and to be killed, to do battle. Far too many plays are penned on these themes.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: And may this end as swiftly as can be.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: The path you all now walk bears not one hope.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Surely, your skulls... would be mesmerizing to see, right?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Hahahaha... haha, hahahahahahaha...

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: This is far beyond my wildest dreams. The best outcome, Doctor.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: It is done. Be at ease, for no danger remains. Well done, Doctor.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Our mission is complete, Doctor. As for those who escaped... they have their own fates to meet.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Haste not; ponder leisurely. We still have opportunities.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Shall we rest here a while? How about some music?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ah... I'm sorry, I was lost in thought.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, could you hold my coat for me briefly? I'll be done in a moment. My thanks.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Some dance and song is all it takes—days like these never fail to tempt art into showing a hint of its beauty, such that more would bow to it. A grand performance is about to begin, Doctor, and when the time has come, will you be able to recognize the true me beneath the limelight?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Welcome, Doctor. Indeed, I knew you would surely come.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Excellent, you are here just as I expected. Though some young operators express their affection in far too ardent ways, you'll nevertheless break their hearts should you hide away like this. And one more hint before you open the door, try to place your feet back, and find something to brace against. Yes. This way, you won't be thrown to the floor when they joyfully tackle you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I have to wear this...? Are you sure, Doctor? I don't recall this sort of adornment being called for on the stage... Very well... And dance with you? That would be a little... Oh my. Excuse me, Doctor. The steps here should go like this... Here, let me show you.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, might these be the books and documents you were looking for? No, no need to thank me, I'm simply glad to be of help. How could I have known what you needed? Heheh. That would be... a secret.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Phantom and I certainly have our similarities, in what we've been through. Though now he pursues the truth, while I only wish to be as far away from it as possible.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor. About that lady who came to borrow your books... is her codename Mint? She seems to be curious about a great many things. Too much curiosity usually invites disaster, you see, and I have my reservations.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: It is quite the relief you were with us last mission, Doctor. I find myself dazed by the sight of you when you command. As if something crosses past the curtain of night and the stirring stars, leading your way...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Dance, music. Both soothe the soul, twin arts calling on us to focus and follow. But at times, too great a fixation can be our undoing. Such stories were already far too plenty where I formerly lived. Even I... am no exception to the rule.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor? What are you standing there for...? I see... you overheard me talking with someone...? Cease your jests, please. There is no one here... but me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You wish to learn of the Crimson Troupe's affairs? Of course, I know of them all. But take caution, Doctor, for should you stray like they from the proper path... or come near to too many of them, you may be taken hold of. And that is not, whatsoever, desirable.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Here you are once more. Please, sit. Be reassured that I will not drive you out. So, what's the matter this time? Could Hibiscus have made another healthy meal? Or is Sideroca bound to whisk you away for training again?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My stories are hackneyed, bereft of novelty. Likely, not as engaging as you imagine. You would like to hear them nonetheless? Very well. Then I will tell you tales... but in exchange, Doctor, would you grant me a request?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor. Doctor? Beg pardon, I know I should not disturb your rest... but it is far too still here for me to fully be at ease.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I envisaged the scene in which we would formally meet, Doctor, and this very moment brings it to life. Operator Shalem, pleased to make your acquaintance.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: At times, I do feel the battlefield and the stage resemble one another, in ways.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion, did you say...? Ah, I'm sorry, it just startled me. Thank you for your acknowledgment, Doctor.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Unlike he, still wreathed in his struggle, I had long since fled the past, never to concern me again... yes, Doctor, so I once hoped.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Worry not, coordinating with others is a strength of mine. So long as nothing untoward happens...

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I may lack for power, but I will do all that I can.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Everyone, follow me, please.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: See those on the stage... knowing nothing of their fates.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Fret not.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Their future is clear to see.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I hope we may resolve this peacefully.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: To kill and to be killed, to do battle. Far too many plays are penned on these themes.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: And may this end as swiftly as can be.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: The path you all now walk bears not one hope.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Surely, your skulls... would mesmerize to see?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Hahahaha... haha, hahahahahahaha...

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: This is far beyond my wildest dreams. The best outcome, Doctor.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: It is done. Be at ease, for no danger remains. Well done, Doctor.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Our mission is complete, Doctor. As for those who escaped... they have their own fates to meet.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Haste not; ponder leisurely. We still have opportunities.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Shall we rest here a while? How about some music?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ah... I'm sorry, I was lost in thought.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, could you hold my coat for me briefly? I'll be done in a moment. My thanks.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Some dance and song is all it takes—days like these never fail to tempt art into showing a hint of its beauty, such that more would bow to it. A grand performance is about to begin, Doctor, and when the time has come, will you be able to recognize the true me beneath the limelight?

And one more hint before you open the door, try to place your feet back, and find something to brace against. Yes. This way, you won't be thrown to the floor when they joyfully tackle you.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, all life requires both sunlight and water to grow. While this potted plant seems to have its needs met, I don't think you've had your ten cups of water yet today.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, you need both sunlight and water to grow, and this potted plant seems to have gotten plenty. But I don't think you've had your ten cups of water yet today.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Who am 'I'? The answer lies only in all that I've seen. The same way seeds are inanimate, and yet they germinate after you put them in the ground. I too lodged myself in a seed once, to feel the growth of life. You wonder what it's like? Hehe, take a deep breath and you've more or less felt it.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Who am 'I'? The answer lies only in all that I've seen. The same way seeds are inanimate, and yet they germinate after you put them in the ground. I too lodged myself in a seed once, to feel the growth of life. You wonder what it's like? Take a deep breath and you've more or less felt it.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I am no fin, and yet I can reason what one is thinking. You may say I've spent the whole day idling. But you are not me, so how can you tell I've not been swimming freely with the fins in the ever-flowing streams? Yes, I know you think this water jug is too small for fincatching, but who's to say I can't drop a line in?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I am no fin, and yet I can reason what one is thinking. You are not me, so how would you know for sure if I've spent the day idling here, not feeling the fins swimming freely in the ever-flowing streams? Even if you think this water jug is too small for fincatching, who's to say you can't drop a line in?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: My eldest brother Shuo guards the border all year round, while my eldest sister Ling sleeps her days away clutching a pot of wine. Without me worrying over the rest of us, we would've ceased to be 'siblings' long ago. Hmm? Of course it's my duty to look after them—I'm the sixth out of us twelve, making me a big sister to five.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Toahia guards the border all year round, while my eldest sister Ling sleeps her days away clutching a pot of wine. Without me worrying over the lot of them, we would've ceased to be 'siblings' long ago. Hmm? Of course I'm a big sister-type—I'm the sixth out of us twelve, making me a big sister to five.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, give me your hand. I'll read your palm. Hmm... Your heaven, earth, and human lines are really impressive. Your past is dim and vague. Your journey is fraught with peril. Your future is criss-crossed with conflict... I see, Doctor. You are an 'ordinary one' who 'stirs up a storm fighting for a good end.'

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, give me your hand. I'll read your palm... Hmm? Your heaven, earth, and human lines are really something. A previous life unknown, your life line split into four, and conflict criss-crossing all along your path... I see, I get it now. An 'ordinary one' who 'stirs up a storm fighting for a good end.'

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: A pity? How so? Petals fall to the ground, so the soil may be nourished, allowing new flowers to bloom the following year. Rivers flow into the sea, but the water will condense into clouds, raining the drops back onto the mountains and streams. Even if this great land is to meet a snow-white end, the cycle continues. When spring comes, there will always be buds sprouting anew.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: A pity? How so? Petals fall to the ground to nourish the soil for new flowers to bloom the following year. Rivers flow endlessly into the sea, yet the water will condense into clouds and rain back onto the mounts and streams. Even if this great land is to meet a snow-white end, the cycle of cause and effect continues, and there will always be buds beneath the snow sprouting in spring anew.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Grain Buds is teaching some children how to make string figures? Yes, it's a Yanese children's hobby. A millennium ago, my younger brother had just arrived in Dahuang, where he invented this pastime to entertain the lonely children. A string in his hands could turn into countless hours of fun... Ah... it's been a thousand years.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Grain Buds is teaching some children how to make string figures? Yes, it's a Yanese children's hobby.
