Yes, it's been a thousand years.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, there's a pond up ahead—Nian! I see you adding chili oil to Dusk's cup. The villagers tell of a huge fin—Dusk! Pouring ink into Nian's bowl is going too far. Oh, Doctor, would you like to go fincatch—Are you two still fighting?! ...Get over here, both of you.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, there's a pond up ahead—Nian! I see you adding chili oil to Dusk's cup. *ahem* The villagers tell of a huge fin—Dusk! Pouring ink into Nian's bowl is going too far. Doctor, would you like to go fincatch—Are you two still fighting?! ...Get over here, both of you.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Our lives vary in their spans, and in their spans only. Just as how this landship holds so many people on its decks, a fallen leaf floating in that puddle is a sufficient vessel to sustain an ant for its entire life. Our burdens only grow as we gather more, yet you and I are naught but a single millet grain in our respective realms.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: There is a limit to our lifespans, and that limit is the limit. Just as how this landship holds only so many people, the fallen leaves floating in that puddle are sufficient to sustain an insect for its entire life. The more we gather, the heavier the load we bear. You and I are naught but a single millet grain in our respective realms.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: In east sun lifts; in west moons fall. Spring cold foretells rain; summer chill, clear skies.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: In east sun lifts; in west moons fall. Spring cold foretells rain; summer chill, clear skies.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Nian should have already told you my name—'Shu'. With my eldest brother, eldest sister, and my two younger sisters here, I feel as if I've returned home… Intriguing. Has that boy from the Sui Regulator not caused you any trouble yet?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Nian should have already told you my name—'Shu'. With my eldest brother, eldest sister, and my two younger sisters here, I feel as if I've returned home... Remarkable. Has that boy from the Sui Regulator not caused you any trouble yet?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Sow no reason for retaliation—point your blades at one another, and strife will never end.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Sow no reason for retaliation—point your blades at one another, and strife will never end.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: The people of Dahuang pray for a year of peace and harvest with this jade cong. The ceremonial artifact also serves as the source of the one I hold in my hand. Summon wind and rain? Hehe, of course I can. Want me to demonstrate?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I pray for a year of favorable weather with this jade cong from Dahuang. This ceremonial artifact also serves as the source of all that I hold in my hand. Summon wind and rain? Of course I can. Want me to demonstrate?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: The fertile fields stretch to the horizon, the fragrance of rice spreads from the golden ocean... Day after day, year after year, with constant work, it finally draws near.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: The fragrance of rice sprouting over ten thousand mu of fertile fields... day after day, year after year, with constant work it will draw near.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: A day of fine sun and gentle breeze. I hope everyone makes it home safe.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: A fine day today. I hope everyone makes it home safe.

voices.text: Just don't get yourselves hurt.

voices.text: Reap not what's sown by malice.

voices.text: Reap no urge for retribution.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Good, good. I had no idea you were so clever and learned. I was going to ask you help me make maiyatang, but with such a good head on your shoulders, I'm feeling a little bad now.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Not bad, not bad. I had no idea you were so clever and learned. I feel a little bad now, putting you to work pulling maiyatang with such a good head on your shoulders.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Perfection is a tall order, just as our crops may suffer from inclement weather, Catastrophe, and pestilence. These problems may not be solved in ten thousand years. You tried your best, Doctor.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Perfection is a tall order, just as the sustenance we sow is beset by the elements, Catastrophe, and pestilence. Ten thousand years will not change this, so just try your best.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The third nine days after Winter Solstice, all lakes and rivers frozen to ice. The fourth nine days, we can still walk on them.' Soon those ice surfaces will be thick enough to carry us, and the coldest time of year will arrive. Did Nian's hotpot warm you up? If not, you could ask Ling for some of her drink. Come on, let's go out and see if it's snowing. An auspicious snowfall tells of a bountiful year, and perhaps the new year will bring us a good harvest.

Come, let's go out and see if it's snowing. A timely snowfall tells of a bountiful year, and perhaps the new year will bring us a good harvest.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, come over here for a bit. Let's see... Hmm, the crops cultivated in Jiangqi this year are indeed taller than a man.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, come over here for a bit. Let's see... Hmm... the scallions from Jiangqi this year are indeed taller than man.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Let me tell your fortune for the year. Hmm, I see a prosperous one in store for you, investments made will bring you gain, and all your wishes will come true. Truths or lies? I've told you before—the answer's in your hands.

voices.title: Birthday

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: What a crowd! I'll take you to Dahuang for their famous opera, if we get the chance. In the old days, its people numbered no more than a hundred, but today it truly is a city. I see you've gained a good number of new faces too. For tens, hundreds, and thousands of years, those before us and those yet to come will spend their days just as we do now—with company.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I've noted down your schedule. You can confirm with me anytime.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: If it's about making someone bleed, do not send Lady Ceylon to the task. Let those who live amongst the shadow take it over, like me.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I won't tell you anything more about Lady Ceylon. And of course, others won't learn anything more about you from me.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I'm your bodyguard, Doctor. My duty is to protect you, not chat with you. If you want to talk, please stop turning to me like Lady Ceylon does and find someone else.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My expertise? Killing targets, guarding people, and... making tea. Don't be so shocked. After all, the tea Lady Ceylon makes is… Anyway, I'm good at that.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, based on the danger involved in the missions to date, I believe you need to learn self-defense in addition to my protection. Otherwise, even I can't guarantee your safety.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Once you've got blood on your hands, there's no turning back… Doctor, I do not wish you to go down the same road as mine. So leave the dirty works to me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You want to hear my revenge story? You won't be able to sleep at night, Doctor. But… somehow I do have this strange urge to tell you. Well then, let's hit the bar. This story will take a while.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Sinners always get what they deserve, I know that. But I do wonder sometimes that... if I could have met Lady Ceylon and you sooner, maybe I'd be more than just a killer. It's still not too late for me? Do you really mean that, Doctor?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Falls asleep just like that? Can't keep a guard up at all, just like her.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Schwarz, Lady Ceylon's personal bodyguard, here to join Rhodes Island with her. If at all possible, please assign me to accompany her.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I see that Rhodes Island is teeming with war monsters. I can only try to learn their way of battle.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Now I understand why Rhodes Island wanted me. Your vision is a hundred times crazier than anything I ever did.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Reawaken my memories? I'm fine with it. Maybe you can tame the evil inside us when on battlefields. Please, tame it for us.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: A mission? Got it

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Follow my orders.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's go.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: None will escape.

voices.text: Where am I needed?

voices.title: Deployment 2

voices.title: In Battle 2

voices.title: In Battle 3

voices.title: In Battle 4

voices.title: 4-star Result

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We got everyone, per your order.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Come, Doctor, I'll ensure your safety.

voices.text: Patrol? Got it.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: ...?! Please, Doctor, I don't want you to hurt yourself.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, I suppose everything's fine?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: New Year's? I only looked forward to New Year's when I was very young, then I lost interest, but... Lady Ceylon enjoys it. I used to escort her home from Victoria at the tail end of the year, and she'd tell me what she'd been up to while away at university. Right, Doctor, you can come have a cup of tea with us later if you are interested.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Don't let your guard down even on base, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here, it's a birthday present. I was there while Lady Ceylon picked out her present, so I chose some fine dishes for afternoon tea to go with the tea set. When you brew your relaxing tea, you can enjoy some snacks along with it.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Master Doykos helped me to get my revenge, and gave me a new life, while Lady Ceylon taught me to see a warmer, gentler world. I'm also greatly thankful to you all. Rhodes Island lets Lady Ceylon be firm in her goal, and I can be more confidently clear in knowing where my fight is headed.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Aw, c'mon, get someone more literate for this job. I'm a soldier, all I know is following orders. Paperwork's beyond me.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Life is tough enough already. Let's relax with some butter, frosting and jam.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: If Frostleaf wasn't still lugging that big axe around, there's no way I would've recognized her. We fought together before, probably as enemies. Anyway, I'm relieved to see her living the good life at Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Watch it, Doctor, you can't go touching my weapon. I just replaced the Originium on that thing. It's dangerous when you hold it wrong... Look out! I, I'll take you to Medical...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Defensive ability is what matters to a Defender. I don't care if it's organic fiber or ceramic padding, as long as it's the state-of-the-art, just buy it!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Stories from my past? Umm… Don't have much to say. I mean, what kind of story could a bad tempered soldier have? All those merits and medals... Hmph, they're nothing in the face of the lives lost.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The greenies we got in the reserves are pretty good. But they suck at securing amenities. Back in my day, the rookies were way smarter about hiding cookies.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I talked to Logistics. From now on, they're putting 'Industrial Material' on all our snack packaging. Then, all we need is you to sign off on them for us, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor? Oh, sorry. I was all caught up in reminiscing. I still can't get past certain things. If my old commander was anything like you, maybe... We wouldn't have had to go through that.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Psst, Psst! Want some pop rocks? I got all kinds. I know I got one you'll love.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hard as rock and lethal as lightning! That's me, Dur-nar. Nice to meet you, Doctor.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Ah, shoot, I'm out of popcorn.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Good, good, do I get paid more too? Awesome!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: The old me only knew how to charge on ahead and fight without stopping. Now, I fight for everybody. Just give your orders, Doctor.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Ready to deploy. Where am I needed?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I only have one request: Safety first and don't ever forget it.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: We're off! Remember to stay frosty and keep an eye out.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I never did get used to the stench of war.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Yes sir!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: In position!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'll leave the support to you.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Cover me!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Hold the line!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Don't be an idiot!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Ya ain't gettin' through me!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Stay down!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Ever heard of the Medal of Glory? I feel that's tailor-made for you.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: No need to clean up the battlefield? Okay, then we're done here.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The enemy still hasn't gone far. Should we chase them down?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Take it easy, Doctor. It's not your fault...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Whoa, I bet a fancy interior like this cost a bundle!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmph, Who the--

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You must be drunk to want to hear me sing war songs. Okay, don't you regret it.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year! I can finally lay my snacks out for everyone to eat with pride! Medical won't be so cruel on today of all days, right? I've been looking forward to this cake forever, *homp*—oooh, it's amazing! Doctor, move that fork quick or all you get is crumbs~

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: As thanks for always getting us off the hook, here's a present I brought in for you. But first, sign here. I guarantee it's all above board—signed? Great! I'll take this down to Dobermann! A permit for building a snack cupboard, signed by the Doctor!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Huh? It's not often I see you at the bar, Doctor. What's wrong, trouble at work? You're a great commander, I don't want you taking any wrong turns any time soon. Come on, I'll order you an 'Iceflame,' and we'll talk over drinks?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Awaitingorders, readywhenyouare, Chief!

voices.text: Intheinterestsofsafety, Iaminspectingescaperoutesandfirefightingequipment. Onemomentplease.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Ensuringawarenessoffiresafetyandfirefightingprotocolsisakeypartofmyduties. Allowmetobeginwithyou, Chief.

voices.text: Iamverysmall, butthatmeansIcandoworknooneelsecan.

voices.text: Um, Chief, I'mverynervous… Actually, I'mnotgoodatexpressingmyself… Thankyou, foryourconcern.

voices.text: Chief, canyoupleasehelpchangethislightbulb... I... can'treachit... Oh, it'sworkingnow. Thankyou.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year Chief, I hope you'll continue to cooperate with my work over the following year! Hold on, I think I smell fireworks I don't know if I inspected that batch or noooooOoOoOo! No lighting fires, no setting off—

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Needsomething, Chief?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Chief, this is a... a Pinenut egg waffle that I made myself. I, I, I hope you have a happy birthday! Uwbwlhbh please stop pinching my cheeks!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Reporting in Chief, all meat roasting for tonight's dinner party that was to be done over a charcoal flame has now had induction stovetops substituted, celebrations can begin at any time! In future I'll be even surer to make every operator aware of how terrifying a fire can be!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Shirayuki, at your service.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Princess Fumizuki is my master, and you're my employer.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My hobby? Standing on the coast, watching the snow fall.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: My affiliation? Secret.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My birthplace? Higashi.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My weapon? A shuriken, the Silver Wind, made by Eastern Heavy Industries.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Favorite food? Sushi.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My age? Confidential.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My duty? Protecting you.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: How tranquil...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Shirayuki. Princess Fumizuki told me to assist Miss Ch'en and follow all your orders.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: You have my gratitude.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? I, Shirayuki, am honored.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I, Shirayuki, may devote greater strength to you.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Understood.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Orders received.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Commencing operation.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: A snowstorm will bury this battlefield.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Very well.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Ready.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Roger.

voices.title: Deployment 2
