voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: All ends on the wind.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Sever.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: The enemy dies, I advance. I advance, the enemy dies.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The enemy has fallen. Total victory.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Of their ranks, some flee. Wariness, a must.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Should we fight again, we will return the favor one hundredfold.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: A very nice room.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Here.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Your consideration, I, Shirayuki, will engrave upon my heart.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year. May all proceed as you will it.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Yes, employer?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday. Please take this present. No, 'tis no bidding of the Princess.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I, ShiraYuki, here ever keep my watch. In duty, and our bonds.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: There are better ways to kill time. Care to try one?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Why the constant sullen face? Can't you at least smile for me? Good. That's what I want to see... Yes, there's no one better suited to solve your problems than me... Isn't that right?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: That girl... Amiya, I believe her name was? She's no ordinary girl. If you don't put shackles on her wrists today, you will find yourself placing a crown upon her head tomorrow.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The stability of the alliance between Karlan and Rhodes Island depends solely on your state of mind, and mine. As such, we should at least try to get along, my friend.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I suppose... it's high time I signed this contract. Of course, I do know that the terms are in yours, and Rhodes Island's favor.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I'm well aware that this contract offers me nothing... But what does that matter? I shall nonetheless accept this unequal treaty. The reason being that I, SilverAsh, recognize that you warrant it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Is Ensia giving you trouble? My apologies. It was originally my own responsibility to foster and guide her, but it's unlikely I will be able to do so. So I must ask... could you do it in my stead, {@nickname}?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Could you show me to Rhodes Island's deck? No, I'd just like to get a view of the area. Tenzin needs to spread his wings every once in a while as well. He must be longing to soar through the night sky.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: If this continues, there will come a day when you and I confront one another... I seem delighted, you say? Hah, perhaps I am. You would be a worthy opponent, that's for certain. Let us make the most of our time before that day comes.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: When the aether darkens, 'tis an omen that snowfall draws near...'

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I, SilverAsh, have joined your cause as a sworn ally. Whatever your plans may be, do not disappoint me.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: For one to travel such an arduous path, one absolutely must have experience.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Ostentatious titles are one thing, but the trust accompanying them is what concerns me. You surely know that.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: It takes a daring soul to drag me into their war. That being so, I, SilverAsh, will show my prowess for all of Rhodes Island to see.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: We all have our roles to play. Use my abilities as best you see fit.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You wish me to act as your proxy? Very well. But you must pay me due tribute later.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Compassion saves no one on the battlefield.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Show me what you're made of. Amuse me, if you even can.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What are you planning?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Made up your mind?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Acknowledged.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Very well.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: 'The fool flaunting his gallantry reaches none with his vanity...'

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: 'Fool, for what reason hast thou come?'

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: 'Art thou mine worthy enemy, or art thou naught but a jester?'

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: 'Thy pleas falleth upon deaf ears.'

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: The fiercer the battle, the more jubilant the victory.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A satisfying battle. It brought palpitations even to my heart.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We should strive for better.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Retreat at once, while there is still time.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: For a place to rest my feet, it is acceptable.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Let me rest for a brief while. I'm more tired than I thought. My apologies.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The snow falls heavy... The blizzards of far-off Kjerag continue year after year, but the political landscape never stands still from one moment to the next. For those who fail to catch up with the changes, this age-old snowstorm will come to bury them beneath.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You haven't changed one bit, my friend.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Oh? Does my appearance aboard Rhodes Island today surprise you? The journey here from Kjerag certainly was an extensive one, but you shouldn't underestimate the fellowship between us so. Happy birthday, my ally and my friend. This present aside, do you have any birthday wishes?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Multiple times now, Rhodes Island has shown its ability and its responsibility as a medical firm. But I'm very curious. In your eyes, will this merely stop at Oripathy? What new ripples will you send across the lands in future? I have great expectations.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'm here to help. So? Whose ass are we kicking next?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You can't go out without permission? Что? Aren't you the one in charge? Screw the rules, let's just get out.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You said something? My headphones were on.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The leader of Rhodes Island looks younger than even Istina. How can you let a kid like that go to battle?!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Why do I stare at you all the time? 'cause I'm onto you, gotta see what you're doing.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Every soldier wants to be the general. And I trust you have no opinion on me taking your position someday?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Plans for the future? Don't have any. You got a problem with that? I'm still young, no need to plan ahead.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I found Istina and the girls out there in the field. We used to have a bunch more, too. What happened to them…? I dealt with 'em. Had no choice, they wouldn't play nice.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Huh? Chernobog? Who'd ever wanna go back to that miserable city? We've got new lives here at Rhodes Island. So, let's keep it together, Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: …You really finished all your work?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Zima, leader of the Ursus Student Self-governing Group. I can make do without one, but my comrades need a place to call home. Let's cut the crap, gimme a job to do. I know lodging here ain't free.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Not too bad.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Cool! So I'll keep getting promoted if I keep doing a good job knocking heads, yeah?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I'll be frank: if I keep getting promoted, I might end up replacing you someday. Oh, you think I'm joking? Sorry, pal, I'm dead serious here.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Don't care if I'm leading or following. Whatever.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: What a pain...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Time to go.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Roll out.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Duh, it's me!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'm heading into the thick of it.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Spineless scumbags.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Hah.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: What're you scared of?!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Bring it on, bastards!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: For power and glory!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Victory or death!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Who else has a death wish? Happy to help!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Not bad. A solid win.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Anyway, this place is ours now.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Man, you suck. Get lost!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What do you want me to do here?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Hey, you're getting better at giving orders these days. I bet you also see the fun in fighting now, eh?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Morning. Everyone's so damned noisy today. All those grown-ass people running around crazy excited for New Year's like a bunch of kids… Say, you aren't planning to waste the first day of the year sitting around here, are you? I bought a whole ton of fireworks, so you're gonna come have some fun with me.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You need something?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Privet, this one's for you. Hey, who said you could open it right now? Whatever, not like it's anything special. It plays music, same model as mine. Gets the job done, as far as I'm concerned… You've had my back for a while, so a little token of appreciation is the least I can do. Happy birthday, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island gave us a place to live. I'm not about to forget that. I'm gonna get stronger, strong enough to make sure I'm worthy of the 'General Zima' title - for my comrades. Now, you'd better work twice as hard from here on, or that chair's gonna be mine. I'm dead serious!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: When I first became a Candleholder, it took me three whole months to finish reading all the literature in the Sui Regulator's library. The paperwork you have piled up here... is no less impressive in size. I will have time to familiarize myself with my duties, right?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: When I first became a Candleholder, it took me three whole months to finish reading all the literature in the Sui Regulator's library. The paperwork you have piled up here... is no less impressive in size. I will have time to familiarize myself with my duties, right?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor? Let me join you for a walk... Oh, it's just Kroos and Mr. Nothing said they would take me around to introduce myself to all the operators on the landship. They've been very warm, much more so than when we first met... Wait, what? You're inspecting the entire ship today?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor? Let me join you... Oh, Kroos and Mr. Nothing said you'd take me around for a 'bai shan men' today to meet all the operators on the landship. They've been very warm, much more so than when we first met... Hold on, are you going to tour the entire ship?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My father forged these blades for me. 'Drive out the shadows of the Feranmut and all the people's troubles.' A Candleholder's work is not so simple that we can manage it with force alone... Um, of course, I've also been practicing my kung fu every day!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My father forged these blades for me in Yumen himself. 'Exorcise the shadows of the Feranmuts, and ameliorate the plague on our land.' A Candleholder's work is not so simple that we can manage it with force alone... Um, of course, I've also been training as diligently as ever.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Yes, I do know Lin Qingyan. We held different titles, serving the Sui Regulator and the Central Judicial Office respectively. I've had my doubts about Rhodes Island before I arrived, and my time spent here has only doubled those suspicions. That being said, I shan't pry into the matters that 'Operator Leizi' is investigating.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Yes, I do know Lin Qingyan. We held different titles, serving the Sui Regulator and the Central Judicial Office respectively. I've had some doubts about Rhodes Island both before and after I arrived here. That being said, I shan't pry into the matters that 'Operator Leizi' is investigating.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: That Operator just now... was that Lord Wei's niece? No, I don't know her, but when I was little, my father told me to learn from her example. Not long ago, we discovered that Miss Ch'en resigned her position with the Lungmen Guard Department. Father did not say anything to me that day. Thinking back, I indeed find her admirable.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: That woman just now... was that Lord Wei's niece? No, I don't know her, but when I was little, my father told me to learn from her example. We later discovered that Miss Ch'en resigned her position. Father did not say anything to me that day. Thinking back, I indeed find her admirable.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My father sent me to Dahuang in hopes that I would reflect upon my mistakes and improve as a man. Indeed, one should avoid deviating from the proper path. But perhaps my father's meaning runs deeper... Decades ago, he and the Grandmaster worked all night on a blade at the Sword Forge, making them late for work the following morning. Hmm... It may be that Father hates to see the flame in my heart snuff out.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My father sent me to Dahuang in hopes that I would improve myself. But decades ago, he and the Grandmaster worked all night forging a blade at the Sword Forge, making them late for work the following morning. Of course, one should avoid deviating from the proper path, but I think my father wanted me to hold on to that spirit.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I'll keep an eye on the siblings, but I can't simply stand by and watch as Nian plays mahjong. Doctor, you've seen those exaggerated metal casts of hers. She conjures them as effortlessly as she blinks. Don't you think she's... just a little obnoxious? I can tell you're not playing dumb. That's the trickiest part.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I'll keep an eye on the siblings, but I can't simply stand by and watch when Nian plays mahjong. You've seen those exaggerated casts that Nian conjures up, and you think she's... only a little obnoxious? You're not playing dumb. That's the trickiest part.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: On-deck capture the flag is no doubt a competition of athletic ability. I was the first to climb onto the bridge, but the Vulpo lady riding her staff breezed past me to snatch the flag. That is blatant cheating, Doctor. How could you accuse me of being too competitive and unsportsmanlike?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: On-deck capture the flag is a challenge of mobility. Even though I was the first to climb onto the bridge, the Vulpo lady rode her staff and breezed past me to snatch the flag... Doctor, that is blatant cheating. How could you accuse me of being too competitive and unsportsmanlike?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: This is a handbook that all Candleholders keep on their person. I did record some observations about you, Doctor. I'm very sorry. But for what it's worth, I am now sure of one thing: You are the guiding post of this ship, and you are indeed ordinary. I will shred those pages, and I will ensure your safety.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: This is a handbook that all Candleholders keep on their person. Yes, I recorded some observations about you... I'm very sorry, Doctor, but for what it's worth, I am now sure of one thing: You are the guiding post of this ship, and you are indeed ordinary. I will shred those pages, and I will ensure your safety.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: The Feranmuts breathe with this vast land, and the Candleholder walks into the long night.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: The beast walks with the generous earth, as the Candleholder walks into the long night...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor, I am Zuo Le. The number of proxies aboard Rhodes Island has almost exceeded that of those in Yan. The Sui Regulator should have sent someone here long ago. In fact, it has been some time since we sent you an official notice, but it would seem your company may have forgotten to reply?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor, I am Zuo Le. The number of proxies aboard Rhodes Island has almost exceeded that of those in Yan. The Sui Regulator should have sent someone here long ago. In fact, it has been some time since we sent you an official notice, but it would seem your company may have forgotten to reply?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: For a pharmaceutical company to have so competently recorded and analyzed battle records… This is nigh unimaginable.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: To think that a pharmaceutical company has made such a competent analysis of battle records.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: My sincerest apologies, in my capacity as the mandarin, I'm afraid I cannot accept any form of 'promotion' from Rhodes Island... Ahem, what I mean is... we will forgo the titles, but I can accept the other benefits.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: My sincerest apologies, in my capacity as the mandarin Zuo Le, I'm afraid I cannot accept any form of 'promotion...' Ahem, what I mean is... we will forgo the titles, but I can accept the other benefits.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Each megastructure coursing through Catastrophes has a meaning unique to itself. Shangshu transferred its mountains and waterscapes to its nomadic cities, while Yumen fends off sandstorms with its Wind Aegis. And so, what of Rhodes Island? On what convictions do you sail?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Each megastructure coursing through Catastrophes has a meaning unique to itself. Shangshu transferred its mountains and waterscapes to its nomadic cities, while Yumen fends off sandstorms with its Wind Aegis. And so, what of Rhodes Island? On what convictions do you sail?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I hope my meager assistance will prove fruitful.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I hope my meager assistance will prove fruitful.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: To the right men, give the right jobs, enlist the talent, and forsake the snobs. I, Zuo Le, shall do my very best.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: To choose the right man for the job is a virtue, to choose a talent is more virtuous still. I, Zuo Le, shall do my very best.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The arrow has been nocked. Do not hesitate.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The arrow has been nocked, why hesitate?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The thrust of a blade takes no shape, take no comfort that it lies sheathed.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The thrust of a blade takes no shape, take no comfort that it lies stowed.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: From here on, your words are my command.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: From here on, your wish is my command.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: The situation is complicated, I shall improvise and adapt.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: The more complicated the situation, the simpler it is for me to act.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: When chaos abounds, tugging a single thread can pull the entire net.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: When chaos abounds, the most minute adjustment can change everything.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Not even a stirring of grass will go overlooked.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Not even the slightest stirring of grass will go overlooked.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Go no further, this road is closed.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Go no further, this road is closed.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Such violence will not be tolerated!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: How dare you?!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: All balance held by the orders of Yan. All beasts hunted by the sons of man!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Let there be order in Yan, and may Heaven safeguard our hunt.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Tiny may a candle be, it shall drive out the darkest night!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Even the shortest candle may exorcise the longest dark of night!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Seeking total victory in peril. You are truly of extraordinary talent and courage.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Seeking total victory in peril. You are truly of extraordinary talent and courage.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A unit never takes the same formation, as water never takes the same shape. Such extraordinary planning and execution... Doctor, I cannot fathom your past.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A unit never takes the same formation, as water never takes the same shape. Such extraordinary planning and execution... Doctor, I cannot fathom your past.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Man strives for perfection, yet flaws remain in every plan. Doctor, the deed is done. Let's not dwell on it further.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Man strives for perfection, yet flaws remain in every plan. Doctor, the deed is done. Let's not dwell on it further.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: The Sui Regulator has contingencies for all possible outcomes. Leave the cleanup to me. Don't worry, my qinggong is good. I'll catch up.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: The Sui Regulator has contingencies for all possible outcomes, of course. Leave the cleanup to me. I have good qinggong. I'll catch up.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I've lived in tents, and I've slept in fields. I'm not particularly demanding.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I've lived in tents, and I've slept in fields. I'm not particularly demanding.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: You must have urgent need of assistance?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: You must have urgent need of assistance?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, how about a game of weiqi? Or perhaps a capture-the-flag rematch?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, how about a game of weiqi? Or perhaps a capture-the-flag rematch?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The northern mandarins are busy, just as farmers have little time for leisure... My duties have me traveling all across Yan. The Yanese are always busy, but this time of year, they come together to eat, to beat the drums, and to enjoy their reunions... The shadows have yet to fade, but likewise, the fireworks will never cease.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The northern mandarins are busy, just as farmers have little time for leisure... My duties have me traveling all across Yan. The Yanese are always busy, but this time of year, they come together to eat, to beat the drums, and to enjoy their reunions... The shadows have yet to fade, but likewise, the fireworks will never cease.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good timing. You must have something to discuss with me. Yes and no?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good timing. You must have something to discuss with me... Yes and no?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I was a fairly mischievous boy. I once leapt into a sand wheel in Yumen, nearly costing me my life. It was my birthday, so my father had me wear this mask for the entire day. Happy birthday, Doctor. Rhodes Island won't be stopping, but would you like to hop off for a look? Don't worry, I'll fly you back.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I was a fairly mischievous boy. I once leapt into a sand wheel in Yumen, nearly costing me my life. It was my birthday, so my father had me wear this mask for the entire day. Happy birthday, Doctor. Rhodes Island won't be stopping, but would you like to hop off for a look? Don't worry, I'll fly you back.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Londinium, Gran Faro, Trimounts... Rhodes Island has played a role in many crises. The Sui Regulator knows that you are not a simple pharmaceutical company, of course, but you have been doing everything in your power to prevent invisible disasters. And so you may stand shoulder-to-shoulder with us.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Londinium, Gran Faro, Trimounts... Rhodes Island has played a role in many crises. The Sui Regulator knows that you are not a simple pharmaceutical company, of course, but you have been doing everything in your power to prevent invisible disasters. And so you may stand shoulder-to-shoulder with us.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: The fire alarm's gone off? Sorry, it was only me passing by your office. My body temperature must've sailed too high again.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: There's no language that's impossible to learn, no Arts that are impossible to understand. Isn't that the plain and simple truth? ...What? I'm the exception to the rule, you say?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My life plans...? Tch, everything was going swimmingly until that dreadful attack. But after Reunion murdered Phil, their eradication jumped to the top of my to-do list.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Rhodes Island's methods aren't nearly tough enough. All they'll do is drag King's Wand down.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Can you talk to Amiya for me? Poor girl, her kind heart clouds her judgment. As far as I'm concerned, total annihilation is the only fitting end for the wicked.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Your current skills wouldn't compare to even the average level of a King's Wand member such as myself. Ha, yes, I'm powerful... and the power of all five of us put together... words wouldn't even begin to describe.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Luminarie's blade was a gift from Shiro. I heard that the owner before Shiro was a swordmaster who could fell all the cherry blossoms of Higashi with a single swing. But even that legendary swordmaster was no match for Shiro, and had to surrender the blade.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: What happened to your shirt? What? I burned a hole in it? But... impossible... my self-control is impeccable, don't you think...? I... well, I'm sorry. Really, truly sorry.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: We might be on opposite ends of the spectrum when it comes to ideals, but I do enjoy seeing the people of Rhodes Island sweat away with bright hopes for the future. Yes, that is a compliment. It's a heartwarming sight.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: How lazy. You think it's fine to just sleep here and while away the precious day?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Skyfire of King's Wand. I will remain at Rhodes Island until my objective is accomplished. What's my objective, you ask? To burn every last Reunion thug to ashes, of course.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This is no way to go about unleashing my true power.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Naturally.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Ha. Enjoying the privileges I deserve from time to time is a good way to relax.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: This battlefield needs some heating up.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: The rays of the sun are my shield.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Now's the time to attack.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Kneel before the flame of the heavens.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Out with it.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: What are your plans?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Bad luck is always in waiting for the weak.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: The wise alway take the initiative.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Here we go!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Fire! Blaze! Inferno!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: May the flames of the sun devour you!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: May the rays of the skies set you ablaze!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: There isn't a soul who may survive the sunflame.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Pathetic... you're nothing but ashes now. Were you hoping to leave a trace behind?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Is that it? I had  higher expectations.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Impossible... how could I...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Couldn't you ready a slightly cooler room for me?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Are you trying to get your hand burnt?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, could you explain this theory to me? I'll need twelve minutes of your time, that's all.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Hmph, they won't let me near the fireworks. They say I could lose control and blow them all to kingdom come. They even set Logistics operators to guard the things. Why, I never—Eek! Get a fire extinguisher! …Anger causing a rise in body temperature is a perfectly normal physiological phenomenon. I—I'll steer clear of them!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: How are you doing today, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Manipulating Originium Arts to bake little clay treats is a lovely way to practice my fine control of the flames, and it's quite safe. Here, this delightful cup is for you. Ah, and it even heats itself, so you'll always have hot water. But do be careful when you sip from it.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I find I do think rather simply about some things. Pure power won't actually achieve everything I set for myself. It may hold the other side off for a while, but it doesn't get to the root of the issue. I must press on, Rhodes Island, I have much more yet to learn here.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I advise you to keep at least two meters away from me, for your own good. And of course you shouldn't speak to me either... I don't want you to be the next victim of what's after me.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You've read my file? Terrible, isn't it? If I'm allowed to stay by your side, the same misfortune will befall you, and that's trouble for me too.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My long hair looks good? Oh… Well, thank you. Would you like to feel it? It should have a soft touch. I'm confident of that.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Could that be...? The one over there, you guys call her Specter now, right? Why is she dressed as a nun? Amnesia? That's a problem… Dr. {@nickname}, you have to help her. She can't be allowed to forget her true function.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: You just don't know when to give up, do you? I suppose I have no choice but to defend you with all my might.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Down beneath the vast blue sea, below the white waves that lap endlessly at the earth, lies all that I once held dear. I fear that one day misfortune will once again take away someone important from me. That is why I fled. I don't want anyone I care about... to suffer on my account.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Good, another easy day. No giant tentacles coiling up my teammates, no fanatics lurking in the shadows with their hands coated in blood... Yes, just some straight fights on the battlefield. An easy day for me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: According to legend, my people have fought against those calamities for aeons. Perhaps we kept them from making landfall and terrorizing you city folk as well... So, how about buying me a drink, as a thank you?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: When you've finally made the long journey through the dark up to the water's surface—your eyes dazzled by the sparkling stars all over the sky, your cheek soothed by the cradling waves, your tears seep into your mouth. They have the same salty taste of your home—compared to all that, the bathtub at Rhodes Island is so tiny and puny... I'll have to show you my home someday.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, you fell asleep…? Rest well then, and may you never see your dream eroded by sea waves.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Skadi, a bounty hunter. Are you really hiring me? I cannot say what calamities I may bring with me.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: So this is how you fight. Rush in with a 'woosh,' knock them down with a 'pow,' and finish them with a 'thud.' Very good. I'll keep it in mind.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: So this is the promotion you Rhodes Island folks are always going on about? Not bad. Feels like I've become stronger. Just by a bit, maybe.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Your thirst for my power really troubles me... But if nothing can really stop you, then brace yourself, for the infinite darkness we will stand against together.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I am quite skilled at teamwork, but...

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You're placing everyone's life in my hands?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: It's hardly a sport when all the enemies are human.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Compared to the calamities I fought against, you are barely a threat.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: By your command.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'm used to fighting alone.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Let's share a dance.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Better safe than sorry.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Who knows what lurks within the kelp forest?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: This sword has a terrifying past. Care to find out?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Sing me a song, my torturous nightmare.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Don't blink, for you may miss the misery of your death.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: We survived somehow.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The words and thoughts of our enemies mean nothing to me. All I care about is how to defeat them.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Feeling a little rusty? Hope you won't mind having part of your share taken away.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Such simple misfortunes are only the beginning.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Put me in a room by myself please.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oops... My hat.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Y-You should watch your distance... I really can't guarantee your safety this close…

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: New Year's is a day of relief and enjoyment, isn't it? I've seen how the bounty hunters celebrate. They drink, they sing, and they don't sleep until the first light of dawn shines on their faces... What are you all going to do here? Eat a great feast, and then ignite some blossoming explosives? I see...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Never let down your guard, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Birthday...? I never considered giving you any gifts before. Are cakes and candles how you convey such sentiments on the land? You must want very much to receive a gift from me, correct? In that case, here is a song. Lie by my side, and I'll sing to you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I am a lurking danger to Rhodes Island. If anyone more is hurt because of me, I-I... We will bear our trials together? That's how a family should be? ...What you've just said is something very opinionated. But I don't hate it. Thank you, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Better to get your job done first than wasting time on chitchat.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You'd better remember that failing to adapt makes you a useless burden.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Work, eat, run, repeat. Big fricking whoop. Isn't that how life is for anyone these days?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: My job was to take care of 'troubles' for my employers. Eventually they started to call me Scavenger.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Just like the two sides of a coin, no matter how splendid the face is, the backside is always stained with dirt.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I've adapted to this place really well since I joined? Pfft, rubbish. It's just that I've gotten used to working on the surface.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: That's Provence, isn't it…? The wretched girl who got Infected while rescuing people from a Catastrophe... Look at that massive tail she's got...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You know, Doctor... I hated the idea of working with other people, at first. I figured our methods would clash. But at some point, I came to realize that's not the case.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: If only she were still alive... Now all I can do is carry on alone, carrying her dreams on my back.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: How can you sleep so soundly when you're defenseless…?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Scavenger. Leave the dirty work to me. Just pay me like my other employers and we'll be good.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: No, it's not enough...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: This still isn't enough. I need to become stronger...

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thanks, Doctor. I feel like I have a reason to fight now.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Do I need to quip just 'cause I joined the team?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Don't you hold me back.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Conceal yourselves so the enemy won't find you.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Hmph, time for a clean up.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hurry up.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Are we doing this?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Tch.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I know what to do.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Garbage.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Keep writhing in the gutter!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: There is no turning back for you!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You get no sympathy!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Gotta say that mission was a special one.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Hmph. They have only their own weakness to blame.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Tch, some of them got away. I'm disappointed in you.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Dammit! Screwed up again...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Just give me a dark corner.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Argh! Let go of me!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: What? You want me to dispose of you too?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: New Year's? Tsk, just another day, nothing different. But if you need a reminder, crowded places mean more stupid crap can happen, so don't get too lost in the fun, okay?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You got a job for me?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I did used to take birthdays seriously... but who's out there still counting out every year they live these day...? Whatever. If you'd like, I could wish you have fun today or something.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Ugh. Just waiting for you to clear out before I grab some cheese from in there. What? My job's never been anything but cleaning up the filthiest of places. Telling me my name's gonna show up on your honor roll?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Time for a break, Doctor. Just how long have you been sitting at a table like that? Get up and go stretch out a little. Yes, I mean now.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: It is my duty to perform regular check-ups on Oripathy patients. Some are personable enough, but a few are hard to communicate with. It's not the first time, though, so worry not, they will understand how vital a doctor is to them.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You know what an amnesia patient should pay attention to, Doctor? Don't work yourself into the ground. Work and relaxation are equally important!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You always have patients who ignore the doctor's orders, but in battle, you don't see a doctor who'd miss a single cry for help.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The advancement of medicine is a lesson taught by none other than the cruelty of war and disasters, a lesson we medical workers learn through pain and suffering... But... It's a fact I figured out long ago. As long as I can help my patients get their lives back, I'm ready to face the fact.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Together we've spent some... uh, I mean, some most memorable moments! Come on, you know I'm not good at this, Doctor. And next time I see you put up that teasing face, I'd be real mad!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Here's a pen. How did I know you wanted it? Well, I've been working with you for a while now, isn't it natural I picked up on it?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I'm still far below the level of Silence and Shining, but that doesn't mean I can't overcome an obstacle when I see one before me. Otherwise, how can I measure up to your confidence in me?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The sun's good on the deck, and the wind's just fine… Mm? No, I'm not slacking off. It's just... I'm feeling swamped right now, like you occasionally do, Doctor. So, anything bothering you? Mm-hm, keep it as a whisper if it's easier for you this way. I'm listening.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Who came up with this meal plan? I'm having spasms in my stomach just by looking at the list!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Sussurro, Medic, reporting in with a little reminder for the Doctor. Now, I understand you have a lot on your plate, and even if they say a 'doctor' makes the worst patient, you need to follow our advice.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I must make more copies of these battle notes for Myrrh and company.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion ceremony, while everyone stares at me? I don't have to make any embarrassing speeches, do I? No, no, I'm not nervous at all, really...

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: For this promotion, I have the entire Medical Department to thank, who's been supporting me all the time with their hard work. And of course, thank you too, Doctor, for your guidance. I'm very, very grateful to you all!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Don't worry, I'll watch over them.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Hold everything! You must complete all pre-battle physical exams to deploy!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Attention, medics, make sure to follow all standard procedures in battle. Now, to your positions.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Safety first, and do not touch anything that may be suspicious or infected!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm over here!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Speak louder! It's hard to hear over the battle!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Medic's here! Here!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Anybody hurt?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Don't worry, you'll be okay in no time!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Don't concern yourself with fighting, you're still wounded!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Listen to the doctor!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Scream if you're in pain, don't hold it in!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Finally, the battle's over. You should take a break too. I imagine commanding the mission would take a toll on your body.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: No casualty on our side. The Doctor's leadership is indeed unparalleled.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Will the enemy return? There are still wounded unable to move here.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Make way, make way! Stop crowding! Wounded coming through!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Promise you'll rest when it's time to, okay?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Um…

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Phew. I need a drink after work! Mind handing me a juice, Doctor? Thanks!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. New Year's is a time for proper relaxation, and you can't overstress yourself. I know you'll be at the dining table soon, though, and you can't let yourself go too much. I remember how bad your indigestion was after you overate last year. I'll keep an eye on you this time!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: How do you do, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday. I made you a cylinder cake—they seem popular lately. You don't need to hide it, I figured you'd be rolling in cakes today long beforehand... Anyway, don't eat too much, whatever you do! Watch your sugar intake!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I don't know how much longer life will carry on like this. Sometimes I even feel like I can't make out the future ahead, but if it even gets to us medics, how much worse must it be for our patients, waiting for us to treat them? I'm sure we'll see the light of dawn one day, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Do you need any help, Doctor? OK, I'll do my homework later then.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Are you curious about my tails? Actually... after I came to Rhodes Island, I realized that I have more tails than the other Vulpo senpais. I don't really know who to talk to about this... But, my dad's colleagues all had a lot of tails... How strange.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Upset? No, no, Doctor. Thank you for asking, but everyone treats me well. I musn't be too needy... Um... Doctor, actually... I feel the bed here is a bit small. It can't hold all my tails. Also, someone's been watering my bonsai. I really want to thank that person, and tell them it doesn't need that much watering...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Amiya Onēsan is really amazing. She always has so many ideas that I never thought of, and she's a great role model. But... She's not an adult yet. She's like me, she'll sometimes feel lost and upset. Doctor, please spend more time with her, okay?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: That first time I took a really long ride from Higashi to Siracusa, I was so surprised! I never knew that other places could look so different. Right now, I mostly stay behind my senpais, and not everything that happens is good... But I really cherish my life here. Mhm!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The flame that my dad creates is so pretty, shining like a crystal even though it is fire. After I came to Rhodes Island, I realized that it is the power dad uses to protect others. That means… I can use what he taught me to help my senpais here! Yoshi! I'll continue to do my best!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Since my arm was hurt, my mom almost never lets me go out. I don't blame her. In fact, I'm worried about her. She's always fighting bad people... I mustn't cause her more trouble and let her worry. If I behave myself on Rhodes Island, she won't worry, right? Mom is super strong when she's focused!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, what we're doing is very hard, right? I haven't been an operator for very long, and even though my senpais are always chatting and laughing, I can feel they are hiding their worries and feelings... If I can become a bit stronger, do you think I can help them share their troubles?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, you... you lost your memories? Is that true? Dr. Kal'tsit just told me about this today... Um, Doctor, please rest for the day! Even the Doctor needs time to think about life and not work, yes? Just leave the rest to me and, um, Amiya Onēsan! Hehe!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: The Doctor will catch a cold like this. I'll need to find a blanket…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Rhodes Island Operator, Lisa... Ah, I mean, Suzuran! Operator Suzuran! It's the codename I chose for myself. Starting today, I'm officially an operator, I will do my best!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: So this is how my senpais fight... Sugoi...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, earlier today, Dr. Kal'tsit praised me... Eh? A promotion? Not just praise? Ehh…

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Look, Doctor! This is my Originium Arts! I've been working hard on this! Now, will I be able to go to more places with my senpais, see more things, and help more people?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Field missions are rare for me. I will do my very best!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Eh? I'll be leading my senpais? Okay, leave it to me! As the captain, I mustn't show weakness!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Operation, start.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Visual on hostile! Uhh… can't we persuade them to give up?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Ah, understood!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Doctor, orders please!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Relax, relax.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: We can do this! Yeah!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Be careful!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Is everybody okay? Anyone need help?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Hang in there!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Please hold on!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: So this is the actual battlefield that my senpais faced... Doctor, I think we can do even better. I can do even better.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, did I do a good job? I didn't hold the others back, right? Really? That's great…

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, are you okay? There are friendlies injured? I, I'm on it!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Sorry, if only I were stronger…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I've lived here for a long time, so I won't get lost.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ah!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor! Oh, would you like some cupcakes? I was planning to take these to everyone in the Medical Department, but you also work very hard. So please, help yourself!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Ah, Happy New Year, Doctor. Here, have some snacks I just baked. I'll be helping the kitchen make lots of tasty treats today. Please remember to take a good rest today, Doctor! It's not often we have a day off, so let's enjoy it with our friends.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Ah, Doctor. Remember to take enough rest, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, could you bend down a bit for me? Yep, thanks. Now open your hands. Oh, and keep your fingers together... Now then... Hmm... Yoshi! Here, Doctor. Dad taught me how to draw a blessing talisman. I have written it on your palm. It'll give you good luck for the next year. Hehe, Happy birthday, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: ...Hm? Oh, hi, Doctor. Everyone's busy today, and I'm going to help Amiya Onēsan— Mm? What was I thinking about? I... I was wondering how mom and dad are doing. Do you think I'll have a chance to visit them, Doctor?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Welcome back, Doctor. Steward at your service.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Steward is my surname, as well as my Operator codename. Doctor, I'm sure you can tell from it what my ancestors did for a living.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I didn't expect to see another from my clan here. Is she looking for someone? I know how that feels... Oh, never mind.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: People often say our fur has the 'color of snow.' Doctor, have you ever seen snow?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Lava has a very distinct fighting style. I thought she was going to cast with her book, but her real Arts Unit is a dagger. Her style reminds me of the mystic who taught me Arts.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: It is my honor to work for you, Doctor. But if possible, I do hope you pay some extra care to Melantha. She's always alone…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Adnachiel is a mysterious one... No one can tell what he is thinking.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Ansel... It's okay... I stopped caring about my identity as an Infected long ago. In fact, I received a lot of help because of it. Before the infection takes away what's dear to me, I will use it to create a place where everyone can live in peace.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Are you tired? Do take a good rest, Doctor. Rhodes Island will need your skills tomorrow.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Caster Steward reporting in. I'm glad to be working with you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I have learned a lot. Thank you.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm glad that you are satisfied with my work. Instructor Dobermann will be happy too.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: What can I do for you?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Cardigan, always read the situation before you act.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Well, I'll be sure to bring you some good news.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: They probably won't make it to tomorrow.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Awarting orders.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Gladly!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Got it.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Understood.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Freeze!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Down you go.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: With the right strategy, we'll make it through any tight spot.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A perfect victory. Good work, everyone!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Ansel, please check the casualties for me. We must prepare for the next battle.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Did we make a mistake somewhere...?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Is that you, Cardi— WAI-WAIT! WAIT! Don't touch the equipment!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, is there anything I can do for you?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Heavy snow always dominates Kjerag at this time of the year, burying everything from the last year beneath. With that, our calendar turns a new page. If possible, Doctor, I really wish to give you a tour of my hometown. But, the wilds there are dangerous on snowy days, and you'll need me as your guide.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Awaiting your instructions, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! And allow me to be your personal butler today! Steward, at your service.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Had I not come to Rhodes Island, I would't have had the opportunity to continue my study on Originium Arts, let alone making friends with my teammates in Reserve Op Team A4. I will cherish all I have at present, for chances like these don't grow on trees. So, Doctor, let us keep up the hard work.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, do you mind me tinkering with a few things here, or would that be too much noise? Just give me a tap on the back when you want to chat, of course.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, I hear you've got a lot of books here. Could you lend me a few to read? They don't have to be on mechanical engineering, I'm plenty curious about stuff I don't know. Like this one, for instance, it's a beauty of a doorstopper... what was that? Don't touch? I-It's got a curse? Hold on, who put that on it?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The Sarkaz deserve sympathy for what they've been through, but one man can't steal another's home for the sake of his own. Peace will come to Londinium, and I hope, one day, every wanderer gets to build a homeland. It's what Rhodes Island wants too, isn't it?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: A lot of people'll say the lord nobles do nothing but cling onto the privilege and wealth they inherit, and never think to build on this land with their own hands. Me? I don't mind fighting side-by-side with nobles, just don't make me call them 'lord.'

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I didn't used to believe things could ever really be dire. Not until an almighty enemy showed up to me, and stole my pals from me, one after the other. They all trusted me, and I failed them. Granny was right. 'Being smart isn't enough to fool death.'

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I'm a big fan of red. It makes me think of fireplaces on freezing nights. And all the friends who've left us along the way... I'm telling you, their sacrifices meant something. Londinium will come back to us, back to our hands, and it'll be better than before.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, I find it easy to trust people, but don't take me for stupid. If you were just another lot of plotting schemers, I would've taken up arms with no hesitation. But you see, if I offer a shake when I meet someone, that's all the more likely I've got a new friend. Haha, I'm glad my bet paid off here.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: When we were on break, me and my work pals liked climbing up to the workshop ceiling. Thirty, forty-odd meters. We'd step out of the window and go jumping between buildings. Wind'd blow by with the smell of the factory heat and rust, stars'd squeeze down past the buildings and smile on me. I could feel my city in its warm embrace.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: *sigh* It's a beauty of a place at Rhodes. I almost want to apply to stay aboard. Shame I've still got all those people and all that work waiting for me in Londinium... Doctor, when it's clear skies once more at home, how about you let me be your guide again? What do you say?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, you must be bored out of your mind sitting at work all day. Want me to take you out for some exercise? Don't worry, no ziplines this time.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor, we've faced so much danger together. Do we still need this paperwork to stand for us being friends? Wait, you mean once I sign, I get to take any of Engineering's beauties apart? That's a promise, you hear? 'Stainless'—done.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Cor, I suppose you really do make your logistics people fight too. Not that that's much of a problem... How about a little pay bump, eh?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: 'Top Engineering Operator?' If I want to be Chief Engineer, I'm still a few steps away, aren't I? Haha, I'm just pulling your leg. I've got no plan to jockey for Closure's living.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: It's a luxury now, just having free time like this to work with my drill and spanner. Doctor, thank you. I'm all willing to take to the field for my homeland and freedom. But it's you and Rhodes Island that won back this moment of refuge for me.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Squad 11 of Self-Salvation Corp, joining up with Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm a little nervous. Still, pressure's a good motivator, right?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Remember, everyone! Not one fewer when we come back!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Hello, everyone over there, you can breathe easy. What's the line? 'I'm just your average mechanic.'

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: About time for us to shine?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'll bring you back victory.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Picked a good place for me.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Down to work!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Swing your hammers!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Hold the barricades!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Drill through darkness!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Fight for Londinium! Victory to Londiniers!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: We'll come together, we'll fight all the way, for this city we stand on, until we fall.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, with you for company all the time, I start imagining I fight even better than the mercs. Don't you let me get too cocky. If Granny and Rockrock saw, they'd be knocking on my head with spanners.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Hah... haha, made it through another battle. Hard as nails, though. Don't look so glum, Doctor. I know it's back to the Commander for a tactical meeting, but how about a bite to eat before then?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Time to scram, Doctor. The zipline's ready. Give me your hand! It's only a win once you survive.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: So it wasn't Victoria with the best construction technology.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Watch it! Drill didn't hurt you, did it?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, you always show up where I wasn't looking. I bet Rhodes Island has secret passages too, doesn't it?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Want a drink, Doctor? How about some ginger ale... what, a dance? Haha, my hands might be skilled at work, but my legs are naff dancers—it all cancels out. Still, if you're okay with me, I can try. Happy New Year, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, I'm just back from patrol. Safe as houses all around! You can break for a bit longer. The tenser the state of things, the more you need a proper stretch now and then.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, help me figure out why this panel's on fire... You can't figure it out either? I'd hope not, I broke it on purpose... um, flip, I shouldn't have said that. Would've ruined the surprise they had for you if I just let you walk on past. Closure's not gonna kill me, is she?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, thank you. Being with my Rhodes Island companions makes me see more clearly what it is I'm resisting. Everyone should have the freedom to run about their own city, and we fight for that right. That's a future that belongs to us all, including the Infected.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: D-Doctor! Excuse me, but could you please move a little? You're stepping on a coin...

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: D-Doctor! Excuse me, but could you please move a little? You're stepping on a coin...

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: My dream is for all Terra to know… Okay, maybe just Lungmen… Umm, well, maybe I'll just start with Rhodes Island, or even just you! Yes, my dream is for you to know my skill…

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: My dream is to be praised sincerely by the entire world... Ah, um, maybe just Lungmen... Well, maybe I should start with Rhodes Island, or, um, just you! Yes, that is my dream for the time being...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Aaaugh… I forgot to turn out the lights when I left the office yesterday… Hm? Rhodes Island has power generation facilities so we don't have to pay for electricity? R-Really? Does that mean I can start eating dinner every day?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Ugh, I forgot to turn off the light when I left the office yesterday... Hm? Rhodes Island has a power generation facility so there's no need to pay for electricity? Really? Does that I mean I get to eat dinner in the future?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: So this is the Originium ammunition that Jessica ordered... Uh, D-Doctor, the amount on the bill, is it right? Or maybe it's in the currency of some small, remote country? It's not? It's Lungmen Dollars? I-I-I-I see... Nonono, I-I'm just a-a-a little surprised, hehehe...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: This is the Originium ammunition that Jessica ordered... Eh? D-Doctor! Isn't this dollar amount wrong? Or is this the currency of some small remote country? It's not? It's LMD? I, I, I, I, I see... Don't worry, I was just a l-l-l-little s-surprised.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Oripathy... Hm, even though it's a bit outside my field of study, it might be worth looking into... But if I add another research project, I'll go from two meals a day to two days a meal... Aww…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Oripathy... Hm, even though it's a bit beyond my field of study, it does seem to be worth looking into... But if I add another research project, I'll go from two meals a day to two days a meal... Ugh...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Frugality is a virtue, but for me, it's more like a habit... E-Even so, if you or my friends ever have money troubles, I'll gladly help out! I'm serious!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Frugality is a type of virtue, but for me, it's closer to a habit... D-despite that, if you or my friends were in need, I'd gladly help out! I'm serious!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You'd like to take a look at my clawhook? That's probably fine... B-But whatever you do, don't push this button. And watch your thumb when you're holding the grip... W-Wait, you're not winding the rope correctly, and... Oh, I-I'm sorry, don't mind me, you can keep looking at it...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You'd like to take a look at my clawhook? That's maybe fine... but whatever you do, don't push this button. And watch your thumb when you're holding the grip... W-wait, you're not winding the rope correctly, and... Ack! Sorry, don't mind me, you can keep looking at it...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: After I become a great, world-famous scientist with lots of money, I swear I'll have three meals a day and dessert too, just like Jessica... And then, with the money I can't even spend, I'll invest it into making Lungmen a better place. Um... if a day like that ever comes.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: After I become a great, world-famous scientist with lots of money, I swear I'll have three meals a day and dessert too, just like Jessica... And then, with the money I'm not able to spend, I'd put it back into making Lungmen a better place. Um... if a day like that ever comes.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Money is very important. Before I went back to Lungmen, I turned down a big retention fee from the research institute, so my self-funded research project went under... But, it's more important to be home. I can always save up again, and now I won't go dizzy looking at all those big numbers!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Money is very important. Before I returned to Lungmen, I refused a large retention fee from the research institute, so my self-funded research project went under... But it's more important to be home. I can always save up more money, and now I won't go dizzy from looking at all those large numbers!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: …Doctor fell asleep? Then I'll handle the rest of the work, though I am a bit hungry.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: ...Did you fall asleep? Just let me handle the rest, though I am a bit hungry.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Oww... my head! Sorry... Oh, a-are you the Doctor? It's a pleasure to meet you! My name is Snowsant. Sorry, I shouldn't be walking with my head down…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Oww... my head! Sorry... Oh, y-you're the Doctor? It's a pleasure to meet you. My name is Snowsant. Sorry, I shouldn't be walking with my head down...

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Woah... This isn't something you can learn with more effort...

voices.text: Woah... This isn't something you can learn with more effort...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Wha-what? A promotion? I… feel a bit more pressure, but I'll be okay. This is proof that I'm one step closer to making something of myself!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Ehh? A p-promotion? I feel a bit more pressure, but I'll be okay. This is the proof that I'm one step farther than when I first came.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: 'Heaven rewards the hard-working.' Wouldn't you agree, Doctor?

voices.title: Promotion 2

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: It'll be all right. I just need to remember my training and work hard…

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: It'll be all right, as long as I work just as hard as I did during training...

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You want m-me to be the squad leader? But I really don't know anything about battle…

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader

voices.text: As long as we work together, there's no obstacle we can't overcome! R-Right, Doctor?
