voices.text: As long as we work together, there's no obstacle we can't overcome!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Not a single resource wasted, a flawless victory!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: What a flawless victory - not a bit of waste!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Some enemies got away, sh-should we chase after them?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Some enemies got away, sh-should we chase after them?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I, I'll go salvage some damaged parts, to at least reduce our losses…

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I, I'll go salvage some damage parts, to at least reduce our losses...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Wooooah, so this is what it's like inside Rhodes Island... I'm so jealous…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Woah, so this is what it's like inside Rhodes Island... I'm so envious...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Eeh-eeh!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Eek!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Yes, Doctor?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: So today's a holiday? No wonder the canteen has such an amazing spread. I can finally enjoy a proper meal, heheh. Speaking of which, Rhodes Island sure has a lot of holidays. If I take another job in the downtime, maybe I can make a little more money...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good day, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good day, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Thank you for always looking out for me, I got you a present. Here's an ergonomic chair to correct your posture, and an automatic document sorter, I made them both myself. I-I know they're made of really cheap materials, but I can promise they're great quality!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Thank you for always looking out for me, I got you a present. Here's an ergonomic chair to correct your posture, and an automatic document sorter, I made them both myself. I know they're made of really cheap materials, but I can promise they're great quality.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island maybe can't offer me a super comfortable life... No, I get enough food and warm clothes here, that's already pretty comfy... A-Anyway, I'm extremely grateful to have a work environment that supports my R&D like this. I will double up my efforts, and get results worth the experimental funding.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I might not be extremely well off at Rhodes Island, no, I can eat properly and dress myself, that's already relatively well off... but basically, I'm extremely grateful to have a work environment that supports my R&D like this! I need to double up my efforts, and get results worth the experimental funding, before I can rest!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: No problem. Just leave the documents here, and I'll filter out anything that isn't worth you reading... Can't do it that way? We have to take each one seriously? Fine, fine, whatever you say.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I guarantee that field op will be cleared without a hitch, so— I can't dump it on another operator? Come on, It was a long trip for me to come here, and I'm better off spending my time in the workshop while I'm on the ship. Work with me here, will you？

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: How's my stay? So far so good. Here I can focus on reviewing my designs without headphones on my head. No need to block everything out with music. Feels kinda refreshing. Still, I haven't modded any of the equipment in the dorm myself, so it does feel kinda like we're missing some features here. For example, something that automatically orders cactus tarts takeout at preset times.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Do me a favor and tell me when Lemuen shows up, Doctor. I help maintain her sister's gun every now and then, so my guess is she wants to have a few words with me. Why don't I just go see her? Uhmm... The way I put it, one can't be so proactive with everybody. Sometimes, you need to keep a certain distance. You know what I mean?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Laterano has tons of magazines covering the combat attire of other countries. Their designs seem to have drawn inspiration from a variety of sources, all of which I'd like to try out. Oh, just so you know, I'm more of an order-by-phone kind of girl. I don't go shopping unless I'm invited by some very specific people. So, you gonna ask me out?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I'm more willing to go on field ops than before? That's because I'm after inspiration for firearms upgrades. When I stand in war-torn ruins, where there's none of the ear-rending ruckus of Laterano, I get this weird sense of fear. I have to find a way to use my technology to combat that somehow.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: If the Lateran Curia ever asks for me, make an excuse and turn them down, will you? I don't wanna go back to listen to my boss nag about faith and standing. She thinks she can talk me into recognizing my mistakes, but I don't ever think that much when I do stuff.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I study firearm assistive technologies, but I don't fundamentally understand what a gun means to a Sankta... Hm? Oh, nothing. Just a friend of mine who told me she's starting to use a gun again. Anyway, I'll be going on a trip soon. Be sure to approve my disembarkation when the time comes, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You look like you're in a bad mood, so I grabbed you a snack from— Hey, what's that surprised look for? Yes, you're no Sankta and I can't feel your emotion, but that doesn't mean I can't care about you. Alright, eat up now. I wanna see if this is from the tainted batch.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You asleep...? Hehe... Well, well, seems like a good chance to release a drone in the hallway and stream someone's sleep-talking... No response? Looks like you're actually asleep.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Spuria, liaison from the Sixth Tribunal of the Lateran Curia, here for cultural exchange. Oh, right. To prevent any safety inspections, my luggage has a self-destruct mechanism. Yep, the stuff inside isn't necessarily all safe.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: You want to watch combat records together? You aren't gonna complain that I'm not serious enough when I watch the videos, right?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: If you're giving me more permissions, I won't have to check with you the next time I want to do something, right?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: We Sankta know how to shoot just by the instincts we were born with. Then, after seven years of schooling, we've mastered advanced shooting techniques and learned the basics of maintenance and retrofitting. After that, we may spend our entire lifetimes without ever realizing... guns hurt people.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Yep, no problem. I've got the objectives all memorized.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Relax, just leave it to me. What kind of havoc can I wreak?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Aww, I prefer combat strategies without so many twists and turns.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Perfect opportunity to observe the battlefield.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Comms online and stable.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Go ahead. Tell me your plan.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Hello, on-site service.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: It's about time we switched to a frontal assault, no?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Come on, don't be such a drag.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Just a smaaaall test.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Take a guess. Am I holding my gun to pray?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Uh-oh, you got it wrong.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: What a surprise. It's been a while since I had so many casings at my feet. You really know how to put on a show.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Just as promised, the mission's a success. What was I doing? Whoa, whoa, whoa, that's hurting. Nobody likes a Doctor who pries too much, yes?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: No worries, it's not a big deal. Just act like you're all remorseful, and nobody will press it too hard. But I still saw every mistake you made with my own eyes, better keep that in mind.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Uh, you're not gonna fix the part of the perimeter that got blown up? That wouldn't fly in Laterano.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Woo, I love this icy, modern feel.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Careful. My gun might go off.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: How much do you know about Sankta guns? There's no way you'd ever be able to fire one, but I don't mind explaining things to you.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: If this was Laterano, I would probably be helping maintain order right about now. The communications center gets affected by explosions pretty easily, and they need my tech repair to mend things... Was it tough? Come on, when everyone else's partying hard, would you really be such a killjoy?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey, Doctor, you're finally here. While you were gone, absolutely nothing happened.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Your birthday? Uh, you never told me. How'd I know? You didn't bring this up because you want a present, right? Haha... I really like that look on your face right now. Here, this instant photo's your gift. The first one I just took is mine, though.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: At first, I came to Rhodes Island just to check the place out and learn some new skills. I never expected to stay here and run so many field operations for you. You really know how to order people around, Doctor. That said, I've seen lots of sights I would never have seen in Laterano, so I guess it was all worth it.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Good day. Please allow me a moment of prayer... before I resume my work for the day...

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: O benevolent Herald, hear my prayer: please watch over my dreams and ward my soul…

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Hehehe… Cutting things... cutting things is such fun... Yes, some things were disconnected from the very beginning, their integrity only a false fiction...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Ehehehe... Hahahah... AHHAHAHAHAH!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Ehehe…Why were you dodging my sight? So pointless... because I already know exactly what your heart desires...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I have always, always wanted to bring you to a special place... A place where secrets are imparted...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: What did you do to me...? Why was I made to drink that strange medicine? Who brought me to this place? PLEASE ANSWER ME!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: That person's words are the complete and utter truth... Dissecting them, dismembering them, disemboweling them... it all grants them salvation...!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You see many things in your dreams that are hard to comprehend?... Those things you see are that soul's despairful tidings... And I, as the messenger, here to convey this exhortation to you... heh…

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hearken... Hear the whispers of vast creation's master, echoing from the deep...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Specter, that is what the spirits call me... That kind doctor informed me that I may receive further treatment by helping Rhodes Island... Yes, of course, my powers are yours to command.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Power... is flowing into me...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I have no right to go against your will...

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Will this position be a new source of joy for me...? Or... will working for you become my life's joy...?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Good night, my brothers and sisters.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: As you wish.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: This will be a path paved with sacrifice.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: All these lost souls on the battlefield... I offer them to you.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Humbly awaiting your command.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Please let me know the results.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I come from the depth of the ocean…

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: You are the one who woke me.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Grant joy unto me!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Return to the abyss!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I care not for valueless ones.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: There's no escape.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I have conquered all trials you gave me... Were you watching me?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Please guide these lost souls to peaceful enlightenment...!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: None of you shall leave this place!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: They shall pay for this... They must pay…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: May I ask you to assign me to a room where I can see the starry sky?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Heheh...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor... What is it inside you… that is driving me to this blissful ecstasy?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Another year has passed? Ahh, how long my years were spent in the sea, so long I cannot even remember how I last spent them... Never we mind. Tell me, Doctor, would you like to be with me by the windowsill today, to watch the stars?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You are... Ah, the Doctor, isn't it?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: How did I spend birthdays before now? Heheh. I don't remember too clearly... While I'm still lucid, Doctor, take this. An illuminous pearl, to be a valuable speck of light to you in the dark of night, there among illusory visions…

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Heheheh. I may have seen some vision or other... You should be careful, Doctor. On the route you've chosen, disaster is unavoidable, and it is far more, and far closer, than you ever bargained for. And I—will live in the true field of battle…

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Work's kinda like a trap, and you just fling yourself into it.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I don't talk much 'cause I don't want to. Not 'cause I'm looking down on anyone.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: What did Midnight do this time? Did he finally end up in Medical after hitting on one too many ladies in the hallway? No? Too bad.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Got something, Doctor? I could probably lend a hand. But I'd rather not eat up too much of my time. I got a lot of comics to read.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I know I speak a little too bluntly sometimes, but I always get my work done. It's not like I got professional pride or anything, I just can't respect somebody who doesn't finish his work.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Rhodes Island is a strange place. The people here just say whatever they're thinking, and somebody's always there to help when someone needs it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Reserve Op Team A6 is a real diverse crowd. We have Lady Stinky-face, Miss Lacking-self-confrol, Narcissist Kun, and a little walking time bomb. But still, I do think I can trust them. They work hard, even if they don't show it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I used to live free and easy like everyone else at Rhodes Island, but my family thought I was a freak. This place may be a freakshow, but at least everyone's happy, and that's pretty good.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Can I go back to my room now?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hi, I'm Spot from Operation Reserve Team A6. My job is to protect the other troublemakers on my team, I guess.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I've seen this battle before. Bad guys got their asses kicked.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm gonna work twice as hard. I'll bump it up from a 0.1 to a 0.2, I think.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I won't ask about the meaning of this mission then.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I wanna get back to my dorm.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Got it.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Save us a lot of time if you just surrender.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Whatever you say.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Doesn't matter to me.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Alright then.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Yeah, yeah, fine.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Hey, catch.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Don't see any harm in this.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: So many weaknesses.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Holding this shield is tiring, pal.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Been through an easy battle, you say? Then better do it all over again.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: With hard work, even an idiot can get the job done.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Perfection is for suckers, you know.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Relax, you're doing fine.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Yeah sure.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ah.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: If you keep petting me like that, my hair's gonna get tangled.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It's the start of a new year. If you were expecting anything to change on its own with time, then stop dreaming. Really changing yourself takes way more effort than that. If you can manage it, do it.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey Doctor...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday. I don't have anything decent, but you can have this old set of limited-edition comics. I always dreamed of becoming a hero when I was little, but I learned the hard way that it takes all my effort just to stay alive. Don't worry, the comics are still good.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Someone like me can't exactly say I fully embrace Rhodes Island's ideals from the bottom of my heart. I only raise my shield to protect the troublemakers of A6, that's all. Doctor, let's try and survive this troublesome land together.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You couldn't even finish the work you're supposed to do, so you're asking me for help?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Stop sending me to teach people Originium Arts. I have no interest in wasting time with common people.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I'm not here because I have to be. Just because I want to be.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The people I hate most are the ones who ask too many questions. I hope you are not one of them.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Looks like you understand my Arts now, to some degree. I hope you're aware of the danger as well.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Before I realized it, these Arts and this staff became my most loyal friends. I don't remember when I gained this power. And of course, I don't actually care.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I have all kinds of memories. I don't know where they came from, and I don't know which ones are really mine. I've been traveling back and forth, from country to country trying to find the source. And now, here I am at Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: When I'm all caught up in chaotic memories, there's nothing better than an ice cream to calm me down. I relied a lot on ice cream, when I was alone.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The memories from after I came to Rhodes Island are completely different from the ones before. There's a sense of realism to them. For the first time, I feel like I'm really myself. That's all thanks to you, and the rest of Rhodes Island… What? I am capable of giving thanks where it's deserved, alright?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hmph… what a waste of time.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Surtr. Are you the Doctor they mentioned? I'll be working at Rhodes Island, starting today. I hope you won't bore me too much.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: That's it?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: What? You're starting to value me now that you know my power?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: So it's not my power, but me myself? Hmph, you leave me no choice but to pay it back with hard work.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Am I needed?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I alone am enough.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Time to go.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Are they the ones I'm eliminating?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Don't order me around.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Enough, I get it.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Not a bad position.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'm on it!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Die!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: You can run but you can't hide!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Laevatain!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Foolish morons!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Hmph. Piece of cake.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Naturally.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Can you not even do such a simple thing?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: If you can't help, just run! I'll handle this.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This room is clean enough, I guess.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: I can find my own way.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Quiet, please.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: This day has always irritated me a little. Time goes by one year after another, and my memories also drift further and further away... Hmph, forget it. Hey you, come take a stroll with me on the deck. Maybe some cold wind will help calm me down.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Oh, here you are.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday. You remember your birthday, even though you're amnesiac. That has to mean that something really important must've happened on this day… Um, I have your birthday memorized now, and I won't forget it this time.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: For now, I still don't have a way to find my past self, but the process has also shaped who I am today. My days here at Rhodes Island are an important part of that. Doctor, we still have a lot of time together ahead of us. Keep your faith in my sword.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, we can't waste even one single precious minute! One minute could mean a loss of millions on the account with extra casualties on the field! Huh? Coffee? I take it with a sachet of sugar and heavy on the milk foam, thanks!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, we can't waste even one single precious minute! One minute could mean a loss of millions on the account with extra casualties on the field! Huh? Coffee? I take it with a sachet of sugar and heavy on the milk foam, thanks!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: They say Rhodes Island is a criminal organization, full of Infected people dirtying up the corridors. But that couldn't be further from the truth. Rhodes Island's Operators are giving their lives to make things better for everyone, just like the police force of Lungmen!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: They say Rhodes Island is a criminal organization, full of Infected people dirtying up the corridors. But that couldn't be further from the truth. Rhodes Island's Operators are giving their lives to make things better for everyone, just like the police force of Lungmen!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Hear me out, do you think we could redesign the instructors' office? At least add a bit of flavor to it, maybe a handmade rug or some atomistic art whatnot. It's just so bland now. Dobermann might say she doesn't care, but it really kills my enthusiasm...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Hear me out, do you think we could redesign the instructors' office? At least add a bit of flavor to it, maybe a handmade rug or some atomistic art whatnot. It's just so bland now. Dobermann might say she doesn't care, but it really kills my enthusiasm...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Ahhh, that awful Ch'en isn't here, is she? Back when we were in the L.G.D. together, she shot me this dirty look every time we bumped into each other. It made me wonder if I've done anything bad! I just... kinda want to take over the L.G.D. myself. That couldn't be bad, right?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Ahhh, that awful Ch'en isn't here, is she? Back when we were in the L.G.D. together, she shot me this dirty look every time we bumped into each other. It made me wonder if I've done anything bad! I just... kinda want to take over the L.G.D. myself. That couldn't be bad, right?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Exercise, study, training, researching my competitors and market shifts... Gotta keep them up!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Exercise, study, training, researching my competitors and market shifts... Gotta keep them up!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I've been allowed to set aside the family business for a while. But it's clear to me that the future of Lungmen needs both a stable public sector and security apparatus, as well as a healthy business and financial system. In both respects, I'm ready to be of service to Lungmen!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I've been allowed to set aside the family business for a while. But it's clear to me that the future of Lungmen needs both a stable public sector and security apparatus, as well as a healthy business and financial system. In both respects, I'm ready to be of service to Lungmen!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Lungmen bureaucracy is complicated, even for us. Keeping the peace, protecting the people, directing traffic, negotiating trade... Agh, it's absolutely backbreaking. But as long as what we do is good for Lungmen, I'll be—hehe—very pleased.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Lungmen bureaucracy is complicated, even for us. Keeping the peace, protecting the people, directing traffic, negotiating trade... Agh, it's absolutely backbreaking. But as long as what we do is good for Lungmen, I'll be—hehe—very pleased.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, why is Rhodes Island's training course so short...? Insufficient capital? Unacceptable, I'm requesting an immediate transfer to the business division! It's-it's not as if I like business, but if you need me to do it, I'm... more than capable!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, why is Rhodes Island's training course so short...? Insufficient capital? Unacceptable, I'm requesting an immediate transfer to the business division! It's-it's not as if I like business, but if you need me to do it, I'm... more than capable!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You know, Doctor, Lungmen could use someone as talented as you. So, well... If you're not enjoying this line of work, there's plenty of opportunities in the banking and management sectors! I-I can get you a job! Oh? You'd rather we work with Rhodes Island? ...Fine!

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year! Look at this crowd! So many people here! I brought some Lungmen street food with me... I-I didn't bring it for you guys! I wanted to have some myself! Right, if Ch'en has any, make sure she pays for her share. Call it a handling fee.

voices.title: New Year's blessing

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, roar!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, roar!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Look at you always wearing that outfit. You gotta at least change your shoes sometimes. Here, look what I've brought for you. Dark, flat, no design sensibility whatsoever. The brand I usually wear just got a bunch of new styles, and I picked out a few pairs for you based on your tastes. But looking like that, nobody will be able to tell they're luxury branded! What a waste!

What a waste!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I went against my grandfather's wishes by becoming a cop, but I believe it was the right choice for me, not that it's easy. This isn't just to take control of my own life. More than that, it's for Lungmen's future. Hey, don't think Ch'en's the only one who thinks about this stuff. Just like her, I have much to do in the future.

More than that, it's for Lungmen's future. Hey, don't think Ch'en's the only one who thinks about this stuff. Just like her, I have much to do in the future.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Smiling can help you feel revitalized. Why don't you try smiling, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Rhodes Island shouldn't be like those black-hearted corporations, right? Lungmen Industrial Waste Disposal License, Lungmen City Sewage Permit... Well, it seems like there are no problems with your certification, and the sewage treatment seems good enough... It's good that you're a law-abiding organization!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Woah, this water tastes amazing~! It's cool and sweet, just like the springs back in my hometown... Where's the water source? How is it filtered? What are you using to filter it? Please tell me quickly, Doctor!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: There are signs of excessive wastewater discharge this mon-- Huh? Did I take too many baths again? ...Oh no, I must reflect upon my behavior!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I love my hometown! Although it's not as lively in the country as it is in the city, and daily life isn't as comfortable, the water there is cool and delicious, and the air is always fresh. Hehe, these are sometimes hard to come by in the city!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The pollution near the city is getting worse and worse. Earlier, we even had problems with the water supply in my hometown, and resolving that situation required a lot of effort. While Catastrophes pose a very clear threat to us, pollution will also erode away at our habitable spaces! Therefore, protecting our environment is also of great importance!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Heave, ho! That should be the last shoe... Got it! Phew, now, this waterway will be much cleaner, and my daily efforts here won't go to waste! Thank you for accompanying me, Doctor!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: There is a legend among my people that we came from a place far, far away. Now that there are fewer and fewer of us, nobody seems to know where we came from, or where we are going...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Back in my hometown during harvest season, each family will make lots and lots of delicious food! Braised, sweet and sour, steamed, fried, marinated, anything you can imagine! Doctor, why don't we go visit together? The people there are very hospitable~

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Ugh... So dry... I want to soak in a bath...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, I am the municipal waterway cleaner, codename Purestream! From now on, I will handle the water treatment and sanitation of this ship, so please rest assured! Oh, these are pickled vegetables from my hometown. Everyone is welcome to try some—I assure you, they're delicious!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: If the purpose is to gain experience, wouldn't it be faster to put everything into practice?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Am I getting a raise? With this promotion and salary increase, I'm well on my way to the top! Hehe, I'll have to tell everyone back home the good news~

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: While there is a difference in urgency between visible threats and less evident threats, they are both dangerous to us! I'm glad you understand, Doctor.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: No problem, just leave it to me!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Such an important task... I'll do my best!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Rhodes Island Water Treatment Team, heading out!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Surprise inspection! That punk just poured paint down the sink! Get him!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: A fight? Alright! Lemme Roll up my sleeves… Oh, I don't have sleeves.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Woah, they're really fighting!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Cleaning work is my specialty!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Water delivery!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Breach and flip!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: That's unauthorized discharge of sewage!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Water works to the benefit of all.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Did that splash of cool water wake you up?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: No more contaminants! Very good, this mission was a great success~

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Operation complete! But we have to be diligent with the cleanup.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Hey, where'd the enemy run off to? I-I can't find them!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: The situation is looking bad, but we have nothing to fear as long as we stay strong! Let's fall back for now?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I hope I can get a nice, big bathtub.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Let me tell you a secret - I can swim upright!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, Happy New Year! Mom and Dad sent me some pickles they made. I've checked the calendar, now's the best time to eat them! Quick, try some, and I'll fetch some for everyone else too. Hehe, Our village might not be famous, but even city people know this kind of pickle!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning, Doctor! Would you like a cup of cool, refreshing spring water?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! This is a water purifier I developed myself. You connect it to the tap, and it lets you directly drink the water that comes out! Oh, of course, I'll keep working on new filter models for you to replace it with. I've got this all planned out, and the next step is—getting everyone at Rhodes Island to use it!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I often have this sinking feeling that my own power is too little, but if I can change a company as big as Rhodes Island by myself, then there have to be more people like me across the land. As long as we all keep up our own strives, the future will be better, won't it?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, I'll be writing reports or reading nearby, just call when you need me.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I believe you reap what you sow, and have always followed that principle.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Wow, I never imagined Oripathy would have such a trait! This requires immediate testing… Um, Doctor, I'm sorry, but I need to leave now. Hmm, I wonder if there's a suitable subject on base…

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The day is not complete without tea. Would you like a cup too, Doctor? I have the finest Victorian leaves here.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I've been with Schwarz since childhood. I know everything about her, including her past from before we met. Oh, but I won't give that up so easily, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: If I could find a cure for Schwarz, wouldn't that mean I could cure other Infected too...? Relax, Doctor, I'm not that selfish. But please also know that Schwarz is dearest to my heart.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Originium research is still a vastly unexplored territory, Doctor. But I just want to find a cure for Schwarz, which is why I longed to join Rhodes Island since I first heard of it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Do you know, Doctor, that I despise those who discriminate against Schwarz on account of her infection alone? But here, she is accepted, and I can learn more about medicine. Coming to Rhodes Island was truly the right decision.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: No matter how good a leader is, there's still a chance to be blinded by selfish interest, so you must watch out for that, Doctor. Hehe, but still, you don't need to worry that much. As long as I'm around, I'll put you back on the right path anytime you stray.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Falling asleep in a sitting position is a nasty habit, Doctor. Let me get you a blanket, at least.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, I'm Ceylon, graduate of Victoria National University, with a major in Originium research. I start my internship at Rhodes Island today, with Dr. Kal'tsit's approval. Nice to meet you, Doctor.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: An excellent application of Originium. Rhodes Island sure lives up to its reputation.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: So I'm officially recognized by Rhodes Island? Thank you, Doctor, I'll work even harder.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Rhodes Island does boast terrific Originium research. If I keep working here, I'm sure I will cure Schwarz one day. Doctor, please help me on this path.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: A mission? A perfect opportunity to test my Originium Arts.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Relax, I'm a confident commander.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I wonder if we'll find rare materials along the way?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Don't panic, handle it with composure.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Where are the wounded?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Leave the support work to me.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: If you're wounded, don't move.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: You're all free to focus on the mission.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Concentrate on the enemy ahead!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: This one should be better for the present situation.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Phew... I feel like I just wrapped up a difficult experiment. It's tiring, but very fulfilling too.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The enemy should be gone now...  Alright then, I'm going to look around the perimeter.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: If I were as good as Schwarz, they wouldn't have gotten away…

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Don't just stand there, Doctor, give me a hand with the wounded!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Hm, maybe I could talk to the other doctors on base.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Wait, my hair is getting messed up!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Did the Doctor fall asleep in that chair again?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Yes, I'll go and chat with my Medical Department colleagues for a while, and then meet up with Schwarz later on. New Year's could never be more interesting at home than at Rhodes Island, and I've sent my father a card in any case.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: How are you, Doctor? Care for some tea with me?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here's your birthday present, Doctor. I know what it's like. You bury yourself in books or research, and you just can't help forgetting to take breaks. But with a tea set this beautiful by your side, I'm sure you'll be more minded to pause and brew a cup... hm? Oh, don't worry, it wasn't... terribly expensive.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I might have gained new knowledge from my predecessors' writings at university. However, only after sailing such a long course with Rhodes Island, have I truly touched on the breadth of this land, and gained all kinds of experience the books never held. Ah, and on top of that, Schwarz is doing wonderfully here. Thank you all for looking after her.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Don't stay cooped up in your office all the time, Doki. Why don't you come down to the mines with me one of these days?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Something smells moldy. Should be in the bottom left drawer. My nose is never wrong... Well, Doki, You should really deal with those documents before they pile up. If you just leave them like that, they're gonna get damp.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My drills are all souped up. They've got twice the impact, improved stability, and they pretty much can't jam. Anyway, I'm a pro when it comes to boring, tunneling, and laying concrete. If you've got any construction jobs like that, I'm your girl!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: First, you check construction blueprints ahead of time. Second, you don't disrupt our work without a good reason. Third: You never, ever fall behind on your payments. That's the three principles Shana's Construction Crew uses to decide on projects. No exceptions, Doki, not even for Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Rim Billiton has more prospecting operation platforms than you can count, with tons of workers running around. You gotta know what you're doing to get anybody to listen to ya. I work hard to refine my skills, and I teach what I know to the gang. That's the way I do things... Yeah.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: We don't compromise on safety, even in barren mines with low output. Infected or not, so long as you work the mines, your rights oughta be guaranteed. I hope we never see another Billy mine accident. At the very least, I always make sure my projects stand up to inspection.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, want a lolly? It's just a regular mint one. I always keep some in my pocket. Don't underestimate the power of a lolly, though. When there's dusty air all around you, a little sweetness can really calm you down.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My dad always said that Columbia's Great Expansion marked the start of a new age. Now, the big corps pull in all different countries on big projects. Rim Billiton's ores really shine out there. But you know how things go, the taller the building, the more solid the foundations have to be. That's why the work we do is always meaningful, no matter the task.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: A Billy worker never sees the sun.' That's what my friends in the mines always say. The darkness down there swallows everything, work and life, past and future... I want to give people hope for the future, Doki, give them better lives. Easy enough to say, but there's lots of work to do. You'll lend a hand, won't you, Doki?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Alright, lads, day's done. Rest up now.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Oh, so you're the Doctor everyone's talking about! I'm new in Engineering; foreman of Shana's Construction Crew out of Rim Billiton! Here's my business card.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Nah yeah… If the mines just provided workers with recorders, it would save us so much hassle.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I thought it was a joke when I got a new contract from HR. Not only did my pay go up, I get even more benefits... Thanks, Doki!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: If I ever get the chance, I want to go check out Columbia, see the Great Expansion with my own eyes and how their workers are different from ours in Rim Billiton... Doki, Rhodes Island works with a lot of big companies, right?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Work, work! Hop to it now!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You all got your helmets on? Check again!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: This shaft's got a complicated layout. Follow me.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Ah! Why is my drill stuck?!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hm…? What's that smell?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Relax, Doki, just show up at completion time.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: The blueprints check out. Let the construction work begin!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Remember, max deviation for each drill hole is two centimeters!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Oi! Stay focused when you're running that boring machine!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: A triple bright miner's lamp could make ya go blind!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Move, or this cement's going right on your heads!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Dig! Diiig! Diiiiiiig!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doki! We… We just wrapped up a huge project!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: When worker safety's on the line, you can't slip up for even a single second.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: If you spot anything after construction's done, that's already too late. We need to find as many problems as we can in the design stage.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Don't be glum, chum. Follow-up work is part of construction, too. Just leave it to me to take care of the reinforcement. Cheer up, Doki.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Let's say Rhodes Island needs some dorms rebuilt, think you might hire Shana's Construction Crew? Hehe…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Eeek! Oh, it's you, Doki. Sorry, didn't notice you over the sound of the drill.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doki, can you hold this shield for me? Careful now, it's heavy. The inside there? That's concrete, baby.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Every time, around this year, those of us workers that couldn't go back home would gather somewhere free in the quarry for an open-air screening. Seeing how happy the people up on that curtain were, we'd all forget our worries for a while. A whole new day, and a whole new year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey, Doki! Here, a mint for ya.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Are you free today? The construction team just took on a new mining project, and the groundbreaking ceremony's today. Everyone would be so happy to see you there... Why don't I buy you lunch afterwards?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Even the smallest project can call for a lot of workers, but Rhodes Island is the place I've seen so many amazing people gathered in one place. What is it that Rhodes Island is trying to accomplish, Doctor? I'm in on it now, so I can't wait to see for myself!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Can't say I wrap my head around your job. Anything you want me to cook? Rice omelette, veggie stew, barbecue?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Take a deep breath! Skyfire, young lady, your body heat'll burn a fritter at this rate! Gummy, wonderful cookies you made—Goldenglow, why's your popcorn all stuck in your hair? There now, let me think how to go about this…

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: AH-CHOO! I was going to see inside the greenhouse where they raise the metal crabs, and fancy Marcille and Perfumer having a talk in there! I thought I'd slip out, but Marcille dragged me right back in to spray all these fancy smells on my beard. Now I can't even whiff an onion! AH-CHOO!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Is this your kitchen? This is... unmistakably magic! Originium cookers, full-automatic ovens, an eight-burner range with temperature control—Aye, they're all for lazy people who lack of dedication to cooking. Take them away at once!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: If you want a sturdy body, you can't go ignoring your diet. Biotransformative Arts, helping you build up body strength in no time, you say? ...Your body'll get dull if you keep trying to take short-cuts. There's a difference between convenience and laziness, aye?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Just cleaned your kitchen, gave the crops a sprinkling, and put everything I cleaned out into the composter. I eat the food your grow here, and I put my effort back into this land. Makes me feel like I'm a part of it that way. Couldn't be more satisfied.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The first time I went to that 'gym' place, they said they never saw a Durin as strong as me, and asked me how I got that way. I told them I just cook everyday. What's that? Now they're all in the kitchen tossing up stir-frys? Well, I'm pleased as punch to get so many people interested in cooking.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Makes me happy to see Laios's bunch eating proper everyday now. That said, Doctor, I hear that you've been eating nothing but instant food lately, using your busy schedule as an excuse, and that's no way to stay healthy! You want balanced nutrition, and that'll only start with more fresh veggies and good-quality proteins!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I might scratch my head at the things you all do everyday, but I respect you mightily for all the patients you'll take on. It warms the cockles of my heart too to see them enjoy my food so much. If we find any way to hop between here and the dungeon, I'll be coming back to visit you all.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hmm, fine amount of sleep. Good, good.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hmm. Clean stovetops, all the utensils, nice and hot flames, and you store your ingredients well... Looks like you know the value of a healthy diet. I like the place you've got!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I was wondering when did I lose my rare spice collection. That's when it happened!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Be it with magic or Originium Arts, people have been trying to save the effort of cooking so long they've forgotten how to start a fire. Proper use of a flint and tinder, that's the most essential skill to grasp!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Sami-style kebabs, Seaborn full courses, Ink Spirit jams and wines, I've done it all. Just give me the ingredients, and I can make you them to try... Speak up? You say we can't be eating those things, now?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: One second, I'll double-check I've got all my kitchenware and weapons.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Chin up, I've got it in me to protect the few of you.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I'm ready!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: That's more monsters than I imagined...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What's the problem, you hungry?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Don't you worry, I know what to do.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Nice spot. Wouldn't mind cooking here later.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Aye, you leave this to me!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Now, what's the best dish to make...?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I'll just taste for salt.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Add your ingredients in turns...

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Just a little longer, and it's done!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Phew, I haven't tussled with a monster that tough in a long while.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I'm going to see with Laios if there's a way to cook these monsters. You interested, Doctor?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Seems I added something funny by mistake...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: ...Get running!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Which way's the kitchen?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Are you poking me? Hmm... I say you're not going to get anything poking through my beard.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Like it? You want me to ladle you some more?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: If you want to make a dish for the operators, I recommend you go with hotpot. You can put in all kinds of stewing ingredients. It can feed a whole table at once, and it's simple to make. Come with me, I'll teach you how the tastiest hotpot's made.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Just in time, it's done. Come give my work a taste.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Tell me anything you'd like to eat, no matter what. Go on now, it's your birthday, and I haven't much I could wrap up and give you anyhow, so I'll make you a whole banquet to celebrate!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: This whole journey's been one endless surprise... Laios and Marcille are both much tougher than I'd thought, Chilchuck's really acting like a grown-up now, and I've made plenty of exciting new friends. It's been a fulfilling time, this.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Drink this, before you start working. Good. That medication will keep you up as long as it's in your system. I trust you'll stay focused, won't you?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Separation and analysis of the extract almost complete; next step, purification; Further testing needed to determine actual effect... Hm? Why are you staring at my hair, Doctor...? It's frazzled? Don't worry about it. Wouldn't be the first time my experiment has failed, or the second.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The concoctions I carry with me? They're not lethal, though I do advise against physical contact.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Always keep your mind running. To cease thinking is to expose your weaknesses to your enemies. This I've been taught many times and committed to memory.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My people once looked entirely different. Our skin was as hard as a carapace, and our hair flowed smoothly like water. However, the relentless sun and arid conditions have turned us into what we are now. You believed that? Sorry, I was just making things up.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: If you are not a follower of the Laterano religion, it is best not to go to Iberia. Their so-called 'purest faith' is rooted in that land. The people there are so pious, even the Laterans feel ashamed among them. As for me? None of that concerns me in the slightest.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, have you learned any of the history of the Iberian Penal Battalion? If you've heard even anything remotely relevant, you should know that the inhabitants of that land are far crazier than their cold, plain gray buildings suggest.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The angle of attack, the path of evasion, and the posture of defense. Every action is calculated, and no effort is wasted. This is what they call 'La Destreza.' Don't you think this is similar to your command style, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I need to unwind a bit more when I'm resting, you say...? Empty your thoughts and just enjoy the sun and the breeze… I suppose it is nice to give it a try every now and then. Come, Doc. The breeze up here reminds me of my hometown…

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Zzz... zzz... Huh? ...What happened? Did I fall asleep too?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: So you're the Doctor? I'll keep this brief then. Code name: Thorns. Starting today, I'll be assuming my post. Yes? My trouser leg is rolled up...? Pay it no mind; this happens a lot.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hmm... These recordings do seem useful.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? I trust your judgment on matters like these. Now, can I be excused?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Neutralize the opponent's actions swiftly and efficiently, then secure victory at minimal cost... I think I fully understand your orders. In that case, I'll use this paralytic neurotoxin in tandem with my attacks. I take it that you have no issue with this?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Let me see how Rhodes Island fights.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Captain? You shouldn't expect much. Leadership is not my forte.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's make this quick. My time is valuable.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Be careful. Don't get overconfident.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Understood.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Awaiting orders.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: This won't take long.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Incapacitating them is enough, right?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Stand still. It'll spare all of us the effort.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Your attacks are all within my calculations.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Futile.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Don't blink, this is the Destreza of Iberia!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: An excellent outcome. Was this also a part of your calculations?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission complete. Very precise and efficient command, Doctor.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: There was an oversight in your command, exacerbated by my improper execution. We should both reflect upon this after we return.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Considering the losses of our squad, there is no better option than to retreat immediately.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: How are the protective measures here?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Shoot, the potion's going to spill.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: My hair? Oh... I just combed it, why's it all ruffled up again?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: New things for the new year…? I suppose I have no need for any new clothes. My outfit here holds up against explosions pretty well and it's comfortable enough. But you do make a good point, though. It's about time to add some new moves to my exercise routine.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You seem tired. Would you like a pick-me-up, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy Birthday, Doctor. Good timing. I have a gift for you. I put in extra effort to wrap it up so you will like it. Looks good, doesn't it? But I suggest you wear gloves when you open it. Just in case.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, I know Rhodes Island has always been curious about Iberia, but no two Iberians can give the same recount, just as no two swordsmen will perform the same la Destreza. While the move may seem simple, one can only observe its form, and not learn its essence.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Yahoo, Doctor! Whacha doing? Looks like fun!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Does Rhodes Island have a karaoke place? It'd be great if we had a place to sing the night away, especially when we don't have battles to fight!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My job as an idol is to make the fans happy with my songs and performances. But what should I do as an operator of Rhodes Island... ?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Hi, hi, Doctor! Anything I can help with? Don't judge me by my look— I actually do some heavy lifting at Penguin Logistics.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Yup, my special skill is singing! I can do a cappella, lead vocals, choir singing, pop music, and I can even rap, yo yo! But, I guess that's not a very useful skill for an Operator. If only I had a more practical skill…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: M-My ears...? Uh, I can't tell you! A-And even if you ask Texas, she's not going to tell you either! Ehhh—Sorry, I'll explain if I get the chance someday…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You know, Texas actually saved my life. She also taught me so much I never knew. Which is why I... want to be there with her whenever I can... I, uhh, I'm just trying to show my gratitude for her, that's all!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You think I look upset? Um... it's because... Exusiai went on a mission with Texas again, right? If only I were as good as Exusiai…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor! Could you teach me to use a weapon? My songs have no practical use except for support and encouragement. If I could fight with a weapon... What? You're not good at fighting either?!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Texas... are you listening to my song?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: (｡･∀･)ﾉﾞHiiii! I'm the loveable idol from Monster Siren Records: Sora! Oops, sorry, introducing myself like this at Rhodes Island must be kinda weird. Aww…

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Leveling—up!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Do we also have an idol ranking on Rhodes Island?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I can feel the surge in my heart. It's like back to my first concert. I'm just delighted that you trust me so much, Doctor! All my hard work has paid off! Hmm? My ears? Wh-What about them?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: As a squad member, I'll try my best to learn from the basics!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm the leader? Is that like standing at the center of the idol group?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Singing on the battlefield... Now that's a fresh experience!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: If only my music could put an end to all this fighting...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Is it my turn?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Yes, I can handle this!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: It's show time!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Alright, let's make some noise!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Come on, we can do it!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: You have my full support!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Now we change the game!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Don't lose heart, we can win this one!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I heard your cheering loud and clear, everyone! Thank you!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Awesome! A smashing victory! Texas, did you see how I sparkled on the stage?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We did a good job, team. Thank you for your hard work!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'm sorry... I wasn't good enough to be your help...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This place is much bigger than the dorms at Penguin Logistics!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Sparkle spark!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Ehehe, thanks, Doctor!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It looks like I can't hold a solo live this year, but that doesn't change my desire to sing. Happy New Year! This year, I'm going to bring even more smiles to my fans—um, no, that's not the word... Oh, right! I'm going to bring even more music to everyone at Rhodes Island!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I hope you have a fantastic day, Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: A lot of fans say my singing can bring people true happiness, and I really hope they're right. Doctor, today I've got a song just for you. Happy birthday! This is for a beautiful life and a cheerful you, all year long!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Idols and Messengers are both jobs about passing on love. Seeing fans and audiences smile is a source of happiness in my own life. I'm sure, together with everyone at Rhodes Island, we can spread this blessing even further. It's a tiny little dream, but I'll do my best to make it come true!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Siege's ordered me to serve as your assistant. I'll be a harsh supervisor for you, if it's called for.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Huh? Do you have a problem with my metal claws? They're totally brill! ...I mean... They're very... Wieldy. Please don't get the wrong idea about my taste.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Morgan picked this outfit. Obviously, something with a knightly air would definitely suit me more. Although this street style... is just a little bit... wicked.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Indra's a mess, both the way she lives and fights. That said, she'll go through hell and high water for her mates, and she'll fight to her last breath for Siege—maybe, she's more knight than some knights out there, and she's never even had to try.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Most of Victoria's people live out their whole lives in their own cities, while everyone aboard Rhodes Island has left their homes to drift around this land. It just bowls me over.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The Montague name and the title of Knight of the Tower used to be more precious to me than anything. But gradually, I came to see how change for Victoria was unavoidable, and it doesn't just stem from the flames of war before us. I may have to abandon my past to follow Siege, but I'll follow through, unto the very end.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Bound to uphold Victoria's dignity, the Knights of the Tower never once shrank back in the face of the Sarkaz's blades. I was the only one who escaped, protected by my brothers and sisters in arms... I often think to myself—if... just if... I could've fought to the end with them...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Siege said I should choose the life I truly want to live when the war is over. Once that day arrives, how will Victoria turn out to be? And how will I turn out to be? I... I can't imagine it. All I hope is I'm still able to stay by their sides.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}... From here onwards, my blade belongs to both Victoria, and you. You can call me either Dagda or the 'Dark Blade.' Isa? T-Too frivolous! But if you've got to... then keep your voice down!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: It's a Knight of the Tower's duty to stand night watch. May you rest well, Doctor.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Knight of the Tower Isabella Montague. On behalf of Siege and our little alliance, I express our sincerest gratitude… What do you mean I don't dress like a knight? L-Looks can be bloody deceiving!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Umm...I'm seeing a wide gap between these tactics and my old training.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A medal? I can't accept any that's not Victorian... hmm, but you are the Doctor of Rhodes Island. Okay, I'm making an exception just this once.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Ever since we left Londinium, I've trained up a million more techniques than just knightly combat! Now you're going to see my true strength!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I've got no need to hide my identity if I'm fighting for Rhodes Island, yeah?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: What style of command do you want from me? The knight type, or the gang type?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: A fight? Wicked, bring it on... Ahem, as a Knight of the Tower, I accept your challenge.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: These punks are nothing compared to the foes Victoria's surmounted!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Is this an order?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I await your word.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: To the death I go.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: As you bid.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Forward, back, forward. Got ya!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: For Victoria!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Even without a blade, I can run you through!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Any soldier's will is worthy of respect.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Be of firm enough conviction, and it won't matter what difficulties you face. You'll have nothing to be afraid of.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Is that it? I didn't get to show off my real skills yet... If there is a next time, permit I continue to stand by your side.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: You can't reach perfection without pushing yourself to the limit. I must do better.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: If only I had a blade on me, I could... No, I can't give up now. Doctor, I'm ready to enter the next battle.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I'll assume guard duties for this room.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Where do ya need me?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Stop calling me Isa...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Whenever they rang the last bell of the year, we Knights of the Tower used to stand still at the tower's top, watching the lights across Londinium dim one after the other... I'm the only one left, but I still want to hold a torch in my hands even now, to protect Victoria's light in its darkest hour.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good day, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, I wanted to do my bit for your birthday party, so I asked Saileach if she could teach me these desserts. Morgan and the rest like to say I'm bad at expressing my feelings out loud... So all I could do is try and make the cakes a little sweeter. I hope you like them.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Another year's come and gone. We've been through plenty of hard times together, and the path forward remains thistly. Even then, we shouldn't give in. In the end, I believe we'll triumph over everything, Doctor, and greet the day and watch the dark clouds scatter.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Ummm... Doctor, the documents on the shelves are a bit messy. Back home, I had a tabletop assistant device that automatically organized our files. All you had to do was stick the files in, then it would package and seal them. I think you should get something like that too.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Wanting to see new places is a pretty common reason for leaving home, isn't it? To be honest, every time I climb a tall mountain or dive into a deep lake, I feel like I've made the right choice.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, are you a fan of wide-open landscapes? For example, imagine yourself next to a lake, watching the surface of the water rise and fall, the clouds gathering and dispersing, the sun slowly drooping behind the horizon, painting the lake a dazzling gold... That's the kind of scenery I love.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: A Catastrophe? Are we really going to cruise past a Catastrophe?! I didn't get to see the last one up close, so I can't let this opportunity slip by! I'm going out right–– What? The door to the bridge is locked?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My staff turns minerals into healing agents, sometimes with other special effects depending on the type of material used. You don't believe me...? I'm being serious here, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I've helped more and more people, which gives me a sense of accomplishment. But as a physician, I still wish there were fewer and fewer casualties from people fighting each other.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, have you seen fluorescent mushrooms before? There used to be a bunch of them growing by the rocks near the waterfall I played at as a kid. Some of them grew taller than the tallest person in the clan, serving as lamps to bring light to places where the city could not reach.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My original reason for coming above ground was simple: I wanted to survey the geography around my homeland, and soak up the sights and sounds along the way. Now I travel further and further not only for the sights I haven't seen, but also for the people who need my help.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, why do people bloody themselves fighting each other? I can treat a wound or two, maybe even a lot more than that, but what can I do as a physician if the people don't change their minds?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Your desk is still a bit messy. Let me clean things up for you.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Pleased to meet you, Dr.{@nickname}. This is for you. It's a specimen box made from gemstones I collected – lapis lazuli, turquoise, plum tourmaline, chalcedony…

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: The lens doesn't move, Doctor. Do you think if we gave this to a Durin operator, they'd be able to upgrade it to automatically follow the subject? If it's my idea, it's my responsibility? Ughh…

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I... never expected to be promoted so soon! I'll carry on my research into the curative properties of gemstones!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I left home so I could realize my dreams, I gained recognition here, and found a place where I could learn even more from my peers in the Medical Department. I've truly found a good job.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Whenever I think of my squadmates getting hurt in battle, I start to feel uneasy.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I don't like war, but that's my personal feelings. As a squad leader, I vow to uphold my responsibility.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Be careful, everyone! Nothing's more important than your own safety!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Is this really the only way to settle our problems?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Waiting for your command.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I trust the Doctor will lead us to victory.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'll heal your wounds and dull your pain.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Don't worry, I've got your back.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: If you feel unwell, report it right away!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Don't push yourself too hard in battle!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Feel any better?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Relax, tense muscles will only make your treatment more difficult.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: The more prep work we do, the better the outcome we'll see. This is all thanks to everyone's hard work.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Now's a great time to watch the sunset. Let's head over there and sit down for a spell.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We fight now for a peaceful future…? If only our enemies wanted the same.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Run, I'll cover you!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: The decor here is really different from back home.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hm? Who is it? Oh, it's you, Doctor.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I'm putting together a new specimen box, Doctor. Want to see it?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Woah, it's nice to see everyone coming together to celebrate! But, I suddenly realized, it's a darned shame this occasion only comes once a year!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, wanna head up to the deck for some fresh air?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: This crystal here can soothe your mind. Try putting it on when you're feeling bad. Oh, and when you're feeling good too, sure! I took it when I left home, and it's yours now. Happy birthday, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I've been here at Rhodes Island a while now, done a lotta work with you and the folks in Medical, helped a bunch of people. Sitting here mulling it over now, I've gained a ton of precious experience I never picked up on before. I'll remember this, keep it all with me, right in here.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I will be your bodyguard, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I will be your bodyguard, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I've always had my suspicions about Rhodes Island. Still do.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I've always had my suspicions about Rhodes Island. Still do.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Why are you staring at me? Nothing better to do?

voices.title: Talk 2
