voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Logistics permits, equipment approvals, mission evaluations... Rhodes Island has too much red tape. While recklessness does tend to get you in trouble, being overcautious also gets on people's nerves. Let's keep it simple. If anything comes up, you tell me directly. I'll decide what to do from there.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I heard the Grandmaster also came to Rhodes Island? Don't worry, I won't pick a fight; but he must be curious if my skills have improved since I left Yumen... Come to think of it, after walking such a long road, he really should be taking it easy. And yet, he still pushes himself into a life of conflict. The same goes for you, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: My dad hated the snow. Snow keeps the doors shut, ruining 'business' for his river fort. That's why he gave me this name. 'Qiu' for hatred, 'Bai' for the white of snow. People always find something to blame for their misfortunes: snow, storms, calamities natural or manmade. As for me, I happened to be born on a snowy day, that's all there is to it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I've seen some die in vain, some turn to crime, and others drive their friends and loved ones to despair… Justice is rare upon this cruel land, and eking out a living is always difficult. But there is no excuse for evil. Never has been, never will be.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The conflicts I can resolve with my sword are actually the simple ones. Unfortunately, most are as a great river surging forth, sweeping up all the sand and silt in its path until it turns into an unstoppable murky mess. I may encounter more places like that small mountain village. And I can't say for certain that I will do better next time. But good is good, and evil is evil. One may not confuse them, and I will find my own way to distinguish the two.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You'd like me to demonstrate my swordsmanship to the operators? Doctor, it's not something you can learn by watching. I know a scribe who served as the Grandmaster's record keeper. He followed the Grandmaster for over a decade. After years of observation, he could nitpick nearly any kung fu style under Heaven. And yet, he is weak to this day. A stiff breeze could blow him over... Anyway, I do happen to have some spare time. So I'll show you all a few moves.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The sharper the blade, the easier it is to break. The same goes for hatred in one's heart... It's easy to understand. But the hard part is, you must first face that which lies in your heart before you can really let it go. I have both hatred and gratitude toward the Grandmaster. The hatred, I paid back how I saw fit; the gratitude, I will hold as close. That is all.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The tumult in Yumen is done, and there's no more reason for me to be there. And the home that I came from is nothing but a river now. In short, I've become the 'one without roots.' But, being rootless is not all bad, as it's led me here to you and Rhodes Island. There will always be a place where my sword comes in handy.  The land under Heaven is vast, and my fate will mark the grave for me.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Let me see... I'm an L.G.D. officer, part of a special task force looking for artifacts. During a hostage rescue mission, I end up losing my memory when my superior betrays me, and in the end I battle a feranmut in the wilderness... Err... Nian, this is a little overwrought, don't you think? Fine, Director.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: As you can see, I note down only my experiences and insights, rather than any specific kung fu moves. What really matters to the martial arts is 'Yi' — your intent. If you let yourself be constrained by those gaudy forms, you will find it hard to break out of them. Take Dusk's paintings, for example. If I couldn't grasp the intent behind them, and sought to discuss techniques and styles with her, she would only shut the door on my face.

You got promoted at our expense. Have you ever thought of us? Oh, I'm merely rehearsing my lines. Haha. General Zuo is certainly nothing like this. He is a fine and upstanding man.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I agreed to be a 'fight choreographer' for Nian's movie. It keeps her from making too much of a racket, or getting too lonely. Dusk is timid, and Ling is too fond of drink. I will look after them as well... We are far from a normal family. Nevertheless, we are siblings, and not the collective 'we' as we are often called.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The fights in the movies are nothing like real combat. You must consider whether your position fits the shot composition, and whether your moves feel original. It's not just simple poses. It's a science, and I must learn everything anew. I should use my tail here? Hmm... Alright, let's try it again.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Death is a daily occurrence to warriors on campaign. But the real challenge they face, is preserving their humanity and morality after facing such morbidity, rather growing jaded and desensitized. Indeed, conflicts and mortality have been the way of these lands for eons. But only those giant, terrible creatures are cold-hearted enough to think so.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: If you want your picture to be exciting, you must pour your heart and soul into creating it. If it's perfection that you seek, you must find a way through trial and error. All this blood and sweat, to turn a brief dream into one that lasts an eternity... Those who walk this path, are truly worthy of admiration and respect.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The world is a vast place, and wonderful sceneries abound, yet man has limited strength and time. It is impossible to see all these sights, much less defend them. To those who practice the martial arts, all we can do is train day and night, from the depths of winter to the height of summer. It may sound like a clumsy and brutish method, but the result is giving every last drop you have, leaving no regrets.

Um, Director, I think as a policeman, our hero should reason with the lost young men, BEFORE engaging in physical combat with them... Ah? Talk sense into them as we fight? Very well, I'll try.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: That sword is an unwanted possession that must not be cast away. Huai Tianpei keeping it is an outcome that all concerned parties can accept. My duel with him, you ask? He trained for forty years, and landed a single heavy blow on me. But how many comings and goings of spring and autumn have I trained? All things considered, I was the one who lost.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Nian, since we are shooting a picture, we must consider the influence it will have. No amount of drink will improve your kung fu, and you need not rely on violence in your struggle for justice. If everyone simply imitates—I can choreograph my own moves for the fights? Ahem-hem, Ling, I'll borrow this wine flask. You may have it back once the shoot is over.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: 'Who am I'... For this question, you need only gaze upon the water. Be it human, beast, mountains, foggy woods, or the reflection of the twin moons on the night sky, whatever it is you see, that is your answer. As for the distant, radically different future, whether we siblings will return to chaos and seek new answers, is an entirely different question.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I am both myself and a character in a story. Now I have left a fictional story, yet how do I know I'm not already in another, real story? If I hadn't come to shoot this picture, I may never have gotten the chance to experience a different life. All this is indeed very interesting. Would I like to try it again? Hmm... It would take much preparation for me to do so.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The scholars at court seek perfect answers in everything. The kung fu practitioners who wander in jianghu seek revenge, status, glory, or a simple resolution. Their obsessions run deep, yet their time runs short. Often, they spend their whole lifetimes chasing a single ideal or undertaking... All those people, how woeful and pitiful, how respectable and regrettable.

voices.text: You say it's over? No! It's NOT over! The real culprit is still hiding in the shadows. How can you say it's—O-Oh, sorry, the filming of this shot is indeed over.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: You calmly place your pieces to plot your victory... Doctor, a weiqi player like you is a truly rare sight.

voices.title: 3-star Result

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: That's another year in the books. How time flies may feel somewhat woeful. But this is a new beginning, so we should be cheerful. What I am holding, you ask? I learned how to use a camcorder recently, so I'm filming whatever catches my fancy. See the fireworks? How beautiful they are.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Nian, Dusk, and Ling are already drunk? It's not often Rhodes Island gets this lively...Let them be. Relax, I will keep an eye on them. Our sibling 'reunion' may be an extraordinary event to most, but this too is human nature. Who are we to reject participation in these traditions?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, you're early today. Don't forget to eat breakfast before you start work.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, I did not see you at this morning's training session.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, I did not see you at this morning's training session.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday. This, is a film print from a picture I was in. It's not worth much, but it's a treasured memory to me. You want to watch it now? I suppose I could borrow Nian's equipment… No matter. You're the star of the show today.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Once I traveled through Sargon and taught the locals a few moves for their defense. From what I heard, they became very fierce and instigated many riots. Ever since, I have been careful who I teach. This booklet contains instructions on how to strengthen your body and health. Take it. It is a joyous day, after all.

Ever since, I have been careful who I teach. This booklet contains instructions on how to strengthen your body and health. Take it. It is a joyous day, after all.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island rarely enjoys auspicious celebrations like these. A certain motion picture says, you should treat every day like the holidays. Before we can love our ideals, we must first love our own lifestyles. Which reminds me, Doctor, if you have time today, why don't we take in a matinee together? Or perhaps you'd prefer to spar outside?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Yumen throws a banquet rather like this every year, to reward its warriors for their work the year prior. The men would clatter their weapons and sing along with the beat. But the next morning, they would still be up for duty, no matter how inebriated. Just like that, Yumen has traversed the lands and defended Great Yan's peace for a hundred years. Doctor, what is it that you defend?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Yumen throws a banquet rather like this every year, to reward its warriors for their work the year prior. The men would clatter their weapons and sing along with the beat. But the next morning, they would still be up for duty, no matter how inebriated. Just like that, Yumen has traversed the lands and defended Great Yan's peace for a hundred years. Doctor, what is it that you defend?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Uh-huh... I see. Hand me this paperwork. I'll sort it out. What? Don't tell me 'I know you can do this'. I'm not a child!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Tch... I had a feeling, but actually hearing the doc dissect my numbers during the checkup was another thing. I need a while away from any missions with Senshi and Laios. Can't keep eating with them at this rate.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I see your face, and I know what you're thinking—'I didn't even know you could eat this!' or something like that. I was reluctant at first, but then I got used to it. Spend enough time with them, and you will too. Uh, not that getting used to it matters or anything, I mean.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: *sigh* This is what I get for hanging around Laios and Senshi. Now everyone thinks I'm some monster-loving wacko too. What's that you've got there, Doctor? Senshi's brand new pièce de résistance? ...You look excited, too. Don't tell me you're one of them?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Okay. It's dawned on me that Durins look young because they're actually young—Myrtle more than anyone. That girl is practically a child. I had a brief conversation with her, and she decided I was lying about not being her age—give me a break!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, Terran mimics are much easier to tell than the dungeon kind. Watch, all it takes to lure one is some bait, just wait for it to bite and you can—ha! Nailed it... Tch, didn't expect there's another one!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I used to manage a guild too, you know. It keeps me on my feet every day, but sometimes even my own kind don't see the point. With Rhodes Island being such a big organization, you should learn to unwind every now and then. Wanna go grab a drink? It's not like the work will run off while you're away, so we may as well relax for now.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Laios and the others believe that giving all you've got equals a happy ending. As if it's ever that simple—what a bunch of morons. You're smart, Doctor. You don't believe in that either, right? ...Come again? I am NOT worried for them!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You want to try dungeoneering? Considering the combat skills you have, you can never have too many extra lives. Okay, how about this? If you really wanna go, then you must follow my instructions when it comes to pathfinding and operation strategies. I'm the expert. For anything else, you and Laios can make it up.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I know I'm sick of Senshi yapping about having a healthy diet, but you might actually need the lecture from him.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I've read through the contract. The terms all look solid, and so do the benefits. If you can pay me upfront, I'll be glad to work with you. I'm being blunt here for good reason—it benefits us all that we hash this out in advance, doesn't it?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: You're not gonna try and put me in combat, are you?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thanks. I'll do however much I'm paid for.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: The viciousness of Terra gives dungeons a real run for their money. On top of that, you have some nasty mimics too... Doctor, you ever see a suspicious chest, don't sit on it. Let me deal with it. Understand?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Let's be clear, I'm just the scout. Don't count on me for combat.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: This isn't my forte, but I'll try.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's go. I've got the route planned.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I hear footsteps.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Anyone need a lock picked?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I scouted this part. All clear.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Hey, this is a LOT of enemies!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Doctor, this is a mistake, right?!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: You asked for it!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Don't count on me to do any serious damage!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Cover me already!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: They just keep coming!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, give me a heads-up about this sort of mission next time. Because I'm not coming again.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Good wrap-up, and I'm a little hungry too. Times like this call for... tch, they're tainting me.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: You guys recover for now, I'll keep watch. Don't worry, if anyone approaches, I'll hear.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Good thing I secured our escape route... everyone follow me!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Time I mapped out Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hey!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, go for a round?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: A party? Count me out. Some Durin buddies got hold of some good booze, I'll go meet with them and we're getting ourselves smashed. If you want a round yourself, you're free to come by. Oh yeah, and Happy New Year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, you're not here just to see me, are you?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Catch—yep, that's a lockpicking kit, your birthday present. You were curious ever since Senshi brought it up, right? I got Engineering to make you a whole set. Do whatever you like with it, just don't let me know.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: To be honest, I was pretty skeptical of you at first. People who say they'll help for nothing are usually up to some pretty shocking stuff behind your back. Now? Now I believe a do-gooder can be real, I'll say that...

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I've never been an assistant before. It's a novel experience, but rest assured that I will not be remiss, even if this work is not my forte.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: If any children aboard Rhodes Island wish to learn piano, you may send them to me, but I am a strict teacher. I am not one to release a student partway once he begins his studies.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I hear a musical school known as 'jazz' is currently popular in Columbia. I've had the fortune to hear a few records. The free, unweighted playing style greatly amuses me, but sadly, I seem to lack the temperament for performing in such a swing.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Are you curious about my hands? Indeed, they're broader than others' at a glance. Please, they're no freakish things. I have them to thank that I can rain every melodie that swims in my head down onto the keys.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The Infected are only comparatively freer in Leithanien, and not that free. Outside of the Afterglow, there was hardly anywhere I could live, or eat... there was almost nowhere to turn.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My near-death experience unleashed a sudden, completely new melodie upon my mind. Compared to it, the musical forms I'd once learnt seemed like shackles. Just what tremendous feeling brought about its birth? Perhaps in the face of Death, I was nowhere near as fearless as I imagined.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Thank you for your concern. I'm not feeling ill—my writing is merely bottlenecked, and I haven't slept in several days. My hair, well... I often unconsciously grab at it while composing, if that explains its current unruliness.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, would you like to exercise with me? You seem surprised. Fräulein Hibiscus requested it. Most artists are the frail sort, but my recitals often exceed two hours in length. How could I handle it without a sturdy physique to support me?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You flatter me. So many voices have been snuffed out in the rapids of history. Their owners were hardly without talent; they simply left too soon, before anyone could stop and listen to their masterpieces fine as nature's song. And I was but slightly luckier, enough so to escape with my life.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Asleep? I hardly expected the lullabies I wrote to have an actual effect on you...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Greetings, Doctor, my name is Czerny. Any charm or taste I may have had has been poured entirely into my compositions. And as for myself, I am no more than a run-of-the-mill performer. That's all the introduction you need.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I will commit to watching these as you require, but this is hardly how I prefer to study. I have always approached others' second-hand experiences with skepticism.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm extremely grateful for your sponsorship, Doctor; I am currently struggling financially. The annals of Leithanian art will commemorate your giving.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I thank you for your approval. I had never seriously pursued Originium Arts before, and I hope henceforth that my Arts may be cast as freely as my melodien.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Through my creations, both pain and joy become immortal.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Compared to my piano, my ability with a baton actually fares quite well.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I've finished tuning. I may perform now.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Please be seated.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Shall I open?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Shall I close?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: To tremble in my music is your honor.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Extraordinary melodies can only be played by the soul that quakes.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Silence, immediately!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Listen or leave!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Shut up or else!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Get out! Right now!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Huff... I may be—exceptionally tired in both body and mind, but I do not want the music to end here.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Drawing the final barline here is perfect. I hardly want any movement of mine to approach tedium.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: There are times when stubborn pursuit of a technique hinders more than helps. Allowing your emotion to follow the music's natural flow can take you further.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Please, don't be disheartened. Not every composition is smooth from start to finish. There'll always be a few rounds of polish before you land where you want to.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: The deck of this ship is very spacious. Have you ever considered holding a concert there?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Watch that the noten in my pocket don't spill out.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Perhaps you like to try learning an instrument? I could teach you; I'm qualified to tutor for the majority of them.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Forgive me for turning down your invitation to perform. Even the most assiduous musician wouldn't want to work on this day, and besides, the fineness of it needs no musical dressing. The laughs of passersby and the clinking of table glasses have answered well enough, no?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I've written a new song. Would you like to hear?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I've reserved some tickets to a performance of a symphony, all fine VIP seats. If you're free on the day, you must attend. Ah, yes, I wish you a happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: To dance to music is a rare moment of liberty for the Infected. Doctor, would there be more dancing, more free souls, if I were to write more myself?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You should take a little break. It's good for you. Of course that is true, aren't you glad to hear that?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Those who chase Catastrophes are called 'Yakumeguri', or as they say here, 'Catastrophe Messengers.' The job is bitter and tiring, and we are often ridiculed by ordinary civilians and bureaucrats alike. Will my lot improve as an operator? No? Hehe, such is life.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Tomorrow's weather... hmm, I see... My dear boss, remember to bring an umbrella with you when you leave tomorrow.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: If I could have stayed in Higashi, I would not have come all the way here. But with these stones on my flesh… there's simply nowhere to call home.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I would rather offer my salary to those in need than stash it away in my lodgings. Considering how little there is, it serves a better purpose in the hands of the needy. Besides, their smiles and words of thanks really warm my heart.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I often wonder if the strange words that occasionally spill from my mouth are born of my own consciousness, or if they are bestowed upon me by the Kami-sama I have never met. The ritual verses of my relatives are all drawn from age-old scriptures, but I've always blurted mine out. It is quite confusing, to be honest.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Again and again we prance, posture, sing, and pray, with no tolerance for the slightest discrepancies. Some people find joy in filling their lives with these things, and tell others that it will bring joy to the high heavens. How truly sinful.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My clan and I lived in the mountains, not far from a Shinto shrine. At the foot of the mountain was a Buddhist temple, where the monks would return at night. Now for the question, Doctor. What do you think would happen? Hehe, I shall leave the answer on your table, feel free to take a look when you have time.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Up so late, Doctor? Do you still have something on your mind? Thoughtful eloquence is your strong suit, but don't let it get in the way of your sleep. Here, I have some incense from Higashi for you. Just one sniff, and you'll... Oh my, I didn't expect it to be this effective. Well, I suppose I shall stand guard for you tonight.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Close your eyes, and calm your mind. Good~

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Pleased to meet you. It simply would not do if I was to forget my introduction, yes? I am Tsukinogi, formerly part of a small Yakumeguri group in Higashi. It is an honor to work under you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Different communication methods? Interesting...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Oh, a reward? Now, now, how should I use this?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: The white night is a raging fire, through which a dark haze lingers. I asketh thee, where dost thy steps cease? Take things one step at a time, and do not stray off the path.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I will not fall short of your expectations.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Great is the responsibility of leading others.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The time has come. Let us go.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: There are more important things to do than pray.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Yes.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Very well.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Impurity be purged.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Soul be cleansed.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Dark flame rising, devouring existence.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Drown in the gloaming, lost in silence.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Land unending, we walk in ignorance.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Back down, before this exalted brilliance!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I was not able to help at all, but that is a cause for celebration.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Congratulations! A perfect conclusion to this mission.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The small issues that besmirch our results can be left to me. You may take your leave.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Reckless moves often bring bad results. Let us reflect upon our plan once more.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I have no demands of my accommodations, so please assign me as you will.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmm？

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: If there is anything displeasing to you, please let me know. Yes, anything at all.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: What was the first word you said this year? Hmm... I do believe that is a fortuitous omen. Rhodes Island will be blessed by good fortune this year. Congratulations.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Have you been well, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here, give me your hand. Don't be nervous. Just follow my steps... Look, our hair flutters in the breeze risen by the movement of my arms, and our clothes sway in an elegant arc. Sharing a dance together is a beautiful thing, wouldn't you agree?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Oh my... It has been quite some time since we were able to have fun like this. Sure enough, many things become enjoyable once you discard the formalities. {@nickname}, sit here. You are not allowed to go anywhere until this bottle of wine is empty.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I won't refuse if you insist, but my poor vision makes it difficult for me to handle clerical work.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: The Engineering Department is very interested in my weapon. I wish I could explain how it works, but all I know is that it requires high-purity gem crystals to run. I have ways to acquire gem scraps, but cutting a precious stone of great value into pieces works the same.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My gosh, briefing documents again? You're not lacking in manpower or technology. My advice would be to avoid spending time and effort on roundabout things... Oh, you didn't bring documents. Then I must express my gratitude. I don't want to be gazing at graphs or designs anymore. It hurts my eyes.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Whistle? Oh, it was me whistling a Leithanian tune. My sincerest apologies, this place just makes me feel relaxed, and it wasn't my... You seem to be fine with it? Strange... to my knowledge, every spire-dweller feels insulted when they hear the sound, and even the mildest scholar would lose his temper when a child whistles at them on the streets.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I've lived with the Infected since I was little, so it was only natural that I would get Oripathy myself... Well, Rhodes Island doesn't seem to accept that explanation. Then how do you like the story of a single explosion at the quarry that also collapsed many futures? A story too fanciful to believe, don't you think?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I may have underestimated you, Doctor. Tell me, would you like to bet on me? Betting on whether I'm worth trusting, betting on what tricks I have up my sleeves, betting on if I'm more than an infected. Of course, should you have a change of mind, I'll get back and continue to work on my worthless stone.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I'm not interested in talking about the past. As you can see, my lab was destroyed, and all traces cut off. I no longer have to put a price on gems with blood on them... all of which have put my mind at ease, in fact. I no longer have to imagine the gems being cut into pieces, after all.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I don't know when I'll return to Leithanien, but I would like to invite you for my next operation. There won't be any cooperation, nor do I intend to share my plans... but I'll ask you to keep your eyes on me, to witness all that I do. You're the only one who can see through me, aren't you? Come then.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I can take you to the top of any spire in Leithanien. How does that sound? You'd understand me there. The scent of the wind is clean at the top... and that's all. That's all that young boy in the gem mine longed for.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: If you fall asleep, then nothing here can pique my interest.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Which name card would you like: the one in my left hand, or the one in my right...? Diamante, gemologist. Pleased to make your acquaintance. Don't worry, there's no target here worth my attention, even if you picked the other card.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: A practical video, free from excessive narration and trite background music.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thanks. I don't normally collect medals for the purpose of displaying status, but if you insist, I will place it at the top of my collection to demonstrate my respect for you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Steal a piece of bread, go to jail. Offend a noble, get beaten. Steal a priceless treasure, and you get to stand at the top of the tallest spire. Be my guest, Doctor, and come watch my show, watch the audience cheer. Will it bring you joy, or sorrow?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Colluding with me is not something to be done lightly.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: One wrong step, and we'll pay a heavy price. I expect perfect teamwork from you.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: As promised.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: What do you possess that's mine to take?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: As you wish.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: This is the only value of gemstones.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: To all my enemies: I will Crack. You. Down.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I shall have the honor to pulverize what you treasure.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Will you cheer for me? I can't help but wonder!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: How will you struggle? How will you hold on to what you have?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: When will I strike, and take what you cherish the most?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Who has not earned their end?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I shared my life with you. Repay that debt, and tell me what fruit our efforts have born. Tell me what's the rewards of valor.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We can leave now. I'm sure no witnesses escaped.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: A gem loses its value when flawed with impurities and cracks. You might as well dispose of it.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Are you still alive? Good. We all have our share of misfortune, but now you've had your stakes back, which you can risk on the line in the next game. Allow me to congratulate you on that.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What assessment would you like from me? It's the only place I can call home for now. I don't dare to be critical.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Of course, it's your prerogative.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: If I may interest you with a grind such as gem polishing, then please, take the seat to my opposite.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Should I hang this up on that wall over there...? Don't look at me like that, I just want to have a good holiday season. I always hope for good things to happen when a new year comes around, even though I know that nothing ever changes without sacrifice.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Greetings, Doctor. Do you need something appraised?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Be careful when eating that cake, Doctor. I put a little ruby in it. Good luck to you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I laugh at those people who put such value on a rock, but I couldn't laugh at you, because you truly want to prove that even an Infected life is worth something. It's almost as absurd as I am.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Omigosh, a close-up chance to watch the Doctor at work. Finally, I'll get a glimpse of Rhodes Island's secrets! Huh? You just want me to tell you a scary story to keep you up? Seriously? Fine, two choices then: The Headless Burdenbeastman of the Barrens, or The Thousand-Year Curse of the Sargonian Tomb. Which one, Doc?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I never imagined I'd see two familiar faces from Wrankwood here. Nah, I'm not that interested in them personally, just curious on how they ended up on a pharma company's landship. They must have some kinda angle here!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: What am I looking at, standing here on the bridge? Uh, I was just thinking how Rhodes Island's such a great place. Look, sealed spaces, high mobility, destinations unknown, everyone's using code names... doesn't it feel like a survival-slasher horror flick?!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I tried doodling a 'Slenderburdenbeastman' symbol on this corner of the corridor here, but no one's reacting to it when they walk by. Why? Not enough Columbians onboard? Nobody knows the legend?—Relax, I'll clean it up once my experiment's done.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The device on my back's made of suspension cables and hover units, and I'm the only one with anything like it in Wrankwood. I met my master who taught me how to retrofit it on a little production. He spent whole days there with a jetpack on his back. Dunno where he went after production wrapped. Omigosh, you might have seen him in Sargon?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Look! Timestamp three-seventeen, see how the vapor turns the smile in the makeup mirror into a spooky face—this clip's one of my best! I tried it at home once when I was a kid. All these people came by to talk about how great my drawings were, only to get a nasty shock. I just knew it was gonna be super effective.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I joined Greta's crew because she promised me artistic freedom, but that was another load of crap! Meeting Miss.Christine and Lucian gave me a lot of inspiration though. Don't you think it'd be fun to make a horror flick about a storm-cloudbeast exorcist?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Nah, I don't butt heads with my parents that much, I just don't like how stiff their pictures are. And I didn't like the path they laid out for me either. But... I guess I've got a long way to go before the skills and resources needed to put together a real spectacular movie.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: When I was starting out, I joined some little production crews, hoping to meet interesting people, but I ended up so busy I couldn't get a convo in... These days, at least I got you to lend me an ear whenever I come back onboard, Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor? Oh, busy? Suits me, Tippi can take care of herself. Let's see if there's anything new to watch... Omigosh, an nonconformist Lungmen horror comedy... let's do this one!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Live long and prosper! Tippi 'Skyriftwalker' Booker reporting for duty! Who, Doctor? Oh, Skyriftwalker's the code name I thought up for myself! Uh, that's not how you do code names here?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: The protag gets a videotape everyday, describing her life bit by bit, until one day the video shows her killing people... don't you think that fits the vibes in this recording? No? For reals?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: That's it? Pretty mid ceremony. No test or anything like that?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I get another promotion? Does this mean I can go some places I wasn't allowed before?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Omigosh, this a co-op mission? I'll get along real nice with everybody.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Ooh, just got a new idea! Let's try it out!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: C'mon! Let's go see the wonderful sights waiting for us out there.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: An extra special spot we got here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Finally my turn to make a move? I'm in a good spot!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Spray gun and hover unit ready.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Let's set the rigging!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I've almost finished this piece. Just a sec!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Some deep purple for a sense of mystery.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Bit of dark red to get your heart pumping.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: A little lime green for a weird rotten vibe.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: The stage's set, now let's see how everyone performs!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Now this is a perfect work of art! Lemme just tag my name in the corner here real quick.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: So much for Wrankwood war movies.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: That was an epic experience!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Let me edit that op's recording. I might just come up with a new kind of horror flick.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: So I can't tag the corridors, but can I spraypaint my own dorm walls?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Keep on tapping the device on my back, and something scary just might pop out.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Don't worry about me, if you're tied up. I can keep myself busy. Oh, you're done? Wanna watch a movie together?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Watch a New Year's blockbuster together? Sure—'Famous Columbian husband-and-wife producer-director duo collabs on joint production for war film...' Okay, Doctor, I don't mind going with you, but don't blame me if I fall asleep halfway in.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Want me to spray some colors around to liven up the place and brighten your mood?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I always had big parties as a kid. The adults would use them as an excuse to socialize, like with totally zero thought to what the birthday girl wanted. Wasn't the biggest fan. So for your birthday, I redecorated your room based on your favorite movies this year. What'cha think?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island's a proper pharma company, I've seen that with my own eyes—too bad it doesn't have the stories I got up here in my head. But Doc, you're full of mysteries, so I have to keep watching you for reference material. And who knows, you might even star in your own horror movie one day.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Good morning, Doctor. Can I paint a portrait of you? And don't worry, I'll try not to... bring it to life. Besides, it's not like I can bring everything to life, you know.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Maybe I wasn't supposed to appear here?…

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor... what color are you, reflected in my eyes?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: There are lots of fun, creative things here at Rhodes Island. I'm feeling inspired…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: See my lovely 'assistants'? Hehe… What? You think they're scary? But, but they're so cute!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Heh, so these are the colors of your soul…? Alright then, look at me. And paint me in those colors, your colors.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: That's right. Even if no one understands me, I'll keep making art. No matter what kinds of monsters my works might become…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: We artists are a unique breed… We spend at least thirty days a month stuck in a rut, thinking all our work is trash. And we only make any progress when inspiration strikes after midnight.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: In the end, the mottled world sleeps peacefully in the dark depths—Yes, that's the true color of the ocean. Black is the only color you see? Looks like I still have more to share with you…

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Are you... dreaming? Is the world in your dreams as colorful as the beings of this world, Doctor…?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Deepcolor, a painter. Yes, just a 'painter', nothing more.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: What's this unsettling feeling...?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Um, could you just... stop caring about me? If you keep treating me so well... I-I don't know what I might become…

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thank you, Doctor. Now, let's complete this work of art, shall we?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: You're sending me to fight? Seriously?!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I can't lead so many people.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Do your best, everyone!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Is that who we're fighting?!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Me?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: What do I do?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Scumble-scumble...

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Aww, I just need a minute!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: No need to rush.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Let's take it slow.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You'll have to get past my 'assistants' first.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Can you defeat my little ones?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: If you really make me mad... you won't like what happens next.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Let me sketch these triumphant heroes.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Aw, got my clothes dirty again...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: If only battles were like sketches. I'd just erase that one and redo it…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This room's got a nice design.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, since we happen to have some time off, want to see my latest work?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. What colors do I see for the coming year? Hm… the aroma of food, smiling operators, and presents full of kindness… a warm, tender turmeric? It's like nothing I've ever felt. I have to get this onto a canvas.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here's a hand-drawn birthday card. Do you like it? Heheh. I have two birthdays myself, in a way. I achieved a new form, after accepting the gift. Here, Doctor, look—I created this color, but it is entirely yours.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: What day is it? Oh, of course. I see my 'assistants' are all joining in on the fun. Alright, why don't we let them make an even more beautiful piece for Rhodes Island?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Close your eyes, don't rush to open them. They may feel slightly hot, that's normal... Shh, stay calm, I crushed some herbs to help your eyes relax. You must have been staring at some dangerous thing. I do that a lot, trust me.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: A guide...? I guess Simone is a better fit for the job. She's also a veteran hunter like me, so I know you'll be in good hands, and won't get into... trouble. There have been some misunderstandings and a few tribes now turn me away. Just remember, if anyone tells you I'm a man eater, they're lying.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Hands off. I've told you before, no one gets to touch my bow. Not you, not the smiths. You don't have the skills to hunt shadows in the depth of Sami, so you shouldn't draw their attention. I know your kind, I know you're curious. I'll just repeat myself over, over, and over again until I get through to you.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Check the logs from the research teams. See? These little hornbeasts are friends, they're harmless. And this kind of snow needs Arts to control, so call me if you run into some. Good, go ahead and add some notes to these pictures, you're pretty clever. Why the look? Is it so strange that I know how to use electronics?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: You all are strange, just like Magallan, insisting on comprehending the land on your own terms. I've seen your hard work, you'll come to know the whole of Sami as you see her in your dreams someday. But now? You aren't there yet. I'm worried about you, but since we're working together, just listen to me and you'll be fine.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Put that navigation instrument down, you're no professional, it's wearing you out just carrying it around. Let me lead the way, just like Arges used to do for me. She always says pitfalls and pains guide you to destiny, but I find I can get where I want by just following the sound of the breeze and the twigs in the trees.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You've never tried sleeping on a cave floor before? What about a bed made of vines? You should give it a try, I can't get a good night's sleep if I don't hear the heartbeat of Sami. How could I even close my eyes if I can't wake the moment I get a vision...? Yes, I have a lot of nightmares, what about it?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: ...You called for me? Did you come across some trouble? If everything's fine, let me sit here alone for a while... I'm looking at the dead. The unsullied dead will walk among the beasts of the forest... I'm still looking for my parents.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Have I ever gotten lost? Hmm... Maybe. I left my home at first to find revenge, but when I saw all that sullied snow, I could only think to draw my bow and aim, to show the shadows that I was the true hunter. Can you be a hunter, too? Or can you be a companion to carry me out of danger when I'm hurt?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Does the Doctor have the same kind of dreams that I do? Hm, probably not, we aren't in Sami, after all... Lucky enough for you, the shadows won't be chasing you through your dreams then.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: If you come across any abnormalities while we're working together, I'll take care of them for you... Codename? Typhon is my only name. I found it on the horn ornament my mother left behind. Some people say it sounds scary, though.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Are you trying to show off your camera skills? No...? But how can you even call this combat experience, if you don't experience it yourself?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Um, what's this promotion badge for again? If it's useless in combat, then let's wait until we settle the danger right in front of us, then you tell me the story behind it.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Many travelers to Sami find death in avalanches caused by loud boasting, or other arrogant behavior. They never even get a chance to see Sami's shadow. You won't make the same kind of mistake, not with me accompanying you.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Take these weapons and tools. We need them more than extra hands.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Got it, I'll take the lead. Don't be nervous, I can handle this.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Stay close, don't run off.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Don't let them out of sight, even if your eyes are hurting.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Stay calm and make your move. No need to worry, I've got your back.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: What do you need of me?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Time to choose our prey.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Good timing.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I'll pin you to your shadow.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Cowards break the silence first.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Nature should not be disturbed.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Get out of my home!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Each of my arrows slows the black that taints the Sami snow.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I see you managed to complete a mission without causing any unnecessary pain to the quarry. Um, not bad, not bad. Sip a hot drink and get some rest.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: If you've run out of arrows or let your target escape, then you should give up the chase. You've already lost.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Grasp these seeds tightly in your hand, and run. Don't look back. I'll take care of things here.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Can you explain how these machines work? I've got a good memory, Magallan explained the structure of the research station last time, and I still remember it all... Well, at least, I think I do.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Nope, you'll have to be faster than that to even think about faking an attack.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Do you have someone you trust standing guard? I want to rest for a bit, your camp is so warm…

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Oh, there have been more and more people celebrating this festival. Will you have a feast too? What about fireworks? Always? Seems I've come to the right place. I'm going to look around for activities I've never tried before, so you don't have to entertain me.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: What's up, Doctor. Where have you been? You're not lost, are you?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I helped you find a safe spot. Trees, water from freshly melted snow, the rotting flesh of beasts buried in the soil—you have to thank them for joining your spirit and letting you walk on this land. Come, take my hand.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: It's good practice to always check up on your prey, because the hunt never truly ends. I've seen you defeat many opponents and save many lives. Good on you, but... you wish to fully wipe your enemy from the face of this land? No, a permanent extermination is just wrong.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: There are some matters I could help you with. But make no mistake, I am not a go-between for you and Enciodes.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I once ran into the Saintess at the foot of the mountain, where she stuffed a book into my hands. She told me that, if I'm bored, I might as well try copying some scripture. I heeded her suggestion and copied a passage every day. At first, I did it just to pass the time, but then I realized it helps me to relax a little too. I find it intriguing.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Leithanien, Kazimierz, Kjerag. Three decades, more or less. The days I spent in Kjerag were the most dull. No opponents, no challenges, no excitement... But before I knew it, I had become accustomed to the bleats of burdenbeasts, the sensation of shoes sinking into the snow, and the weight of a little sobering medicine on me.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The first time I became champion was to prove myself. The second time was to hone myself. And the third was a wake up call I made to those who thought they could control me. The price I paid for it? Just a few Darksteel arrows. Hmph, a pity I didn't get an actual match.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I saw the Radiant Knight. No, there's no point in fighting here, so you need not arrange one for me. A proper fight needs her at her peak, at the right time, in the right place, and situation. Victory then will be a matter of life and death. Though, how or when that moment will come won't be up to me at all.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Enciodes treats me like a sword—a sword intended to reflect more than kill, a blade serving as a mirror with which to scrutinize himself. The stronger I get, the more he exercises restraint. Such a relationship will continue until the day... he no longer needs a sword.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I went back to Leithanien once, after becoming champion. From 'a defective Leithanian unable to use Arts', to 'a natural-born warrior', only to still find myself unwelcome. The locals looked at me the same as they did decades earlier. Coming to terms with that, I found my hatred for the land had cooled some.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: A few years ago in Kjerag, I was dining at a local restaurant I frequented where some foreign tourists tried to pick a fight with me. Before I could get a word in, the shop owner grabbed me by the arm and shouted to them, 'What are you punks doing?! Get away from our Kjerag lady!' I'll never forget that.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: There are many who rely on you and Enciodes to provide them a meaningful way of life, and you relish it just as he does. But for me, I've just met another patron who engages in self-neglect. Right then, the meeting's about to begin. Drink this glass of water to refresh yourself. And hold still, your collar's wrinkled.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Sleep. No one will bother you.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Degenbrecher. A codename? You can just use that. I looked through the contract, and the scope of my work seems unchanged. I am still a bodyguard, just the employer is different.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Not bad.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Formalities like these remind me of the time when Karlan Trade was first established. Gnosis was so full of himself as he declared my position to the others. It was then that I decided to wait for a chance... to smash that cocky face of his to the ground.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: When I pinned the medals on my soldiers, the first cohort of Tschäggättä to complete my training, I saw some pretty fine expressions on them. I can see this ship has many with similar faces.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Is this a mission, or a training session?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Follow me close, no dinner for those who fall behind.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Good, I suppose you've already got a plan.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Keep your distance, or you risk getting caught up in the fighting.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Still mulling things over, Dr. Perfectionist?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: You want my opinion?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: How soon do you want them gone?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: You can go do something else.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Emotion is meaningless here.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Conviction will throw you off pace.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Still soaking yourself in the past?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Use your weapon to tell me who you are.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Whenever there's an avalanche in Kjerag, I always free my schedule to test my skills there. It's a rare form of recreation for me. Apparently, Rhodes Island won't be dull in that respect, at the very least.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Your face just now... it seems the expression 'fowls of a feather flock together' is indeed true.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I let a few get away, as you bid me. What next?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Hold my hand tight, and your breath with it. What comes next might be a little disorienting, but press on.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: We have to use codenames here? That's obnoxious.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: You'll need to try a little harder if you want to pick up my degenbrecher.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Here. You left this file in the meeting room. It's fine, I'm used to doing this.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Rhodes Island is a bit too warm, compared to Kjerag, be it the temperature or the extent of enthusiasm here. I'm far more used to spending winter all bundled up indoors, partaking of some home-cooking together with a few weary faces. But maybe I should adapt to the ambience here.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, you know how busy your schedule is today, yes?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I've forgotten my birthday, just as I'll soon forget my own name. But that's not important. Degenbrecher is my name, and if I can recall the day I took it, you can call that my birthday. But back on topic. Will you manage to open all the presents here today?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I used to have my doubts about Rhodes Island, same as I used to distrust a certain someone's nonsense when I started working for him. But today, Karlan Trade is building Kjerag, and tomorrow, Rhodes Island will treat more Oripathy patients still. I've been keeping an eye on Rhodes Island for Karlan Trade long enough that it's just another part of my routine.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Good work, Doctor. Why don't you take a break? Oh, don't worry, I'm already done with the report… Haha, there's no need for a compliment. It's really not a big deal, I've simply become experienced with these things.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Wait, wait, Doctor, s-stop tugging, I'll take them out myself! There, all the cards I hid up my sleeves. Haha, I figured you'd see right through me. If we get a chance to go to Dossoles, I'll show you some even more interesting things.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Every time I talk to Miss Ch'en, as well as that Miss Lin, I get all nervous. Man, I really don't want to get beaten up again… What, you can't tell? Well, Doctor, here, check out my palms. They're all sweaty!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Yo, Doctor, fancy seeing you here. Looking for someone? Oh, Rafaela? I'm afraid I don't know where she is either. Guess you can tell, without the old man here, we have very little to say to each other.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My old man threw me into the army reserves when I was just a kid. We were all kids, really. Some of us had burning ambitions, but I'd say most of us didn't even know what we wanted. Life was tough, and we were just looking for a way out, nothing more.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Dossoles should be in good hands with Miss Candela. As for the old man, he's better off behind bars for now. He needs to calm down and reflect on his actions. You see, Doctor, when I agreed to help him one last time,  it was my way of trying to find answers,  and sort out my thoughts. Now... I've found my answers.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: When we first arrived in Dossoles, Rafaela and I were still very young. We quickly adapted to life there, but the old man still insisted on his integrity and his old ideology... Can't do anything about it, but I figure I should at least try to help.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, here's the mission report from last time. I've already handled the follow-ups. Ah, don't worry, there won't be any problems. It'd be a real bummer if something unexpected happened and ruined our carefully laid plans. I'm not about to allow that.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: So how about it, Doctor? Did you draw the card you wanted? Aw, better luck next time! Though I should say, in a game of chance, there's nothing less reliable than luck. But rest assured, if you're ever in need of it, I'll deliver luck right into your hands.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, I'll put all the materials I've organized over here. Hm? Asleep… Look at all the important documents you left lying here... You must trust me a whole lot…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello there, are you the Doctor? Great, you're just as recognizable as Miss Ch'en said you'd be. Oh, right, I should pick out a code name, then? Hmm... Let's go with Tequila! Sounds pretty nice, eh?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I'm supposed to try this move myself? That… seems painful.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Already? Whoa… thanks a million. In any case, without further ado, let's talk about future changes to my work…

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: When Miss Ch'en brought me in, I never thought I'd see a day like this. So, does that mean I'm one of your most capable subordinates? Haha, it's not a joke, whether you need me to be a tour guide or something else, you can rest easy knowing you're in good hands.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: OK, Got it. Leave it to me.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm in charge of the squad? Haha, I appreciate the trust…

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Follow my lead. Be careful, and don't fall behind.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Come, let us show our guests some hospitality.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Need my help with anything?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Awaiting orders.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Sorry, this path is closed for business.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Pardon me, I'd like you all to stop right there.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Don't get worked up, let's talk first.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Violence isn't really my thing, but well…

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Negotiation Failed.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Begone.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: You even managed to anticipate their ambush, Doctor! I guess there's no shame in them losing like that. I still have much to learn.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Everything's taken care of, Doctor... How did I take care of it? Doctor, do you really need to hear that?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Phew, that was a close one. Are you alright, Doctor? Yeah… A few of 'em got away. Let me see…

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Let's retreat for now! We'll live to fight another day!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Ah, so this is the dorm... Mind if I give it a makeover, and buy some little decorations for it?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Tsk... What the… Oh, it's you, Doctor.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: It was raining out there just now, and my hair got a little wet... Sorry, Doctor, could you pass me that towel?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy new year, Doctor! My new cards are here, so, how about a game? Entertainment at Rhodes Island is nothing compared to Dossoles, sure, but as long as you've got me, we'll manage. I know a thing or two about creating a festive atmosphere.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: How are you feeling today? Want to head out for a bit?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here, Doctor, a birthday present for you. Guess what's in the box… Hey, no, don't shake it so hard! It's expensive, and we'll have nothing to drink if you break it!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: For those who seek change but set off on the wrong foot, no matter how flashy their appearance, they will always lack substance. That's why I appreciate Rhodes Island and its work. Salud, Doctor, to us both finding the right path forward.

voices.text: My next mission is to protect you, Doctor.

voices.text: Happy New Year. I was just about to give these to Exusiai. She said she'd be hosting a big party tonight, to celebrate her results not being rock bottom. The other girls? Croissant was hauling a huge batch of goods she got in earlier, so I figure she's got a stall laid out now. As for Sora... have you heard her new single, Doctor? I'm pretty into it.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here's a box of vinyls from the boss's collection. I got it from Lungmen. Take it, Doctor. No need to worry about my boss. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here's a box of vinyls from the boss's collection. I got it from Lungmen. Take it, Doctor. No need to worry about my boss. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I like how Rhodes Island does its anniversaries. Here's a couple wine truffles I just picked up, rum and bitter almond flavor. Tastes pretty good. Why don't you give them a try?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I like how Rhodes Island does its anniversaries. Here's a couple wine truffles I just picked up, rum and bitter almond flavor. Tastes pretty good. Why don't you give them a try?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Help you with your work? Okay, I can do street art, choreography, puppet craft... anything, really. What do you need?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: No, I don't know any Durins at Rhodes Island. Besides, I don't want to go back underground. You know why I left in the first place? When we voted on the monthly music genre, I tossed in death metal. They actually voted against me a thousand-to-one!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The graffiti in the corridor? I forgot to wipe it off. Besides, I went to fess up to Closure. And I got a gift for Aciddrop, since she took the blame. I even stepped in to clean for Purestream. You're not mad at me about anything? Hm, okay. So... Do you want to go tagging with me next time, then?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The bandages? Yeah, I was gonna use them to cover my Originium crystals, but they keep popping up all over me. A few little bandages can't get them all. It only makes the crystals even more obvious. Why keep the bandages? It's like a statement, you know? The crystals are there, whether you see them or not, and they haven't killed me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: After they destroyed the puppets my street art community made, I spent two weeks apprenticing with my electrician neighbor. Taking the new skills I learned with my Arts, my puppets became more than just artwork. Whenever I cast it, the puppets appear, and uppercut the bad guys as hard as I do.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: This looks like a coffin? Because that's what it is. Oh, could I trouble you to write a eulogy for me? Don't worry, it's for an art exhibition. Many people are 'further from death' than me, but they're still basically walking dead. I just want to give them a wake-up call.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The Society Tribune in Dossoles talks bad about our community. They called us 'sociopathic'. So I pinned a bulletin outside their office, telling them how we eat when we're hungry, sleep when we're tired, and love when we're lonely. If that's 'sociopathic', then society's pathetic.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: We beat Mateo down hard in the end, but storming the art gallery was a mess, especially when I led the charge to the balcony to save that bastard, Reynell. Some guys got hurt so bad they'll never hold a paintbrush again… This should've been my blood.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I told you NOT to pat my head! If you were anyone else, I would've thrashed you for that. Since you're not exactly tough, lower your head... lower... now close your eyes. Hmm... there! I just slapped a ticket on your head. Wanna know where? Go ahead, pat your head for it, hehe.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, I know I was wrong. I shouldn't have hidden my medicine, let alone tried to send it to Dossoles. Please don't be mad, okay? Wait... Are you snoring? Are you even listening?! Ah well, guess that means my apology is accepted.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Are you the Doctor? I'm Tecno. Ernesto sent me to Rhodes Island for treatment, so I'm here to say hi... Um...You're not calling me kiddo? Because you're a nice person, or because there are lots of Durins at Rhodes Island?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: The way that guy fights, it's like some sick choreographed dance. I'm totally stealing those moves. Fighting or dancing? Wouldn't you like to know... hehe.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, ahem, well... you've always looked out for me. So I got my street art crew to make this bracelet for you. Ah? Wait, you've got something for me first? I... guess I won't argue, hehe.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, forget the medal. I got my art crew to build you a puppet—we're talking several stories high. Now I just need a hood for this monster. You got any spare outfits I can snag?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Beating up bad guys again? Count me in! My puppets and I will come in handy!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: A group fight? Leave it to me. I'll make sure everyone gets back in one piece.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I don't care how you fight. Just remember one thing: don't play the hero. Call me if things get messy.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Hmph, aggressive. Looks like we'll have to settle this with force.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Out with it! I'm in the middle of stretching!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Give me an order. Me, and my puppets, are getting antsy.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'm not used to being this high up. Can I go back down?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Okay, sure. My puppets should be able to handle these guys, anyway.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Box step!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Weight Shift!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Spiral Turn!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Hey, you! You're the one getting beaten! You don't have to follow my moves!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, why are you just standing there? C'mon, take my hand, let's dance!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Phew, another lesson for those who never learn. What a satisfying day.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Some of them got away? Let them go. You know the old saying, 'today's enemies are tomorrow's friends'.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Today you got lucky, but we'll see! Quickly, Doctor, we gotta run!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Rhodes Island's facilities are impressive... I'm getting the itch to help renovate the art community. Have to pay it forward.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Puppet's right behind you. Hmmm, seriously? You're not scared at all? Boooring!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: A shoulder tap? Fine, so long as you don't pat my head.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Come! Check out our New Year's concert. Doesn't it make you want to dance? Hahaha~ Good music is supposed to make you jump out of your seat and dance! And Leithanian music totally fails at that!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Morning, Doctor. Still remember the dance moves I taught you yesterday?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Come dance with my puppet! Your feet are stuck in their joints? Don't. Move. I'll fix this... There! Now you've got yourself a mobility scooter! Happy birthday! Wondering how to get your feet out? Hehe, I'll tell you tomorrow.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, my old man just came to Rhodes Island to visit me! Who's crying? I'm not! Here, a voucher for Spicy Krysztauowa's Rhodes location. Go there! Go and eat! Don't you forget to use it!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Remember, you two, this purr-ticular assistant role calls for maximum vigilance. If any meownsters come knocking, we throw the Doctor on the cart and go!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Curious about our latest research? We're gnawing on 'An Investigation into Biological Discrepancies Between Us Felynes with a Y and Terran Felines with an I.' We were halfway done, but then we found out you have Aslans too, so it's back to the scratching post for us... You Terrans are meowder with your subspecies!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Your Meowjesty, never forget to eat your fill before you go on a hunt. Dive into a fight with full stamina, and you might end up doing things you didn't even think you could... mrrreow!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: *dink* *dink* No Machalite Ore left...  Could substitute with Rock Spider stones and gloompincer shells... Don't know without trying. In you go.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The mountains never fail to remind me of an old bud, built just as tall and strong. He broke his weapon once and quit the Palico life after, but if memory serves, he then went with the Research Commission to take up cheffing in the New World... You never know what turn your next life'll take.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Say, Doctor, I'll let you in on a secret trick, friend to... maybe furless friend. If you ever get hurt in battle and you need to chug a Potion, set off a Barrel Bomb behind you while you do. Why? It'll stop any baddies getting the pounce on you, that's why!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Terra has new materials. Lots of ores. Very lovely... Maybe I can make a weapon just like that Great Sword in the ice cave back home! For mew, Doctor!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Meow, meow, lots of... fascinating things in Doctor's room. Want to move them elsewhere, while Doctor's asleep... Smithy! Stay your paw!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: On Your Meowjesty's summons, we the Felyne Special Corps... cream of the crop of the Terra Research Commission's Furst Fleet, have arrived! Meowch! Get your hind paws off my head!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: What are you doing inside this box, Smithy? Im... Impawssible! It's all moving! How is it done?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Ready for departure!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: A simple task! I'm a purr-ime leader, after all!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's go, 'Hunters!' Put some pep in your step!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Purr-ey spotted. Watch out, Your Meowjesty.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: By your bidding, Your Meowjesty.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Meow! Right here!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: You two! Now!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: You're purr-essing too hard!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Aim fur that weak spot!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: They're wide open!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Taste the flaming soul of a hunter!

voices.title: In Battle 4
