voices.text: The purr-fect slinger technique!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Are... Are we out of danger meow? Can I open my eyes yet?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Absolutely stellar command, Your Meowjesty. That's what I call great gains... mrreow.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Equipment everywhere... grabbing, all of it. Grabbing and going.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Good gravy, they're catching up! Run, run like your tail's on fire!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Hauling, hauling... Smithy, why do you drag that meowntain of materials with you everywhere you go?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Mrrow~

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: What are you doing? Mrrow... right there, please... Hey, save a pet or two for me!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Ah, Doctor! Fine day to mew!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Be at ease. I won't let another assassin do his work right in front of me, ever again.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: There's nothing that can derail the historical trajectory of Victoria, not even Theresis, or even the dukes. It's nothing but different people taking turns to wallow in the same puddle of mud. You want my honest opinion? Heh. Stay back, lest you get mud splashed on you.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I lived with Mum for a long time when she was stationed on the border all year round, and the towers of Londinium were never in sight... I never so much as asked her. Just what it was that made her so willing to toil away all those years, out on the border?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Say. I hear Her Royal Highness Alexandrina is continuing to gather more supporters? Very well... Sooner or later, Vina will have to face the same choice as I did. Though all told, taking off a crown invites far more obstacles than giving up a dukedom. If you get the chance, do tell her I wish her all the best.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The sword brandished and never sheathed is the sword of the weak. Even though my mum taught me swordplay from a young age, more than anything, she made me practice the art of stowing my blade. If I'm to inherit her position, then I can't be daggers drawn for most issues that greet me... And just knowing that chafes.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: 'Self-evident?' 'Just?' Great nobles in their ivory towers, engaging in nefarious deeds so that their country endures and prospers, is that self-evident? The starving Infected robbing the innocent in a desperate attempt to live another day, is that just? These are questions I won't give up on finding the answers to.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Rhodes Island has shown its sincerity to me, so even though she's... no longer with us, our deal still stands true. Of course, this is as long as you don't mind my currently utterly powerless status, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Did you find these... at the video shop? I actually picked these out just for Baird, but she never gave them the time of day, saying they were just so noisy... They're useless now, so you can have them. These are some of Wrankwood's must-watch comedy classics.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: There's countless scenarios I've thought of to prevent my mum from being assassinated, and always, always, the result is the same... She was so strong, she never had a need to question her own decisions. Tears? Hah, you must be mistaken, Doctor. I learned long ago to never cry.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You can rest easy, I'll be here. There aren't many chances to take a nap on the battlefield.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: We can save each other the trouble of introducing ourselves, and I'll treat this contract as a token of you approving how we cooperate. Can I get back to work now, Doctor?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This battle record is a five out of five. It's as good as the Wrankwood action blockbusters I used to watch at the video shop.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Interesting. A 'medical organization,' employing a standard military promotion system...? Hmm. I can already see certain people getting their just desserts for underestimating you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: A higher position often means taking more responsibilities, but I'm sick of people in those positions using responsibility as a shield for their own selfishness, so I hope things will be different here. In any case, our partnership has at least for now, taken another step forward.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'll cooperate at all times.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Don't worry. I'll make sure everyone on the squad is safe.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Bury the habit of fighting each to your own!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Survey the terrain, and clear out those despicables in hiding.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hesitancy is forbidden on the battlefield!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: May I draw my sword now?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: A radical strategy, but I can work with it.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Judge by appearance, and suffer the consequences.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Do not disregard me!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: You picked the wrong foe!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: A fine opportunity.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: No need to hold back.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: That was some clean commanding. We have a bit of time before our mission is estimated to end, so you should grab the chance to think about how to reward yourself.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A reasonable result. I'd doubt your ability to achieve your ambitions, if coping with this was beyond you.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: It's not for us to leave without regrets, Doctor... Let's accept reality.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Am I... still not good enough?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This style... it fits my impression of you.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: That's rude.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Want some canned food? The sugar will get you fat though.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor... Um, everyone's asking me to attend the party? I used to spend the day with just Mum, so I don't know... Never mind, I have nothing else to do today anyway, so let's go, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: It's been a while, Doctor. Ready to move out?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I took this photo from someplace high up while on a certain trip. Can you tell who these people are fighting for, when they've been reduced to dots? Perhaps you've never seen the land of Victoria from such a perspective, so who knows just what ideas you might have. No need to tell me though. Happy birthday, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: We were all there when that happened out of the blue... Even now I still can't forget just how powerless I felt then. Such occasions will only happen even more often, as you get more and more factions watching you. Can you still persevere on, even when facing an unstoppable disaster?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hey, Doctor. I'm here to hang!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, don't look down on me just 'cause I'm little. Back where I'm from, all the kids looked up to me.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Durin used the name of our race as her codename because she's so lazy, but isn't it kind of dumb how calling me 'Myrtle of Durin' made me sound like I belong to her or something?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I understand how all the machines here work, but it still feels weird using them. Some have a lot of different parts, but some are surprisingly simple.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My banner? Good eye, Doctor. It sure is a tablecloth from my house. I sneaked it out with me because it can't get dirty. My dad is probably pretty mad about it!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Is my apple really that great? They're popular back home. You can study or play with it if you want, Doctor, just don't break it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: There are still many things I'm not used to on land, but I love the many delicious foods. The cafe on Rhodes Island is my favorite!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I do have to point out the fact, Doctor, that I am a full-grown adult! And I'm tall by Durin standards! Please tell everyone to stop patting me on the head and giving me candy!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Say, Doctor, are you interested in my homeland? I can take you there! But it's pretty far, so wait till I'm in the mood.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Are you taking a break? You can use my banner as a blanket.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Reporting in! You must be the Doctor? Call me Myrtle, Myrtle of Durin. Durin said I could get a job here, so what have you got for me? I may be small, but I'm tough!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Cool fight... Got some more, Doctor?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Oh, did I get promoted? Does that mean I can go somewhere I couldn't before?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I told you I'm tough! Told you!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: There's a mission? I wanna go!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Don't anyone wander away.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's go!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Don't worry, you got me!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Whoa, almost dozed off...

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Good scenery here, Doctor!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'm here to help!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I have to get serious now!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Gather around me, guys!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: We're counting on you again today, little apple.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Phew, I'm exhausted! I wanna go to lie down, Doctor.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Flawless victory! I was pretty good, wasn't I, Doctor?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We won, Doctor, and that's what counts!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Run!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Wow, Rhodes Island is huge!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hey, that is fun!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Why can't the cafe open 24 hours?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Take the flag down, tie it up over here... Good! That's my cloth sack done! Oh, Doctor, you're here, too. Come, we'll eat up all the tasty food in the canteen! It's the first day of the year. Let's kick it off by eating our fill!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Any more fun things to do, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: So, Doctor, today's your birthday, huh? Then as a mature adult, let me give you a little present. Hm, Doctor, kneel down a little... Ahem-hem. Good job, good job... Alright! That was a compliment from the Generalissimo herself. You did well, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I guess I followed Durin to a pretty nice place. I've seen huge nomadic cities, beaten up so many baddies in battle, and eaten so many great foods I'd never seen before. Once I get home, I'll turn all these stories into a travelogue and get it published. It's bound to be a bestseller!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You want me to do something so boring...? Fine, fine. I'll tag along, just because you're somewhat amusing.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Don't count on me to move stuff. I'm not that brand of Forte.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: This is some insanely precise instrumentation... Wait, haven't I seen these before? Oh, right. If that Mayer girl shows up, don't tell her where I am.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Never seen the equipment on my back before? Right, come over, put your hand here... keh-ka-hahahahahah! Look at your pathetic face! Guess what just sprayed out? It's water!—With a few... extras. Don't bother asking what!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My interest in helping others is zip. But boosting efficiency benefits everybody.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Battles finish up faster now. Good to know, I guess.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Cake? Soft and squishy—not my speed. But. Mmp, mmnm... the umeboshi on top's not bad, sure.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: No rain inside the landship? Duh, obviously I know that. But you never know how it might go outside. Hmph, next time there's a storm, stick close to me. You'll be glad I'm holding this.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Hey. Fancy a desert day trip? I can guide you around there. Or anywhere else you like, as long as I have my multi-function jetpack, following the scent of the wind... heh, you're incredibly lucky to have a guide like me.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You out cold? Hehe, then I've got a trick to try. Higher pressure, wider spray... And you're past the statute of limitations for a complaint.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: You the Doctor? They all say you're the one here who knows more than the rest. You're gonna let me figure that out.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Combat's just like crossing the desert, where experience means nothing. Your only need is survival instincts.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Doesn't this elite medal do anything at all? No fun to be had here.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Medical professional? Funny thing to call me that. Anyway, it's all about getting my job done, either way, right?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Out for field work again? Fine. You're helping me test new equipment when we get back.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Leading a team in combat is close enough to being a guide.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Route, okay. Equipment, check. Let's go.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Boring... Worse than running into a sandstorm.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Speak up.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'm thinking...

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Good. Efficiency up seventeen percent.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Need to move faster.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Even faster.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Time to test my upgraded equipment.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: How's the new nutritional paste taste?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Scent of the wind's changed...

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Ugh. The sandstorms I've seen beat this any day.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Scraped by, huh. Wasn't a waste of time after all.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Efficiency lacking. Gotta head back and adjust my equipment, or switch reagents, maybe.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: At least you figured a good retreat route…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: You have a lot of rooms, huh…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: You gotta stop with the boring crap already.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Wanna try touching my bag again? Won't hit you in the face this time. Promise.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Wishing you a Happy New Year! I look forward to your kind guidance in the coming year. Okay, done. Without a hitch, right? Happy now?—a bonus? For me? Really? Hmm... thank you. Happy New Year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Rain again. Nice weather, huh, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday. Here's this umbrella's for you. I bought it from a trustworthy merchant in Sargon—It's top-notch. You'll be traveling all over the place, so it'll come in handy. Oh, and if you feel like jumping off the ship's bridge with it, I won't stop you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I've checked Rhodes Island's navigation log. You've been down some awfully treacherous routes. But why don't I see even a hint of fear in anybody? What talent do you have, as the one who guides the ship, to bring out such deep, unshakable trust? I'm... curious.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Morning, Doctor... Mind if I lay out my sleeping bag here...? Thanks. The rest is up to you...

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: How do I fight? Using Arts, of course... Want me to show you the power of earth?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: What time is it...? See, I don't work mornings, noons, afternoons, or nights...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You'll make an S-sized uniform for me...? No thanks. My oversized one works as a sheet when I take naps... plus, it's really warm.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Dooooctoooooor? I need a break! I'm competing in the Speedy Sleep Contest.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, check this out. This isn't my normal wand, it's a pendulum. You're feeling very sleepy and will nap in five minutes without giving me any work... Zzzz...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I was hoping I could tell you about my homeland, Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: After you went to sleep, I somehow didn't feel sleepy at all anymore... Hmmmph...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello? Hellooooo? Can you hear me? Down here. Down heeeeere! Nice meeting you, big Doctor. I'm Durin the Caster.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Whoa... I've fiiiinally gotten s-tron-ger.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: The secret to staying healthy is to sleep whenever you can.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Captain's orders: everyone, save your energy and take a nap!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I wanna dig a hole in the ground and make a shelter to sleep in, if you don't mind.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Take over for me. Thaaanks.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Wooo.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: What a pain.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Okaaaay, I'll do it.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: You're going down!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Gooooooo!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Why do we have annoying missions like this? Can't we do something easier...? Still, it's nice that we won.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Of course we won. I worked real hard supporting you with my Arts.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, are you still worried about those ones that got through?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Ugghh... Sorry... I'll try harder next time...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: The Land of Giants... Here I aaaaaaaaaaaaaaam!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmmm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I'm in a good mood, so how about a magic trick?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Big Doctor. There's lots of tasty foods at the cafeteria. Have you been eating well? Oh, right, I saw Myrtle carrying a huge sack with her to the cafeteria just now. Too late, though. I already ate all the cheese fried fowlbeast.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: *Yawn*... Good morning...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Big Doctor, Big Doctor, Happy birthday! If you're another year older, does that mean you're getting taller, too? I bought you a sleeping bag. If you're getting taller, I don't know how long it'll fit...?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Because of how short I am, nobody ever notices whether I'm working or playing hooky... Rhodes Island gave me a really comfortable environment to sleep in, though, so I still gotta do some things every now and then to repay the favor. Doctor, I'm looking forward to a good year.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, are the new recruits keeping up with my basic training regimen?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: A balanced, regular diet is also an important part of daily training. Any complainers get fifty laps around the deck.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: As a military instructor, it's important to achieve the perfect balance between strictness and leniency. To be honest... I may be a bit too hard on Fang...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: When putting your Operators into squads, it's crucial to assign them positions where they can exercise their skills to the fullest. It's true that Operators' ability is important, what's really being tested here is your judgement.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, when training Operators, you need to work on spiritual fulfillment as much as improving their physiques and skills. After all, they need to be mentally strong enough to survive interrogations and all sorts of attacks on their minds.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: You're looking for the newbies? They're training out on the deck. Yes, I do realize what the weather's like right now. Of course I do.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Anomalies... ha. You can never fool the eyes of the 'Hound'.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: If you believe that command allows you to slack off whenever you want, then I WILL correct your misconception, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: If I hope to remain at your side through all the difficulties to come, I must be even harder on myself. After all, with the world around us being what it is... the only way we can keep it together is to keep training our mental strength.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: No slacking off!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Attention! I am Dobermann, former military instructor for the Bolívarian armed forces. Now, let's cut to the chase. Hand over the list of Operators in need of training.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This is how our training pays off.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion, huh? Thanks. I'm just doing my job.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: The responsibility for training the future of Rhodes Island is on my shoulders. I will do my best to be worthy of that responsibility.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Got it.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Then show me the briefing docs for the mission.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Calling all hands. This is not a drill!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Time to interrogate.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Your orders.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Orders?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Got it.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Commence tracking.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Filthy scum.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Take that!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Tear 'em up!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Hang in there!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: No matter the challenges we face, strong fundamental combat skills can mean the difference between life and death.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Come back when you're less mediocre.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The operation was successful, but we still have room for improvement.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We have failed. I am the one to blame.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: The newbies are intimidated by me, you say? That's only natural.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Please mind your behavior.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You want to cheer me up? Hm, let me interrogate someone, then.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Whether a workday or a holiday, I'm always on standby. You should keep your guard up too, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning to you, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Today is a day worth celebrating, but nevertheless, I'll have to ask you focus on work before this evening's birthday party. Sorry, please forget everything I said about 'birthday party.'

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I always feel a sense of pride, watching as the novices grow step by step. Of course, I don't view that as a contribution to Rhodes Island, but I do walk together with them. Doctor. Never forget your calling, on the road to come.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Let's just burn 'em. You weren't gonna give those papers a second look anyway.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: If you wanted me to lay defenses in here, I'd break up the floor for starters. Not that I mind, it's for you to think about.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Got twps from Royal Guard knocking about, have you? Heh, ain't that interesting.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Calibrate the sight? Nah, materials I ordered last should be here almost, I'll make the arrows first... Oh, push off, out my way.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Most who leave Vouivre don't agree with the mercenary life in Sargon. Move to Victoria, end up doing something else instead, they do. Like... factory-working, farming, you know. Having their own little touch of land.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: You could probably tell, but I didn't use to be artillery. Mainly studied recon, infiltration, CQC, all that. Did not bloody take to it, and the instructors wouldn't let me switch courses, so I dropped out, simple as. What's the point in learning things you hate?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Oh, you're helpless! How am I going to the workshop wearing this?!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: It's meant for attacking nomadic cities, this weapon. Using it to help you lot cope with skirmishers? It's like a hatchet to a cupcake. Let me try hitting a city or two sometime for practice, won't you?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Don't you think these crystals on my shoulder here match well with my hair color? I like my off-the-shoulder clothes too, so it's perfect. Shame, though, it would've been nice if they covered the whole way like that Siracusan Messenger girl.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I'll be heading back to sort stuff out, then. No point wasting time on this rotter.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Arianrot, codename Toddifons. I don't like working for ordinary people, so I've got my fingers crossed you show me something unusual.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Boring. Off we go.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: What goes on in those Logistics' minds? Oh, look what Arianrot made, let's just grab it and... For me? Tch, fine. I accept. Your feelings are loud and clear. Thanks, see you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: You've seen a Draco's flames before, I bet you anything. You ever imagined, the sight of them raining down on your enemy? I can make that your reality!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'm listening.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Work's on. Focus.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: You lot go ahead. I've got things to prepare.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Visibility clear. Awaiting orders.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Still not done?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Iawn?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Mounting complete.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: In position.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I don't need visuals. Give me the map.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: This area is cleared. Next!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Nothing remains once the arrows rain!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Ha! Fire wouldn't go out while there's something left to burn!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: There's only so many who can make this thing shine—guess you're one of them.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Out without too much ash on me. Gwych.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Ammo's more precious than that little lot. Deal with 'em yourself.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Still good to move? We're heading home. Grab on.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Like this titchy bit of space is enough? Let's break this wall down and I'll have the whole area behind, Diolch.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Think it through before you put your hand out.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Go on if you need something. Don't wait for me to change my contacts, I can hear you whatever color they are.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Yeah, New Year's, there's a party, the whole song and dance, I get it. And that's why I'm sitting right here, having a drink with my magazines, while you carry on moaning and whinging. Trust me, that's my happy times.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: So it's you. If you need something, out with it.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Oh? Birthday, then, today. How about we head deckside to celebrate? I'll give you my little siege ballista, can set off some massive fireworks? Oh, too dangerous? Tch, you sopping wet blanket. Whatever, off to the shops then, pick you out a proper present. Well? Get changed already, we're off.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Oripathy comes second, I've said that. If I'm not able to do what I like, that's not life no matter how long it drags out. And you know, being here, Rhodes Island, I always get a crack at something interesting. I half like it working with you lot. So don't you ever go letting me down.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You keep the place so messy but find what you need anyway? *sigh* Well, that's also a talent, I guess.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, am I able to file for exemption from paperwork? I have a bad case of farsightedness. It's a lot of strain to read, and fatigue strikes easily.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I'm a repressed sort, not talkative. If you're not entertained, you can head out for now. No, I don't mean to drive you off, I just...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I don't need to be issued a scope. In my crossbow's killing range, my naked eye sees clearly enough.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My bolt points are a custom make. They pierce armor and cause massive blood loss in a short time. They're based on what Sargon hunters specially use to hunt big beasts, then I made modifications after coming to Victoria. Now they fly lighter, and kill harder.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The merc business is tough, absolutely. Sometimes I'd be in the snow and an entire day would pass on my watch, and my feet would be frostbitten by the end. I appreciate your look of concern, but it was fine. Even lucky. My left foot hurt less when it was frozen.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Why I like snow, you wonder? Let me think... Does never seeing it in Sargon count? Heh, it's not really that deep. People always have their inexplicable fancies.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: ...If it's alright for me to ask, could you read the poem in this book to me, Doctor? I borrowed it from Istina. She says it's a fine poem, about winter in Deity Grypherburg.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Do you know what's most precious? Someone to peacefully watch the snow with. Maybe I've met one at some point before, but who knows? Once the snow descends, it covers all traces of anything, including the fading footprints.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: How about a mug of hot water? You seem a little pale.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor, I'm Totter. Long-range sniping's my specialty. You can leave any task to me as long as it's a workday.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hold on, Doctor, it's too close. Let me put on my glasses and try again.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: If you're pleased with my work, then I couldn't ask for more.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thank you, Doctor, but your appreciation actually leaves me at a loss. Err. If I'm being honest, I don't have big dreams for my work.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Orders ASAP, please.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Everyone, please coordinate. Thanks in advance.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's move. Time waits for nobody.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: They're fast on the move, but I can still read their tracks.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Foggy today. Bad luck.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Great luck. Got a tail wind today.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I see clouds rising. Probable hostiles in the snow.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I see fowl taking off. Probable ambush in the grass.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Come out. Stop hiding!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I see you.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Stop moving.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: It won't be any use.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: The best kills are one-shot. Less pain for them.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Target down. Mission clear, no setbacks.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: *Tut*, not my best shot.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Sorry, Doctor, target's out of range. I can't hit them.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Nice. Luxurious compared to my safehouse.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Speak. I'm all ears.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, is that you? You're blurry, but you've got distinct footsteps. I can tell them apart.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I saw all the snow outside when I came today. One vast blanket over the deck, it's beautiful. You should go take a look. Oh, right, Happy New Year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I picked this out for you from my own collection. I hope you like it... Okay, stop giving me that look. Is it so strange for someone who likes snow to collect snow globes as a hobby?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Nothing complicated went into me leaving home. I just wanted to live somewhere it snows in winter. How about you, Doctor? Have you gotten what you want, on the move all these years?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Gavial doesn't do this kind of work, and nobody in the tribe wants to do this stuff either. So, that's why I help out a bit when I have the time.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: If there's no trainee nurse at the Medical Department, I can give it a try. I have some basic nursing knowledge.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, this pen seems to be out of ink. Oh, wait! Please don't throw that out! If it's not too much to ask... Um... could I have that?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I can't dig up the floors on Rhodes Island? There's no buried treasure? But where are all your precious things, then? Locked inside rooms? Oh, that's too bad…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My tail's gotten even bigger. If this keeps up, everyone's going to hate me for sure. Wuh... What do I do…?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Some people are born strong and cool, others, smart. For me, I've got a big tail... Since we can't choose what we're born with, let's embrace our uniqueness and make the most of it. Um, of course, if you could help me out every now and then, Doctor... that would be best.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I understand Gavial skipping work, but why would she skip a meal? Could something be bothering her so much that even she has to hide? And no one else even noticed. I'm the only one who can save her! Ah, Doctor, good thing you're here. Can you help me with something?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Are you sure you want to see what's inside my backpack? Okay... I haven't organized it in a while so it might be kind of messy. Let's see… An amber wrapped in a leaf. A loose fang...? A bloodstained black crystal... and a stack of autographs?! Uh, Doctor, that's all for today! Sorry, but we're done here!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: She shines with such brilliance that I can't help but stare, even as her flames scorch my eyes dry. That's my Gavial, she shines like the sun. Oh, by the way, I came across that passage in a book and thought it sounded nice, so I memorized it. It really fits Gavial, doesn't it?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I'll leave this dreamcatcher over here… May you have a pure and peaceful dream, Doctor.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. Er, I'm not here to cause trouble. I'm here to… to... Study! Right, study. No reason for me to stay home alone if Gavial is here, right?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hmm... Maybe I should just practice on the battlefield, I guess…

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you for giving me such a pretty badge, Doctor. What? It's a promotion badge? Ah, uh, y-you sure...? A-A-Am I really qualified to have this?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I'll be worthy of this flag one day, I swear I will.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'll watch and learn, Doctor. It would be great if I could actually master some of your skills…

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You're leaving it to me? Really?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's go. We are gonna F… um… beat them up!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Wait, I'm not ready yet!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Please not me, please not me…

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Maybe I'll have a go…

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: H-Here I go!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Who needs beating? Come over!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: C-Come on, you can do this!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: A little more, a little more!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Haah!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Wh-Who's next!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I got beaten like that before, by you, Doctor.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We won, yay.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Phew, my back's sore. I need a break.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'm sorry... so sorry…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Ah! Please don't throw that away yet. Can you leave it to me? I'll take care of it.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: M-My tail...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Want to try Sargonian barbecue? I'll work the grill, you just enjoy the food, Doctor.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: If today's a holiday, does that mean I can take the day off? Haghhh… Oh, where's Gavial? Have you seen her, Doctor? If I've got a free day, of course I'm going to spend it with Gavial!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hnngh... Doctor…

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor! I brought you a birthday present! Umm... huh? Wh-Where did it go? I hid it behind my back so I could surprise you. How could it go missing...? Wahh… Oh! Here it is! It was stuck under my tail... Sorry about that, and happy birthday to you, Doctor. Hehe.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, I got a paper slip from the fortune box, and it says if I say five positive words to a plant every day, it will grow even bigger. Let me try it with this one! Tail, backpack, barbecue, sweet dreams... And... Gavial. Hehe... Doctor! Why are you laughing at me?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, I've brought myself here in the flesh. You may stop watching my videotapes.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Ever since doing away with the suppressor on my throat, Miss.Christine has deigned to lead my vocal training, teaching me how to sing unto people's minds without damaging their psyches. You'd like to hear the results? Hm. You did once request a lullaby, which... isn't my forte. I'll need practice still.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: It never struck the Crimson Troupe just how their rejection of critique, their scorn of video, laid bare their cowardice and mediocrity. I used to avoid watching anything I performed in, such was my disgust... But perhaps it's time for a better seat. I see you holding those film tickets, Doctor; you needn't hide them. I accept your invitation.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: There are people after me. They are disenchanted and voracious, screaming in chaos, dying to find the maker for their crazèd flock. For how could Tragodia truly die? He is but one of countless graven images to fall on the steps—He and all his kind are wholes made of shards, idols formed from syncretism. As it was with that mad and lonely stage director, snobbish soul, old friend of mine.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I've read that evaluation report; Dr. Folinic is suggesting I exit from the frontline for the time being. I can't maintain constant sobriety, that much is true; after years with these hallucinations for company, they are among the few friends I can count on my fingers. But I remain your assassin... Call me, and let me see to the work I know best.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Upon his followers, the troupe leader bestowed masks. Before long, I will set out in companionship to find those followers, one and all. Abandon reason and surrender to violence as they may, I will simply create, perform, and weave their dreams. Till they awaken from despair, till they can reexamine their souls in the mirror, wretched yet free, for better and for worse.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Some unfamiliar operators invited me to a 'movie night' after I reboarded, and the Vampire madame from Engineering seems somewhat soft on me too. So generous is the drama, it bathes its actors in halo even outside of the silver screen. Pardon? Rhodes Island's operators trust me on principle...? Mmm. They ought to be a little warier than that.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: It is harder to resist destroying beauty than demonstrating it. It's a notion I try to stifle, but is it so simple to shake my bloodstained creative impulses? They were the one excuse in the troupe to touch on love and hate; they were a poison to tempt the audience; they are an inextricable yet unwordable part of me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I must recall—the conspiracy, the slaughter, the false performances. Does creation break me free of the shadows about me, or does it bring me closer to them? Perhaps my thirst, reignited by death, will one day finally catch fire and rage. Doctor... Witness it. Grasp it. Endorse or reject it. Do not stop it.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Close your eyes. The dark of night now shrouds your consciousness; the sharp discomfort fades. So tell me, what is it you long to see... a ship, a sea of flowers, and us... That is all you want?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Permit me to shirk our operators' curious gazes for a spell. The curtain has finally fallen on the longest play, and I need some time to reorganize my thoughts. I'm sure you understand, Doctor... Pardon? I have to sign the returnee ledger with my Wrankwood autograph?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Would that they could break free of the slaver that is Hate, what then would they do...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I've woken from a nightmare, yet I still am in the night. Would you journey with me even then, dear Doctor?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: The symbol of a troupe member's honor was a medal bearing Tragodia—a sentencing to days with thought and taste imprisoned, a painful past I tried again and again to cut away. But you give me a present to delight... and I will cherish it.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: The stage is set.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: To lead or to dominate—they are but a hair apart.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Alas, the scent of strife; I know it well.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Below the stage stirs not a soul.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Here I perform as me.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: The apron and the wings are but the same.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I am everywhere.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: The shadow beneath your feet is not your own.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: The killing urge doth seize your flesh.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: The burning hate doth speak your minds.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Resist me not; come to my song.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Shh... Listen.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Heeding your direction always leads so simply to ideal results. I ought to be on guard...

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Stay the curtain call... the time is not yet come.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Flee... until your nightmares catch up to you again.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: If this is not the ending in your heart, then rewrite it.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: ...Could you take some of those film posters off the walls?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Yes, this attire is too formal.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Once this one-act play is... roughly ready, would you like to be the first to watch?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: On and on do new days come, yet shadows squat in the crevices of bygone days, so loath to leave. Doctor, be careful, please. Don't wallow too deeply in feelings of regret, in cursing fate. Accept failure, unease, fear... and then carry on walking.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: History and murders aside, Wrankwood is a fine vacation spot.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Pierced by Originium crystal, this larynx of mine is a ruthless weapon, and proof of how the arts intoxicate me. Now that I've finally recovered my singing technique, I wonder, would you mind if... As you wish, then. Allow me to dedicate this long-overdue ballad to you. Happy birthday, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Perhaps this sailing ship we stand on is a clear glass reflection, and Rhodes Island is but a fantasy woven by you... Yet oneiric emotions can move just as deeply as waking ones; if you believe this is all one beautiful dream, don't wake so soon.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I was an assistant for other researchers before I got my own lab... That being said, shall I begin your day with a cup of coffee?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor... Doctor who? Oh, it's your codename? Sorry. At Rhine Lab, calling for a 'Doctor' usually gets a response from everyone in earshot. You must be very special to Rhodes Island, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The rumbling grapevine says Saria is at odds with Control. But I get the feeling they're both idealists, and those with a strong will tend to have an edge to them. I... am I any different? I hope you'll never see my edge.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You think scientists are weird? Yes, obsession may drive us to ignore certain other things, including social and ethical norms. Our jobs aside, though, we're all normal people at heart.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Research is like exploration; the further you go, the more dangerous it gets. But every step we take has a chance to change lives, which is why we keep going, even if death or public scorn await. We're kindred spirits, Doctor… And that is a fact.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I made lots of friends in the world of science. They often discuss their dreams with me; some are not so good at expressing themselves, but I can guess. You say I've guessed wrong sometimes? Hm... perhaps. Maybe I should reflect...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: It's getting cool outside. Remember to dress warm when you go into the field... *sneeze* I, er, forgot to do so myself. I often forget these things if Elena isn't there to remind me. *Sneeze* Oh, thanks for the coat. That's so kind of you.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I never thought of myself as a genius. I'm just fortunate. My father and other people in the Pioneer team saved the money to send me to school, while the government sponsorship also allowed me to pursue scientific research. I'm here today thanks to the help of many people. That's why I want to do my best to help others too.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Sometimes, I wake up in the middle of the night in the labs and feel... scared. Scared that people will end up abandoning me, even after all I've done, and even... with hatred in their hearts. What should I do? All I want is to bring them happiness. Can you help me, Doctor?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: All work and no play makes it a sleepy day... We have so much in common, don't we... Let me turn up the temperature. Noise-canceling mode... Oh, seems your cabin isn't equipped with that…?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, I'm Dorothy, head of the Originium Art Section at Rhine Lab. Dr. Silence already introduced me? Then it saves both of us the formalities. Please, just call me Dorothy.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Are these simulations or... hm, Rhodes Island feels different from how I imagined, but I understand.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: As a matter of fact, I was worried about not spending enough time on the Rhodes Island Landship... maybe I should apply to Kristen for another long-term cooperation project.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, how do you like my lab? I'm thinking about what equipment I should bring over. Mechanist says my command of resonance might come in handy in obstacle removal and weapon development.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: What sights will the Doctor show us this time?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Don't worry, I'll take care of the others.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The battlefield is an extension of the laboratory.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Strayed, aren't you?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Security systems online. Monitoring intruders.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Initiating environmental scan.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Do you need the traps activated?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Terrain data collection complete.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: The sand will reshape the land.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: The slightest vibration can change the result.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Stay down, and you won't get hurt any worse.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: No, I won't let you take another step… I promised them.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Whether it's by your calculation or instinct… All I could say is, marvelous.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Your decisions were on the mark. Were you kissed by the goddess of truth? Can I touch your forehead? For good luck, you know, while I tackle my next experiment.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: 70% of my experiments don't turn out the way I want them to. The answer lies in the next attempt, Doctor.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I won't let anyone hurt you! I'll take care of things here. Go, and never turn back...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Rhodes Island is always so lively.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh, it was you tugging at me? Thank goodness, I thought I skipped too many meals and was hallucinating...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: What is it that keeps you staring at me, Doctor? Did you find an interesting problem to tackle?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I just sent some gifts to my Pioneer friends. I wonder when they'll get them... Thinking of their hardships makes me worry and glad at the same time. Oh, I have a gift for you too. You're always moving forward, just like them.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, I was thinking about going out for a walk. Would you like to join me?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Humm, did those young operators just give you something? Wait... what day is it? Oh dear, I lost track of the days again! Dr. {@nickname}, could you make a stop by my lab? Thankfully I've got the entire year's presents all lined up!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I hope everyone will have the chance to find themselves, regardless of whether they're Infected or not, regardless of their talent for Arts. Many think this is just a pipe dream, but Doctor, I know... you and Rhodes Island will understand.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I apologize... It's my job to attend to you, but my body simply won't move like I want it to...

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I once breathed in some kind of Originium toxin... it damaged my memory and the nervous system in my lower extremities... at least that is what Dr. Kal'tsit told me. So I often wonder... what was my life like before then?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: This little blue bird often comes over and chats with me. Sometimes, I dream about turning into a bird myself... flying free in the skies, without a care...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Once upon a time, I was imprisoned in an empty room. I only saw another human being when they needed my healing...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: With this staff in my hand, I can heal as many as I will. Is this... really an ability I was born with?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Shining told me that the sins we carry... the guilt of starting the war, as devils... will one day catch up to us and we will have to face judgment. Those people who imprisoned me said the same thing. But...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Amiya... I feel a sense of deja vu whenever I see her. Perhaps we met sometime in the past?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The memories I have are mere fragments. My people... Originium... my mission, the rebellion, the war... but tell me, why are you in one of my memories too?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: How did I end up like this? Why must I suffer all that I do? Doctor, do you have the answers?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Do you too dream of flying freely through the skies like a bird?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Liz... that's my real name. Everything else is just cloudy, indistinct memories...

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Why is there a need for me to grow stronger?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? I see. It sounds like something to rejoice over. But... I apologize, I don't feel any joy within...

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thank you for personally informing me of my promotion, Doctor. But... to me, it doesn't matter as much as the story of the world outside that this little bird is telling me right now.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Is this the rendezvous point?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I shall do anything you command me to.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I need only do as the manual said, yes?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The battlefield... a place where lives are taken...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Doctor...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Who will you choose?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: This is... the battlefield...

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: It's not my wish to take lives.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: My power is all yours now.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Take flight.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You will not come to harm.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I shall protect you.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: No matter how difficult the battle gets, I will always…

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: To fight to the very end... that's our destiny.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Perhaps they've already escaped this cage called fate...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Is this... how despair feels?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Rooms... They too are a type of cage.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Yes? What is it?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor... is this... what is known as 'intimacy'?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy... New Year? I'm sorry, it seems I've forgotten what this holiday entails—just make a wish and that'll do, you say? Then I would wish, in this coming year, for Margaret and Shining to be safe and sound... as well as you, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good day, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday. You still remember your own birthday... how fortunate, truly. Alas, I can't procure any present for you... Would you tell me what your birthday wishes are, Doctor? Your wishes may bring hope to me.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Shining notes that since we came aboard Rhodes Island, my health has taken a turn for the better. When by your side, I feel this warmth, too. But why can I not shake this harsh premonition... Doctor, after I recall everything, will Rhodes Island still welcome me with open arms?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Um, it hurts my eyes in here... Doctor, could you turn down the office lights a bit? I'm not so used to bright rooms...

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Um, did you really bring me here to be an Operator? Not to keep a watch on me? What about that doctor, Miss Kal'tsit? What is she going to do to me...?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My staff was passed down to me by my father. Its magic does something called 'Evernight' to those it touches. Anyone trapped in that illusion will... have trouble waking up the next day...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I'm used to being alone. When I feel lonely, I'll just talk to myself. Eheh... Hmm? Is that weird?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Stare deeply into my eyes. Feeling sleepy, aren't you? Hehe... Now, wouldn't you like to do something for me? Tell me, where does Rhodes Island store all its Originium?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: You called for me? Oh yes, my disease is worsening. That's because you wouldn't give me your Originium, which means now this body is gradually disintegrating... So, just what should we do, Doc-tor?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Um, please let me apologize! I mean, erm, I m-might still end up saying something weird, but please don't get angry... I just have no way to control 'her'…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Say, Doctor, if I were to suddenly end you, right here, how would everyone else react...? Argh! Grgh! No! I have to stop myself from... Hehe, I really would like to see it...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, don't you get tired of it, from time to time? Your work,life, feelings, everything... What would you say to just forgetting all of it, all at once? With my power, things like that can be arranged...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Your sleeping face is so cute, it makes me want to...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Nightmare... Ah, that's a code name. My real name is Gloria. But, if you don't mind, I'd rather you call me that... I think my code name... is kind of scary...

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: You're making me stronger... but why...?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I came here as a patient, to get treatment for my disease. But now, I'm given to understand that that doctor wants me to fight for you, doesn't she?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Don't you think I'm only barely qualified for this promotion? Not that it matters—go ahead and call your shots. At this point, I'm just lucky to even be alive.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Alright, I'm coming.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I can't do this alone...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: What sorts of incredible powers will you show me? I can't wait to see.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: So these are our enemies? Well, well, you look like fun.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Um, is there anything to eat?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Say, why don't you let me take you on?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: This is... the battlefield...!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Ah, the battlefield. How I missed you.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Ahaha, why so serious?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Come on, relax for me.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: May you have sweet dreams...

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You'll run if—if you know what's good for you.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Victory... Always so refreshing.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Well, sorry, but this is the end I prepared for you.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We won. What more could you ask for?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: What... have I done...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I'll be fine in the corner...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Argh...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: D-did I do something bad again...? J-Just, please let me apologize. I'm so, sooo sorry...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor... My wish? Good health, so that I can help you out more... Ah, well, then my wish is for this wish not to come true so easily.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! It must be hard always carrying such heavy responsibilities, you deserve a break. Come closer, close your eyes, and let me bring you sweet dreams... Doctor?! S-Stay back, don't listen to me!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island feels so lively today. I like this sort of energetic atmosphere... Huh? A party? Er, maybe not... I'm happy enough watching everybody enjoy themselves...

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Alright, I'll schedule the training, organize a tournament, and manage the burdenbeasts. You handle all the talking and writing here. I got it wrong? But I thought I gave you the easiest tasks?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Check out this knife. It just cut through tough bones, yet its edge hasn't dulled a bit, and its patterns remain intact. What a beauty, isn't it? What? Why are you backing away? It's not like I'm going to wipe the blood on your clothes. This is just from the Leporibeasts I slaughtered on the deck. Come tonight, and I'll treat you all to a nice meal.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Yep, this is the toxin you're developing. I simply borrowed it for a look. It's true that I couldn't pick the laboratory's lock, so when I saw the door open during the day, I pasted a 'Do not lock the door' notice inside. Wait... that face of yours... You knew it already? But I was so careful...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I've sat on a mountain of gold coins before. One lord ameer coveted the treasury of another, so we did the job for him. He paid us the full amount as promised—not a single coin less, and, all in gilded metal. A cheat? On his turf, he gets to say what counts as a gold coin. But once we're outside his city? Then it's up to me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Even your 'high-grade hair dye' isn't working on me? I guess we'd better find someone else for our infiltration mission. I don't get it, people always talk about 'bloodlines', but I bleed the same red as everyone else. It only made my hair EXTRA red..

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I just have to watch the sky and I'll know where to go. Like, stay clear of hungry beasts when the southern wind blows. Ship all the wood downstream before a flood hits. Plus, I know no one will transport any ancient paintings during a heatwave. But prayer vessels can be seen all over the ground in a long dry spell. Now I follow you chasing Catastrophes. As for the future, I might gather up a gang and go after the sun.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I'm pretty good at handicrafts. We have a saying: 'A dead beast has a hundred uses, worthy of a living person to master a hundred skills.' So don't be shy. Just sit here, be good. Wait for me to braid your hood drawstring and thread beads onto it, alright? I'm sure the patterns are going to be great.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: There were some commanders I admired. They are good with tactics, but they always scare their minions and cause trouble for me. You're different, and I like that. But since Amiya is the real boss here and not you, you'll probably get your name known by half of Sargon, while I'll be known by the whole, for sure.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My kin, friends, and my men are all scattered, like the stars in the sky. Have you ever tried stargazing? The fun thing is, wherever we look up, we all see the same night sky with the same stars... Hehe, sometimes I wonder what would it look like, if all the stars gathered together...? Huh? What do you mean by 'a big bang'?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: They all say you're a workaholic, but it's not as if you're always awake... Hmm… or these work just isn't exciting enough for you to stay up all night?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Thanks a lot for the free ride. If I, Narantuya Kapudan were to die on my Khaganquest, what a loss it would be for Sargon… You have never heard of me? Doesn't matter, one day, everyone will know who I am.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This recording system seems very useful! If I had one of my own... No... forget it. It's too expensive. Better to just draw my battle plans in the sand.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Rank, title, trust level, all good stuff. But what I want the most is for you to lend me a few of your people. As for when I'll give them back—We'll see when they want to come back.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Delivery today, rescue tomorrow. We've accomplished so much together. But hey, let me get this straight—sometimes I'll look at the sky to decide where to go next, so when I do have to leave one day… Ahem, you'd better not miss me too much.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Raise your whips, swirl the sand, shade the sun. Then take whatever you want.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Just give me the target and enough hands.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Sun's perfectly positioned. Let's head to the ambush point.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The only sound they will hear is my blade slicing through wind, not my footsteps.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I've got an idea…

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Relax, I'll always help you out.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Toxins and traps are my tactics.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Illusion and intimidation are my tactcis too.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: What do you fear most?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Bam! I've swallowed up the sun!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: What, you think you're a better robber than ME?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Enough dreaming. Only nightmares come with me.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I'm scaring some of our own men? Alright, give me some time to stroll around the battlefield. Need to cool off my blood.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: You're reliable, the people around you are reliable. Man, how can everybody here be so reliable? I'm starting to envy the captain of this landship…

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: You know, sometimes we'll toss our gold coins into a stream, and pray we find them in times of need.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: You don't look so good...? Wasn't that just an early test? Every plan has to be tested, adjusted, and you repeat that until it's good to go. That's my secret to a foolproof success.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This bed is so soft, and the air conditioning is so perfect! But I have one tiny question... do I have to pay for the lodging?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Haha! I like you too!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: What a shame. If you had a blade of your own, I could sharpen it for you now.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Come, let's dance! Festive music's always nice to groove to! Relax, I'll lead, you just stomp to the rhythm, and slap your own—I'm hitting your hand? I've had a bit too much? I mean... All the drinks are free here, you know!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: So, Doctor. Had a good dream? Tell me about our next objective, even if it's from your dream.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: We always say that maturity comes with the paths you've traveled, not the time you've passed. So on a day like this, we'll use these colorful ropes to decorate the burdenbeasts, or... You call the chair your burdenbeast? Nonsense, you can't hang these ropes on it. Give me your hand. You can forge a path on your own, you know.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: People often call me greedy, but you guys are the same, no? You fight for the best outcome, same as I fight for the best treasures. Even if we turn up more losses than wins, even if what we hold slips away like sand... Hehe, well, no wonder I like you so much.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Salutations, Doctor. May the light be with you.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, I ask that you give me the most dangerous assignment available, such that my shield and I can best protect those in need.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The title of 'Knight' should be a symbol of honor. And yet now, it's been reduced to a mere commodity...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: As long as the light continues to guide me, I will neither bow to cruelty nor kneel to violence.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm grateful as always for your service, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The Kazimierz chivalric spirit should have been a force of salvation for all who suffer in this world. But now, it's nothing more than a rotten legacy, used to benefit the rich. Nothing is more shameful.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Shining, too, is a beam of light that guides me forward. She carries the hope I've long sought.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Something flickered in Shining's eyes when she heard the name Rhodes Island. I had no idea what it meant...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: In this time and age of a world plagued by Oripathy, may the ray of hope from Rhodes Island light the way.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Let us embrace this momentary respite.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Margaret Nearl, the Radiant Knight of Kazimierz...and now a Rhodes Island Operator. I will defend your life and your honor with my shield.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Thank you for granting me power.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you, Doctor. These new powers shall bring relief to those who suffer. This I shall engrave upon my heart.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Shining once said that dawn remains distant. But I believe that, one day, we will revive the dying glory with our very own hands.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I shall protect them from all harm.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I shall not blemish Rhodes Island's name.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I am ready. Set out!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Honor must be defended.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: In your name.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I shall give my all to you.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I shall cover you!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Get behind me!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Light, heed me!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I'm with you!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Don't be afraid.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Revitalize!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: A true knight will not bend to the threat of violence. Now, repent for your sins, in front of my warhammer.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Let us go forth. And there will be one day…

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: A true knight will not chase one who's lost the will to fight. Everyone deserves a chance to choose a new path.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We must not give up now.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I shall keep watch here.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: I sense an intru- Oh, Doctor?!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, umm... may I enter your office? I've heard you have a vast collection of literature.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Tonight in the Grand Knight Territory, the corporations who've won the bidding war for firework permits will blanket the sky, and out in the barrens, destitute settlements will warm themselves on firewood as a rare luxury. While you can have your name written in those New Year's fireworks, I'm more than glad that I have brought those people firewood.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning to you, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Aplogies that I don't have anything that might pique your interest with me, but perhaps you'd like this book on the history of the knights of Kazimierz? Forgive me, I've already given you my knight's oath, and anything I could grant you beyond that is negligible by comparison.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: When I was bestowed the title of Radiant Knight, the General Chamber of Commerce didn't much appreciate my shine. Fortunately, neither Shining nor Rhodes Island have since found me too bright to look at. As vast as the land is, I imagine the rays of the sun will only reach so far. In that respect, I will strive until I can strive no more.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Man, I'm so bored... Might just go shopping... You know what, yeah, we're doing it! Come on, put your shoes on. Yeah, we're both going out, that's why I said 'we'!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Man, I'm so bored... Might just go shopping... You know what, yeah, we're doing it! Come on, put your shoes on. Yeah, we're both going out, that's why I said 'we'!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: That lame look of yours is grinding my gears... Here, have a toy to lighten up. You're busy with work? Who cares about some boring-ass work? Just one thing: don't lose sight of this little doll, or it'll vanish in the blink of an eye.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: That lame look of yours is grinding my gears... Here, have a toy to lighten up. You're busy with work? Who cares about some boring-ass work? Just one thing: don't lose sight of this little doll, or it'll vanish in the blink of an eye.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Maaan, I'm so hungry... But as they say, gourmet food takes a gourmet cook. My brother's a great chef, you get hungry at one of our family reunions, just call him up and he'll take care of you. Now that's what I call service! Rhodes Island's food tastes like crap compared to his.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Maaan, I'm so hungry... But as they say, gourmet food takes a gourmet cook. My brother's a great chef, you get hungry at one of our family reunions, just call him up and he'll take care of you. Now that's what I call service! Rhodes Island's food tastes like crap compared to his.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Lungmen's a pretty chill place, but their cuisine? It's got no kick to it! How can they eat that flavorless baby food? Listen up: spice is a way of life. Once you taste a little pleasant pain and feel that explosion of heat on your tongue, you'll realize what you've been missing all this time.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Lungmen's a pretty chill place, but their cuisine? It's got no kick to it! How can they eat that flavorless baby food? Listen up: spice is a way of life. Once you taste a little pleasant pain and feel that explosion of heat on your tongue, you'll realize what you've been missing all this time.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I used to just focus myself on what I needed for daily life, but I'm the type to really absorb my surroundings. And somehow or other I keep getting into fights. So I guess I could say it feels weird to NOT carry a weapon around. So it goes, I guess.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I used to just focus myself on what I needed for daily life, but I'm the type to really absorb my surroundings. And somehow or other I keep getting into fights. So I guess I could say it feels weird to NOT carry a weapon around. So it goes, I guess.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Rituals get passed down from generation to generation not 'cause they have any inherent meaning, but because people find their own meaning in them. A performance has its rewards, and a wish has its fulfillment. And when one of my favorite stories is involved, you bet your ass I'm gonna participate.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
