voices.text: Rituals get passed down from generation to generation not 'cause they have any inherent meaning, but because people find their own meaning in them. A performance has its rewards, and a wish has its fulfillment. And when one of my favorite stories is involved, you bet your ass I'm gonna participate.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: If you're out of touch with reality, you'll end up crushed beneath its boot, sooner or later. You'd think that's common freakin' sense, but some of my siblings ignore reality for what it is. Their dull lives are only gonna get harder for 'em as time goes on.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: If you're out of touch with reality, you'll end up crushed beneath its boot, sooner or later. You'd think that's common freakin' sense, but some of my siblings ignore reality for what it is. Their dull lives are only gonna get harder for 'em as time goes on.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Your dreams turn to haze when you've lived as long as I have. But I've got better stuff to do than dream all day, and that's why l feel so alive. Sure, life is suffering, but seeing people carve something out for themselves is incredible. And as for you: think you got what it takes to be the anvil to my hammer?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Your dreams turn to haze when you've lived as long as I have. But I've got better stuff to do than dream all day, and that's why l feel so alive. Sure, life is suffering, but seeing people carve something out for themselves is incredible. And as for you: think you got what it takes to be the anvil to my hammer?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Blacksmithing may just be a regular old occupation, but it was also a part of early civilization. I'll keep metallurgy well and alive, even if everything else dies out. That's the future I chose for myself long ago. And you, you've made important choices before, haven'tcha? Don't ever go back on them. Stay true to the end and see it through. That's what it means to complete something.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Blacksmithing may just be a regular old occupation, but it was also a part of early civilization. I'll keep metallurgy well and alive, even if everything else dies out. That's the future I chose for myself long ago. And you, you've made important choices before, haven'tcha? Don't ever go back on them. Stay true to the end and see it through. That's what it means to complete something.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You're sleeping AGAIN? Wake up, sunshine! We're going shopping! C'mon, hurry!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You're sleeping AGAIN? Wake up, sunshine! We're going shopping! C'mon, hurry!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Anybody home? Heard from one of your guys that I can make a comfy living here! Something about free lodging and food, with plenty of free time left over... Hm? This area is for staff only? Don't be like that! You make it sound like I don't belong here!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Anybody home? Heard from one of your guys that I can make a comfy living here! Something about free lodging and food, with plenty of free time left over... Hm? This area is for staff only? Don't be like that! You make it sound like I don't belong here!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Huh? What good do you think this stuff's gonna do me? Skills like these are only useful to people who value them.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Huh? What good do you think this stuff's gonna do me? Skills like these are only useful to people who value them.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? That takes me back... I got something like this once before. Anyway, that's cool, I guess. You have my thanks!

voices.title: Promotion 1

My blood and sweat went into making this one a special effects blockbuster. You're not gonna watch? Wait, wait, all of you got the day off, right? Why aren't you coming?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Yo, Doctor, you had lunch yet?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Yo, Doctor, you had lunch yet?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Birthdays, huh? Yeah, heard of those. You guys know where you came from, when you got here, so you like to celebrate the day. Here, this hammer's for you. Can't lift it? Hehe, of course you can't. I like to see people live and grow, you know. If after all these years, all we've forged is weapons, without honing our people, then the weapons are just some lumps of metal too heavy to wield.

voices.title: Birthday

If after all these years, all we've forged is weapons, without honing our people, then the weapons are just some lumps of metal too heavy to wield.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The food was bad, but a fun time was had, sort of... Well, I know they had fun, but I just couldn't enjoy myself. All I see is Rhodes Islanders putting down their weapons, and coming to munch on spice and play mahjong with me. And when the party's over, they pick those weapons right back up. It makes me think, damn, what a shame. Hey, what are you gawping at me for? C'mon, let's take a walk.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Sort the paperwork for the other departments, check. Water the plants, done... Oh! Doctor, here's the water you wanted. I've also asked the cafeteria to make you a snack. I've done my homework with help from the other operators, nothing'll go wrong on my watch!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: There's a small furnace next to my home. Ermi once told me it's used to transport energy, but we mainly use it to cook, dry our clothes, and stay warm. I've also heard that if you knock on the furnace twice before using it, your ancestors will watch over you.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Djaj don't read minds, and we don't suck out your emotions, and we definitely don't eat brains! Honestly, where you even get these ideas? Keep saying stuff like that and I'm gonna get mad! I mean it, I-I'll bite your head off!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: When I was searching for my ancestors' soul fragments in Kazdel, Ermi gave me this cube to hold them. Now, I use it to store oversized luggage. I really want to know how it works, but Lich technology is way too complicated. Even if I could take a peek into Ermi's soul, I doubt I'd understand it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I'll put this money to good use, hehe... Oh, hello, Doctor! This? It's a little reward for helping out my friends. Completely legit and very common practice. What did I do, you ask? Hmmm... finding their lost pets, organizing their thoughts, and other stuff like that. Nothing special.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Hi Doctor, just wanted to check if you're satisfied with my work so far? Cos you know, being trusted and being favored are two different things. We Djaj get the latter a lot, but the former... Mm, I can hear it. Thank you for your trust, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Mom and Dad have been away for quite a long time... Do I miss them? Mmm... A little, I guess? They're my parents, but they're also their own people. I can already take care of myself, so why keep them chained to me? As long as I can feel their love, I'm happy that they're out there doing what makes them happy.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Djaj can penetrate one's psyche, which is why they call us the heart-whippers. But we must also remember to whip our own hearts, by that, I mean self-restraint. Legend tells of Djaj whose obsession with the mind drove them to insanity. The King of Sarkaz had to finish them off. O-Of course, it's not like I witnessed it myself. Anyway, as long as I stay on the right track, everything will be fine!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Heart whipping is no joke. You really want to give it a try? Okay. I won't go too deep. Now, look into my eyes… Um, uhhh. Sorry, I-I-I got a little nervous, like my heart is in my mouth! Let's try it a-another time. Lots of stuff I need to prepare first...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: What a good dream. It's making me a little drowsy, too…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Sorry I'm late! I was chatting with the Djall HR lady and lost track of time… You must be the Doctor. Hello, I'm Nymph. I'm great at taking care of all sorts of trouble, so please come to me if anything ever bothers you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This is pretty interesting. Is it okay if I take it with me to watch later?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Ohhh… I've only seen people from the Military Commission wear medals like this! Thank you!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Let's open our hearts to each other, Doctor. We will definitely get to know each other better.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Do we really have to settle this with violence...?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I understand. Don't worry. I'll find a way.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: It's time to go. I can't keep hesitating like this.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Focus, Nymph. It's… it's no big deal!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: M-Me?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: *sigh*...

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'm still kinda nervous...

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: You can do it!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Look into my eyes!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Turn back. Don't let your heart shatter here.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Let my key whip reach your soul!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Your hearts, now unlocked.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: What you did back there, they're all natural reflexes to you? You are amazing!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I've learned a lot from your commands, Doctor. Maybe I'll get to use them in the future, too.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Don't worry, just let them go. We should head back now.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Don't be scared! I-I'll think of something. There's gotta be a way...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's so clean here. With a few simple touches, I can definitely make it a comfy little home.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Um-um! Quit it.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: There's no key to that lock at the bottom of your heart? Don't worry. I'll find it for you.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: There's laughter all around. Just being here, part of all of this, makes my heart melt... OK! Let's go all out and enjoy the day, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Put your thoughts to rest, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Today's your birthday, right, Doctor? So why are you still buried in these documents? Quit looking at them. Look at me... Go to the cafeteria, and have a big, hearty meal. No coming back after dinner either. Okay? That's right. Everyone deserves a break on their birthdays, even the hardest worker. Now come on, let's go.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Looking back, it's amazing how much I've done this year. I've been going back and forth between Rhodes Island and Kazdel so much, it's a wonder my legs didn't fall off... Tired? Umm, not really. More like happy. As for next year... Hmm... I think it's best not to think about it too much. It's the unknown that fills us up with anticipation, right?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Would you care to try some sweets? I could prepare a selection for you. Wine to pair with? I have some too.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: My servants relish in manipulating the fates of others. Some imagine themselves cunning conspirators, others mere wavering dreamers. Yet they remain equally cold when consuming lives not their own. And me? Heheh. It matters not whether I am puppet or puppetmaster… for the end of life lies with me.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: That Dr. Kal'tsit has a frightening glare. Whenever her eyes fall on me, I feel as if she plans to nail me to the landship deck. Fret not... during my brief stay here, I am but your Operator Necrass, and nothing more.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: An ice-cold body, a dulled sense of touch; a pain inside that never rests, as if my own freezing flames pierce me through... But it is the pain I find so fascinating, for without it, I might forget I've already tamed death.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Rhodes Island is a beautiful place, where anyone can write their story, no matter who they may be. It's something of a utopia, built at the theoretical cost of countless lives. Illusions are ephemeral, however, so do try your best to keep it alive.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I permit your silence—or perhaps, your evasiveness—toward my invitation, but this does not mean you can escape me. Once I grasp you, your soul will be mine. Time, life, and joy are all yours to squander, but remember this well: your end, too, lies with me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: What brings me here, you ask? You do. Or should I say, your willingness to explain the glimpse I saw... of a future where even death is gone? Whether you choose to serve me before that future comes matters little... I'll gladly keep on waiting.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Loughshinny? Were she still the girl shivering under that snowy night, I would have simply gifted her a peaceful life until death reunited us both. A pity she ultimately learned to dance between blades and lies, and you surely understand how rare a truly endearing dance partner can be.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: What must I do to have you submit to me? Must I plead, or yell? Show you a side of me no one has ever seen, or grant you my dominion over death? All that you desire, I... refuse. First you must submit, and then we can discuss further.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: ...A deep sleep is akin to death. I hope you manage to wake as usual, Erudite.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Allowing me on board at last? Then, hand me the register. 'Necrass'—how about this codename, Erudite? Hm? Rhodes Island requires I go by a codename, so I've decided to fashion an appropriate one for you as well.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: How delightful. Another momentary escape from their predestined end.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion. Does this imply I now have a formal position in your organization? Do you deem this appropriate, Erudite?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: This medal symbolizes your trust, yet death is an eternal betrayal of life. If you've thought it through, perhaps set me a deadline—I'll strive to live up to your expectations until then.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Do you require me to conceal my face? No? A judicious judgment. The dead shall remember, while the living will forget.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Your operators might fail to keep up with my harsh demands.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let us be off, to create many more corpses.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Mortals grieve over death, but death has never mourned.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: My flame holds no warmth.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I see it.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I accept your invitation.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: So this is your judgment?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: A touch of my finger shall crumble your wills.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Life withers and dissipates, remnants left to hesitate.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Bathed in fire, departed souls dance in a frenzy of fear.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: The clamor of the dead peters out into oblivion.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: You and your tactics are equally lethal, Erudite.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Why repress yourself? I see a desire for destruction in you, and you should let it all out... with no reservations.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Life is inherently flawed, so let's not grieve too much over it.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Should I take them all away? Good, you need only pay a tiny price... I'm sure you can afford it.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Ah. A warm place.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What do you want?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You may hold my hand, if you can bear the icy burn.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: A new year ought to be welcomed with fire; burn away the past to build again upon the remains, and the cycle continues anew. That being said, I do quite fancy this tiny flame before me as well. Roast something for me, accomplish what my flames cannot.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Are you happy to see me, Erudite?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Should I prepare a bouquet of flowers for you? For what reason, you ask? I simply want to receive one in return, and watch your flowers crumble into ashes between my fingers, that's all.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Loughshinny aside, Rhodes Island still bears scant traces of Dublinn... don't be nervous. The dream has been realized, so Dublinn should die, but death does not mean to vanish without reason. I shall allow it—let this gravestone of Dublinn remain at Rhodes Island as-is.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: What's up, Doctor? Me, I'm just on standby.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: My shield? Fun fact: I personally provide a portion of the energy it needs.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: What I look like beneath the mask? Well, I... Actually, let's keep it secret for a bit longer.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Man, nothing better than a break after you finish a mission.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, if I get to know you better, I figure my shield's gonna get even sturdier.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Course I know where my limit's at. But I don't want Yato to worry about me, which is what matters. We'll worry about the rest some other time!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: There's always the need for guys like me, you know? Nah, I'm not trying to act high and mighty. What I'm saying is: when you have a VIP plus a lot of danger, you need a guy to stand between them, that's all.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Sometimes you've just gotta take off the mask and catch a breather.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Defender Noir Corne, reporting for duty. You need VIP protection, I'm your guy.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Cool... So this stuff is what Grandpa Rangers was talking about earlier.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: We bringing friends?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm gonna get even stronger!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Holding the line is a Defender's most important job!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: We're doing it!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: C'mon, say something.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: What's up?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I've got this!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Here I come!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Watch it, buddy!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Reinforce defenses!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Even guys like me are happy to get through tough battles like these.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: That was all right.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Well, we managed.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: This wouldn't have happened if I'd worn my good mask! God dammit!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Alright, let's take a breather.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Yeah?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You wanna get some drinks after work?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It's these kinds of days I love the most. Everyone has a blast getting together, and we're off work. C'mon, Doctor, you gotta try this burdenbeast offal flambé while it's still fresh from the pan! Whoa, whoa, I don't think Dr. Kal'tsit's gonna like you drinking that much, y'know?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Nothing outta the ordinary, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Yo, Doctor! Here's a mask from my stash, straight to you! You've rocked the hood for long enough, right? You could try masking up, just for today. Think about it! And hey, if no one else is gonna say it, I will—I think you'll look cool as hell with it on.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: With all the years I've spent at Rhodes Island, I know exactly what's left on the agenda today. The Doctor's still got mad business, alright? Can't keep 'em any longer. Everyone, a toast to the Doctor, who's spent another year working hard for us! To you!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'm a jack of all trades, master of none. If there's one skill I can say I have, it's whiling the time away.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Hmm? Oh, these are test lenses, I'm sorting them by prescription strength… Indeed, glasses help us to see things clearly, but 20/20 eyesight is far from enough to truly see the land for what it is.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Reunion? I was with them for a brief moment. The bonfire that is life... You see, they still have much flame left; meanwhile, what am I but leftover ashes, cupped in the hand, waiting until I scatter to the wind.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Was I distracted again? Sorry. I was just glancing at the drizzle and mist outside. It's the bane of wanderers. The mud traps our feet and the mist blinds our vision, making every step feel like wading through a bog, and I mean that literally.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I learned Gaulish pugilism as a form of self-defense when I was an apprentice in Lingones. It hardly differed in technique from plain street brawling, and it was already lost by the time Gaul fell. Hm! I might even be the last in the land to remember it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: There's only one way to free myself, and it perfectly coincides with Rhodes Island's goal. That's why I choose to stay, to help others, in hopes that each day, little by little, I get closer to... the end.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: In my great-grandson's eyes, you know, I see his grandmother. He visited me, but I wasn't the stranger of the family this time, nor was I struck with pain to see the lines on his face. We've made great progress both. We met, and bid farewell to each other in peace. I could envision no other ending for you and me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: See? Tilt the lens just so, point it at your kindling... and poof, fire. Got the hang of it? Good. Not that I recommend it as a technique, no. All that fussing with sunlight and angles? Just grill with an electric grill instead.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: These involuntary flashbacks and déjà-vu are beginning to affect my work. The young lady from Medical suggested I carry a notebook with me, so I could jot keywords down to piece together later. Her other advice was to find someone who could help verify the content of my memories. And well... here I am.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I can prescribe a pair of glasses for you, if you can't read what's on the… Doctor?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Nowell. I've made glasses for your patients, and I know a little about medicine... I'll be spending some time here.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: That one's carrying an umbrella, but it's not raining... oh, it's an Arts Unit.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I didn't do anything worthy of this medal, but... Thank you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I still await death with a passion. It may be that I never repay Rhodes Island for its kindness. Even so, do you still insist on this... reward?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: My experience working alongside others is limited.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You don't need me in the rear?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: *Sigh* Let's go, then.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Follow me.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Go ahead.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'm ready.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Alright.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll take good care of them.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: The light is shining at the right angle.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Hang in there.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: If you're wounded, stay behind me.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I'm here. I'll help you.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Will there ever be an end to conflict like this?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We have saved some lives. That's something.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Making mistakes is a human thing.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Go! I have the rear… Go!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Any place to rest is fine.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Unfortunately for me, with age does not come heart disease, Doctor.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Being an optician doesn't mean I have any vision problems. That's to say, I can see you, Doctor. You don't need to get so close.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Once, it tortured me to see doors and courtyards dressed in festive decor, a cruel reminder of time's passage that one could never escape, a far cry from the intended joy. Thankfully, things are different now.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I've heard it's your birthday. When you blow out the candles and make a wish, don't let anyone hear it, for those with cruel intent might exploit it… Just a joke. Happy birthday, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island is a ship that gives sanctuary to those on a long and arduous journey. Those who find this vessel no longer need to wander, to measure their remaining lives with their feet. If only I had... no, it never could have been.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I can spend some time discussing matters with you before my next experiment.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You are spending far too much time outside the laboratory, Doctor. As a researcher, you must know this only hinders you from making great strides.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: SilverAsh's sisters? Yes, I've met them several times... Hm...? What more do you want me to say? I know nothing about those frolicsome, ever-changing creatures, and I certainly am not interested in them.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: It is incredibly ignorant to simply write off the symptoms that arise upon Oripathy infection as a mere disease, and then to go on to think only about how to 'control' and 'heal' this disease. Don't tell me this is how you think as well.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Shining. I knew I would find her here... Hm? No, she is an excellent scholar, and we collaborated for a period of time until she disappeared one day. That's all.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I am not working for SilverAsh; our objectives merely overlap. Of course, I won't deny what he is trying to achieve holds great significance for the future of the Snow Realm.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The best way you can earn my trust is by showing me your true academic strengths, and it seems you've already realized as much, Doctor. I am not like SilverAsh. I am not interested in deeper emotional exchanges.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: If you understand SilverAsh well enough, you know he is not a callous man. From my point of view, he might even be a little indecisive... That, is your weakness too, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Much like SilverAsh's, your endeavors require the help of countless supporters. However, the more supporters you have, the more you have to worry about. Since you cannot disregard them, you should avoid getting entangled. That is my one and only piece of advice for you, Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: It seems you are rather lax in maintaining your own health, Doctor.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Pleasure to finally make your acquaintance, Doctor of Rhodes Island. I've been eager to meet you ever since Karlan began its relationship with your company. You may call me Gnosis.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: War is merely a means to an end. That said, if you claim there are more efficient ways, I'm happy to learn.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I am far more interested in gaining access to Rhodes Island's databases than I am in a salary increase.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: If Rhodes Island is willing the cross the line, I am sure you will see results that far surpass what you are currently achieving... That said, with SilverAsh as an example, I do understand the reasons behind your convictions. Hmph, allow me to offer a helping hand, then.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: You're in luck. I just completed my experiment.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Fulfill your roles, and leave the rest to me.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I can only hope this mission won't prove to be a waste of time.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Follow the plan.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Right.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: You disrupted my train of thought, Doctor.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: A fine choice.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Let's put an end to this as soon as possible.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: As expected.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I have an idea.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: What a ruckus.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Do not disrupt my thought process.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I look forward to seeing such spectacular results from you in your research, Doctor.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Having prepared appropriately, these results are unsurprising.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Sometimes, there is much to gain from the unexpected.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Were there too many variables outside our control...?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Time to head to the lab.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hey.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I have an idea. Care to hear it?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: My experiences of Kjerag inform me that today will be a raucous day... Well, Doctor, I still have experiments to perform, so if you'll excuse me. As compensation, I will provide you some novel research results. Oh, one more thing: Happy New Year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You should spend your time more efficiently, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I've gathered from the hollering and hooting of the operators out here that today is your birthday. This book will serve as your birthday present. Accept, and then I ask you to please pacify the people outside the laboratory... SilverAsh is here too? Hmm, it seems you do carry a beyond-average estimation in his eyes.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Celebrate, out there? I have no interest. I've made my way out of the laboratory and given you my greetings, so there is no further reason this occasion should keep me, unless you think I can produce novel research results for you in conditions this clamorous.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: If you didn't have the time to get to all these files, why didn't you come ask me for help? I would've been more than glad.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Don't worry, there wouldn't be anything in it for me if I left Rhodes Island, at this point. You're free to get up to whatever it is you usually do, never mind the fact I'm here. And as recompense for your trust, I won't leak a single detail of your work. Now come on, chop-chop. I'm deathly concerned for you, what with that doorstopper of a document.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: 'Darling Rita.' I assume you're curious, if you bring it up? You know those certain few students who always leave their mark on you in your school years? I took quite a fancy to one of them—such an excellent soldier she turned out to be. Still, we have the space to keep out of each other's ways here, and that suits my fancy just as well.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Anything you'd like of me, Doctor of Rhodes Island? If it's in my power to deepen our bilateral trust, then I would be willing to stop gazing out at the window scenery, and focus a little instead on whatever it is that's vexing you.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Shame you're short on people with a shrewd eye for Londinium affairs—I was quite curious what they'd think of me. After all, a medical organization like Rhodes Island, unaffiliated with any nation, opting to work with us? Either you did it out of sheer idiocy, or if not, then you must've known a little too much.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: So what's your next step? Keep throwing yourself into the maelstrom of Victoria, or continue to build the peaceful paradise that Rhodes Island hopes for? The Leader once gave me a display of land torched to ash by her fires, and I'm ever so curious. If you had flames, what color would they be?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: 'Reed.' Such a darling codename—I can practically guess what was on her mind when she came up with it. Still, I'd be more the fool for claiming the prospect of a book club partner drove me here. She just happens to be somebody very useful, hence my need to protect her.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Just making a little bookside conversation, but... how do you regard the act of dancing? You know, when hands rest on collars, and gazes lock, and involuntary reactions let slip the true intentions of you or I—my my, your heart's hardly fluttering at all. No wonder The Leader's so interested in you.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I've gone through the files on my desk. Not at all surprised Rhodes Island would be going after my true reasons for coming here. That said, you were kind enough to drop the papers off with me? You must not be planning to boot me out any time soon, let alone hand me off to a duke. So, what is it you want me to do for Rhodes Island, or perhaps, for you?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hm-hmm, time to paint my nails. What pattern shall we go with?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Pleased to meet you, and my codename is Harmonie. Here's a dossier on Victoria for Rhodes Island's perusal, as a gesture of goodwill. Don't umm and ahh about it, now—that's basic etiquette for when someone thanks you. May we get along smashingly in the days to come, Doctor.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Oh, what a splendid war command.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Ah, well, thank you very much. It's my honor to receive your endorsement.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: What you're doing here has me startlingly curious. What could you be up to, placing me in this position?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: What would you have me do for Rhodes Island?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I thank Rhodes Island for its trust.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I do hope none of you turn on the waterworks anytime soon.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Get yourselves ready.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Present.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Received.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Operation commencing.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: On your command.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Take a breath, go on. It's not as if I'm crushing your throat.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Stop flailing about, and do as I tell you.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Now now, close your eyes.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: This'll all be over before you're bored of it.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: If I hadn't seen the battle for myself, I just might have been shocked by your command style.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I'm sure if The Leader saw you now, she'd be delighted.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Oh, there's a rare sight. Maybe you have other things on your mind?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Right, what else can I do here?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Minimalistic, but not at all design-deficient. I have to laud your tastes.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Tut...! Ah. Was something the matter, Doctor? Do tell.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: If you're free, we could always chat about your bookshelf.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It's a day worthy of celebration, and I'm here on a certain noble's behalf to gift you this. I will say, though, I've been watching this entire scene unfold, and it makes me think back to my student days, dancing with my classmates at whatever functions the school put on. Those were indeed times...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Dr. {@nickname}. Cup of tea?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I'm not here unprepared, let me say that. It'd be incredibly rude of me to have forgotten the date. I'm sure the typical gift-giving fare wouldn't have piqued your interest, so I have some choice pieces of intel I assume you'll like—if, of course, you're willing to believe me.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: You really do seem to have the utmost confidence in the future you're cooking up. A paradise, is it? You starry-eyed people and I may only be together so long, but make no mistake, the way your endgame will pan out makes me very curious.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, do you need my help transporting anything?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: This noisy metal music... sounds like Exusiai is throwing another one of her parties again. Doctor, should I go reprimand her?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I'm quite good with manual labor. I also know a bit about company management as well. So, Doctor, is there anywhere I can be of use?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: My parents were the first generation to settle in Lungmen, so I'm actually a Lungmen native... Doctor, if there's anything you'd like to learn about it, I wouldn't mind helping you out.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, if you want to know how a real logistics company operates, it'd be best to just ask me directly. Penguin Logistics is more of an exception than the rule, and though I don't mean this in a bad way, they don't have any reference value whatsoever.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: What do I like to do outside of work? Other than just resting, I'll sometimes accompany Croissant on her shopping trips and make sure she doesn't waste too much money... Doctor, do you also want to come along?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I used to believe that for any company to survive in the long run, standardization and efficiency were of critical importance. That's why at first, I couldn't fathom how a company like Penguin Logistics could stay afloat.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: After getting to know more about the people at Penguin Logistics and talking to them, I began to understand that the world is much broader than I had thought. There's nothing wrong with structure and rules, but they don't necessarily apply to everyone.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, perhaps you haven't realized this yourself, but the fact that you can unite so many people with very different personalities under one banner is no simple feat... It'd be great if I could become more like you one day.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor... You're taking a nap? I guess it can wait. Guess I'll start tidying up the place first.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Pleased to meet you, Doctor. My name is Bison. According to the terms of our contract, I will now also be a member of Rhodes Island. I look forward to working with you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Thank you very much. I will make sure to learn from this.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you very much, Doctor. As long as I put my best foot forward, my hard work will be rewarded. This is what I believe.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: At Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, I saw a more expansive world than before... Doctor, one day, I will also find my place in this world.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: A mission? Understood.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: On-site command? I have some experience with that.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Yes, I've noted the mission location and objectives.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Hah... I won't be a burden on the others.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What would you like me to do?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Is it my turn, Doctor?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'll do my best.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Got it.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I can keep going.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Hang in there a bit longer? Understood.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Don't worry, my shield still holds firm.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Way to go, Doctor! You must be the kind of leader that every company wants to have if you wanted to change jobs.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Wow, Doctor... You really are amazing!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The basic objectives of the mission have been accomplished. This should be good enough, right?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Don't feel down, Doctor. We'll have another chance.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: So this is the inside of Rhodes Island... It sure is big.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Where should I go?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Sora's new album is really good.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It's New Year's, so on behalf of MountainDash Logistics, I'm sending formal greetings to Rhodes Island. May everything go well for Rhodes Island's employees, and may you be safe and sound in the coming year. Also, here's a personal card from me to you, Doctor, to wish you a Happy New Year. To another great year working together.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning, Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday. Please try this bowl of long life noodles. All ingredients have been chosen with care. It has wheat from Yan, fin from Higashi, and the broth is Iberian ham. It took me months to put together, and it was still a rush to get everything in on time. I hope you like it.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: My father says the most precious thing to a business is pulling everyone together under the same ideal. At Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, I've seen that cohesion for myself. I have to learn from yours and Emperor's examples, in that regard.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You need an assistant too...? Ah, I just heard a little about you from Kal'tsit. Don't mind that. Is there any work I can help with?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: What a surprise, Doctor. Where did you pick up my novel? It only got praise from a few fellow writers thanks to some friendly connections; it's not worth spending your time with.  Unfortunately, it's the only sort of thing I can write, given the state of Victoria. I'm sorry about that.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I have a fair insight into coordinating formalwear and jewelry, you know. Right now, though? Treat this sort of dress-up as an actor's costume. The gentry and aristocracy are all at their drinking parties trembling for dear life, putting on a play of peace, watching for an explosion without knowing when it'll come.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: It's a pity you chose a bad place and time to arrive, or else I would've invited all you Rhodes Islanders to visit the theater as the Victorians do. The epic of the Aslan King owes its celebration to bards, after all, not letters on paper. Besides, my theater friends always leave me a seat.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Kal'tsit's always called herself a doctor, but before I actually came to Rhodes Island, I couldn't understand why she'd fixated on Oripathy treatment. After all, there were so many tricky issues she could solve.I mean... Really... She could have solved anything. Anything except Oripathy... But I see now. You're bringing hope.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Teaching a group of barehanded commoners to stand off against Sarkaz warriors—hard to believe, even for them. Some advised me not to even waste time trying... But when I met Kal'tsit, I was still very tender myself. The small and weak have their own strength, by all rights.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Without even looking, I know how Golding would evaluate that book. After all, we once wrote for the same newspaper and inked practically the same sentences between two articles—no, it wasn't a rapport, just that there's few words Victoria will allow you to pronounce loudly these days.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Has Amiya been sleeping well...? She really is just like Clovisia. Though their hearts have grown to the point they can bear everyone's hopes, their bodies are still so easily overwhelmed. I'll be off in a while, to see how I can help them.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Ever since I was very young, I sat by my father's desk, watching him read and write. Even when writing letters to Kal'tsit, he never pushed me away. Just like he said, sooner or later I'd understand this all, and I'd have to at that.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Oh, you fell asleep... I wonder what you dream of, Doctor? The past, perhaps?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I've been wanting to meet all you Rhodes Islanders since a good long time ago. Very glad to make your acquaintance again, Doctor. Just call me Heidi.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Oh my... This is all a lot harder to learn than what Kal'tsit taught me...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Do you need me taking on greater responsibilities? Of course I'd be glad to; I appreciate your faith in me. But as her Messenger, it's crucial I don't draw too much attention.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: What sort of clothes should I wear to match with this 'jewelry' Rhodes Island confers on me, Doctor?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: And by this, I will protect my home.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll see your orders relayed to every last one.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I have the intel for what lies ahead all sorted. Go forth with aplomb.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Let's go by the plan.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Let me witness this with my own eyes.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Is there anything you need me delivering?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Dust, and the scent of rust...

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Give me your orders.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: 'The young prince saw the other reach for the crown, and he raised his sword.'

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: 'We sing our elegy at full strain, in rivers of blood formed by fear.'

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: 'The girl, expelled from the city, still returns to rescue it.'

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: 'He lifted his slaughterer's blade, not believing that he could earn the love of a different line.'

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I venture no one could have envisaged a victory so marvelous. Doctor, it seems the intel on you needs another update.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: There will surely be an end to suffering.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: There's nowhere nearby for them to hide. I know where they're likely headed.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: This is the risk we must face for the sake of ultimate victory. There are times we must bear the cost of defeat too, am I wrong?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I really wish Londinium's workers could have an environment as fine as this.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh? I'm here if you need me.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: That's odd, I wonder where my bookmark fell.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I've brought you my father's well-wishes too. Don't open those now. Leave the stuffy letters until the fireworks are over, hm?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Have you rested well, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Do you look forward to birthdays? Even with how long ago I crossed into adulthood, birthdays for me still are a commemoration of growth and progress.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: *cough*... I'm only dropping back in here to find Kal'tsit, I certainly wasn't ready to perform in any sort of program. Poetry recitals wouldn't be too in the spirit of this party now, would they? How about I go and help fix up the cake? ...Take care not to let other operators steal a bite? Jolly good.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I don't need to go outside today? Th-thank goodness... Infected people like me have no right to wear these clothes. How strange it is that I cannot wear the clothes I make with my own hands... Eh? Rhodes Island doesn't care about stuff like that? Really?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Um... my outfit? O-Oh, I designed this one myself. The skirt incorporates some traditional motifs, though it can't compare to my papa's work... Still, this is my attempt at a vintage style.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Good afternoon, Doctor. I'm trying to clean up my room... Sorry, my room often ends up being a mess... I used to never have to organize my room, and now that I'm starting to learn, it's actually rather fun... although I often break things in the process...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I've always had trouble adjusting after being pulled away from my old life. In the very beginning, I felt like I couldn't continue living after becoming an Infected, and I was just so scared... But I'm not like that anymore. There's so much I want to learn, and I want to do more for those just like me here at Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Since I was young, my father insisted I study swordsmanship. I didn't enjoy it at the time. But after the incident, I've found holding the sword more reassuring... than holding the spinning thread.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I used to be afraid to go outside. As an Infected, I felt like everything scorned me... But now I understand that one's self-esteem has nothing to do with whether or not she is Infected. After all, that is the most beautiful adornment.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, um... If, if it's possible, can I make some clothes for you...? I think you'd be just right for bringing out some of my ideas. Um, I sometimes ask the other Operators in the same way...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The people who stoned me with Originium... Of course I hated them, but now... If I continued to harbor that contempt and despair, it would have driven me to do terrible things. I have no regrets about running away from home, even if it holds many warm memories of my past.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I want to incorporate the many things I've learned from everyone into something we can all wear...Hehe, even with that in mind, the elements are a bit complicated. But this reflects my emotions, whether I'm brandishing my sword or flourishing my needle.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I'll use this time to craft something small.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: H-hello, Doctor... My codename is Bibeak... Excuse me, but is there a facility with a loom and a knitting machine here?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: The way they fight... I've never even considered it before…

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A p-promotion? Are you sure? I'm actually not very good at fighting... Thank you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: All the Operators of Rhodes Island, and you, Doctor… stand at my side. I know, even with my limited lifespan, I'm still able to live as a normal woman… Or even, a life most people would never dream possible.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Ah! I understand!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Hm? I-I'm the captain?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Just like a textile, there is only one way to weave.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Is fighting unavoidable after all...?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Oh! Understood!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Our combat uniforms are all ready!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Is wielding the sword the same as wielding the needle?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I can also fight! Believe in me!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I won't hold back!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Save the talk for after the battle! There are people I must protect!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Like threading a needle... Strike!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Can the thread of life also be cut?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Great work, Doctor! Um, what did you think about my performance?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I-it's finally over! If your uniform is damaged, I can help repair it…

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Oh, someone got away... But, that's a better outcome... than the cruelty of death.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I, I'm still... so useless...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Hmm... Where is the textiles room?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Yah!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Oh, Doctor, could you grab those textiles for me?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: At New Year's, I used to make a new item of clothing for each member of the family. We would all sit around the fireplace, to greet the New Year together. It's the most blessed memory I have... But now, while clothes are renewed year after year, the people who've left us will never return.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: D-Doctor, um, happy... happy… Happy birthday! I've never seen you wear any other clothes, so I made you an outfit exactly like your current one, but with lighter and suppler material used. It... it should be more comfortable... Would you like to try it on?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Time is like the thread on a loom, forming into a person's life bit by bit… These moments I've experienced at Rhodes Island have surely made me stronger. With my sword in hand, and companions at my side, I'm given the courage to withstand the bitterness.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Did you call for me, Doctor? I feel so happy to be with you!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor! Dr. Kal'tsit said that you need to look after your health more. In two words, E-A-T L-E-S-S! So there!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You know, Doctor, if my sister starts getting all bossy with you, you have to tell me! She needs my treatment or else!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Dr. Kal'tsit teaches me a ton of practical stuff, although it's tough to actually learn! At least I've always had a knack for nutrition, so I think I'm doing well with that!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I feel better about everyone here, compared to when I just joined Rhodes Island! And they all eat my healthy food on schedule! But... why does everyone pull these weird faces when they finish?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Tadaaaaaah! A special healthy meal just for you, Doctor! Decaf coffee and a hamburger without meat, cheese, pickles, or lettuce! Oh, and a mixed salad made of 12 different vegetables!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Hey, Doctor, where does your family live? Are they doing well? I know there's things you can't tell them about because they're your family... but, still, I think you've got to reach out. You have to try, at least.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Isn't it lonely cooking all by yourself? Let me help you out! Oh, right, and let's get Lava in here too!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, did you fall asleep? Have a good rest then. You need to sleep plenty to stay healthy.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: This is intern Hibiscus. From now on, I'll be in charge of managing yours and every Operator's health at Rhodes Island. Thank you for your cooperation!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Oh, I see! So that's how you do it!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: It's my honor to be promoted! I'm looking forward to working under you for the health management of us all, Doctor!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I won't fail you! I'll protect everyone!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Acknowledged! I'll take good care of everyone! First, I need to get my special sustained-release medicine ready...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Please take good care of yourself while I'm gone!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Ready to heal!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Don't be afraid!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Doctor?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: There we go.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: It's safe here!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Please come to your senses!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I can heal that wound in no time!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Even if everyone gets wounded, I can heal them all with my staff!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Looking after everyone's health is my greatest motivation.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor! Everyone! Are you alright?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: No... First aid needed!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Anything I can help with?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh, my~!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, do you want to have a taste of my new vitamin drink?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Here, Doctor, your new customized healthy daily schedule! Relax, given this full table of gourmet food we have here, I will make an exception today. I will allow you — one bite of fries! That'll be my most generous offer!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor! Would you mind tasting this?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Stop hiding the cakes, Doctor. They aren't escaping my eyes!... Look at all these cakes you have here! It takes three full teaspoons of sugar to whip the cream for just one of them, let alone the milk and butter that went in there. I know, I understand they are just tokens of appreciation from your fellow operators. But you could have just looked at them — Hey, don't steal a bite when I'm talking!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: They had a celebration today? I was so occupied that I hardly noticed… Doesn't matter, as long as there are wounded looking for treatment, my job's not finished. Not to mention the goal I set for myself to become a better medic. See you then, Doctor, for I still got works to tend to!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: If some work is beyond even your power, then how can I possibly take on a share?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: That nightmare still comes to mind, even now. My life denied by some grand ecology... no, not denied. It would admit everything, it was more sublime than life itself... it made me feel shame at the selfishness of life.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I don't want to belittle the Medical Department's effort, but I don't believe life can be 'cured' like a disease. Human or Sea Terror, I'm doomed to live on as half-baked, and that's the price I pay for my own foolishness.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: That special 'collaborator' of yours is just something other right now, using biological function to imitate his old form, and you should know that better than him. You're still seeking possibilities in him? I hope you aren't repeating my mistakes.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I've felt at ease in my time residing aboard the landship, even come to recognize it as a feeling similar to my long-lost home... You don't need to be concerned. Even if Iberia will never be a home to the Ægir, I'd never refuse to execute my responsibilities there, such as we've agreed.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Anything that seems to be given for free will eventually demand some price of you. That's the lesson I learned. And some of what you do appears to practically overturn that... I'll have to wait and see.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You're wondering what this song is? It's just something my mother taught me when I was young. I didn't take much interest back then, only humming perfunctory notes to follow along. It was only after losing her, I realized... these melodies form one of the few things I still have to my name.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: An ignorant girl gives up her song, and gains naught but a dream snuffed as quickly as the foam in return. It sounds just like a fairytale, doesn't it? And the fact that such a stupid girl could be saved at the story's end... seems like a fairytale, too.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You've helped me recover the courage to trust in other beings, so I hope you see this responsibility through. Lead those willing to follow you, and put an end to those disasters that should never have befallen the innocent. Please, don't disappoint me.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You see them in your dreams too, don't you? All those faces who've quietly left your life.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: So, you'd be the 'Doctor'. I don't have much to introduce about myself. If I'm standing here, you must have read and approved all the files about me.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Maybe I shouldn't doubt the value of these records, like I did before.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: The more you seek from a power you should reject, the deeper you fall into it. Eventually, it will engulf your entire being. You understand this, don't you?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: You wish to forge a space that can admit me, and hope for me to admit everything surrounding me...? An arrogant notion, truly. But maybe I could bear witness with you, until the day you give up.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Looks like we've gotten our approvals. It's time to go.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I might bring their ruin, but only you can bring our victory.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let us reap those naive delusions and immature obsessions.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I hear the sound of the flooding tide.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Do you have instructions for me?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Do I still have to wait?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: As you ask.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I have no doubt.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: They have no position to evade.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: They have no power to withstand.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: They have no way to advance.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: They have no path to escape.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Sometimes, your grasp of the surrounding situation makes me instinctually fearful. Yes, I believe you could make even Sea Terrors comprehend fear. So, do you intend to feel happy about this?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The waves have subsided. If you have no other tasks, I should leave immediately to undergo a 'routine' inspection.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Were you showing mercy? Are enemies of this level worth your indulgence?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We should go. Before the next wave has us drowned.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: So this, too, is the place you promise I can belong.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Did you need me?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: This place might be more... calming than expected.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I don't expect much for the new year, nor do I want to. I just want to take a walk around and see whether anything's changed, compared to my memories of the last year. If it won't bore you, I don't mind you accompanying me.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: We still have some time, before the tide floods the soil beneath us.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Look at this mountain of gift boxes. They symbolize everyone around you who treasures you. And I add: this, my present to you. I'm so glad these petals and pearls my mother gave me didn't fade with time, just like how she taught me to string flower garlands.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Does Rhodes Island's intent to cure Oripathy stem from its mission as a healer, or its core members' self-interest as Infected? Now, under this starry sky, another threat has appeared to endanger us all. What will Rhodes Island do? You already have an answer, don't you, Doctor?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor? No, I wasn't taking a nap! I was... I was just spacing out!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Is it raining outside? I used to really hate rainy days... Mud gets everywhere, and construction grinds to a halt. Dad would always come home late when it rained. But I always felt cozy when the rain let up and I'd stay inside, just like this.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Back when I worked construction in Columbia, life was a real grind. I had to get up early every morning and go to bed late every night. Sometimes I'd be working overtime and suddenly realize I hadn't slept at all…

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Oh, Doctor, would you like to go for a walk together? Hm? Ahh...! Wh-Where's my tool bag...? Did I leave it at the construction site again? I-I'm sorry, wait a sec while I fetch it!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: What I want to do...? Hmm... A steady job and an honest life would be enough for me. So why sign on to be an operator here? Well... The pay is a bit better, and the work isn't all that different... so I figured, why not give it a shot? I guess?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The Infected... There were plenty of Infected workers back in Columbia. Everyone warned me to keep my distance. But watching them work, I realized they're no different from the rest of us.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Oh... what the job Closure put me on again...? If I go back and ask her, I'll probably get an earful... Say, Doctor? Do you think you could help me out...?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My dad always says, studying hard is the key to a better life. Doctor, you know lots of stuff, right? Could you teach me something? I promise I won't zone out. Well, I'll try really hard, anyway.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I never used to think much about the future. I figured I'd just drift between odd jobs with the Pioneers, spending my life as a craftsman. But now... I really need to thank our friend—the big guy. I wouldn't have met you, if it wasn't for him... Uh... A-Anyway, I really appreciate what he did for me.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Fwahh... I'm so tired... Maybe I'll take a little nap, just like the Doctor...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Codename Pinecone... I'm starting at Rhodes Island today... Um... Have you seen my portable battery?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Um... Umm... I don't get it...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you, Doctor... But what should I do now? Oh... Do I just kinda do what the others do? Okey-dokey…

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Hm...? Another promotion? Ehehe, you're awfully forgetful yourself, Doctor. Didn't you already give me a promot—This is a new one? Um... Okay. I'll follow your lead. So, when are we heading out?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Time for work.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I guess it's like being a foreman at a construction site?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Um... Where are we going again...?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: It's the enemy! Don't hold back!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Yes, I'm listening!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: What's the job, Doctor!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Here, right?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll stay right here like a nail.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Hyah!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I still have lots of batteries on me!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Pulling the trigger!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Just like shooting nails at work!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Phew... That was a lot harder than building a house. Doctor, it makes us kinda impressive, don't you think?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: That was perfect... Doctor, are you happy with how we did?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Hmm... Maybe I messed up the process...? I'm sorry. It didn't go as well as I'd hoped.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Eh? Why are there sparks... S-Sorry... It's all my fault...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Okay, is there anything that needs maintenance?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, want to watch the rain together? There's not much to see, though...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Uh, since it's New Year's, I figured I'd give your office a little touch-up, Doctor... Yes, I cleaned up some wear marks and remade the wall decorations. Err, if—if you don't like it, I can take everything down right away...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Hope you have another year of steady employment as a doctor... Err, is that not your job? Okay, I hear you. So, uh... hope you have a year with less overtime. Mm-hm.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, after listening to everyone's stories over dinner, I've been wondering... I feel like we're doing something epic, aren't we? So, would it be... inappropriate someways if I brought my parents to work at Rhodes Island?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Assistant? The one where ye just stand next tae folk, aye? Nae bother, saw that plenty in the army myself. Wait, I have tae do paperwork too? And assess combat data? And compile reports?! Th-that sounds mighty hectic.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Back in school, Chenchen always had a pissed off look on her face, made no end of enemies at first, but tha's just the kind of girl she is. Nae time at all, she had people seein' her wi fresh eyes. But y'know, bandagin' up her wounds, cookin' for her, teamin' up wi her squad and all that... I had tae look after her a fair bit, and that was no easy thing.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I'm great at drivin' machines! Harvesters, tractors, tillers, I'll be right at home wi anythin'. Hm? PDAs? Screens? Wireless systems? If yer meanin' little gadgety stuff, I'm nae so—ah crims, I just barely touched this—why's it smokin'?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Ye didnae get a proper supper in yesterday, did ye? No, I dinnae want tae hear aboot 'work, work, work'! If yer body gives out on ye, ye willnae be able tae get a thing done. Tell me what ye'd like, and I'll whip it right up for ye. Ah, na anything too fancy though, aye? I'd be lost tryin'.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: This Rhodes Island ship is... crivens, it's a million times more wonderful than Victoria's warships! We've got sunlight, wheat fields, herds of stockbeasts... Doctor, what if, we try growin' somethin' too? Like potatoes, say? I know all aboot growin' potatoes!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Where d'ye think someone's hometown ends? The hoose furthest from the tractors? Or where the land meets the sky? Does it stop at the fronts we keep drawin' and redrawin' maps wi, all reds and blues and lines and arrows...? Y'know, after so many battles... sometimes I cannae recall what my hometown looks like.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I'm sure that I ran across her once, that Reed lass. But she looks so lonely the noo, so pitiful... can she really be the same terrifyin' person I met before? It's right strange. I should go ask her...  What? I cannae talk tae her? Why no?!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My mum's part of the reason I ended up runnin' off to military school at all. Always bangin' on like 'Vouivre women must keep gettin' stronger', she is. ...S'pose I wanted to be cheeky about it, aye? Though lookin' back on it, no need to be AS tough as my mum. Och, I'm still more soft and cute than hard and chiselled, wouldn't you say? Go on, say?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: When I was still in the army, I came across this spectre-like force. Hauntin' the dark edges of Victoria, and most of the people who witnessed them went missin'. I've a duty to expose them, and that's why I've been scramblin' aboot. Oh, dinnae you step in for me. You've got yer own callin' to worry about, na?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Ah! Fancy that, skivin' off! Aww, got me jealous. Doesnae beat a nice hay pile for a few winks though, aye? I'm noddin' off just thinkin' aboot it... Wouldn't hurt tae take a wee kip myself...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello! You're the Doctor, aye? Officer Ch'en fae Lungmen said I'd be able tae find some helpers here! I need tae sign my name first? Aye, right enough. Baaag...pipe. There! Eh? 'Become an Operator?' 'Full-time bed and board'? Ach, what's goin' on here?!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Whoa, you folks here at Rhodes Island sure can fight!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Hmm... cannae say if I like it or na. For soldiers, more responsibilities means more battles, and a greater risk of mistakes.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Joinin' Rhodes Island has been a good thing for me. Oripathy and the Infected may seem a touch scary at first, but runnin' from it willnae solve a thing. That's what I've learned here, and I mean it when I say, thank you—I see my way now, right ahead of me.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Stand to attention!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Assumin' leadership! Team will hereby carry out the operation!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Honor your orders! Move out!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: All units, spread out!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Orders, please.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Standing by.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Forward!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: My spear and I hail from Victoria!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: 'Tactics sharpen the mind!'

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: 'Discipline strengthens the will!'

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: 'Bravery shall overcome evil!'

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: 'Benevolence shall save lives!'

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Be it school or the military, I've still seen worse.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Phew... I've managed tae live up t' the reputation of this uniform once more.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Enemy routed! All units, pursue only wi caution!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: You get out of here! Go!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: How do I get tae the greenhoose?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Whoa-whoa!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Wanna go on a picnic? Just the two of us!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The toon always used tae get together at New Year's back home. Roastin', drinkin', dancin' aboot bonfires, playin' bagpipes loud and proud, and then gettin' all kitted out in fancy dress and jumpin' straight intae the freezin' lake. Oh, it isnae anythin' too serious really, just a daft auld way of sobering up a wee bit.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, how's about we go farmin'!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I heard the news! Today's yer big day, Doctor, so that means a meal on you, aye? Me and Chenchen'd always treat each other to supper back on our birthdays at school, heheh. Oh, right, I've got a wee prezzie for ye, too. Here y' are! It's one of the potatoes I planted a wee while ago- just sprung up proper today!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Thinkin' over it, I've been through a fair few battles wi all the folks at Rhodes Island by now. I really do miss the days of lyin' in the hay havin' a nap sometimes. But nobody'd have an idle life to live if I put this spear doon and left, ye ken? So you'll no catch me moanin' aboot it!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Sorting files, serving tea, and transcribing meetings? Of course, I'm at your disposal...
