Come to think of it, in my first mission, I also approached the target under the guise of a secretary. One week later, I'd hollowed them of all valuable intel, and torn their influence down to rubble.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: If you don't trust me, you have permission to search my briefcase, and ascertain whether any data inside is critical to Rhodes Island. The Curio Collector's Guide to Antique Appraisal? Learning material for skills required under certain guises—nothing more, certainly not a personal interest. Pardon me if you wanted specifics, but no comment.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The Dublinn Feline, name of Harmonie. Her plan had a lot of moving parts, and almost went off without a hitch—shame she still left an opening. Even your smallest mistake can have irredeemable consequences, such is the cutthroat nature of intelligence work. Yes? Do I consider her an enemy? Hardly; there is no value in a spy whose identity is exposed.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I'm working on a puzzle... Sorry, please be quiet for a while; your voice is disturbing the pieces. A puzzle's answer is unique; do you solve it through incessant trial-and-error, or through calm analysis and a hold of every detail? Only morons would elect for the former... Well then, did you need me for something?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Inside the aristocrat's ballroom, you need to mind every gaze, to pry into or guard against one another. That is the battlefield the spy roams. It demands of us the proficiency to cruise through it, but I highly doubt anyone truly enjoys it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I rarely make decisions based on emotion, but my saving a completely unrelated civilian was out of fear, it's true. It didn't amount to a mistake, Doctor, and it won't impact anything... War only showed me some of its spiny thorns, but I know It will crush every emotion we feel and every concept we hold

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Rhodes Island's doctors constantly limit my usage of Originium Arts. Aside from ensuring my condition doesn't worsen, they must be concerned that I'll cause some sort of uncontrollable accident... You can put your worries to rest, I know my limits. But nevertheless, thank you for caring.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: It was on a mission that an unanticipated explosion infected me with Oripathy. Of course, that mission was still a success... Why didn't I take cover? Doctor, a variable like that could impact the entire operation. But we could also accept it, and implement it as part of the plan.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Thanks to work reasons, I've met quite a few people as unique and interesting as you. And for those same work reasons, the 'me' they got to know has vanished. Is it a shame? No, it's just the piecing of a new puzzle. All that said, I don't plan to ditch my current codename, for the time being.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: No pending intelligence work for the moment... What a rare break.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: You'll have received personal correspondence from the Duke. I'll be stationed and active aboard under the codename Puzzle. No need to bother investigating me; I've handed you all personal information that's been made public.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This deployment is somewhat sloppy... or does it speak to your confidence in their individual abilities?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, you need caution when promoting intelligence workers. It may well add danger to your situation... But I'll let this one pass, seeing as you're affirming my work ability with it.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: The last promotion wasn't that long ago... I appreciate your trust. Of course, if Rhodes Island is wishing to work on closer terms with any nobility I serve, I'd be willing to pass on the message.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Doctor, my public activity with Rhodes Island is better kept on the minimal end.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: An intelligence worker in this position is barely a good fit... I have no reason to decline, naturally, if you have your own considerations.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Do you need me to tell you all, you seem like a pack of children at a holiday camp?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Within expectations.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Let's establish a code.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: The intel work began long beforehand.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Probing the enemy's weak points, posthaste.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Be ready at a moment's notice for the info I send back.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Don't leave it written across your face.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Every look you take has value.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Every expression you make is an opening.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I can read you like an open book.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Such adaptability and command proficiency... I'm all too glad you're not my target.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Intelligence is the invisible scaffold, each battle merely following whatever course it lays out. With the boon of our preceding work, this victory should come as little surprise, Doctor.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Check for lost weaponry, cover all tracks, don't let anyone in the future discover what happened here.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: A comprehensive plan must include a contingency for failure at every step. We're prepared, so evacuate ASAP... wait, destroy this intel before we leave.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: If certain Victorian nobles decorated their residences the way you do, my work would be more than twice as difficult.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: That's extremely rude.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I was out of practice with a few skills—it seems I can revise here.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I've never joined in with noisy parties like this before. Everyone's completely open about prying into each other's freshly sworn resolutions, writing what info they're sending to their recipients on postcards. To a degree, it's stupid... Are these every year? These kinds of parties, I mean.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Oh, I see it's you again, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: If the intel I've collected isn't mistaken, then nobody has ascertained your true preferences as of yet. So provisionally, I'm choosing to give you a puzzle as a gift. You want a race? No, it wouldn't be much contest.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Puzzle.' It's the identity I've both kept the longest, and had the least motive to work under. Rhodes Island really is a strange place. What is it that makes you all gather here...? Doctor, I've already handed in my on-board continuance application to our superiors.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. I'll be acting as your assistant from here on. Please keep an appropriate distance from me; I'll be more at ease that way.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I recall my first time ordering a fountain pen from Zeruertza's artisans, where I didn't make my requirements clear. Then I ended up with this crossbow. It plagues me to have had the peace-loving Durin forges a weapon… Operator Myrtle? Calling herself Generalissimo? That's just a childish fan—Ahem, it's her own self-styling.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: If you'll permit my frankness, it's my belief Rhodes Island should build work and living environments more suited to the Durin operators. At least the cafeteria menu should be decided by vote—they're all satisfied? They can't be! I'll go and ask them, lest you—lest someone be tricking them.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You require me to draft some slogans? I'd be happy to. It was routine work of mine in Zeruertza. You only need to provide me a typewriter, and that's all... Why do I not use a pen? My fountain pen is typically for more private things, more... not-so-Durin things.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I was a steadfast teetotaler back in Ursus, but to my surprise, I could keep more drink down than most in Zeruertza. Truth be told, I didn't immediately understand why they loved their drink so, but I did eventually come to realize. We only drink in excess when hope is lost, and a forever stagnant, easy life can lose us hope as well as anything.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I still hold that life in the Durin cities far surpasses that of the surface, but I have to admit, the flowerets that vie to bloom in the ruins have more of a power than all the blossoms of Durin greenhouses... Hah. All these years, and yet I'm a surface-dweller through and through.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Ursus desserts and wine? Let someone else have the pastries, please. 'Ursus-style' is an exceptional stranger to me by now. That said, do leave the liquor here. Zeruertzans love their drink, and I'm no exception—wait, this isn't mead. Is this pure spirits? Oh, my head...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Noble? Correct, I was once a noble. Until a conspiracy wrested my family away, and left me with the sole luck of escaping underground to Zeruertza. There was no avaricious nobility in the city, nor any commoners who'd take advantage for their own gain. Only kindhearted Durins... What more could I ask for?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, I'd like to talk with you of beauty and virtue, of those things I consider vanished from the surface. I've witnessed their existence aboard Rhodes Island, and you've told me that more of their sparks are alight upon this land still... I don't dare trust. I have to go and see it for myself.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, are you asleep? No? Well, no matter. If you're planning to hold the same posture for a while, perhaps I might draw a fountain pen sketch of you.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I believe you're the Doctor? It's nice to meet you. Please accept my gratitude; thank you for allowing me to lodge here, a refuge on the unseemly surface.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I could never imagine. Do you show these violent, bloody tapes to the Durins as well?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you for the gesture of confidence. I'll endure the urge to flee the award ceremony as best I can, so please, if you could wrap it up soon... There's no ceremony, it's just a normal presentation? Oh, that's a relief.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Another promotion, is it? Thank you. I'll accept this honor with my chest out in pride... And of course, we don't need to end this presentation as quickly as last time. Do not be afraid of those I should not fear—this is what life aboard Rhodes Island has taught me.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: The day shall come for every land dweller, the day they find a cold weapon in their arms. And I learned it the hard way.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: For those of you who've spent not a second out of the fight, decades-old tactical thinking from Ursus must be far past its prime.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: May we all return safely.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Enemy... A noun I hardly want to reunite with outside of writing. It's been so long.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Your orders, please.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: With pleasure.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Good visibility. I'm ready to fire.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll cover my allies.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Bolt pierces deeper than nib on the battlefield.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: For a life of peace...!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Abandon resistance now, or I pull the trigger!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Hff... haa... Fire!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Surface civilization is no different to the ferocious vile beasts, but perhaps you can become one who loops its reins.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The battle is over. It's time to return and write, and do something more meaningful than this.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Apologies, Doctor. I'm still unaccustomed to the sensation of combat.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, evacuate everyone as fast as you can, I—I'll bring up the rear! Don't mind me, go!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Zeruertza has molded me. I'm still a little unused to moving about these narrow spaces.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hands off! ...Apologies, that wasn't intentional.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, if you insist on chatting with me, what say we talk about your favorite books?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Please, enjoy this little play written by me and jointly presented by the Durin operators of Rhodes Island—er, where's Durin? She's asleep? Oh... well, don't wake her up. I'll take up her role.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: *yawn*... Good morning, Doctor. The book you recommended was very interesting. I finished reading it overnight.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: This is for you, Doctor. I asked a Logistics Operator to formulate a special shade of ink—apparently, this one gradually changes hue once it's on paper. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Recently, I've begun to feel that if you had me recommend a lodgings for any surfacing Durin, I would suggest Rhodes Island without a doubt. It may not compare to the underground cities, but at least it's a place one can live with peace of mind.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: To be of assistance to you would be my great honor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: What did you find in time, mysterious master of the black market? The past, Elliot. I have always been seeking the past. Perhaps I will find a home among the patterns of the cacti and quicksand, but neither you nor I know where our fate will lead.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: The Originium crystal on my forehead is oft regarded as an adornment. A very convenient mistake; it lets me save the effort of concealing my Infected status. That said, every time pain crosses my brow, I'm deeply struck by my own foolishness. To say I leave Sargon asks just where my path now leads.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I detest everything there. I had to leave Sargon, even if letting a coin flip decide for me meant surrendering to fate. But I am still there, Sand Soldier. You can't escape what you are. Our destinies have already been written.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Sesa is still quite young. Indeed, I am but a few years his senior. Yet, his grasp on patience is somewhat awkward, and his resentment lacks solidity. Should he seek a spark of truth to ignite his thirst for vengeance, I would be more than willing to oblige... Ah, should you forbid it, I would not act out of turn.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Sargon will leave its mark on you. To the employer, you are as feeble as a fledgling fowlbeast. I forgot how it felt to be put to the lash. Do you hate those people? No. I know their end. I know it from your eyes. Fortunately, you don't seem to regret it.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I abhor the black market. Only lowly, vapid ruses circle it. People all believe themselves the most veteran players, yet all end dismally. At times, you need only think with some care, and you can send someone to their demise—even a padishah's very own appointed lord ameer. Hm, might you be curious?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Yet your expression suggests otherwise. Did you not throw all of the past into that big fire? There is a plaza in the black market with a view of the sky. Do you remember what the night reminds you of? I called it a cremation ceremony, but when my plan worked and the flames raged... What came to mind was not the face of my beloved teacher.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: That great fire, you say? Do you look to blame me? Indeed, I shall not contest it. But know this: not a single innocent suffered in that fire, nor did any perpetrator survive. In the black market of Sargon, the good only comes in one form... They are the ones who've endured. And I have endured.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Do you remember the first component of Thorne's Gift? The shoddy Arts Unit you obtained by burying your conscience in the sand? By exploiting and deceiving a guard who had just lost his son? Not to mention the irony in that name. What gift will a teacher give to a conspirator, Passenger?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Kal'tsit... Dr. Kal'tsit and I, are indeed old acquaintances. To be precise, she was my rescuer and savior, but be at ease; I am yours now. Oh, was that not your concern? How remarkable, that as a coworker of our 'Kal'tsit,' you could still be so unwary?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Tell me. Has Oripathy changed our lives? Do you feel pain? How will the illness transform me? Have the schemers behind the scenes miscalculated? You are trembling, poor Elliot. Never mind the cause, leave them in the past. Now, I simply marvel at the beauty of Oripathy's creation in the mirror.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Were I to return to Columbia'... I cannot say I've never entertained the possibility over the years, but such supposition would only serve to shake me. Doctor, I hope you will use me to the utmost. If such mild civilian technologies have become a stranger to me, I would now much rather renounce them.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Spring is when business is best. Summer is adorned by festivals. Autumn is the season to seek fortune away from Ibut. Winter belongs to war. These are the seasons of Sargon, seasons that you will come to hate… But in Ibut, I can see the stars shine bright on summer nights.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Elliot? How do you... Hm. Elliot. His parents gone before their time, his one beloved, esteemed teacher dead in Sargon. The work which bore his faith but a stepping stone in someone else's conspiracy. To this day, he is bereft of anything. Elliot Glover is merely a laughable life lived.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Strange things, fabricated dreams are. What should I say to you, Doctor of the future? If I had met you earlier... No. The Doctor does not exist where we do. The Doctor belongs to my time. Let our special friend act freely. I have high hopes for this one.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I know a scientist—a star so bright, a soul so graceful, a leader so natural. I admire him, rely on him, and regard him as my elder brother. However, his end is not a good one, considerably not. So you must protect yourself well, Doctor. After all, we do get along quite pleasantly.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: A Vouivre, and the 'Doctor'. Are you begging for their pity? No, I simply want to learn about my future, or tell others about theirs. Nothingness without end is worse than any illness... Listen to me, Elliot. I feel a little tired.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: How long it has been—since such clear skies.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Sleep, my Elliot. Sleep and dream together with me. In our dreams, you will become me, and I will still be you.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Your Operator, Passenger. I have long wished to work alongside you, Doctor. I'm sure we will both find this journey most enjoyable.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Have I turned the pages of destinies past? No, it is but a dream you avoid. My future.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Marvelous tactics, owing to your command, no doubt.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I see conspiracies from time to time... Yes, Elliot. The conflicts, the greed. They are everywhere.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I shall refine my services even further for you and Rhodes Island. Trust that the Sand Soldier of Reefsteep Black Market has more tricks up his sleeve.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Oripathy has robbed me of my future. I hope that Rhodes Island can make use of what I have left. Wrong. Nobody in Rhodes Island can indulge your desire for self-harm. It is not that they are too kind, it is that you are too harsh. This is Elliot Glover's conclusion.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I truly hope that my amusing Operator codename will remind you—Doctor, there is no need to trust others, and you are capable of doing everything yourself. Oh? It seems you have other views. I shall duly accede, then.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Will you see the Sargon's winter when you awake? Will you sleep away in the eternal summer? Must I become you? Prophecy is but fate in disguise. Sleep soundly, Elliot. You've shaped me, and I shall complete you, until the day the prophecies no longer foretell.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Allow me to demonstrate how a truly exceptional weapon of war operates.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Why do you not seek more companions? It will make things easier. In time, you will understand. And much more than once, I regret to say.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I am quite familiar with strategy and planning. Of course, should you have other ideas, I defer to you.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Elliot would have asked me: How does an empty soul lead others with sincerity?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let us depart.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I recall the weight on my back as I carried my grievously injured teacher—it was the weight of my war. Most wars are waged for profit; mine is born from vengeance.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Now then, we have everything in place.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I fought for a single purpose. Let war be the past, then, if the purpose is lost.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I heed your command.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: In place of training.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: As you wish.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Do you remember the touch of quicksand?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Should this be your intent...

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: My war machine will fulfill your wishes.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I am prepared.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: After all, 'Man' is the ultimate weapon.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Now go.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I remember how each piece of equipment was born.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Punish these people.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: What is there to be gained... by fighting in the name of my teacher?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: All as you desire.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Sentimentality does not bring victory.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Begone with the wind.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Vengeance has ended.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: You must pardon me; it seems my lowly weapons have barely served to accomplish this mission. Should you assent to my adopting more... extreme methods, we may thus have an easier time.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: There is no snow in the winters of the black market. Will I still see snow? Yes, but in that world of silvery white, nothing you know will remain.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Thunder and lightning are but a form of punishment. They have paid the price for their ill deeds. How good it is, do you not think?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Your machinations will claim all. Is this how you became the master of the black market? Yes, as will you, Elliot. I know that well. You will not let anyone escape.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I cannot permit the punished to leave my sight in peace. Doctor, I plead you permit me to perform this aftercare.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Did you see how the punished fled? Yes, I did. I wonder if that was how those Columbians saw me.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: A rather harsh defeat. But worry not, Doctor. Those who have snatched victory from your hands... will be privileged to experience suffering in full.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: The days to permit mistakes are gone for good, never to return. We are fighting an enemy too powerful. Fate? No, ourselves.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What a captivating landship. Doctor, Sargon has never accorded me such treatment.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Do you find Rhodes Island comforting? It's more the caffeine.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh. Might something be the matter?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Do not wake him, okay?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, care for some coffee? I grew these beans myself. Back in Sargon, it was my sole form of recreation.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Treasure your memories, treasure a time when you still had emotions. I understand. At least, I can still understand.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The New Year... what an unfamiliar concept. The golden sands of Sargon remain unchanged year after year. Making resolutions for a new start on an artificial calendar is nothing but empty self-consolation. That said, here at Rhodes Island, perhaps a day when everyone has a common cause for celebration is indeed special.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: At New Year's Day, I guess many will come to curry the favor of the master of the black market? Is that so? I have forgotten. I only remember that science museum admission was free when the professor took me there that winter... So distant. The memory is so very distant.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: My greetings, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I dreamed of a future where all faded into nothingness with the changing seasons. No sweet dreams, no nightmares, only... darkness. That is where fate will lead us, Elliot. That darkness is no metaphor, just nothingness itself.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: A birthday should be no cause for celebration. It is, instead, a countdown to one's death. Each time such an occasion arises, I reflect on what remains unaccomplished. The terminus of ideals and hatred lies far beyond sight, much like the unpredictable end of one's life. These ravings are perhaps not suitable for this occasion. I should congratulate you instead. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Seems that even time celebrates you, Doctor. Forgive me for not having prepared a gift. May your dreams be free of the pains of the past. Or perhaps, I will tell your future when the past eats away at you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Having lived such an absurd life, I am but a husk of a man. Yet, from this ship that Kal'tsit has placed great hope in, I caught a glimpse of light in this boundless, dull realm. Doctor, I look forward to the sights you will show me, after we traverse the immeasurable hatred and battles ahead.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The mission of Rhodes Island is clear, but you seem to seek something else. I know. What I seek could never be had, ever since the morning that I left Columbia. Do you remember Professor Thorne's voice, Elliot?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Do we work so hard every day? Hohh... this is rough... Doctor, if the stress ever gets to you, please don't bottle it up. I'll chat with you anytime.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Here, Doctor, this is for you. I sent an application to Dr. Kal'tsit, and remodeled an unused cabin into a conversation room. This is the leaflet I made myself!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I've heard there's a mysterious snackseller here who can dodge the Medical Department's controls, and shows up when anyone needs them... Doctor, is this all true?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: As long as you take daily precautions, Oripathy is hardly that easy to catch! The sick aren't that dangerous, let alone their healthy relatives... Why do people always let ignorance scare them about this or that, and they're never even willing to look into it some more?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, look at this! Ehehe, it's a notice that I'm qualified and approved for psychological counseling. I've been preparing forever, and I finally passed the test!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My dad passed away when I was very little, because of Oripathy. The villagers were scared of getting infected, and they shunted us deep into the forest, far from the settlement. Life might've been very tough, but my mum still carried on as she took me through... Now I'm grown up, and it'll be my turn to look after her!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: My old home was in the woodlands in west Rim Billiton. I grew up in the forest all my life, so I'm a bit familiar with all kinds of herbals. That said, herbals can treat your surface injuries, but invisible wounds on your spirit just aren't that easily cured...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, can I stay here? Would I be able to chat with you? I promise I won't interrupt your work! Everyone in the Medical Department has missions today, Mint's studying and she's not coming out for any fun, and there's no patients who need tending to. It's just me left now... I don't want to be alone...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I believe that getting good sleep, eating good food, and sharing the glad and the sad times with friends can make people happy. There's times when enduring too much does more harm... Doctor, just to let you know if you've got any worries, share them with me. Don't forget about it, okay?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, did you fall asleep...? Hmm, no reaction, gotta be asleep. Okay, good chance! Let's find where the Doctor's been hiding all those snacks...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Nice to meet you, I'm the new Medical Department intern, Honeyberry. I'm assuming you're the Doctor...? Hmm, it's just like Dr. Kal'tsit said. You're different enough from everyone else that I can tell you at a glance!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: So you can do emergency treatment like this too...!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? So that means, I've cleared my internship without any problems?! That's brilliant!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I've learned and gained so much at Rhodes Island. It's all the experiences that build up, and all the beautiful memories, that give me the drive to keep going, to strive together with all of you!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: After our mission's over, why don't we all celebrate together?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Please don't worry, leave your health to me...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: It's time. We should be departing any moment now.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Before checking what methods the other side might use, each of you please watch yourselves!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: No problem!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Do I have to jump down? I've got a real penchant for that!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Arrived at designated position, treatment targets sighted!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Everyone, focus on fighting! Just leave treatment to me!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Get a hold of your breathing, and relax.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Everyone... hang in there!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I've got a way to treat you here!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: No matter what trouble we're in, I'll face it together with all of you...!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Mission complete! Now it's time for a celebration party... why don't you join us, Doctor?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: It's finally over... you all worked so hard.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We're not done yet, we need to treat the wounded as soon as possible...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Don't get discouraged, we still have a chance!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What do you think about building a treehouse?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hm? What's the matter?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, do you want some snacks?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy new year! It's such a major day. I wonder if everyone's celebrating with their families? Um, me? My mum's waiting for me to go see the fireworks with her... hehe, Rhodes Island is like a second home for me now, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Wow! D—Doctor, I'll jump down right now! Catch me, please!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Here's a dried berry mix as a present! I've divided it into little pouches according to your intake each day, so eating one a day will supplement all the nutrients you need. Um, Doctor, Why are you hiding them? You don't want Hibiscus to see them? Hehe, Don't worry, she's already gotten some herself!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I used to dream of being an executive, and my mum still frets over that sometimes. But one day, I'll cheer her up for real, and she'll see that her daughter's doing great. More than that, I'm doing amazing. One day, when we help people overcome prejudice towards Oripathy, I know she'll be proud of me.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Awaiting your orders, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: The two seniors from the BPRS squad are here too? In that case... Could you assign me to their squards in future missions, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Huff... huff... three more sets of physical training and I'll be half-done for today. Doctor... please... fetch my water bottle for me...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You want to know about my hometown? My hometown… it's a cruel wilderness. Even survival itself is a difficult feat there. Compared to that, Rhodes Island is like heaven.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I've become stronger than when I was an intern for Blacksteel.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The 22nd rule of Blacksteel: 'Anyone who loses her weapon no longer belongs here.' That's why I always bring my hellebarde with me wherever I go. The rule doesn't apply to everyday situations, you say? But... if I remember correctly... wait, let me check. 'This rule only applies to contracted Operators and new recruits under training.' What?... Ms. Franka didn't tell me about this part...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Instructor Dobermann's really got a heart of stone! Why choose me other than anyone elase to deal with all those live Originium slugs? I... I just can't!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I think I know now why Franka and Liskarm decided to stay at Rhodes Island. Compared to Blacksteel, this is a place we can call home. There's lots of fun things to do here besides the missions...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Shh, the Doctor's having a rest now. Keep your volume down, would you?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Vanilla, trainee Operator from Blacksteel. Looking forward to learning from you, Doctor.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: It's time to organize my notes. I need to digest what I've just learned.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion medal? For me? My-my sincerest gratitude!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'm here to help everyone!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Me, the leader? Are you sure about that?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I'll work even harder.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I will not bring shame to Blacksteel!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Your words are my command.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Okay!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Understood.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: You shall not pass!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: This hellebarde isn't just for show!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Battles aren't always won by the most experienced!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Take that!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Whew, perfect victory!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A very successful operation.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: If we worked a bit harder, we could have done better.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I... I'm still not strong enough...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: At your service.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, would you like to dine with me tonight?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year! There's so much good food, plus the party tonight; this is bliss... Back home, our evening supper depended on how much we could catch that day. So we'd be out hunting before sunrise, just to celebrate the New Year. It really wore you out...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Morning, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, I heard it was your birthday. I have some beast jerky from home, please, help yourself to some if you don't mind. The people back home loved it, which is what made them all so strong! Happy birthday, and I wish you another year of good health!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: It's been a while since I came to Rhodes Island, and I'm so grateful to everyone for helping me get settled in with life here. I don't freak out whenever an automatic door opens anymo—ah! Doctor, I think a burdenbeast-looking robot just passed by...

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, archiving and categorizing documents is my specialty. Rest assured, I will put the files you need precisely where you want them.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Eek—It's okay, Doctor. I got a papercut, that's all. Please don't worry. It's not bleeding anymore. Pepe used to tease me for getting hurt without even going outsi—Agh! It's okay. The coffee scalded me, that's all.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: This? It's only a notebook for my work at the museum. It's mostly meeting minutes and exhibition schedules, nothing really interesting... But there are some silly mementoes. Like this photo here. It's a little bird that often stops by my window.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I still remember how Pepe and Titi would come by and play with me when we were kids. Even when Father had me grounded in the study, they'd stand outside the window and make animals with their hands. They were so animated… We haven't seen each other so much since we grew up. But when I look out my window, I sometimes think of those times.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, truth be told, I've spent most of my life following Father's plans, from my education to my career. He did pick a path that's been fairly easy for me. So I have nothing to complain about, and the idea of leaving home never truly crossed my mind. If I had made my own choices, what would life be like?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, there are two kinds of fowlbeasts. One soars through the skies, roaming freely. The other, with its shorter wings, dwells in the woods, catching only glimpses of the blue sky through the leaves as it enjoys the shade. Which one am I? Hm... In truth, I don't wish to be a fowlbeast at all. I would rather be a tree that doesn't block the sky.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Oh, Doctor, you're here today, too? Me? I visit the Medical Department once a week to spend time with the children. I tell them stories, or simply chat with them. They're so young, confined to their sickrooms... I know how they feel... truly.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: When I was little, if I misbehaved, Father would confine me to the study for an entire day. In those moments of boredom, I would take all the books off the shelves and reorder them in different ways, again and again. Reflecting on it now, it seems I was perhaps fated to pursue archival science.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My favorite exhibit? I couldn't choose. What does my heart say? Hmm... Okay... There is an ancient seed. It was sealed away in darkness for centuries, yet it persevered and quickly blossomed with just a little care. Ahh... Truly an inspiring miracle.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, it's dry here in the office. Don't forget to hydrate.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Pepe told me that once I'm ready to leave my office and go on a journey, I should come here and ask for a Doctor... She didn't specify a Doctor in which field, just that I'd know as soon as I saw the right one.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: My hypothesis was correct… There is so much I can learn only by stepping out of the office.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I am only doing my job. It's nothing worth mentioning.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thank you very much for your recognition of my work. Father would likely hold these ribbons and medals in high esteem. Me... I don't think they matter as much as your approval.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I've made a complete, thorough plan for the mission. I'm ready to sortie at any time.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Everyone, I'll be leading this one. Please follow the operation manual I distributed, and stay safe.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Perhaps I should bring an extra notebook. There may be lots of things out there worth documenting.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Don't worry. I have anticipated the enemy's plans and written them down in detail.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Wait, please! I-I still need a bit more time…

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Phew... I-I'm ready. Please let me give it a try!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: From here, I should be able to cover everyone, right?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I really hope nothing goes wrong.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Don't panic. I have everything I need to know in my notebook.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Um, which page did I put my notes in...?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Oh no… I can't find it anywhere…

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Ahhh! I'll just improvise!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Thank goodness everyone's alright... Your quick thinking was the key, Doctor!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: How wonderful. The operation went according to plan.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: If only I had planned for more variables. I'll definitely reflect this in my notes!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Our plan has failed. Please give the order to retreat, Doctor!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Doctor, please let me explain! I didn't bring all these books here for leisure! I just prefer to rest my head on a stack of books during lunch. Like so. It's surprisingly comfy…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hnngh! D-Don't tease me like that…

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, could you please pinch my ear? When I get anxious... my friends comfort me like that.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: When we celebrated the New Year Festival at home, Father would always have the entire day planned. We'd visit family and friends, attend parties and banquets. It was all so overwhelming. This year, I hope to relax a bit more… Maybe... play an extra thirty minutes tonight?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, when will your next trip be? Would you mind if I went with you?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Please stay still, Doctor. You could get pricked. The museum makes these brooches custom for our VIPs. If… hypothetically, you're willing to visit the museum… I could be your guide. Oh? Today? O-Of course. I took the day off, so I'm totally free.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, after visiting so many places with you, I've come to realize that the true destination of every journey is also its beginning. We may wander far and wide, but we always return to where we started, to reunite with those from whom we parted. And then, we wait... until the next journey.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Listen to me, Doctor, it's for your own good.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: How do you like this fragrance? You feel refreshed, right? It's all thanks to Melantha. Her samples inspired me.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Thank you for building me that flower greenhouse. It'll be a good place for our people to rest and ease their minds.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Oh, you're up? Try stretching, see if you got all the tiredness out. Nice. I put a lot into this new fragrance. Glad it works.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Narcissus, rabbitear iris, kalanchoe, boronia... I always carry all sorts of flower seeds on me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Oh, you mean this little one? She's still young, but she's been a big help with my fragrances.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I've heard that scents are the foundation of ant society. The relationship between perfumers and their clients is the same.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You seem to visit the greenhouse a lot these days. Oh, there's some pollen on your sleeve. Let me wipe it for you… Alright, you're good.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You were asleep for quite a while. What did you dream about, I wonder?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor? Doctor...? Wow, the lavender was much more effective than I expected…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor. I'm Lena, the perfumer. Interesting job, right? Have you heard the word before?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Please take a look and tell me how I did.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion...? You came to tell me in person? I'm flattered. Oh, just a moment, Doctor… There we go, your collar was wrinkled, so I smoothed it out for you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I don't appreciate violence as a tactic... But I'll do my best to get used to it for Rhodes Island, Doctor.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: With pleasure.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Whether you need me as a perfumer or a healer, I won't let you down, Doctor.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Do be careful, everyone.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: What kind of battle will it end up being, I wonder…?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Yes?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: That's fine with me.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: So this is a battlefield…

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I won't be afraid.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Let fragrance revive your mind.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Come on, chin up!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: How do you like this scent?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Stay calm, my friends.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I always knew we'd win, Doctor, so long as you're the one in command.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Very well done, Doctor.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Good job, everyone. Go get some rest.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: It's too bad we didn't win, but I won't let it discourage me.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I always feel best when I'm at your side, Doctor.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I sense… a pleasant smell from you, Doctor

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I'll just put all the New Year's plants right here, if you're fine with that? They might only bloom for four days, but so long as I'm around, your office will be filled with color and fragrance no matter the season.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Perfect timing, Doctor. I was just about to go look for you. Come take a seat, I have a special aromatherapy and dessert prepared. Go on, take a deep breath and relax. Just for today, this greenhouse's flowers bloom only for you. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I admit I have had a lot of regrets about leaving home. But now I run this little garden on Rhodes Island. This job has its own blessings, filling everyone's lives with wonderful fragrance. You know, Doctor, there's a saying in Minos: 'When a flower leaves its branch, it is embracing the whole land.'

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'm not good at this stuff either. Huh? They need it done today? Eh... Fine, I told you I'd help. I keep my word. Give it here. I'll take half, but you gotta finish the rest on your own!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Got any salt on you, Doc? Here, gimme some. I made potatoes. They taste so good when you sprinkle salt on them! We eat them like this a lot when we're out on a job! I roasted some fruit, too. Take it to W and Ines... Don't tell them it's from me! Got it?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I heard I might run into W here? Seriously? She and Ines saved me a while back, and I'm thankful for it, but she can be real annoying sometimes... Doc, I'm surprised you had the guts to hire her.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Manfred, that jackass! He actually did it! And he was serious about it, too! I totally thought I was going to die... Ugh, I know he's got his reasons... but I still can't let it slide! I've got a grudge!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: You were leading the squad then, right? Hmph, how could I forget? You gave me a real bad time! But if I had to do it again, I'd still choose to take everybody and bug out... I don't want to have to watch somebody sacrifice themselves ever again.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Is rebuilding Kazdel really a good idea? I don't know. All I know is I care more about the people around me—my squadmates, everyone from Rhodes Island... of course, that includes you, Doctor! We're buddies now, right?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: If Kazdel really gets rebuilt, does that really mean us Sarkaz all get to come back and reunite together? What will the Victorian rebels think of us? I can't see how this all ends... I don't know...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doc! Is the mail in? Anything for me? Thing is, I was raised by my nana in a small town in Columbia, and we still write to each other! I'm always telling everyone here to write home more often, but for some reason they get pretty upset about it. I wonder why.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: C'mere, Doc. Try this on! Hm... Looks great on you. My nana knitted it for you! It matches mine, too! How's it feel? Comfy and warm, right? I told Nana all about you, and she called you a good egg!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: So bored... Maybe I should knit something. What do you think of this little pouch? It's very practical!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hey there! Starting today, my squad and I are at your beck and call, Doctor. Call me Paprika. You seem like a solid employer, but you're still on probation! I've got my eye on you!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Are these the ancient Sarkaz tricks the old folks talk about?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Awesome, I finally got promoted! Hehe, you said you'd let me lead my own squad after my promotion. You're a doctor of your word, aren't you?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor! You're a mighty fine employer! Amiya looks real dependable, too. There's no going wrong, hitching my wagon to you. If you've got any more high-paying gigs, be sure to give me a holler!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Hehe, you picked the right girl for the job!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Just leave it to me! I've got some experience leading a squad.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Stay safe and keep in contact. Remember, the mission comes second. Your lives come first!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Let's clear the place in one fell swoop!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Don't worry. I've been standing by here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I don't pick fights I can't win.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Not one of you is getting away!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Don't get careless just because I'm here!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Everyone hanging in there?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Get behind me, if you feel yourself slipping!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: We can't have any more casualties...

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You bastards... Scram! I'm busy here!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: You're pretty amazing, coming up with a strategy like that... I gotta say, you're a lot better than W just lobbing bombs at everything.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Awesome, smooth like butter! Hehe, I didn't need any backup that time. Let's see what W and Ines have to say!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: A few footmen slipped past us, but that's no big deal, right? Yep, everyone made it out of the fight alive. I call that a big win!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: N-No way... Doctor, you aren't trying to hold the line here, are you? C'mon, quit spacing out. Hurry up and run!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Rhodes Island really treats us well... Oh, don't be so humble. This is much better than the dump we used to live in!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Whoa! What's up?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: This poncho feels great, right? Nana knitted it for me. It's so warm.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year! I didn't expect such a crowd celebrating the new year together. It's so much fun hearing all the New Year's wishes! Doc, what's your wish this year? Me, I'm wishing for Nana to stay safe... Oh no, if I tell someone, the wish won't come true, right? Forget what I just said, instantly!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey, Doc. What kind of missions do we have today? Oh, right. Let me get this out of the way. I'm not taking anything too crazy!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Hey Doctor, guess what day it is? …You don't remember? It's your birthday! How could you forget your own birthday! Huh? You were pulling my leg? And you know I've prepared a present...? What?!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: A great employer like Rhodes Island is hard to find. Our partnership has been wonderful! I never thought I'd see a day like this when you guys first beat us back in Londinium... We're gonna keep this up for a very, very long time. Right, Doc?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Let's see what goodies the Doctor hides in this drawer.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I'm probably only about as big as one of Papa's legs right now. But one day, I'm gonna be as big as him, and then I'll trample all over the bad guys! Graaagh!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I'm really, really sorry! I won't run in the hallways ever again!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Fighting is super easy. I point my shield one way, and nobody can beat me. Huh? What if they get behind me? Ohyeaah... I never thought of that!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Gavial? Never heard of her. She's tough? She's famous in Sargon? Okay, whatever. I'll see for myself how tough she is.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Oh, you're talking about Gavial? I'm Gavial's number one fan. See, she even signed my shield for me. That's her autograph! I think pretty much nobody could take down Gavial, besides Papa.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, shhh, tell me the truth. Kay says Vulcan can hammer straight through the floor, can she? No? Phew... Hehe. I knew it. That means my Papa is definitely stronger. He could bust down a Rhodes smoke stack with one punch.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Do I really have to write it in the notebook...? Fine... 'I knocked over Lancet-2 today. I won't do it again.'

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: This is my shield. It'll be one of my greaves someday, or maybe a pauldron. Then as long as I'm standing behind you, hehe, nobody'll ever bully you.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, wake up! Someone's here to see you.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: You're the boss of this training camp? And they call you the Doctor? Hrmmmm... But you don't look strong... Whatever. I'm Bubble. I may be the weakest in my tribe right now, but you're gonna train me until I'm the second strongest.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Fight! Fight! Fiiiiiight! What, why'd they stop. Is it over?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A reward for my training? Great! I can't eat it? Grrr...

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I think I got a good chance of beating Kay now! Okay, lemme at her. Doctor, you can come watch!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Be good? I'll try.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll count down and we charge on one, okay?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Chaaarge!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Waaar!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I got this.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Haha!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Get the bad guys!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Shield up!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Traaaaaample!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Baaaaash!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Spike striiiike!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Bam!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, if you got your body as strong as your brain, you could be an awesome warrior like my Papa!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: What did I tell you? I'm super strong.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Huh? Some of them got away? Did I let them through?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We can't beat them! Whatdowedo?! Whatdowedo?!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I need a way, waaay bigger room. How can anyone live in a little place like this?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hey, that tickles.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, let's play hide-and-seek!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It's New Year's! We got the day off! No homework! That means it's time to challenge Kay! Doctor, you can't just sit there all day. Why don't you come wrestle with us? It'll be fun!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Oh, this means you've grown a whole extra year! When am I gonna get as big as you?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I have to train hard at Rhodes Island! First, I'm gonna get tougher than Kay, then I'll beat Gavial, until I finally outdo Vulcan! Then I can go back home and be a warrior as great as Papa...! Doctor, are you gonna miss me when I'm gone?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You would have me as your assistant? Well, if the said duty is akin to my last, where I served within the Hall of the Twelve Heroes as its priest, I shall be fine, I assume.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Ugh... Uh… Ehem… I must not drink so much... next time… Ah, Dr.{@nickname}. Why do you stagger and sway, so much in your movement today?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The city is a grand sight during the festivals. Theatrical performances, sparkling wine, sports competitions... Truth be told, I once joined Formula Chariot racing, competing with my equally unskilled fellows. That chariot was not cheap. I wonder if its fate was inheritance, or if it was simply abandoned after I left?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: To think there were so many like-minded souls at Rhodes Island. Ah, poetry, war, freedom! From within the torrent of history, you summon the strength of many to rebel against fate, and undo its blight upon the lands. How exhilarating! These tragic yet extraordinary stories… They should be immortalized, and passed down forevermore.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: After contracting Oripathy, I moved to a small village in the Minoan borderlands. There was a small ongoing war against the Sargon incursions... which ended with the victory of the Minoans. However, I would prefer this story to gradually spread as a tale, rather than live in its so-called reality.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Simply light the flames of resistance, and they shall burn hot and fierce. For those whose wishes for liberation are so dear, the story of the 'Goddess of War' shall be their flag, a banner under which they will unite in the forthcoming battles. For me, I have naught but this infected body of mine, and this unchanging faith.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I see... Vulcan, once the champion of weapon forging, is here at Rhodes Island. That is great news indeed! This weapon in my hand has confounded many a smith. But none could restore it to its rightful condition. Here, look upon this signature, that of the very same Vulcan... Hm? I ought to keep it a secret?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The stories of Minoan heroes… They include both comedy and tragedy alike. However, the noblest aspect of the Twelve Heroes is that——Without exception, each and every one of them returned to a simple, ordinary life.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: To suffer oppression for such a length of time, that their souls have grown numb to it… My heart goes out to those poor souls. Still, a heart without hope cannot burn with the fires of rage. I would never wish for anyone to face cruelty, but if a man is to be a warrior, then he needs a bit of faith, a little spark, and most importantly— a 'start.'

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I am used to thinking while standing upright. From time to time, I am suddenly poked, simply to check if I have fallen asleep on my feet.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am the Minoan priestess, Pallas. I shall be convalescing at Rhodes Island for a time... Be that as it may, I hope to enjoy my share of alcohol and theatre, and I yearn even more for battle.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Recording the valiant warriors in battle, and with such realism. What a great convenience it is.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Abandoning glory, the hero decided to return to normal life, but could not, due to Oripathy infection? No… It should not be so.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I, Pallas of Minos, am a woman of faith, a follower of the will of the heroes. My weapon shall remain ever sharp and free of rust, such that it may strike at the forces of injustice and cruelty. My humility shall not be forgotten, an eternal expression of my duty to salvation and redemption.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: O heroic heralds of victory, I welcome your blessings.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: O great warriors, I fight by your side, shoulder to shoulder.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The next time you turn your head, you will find us returning, with victory in hand.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Fear not, for we shall claim victory over these reckless foes.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Rejoice!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Come—

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: There is no room for regret.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: There is no need to retreat.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: O heroes, stand together with us, for the paramount power of faith!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Tremble, in the face of ture bravey.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Weep, for that wavering faith of yours.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You shall kneel here.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Have we done it...? I feel only the greatest honor and joy.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Turn about, brave champions. We have achieved a perfect victory, and it is now time to return and enjoy the fruits of our labors.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Listen well, the lamentations have ceased. This calm heralds the arrival of peace and joy.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Even though the wars of humanity have no end in sight, we have protected our dignity, for the moment. Leave. Keep your heads held high.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: My horns might pose a threat to furniture. I shall be vigilant.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What would you do, should you possess wisdom and strength?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: There is a Minoan-themed multimedia room event. Shall we go and see what thrills await?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: A happy new year to you, Dr.{@nickname}. I have dined upon many delicacies of the East today, and experienced a uniquely different kind of celebration. I have even obtained many fun prizes, such as this... Oh? This 'firecracker', it is not to be used indoors?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Are you rested, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Congratulations on the day of your birth, Dr.{@nickname}. This wreath, a symbol of honor and victory, is a gift for you. On your road ahead, may you always journey alongside wisdom and courage. The glory befitting a hero, it's sure to be awaiting you at the end of the thorny path.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: A boisterous celebration is always exciting no matter the venue. Sing! Rejoice! Let us engrave this moment's animated air into our mirth, and we ought to open our vision for tomorrow with some fine wine— What? I should limit my drinking, even on such a day as this...?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Induct yourself an adjutant, one you can trust, and secretarial busywork will never hound you again. Between ourselves, that's an industry secret. Steady, Doctor, I would be loath to suggest you induct me...!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Hip-hip to Rhodes Island's young generation. They can fight and they can imbibe, my goodness. But youth's folly is ignorance, you see: they don't know all's fair in love and war, they never caught me diluting my drink! Bah-hah-hah-hah-, my head... Doctor, if you'd hurry. Fetch me a sobering physic.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Hah, what talent General Hellagur's girl possesses! I'd gladly have the youths here make a friend of her sometime. All the while my daughter plays the contrarian, but she at least heeds her father's wise words. Hm? To speak of which, Doctor, that letter you're holding... Excuse me? Incorrect address? Returned to sender?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Good girl, no fear, just a little more... Doctor! Yes, like that, stroke the girl on the neck there, softly, gently, let her know you're there for her, you love her... well done, girl, now push! I see the child coming! It's a stupendous little burdenbeast lad!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Will! Charles! Funny business, they've vanished. What? They're off playing drinking games again? They had the nerve not to invite me...?! So be it, let them drink. All the years they've been company to me, the old fellows, and what have they gained? A riddling of scars and chronic pains, too pernicious for me to cure. How can I blame them, now they've so little but tipple for pastime.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: War stories? No, no, no, a richness of topics I could be your partner in. Why one of such sensitive dearth? I've said my piece on it—the battlefield lingers in your Sunday lapel like a bad odor, and never comes clean even should you change your suit. No, what say we talk of something else, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I've partaken of fine foods across the land, but in my lowly opinion, only in the bosom of hometown, amidst the throng of locals, can you taste the most essential delicacy. This fondue tells such a tale. You'd like a travel guide from me? Hah-hah, very well, as you wish. To be asked for a work so dear to my passions is my honor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You have a most vorpal gaze to recognize this pipe's Gaulish make. It was seized by my father's commander in the Battle of the Four Emperors, a spoil accorded to my father, then—bless his resting soul—it was handed down to me. Some decades it's spent crossing the fields of war. You'll even note the lost segment along the shank, much as I've lost a leg.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Hush, Doctor. We shouldn't forget that I'm an officer to Victoria when all is said and done. Befriend me you may, and depend on me, but never should you drop your guard, nor tell me too much. Should the worst come to pass, it would spell the end of our continued association... and with my age, I'd fold under the regret.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Don't watch your health now, and you'll certainly curse yourself when you're old.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Here I thought they'd finally given me hard labor on the borders, and yet... I wonder if the Empire's deigning to smile on me? Oh, where are my manners? You, then, should be my commanding officer from hereon? I render you my services as a plain medical officer.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Combat that would emphasize the individual's strengths... What revelation.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Could it be? Is this in recognition of my surgeon's abilities? This means far more to me than a higher title ever could.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I feel I could return home and open a practice right this instant. In fact, I plan to be off on the morrow. Hoh-hoh, yes, I'm pulling your leg. I tell you, I could have found no greater place than here to retire.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Me? Surely I'm not about to be an accomplice in your sunbathing schemes?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Attention, good fellows. Your only obliged consideration is how you survive. Agreed?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Good fellows, let us think of happier things. If I may: how about something nice to eat after this operation?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Be a little courteous to our guests, boys and girls.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: At your service.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I trust your plans are drawn.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Great minds think alike.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: What fine scenery. A shame about the fighting.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Fall in! I hereby command!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: No soldier may cower in the field!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: All casualties, retreat! All others, cover!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I say this once, protect your own lives first! I'll bear the onus!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Outstanding peace talks! As I always say—bloodshed can spoil anything. Best we remain amicable.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I see I'm deprived of a chance to practice my surgery! A marvelous regret to have.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: You say I've 'held back', do you? Hah-hah-hah, piffle! Don't you worry.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: To admit our own defeat is a form of virtue.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Mm-hrmm. Doctor, your tastes are... comparatively maverick.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh? Are you angling to swipe my cane?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Oh, Doctor! Would you care to take a stroll with me?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Goodness, how saintly is our Doctor that you would worry I be devoid of companionship, let alone ask after me? Hah-hah-hah, but a Happy New Year. Yes, lest I forget, my family chances to trip to Rhodes Island in a couple of days, and I'd be remiss to not personally invite you to our household dinner.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Tally-ho, Doctor. Your presence suggests today will be a fine day indeed.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: *sigh* Every soul that celebrates a birthday reminds me that while my girl was young, war had me miss several of her own special occasions—and as is the case, she came not to care if I would be there or not. But I apologize—you tend to reminisce at the drop of a hat when you're my age. How many slices should we cut this cake into?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Being of two different stations, some things I can't tell you, nor could you I. But there is one point we needn't doubt—we both are fed up with war. I imagine that's more than enough reason we might sit down together, open and honest, and share a drink.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, I'm your guard for the day! Don't worry, I won't let any sketchy people near you! Just relax!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: My training score for today...? Um, I mean, we could talk about something else...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I can't shake the pre-battle jitters, and that makes Captain Fang really nervous too... What should I do? Doctor!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Hibiscus and Lava always complain to me about each other, but both of them are my good friends, and neither of them are wrong... Doctor, what should I do?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Instructor Dobermann always told us, 'Even when after you finish your training, your number one goal on the battlefield is to stay alive.' Urgh... How can I become as strong and awesome as she is?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I'm still a rookie Operator, but I'm working hard! Hehehe, I'd really love a compliment or two, if you agree.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My Oripathy? It doesn't bother me all that much, I'm used to it. I just want to be with the people I care about until my disease gets cured... Ughh...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I didn't have much confidence before I came here, but I'm so glad that I can protect you and everyone on Rhodes Island! It's my dream to protect everyone! I really wish days like these could last forever.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Aww... seeing the Doctor sleeping all vulnerable like that makes me want to doodle something on a certain someone's face...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: My codename is Beagle! I know I didn't do very well on my assessment, but I'll still do my best at my internship!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I did it! I've become stronger!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Finally, FINALLY! Now nobody's going to call me 'the Rookiest Rookie in the Rookieverse' anymore!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'll do all I can!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Huh? I am the leader? I don't feel right about Fang not being the leader...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Everyone, let's roll out!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Everyone, enemies incoming!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Grant me strength!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Is it my turn?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Target location reached!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: This is the place!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Haah!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Watch this!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: It's my duty to protect everyone! My resolve will never falter, no matter the odds!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: All enemies have been defeated! We Rhodes Island Operators are the finest!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Hooray, we won! Although a few enemies managed to get away... *sigh*...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'm sorry... so sorry...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What can I do for you?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Doctor! Th-That tickles!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, can I come to your place to study every day?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, Happy New Year! Today's a day off, right? So that should mean we don't have to go to training... But just a minute ago, I saw Instructor Dobermann and a bunch of other operators at the training grounds. Maybe that means I should go too...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hi, Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: D-Doctor, happy birthday! Huh? I—I'm not nervous, not at all. We got you a birthday present, so can you come visit the dorms real quick? But you'll want to be careful! And please don't tell Kroos I was the one who warned you!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I think—what scares me more than Oripathy is the idea of separating from my friends. I love being here at Rhodes Island with everyone, and making a bunch of new friends too! As long as I keep doing what I can to get stronger, I'll be able to protect them all!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
