voices.text: Doctor, you'll be working hard today? Then, I'll stay with you. If you slack off, then I'll use this staff... Like this... and give you a smack on the head. Bonk, bonk.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Beeswax, Beeswax, Beeswax... Mm, okay. I should get used to it after reading it a few more times. Oh, Doctor, do you need something? I'm just trying to get used to hearing my code name... so I don't fail to react and get made fun of when others call me.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: This bug... Midnight seemed very scared of it and jumped up into the air as soon as he saw it, so I helped him catch it. But, where should we put it now... Um, Doctor, why are you backing away?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: My clothes are a bit big, so I feel at ease when they drape over my body. I like that sensation. But, sometimes, I'll accidentally step on them—Uu, uwah, ahh...! ...Fweh, I tripped again... Ow…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The new piece the Folk Song Association put out this month is my new favorite song. Oh, you've never heard of them before, Doctor? The full name is the Folk Song and Originium Arts Research Association... Still haven't heard about it? What about the Electro-music Arts Alliance? How about the Rap and Folk Joint Vantage? Haven't heard of any of them?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The mark on my head? Ah... this is a ceremonial emblem passed down from generation to generation in my tribe, and it is a symbol of our Golden Gods' blessings on our tribe and our people. The faceless gods will protect us, no matter where we go, whether or not we remember them...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Leaving the tribe and traveling to other cities and countries is a rite of passage for all our tribespeople. Only by completing it can one become a fully-fledged adult like my sister. Um, Doctor, you believe I can handle it, don't you?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Hehe, my horns are big and pretty, right? There aren't many people in the tribe who can boast horns like mine! The secret to maintaining them is to apply essential oils once a day, gently massage them with a soft brush—W-Wait, Doctor, I haven't finished today's routine yet, even you can't just touch them like that!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, please come here. Mm, okay, close your eyes, and let me touch your forehead. The scorching sun, the raging storm, and waves of golden sand washing across the desert. The gods set foot upon the land where we were nurtured, and bestowed our tribe with their blessings. Now, I will share this blessing with you, Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Zz... zzz... Sister... you dummy... zzz... mm... H-Huh, Doctor? I fell asleep...? Sleeptalking? Did I say something?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hmm... Wah, excuse me, I let my mind wander. Hello, Doctor, I am, my code name is... Umm... Ah, I remember! It's Beeswax. Do you like it? My tribe helped pick it for me.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hm...? I have to watch all of this?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion? Mm... I don't quite understand.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, perhaps the path that lies ahead for Rhodes Island is destined to be long and treacherous, but please remember, the gods' decrees and my blessings... will always be with you.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Umm... where are we going this time?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm the leader...? Even though I'm not sure how you select your team leaders, I'll try my best.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Well then, let's go.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Someone's over there. Everyone, please be careful.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Yes, I'm here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: How can I help?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Over here? Leave it to me.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: The land beneath my feet is the domain of the gods.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Devour them.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Crush them.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Sleep beneath the golden sands.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: This is the blessing of the gods.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: May they also receive the blessing of the gods…

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Phew... It's over. Doctor, was I able to be of use?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Ooh, they got away! Mm... but I guess that's fine?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We can't do this anymore, Doctor. I'll hold the enemies back, so please escape!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What a spotless room... It'd be troublesome if I accidentally spilled sand over it, right?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: W-Woah... I stepped on my clothes again…

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Ah, Doctor, please look at this! I caught another bug!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Wepet renpet neferet, Doctor. It's an important day, so the first thing I did was a little horn care. Now my friends can come touch them... Oh, touching my horns, you can't feel how well I've kept them? Hm, that's okay. You don't have horns. I don't blame you.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, I've been waiting.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: It's your birthday today, Doctor? Okay. Let me give you my blessing. Please close your eyes and imagine an endless desert. In the desert, a priest knocks the staff on the ground. The sound signifies the gods' blessings are drawing near, and each step kicks up a sandstorm... Huh? Why did you start coughing?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Even now, I still haven't figured out what my sister is up to. But having traveled with Rhodes Island for so long, I've seen lots of sights like the ones in the magazines, but with my own eyes. When I go back to my people, I'll probably see more clearly the blessings of the gods.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Boss, let's go grab a bite. On you this time. What? You bought last time? Doesn't sound right to me.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Use my head to win fights? Hmm… Hmm… Pummel them until I win, train harder if I lose. That's using your head!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Honey's sweet, but getting it hurts. I went for some the other day… They really give me a hard lesson.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: My knuckles? Haha~ They're my precious babies. Wouldn't have racked up all those wins without 'em!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: There's more rules in the underground fight scene than you might think. Plenty of gopniks dove in before they had 'em figured out. They usually ended up dead.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Oripathy? Who cares? Infected, Uninfected... They're all the same after I knock their lights out.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: What? The fin in the kitchen? Hah! Right here in my belly now!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My book of names here? Ah, looks like that big brain of yours doesn't know everything. Gotta meet people to fight people, right? I don't want to run out of enemies.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The only reason I joined the underground fight is 'cause I didn't have two kopecks to rub together. But here on Rhodes Island I got that load off my mind. It's all thanks to you, Boss!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Smells like grilled fish!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Yo! Boss, you know a winner when you see her! Now, put your hands together for the strongest underground fighter out there. The one! The only! BEEEEEEEE-HUNTERRRRRR!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I really don't wanna study. Send me out to fight already!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Hah hah hah! Somebody likes me a lot!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Hah! After this promotion, ain't no way I'm gonna let you down! Lemme show you what I can do in a fight, Boss!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Here I come!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Chow's on me after we win this one!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Relax, Boss. Ain't nobody can go three rounds with me!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: So you're the ones looking for a beatdown. You guys?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What's up?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Ready?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Gimme the bell!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Let's do this.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Eat this!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Get over here!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: One-two, one-two, one-two!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: C'mon, c'mon! Bring it on!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: The stronger the matchup, the more pumped I get!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: K.O.! Check it out, Boss. See 'em all piled up there?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: That's a wrap. Let's head back and chow down!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Ouch… Where's the Boss? Is the Boss okay?!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This room's a lot better than any I had before!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You brought food? You're the best, Boss!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Hey, hey, hey! There you are, boss! I was just out having some honey with the others! Man, it's nice to have a stable income. Now I can buy as much honey as I want. Sure beats gathering it myself, with all the stinging... You're the best, boss!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: What's up, Boss.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Honey-grilled fins! I just came up with the recipe a few days ago, and it's sure to be a blast! Same goes for fin jerky with honey. Why aren't I sharing any then? I couldn't hold myself back and ate it all last night.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The way Rhodes Island fights is different from what I'm used to, but that doesn't bother me one bit! And I only learned after coming here how many people look down on the Infected. But don't worry! Me and my fist will change their minds!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Want my help? Hehe, I'll think about it if you give my buddies three days of luxury pet food! How about it, sounds like a deal, isn't... Hey, wait up! I'm just kidding! Don't go!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Outta the way, outta the way~ Beanstalk Breeding Center coming right through! Watch your feet! Careful not to step on any of us~

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor! Click is here at Rhodes Island? I can't believe you haven't ever told me! I'm a huge fan of her outdoorsy videos! She called Pea cute, and she even said she'll bring Pea along the next time she goes on a shoot!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: There's been all these morons saying they'd go mining and then dug up a bunch of holes out in the wilderness. Fine, but how dare they make a mess of everyone's home! If I ever catch those bastards, I'm blowing a hole in their asses with my crossbow!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, I'm done with my breeding proposal. Take a look, will ya? Huh? The budget doesn't add up...? Tsk, he found out, huh? Oh, my bad! I probably got the numbers messed up somewhere! I'll get it fixed right away~

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Before I came to Rhodes Island, I sent my resume to so many companies out there, and they all turned me down. Well, just look at how helpful my little buddies are now, both in the battlefield and in logistics. Those big shots only have themselves to blame. It's their loss!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You see, Pea may be the smallest of the Metal Crabs I brought with me, but she's also the brightest of the bunch! She's gonna be so amazing in the future~! My little buddies are nothing like the normal Metal Crabs out there. They're so smart! They won't be controlled by anyone out there so easily!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: 1, 2! 1, 2! Line up! Defense position, and block! Okay! All of you are doing amazing! Here's your reward. Eat up~! Let's switch it up now. Attac—Whoa, Doctor, how long've you been here? How come you're always so quiet when you walk?!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My old man doesn't really support me raising my little pals. He says they're useless, and that I'd be better off raising burdenbeasts. Hmph, I'm show him. I'll make it big with my buddies, and we'll see if he has anything to say then! Hey, Doctor, have you ever thought of investing in me? I guarantee you you'll be raking in lots of money!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Alright, focus! Doctor, you can't just space out while you're working. Take a look at what a good girl Pea is. Be more like her.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. My name's Beanstalk. Starting today, I'll be... Eh? What's in my case? Oh, this is Peacake. Here, Pea, say hi to the Doctor.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Aha! That was awesome! Did you see that, Pea?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Ehe, you're promoting us because of how well we did in the last operation, right?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, thanks for giving me and my buddies a chance to prove ourselves! I'll cut the formalities. We'll get even more amazing than this! You're in for a surprise!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: It's our time to shine~

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Alright! Everyone, do what I say!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Team Beanstalk, here we go!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Huh? Are these who we're up against?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Here you are.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: All ready to go~

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Go! Show them what we've got!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Let's go!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Hehe, you can't hit me~

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Stop them!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I won't let you get past us!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You assholes! I won't let you hurt my buddies!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Hehe, you guys are no match for us~

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission complete~! How's that? My buddies did great, huh?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Oh, some of them got through! Wait here, Doctor. I'll go after them!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: *Sob*. It's okay, everyone. Don't cry. I'll beat those jackasses up next time!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I don't mind sleeping anywhere. Where's the breeding room, though?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Why'd you do that? Stop pulling my ribbon!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Hm? What's up? Wanna pet Pea?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. For my New Year's wish, I want the Beanstalk Breeding Company to get founded this year without a hitch! If you'll do me just the tiniest favor, then I'll work even harder when I'm on the clock!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Yo~ Whatcha doing, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Given our unusual friendship, I've decided to give you a very precious present. Ta-dah—a robust little metal crabling, choice selection of the Beanstalk Breeding Company! Isn't he just adorable? Shh! You can't let anyone else know, or they'll all be hounding me for their own!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island dinner parties never fail to impress! But when do we get to hold a pet show here? We can compete to see whose pets know the most tricks, or just find out who's most popular. You want them to fight? Are you crazy, Doctor?! You think way too violent!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Can I have this printer that's written off? And my gosh, how could you dump that whole pile of paper in the shredder? You can still write on the back!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Whoa whoa, Stay back. I just finished work, so I'm all sweaty. You need something? If it's not urgent, just go back to your office. Let me wash up and get a change of clothes, then I'll come talk to you.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Hahaha, Check me out! I made this whole outfit by myself. Yeah, it looks like crap, but it's sturdy! And you see this sickle?  I tore a door off a huge car to make it. I've used it for years, and it's good as new.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: See that electric cooker of mine? I made it out of an old heater. And my space heater there, I made it out of an old TV. And As for the TV here, I put that together from the parts of a broken bread maker. Where did I get this bread maker? Aha, I modded an electric cooker I scavenged.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The Pioneer guys are different from us. They get to wander around. Not us. Once you come to the disposal plant, you're staying forever.  Think you can run? Not happening, my friend. Look at your supplies, how far could you go? There's nothing but wasteland for miles. Your only shot at survival is staying inside.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: You have no idea how heartless those snobs are. They dump just about anyone in the disposal plant. Kids barely old enough to work, old folks in bad health. I can't stand it, but there's not much I can do other than making sure they get fed alongside me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, remember that printer I took off your hands? Here, I fixed it. Oh, but keep an eye on the thermometer up top when you use it. If it goes over the threshold, it could explode.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Yeah, Doctor, I've got a temper, and I can't just sit by and watch bad things happen. In the end, I made the wrong enemies, and got thrown in the disposal plant. A whole decade came and went in the blink of an eye, like a nightmare... But now the dream's gone, and I'm awake! I don't regret it one bit. I'll keep my temper and make no compromises.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Ever since we were kids, if folks like us wanted to eat, we had to count on the scraps the snobs let slip from on high. Sadly, that's not enough to fill your stomach. So some folks end up stealing, naturally. That's not something anyone should do, I know. But if there was another way, why would you need to steal?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Whatever it is, it can wait until tomorrow! There's unlimited steak at the canteen today, I'd better get over there right away!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor, Rhodes Island has done so much for me. What can I say except thank you? If you need anything, just say the word. I'll do whatever it takes to make it happen!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Doctor, I can read a little bit, but the jargon in this video is pretty dense. I can barely make any sense of it.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: What? You're giving me a promotion? Me? For real? Hold up, what was I doing before this?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thanks, Doctor... If only my old man had lived long enough to see this day. His kid... always up to no good... has finally made a name for himself.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Agh... It's been a while since I beat anyone up. Hope I didn't get too rusty.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Yeah, I can be the captain and chaperone these kids. I'll make sure all of them come back alive.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Stop right there, you little cubs! Don't just rush in ahead!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: You come at me like that, you can't blame me for what happens next.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Are you ready?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'm all set to go.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Huh? I thought you wanted me here to fix a lock!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Whose car is this? I... How should I know?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: A one-on-one? Tough guy, huh.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: What, you think you're gonna grind me down with numbers?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: There's more of you? Ugh, what a day.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Arghhhh screw it! Bring it on, all of you!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Ugh, I just hope these punks learned their lesson.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: No enemies in sight. But I'm sure they left behind some pretty good stuff.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: No, no, don't chase them. Just let them be. They got beaten so bad, they won't be causing trouble for a long while.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Relax, nobody wins every fight. Go home, wash your face. Life goes on.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Man, this bed is too soft. I just can't fall asleep. Could you give me something firmer? That's how I like it.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hm? Need some help? I'm your man.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Here, I grabbed you some tangerines from the canteen.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: When I first got to that stinking place, I didn't celebrate any holidays. That's for men who still got something to look forward to. But the kids kept pestering me, asking me to make them some fireworks. In the end, I burned the whole tent... Save it. Thinking back, I guess it was pretty funny, hahaha.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: No matter how busy you are, be sure to eat right, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: It's your birthday, huh...? *sigh* I didn't know, so I didn't get you anything. How about this? I'll treat you to a feast tomorrow. Whatever you want. But uh... try to not order anything too expensive.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I sorted through tons of trash at the disposal center, for years. You can use most things after a little cleaning. If cleaning isn't enough, you can probably still fix it. If that doesn't do the trick, you can disassemble it and use its parts. That goes for people too, don't you think? No one out there's completely useless.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: It's done. The battle plans, reports, and mission schedules have all been sorted... Eh... Is this not the right way? Sorry, I'm not used to this yet...

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Iwona and Ashlock can make quite a ruckus together. I can't hear the wind when they do that. It's a pain.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Hm? Who's that in the training grounds...? The Radiant Knight? Doctor, is it okay if I go check it out up close?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: It's really close. When I sit here and look outside, I can see the crops in the distant ripening as the farmers harvest their fields. It's just like my hometown.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: It's actually not very hard to become a knight in Kazimierz if you're healthy. All you have to do is sign up at the arena. But to become a real 'knight' is difficult. Real difficult, even for those who are healthy.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I agree with Sona's ideas, and I'm willing to fight for them... Though, I guess I might just be afraid of losing the one place where I belong. Doctor, do you also see Rhodes Island as a place you will protect no matter what it takes?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Thank you for treating us. Sona, Iwona, and Ashlock asked me to bring you these as thanks. And here's one that I picked. It's a small token of my appreciation.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I used to dream of becoming a knight, but on the way to the Grand Knight Territory, I got infected in an accident. I still remember how it felt. The numbness spread from my palm to my fingertips... That was the first time I couldn't hold my sword.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Here's a grass whistle... Want to listen to me use it? I used to whistle with it whenever I had some free time back home. The wind back then is not like it is now. It was clear as crystal, and it wasn't dangerous at all... It was calming.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Finally awake? Here, the files are sorted... Should be right this time, I think?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: 'Fartooth' Justyna, Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub. You can call me Fartooth. I've heard about Rhodes Island and you in particular, Doctor.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: They're going to lose. If they don't take a proper defense stance, they won't be able to block this one. You've got them.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Is that something like advancing to the next round?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: There's not much that I want, and I don't have much either. That's why... as long as I'm still standing here, nobody can hope to take anything from me!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: ...I'll do as you say. You are my commander, and I'll follow your orders.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: A team battle? Understood.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Ready. Line up... Sortie!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Wait, the winds have shifted... Everyone, stay alert!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Yeah, I'm ready whenever.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: One-on-one, or one-on-many?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I hope we can win this match fair and square.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I, 'Fartooth' Justyna, will be your opponent.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: The winds are stirring. I can tell.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I've locked onto you.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: There's no need to talk in battle.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Let's put an end to this... You can't beat me; accept your defeat.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: You've done well, Doctor. This is a glorious victory.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I fended them off just as you instructed... I'm being too solemn? Really...?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I won't attack those who leave the arena.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Go on ahead...! I'll hold them here, Doctor! Lead the others away!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Not bad. The airflow here feels refreshing... Thank you.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hm? What is it? Want an autograph?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor...? Yeah, I can tell it's you without listening to your footsteps. The winds around you aren't like the others.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: There are so many noises mixed in on the wind here. Fireworks, dishes and glasses, the voices of people as they celebrate. My neighbors would be just as noisy every holiday back home, but I've never minded it, because that's how this day should be. Happy New Year, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Don't move... Your hair's sticking out. That's right. Stay still. I'll fix it for you.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here, Doctor. This is your present from me. It's a chime. Hang it on your window, and it'll sing whenever the breeze stirs. Very soothing. Happy birthday, Doctor. I gift you the sound of the wind.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I brought this flute from home, and the only songs I play are ones my neighbors taught me. I know you can never return to the past, but that's not so bad, is it? Just like how the wind never blows back to where it came from. It carries itself on its own momentum, flying further and further away, to a loftier place.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'm keeping an eye on our surroundings. So far everything seems fine.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You should know that some of those eyes on you hold nothing but malice. You're not safe, not even at Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Don't be afraid of those hostiles hiding in the shadow. No matter how those criminals try to hide, they can't escape my eyes.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I'll have my revenge... even if I must lose my life for it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My clan, my friends, they all perished in the woods of our hometown... The only ones who mourned them were the trees, which gave unto them their leaves.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: This crossbow is manufactured for the sole purpose of punishing sinners. The day will come when I use it to pass my final judgement on those who deserve it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Meteorite... we used to be friends. On the day my hometown was destroyed, we were part of the small group that managed to escape.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Since then, I've never stopped searching for the traitor who led the rebel army to our town. Could it be Meteorite? No, I... It couldn't be her...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: ...Oh, did I fall asleep? Sorry, I've been spending more time patrolling these days... It's fine, you say? But... um, thank you for caring.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I'd like to take a nap...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Firewatch here. I'm a sniper. To avenge my fallen clan, I need all the power I can get.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I need more power...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thanks for appointing me to this position.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thank you for the promotion. I hope you'll keep using my powers for the right thing. If you don't, however...

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: The team is complete.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Got it.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: All Operators, get ready!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Enemies spotted. Taking action.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Understood.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Awaiting instructions.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Searching for enemies.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I am in position.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Laying suppressive fire.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Target locked.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Strike inbound.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Firing!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I'm not done until I have my revenge...

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: All targets eliminated. Mission complete.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission accomplished, request search for remaining hostiles.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Retreating... immediately...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I'm not used to being in a room with so many people...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh!?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Uh, please don't touch my antlers... it tickles...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: New Year's? It's noisy, but I remember days like this back in the forest. We used to sing around the campfire, give each other bracelets weaved from vines... Do you want to hear the songs of my homeland? I've never forgotten them.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Huh? Oh, it's you, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: You want to hear my harmonica? Fine. What are you in the mood for?… Calm and leisurely… Alright, here's a little tune called 'Greenleaves.'

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Today will be noisy. I think I'll find a quiet place to hide. Have fun with Meteorite and the others.

operators.name: ファイヤーホイッスル

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: With all this paper around, it's hard to resist the urge to start fires… Whoa, whoa, don't look at me like that, I'm just joshin', okay?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, our employees are all Billy natives who know the lay of the land. If any Rhodes operators are traveling to Rim Billiton and need an escort, come find us! We will offer you a fair price.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Why hire Infected when it's bad for business? Well, umm, because... Ah, come on, we all know how Oripathy's transmitted. All you need is proper protection and monitoring. Rhodes Island does the same, right? Ahaha…

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The right type of ammo can turn the tide of a battle', it's a line every artilleryman knows. So their bags are filled with grapeshot, flashbangs and tracers. 'Course, they always have trouble deciding which to use when the time comes. As for me, I just bring incendiaries. Use 'em right, and they replace any type of ammo you could need.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I hated it whenever anyone brought up my dad while I was in university. Are we on bad terms? Naw, he's not a bad dad, and I'm grateful to him. But I hate it when people look at me like a mining mogul's spoiled kid. I'm more than just my dad's daughter!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Dad wouldn't let me near fire, Mum didn't let me play with the miners' kids, my old boss told me not to poke my nose into business that isn't my own, and everyone told me not to be too nice to the Infected. I never listened to any of that. You decide what's right and wrong for yourself, and never get swept up if you need time to make a choice.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: That little firefighter always tenses up when she sees me, then points her hose right at me. Well, It's cute, sure, but that can't go on forever. The three of us should go for a drink sometime and clear up this misunderstanding. For the two of you, I'll make my special flaming cocktail.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I know I'm not great at business, but I also know how it feels to be helpless, relying on the kindness of others. It hurts, the company being in debt, but debtor's prison beats having to burn your own comrades to cinders.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I loved playing army when I was little, and I always dreamed of becoming a general. But Rim Billiton wasn't the place for that, so I had to settle for a private security firm... Now? Now I just want to keep my people warm and fed. My dream of becoming a general died the first time I saw someone get shot.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Yawn... I'm bored. Might as well build a grenade tower over here... Whoa?! You're awake? Er, these are blanks! Nah yeah, just blanks!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Thank you for choosing Firewhistle Security Services! My name is... huh? Codename? Umm, just call me Firewhistle. Yup, that's the key to raising brand awareness!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Nice strat. Would've been even better with some fire on that spot.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Thank you! If you've got any more security jobs for me and my people, that'd be even better. Hehe.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Working with Rhodes Island's seen my company turn a profit at last. I'm not paying my employees out of my own pocket anymore! Thank you so much, Doctor! You have all my appreciation and all my gratitude!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Firewhistle, at your service!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Captain? No problem, I'm used to running the show.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's go,everyone! I'll buy a round for us all when we're done.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Stay low. Wait 'till you see my fire.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Need some fire to turn up the heat?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Your orders please.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: In position and ready to light'em up.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Artilleryman in position!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Let's burn'em up!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: This one's for you!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Panicking just spreads the fire faster.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Load, fire!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Your plan actually worked! Sure wish I had a tactical genius like you on my payroll.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We should put out the fires before we call it a day. Wanna join me?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Leaving a smoldering ember is a good way to end up with a wildfire. Let's watch out for those.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'll cover our retreat. Don't worry, I've done this a bunch of times.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Rhodes Island's base is outfitted so much better than my little office.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hey, Wanna see some fireworks?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Here, I made this ornament out of a shell casing. Hehe, I'm really good at it, right?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Just a sec, I need to file my annual financials... alright! I hear you've got a lot of good Billy cooks at Rhodes Island. Why don't we go for a little tasting together?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: G'day, Doctor! Need a warm fire?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here, Doctor, rainbow candles for your birthday! Hey, what's that look on your face? The flames are as colorful as the candles. How about that?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I thought about asking my family for help when my company was in debt. I even went home once, but when they asked how I was doing and whether I needed money, I just said everything was fine. I don't regret it one bit, but everytime I think of the concern in their eyes, I still feel sorry.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: No need to look for me. I've always been here.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Those in the dark cannot show you the way, nor can they see where you point. Don't tarry here, it's time for you to leave...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Under this mask, even I do not recognize myself.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: This is Miss.Christine. I don't know where she came from, nor do I know when she will leave. If she likes you, she will approach you on her own... Yes, just as she's doing right now.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: In the past, I was not lonely. I once had several friends, and we traveled all over as a theatre troupe. But when Oripathy broke out, everything drew to a close, and everything began...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: This darkness is a refuge, a throne, and Paradise above all. The spirits of the dead have never left, and I've cursed the world from atop their bones... You see me as I am now. Do you still wish to hear my song? Do you still dare... to stand before me?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: This device embedded above my throat presses against my neck, but it is exactly what I need. Like a mask does, it conceals my sins and my voice. You'd like to hear my real voice? No, you can't. It isn't something you ought to bear...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My song ended all of their lives. It came, that endless night, the song that would not stop, the quivering falsetto and organ fragments that expelled from a throat—it horrified them, suffocated them, but it was so... miraculous. Doctor, tell me. What in the world is it... that I do?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I can end many lives for you, but I first need you to confirm that I am awake. Something is trying to influence me. It doesn't want me to leave the stage. It wants my song to echo forever... and it wants me to kill you. Before I play the role of your assassin once more, I must discover the truth.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: The shadows have never left your side, even without the night. Do be careful of your untimely somnolence, Doctor.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Code name, Phantom. The Phantom Behind the Curtain, Treasurer of the Night. Tell me, who are your enemies, and where do they hide?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Killing is not an end, but a means.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: As you wish. You are the one who sets Rhodes Island's tune, and you require neither guide nor guardian... Yes, I know all too well, you are your own master.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: There is no looking back after this step, no turning back. What I am about to share with you is not as wonderful as you may believe... Come, come here, and allow me to show you what lies beneath the veil of night.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Is it time for me to take the stage?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I am no stranger to giving guidance.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I'll do as you say...

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Let us raise the curtains on this play.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm with you.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: So, let us sink into the night.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I come from the shadows.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Hear my voice. Hear my song.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Do you see your own face in the mirror?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: The actors are all puppets of the script.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: The guilty... will be punished.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Yes, lift your voices! Sing for me! Sing for me!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Is this the victory your leadership has brought about...?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: It is over. Victory is not sweet, as conflict always leaves an aftertaste.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: They escaped. Fortunate for them... and perhaps for me as well.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Fall back... You've already lost your way.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Hm? Behind this mirror, there seems...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What is it?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: The sound of these footsteps... It's you, Doctor.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Is time's passage so worthy of celebration? Is it truly within our power to bid adieu to the past? It may be all too ironic that one like I, draped in misfortune, should wish you well... but as the New Year beckons, the shadows shall continue to keep to your back.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: The shadow behind you looks heavier than it was yesterday, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. If this desolate throat of mine could still sing, I would gladly devote a ballad to you for the occasion. It is my regret, then, that the opportunity is no more. Ah, Miss.Christine offers us a rose—it seems she, too, wishes you well on this special day.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: A role who deviates from the script cannot exist, nor may a shadow hide forever in the night. Rhodes Island—are you to be the stage I next take...? I only hope that this time, it is by your hands the curtains are brought down.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Stay sharp. Focus, finish your work. If everyone could just get their own work done, it might as well not help at all, but it's not going to make anything worse either. Lecturing? Who am I to lecture you, I'm just... reminding myself.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Whatever it is you want, it can wait until I get my hands on Mostima! It has to be that damn idiot who spiked my finballs with chili! Get to the side and make sure you stay there, this day's not done until I put a bolt in her—

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I tried using guns before, but it didn't pan out, so I gave up. What, are you surprised? Guns aren't some huge mystery, but they need practice... and maybe you practice until you're smooth, or you blow yourself up in a burst.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: If it's deemed necessary, taking measures to block intel leakage is part of my work. ...Hey, stop staring at my back! Those idiots at the Notarial stuck those wing stickers there, they're not coming off! *cough* Anyway, don't count on me telling you anything. Keeping secrets is my job.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Too much curiosity's never good. That goes for Lemuen's sister, and it goes for you too, Doctor. Am I worried about you? ...Hardly. I'm just tasked with making sure *someone* doesn't leak secrets or make trouble, and anything else is beyond my care.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I've been to plenty of nations before. It's not like nowhere moves me more than Laterano, but I'm all too clear about what I have to do right now. I've got no intent of letting anybody harm this city of Laterano. There's no more answers I need to seek from anyone.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: ...Don't call me 'Suffering.' And don't call me 'Chosen Overseer' or 'Flaming Envoy' either! That's it, no matter what that Mostima-on-low told you, I want you to forget all of it right now! Immediately! On the double!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Thanks to a certain *someone*, I couldn't be more familiar with all the food streets around. I seriously don't know what's so good about this place. See the shooting gallery at the entrance? I could hit their targets from the roof of the skyscraper opposite. You want me to bring you along next time? ...I'll consider it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Can people really cut everything loose without looking back, even shatter the order that was there, all to chase ideals? That's a dedication that... I can comprehend, but can't identify with. I know you all have your own beliefs at Rhodes Island, too. Here's hoping we don't come into direct conflict one day, Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Beats me how you sleep while standing up... and you even look pretty normal. It's a cut above everyone back then who sneaked naps in class.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: My duty's to monitor Mostima, so I'll be acting alongside her here, if you don't mind. You need a codename? ...Just call me Fiammetta. I've had enough of those codenames my bosses keep giving me.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Keeping battle records is a pretty good habit.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Let me get this out of the way—this is my chance to use my own name, and you *cannot* give me any more weird job titles.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Laterano code says whoever breaks it, pays for it, but reasonable loss of property in missions can be expensed. You order my actions, thus compensation fees naturally land with you too... what? You can't be regretting it now.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Less dawdling, come on.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Fine. But I'm not waiting for anyone who falls behind.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: We're heading up. It'll be faster by rooftop.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Don't make too big of a show.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Sights locked.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Boring.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I only do what I need to.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: What, you've got time to take in the sights?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Anyone in front of me who still feels like blinking?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Sorry, forgot to hold that back.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I don't like damage—unless it's necessary.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: There's no fluking between success and failure.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: You did a better job than I imagined. The feeling of fighting in a squad... it's been a long time.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission complete. Look, this much is granted—don't make a fuss over nothing.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: If you're fine, we're fine. If something happened to you while I was on the job, I know *someone* would be laughing at me.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Sorry, I was careless this time. I'll remedy it somehow.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Ventilation's fine, visibility's excellent. Good, that's conducive to getting my work done.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Don't touch that. It'll explode.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor... is that your job title? How normal. How nice.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Ever since I took on the task of monitoring Mostima, I've hardly gotten the chance to stop anywhere for long. I adapted to the runabout lifestyle a while ago, but having somewhere I can just take a breather on a day like this, it's nice. Happy New Year, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Same old, then?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: About that food street I mentioned. You wanna go check it out? I've never seen you use a firearm before, so we can just play by the rules at that shooting gallery. You want to see me hit their targets from the roof of a skyscraper? Ugh, I shouldn't have told you that... Fine, today's your birthday. Special exception!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: 'Fluffy Top Buns?' Mostima you little... There was this Sankta kid who didn't know Liberi have ear plumage, so he thought my hair was— you know, buns. And thanks to another superior of mine playing eavesdropper, I got saddled with the name for a full month! No, you're NOT allowed to laugh!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Back when I was an assistant at the shop, I filled the binders with hundreds of customers' preferences. Materials, hem lengths, even the number of buttons they wanted on the cuffs. Rhodes Island's paperwork couldn't be more complicated than––oh, w-wait, so much?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Back when I was an assistant at the shop, I recorded whole binders of hundreds of different customers' preferences. Materials, hem lengths, even the number of buttons they wanted on the cuffs. Rhodes Island's paperwork couldn't be more complicated than–– W-Wait, this much?!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: This strap buckle came from a Carnival stall, and the strap itself is an old measuring tape of mine. The hairpin was customized with a beading needle, and I embroidered this pattern here myself... It's too flamboyant? How silly, this is the pinnacle of Siracusan style. Get with the times.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: This strap buckle came from a Carnival stall, and the strap itself is an old measuring tape of mine. The hairpin was customized with a beading needle, and I embroidered this pattern here myself... It's too flamboyant? I'll have you know, this is the pinnacle of Siracusan style. Get with the times.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The tailor shop isn't half bad. Let me tell you about two of my good friends: one went to the police academy, the other joined a famiglia. They don't speak anymore. But they're both customers here at my shop. They come to me when they need clothes made.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The tailor shop isn't half bad. Look at this way: I have two brothers; one went to the police academy, the other joined a famiglia, and the two have never spoken since. But at the tailor shop, they're both my customers. They come to me when they need their clothes made.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Nonno used to tell me all sorts of fanciful stories, so I wouldn't get bored in the shop. I've known those stories backwards and forwards my whole life now. There's no way I would believe—oh, by heaven! D-Doctor, a doll just floated by! In midair! Y-You didn't see it? No-no-no, I'm not kidding!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Nonno used to tell me all sorts of fanciful stories so I wouldn't get bored in the shop. I've been able to retell those stories backwards and forwards for ages, so how could I believe in them...? Woah! D-Doctor, just now, there was a doll floating by! Y-You didn't see it? Don't try to scare me!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Once upon a time, I wanted to join the ranks of Siracusa's worthies, but Nonno only taught me how to hold a ruler and a pair of scissors. Still, with nothing but these two tools, he managed to win the respect of so many such worthies... There's still a lot for me to learn. And for now, I want to start with a new suit of clothes.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Once upon a time, I wanted to join the ranks of Siracusa's worthies, but Nonno only taught me how to hold a ruler and a pair of scissors. Yet with those two tools alone, he managed to win the respect of so many such worthies... There's still a lot for me to learn, and for now, I want to start with a new suit of clothes.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I thought the end of Carnival was just as cruel as Siracusa's old fairy tales. But when midnight came and the fireworks burst into the night sky, everyone could still truly celebrate together... I guess that's how a fairy tale should end. Ah, will future Siracusan fairy tales also be like this?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I thought the end of Carnival was just as cruel as Siracusa's old fairy tales. But when midnight came and the fireworks burst into the night sky, everyone could still truly celebrate together... And that's how a fairy tale should end, right? I wonder if the tale of Siracusa to come will be like that too.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: It's alright, I can sort out these letters on my own. See, they're from our neighbors, de Montano's regulars. Even though they know that Nonno isn't around anymore, they still send their regards to the shop... Hmm, maybe this is what he meant by 'decency'.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: It's alright, I can finish these letters on my own. See, they're from our neighbors, di Montano's regulars. Even though they know that Nonno isn't around anymore, they still send their regards to the shop... Maybe that's what he meant by 'respectability'.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, did you not sleep well? I can see the bags under your eyes. Why not take a page from my book and use some eyeshadow to make yourself look more energetic? Ah no, pretend I didn't say anything. I can tell that you're the type who never gets enough rest, but can always freshen up when it's time to get serious. I'll keep all the makeup stuff for myself.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, did you not sleep well? I can see the bags under your eyes. Why not take a page from my book and use some eyeshadow to make yourself look more energetic? Never mind. Even though you're the type who never gets enough rest, you can always freshen up quick when it's time to get serious. I'll take care of dressing you then.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Fold this corner first, go around twice like this, and finally tie it around your neck... Hmph, the scarf doesn't match your outfit. How about I just make you a complete Siracusan ensemble? It won't take anything I don't already know, so you might as well say yes.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: This thread goes here, this goes there... Ugh, it's all tangled anew. What, you think tailors never get their threads tangled?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: One end of the thread's over here, and other's over here... Ugh, it's all messed up again. What, do you think tailors never get their threads tangled?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: This is where I report in, right? Sorry, I came without getting changed first. Oh, I don't need to do that? Thank goodness, I feel more comfortable in familiar clothes.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Uhhh… can't be any harder than learning to tailor.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Well, can't be any harder than learning to tailor.

voices.text: I appreciate the thought, but you really don't have to go out of your way to treat me like a child.

voices.text: The mafiosi had their own secret ways of exchanging New Year's greetings. Back in the shop, we'd sew lace onto sleeves and gift leather wallets to our clients to celebrate the occasion. But none of these rituals seem appropriate for Rhodes Island. For now, I'll have to make do with a simple 'Happy New Year'.

voices.text: Oh, Doctor, what a spiffy ensemble you've got there today. Oh? This is what you always wear? Err... Well, that's worth complimenting too!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Come and try this new outfit. I based it off the measurements of your coat to make sure it would fit. Huh? I made it too small? Impossible! You must've eaten too much cake! Uhh... *Ahem* No, no, that's not an issue. I have all the tools on me right now. Let me fix it for you!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Come and try this new outfit. I based it off the measurements of your coat to make sure it would fit. Huh? I made it too small? Nonsense, you must've eaten too much cake! No, no, that's not the issue. I have all the tools on me right now. Let me fix it for you!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: When I set out, I grabbed all the spools of thread from the store, thinking I would advance beyond Nonno's level before they ran out. Now, with plenty of thread still left, I wonder, Doctor—if I might have already reached my goal long ago?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: When I set out, I grabbed all the spools of thread from the store, thinking to myself that I had to surpass Nonno before the thread ran out. And at this moment, I still have plenty of thread left—Doctor, do you think I've met my goal?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I can help you transcribe the documents. I used to help the priests copy the scriptures all the time, so I have a lot of experience with this kind of work. Oh, you use photocopiers here? In that case, I'll just guard you.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Shh, keep quiet; don't startle it. An operator who knows insects told me this chrysalis is about to emerge. It feels wonderful, waiting for life to break free. I wonder what color its wings will be. Yes? You think it's turning darker? It can't be…

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The high priest gave me this telescope to broaden my perspectives. I would watch tuskbeasts on the prowl, traveling merchants, and even the Minoan cities, yet my thoughts lingered in the temple. Even though it was right beside me, it felt farther than the horizon.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Am I daydreaming? No, I'm feeling the flow of the wind. Doctor, do you believe there are rivers in the sky as well? I do. They're invisible, yet nourishing; the gentle wind is their gift. Hmm, is it... raining? Let's head back, Doctor. I wouldn't want you to catch a cold.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, Midnight is twisting Spot's neck, and Orchid is pummeling Midnight... They are not fighting? But Sarkaz don't usually form friendships with other races... Is it because of Midnight's charm? Mhmm... Yes? You say he is not a good role model?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: When I left the temple, I took it with me and had a master smith craft it into a shield. Special, isn't it? The ancient texts say that sarcophagi are meant to guard the deceased for centuries, so they're always sturdy. I thought, since it would be my final companion anyway, I might as well use it to ward off evil.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Even the slightest contact with my Arts can cause extreme fatigue. You want to use my power to cure your insomnia? I'm afraid I can't do that. If you're having trouble sleeping, I'll burn some incense and chant for you, or join you in quiet contemplation, but my Arts would make you feel even worse. Oh, you were only joking? Phew.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: After the rainy season, life flourishes. Every year, when the time comes, I go back to the villages to help drive away unwelcome intruders—wild beasts gnashing their fangs, swarms of sand fleas, and even armed raiders… Think that's scary? Well, many think the Sarkaz are even scarier.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Someone once invited me to become a mercenary for the Lord Ameer, but that's not what I want to do. The river will still flood, conflicts will still rage, and life remains at risk. And I… I don't want to stand on the sidelines. Doctor, I once asked why you chose to save people, and you gave me the same answer.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: The sun will set, and people need sleep. We don't need to carry on as the ever-flowing river, it's okay to rest.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I come from Sargon to travel across the land, training along the way. Is it the 'River of Life' that brought us together here? Human Resources tells me you're the most knowledgeable one on this ship. May I learn from you?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This is a very efficient way to train. The next time I return, I hope to record the flow of the river... Doctor, may I ask what is the maximum recording length?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion… I am one step further than I was yesterday.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thank you. I understand how precious it is to win recognition. But this also means I'm entering even more turbulent waters… I won't back down.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Stride forward, righteously, to ward off disaster.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I shall take up this responsibility.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Some conflicts are irreconcilable, but I will try my best.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I see you dumping filth into the river.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: This is the branch to which destiny flows…

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I will meet the moment.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Withstand the test.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Solve the mysteries.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Withering longs for flourishing.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Drought sings of abundance.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Feel the sand in your mouth. Taste the unspeakable bitterness.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: The River of Life flows unceasing.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Ah… like a miracle.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: May they all reach the other side safely.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Perfection is hard to come by. You have done a great job, Doctor.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Failure is an inevitable part of learning. Let's try again.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I'll be careful not to knock anything over.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Please keep your distance…

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I haven't finished telling my last story. It won't take too long, three days and nights at most.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: During the Wepet Renpet celebration offerings, nearby settlements send emissaries with gifts of fine wine, fresh milk, and seasonal fruits. The priests pour these offerings into the river, giving thanks for the blessings of the past year… Oh, perhaps we should share a drink together, as is tradition? Hehe, happy New Year, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, are you free today? I still have many questions I'd like you to answer.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: In our faith, birthdays are incredibly significant. To us, birthdays do not hearken back to the beginnings of our lives; rather, they remind us of the difficult paths we have trod to our births, Doctor. Having endured countless hardships in your previous life, you won't be daunted by the trials of the present. Relax, and proceed apace.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: 'The rivers of Sargon are never bound to any one oasis.' This saying is common among our followers. Yet if I could start again, I would still sail here and share a journey with the Rhodes Islanders. Why? Doctor, I think you know better than anyone else.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Greetings Doctor. How may I assist you?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Deep Sleep Mode enabled... Zzzzz... Setting advanced config and power interface... Zzzzz…

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My racial traits, in conjunction with my infection, may cause me to fall asleep in mid-conversation. Do not be alarmed.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I met Dr. Silence at Rhine Lab. I assisted her with data and risk analysis on a secret project.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Warning! Formatting Rhodes Island database... Don't worry. It's just a joke. Please don't panic.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I recommend you refactor my data if optimization fails to increase my performance. This will improve communication efficiency, and Ptilopsis will... Zzzz...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The way I speak? It is a side effect of Originium poisoning. By no means do I enjoy articulating my thoughts this way.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Warning, system has recovered from a fatal error. Reconfiguring to last normal system boot point. Do not be alarmed.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: It is, in fact, quite burdensome to speak in this manner. But this is a necessary measure to prevent the system nexus from being devoured by that other voice. Doctor, if I lose control, please guide me back onto the right path.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: System... is now in Sleep Mode...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Ptilopsis, former data analyst at Rhine Lab. Please submit your orders via the Command Line.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Reading package data… Installation complete.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Update installation complete. Ptilopsis's system permissions have been revised.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Warning. Reverting Rhodes Island database to previous save state. Time since save state: two years… Just joking. Please calm down. System update complete.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: New data used to assemble package build.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Squad leader permissions acquired.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Direct memory access for application map and enemy coordinates authorized. Please stand by.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Tactical support system online.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Program initializing.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Initiation complete.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Arts Unit charging.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Target marked.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Initiating healing process.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Loading complete.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Healing Mode enabled.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Activating Arts Unit.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Even such a challenging scenario couldn't stop you, Doctor. Perhaps one day you will find the solution to the non-deterministic polynomial time problem.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Your logical deduction was absolutely correct. What a perfect calculation.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: A number of errors have been detected. Please confirm.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: A fatal error occurred during the operation. Reboot the system to proceed.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Is this place like a disk array?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Error occured.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Detecting affection increase for the Doctor within Ptilopsis. Would you like to skip to the next dialogue choice?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Loading… Loading complete. File name: New Year. Date modified: twelve hours ago. Updating entry contents: Doctor, Happy New Year! Your present has been placed on your desk. Open it and take a look!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Date rollover complete. The Doctor is now online. Detecting emotional surge within Ptilopsis.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, people celebrate their own dates of birth. How do you wish to celebrate yours? Acknowledged. Increasing favor rating of Doctor. Error: Invalid operation. Cause of failure: favor rating is already at—maximum.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Zzzzz... Detected passage of the Doctor. What is the Doctor laughing at...? Scanning hairstyle condition of Ptilopsis... Detected three pigtails, five bows, five colored bands, two clips. Assumed to be practical joke by Ifrit... Final assessment: Adorable.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Is there anything I can help you with, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Thank you for believing in me! I'll keep up my work!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Hibiscus and Lava are fighting again... What a pain. Why are they like this? They're sisters.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Instructor Dobermann puts us through mock battles a lot, but I can never get a handle on her skill. Doctor, next time you and Amiya observe our training, would you please give us some notes?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Someone on my team is late again, huh? I'll make sure that gets fixed.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Lava and I are both Infected, but I didn't get a talent for Arts like she did...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Rhodes Island is our home and shelter, Doctor. I will protect everyone here with my life.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The ever-honest and reliable Beagle, the perceptive Kroos, the resourceful Lava and the energetic Hibiscus. I like everyone in this team... as long as Hibiscus doesn't force her health food innovations on me.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Shhh! The Doctor's resting. We can talk outside.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Lancer Fang, captain of Reserve Op Team A1. My team and I will do our best to serve Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Thank you for your guidance.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Your approval means so much to me, Doctor. This promotion proves my hard work is paying off.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Leave it to me.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I know the captain's duty well. Rest easy.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Team, check your gear before departing.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Enemy spotted. Prepare to fight!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Ready for action.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: On standby.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: In position.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Leave it to us.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Thrust!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Everyone, follow me!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: With the right plan, even rookies like us can win a tough fight!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We have accomplished our objective as planned.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We can't call a mission complete if we let even a single enemy get through. Beagle, let's do better on the next one.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'm sorry I failed you, Instructor Dobermann...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Yes. I'm back. Is Kroos here too?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ahh...!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Am I helping?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Our team's going to eat dinner together, and we were just about to invite Instructor Dobermann. Would you like to come as well? I have some combat-related questions I'd like to ask, too... Oh, sorry, I know I shouldn't be mentioning work on a holiday.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I'm ready whenever you need me, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! We got you a birthday present as a team. Have you seen Kroos? We agreed to do this together, and she still vanished. Anyway, whatever she told you, just don't believe a word of it, we did actually—awgh! Krooth! Whah ah yoo cavvarin m' mauph phor?!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Looking at our set goals, I've already finished all my training, the other members of my team have made huge progress under Dobermann's instruction too, and we're adapting better and better on the combat side of things. Doctor, I'll be a better captain than I'm now, I promise.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Tabletop, 60 points. Floor, 63 points. Air quality...... 56 points. There's room for improvement, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Have you experienced any bodily discomfort recently? Umm, dry skin, stiff shoulders... dry eyeballs, hair loss, fatigue? ...Very good, just old problems then, nothing serious. As long as you start exercising, these problems should go away in no time.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Life in the Medical Department is just daily meetings, visits around the Island, learning the operators' physical conditions, and developing new drugs. Nothing really fresh or exciting.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Mother, no matter where you are, please watch over me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Thanks for always taking care of us medics. I feel so much less anxiety while working, and I'm very happy. Of course, there are troublesome things to deal with as well, for example, when Blaze comes back, her body is always covered in blood, each and every time! Does she know how hard it is to clean up those bodily fluids?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: How many times have I told you, don't stay up late, and don't overeat! You just won't listen, right? How are you going to take care of your health then? You might as well spend the rest of your life in that chair!! ...... I'm sorry, I need to go calm down first.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I never quite know what Dr. Kal'tsit is thinking. Has she always been that... unique? I hope I can catch up to her one day, even if it's in just one area.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: As long as the wicked can be punished, what's a little bit of criticism? I don't mind spilling these poisons on my enemies. They deserve it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The word 'Ursus' only gives me pain. I don't want to hear it, not again for the rest of my life. But it's giant, its voice deafening, and I'm the only one it's going to drive mad.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You also know that your previous environmental cleanliness evaluation scores weren't very high, right? If you don't turn things around, Doctor, you'll be on the business end of the Rhodes Island sanitation crane. ... I'll help you take care of these for now, so make sure you clean up the rest in your free time.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Folinic from the Medical Department, and I am now participating in field medic missions. Meanwhile, per Dr. Kal'tsit's request, I will also help you manage your health. I look forward to working with you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: It seems that the volume of drug input was insufficient last time, and it should be able to achieve its intended effect next time at triple the dosage.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you for your acknowledgment. I am simply doing what I should.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: One day, I will become as capable a physician as Dr. Kal'tsit. Just you wait and see.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Medical support ready. I'll protect everyone's life.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Medical support has covered the whole squad. The rest is up to you, Doctor.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: No problem, I can handle some psychological burden.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Enemy engaged. Prepare for counterattack and treatment.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Haven't decided yet?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: The clock's ticking.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Medical support has arrived.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Permission to attack has been granted.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Start medication.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Don't worry, the effects will kick in soon.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Three, two, one!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Overdose decoction prepared, begin use!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I was able to be of some help, right?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Saving medical supplies is a good thing, but there's no need for that on the battlefield, is there?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Luckily, it's just a scratch. Just apply a bandage after cleansing the wound.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Transfer the wounded! Get ready for emergency operation! Prepare for intraosseous infusion!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Inspection complete. This area is habitable.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Sometimes the things I say to you can be a bit... excessive, but you should also recognize that you have your shortcomings, all right?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
