voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Why don't we take this chance to look back on your health over the last year? Let's see... Forget it. I have to admit my management of your health still has room for improvement. I will work extra hard on that this year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You've been working hard.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I prepared a gift for you. This is a neck massager developed by the Medical Department. Why don't you give it a try now? It might hurt a little, but it's good for your health. Hey, don't try to escape. I will manage your health one way or another.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Ever since my mother went missing, I haven't had a place to call home. Rhodes Island is the closest I have. Dr. Kal'tsit invested her ideals in this company, and so have I. Doctor, bear witness to my determination.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, if you need me for anything, just say the word! You want me to file the documents? Oof, I'm no good with paperwork... How about this, we set work aside and I take you for a spin?  Wink.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, I got the ceiling light fixed. Is it bright enough for you? If you don't need me for anything else, I'll go take care of other stuff. You think all this work is hard on me? I get to make some money, meet new friends, and seize the life I want to live with my own two hands. There's nothing better than this.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Ugh, I hit the wrong note again. Come on, don't laugh at me. Not all Siestans are natural-born musicians. Besides, the kalimba is harder than it looks! You wanna try? Here you go. Alright, Hold it a little further down, and gently pluck it with your thumb... You want me to teach you more later? Oh no, I'm no good at teaching either.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Doctor, I found the perfect spot for sunbathing on the deck. It's got a great view. We can set up a parasol there, grab some ice-cold sodas, lounge on some beach chairs, and watch the clouds. When I was a kid, I used to take naps after I was done helping out at the store. Fell asleep listening to the waves like this.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: A police officer taught me these combat techniques. She said that when you run a business, you gotta have a few tricks up your sleeve. Most important is self-defense. Oh, right, she also gave me a membership card. She said it lets me sightsee all around Lungmen. What, You have one, too? What?! And there's no expiration date?!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, look! I marked all the sightseeing destinations on the map. There's the volcano Miss Naumann talked about, and the underground forest on Chuck's postcard. When Rhodes Island passes by these places, I'll be sure to apply for... Aw, darn it, my nose is bleeding again...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Oh, I'm writing Harley back, telling her all about the places I've visited. Can't let'em think I traveled less than Chuck, you know. I used to think about the future very little, and I never thought I'd one day leave the 'White Volcano.' That said, when I made up my mind and said goodbye to the past, the future was already there before my eyes.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: This round little thing isn't a fowlbeast egg. It's a cobble found on the old Siestan beaches. My sister really treasured it, but she gave it to me right before I left. You know, Doctor, ties between people are like the beach. After the tides recede, you find only treasure. My life here at Rhodes Island has made me believe that even more.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I promised Lut and Liv that I'd keep track of all my 'journey experiences' with Rhodes Island. Our adventure team may have disbanded for now, but when I become more mature and when they grow up, I'll definitely take them on this journey of mine.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: One yawn, two yawns... Doctor, why don't I make you a glass of 'Cotton Sunset?' Trust me. You'll find yourself drifting in a fluffy, pillowy dream.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. I'm Enis, and I'm formally joining Rhodes Island today. What, a codename? Umm, let me think... How about 'Bryophyta?' I hope I'll get to leave my mark on the mountain rocks and reefs, just like the moss.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I didn't know you could work together in battle like that! Uh, I'm getting a little hungry. I'll go make some popcorn. You want some?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: This counts as a promotion, right?  Nice~ I'll write a postcard back to 'White Volcano', and brag all about this to my siblings, heheh. Yeah, I'll have to use a postcard with a picture of Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Elite instructor? You aren't trying to get me to become a kindergarten teacher or a boy scout leader, right? Haha, just kidding. But I've gotten pretty used to life here at Rhodes Island now. Let me keep following you guys to even more distant lands, Doctor.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Huh? I-I'm heading to the battlefield, too?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: My gosh, you want me to lead the team? It's not the pay I'm worried about. I'm worried I could mess it up!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: It's okay... Relax…

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Gotta give it 200%, better take a coffee mint…

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: A capable helping hand? Me?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Alright! I'll guard this place well.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Fasten your seatbelts, everyone. I'm starting the meter now.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: You want me out of the way? Don't be silly. You can't get inside without tickets.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Fierce winds won't push me back.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Rough seas won't pull me under.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Wildfire won't burn me down.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Who says a logistics operator... can't fight?!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I really thought I wouldn't make it... But looks like we can overcome even the biggest waves when we're working together.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, I did well, right? I'm gonna get some ice cream. You want some, too? Alright, I can give you an extra scoop. Okay, okay, I'll give you two extra scoops.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Uh, I got careless... Hm? I did well enough already...?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Go. Don't worry about me... I've got a lifesaver license, you know.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: If only we had a surfboard here, oof…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Watch out! Phew, that was close... I almost spilled it.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: H-Hold on! Don't look! I'm not done with the lyrics yet! You... want to hear it?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, Happy New Year. I'm here to change the water cooler's jug. Why am I still working today? This job's special, you see. I get to run into a lot of people on the first day of the year, and I can wish each of them a happy new year. It's meaningful work, don't you think?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, want to try some Siestan coffee? You can add some tonic water, too.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Be sure to make a wish out loud on such an important day. Huh? It won't come true if others hear it? But back when I was still at the 'White Volcano,' it really seemed like our wishes would come true more easily when we yelled.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Just like Siesta, I said goodbye to that beach, and just like Rhodes Island, I am searching out sights I had never seen before. Doctor, the destination of my journey may be a bit far away for me still, but the journey itself has already become a stack of postcards thick enough for me to look back on and treasure forever.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: *Yaaawn*... Doctor, could I take a quick break?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Don't worry about my bow. I keep it well maintained. It's much tougher than you, so stop asking about it already.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: There are so many interesting people at Rhodes Island. Would be nice if I could make a friend or two to travel with.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Nowadays, the Knights of Kazimierz are little more than a bunch of musclehead jocks, or clowns obsessed with billboards and firework shows. Man, it's so lame.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I was planning to return home after finishing this job, but now I've changed my mind. Why, you ask? You should know better than to ask a girl a question like that.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Want to know the origin of my codename? You see, there are different ranks for the Knight Assassins in Kazimierz. There's three Darksteel and two Lazurite assassins above me, but I and I alone bear the rank of Platinum, from now till the day I die. So I figured it'd make a good codename.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Ah, it's Miss Nearl! No, no, I wasn't going to lay a hand on her. I'm just worried she's going to charge at me with her hammer.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Kazimierz is... a boring place. *Sigh*, I'm almost mad at how much more amusing life here at Rhodes Island is.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Have you thought about how you're going to maintain your relations with everyone here at Rhodes Island? You know, all suits of armor have small gaps which leave you vulnerable, and that's where the enemies always try to jam their blades. One hit to your weak point can bring down everything you've painstakingly built.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I'm so bored. Hoping something amusing happens.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Assassin of the Armorless Union of Kazimierz here as per our agreement. What am I called? Hmm... Call me Platinum, then. Nice to meet you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Good. My bow feels even lighter. Thank you.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion? Isn't the rank of Platinum already intimidating enough? Oh, you are an interesting one.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Hah. Do you have the guts to gaze upon the true face of the one called Platinum, my dear Doctor?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Platinum, reporting for duty.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Really? I'm commanding? It's not my strongest suit, but all right.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Will this battle be an interesting one?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: You may as well attack at the same time. You're all too weak anyway.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Your orders?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Who's my target?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'll make them disappear.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Moving to intercept.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: First, break their legs.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Second, break their armor.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: And third, pierce their flesh.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Now, it's checkmate!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Nice. I had quite an enjoyable time.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Checkmate. I'm sorry, but victory is mine.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: What a pity that we left some alive.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Don't give up... He who laughs last laughs best.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: The atmosphere here is surprisingly good.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh?!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Want to go on a walk? If you're busy, there's always next time.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Huh? Wasn't expecting to run into you here. Me? I'm just feeling the breeze. It's too noisy down there, and too many people. I want to be alone. Hm. Still sticking yourself here like a little dope after you've learned my answer? Could it be... You want to stay with me a bit longer? Ugh—whatever, this place is boring. How about we just ditch in secret?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You look well, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: A kind little reminder from me. Those tickets I gave you WILL expire. Don't make me tie you up and drag you there, okay? ...Day after tomorrow? Alright, it's a deal then. No backsies. What, why am I smiling? Is this your first time going to an amusement park with someone? That's cute. Interpret it however you like, little dummy.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Missions: boring, enemies: boring, but it's still way better than Kazimierz no matter how you slice it. Just getting further and further away from there feels great. The wind from Kazimierz will never again blow my arrows off its mark, and I never want to breathe its air ever again.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Your files are all fully sorted. Hm? Was that fast? I wasn't dozing off on your last shift, after all. I have your whole workflow noted right inside my head.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Stop! You're triggering one of my traps. Move any further, and a bolt will blow your brains out. How could I fall asleep surrounded by traps? That's a strange question. I couldn't sleep at all without these little trinkets around me.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: What we stole from the Leithanian nobles, they plundered from the land before that. We're the children of the wilds, but we are not unreasonable. Lungmen traders do good to others, and Siracusans keep to the rules, so I told my team not to lay a finger on them.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Is that Lee guy here too? He got me when I was careless, and now I want a rematch. No, no need to worry, none of the trinkets he carries interest me. You go tell him as much.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Infected? Only city people would call themselves that. In the endless and cutthroat wilds, whether beast or human, survival means you can call yourself the strongest.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: There's plenty who think the wilds are a frightening place, but to me, they were my home. I made a mistake once. It torn my family apart,  and these slumberfoots are the only ones left to roam with me. I'll never make a mistake like it again.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The name Blacknight was given to me by a Yan storyteller. I always used to do my work at night, pulling the floor from under them when those merchants were drowsy. Me and my slumberfoots would take away their wealth, and 'devour' their dreams too.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Don't act so nice to me... you never know when my crossbow will be aimed at your head. You don't believe I'm like that? Up to you, then. I've got no interest in dealing with a penniless good guy.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: They called me their boss. So I protected them, gave them food and a place to rest. But now, for as long as I haven't beaten you, you're my boss. I'll protect you, and I'll follow your orders.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: ...Fell asleep hugging Helmet? Light, bring a blanket over. Keep your movements low.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: You're the best tactician on Rhodes Island? I'm Blacknight, and excuse me but we're going to need a showdown. If I lose, you'll be my boss from then on, and I ask to be trained properly.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Mm, all memorized. Anything else?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: You're not worried I'll take the bonus and run? I'm joking. For that matter, a badge like this won't fetch any real money anyway.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Work and earn a living. I wonder if my parents lived a life like this in Rim Billiton? It's fine, but I'm not letting my crossbow rust.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Good timing. I need something to do.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You want me leading? Then you'll want to watch how I do it.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Listen up, darlings. Once we're on the battlefield, you need to listen to the Doctor too.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: You want to run? Before you do, remember to leave your valuables behind.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm right by you. Don't make a sound.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Understood. Just as planned, then.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'm heading that way.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Let's clear this path up first.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Helmet, lure the enemy left!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Light, harass the closest enemy!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Cart, set mines in the bushes!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Drill, open a hole!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: How'd me and the darlings do? No compliments for us?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Not bad! I've learned some more moves.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I'll take a few to the next crossing. We need to get this cleaned up.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: No, you have to get out of here! Do as I said, or the enemy will have you trapped. We'll retreat for now and think of a better way to fight back.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Roaming under the night sky is just one hundred times better than getting shut in here.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Who was that?!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Tired? You can have Helmet to hug for a little bit, then. At least until tomorrow.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Well, New Year's today. Once winter passes, the caravans start coming again. If things were usual, we'd pull off a big job, and have a feast on the nobles' dime, celebrating all around. It's comfy times here, though, and I have no need for my old job. I wonder when I'll finally get the chance to bring those kids in.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey, Helmet, no running about in the corridor! Don't think I can't see you just because you're hiding in someone's arms... oh, fine, I'll let you off, for {@nickname}'s sake.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: To the children of the wild, having food in your belly and a safe place to shelter's all the lucky blessings you'll ever count—no one has birthdays on their mind, and I have no idea what I should even give you. How about this? Ten favors I'll do you. Not missions from the Doctor of Rhodes Island, but things you want me to do.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I still remember some of my toddler days. The fireplace at home. Mum holding me. The little handicraft beastling from my dad. That was my first home. Then I left the wilds, and lost my home again. I know there's no protecting who I want to protect yet, not before I get stronger. So, you're not going to stop me in my step. No one will.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hm? You're here to pray? Sorry, I'm busy right now.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Hm? Yes, I'm the current Karlan Saintess. But everyone swamped by work deserves a little break from time to time, don't you think?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Wasting time on trivial affairs is what I call slacking off. What I'm doing right now is… taking the opportunity to recharge.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Work hard, play hard, right? Don't force all those rigid rules on me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The Karlan Goddess? We share a good relationship, thanks to my duty as the Saintess.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I'd be happy to help you, but the life of a Karlan Saintess is a busy one. Well, I guess I'll make an exception for you this once, but please make it short.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: My sis... Ensia... you people at Rhodes Island are all pretty fond of her, right? So it's not like she received any special treatment from that guy. And now... well, I think I get it now. It's fine like this. I'll just keep watching over her. It's fine.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I twisted my ankle once when I was a kid. My brother carried me on his back all night, going from house to house until someone agreed to take us in. I decided that very moment that I wanted to grow up to become someone like my brother! But now... heh, forget it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Huh? How did you find me? I'll freeze your toes—Um? Coffee? For me? Thanks. Oh, right, Doctor, wanna hang out here with me for a while? The view is pretty nice. But let's keep it a secret, okay? A secret between just the two of us—aw, this coffee is so bitter!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: It's rare to get to rest like this.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Shh, I sneaked out—oh, um, hi, HR Director! I... I'm here to lend my powers to Rhodes Island. Pramanix, Karlan Saintess, at your service. Bless you, my friend.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I hear a voice... repeating something in my head...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: 'You shall emerge victorious one day.' This is the pledge of Karlan, and what I'm praying for as well.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Since when did you need blessings too? Can you wait a bit? I'll get ready.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: May the Holy Mt. Karlan be with us.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Follow the bells and you'll find the way.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let me pray towards the mountains for you.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Impurities must be purged.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Be careful.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I am ready.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Let us begin.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: You have my blessings.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: O Spirits, hear my prayer.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Here come the bells, cold winds binding my enemies.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: These powers are a gift from the Holy Mountain.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: As the bells ring, the impenetrable armor shall be no more.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: It was simple, thanks to the Spirits' power.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The light of Karlan was shining on us.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: If only we could have won without bloodshed... just my wish...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: It's not looking good... I suggest we retreat at once.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's a really peaceful place.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Close your eyes and I'll bring you somewhere new... Do keep your eyes closed, okay?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: What am I doing here? You see, Doctor, Ensia's aboard Rhodes Island, and as her big sister, it's only natural for me to pay her a visit on New Year's. You won't have the heart to let Ensia spend the holiday out there alone, would you? How very cruel that would be.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You have my blessings, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: So—how does it taste? Nice and cool, isn't it? It's my own handmade frosted chocolate. Do you like it? Good, that's a relief, I really spent a lot of time studying it.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: My brother's here too? Oh, no need to worry, Doctor, we all know what our business is. On this day, we're no more than operators for Rhodes Island. This place is like a little pocket, and I'm here from time to time just to relax, not for anything else.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: We're changing shifts right now, Doctor. Just ignore me and get on with your work.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Back in BSW, I was appointed as a BPRS... you know, Biochemical Protection Response Staff. You can probably imagine what it was like... bulky hazmat suit and all that...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Hmm? You think I'm a clean freak? Well, Doctor, I see you're unexpectedly direct! I admire your courage.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Some of the Operators' rooms are in dire need of cleaning. For example, the one belonging to that high-and-mighty teacher's pet. What do you think?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: You want to see the intricate pattern on my sword up close? Sure, hold it tight, then. Don't let go—it'll heat up to 2,500 degrees Celcius in 3 seconds! Haha, just kidding! Don't be scared!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Stay clear of that room full of chemical haze, toxins and harmful radiation... that's right, I mean Dr. Kal'tsit's lab.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You're asking me for advice regarding the prevention of biochemical contamination? Well, for example... always brush your teeth after eating?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Liskarm's been looking so flashy since she got her promotion. 'Hey! Hot girl here! Get your gunsight on me!' I bet that's how she greets the enemies.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Good golly, if this is how free life is at Rhodes Island then I might just quit my job at BSW. Liskarm would be upset, though.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: There's a mosquito on your arm, Doctor.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm chemical specialist operator, Franka, here to do my bit to help minimize the pollution wrought by Originium.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I could perform these techniques anywhere, anytime!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Wooow, you're giving me a promotion? I'm having a lot more fun here than at BSW.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: *Giggle*, you want to see my sword at its most glorious? Too bad, Doctor—you're not qualified yet! If you work at it, maybe one day you'll gain the privilege!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: All right, I'm ready.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: The best thing about training capable subordinates, is that I get to let them handle all the annoying stuff for me.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Well, let's go, then.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Too bad... these people have already been contaminated. In that case...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Gotta hurry!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: No time to hesitate.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Offense isn't what I trained for, but hey...

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Heavy defenders are SO scary... Hehe, just kidding.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Weak spot, Sighted!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Let's burn it up!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Hold your breath now.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Tricked you!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Obsession with power is a fool's game.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: That was perfect from start to finish. Well done.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Just as expected.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: What, you still have time for that upset face? Fall back now.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Say, do you have black tea here?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Need something?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Want to hear about my time at BSW?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Thanks for the end-of-year bonus, Doctor! It motivates me to work even harder next year. If you've got any tough missions, leave them to me! (Now to get a bonus from Blacksteel too...)

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Gooood morning, Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Here's your gift, no tricks attached. Don't forget to make your wish and make it come true! You only live once, after all.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island is a more interesting place than Blacksteel. The medics always look like they're attending my funeral when I get a checkup. It scares me... Yeah, yeah, I know, I'll be good and listen. I have too much on my bucket list to give up now.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'll gladly offer my help if you need it. Just remember to return the favor someday.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Vina... Err, I mean, Miss Siege—always gives me this feeling I can't describe. I wonder why...?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My dad? Oh my, you know I ran away from home and you're still going to ask me that? Doctor, are you perhaps not the best at conversation?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}! Do have a try of my cooking... You taste medicine? Oh, gosh... Well, I do have some knowledge in herbs, but you know I wouldn't be experimenting on you, would I? Eheheh...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I used to think my parents were so stuffy and numb to it all, so I ran away from home to find a new life. But after having traveled so far and been through so much, I've come to realize why my parents felt how they did now. Ahahah, c'est la vie, as the saying goes.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, see that lone cloud over there, off from the rest? That's the way my hometown lies.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Faith' is an interesting topic. I never had the chance to go to Laterano, but how funny I should hear all about its feats on Rhodes Island? Although I've mostly heard about, er... one very overly active girl. Has Laterano always been such a lively place?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The boats of Toron need a lighthouse to make their way back to port, and Rhodes Island has served as the safe haven at the end of my trip. Dr. {@nickname}, your light might not illuminate the whole harbor, but go on... Do what I couldn't. It's my honest request.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Right here, right now, is where I, Grace Arizona, place my faith. Dr. {@nickname}, you hold my hopes in your hands, forever more.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: ...That's the face of someone lost in their dreams. I wonder if you're feeling uneasy, Doctor?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Breeze, a traveling scholar from Toron County. It is a pleasure to meet you, Doctor. Phew, I've had enough of formal etiquette, so this will be the last of it.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: ...Stunning medical skills. There's Rhodes Island for you...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I bestow my heartfelt blessings on you for your gift, Doctor. Hmm? What a shoddy reaction—this is a hand-kiss, you know, we're being serious here. Hurry up, come on!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Well, this time won't be as mannerful as the last, not that I'd think you were hoping for that? So here goes. I will dedicate everything to Rhodes Island, a pledge that transcends my consciousness.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Leave the medical work to me.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Thank you for your trust. I will make sure to prioritize the safety of the Operators.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: It's getting windy...

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Those who seek to inflict harm on others have no right to ask for forgiveness.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Awaiting orders.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Let's get this done quickly.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Make sure to look after yourself.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Rings through winds the Eulogy…

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Sings the breeze an elegy!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: We have the will!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Everyone, victory is ours.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Every victory creates a kindling that will flourish into an everlasting fire.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Keep your senses alert. The wind is still restless.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Why are they so fixated on hurting others...?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What a... unique place this is.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Wait, wait!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, would you like to hear the story of my hometown?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Seems a whole year's flown by. How long does that make it since I left home, then... wait, don't give me that look, or the head-patting! I'm not homesick!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good day, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Here's three slices of Victorian cake. One of—excuse me, what's the rush? I didn't even finish yet. Lucky you to pick the spicy one. Come on, wash that down with a spot of tea.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I wonder from time to time what my parents would think of me now, working at Rhodes Island. Would they be proud of me? Or maybe they still wouldn't forgive me... Either way, saving more lives is an ideal I'll never be swayed from.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Ah, files all sorted. Relax. Not everything spills its secrets, and not everything merits recording. A document left to a Maylander detective? Well, that must be one not worthy of doctoring.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Now that Rhodes Island and Maylander have reached an understanding on our partnership, we'll be sending specialists for the follow-up. In fact, I'm more curious about my old friends on this ship. For example, the K'uk'ulkan, the Friston-3 robot, and you, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Can I smoke in the office? If it bothers you, I won't exhale... Mmmm. Picked up this little habit during my time at a volcanic caldera in Bolívar. Can't seem to break it. But no worries, not like I have lungs to file a complaint.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Are those kids still following me? Fine. Let them believe the Columbian fairy tale is real... My exoskeleton sure grabs attention, and man, does it need regular maintenance. But I'm just too lazy to keep replacing it. Well, that's the force of habit... even a tin can gets used to its dents.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Wanna take a look together? These are social dynamics reports from some academic journals. Helps us catch a glimpse of the new inventions and trends coming next year... Hmm? Of course it's necessary. Can you tell that I'm a revenant who's lived for millennia? See? That's the charm of keeping a youthful mind.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: W brought a swath of drastic reforms. Nasti's aiming for a city floating above the clouds... Hehe, you gotta admit, the Sarkaz vision for the future never disappoints. Me? I'm just an average joe working for the Foundation, investing in the next generation is where it's at.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I like the top deck of Rhodes Island. It's got a great view. Too bad I didn't have a ship like this, or friends like yours when I was... scavenging, all those years ago... But I did meet Maylander Selene, and we roamed that wilderness together.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Keep your distance and don't get yourself burned. Without witchcraft, sometimes this tin can sizzles in mere sunlight... Do I regret it? Perhaps. If becoming a pile of firewood could solve the Sarkaz's problems, then I'd hop right into the Soul Furnace. Yet, that's not how it works.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Dame Kal'tsit and I talked a little about you. Don't worry. Your past won't be an issue for Maylander. Time sure flies for people like us, don't you agree? Care for a smoke? A few puffs and we'll be enjoying the sunset.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Good, I'll get the newspapers, and make us hot dogs with some nachos. Hats off to fast food, for keeping us pioneering without even a moment's rest. Great invention, don't you think?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I haven't seen you since Trimounts, Doctor. Tin Man, P.I., representing the Maylander Foundation. Starting today, we'll be cooperating with Rhodes Island in a variety of sectors, along with sharing our resources... and secrets.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: It looks like Rhodes Island excels in its other business areas, besides just Oripathy treatment. We've got more room for cooperation... than I expected.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: And the last time I experienced something like this was by a campfire. Maylander Selene threw a map and a bottle of hard stuff across the flame, and invited me to join his team. Columbia wasn't even on the map yet... Hmph, it's like yesterday once more.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thanks. It's tough for people like you and me to trust, I know.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Some people on this team are as talented and impressive as Maylander's agents. I'm interested to see how this operation unfolds, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Call me Tin Man, ladies and gentlemen. For this operation, I'm expecting you to follow all my orders to the letter.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I'll be finding a backup route for our operation.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: How about you take another way, good sir?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Let me stretch a little first. My joints are getting rusty.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Patience, my friend. Let me have a smoke first.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Watch out for voice; it's the best vessel for curses.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Even an old haunt has its perils.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Don't treat history with such a flippant attitude.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Don't imagine the future with such a narrow view.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Found your archive... Alright, destroyed.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Feel how your soul's imprisoned; it will be a lesson you won't forget.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: A few years ago, I heard some rumors about the Kazdel civil war. Seems time has not rusted your talents in this area, Doctor.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I had a taste of it back in Trimounts, but your strategic planning and judgment here were truly impressive... Would you mind if I reported to the Foundation? They would be glad to know there's an outstanding commander behind Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: They may have escaped the battle, but they can't escape the war.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: It's not a problem. Per our agreement, the Maylander Foundation is responsible for damage control. Leave this to me.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Pretty nice room. Maybe once I get used to it, I'll turn it into my new body... Hehe, Just kidding.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What do you think happens when a human touches scorching hot metal?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You... didn't spot me pulling smoke rings back in my body through the gaps, did you?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Kazdel doesn't have New Year's celebrations like this, but in Columbia, I always join the kids in the square for the countdown to the bell. As a Rhodes Island operator, I guess I'll have to satisfy the children's curiosity about this tin man…

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You had a light, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Me? How to decide a revenant's birthday? Umm... The day I was born? Too long ago to remember. The day I got a new body? Then I'd have too many birthdays to count. Birthdays don't mean much to me. But for you, commemorating something is a way to validate your own existence, isn't it? Happy birthday, Doctor. How about we go for a walk?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Columbia, Kazdel of the future, and even Rhodes Island share one thing in common—Youth. Youth represents everything. Doctor, you and I are from the past, but at the moment, we're defending the future. I believe Rhodes Island and Maylander's partnership will continue.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I dunno what this assistant thing's all about, sorry, but hanging around, doing our own thing? That's me all over. Run into someone, belt out a tune, share a wee bite and a pinch of cheer, then we move on. That's the way of it.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Even with an empty post bag and no Catastrophes on the horizon, I'd still be wanderin' with my burdenbeasts in tow, never stoppin' in one place for long at all. Mm... Lyin' on their backs, fallin' asleep under the blanket of a starry sky... The further I am from them, the more I miss that life.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Down below, whether I'm in or out, I can't see the sky at all, sorry, I'm happier staying on the top deck so. There's a Lupo girl's tent pitched not quite securely. I helped her peg it with some rope and stakes, heheh, now it won't go flappin' mad as the landship goes full tilt.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I went down to have a look at where you forge your weapons. The furnace is massive, and its flames get the tin red-hot! The ceiling is real low though, and there's only one lad mannin' the whole place. He the one who makes all the weapons for you? 'Boiler room'? What's that?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Hmm, there's this legend about changelings: the Dead swappin' wee ones who'd end up as wakemen, stuck guardin' ruins their whole life. But I know Nemos' not like that. Born in the ruins, she up and scarpered off; became a wakewoman and then chucked it all in. These legends? Nothin' more than tall tales, when it comes down to it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: To forge this blade, I ground some burdenbeast bone on a metal crab shell dusted with lime powder. Next, I set the blade in the polished handle, grippin' it tight, even when I slept, to knit the bone and iron together. Then I Spun the knife 'round to mark me path, and just like that, I bid me clan farewell. Once I die, this knife'll guide me home.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Got a letter back for you, Doc! Feels mighty strange saying that. When I wasn't helpin' Nemos, I'd be tearin' about warnin' folk of Catastrophe, maybe deliverin' some final letters along the way. Other Catastrophe Messengers are like bridges, but me? I'm more like a stone you hurl with all your might.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The rope I got you's all tangled up? Odd that, it's slick with beastoil... Alright, here's the trick: first, loosen the twists, find the longest strand, lift and stretch it open 'till it makes a hole, slip your wrist through, then give the rope a good tug outwards. Tada! Got you tied up tight as a drum!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I know how to use comm devices, and I keep one on me always. If I don't answer while I'm out, means I'm too busy. But Doc, if you've got need for me, or just want a look-see, stand up on deck and call my name. The wind'll carry your voice to me, faster than any device.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: No bonfires to watch here... Think I could draw a me on the wall to keep the Doc company?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm a—Err, what's the word again? Catastrophe Messenger, right. Call me Brigid. Sorry, got a letter here for the Doctor of Rhodes Island. Know anyone by that name?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Can we bring these up on deck, watch them outdoors?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I've helped deliver a few of these bits of metal before, but the recipients always cried. Emm… since it's a happy moment here, those must've been tears of joy, surely?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: If you keep pinnin' these metal trinkets on me, I'll run out of space on my shirt... But I've no mind to trade 'em away neither. Would you be willin' to keep 'em safe for me, Doc?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Got me knives polished, when're we headin' off?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Like heading off into battle, yeah?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I think we ought to run there, personally.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Alright, time to focus! Can't let the quarry go!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Need me to have an ambush set?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Just tell me where to go.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Just so you know, this here's a knife, not a boomerang!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Weather not looking too good? No mind, my knife'll slice clean through the fog.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I'll chase you to the ends of Tara and back.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: You can't hide from me.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You gotta flick your wrist, just like that!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I've been here too long. Let's wrap things up.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Men or beasts, they run all the same, eh?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Hmmhmm♪Hmmhmm♪Hmmhmmmmmm—hmm♪ Hmmhmm♪Hmmhmm♪Hmmhmm...♪

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Didn't it turn out grand? Let's go, I'll roast up some meat for you!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Does victory wander like a burdenbeast?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Like I could reach out and touch the ceiling, same as Na Saoirsí.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmm? Wouldn't be pushing me like that, Doc, gotta put your back into it!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Fancy how the hair on my tail curls up?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: 'On the eleventh knell of the bell, carve a Trinity Knot rune onto a stone. The comin' year's bad luck will go into the stone, leavin' you with a bright and breezy future.' Some of the legends teach ancient wisdom, guidin' people towards better lives. I practice it every year. Go on, give it a try, Doc.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You should really walk more often, Doc.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Back in me clan, birthdays always mean green cheese made from cystymilk. A bite of this cheese is like eatin' the moons themselves, so when night falls, your fire—your very soul—won't be snuffed out by the twin moons' gaze. So come on, Doctor, I made it with me own two hands!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: If I had never come here, I might never have known there were such wide open spaces beyond Tara. Though life aboard the landship's real interesting and all, I still much prefer to get me own two feet movin’. Afore my fire burns out, I'll keep runnin' and runnin', just like I did back in Na Saoirsí.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Don't worry, Doctor. No matter what happens, I'll protect you.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Liberi have excellent eyesight. According to legend, some can even tell one droplet from another in a rainstorm. Sounds incredible, huh?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I take everyday life too seriously? My apologies. I think that comes from my time serving as a Laterano Guard. I'll work on that in the future.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: To most Lateranos, heavy armor doesn't serve much of a purpose. Of course, when we perform the large-scale rituals of our homeland, we do dress up in ceremonial garb.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I appreciate your faith in my abilities, Doctor. I won't let you down.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Right... I submitted a request to the HR office... to become your personal bodyguard. I guess maybe I miss my old job too much.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I grew up in Laterano and didn't really have the chance to learn about other cultures. Here at Rhodes Island, I get to see such diversity, way beyond my imagination. Actually...it's not so bad.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I have no regrets. Yes, true, they did drag me out of Laterano against my will... but this has been a great adventure. I've enjoyed it.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: It is my duty to protect you, Doctor. Rest assured.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: My name is Plume, formerly of the Pontifica Cohors Lateran. I will be your sword, and your wings, as I defend your very life.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Ah, so tactics can help you overcome a more skilled opponent, huh?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you, Doctor. As your bodyguard, your approval is the best reward I can ask for.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'm ready.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: As the leader, it's my responsibility to keep everyone safe.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Watch the friendlies!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Keep your guard up!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Got it.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Ready for overwatch.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Understood!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: You think you're faster than me?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: No move can escape my sight!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: My resolve lies with my spear!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I fight for the glory of Laterano!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Nothing can hold me back.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Like a wave crashing against an immovable stone, isn't it?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Regroup! I'll look out for the remaining enemies!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I can't... fall... yet!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Should I patrol this area?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Anything over there?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor... it feels like I'm abusing my position...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Lift the corners of my mouth, don't knit my eyebrows...good, hold steady, then ease my mind, relax... Okay, now get in and greet everyone… Ah! Doctor, you scared me. Um, Happy New Year!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: So today is your birthday, Doctor? Alright, happy birthday! I promise I'll see my guard duty through more vigilantly. Uh, I mean, if you're going to hold a birthday get-together like the Laterans do, then I'll ensure your safety, and take responsibility for the aftermath.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Someone once told me that the honor of protecting Laterano was the sole reason I fought. But now, I have more things to protect. My beliefs, my companions, and you. It all weighs heavier on my spear, but I will never let it slow down.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, can I borrow half of your desk? Thank you very much. Huff... Ah, it's a blueprint for a new electrical system. I need to get it drawn up by today. Are you busy too? Let's be partners in overtime, then?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I've been into electricity ever since I was a kid. Just listening to currents crackling really soothed me. Huh? You think that's weird?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You learn a lot when you're in Rhodes Island's Engineering Department. The Operators bring weapons and equipment from all over, all sorts of technological applications you've never seen before, and all of them worth plenty of research time. If I put more efforts to my work, I might be able to stay in the Engineering Department.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: This is 'Pillow,' a childhood friend of mine. Our family moved from somewhere way far all the way to Columbia, and I found myself very lonely at school. My mom gave me Pillow to keep me company. Oh, Doctor, you should know it can't speak!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I got into an accident while I was on a lone study out in the country, and was unable to contact the rescue team. Pillow and I had to make it all the way back to inhabited land on foot. After that... I didn't really want to go out doors.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My dreams... that I work well, and everyday is a nice day. Also, I want to buy a holiday villa in Sami, and after my parents are retired, they can live there together... yeah, I've gotta stay healthy, and keep on trucking until they retire.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Since I was little, my mom and dad would find time every year to take me to the tundras on vacation. We're all really into cold places! Although if I wanted to cover the cost for my own vacations, I'd have to go pick up work in the city again.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Haah, *yawn*... Sorry, Doctor, can I take a break here for a little bit...? Ever since this new project kicked off, the shift schedule's been completely crazy! I still have to go check over the base station later...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: To tell the truth, I've wanted to try going outdoors lately. I've gotten to know a lot of people in the same line as me at Rhodes Island, and I wanna experience more along with them. At least... I'm not ever going to be stuck on my own again, not now.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Oh, the Doctor's asleep…? Well, I'd better turn this machine down a bit. It's kind of loud…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, I'm an electrical engineer from Columbia, codename... Well, Closure suddenly started calling me 'Pudding', but I don't know if that's too weird...

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: So this is how professionals fight… Alright, I'd better put in some training if I'm gonna make it through this safely.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you for the recognition. I still have a ways to go compared to Rhodes Island's other Operators, so if there's any more high-effort work, throw it my way. If I just get enough sleep, I can hold out for some real long shifts.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Combat missions in the tundra? At this point, I think I can be of help. Doctor, thank you, and all of Rhodes Island for always encouraging me. I'd like to pitch in some of my own strength now.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'm being assigned to combat? Just give me a bit more time to get ready... I... I can do this.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I don't have much confidence in commanding, but I do know a thing or two about basic survival in the countryside.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Pillow, don't you go leaving my sight.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Getting shocked hurts, you know?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Yep... understood.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Phew—Pillow, let's do our best!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Waaaah, careful!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Alright, I... I'm up!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Collector on standby!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Electric diffusion!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Electric charge!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Live discharge!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Mission complete. Right now, I got the same feeling I get seeing a blueprint come perfectly to life. What a relief!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: That wasn't too bad of a job... heheh, can you put this in my evaluation?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Ugh... no. A discrepancy like this should be totally avoidable.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Everyone, orderly retreat, please! I don't want anyone to fall behind!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Phew, now where should I put Pillow...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh, careful, you'll get shocked!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Ahh... please don't throw out any of the pink household goods in the Engineering Department. Those are for overtime use!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, Happy New Year! Heheh, I'm going to take a few days off at a mountain resort nearby. There's a towering ski slope there, and hot springs, and ice fishing! Alright, see you la— The electrics need maintenance? Ohh... okay...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning, Doctor. *yawn*... I should probably catch up on some sleep.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Here's a doll for you, it looks just like my Pillow. Isn't it cute? It... It looks kind of like me? No it doesn't!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Closure says she has a surprise for everyone today. Soo… I hope you'll like the light show tonight, Doctor. Actually, the energy-saving proposal for the string lights was mine, which I worked a whole week of overtime on to... no, never mind...

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: File management? Alright, then. Teach me how. Okay... Sort them first. Like this? Then put them in order, by date… Uh. I tore the paper… S-Sorry. I didn't mean to.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Some of the people here. Don't you think they're a little too tall? No, I don't care. Not actually. How tall you are and how strong you are don't relate. I just need to bring every last one of them down.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: What's my tribe gonna do now that I'm gone? That's a dumb question. See who has the bigger fists. The biggest is the new leader. Then they're done. That's it.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I heard a lot about Gavial. Like how she can crush a rock with her abs, and tear a raging beast apart with one hand. Is she actually that strong? Stronger than Chief Blaze? Warfarin said if I get treatment from Gavial, I'll know firsthand how strong she is. It's worth a try... Hm? Doctor, why are you stopping me?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I came here to get stronger, and that hasn't changed. Not just Chief Blaze and Gavial, there's a lot of people here worth challenging... What? I look happy? You're right. I sort of like being here.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The Rhodes Islanders. They all think too much. You too, Doctor. You have to think about so many things every day. You must be tired. You're not? You have to do it? Hmm, I guess that's true. There's a lot of stuff only you know how to handle. So it has to be you... Alright then, keep it up. Shout any time you need me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, I need help. The flower basket up there. Get it down for me. What? You can't reach either? This sucks... Okay. I got an idea. How about I lift you up?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Zumama's going on the same mission as me this time? Don't worry. I won't pick a fight with her. We'll have lots of chances to settle our score. Also, if we started fighting, that would make things hard for you, right? Yeah. I don't want to do that to you.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: This flower. Don't you think it's pretty? I grew this one myself. Hey, why are you so surprised? I'm not so crazy about fighting that I only care about getting stronger. Having a hobby or two is completely normal, okay? You... You like it too? Then I'll give you this one. Not bad. It suits you.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, I picked a flower and... You're asleep? Aren't you lazy? I'll just put this flower on your head. Mm, looks pretty good.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: We meet again, huh. I'm the tallest, strongest warrior of my tribe, Flint. I hear you've got a lot of strong people around here? Great. I'll challenge them one by one. Oh, right. Do you know where I can find Chief Blaze?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Not bad. Very nice move. Doctor, I want to challenge this warrior! Where can I find him?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion? Sure, do whatever you want, but I can keep fighting like I was already, right?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, you. You've been thinking too much. Any enemies, we can hit them away with our fists! Come. Relax a little. You need to loosen up when it's time to take a rest. Do you want to come over here and lie down with me?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Got it. Shout for me when it's time to go.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: No problem. Leave it to me.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: We're going. Each of you, watch your cover. Don't leave any tracks.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Here comes the prey!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Let's do this.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Got it.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: One round, let's go.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Will you come one by one? Or all at once?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Heh. I've been waiting!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Taste my fist!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: That look in your eyes, it disgusts me.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Don't look down on me!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: You can find victory even without your fists? Heh. I guess that's your style...

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Good job. Didn't know it, but you really are skilled.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Tch. Just some weaklings. Let them go. They're not worth chasing.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Don't blame yourself. It's my fault. I'm still not strong enough.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Hey. Can I hang a sandbag or two in my room?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Uwah!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Huh? What are you doing squatting down over here? You want me to pat your head?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: So much food and so many presents... Say, how about ringing in the New Year with a nice boxing match? It would be hard on Medical? How come? They've got Gavial.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Let's pull it together. Anything you need me to help with today?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here, a pair of boxing gloves and a bouquet of flowers. Which one do you want? Both fights and flowers can lift your mood, and I want you to be happier. It really feels like you're being too hard on yourself. Oh, know what? I'll give you both. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I used to be determined to beat anyone who looked down on me. It wasn't until I came to Rhodes Island that I found there were a lot more ways to prove myself. Say, finishing a mission, helping others... Yeah, I learned a lot of new things here.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: C'mon, I'm no good with paperwork. You sure you want me here in the office? I'd be better out in the field. Wouldn't you rather I brought home some wins?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I fight for the Infected. Life for our people is rough, anyone with eyes can see that. It's just that most people don't give a damn about our lives. But I do, I care a lot. We've got so many operators here counting on me, and I'm NOT about to let them down.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The reason I work for Rhodes Island? Because I've got nowhere better to be, naturally. But I've gotta be honest, I can't think of any place better than here. The pay's good, the medical treatment is cutting edge, and we've even got a cute little rabbit. It's just brilliant. What could be better?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I'm one of Rhodes Island's frontline breachers, I don't have powerful Arts that wipe the field, and it's not like my combat techniques could down a whole army. But, if I combine the two things I'm good at, then BOOM! You get quick results. I think that's what they call a chemical reaction.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Amiya is one of the most talented fighters I've ever met. She keeps a clear head in any situation, and her Arts are enough to scare even me. You know, Doctor, I can't help but wonder, how did she get so good at fighting, as young as she is? Honestly, I wish she was picking up joyful, happy experiences, not the combat kind.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: If you need my help, no need to be shy - just say the word! You put your trust in me, and I return the favor. You command, I fight. It's symbiotic. Aw, look at us! We're the best partners in all Rhodes Island! Oh, don't tell Amiya I said that.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The crew's been buzzing about who you used to be, before your memory loss. They were talking back before I even met you. It looks to me like you aren't the same person anymore. Soooo, I guess I'm talking about two different Doctors? Past Doctor and Present Doctor, hah!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Dr. Kal'tsit says you're going to really shoulder responsibility for Rhodes Island someday. She saved my life, and I trust her. She also asked me to decide what kind of person you are for myself. And I'm going to do that, at least until Oripathy takes my life.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Hey, Doctor, pass me that towel, would you? Yeah, just finished training. I need at least six hours every day to stay combat-ready. Gotta roll out whenever the order comes in, you know. Alright, I've kept you waiting long enough. So where are we going this time? If that's the plan, I guess you're picking up the tab?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Would people get the wrong idea if I carried the Doctor to bed? Maybe I'm better off leaving well enough alone…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Rhodes Island Operator, Blaze, reporting in. Here, the authorization letter signed by Dr. Kal'tsit. Now I'm under your direct command. Alrighty, Doctor, let's show the other squads what we can do!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I've seen a lot of battles like this. But tougher times might still be ahead of us.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Hehe, can you feel the air getting hotter? No? Reeaaally? Then I'd better kick things up a notch. Aww, I was trying to get you fired up.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Us Rhodes Island Operators put all our trust in Amiya, Dr. Kal'tsit, and you, Present Doctor. Because you've never given up on any of us. Fighting for the Infected is the right thing to do. It's worth it, Doctor.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Time for combat? Count me in!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Alright, I'm the leader, huh? I got this, I know all about wiping out hostiles!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Us frontline breachers have high standards. Try to keep up!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: It may be a little gruesome, but I love shredding steel and crushing bunkers!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: You know, it wasn't easy learning high-temperature vapor dynamics!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Let me show you the chainsaw techniques the other elite operators taught me!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: This place could use some heat.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Hear the roar of my chainsaw!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Don't worry if you see fire, that's just a side effect!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Surrender now if you don't want to get sawed in half!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: My blood's only gonna make this place hotter!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Fresh blood coats my saw, and boils the whole battlefield!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: No sacrifice is meaningless, and no victory comes without a cost.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The rights of the Infected will only be won by the actions of the Infected!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Let's work harder next time. We can always do better, right?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Let's just say luck wasn't on our side this time.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Any new facilities at Rhodes Island this time?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hey, knock that off!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Wait a second! I'm way too sweaty!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: 'Scuse me!—Oh, hey, Doctor, Happy New Year, one sec, I gotta get all three of these drink crates to the canteen, and then move the movie projector for 'em—ah—and a few offices need decorating... and then I'll come back for you! Hey, Amiya just passed by, I gotta drag her over to get her height measured!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, when are we heading out on our next mission?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Here's an extra-extra-large cake for you! Yeah, I can't hold birthday parties of my own, so you got the kind of cake I wanna eat. Any other presents you'd like? I don't mind if it's a tricky request. I could carry you twenty clicks to find the right shop!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I don't have such crazy Arts, but reading this mission summary for the year, I've been in a bunch of tough battles, huh? Sure saved a ton of Infected too... You're worried for my health? Hey, what's to worry about? My stamina training figures are always on the rise.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hm? Need a hand, Doctor? Or you got something interesting for me?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Do you know how wild it is, as a Kazimierz Knight, to see a 'company' actually trying so hard to treat Infected? It's a mind-melter, trust me. Yeah, seriously. Justyna still keeps wondering how Rhodes Island turns a profit.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, question? Can I take a look at Operator Nearl's battle records? Uh, no, I'm just a little curious—yeah? Thanks, Doctor! Let's see, uh... oh, man. Maybe I oughta tell Iwona to push back her sparring with Nearl…

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Ashley and me? We met through the Major. I just got a feeling we could get along. So I took it upon myself to talk to her after the match. Jeez, thinking about it, I've got a talent for scouting, don't I?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Platinum,' huh. I know what happened with her after, but still, no plans to be her friend. Y'know, before, we said the Armorless Union, and the General Chamber of Commerce, were our greatest enemies. But to be real... ha, it's the whole age we live in we're dissenting against.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The titans we call cities rumble forth. As people live on their backs, neon outshines the moonlight, and car engine silences bug chirps with its deafening rumbles. Too much gets tossed away, flattened undertread. Those people, they all deserve a different life... a better one. Infected or not, Doctor, we all oughta be searching for a new way forward.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor! Heard from Gravel and Amiya, you faced off with the Armorless Union during the Major? And you're the one who sniffed out the Area 0 plot? How'd you—wait, hold on, lemme bring a chair over and get some snacks while I'm at it. Alright, Teach! Take it away!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Before I met Ashley, I honestly figured I'd be fine if I just kept living. But now, with Justyna, Iwona, Maria—and the Radiant Knight... I'm prepared to fight alongside them. Throw that life of mine out there for them. It's why I fight on.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Maybe one day, when everyone figures out what 'Knight' deep inside their hearts really holds for them , and knights truly retire from the stage, Kazimierz can be peaceful in the truest sense. The Radiant Knight, she told me these words, and they spurred me into seeing more and further with my eyes. Maybe there's more I should be doing, you know.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Take a rest, Doctor. Man, I wonder what Ashley and the others are up to right now.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Leader, Flametail Knight, Sona! You're the Doctor? Mmm, well, you're kinda not like I imagined, but hey. I'm under your wing from here on out, Doctor!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Huh. The stuff you watch for real combat's pretty crazy different from the Major.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: It's a first for me to get promoted without commercials or camera flashes. Well, Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Leader, Flametail Knight, Sona! Continuing the stride!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I used to worry how an ever-heartless fight would lead us all down a messed-up way, but now... heheh, I guess ideals are something you oughta have. Aren't they, Doctor?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Ashley not gonna come with?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Flametail' Sona, spearheading and rolling out!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Live up to duty!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Enemy spotted. It'll be nice if they entered single file like the Knights do, though.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Any instructions for me?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Feels fresh every time when someone gives me orders.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Can your eyes keep up?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: A new challenge!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: C'mon, let's pick up the pace.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Haha, losing sight?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Feels bad to lose your target, doesn't it?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: 'Tail like a shooting star,' that's what they say.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Maybe our life and times will make its own choice for us. But right now, we can only choose to fight to the last. Because we're Knights, because we're Infected. Because we're alive.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We've won a lot of times before, Doctor. Here and now, though, we're struggling for our own destiny, our own future. That's the real fight, isn't it?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: This sure as hell isn't a competition, Doctor. Letting them off easy's not gonna win the crowd over, y'know?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Everyone, retreat! Let me hold the rear! Don't worry, I'm an expert in escaping the pursuits.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Wow, this sure beats the Grand Knight Territory sewers. Guesstimating a couple hundred times better?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hyah!? What?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You're wondering how I usually dress? Mm, uhh... ahaha...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Never woulda expected I'd be spending New Year's at Rhodes Island... nah, not like I miss my days in the Grand Knight Territory. Who's gonna go and miss getting hunted, right? I'm just closing my eyes, seeing the broke and Infected celebrating the New Year, under that skyscraper's shadow. The looks on their faces. I still remember it even now.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Morning to you, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, please take this emblem of Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub handmade by myself! From now on, you are an honorary member of us. Thank you for all the things you've done for the Infected. And happy birthday to you!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: What a bustling day. Ashley's been busy signing her autographs for the fans, Justyna's playing her grass whistle, and Iwona and Justice Knight are also having fun with other buggies. It's been a while since the last time I saw such smiles on their faces. Good to see they enjoy themselves again, and it's all thanks to you, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I wouldn't dare boast of my prowess with a sword or Arts, but if you have any problems with equipment maintenance, you can come talk to me!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Zofia is my distant aunt, as well as my swordsmanship instructor. It's thanks to her that I can survive in the knight sports scene, but my aunt sometimes— Oh! I mean, my sister! Um, Doctor! Please don't tell her I let that slip, she's actually super sensitive about it!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, to be honest, I'm a much better craftsman than I am a knight! Whether it's repairing an alarm clock or forging armor, I can help! So, Doctor... Can you please take me to see Vulcan's and Closure's workshops? Pleeeeease.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Those two Sarkaz ladies seem hard to talk to... But if my sister trusts them so much, they must be very good people. The Radiant Knight fighting alongside the Sarkaz for the sake of the Infected... Unbelievable! That sounds even more exciting than a breaking news headline!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Actually, I never got an official title like my sister's 'Radiant Knight.' 'Blemishine' is just the codename I chose for myself... But if I was to continue down the path of knighthood, maybe Blemishine wouldn't be a bad name.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Kazimierz's knight sports are nothing more than a huge commercial game, and we all eat out of its palm. I didn't realize it until after I came to Rhodes Island. But the trouble with Kazimierz may run deeper than its betrayal of the knightly traditions... much, much deeper.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
