voices.text: Compared to competition knights, Rhodes Island operators are way more like the traditional knights in the novels. In fact, I've been pretty obsessed with these knight novels for a long time. Knights, enemies, adventures, and treasures... But I guess everyone can get that stuff from knight sports, so the novels aren't as big as they used to be.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: When I first saw my sister after all this time, it was like she was a totally different person. Instead of that dazzling, blinding light she used to give off, she was more like the gentle sun, warm and stalwart. Did she change for Rhodes Island? Then I want to see for myself what my sister found here!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I couldn't become a real knight, but maybe that's why I was able to get a better view of the lands. I might have more insight now because of it. 'To be a knight is to be the noble light that illuminates the land.' {@nickname}, you will bear witness to my resolve.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor? Oh, you fell asleep. I wonder if you also have dreams.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Kazimierz knight, codename 'Blemishine.' I've heard all about you from my sister, Doctor. You can just call me Maria if you want.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Wait, hold on... Gosh, you can do it like that?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion...? Hehe, for the glory of the Nearl family, I'll continue to give it my all!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I just realized it's all older folks around me, and I don't really have any friends around to ask... So, Doctor? What do you think about this equipment I made for myself? Pretty cool, yeah? Does it look good on me?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Blemishine will not disappoint!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Captain? Me? B-B-But I don't have any experience with team battles…

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Leave the front to me!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Our family motto is, 'fear neither hardship nor darkness!'

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: All ready.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Pray for the coming battle.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Forward! Into the battle!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: The light holds resolute here!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Light, heed me!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I am here for you!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Don't worry!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You will repent!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Small as it may be... our light persisted until the end!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Each victory will become a light that illuminates the path forward. Doctor, you've done well!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: This... this isn't over yet!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'll protect the wounded. Take the others and retreat, quickly!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: So this is the inside of Rhodes Island... Aw, I'd really love to see the schematics…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Woah! Don't scare me like that...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor! Shh! I snuck over here to hide from Auntie Zofia. Hehe, let me take the day off!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Kazimierz will have already auctioned off the 'firework rights' by now. But rather than a flashy fireworks show, thank-you letters to my grandfather made a deeper impression on me. The kid he saved from the war grew up, started a family, and came to Kazimierz to see him. Margaret was also really happy that day.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Oh, hey there, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I've made you all sorts of gifts, Doctor. Metal mask, swords, other things… But I guess you don't have much use for them. Why don't you choose something you'd like to display in your office? Ahahah... Sorry... I really only know how to craft knight stuff, I haven't figured out what to do for Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: What exactly should the Golden Pegasus coat of arms symbolize? I'm not nearly as clear on that as my sister. I never got the chance to learn much from our ailing grandfather. But I still think... people can recognize a sublime spirit, and naturally look up to it, even outside Kazimierz.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: These documents won't take me long to take care of. Why don't you show me Rhodes Island's old business contracts? You never know what kind of restitutions there might be hidden in a contract's terms.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, when you work out your business plans, feel free to put off the legal ramifications till the very end. I've never lost a case as a defense attorney.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Huh? Even that ice-cold Młynar is here? And here I thought he'd want a breather after leaving his job behind in the Grand Knight Territory. Well, Rhodes Island isn't a bad place. At least they don't expect you to wine-and-dine clients here. Otherwise, considering his alcohol tolerance...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Is that a Kazimierzian newspaper you're reading, Doctor? 'Despite Conclusive Evidence, Knight Sports Match Fixers Found Innocent'—Oh, I was in charge of that case. What does that mean? Hehe, if they walked away scot-free, then obviously the evidence wasn't conclusive enough.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I've never actually worked for a multinational corporation before, so I've been reading up on other countries' laws, too. But no matter where you are, the lawbooks make it clear as day who benefits under their rules.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The courtroom is a place of victory and defeat. Both sides submit their evidence, and their disputes are arbitrated within the confines of the law. I never expected to find any justice in that process, but when the law can be freely trampled on by capitalism, being a lawyer gets real boring, don't you think?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Ugh, my back hurts. I kind of want a massage chair, but money's tight with my current salary. But considering Rhodes Island's revenue, I suppose the pay isn't completely unreasonable—Speaking of which, what do you think of my plan to demand compensation from companies we've worked with? What? How can it be extortion when we're asking for pocket change?!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, I think there are a lot of problems with the medical malpractice liability clauses in Rhodes Island's contracts. In most countries, we as a medical company wouldn't be liable for a lot of the scenarios listed in there—You don't want to fix it? Alright, I'll give it some more thought.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I'm slowly starting to understand that expecting the law be able to judge all disputes fairly isn't just naive, it's intellectually lazy. The law is not perfect, and it will always be riddled with holes that we need to fill with humanity.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: So even the Doctor likes to sleep at the desk, just like me. I'll be worried about your spine if this keeps up, though…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, my name is Deszcz. I'm your new legal consultant. If you need to call me by a codename, then use Proviso. Let me get this out of the way first, though. The general practice of obfuscating all your employees' identities isn't going to fly with me.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: If you're putting me in charge, I can make sure the enemies will be liable for all damages.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Let me take a look at the new contract... Alright, everything checks out. My salary did go up. Thanks!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: If you're letting me read these high clearance level materials, this is going way beyond a normal partnership, isn't it...? Thanks for your trust, Doctor. I hope I'll be able to accomplish with law what I never could before I came here.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'm glad to help, but before we get started, can we be more explicit with regards to the terms of compensation?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Everyone, please be sure to handle the work you're assigned. Do not give our opponents any loopholes.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The court is now in session!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I've gathered enough materials on our opponents. They will lose this case.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I never prepare drafts.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Ahem. Allow me to present my argument.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: If you are not party to this suit, please leave at once.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Order! The court will soon reach a verdict.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Hold it! The evidence submitted by the opposing party is suspect.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Objection! The witness's testimony is self-contradictory.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Anything you say can and will be used against you. I suggest you exercise your right to remain silent.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Based on the above, you are found guilty.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: No surprise there. As long as you understand how to use the system, the results follow naturally.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I take it I met your expectations, Doctor? Now, per our contract, let's discuss legal fees.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Don't worry, we'll get this case thrown out and win the retrial.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Something must've gone wrong somewhere... I won't let this kind of failure happen again.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Can I apply for a more comfortable chair?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, I took a photo of what you just did as evidence.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I wanted to treat myself to a gift at the end of the year, only to find myself completely broke. This would've been unthinkable at my old job... Oh, whatever. It's a new year. Better not dwell on the past. Happy New Year, Doctor!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. I'm happy to report that Rhodes Island is not currently involved in any legal disputes, for now.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. These scales of justice are a graduation gift I got from my law school. Take them. Not that I don't want them anymore, but I just thought it would be more meaningful for you to keep them in your room.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Taking in patients with a incurable disease feels just like taking on an unwinnable case... That said, I also believe that the value of doing something isn't determined entirely by the results. Keep it up, Doctor, and let me deal with all those pesky corporate rivals.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: If you need your room cleaned, I'd be glad to help, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You seem really interested in my tail, don't you? You say it's furry and looks cute? Well, wanna touch it? No one else has a tail like this, you know!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Water is precious in the wild. Rhodes Island is in no danger of having a drought right now, but that doesn't mean we should waste water.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: It's my duty to search for and rescue those who encounter Catastrophes. I rarely find any survivors though...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Retrieving beacons, exploring mineral deposits, and recycling... Then we can call it a day!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Mr. Grape is my buddy and a capable partner I can rely on! Where he came from, you ask?... Uh, hmm... Now that's a good question. Where did we first meet?...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: W-what's with that red one...? I... can't stop trembling... uh... Doctor, can you lend me your arm? I'd feel much safer that way...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Those who do Catastrophe relief work often develop all kinds of mutations. What mutation do I have? Well, it's better not to ask. The more you know, the more dangerous it gets for you, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Catastrophe relief workers in the wilderness... don't usually come out unscathed. No need to worry about me, though! I'm already very happy to have a chance to rest at Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Aw, falling asleep in this kinda place again... Guess 'safety' isn't a part of your vocabulary.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Provence, your average Catastrophe relief worker. Hmm, why are you staring at me like that? Interested in my tail?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: So... does this bring me closer to what you imagined I should be?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: It's fun working with you, Doctor!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I sense a storm approaching Rhodes Island. But don't worry, leave the evacuation to me! I'm an expert at Catastrophe prevention!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Who will I be teaming up with this time?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Don't worry. Everything will be fine.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: My job is to bring everyone home safely.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I despise natural Catastrophes and enemies equally!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Is it my turn?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I am in peak condition!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Let's greet 'em with a warning shot.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Arrows loaded. Ready to go!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I've warned ya! Now time for Crowd Control!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Pinpointing enemy weakness!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I'll distract the enemy.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: The wilderness has its own rules.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Compared to natural Catastrophes, these enemies are really powerless.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Disaster assessment report: we received zero damage!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Everyone worked hard. Even if we suffered some damage,  let's not be discouraged!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Aw... my assessment was off. This'll leave a spot on my record for sure...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It'd be nice to have a room to rest in!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh, Doctor?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I've got a fluffy tail~ a fluffy tail~♪

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I'm measuring my tail, because I think it's grown since the last time I checked... Could you hold the tip for me? And here's a ruler... let me see...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Oh, good morning, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: This is the kind of day to try new things, Doctor. Trust me, the memories you make on birthdays will last a lifetime. I've already looked up the weather and lay of the land, and I've got backpacks ready to go. Let's head on an adventure for a couple of days!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Stopping Catastrophes is still beyond me. We might not have a real solution for decades, even centuries. But what I hope for right now is to save as many as I can, from both Catastrophe and those who would exploit it.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Stand guard? How annoying... Fine.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: That Amiya girl is one of this place's leaders? What a black-hearted company Rhodes Island is.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I'm not about to freeload here. Just let me know if you need some elbow grease.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I have nothing against taking orders, but I don't like fighting without knowing why I'm doing it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My hobbies? Why should I tell you? Ugh... Alright, alright, I'll tell you. Just stop making that face... I like tinkering.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Without Chiave and Aosta, I'd be a corpse in an alley. I owe them my life. So no matter what they want, I'll help them without a second thought.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I don't hate you, but... I find it difficult to fully trust you.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Do what you're told, keep the wolf from the door, live life. They all seemed like simple ideas once to me... But Aosta was right. In a country like Siracusa, things like those aren't ideas, they're dreams.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I gotta say, your leadership skills are decent... But Aosta once said that an organization turns rotten when people let their guard down. So, I'll be keeping a close eye on you.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Asleep? What a carefree Doctor... Gah, where'd the blanket go…?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Since Chiave decided I'm joining you, I don't have much else to say. You can call me Broca. I'll follow your orders, but don't count on me doing anything extra. I have no love for big organizations like yours.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Thanks.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A raise...? Don't particularly need one.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Maybe Aosta was right, maybe Rhodes Island is actually trustworthy. And if so…

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Alright.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: ...I'm not good at leading.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's go.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Time to fight.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Don't try to micromanage me.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Tch... Got it.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Are those the enemies?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I can handle it.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: This won't hurt for long.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Let's get this over with.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Die, you moron!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Shaddap you face.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Alright… You've got a few tricks.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: They've all been taken care of.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Need me to go after them?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Relax. You did what you could. Even Aosta makes mistakes.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I'll take a look around.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hey…!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You're pretty annoying, Doctor.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor... What? I have to pay for my freeloading. Besides, occasions like these are incredible to me. Comparing to my time in Siracusa, Rhodes Island is decent.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Morning.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I've never given anyone a present before, so I'm not too good at picking. Aosta said I should make one myself. Here, it's a block of carving wood, anti-mold treated by me. Tung oil, stops it rotting. When I'm not around, you can move it in front of your desk, and treat it like I'm supervising you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I didn't think I'd run into you here. I just finished cleaning up my workbench— there's been a lot of orders in for weapons lately. Why haven't I been supervising you lately? Because you don't seem like you're about to turn rotten these days. And I approve of your goals. Let's work hard together, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Want to listen to some music? I'll lend you my headphones.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Sorry, please keep a little distance from me.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I never imagined that I'd have the chance to become a rescue worker.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I picked up this axe a long time ago, maybe even before I learned to read.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The songs I like are probably not so popular. They're only good for humming to myself when I'm alone.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Don't blink—you have but one moment to witness this epic move.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Want something to drink? My treat. You should relax a bit after work, you know.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I only realized how precious life is after everyone around me died, one by one. Ironic, huh? I think so, too.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I'm a mercenary. I just do my job. As for the purpose of my mission and its consequences, I don't have a say in any of that. So, from now on, all my responsibilities are your concern.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Dun... dun dun♪dun... dun dun...♪

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Frostleaf, former mercenary. From now on, I'm your operator. Assign me any job you want, I can do pretty much anything.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Thanks.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Things are on the right track now.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Whew... not bad. Feeling fulfilled for the first time in a while.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'll do my job.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Go your own ways and do your own jobs.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Great, I feel like some exercise.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: You will shatter.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Your orders?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: This should work.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Hm, okay.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: My bodily fluids aren't the only thing that's chilling.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Extend my edge!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Life, brittle as frost, fragile like leaves.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Let's chill down some hot heads.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I've been through countless battles... seen the carnage, witnessed the silent nothingness at the end.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I remember every enemy I fought. Not a single one escapes.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We didn't lose anyone, did we?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'll hold up the rear.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I'd like... a more private space.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ow.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: How about a drink?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I never celebrated any holiday like this before coming to Rhodes Island. Even on a peaceful New Year's, I wouldn't have a room as safe and warm as this... Sorry, Doctor, can I just—listen to some music on my own for a while? I'll come and catch you in a bit. Thank you.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Here's a charm I made for you. Inside it are some lyrics I extracted from a song, the one I always listen to when I'm feeling down. I hope it'll protect you from any hurt enemies might deal you. Oh, it's coming on too heavy? Not at all. Life's the most important thing, trust me on that.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: You don't need to be too worried. My past experiences weren't all bad. They taught me what living wrongly looked like. And my time at Rhodes Island has made me want to stick even harder with this all-new outlook, to explore even more unknown places across the lands. Maybe you'd wanna come with me, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Didn't notice me behind you, eh? It's only natural. I'm a cat. We're known for being silent prowlers!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Hey, don't touch my hat... it's crazy, you know! If it feeds you too many secrets, Doctor, you'll be in trouble.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: So rare to see a pharma take in runaway kitties from a jail. Did you all want a peek at my maps? Or,  was it some advice on prison breaks?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: We thieves have our own principles and standards too... perhaps. Who can say?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Meow, meow, meow... Meow? Never you mind, I'm just talking to myself.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Anytime you want. Don't you worry, I have friends everywhere. Eyes everywhere.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Curiosity can kill a cat, you know.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I'm in a good mood right now, so here's a riddle for you. 'Why is a raven like a writing desk?'

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Thank you, for this 'Haze' I'm now.But... did you catch a peep of any of them, along the way? Any of, well... my secrets?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Asleep like a baby... Time to get 'meown to business,' then.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, I'm Haze. I like relaxing work environments, and an employer who knows better than to bother me with too many questions.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Yummy.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion? What's that? Does it taste good?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Finally out of those old shackles... and here I am, straight into new ones. The destiny of a thief's no wonder.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Give me a bit of freedom and I'll be happy.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: What do we need a leader for? Can't everyone just fight on their own?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Meow... It's driving me wild... this sweet, sweet smell of freedom!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Everyone, no need to have cold feet here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Meow?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Here we go.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Out and about.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Like a shadow.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: How do nya like this?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Careful, kittens. Don't lose your mittens.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You think you've got all the trimmings, don't you?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Nah-ah-ah, Don't get carried away.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: No one stands above a kitty in the end!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Perfect victory? Whatever. A victory's a victory afterall.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Do you know how many enemies you let go? That will be a spanner in the works.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'm no stranger to running for it, but this is just too embarrassing...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Kotatsu. Where's the kotatsu?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Meow?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Meow? I'm not satisfied yet. You know my rule: if I can't have it, I want it.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: New year? A year is such a long time for a kitty. And happiness won't come knocking if one worries about more than just today. Speaking of which, today is really nice for napping. Doctor, how about we just spend this day with some lazy, cozy naps.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, nice to meet nya.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Meow? My best wishes aren't enough? Don't tell me you want some presents, you greedy kitty. Well then, what do you want? Shall I give you a riddle, or allow you to rub my ears?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: A kitty visits gardens that provide food. But if someone tries to lock the kitty up, it will surely run away. When the kitty's in a good mood, however, it can bring back some tasty stuff as thanks. Know what I mean, Doctor? Be sure to make Rhodes Island a garden that everyone likes.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: That's a huge stack of documents... I can lend you a hand if you're struggling to clear them, Doctor… Oh, sorry. I should be on standby waiting for your request.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Hildegard doesn't care how Leithanians think of her, and I'm not some civil servant mincing words for her. It's just that we've been together for a long time now, so I'm able to stand in for her on unofficial occasions, to speak words she's not at liberty to speak, or meet people unsuitable for her to see.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: That must have been Federico earlier... He's also the type to think of normal conversation as stepping on glass. But once you know them long enough, you'll be able to understand what they're perplexed with, or what they're chasing after. My advice? Get used to awkward silence.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I just heard some people discussing my age, but I don't see the issue, really. I met a sickly fellow in Zwillingstürme. He was younger than me by a few months, but he's skating on thin ice every day due to his status as Graf... Well, at least I don't have to worry about my own safety like that.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: 'Wolfgang, everything you say and do will affect Wulfsburg's future.' That's what I told myself back then. My life is my answer sheet, which I keep neat. But the problem is... maybe not everything has to be treated as an exam... Um, I still seem tense, even now?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Thank you for your concern, but I don't mind Hildegard's disappearance at all. She told me the enclosure of war was built so that it could be torn down in the future without any worries. She must have been somewhat aware of it that day, but she still... Anyway, my mission isn't over yet, and I remain her envoy still.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, why are fowlbeasts unable to touch the stars no matter how far they fly? Uh, no, I'm just used to breaking the silence when it gets too quiet. Please pay me no heed. I don't think the answer's that important...? It's because they can't even fly right when they're... Ahem, seeing stars.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Didn't I soundproof the room with Arts...? This castanet? It's a gift from Lieselotte, given during my first audience with her. When I was living in the Spire, I would kick it at the books in my room. Knocking them down one by one, then put them back before the sun came up. It's normal for me to be childish at my age, isn't it?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You two are so similar... Sorry for disturbing you with my sudden words, Doctor... I was just thinking about how you and Hildegard are so alike. Both of you shoulder so many responsibilities in silence, and I can't tell when to step in. Can I help you? Or... can you help me?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: My tuba? Of course I can play it... Speaking of which, can you play the piano? Can you practice with me when you're free?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor, I am here at the behest of Empress Hildegard of Leithanien, and I hope to maintain friendly relations with you. I can act as a your Messenger, and perform music for you as well.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I've already seen this... Hold on, I have some old recordings of the annual Kaiserinnensfest. Would you like to watch them together with me?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Phew... Seems like I haven't disappointed you. Uh, Doctor. Should I be acting more nonchalant about this?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Mm... I'm glad to have met your expectations.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'll follow your baton for the time being.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I knew you were too lazy to show up, so I went to run some errands... I'm very much used to this.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: A music score or a battle plan—you have to give me one of those at least.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Hm. Dissonances.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Opening with a tuba? A rare arrangement.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Am I the only tuba in your band?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'll warm up my fingers first.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll join in the performance at the right section.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Can you hear it, the restorative vigor of that fortissimo?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Can you feel it, the melodious emotions of that pianissimo?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: A shrill howl? That's what happens when you mess up while performing.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Out of my way, or I'll shove your head up this tuba.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: While the tuba is one of the most difficult instruments to play, I'm sure I'll get somewhat proficient at it in time. But you, you seem like a musician who was born proficient with all kinds of instruments... Life is so unfair.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Your ingenuity put to shame any conductor I've seen.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: How does one keep their musicality in tip-top shape? Practice. A flawed performance simply means you haven't practiced enough.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Did we fail? I don't think so. People like you usually factor failure into your plans, yes?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: The soundproofing here should be decent...?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ahh... you gave me a fright.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, I'm just about to replace the bell on my tuba. Can you lend me a hand?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The new year was just a month away when I left Wulfsburg. They said we had to hurry to meet Their Majesties so we could make it to the annual celebration in Zwillingstürme. I was practicing the whole way, but... I really liked that piece though.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Are you resting well, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Your seat is here. Yes, right here, in the center of the front row. Miss Orchid had me arrange an ensemble with the children on Rhodes Island, and, um, I'm one of the performers too... This is not a birthday gift, but I'd like your opinions on the performance.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The annual Kaiserinnensfest is always a stunning event. The Royal Orchestra performs to the people, and it closes with a grand ensemble on the covered bridge for Their Majesties. The main reason we hold it every year is to make everyone believe in the path under their feet. Rhodes Island doesn't have celebrations as grand as that, but your footsteps are still full of conviction.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Why is this history book only half-written? Because it is waiting to be filled with the wars yet to come. Those Sarkaz who march off to their deaths will be nothing but footnotes. Speak your mind, Doctor. You might just as well leave behind some unique commentary on this segment of history.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I was the one who killed Scout. We made a 'transaction,' then I jammed my sword through through his heart. Mercenaries like us could put a price on anything. Hmph, the most unfair part of the deal was that I had to keep on living.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: A pathetic soul looking to crawl up out of the quagmire? Ines is right. Still, when the mire wanted to drag me under, I realized there was no escape. For most Sarkaz, they'd find only hatred-borne victories to swallow when they're hungry for revenge. But I refuse to believe it's the way it should be, and I won't stop finding for us a true path to freedom.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: When I was young, my mother taught me to read and write Sarkaz. I still remember that volume of 'Qui'lon's Expedition' she kept on her, its ink smudged with some guy's blood... She died of Oripathy. As for the book, it's gonna carry our hopes and tears, until time wears it out.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: While I was in prison, I liked to kill time by debating a scholar, an old Feline in the next cell over. Our conversations usually ended with him trying to prove that Victoria was more civilized than Kazdel. Eventually, he failed to prove it before the Sarkaz guards executed him. I should say it's not something I feel happy about.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Most of the Sarkaz history books I collected have been lost. Whether burned to ash or cast aside in action like worthless scraps, their whereabouts hardly piqued anyone else's curiosity. But... for better or for worse, we have other ways to remember history.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: No, it's nothing... Fine, 'Introduction to Accounting Practice,' borrowed it from the library. Ines says that all you need to know to open a shop is how to collect money and give change, and now I'm a little surprised to find out she's right. Well, I won't call this a waste of effort. At the very least...there's no harm in having some idle thoughts.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Can you guess who made these salted potatoes? W, Yeah. Hard to believe, huh? She actually cooks a lot more than Ines does. Try one, they're not bad. Mercenaries are good at taking lives, but there's a limit to one's energy. To hone our craft, we have to set aside everything else.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: What were you like back then? My lips are sealed, Doctor. Oftentimes, getting to forget is a gift. Make no mistake, I'm not suggesting you were a good person or some kind of bastard. People always expect things to 'return to the way they were,' whether it's about circumstances or people. However, amnesia won't give anyone a clean restart of life.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Seems like a lifetime ago...  Only that room with the swaying white curtains is long gone.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: A nostalgic place, Doctor. As for this commission of yours, I trust we can both set aside its details for the moment. I do have some other ideas on the rewards, though, beyond the bounty itself.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Is this your upgraded training regimen? Hmm, it's definitely safer for the masses, but I'd do better with something more direct.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I don't need these, Doctor. But if you insist on some sort of reward... you think I could teach a class to the children here in my free time? No, not to teach military history. I just want to share with them... some Sarkaz folk songs.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Medals and titles give people an illusion of some kind of irreplaceable responsibility. Most times, though, it begets nothing but ruination. That's true for 'elite,' 'leader,' 'king'... and even 'the Lord of Fiends.'

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: If conflict is unavoidable, a swift end is a form of mercy.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I only hope this is temporary. It's not really my thing.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Embers will hide our footsteps.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: ...War never changes.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Don't doubt your own judgment.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Seize the moment.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Order acknowledged.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Same battlefield, different day.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Eyes blind by hatred.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Sense deprived by ember.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: The battlefield's all around you. Where do you think you're running?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Enough. Time to end this.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: One great victory isn't enough to tip the balance, but it can buy you a moment of respite. You may catch a breath now.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A single military victory means nothing in the face of what we're putting a stop to.  This is just a nuisance we've cleared aside.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Why the long face, Doctor? Our heads are still sitting on our shoulders. As for them, don't worry, I'll take care of that for you.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Less guys on your case isn't such a bad thing, is it?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Ines and W? They're here too?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: You… Anything else you want to know?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I don't have time for small talk. If you want fun and games, go look for W. Huh, so I'm not the only one who just got kicked out.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Fireworks at the New Year's party? Looks like you folks are giving W a perfect opportunity to indulge herself. Oh, I'll take care of that... Call Ines over too. Can't let her stay hidden during times like these, she'll force me to clean up the mess myself.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Didn't see you there. I was just... thinking about the future.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Most Sarkaz... don't put a whole lot of stock in the process of getting older. They may forget a lot across the span of their long lives, but if you carefully listen to the way they describe the many oddities of life, you'll quickly find that the one thing never missing is the chapter in commemoration of suffering.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Babel was once the ideal home of the Sarkaz sailing the ruins. Her Highness thought she failed, but you're proof that the road hasn't reached its end. It continues to stretch on... I really hope to see what you'll show us, when all is said and done, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Do you think me Lady of the Office? This is work for grown-ups.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Don't take Iris's songs so literally. They're meant for the young ones, you know. What? Yes, I'm the guard with the scissors—what about it? Chop-chop? That's the sound of me making clothes—what did YOU think it was? Huh... adults, honestly. So eager to assume the worst.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Preservation techniques? Huh, fat chance. Even Iris hasn't the faintest clue about how I safekeep things. Why should I let YOU know?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Let me introduce Annie to you. She's my very best friend, and another 'me.'

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Don't ask me. I don't know why the Castle takes deposits from everywhere, just to send them back out. Granny wants me doing it, so I do. Don't you know? I hear adults call that work. It's when someone has to do it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Annie's just the quiet sort, nothing at all like me. C-Controlling her? What are you talking about? She's a whole person, she goes where she wants to! She's only by my side because she likes being with me. That's what best friends do. Isn't it, Annie? 'Mm.'

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: With all the children here, it's no wonder Iris doesn't want to leave. Hrmm... if this carries on, we'd be better off plonking the whole Castle of Dreams here onto Rhodes Island. That'd save so much time and effort.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Good girl this and good girl that, are you saying that I'm not good?—Well, I suppose sometimes you can't just do as you please. You have to 'act' a little, Granny says. Act how? Well... 'My greetings to you. I come from the County of Linton. Bena is my name.' Something like that, you know!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Granny brought me into the Castle when I was young, and I grew up there, and once she retired, I took over her whole job. What could I have in common with Iris, Little Miss Heir-to-the-Castle? What, you think I'm jealous? Dream on! Iris has to watch her figure, but me? I can eat all I want without putting on a pound!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: 'Rest soundly. Doctor.' Who cares about that Doctor? Come on, let's go out and play! 'Alright.'

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Bena, and I was here to fetch an idiot who went out and forgot to come home. But I hear she still has things to do, so I'll just stay a while and keep her company.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Oh, you can't show something this violent to Annie and me.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Ah-hah! See, you do know how to play by children's rules!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Annie, are you ready? We're going to show this hooded hoodlum what our Arts are made of! 'Alright, Bena.'

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Two people for a single job. This won't be tricky.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Attention, please! Annie's told me of some brilliant ideas.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's just take it like a walk in the forest.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: So you want to pull these toys apart too?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hehehee.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Don't you rush me!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Annie, don't go too far.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Have to be careful, now.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: It's trimming time!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Chop-chop!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Whatever breaks needs a fixing.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: If there's no fixing it, smash it to pieces.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: What did you expect? I'm a dab hand at doing bad things to bad people!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: No one else in need of a trim?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Leave the rest to the adults, then. We're going home.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Annie, where are you?!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Hang on, this room's a little small. We're two people here.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Wagh!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Annie's off on an adventure. Want to come along?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Well, happy New Year to you. Annie and I are taking our crack at the Yanese lantern tradition. This one's for Granny, may she live a long and healthy life. And this one's for you, may you... err... you know what, make your own wish...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey, no hiding things! What's that you're playing with?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: It just baffles me! How can you all be so happy to have your birthdays? One year older is one year further from your childhood innocence. Honestly... here, a new pillow for you. Take it and dream sweet dreams. I wish that you keep that child at heart of yours alive... forever and ever.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: It's all over the shop today, isn't it! Let me take some photos for you. One, two... Good, these merry moments are safe and sound now. If you ever want to relive the memories of today, just come see me at the Castle.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: It's been a long time since I've felt like there was any conviction or meaning in my work. Rather than sit through show trial after show trial, I prefer to wade through these thorny, complicated files.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: It's been a long time since I've felt like there was any conviction or meaning in my work. Rather than sit through show trial after show trial, I prefer to wade through these thorny, complicated files.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You don't have to tiptoe around me. I don't judge good or evil on any ironclad law. And with all the crimes staged in the name of order… Ah, pay no mind to this judge's grumble, a powerless judge waiting to be indicted for misconduct in office.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You don't have to tiptoe around me. I don't judge good or evil on any ironclad law. And with all the crimes staged in the name of order… Ah, pay no mind to this judge's grumble, a powerless judge waiting to be indicted for misconduct in office.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The thorns on this codex? Yes, of course the spikes hurt, but I wish for the pain to remind me: No matter how weak the statutes in Siracusa, no matter how highly I think of my calling, perversion of justice and blasphemy against the law are crimes.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The thorns on this codex? Yes, of course the spikes hurt, but I wish for the pain to remind me: No matter how weak the statutes in Siracusa, no matter how highly I think of my calling, perversion of justice and blasphemy against the law are crimes.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: They say 'the law is the basis of morality,' but that's not a natural truth. It emerges from a consensus of the people. When the people come to see violence as order, the law is nothing but a fantasy to dream of. And I, as the keeper of that fantasy, am the most ridiculous of all.

voices.title: Talk 3

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: In Siracusa, being a city court judge is a dangerous job. Either you join 'them,' or... you disappear. I thought I could strike a balance between the two, but there's no way to stay clean when you're surrounded by mud. In the end, I was just another accomplice.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: In Siracusa, being a city court judge is a dangerous job. Either you join 'them,' or... you disappear. I thought I could strike a balance between the two, but there's no way to stay clean when you're surrounded by mud. In the end, I was just another accomplice.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Maybe Siracusa really is that hard to change. The gangs, the famiglie... They shared a womb with Siracusa and shaped it into the country it is today. But we can't take them for granted. We must believe that a different path exists.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Maybe Siracusa really is that hard to change. The gangs, the famiglie... They shared a womb with Siracusa and shaped it into the country it is today. But we can't take them for granted. We must believe that a different path exists.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Oh, mi dispiace, I didn't see you there. If you're all done with work, how about joining me for a drink?… Why that look in your eyes? I'm not an alcoholic. But everyone needs some liquid assistance every now and then, whether for fatigue or for suffering. Ecco. It's on the strong side, so sip slowly.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: If you ever get a chance to visit Siracusa, please avoid the rainy season. However, if you really are that unfortunate... best thing you can do is find a little shop on the street and sit for a while. Maybe only after the rain can one enjoy the momentary illusion that the city is clean.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: In my many years as a judge, I've only handed down a few verdicts I could feel good about. I still remember the look on those two kids' faces when I broke up their little scuffle and told the aggressor to apologize. What, why are you laughing? Even the greatest justice must start from somewhere small.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You're sleeping? There's nothing more valuable than these rare moments of peace. Conserviamo questi momenti.

voices.title: Idle

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Lavinia Falcone, formerly a judge of Siracusa. Today, I report to you as Operator Penance. I hope that in working for Rhodes Island, I can absolve myself of my past mistakes.

voices.title: Onboard

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: So much violence in the name of order... Doctor, I can only pray that your efforts are more than futile.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: So much violence in the name of order... Doctor, I can only pray that your efforts are more than futile.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I am honored to earn your support. We can certainly work together and offer mutual assistance, but let me be frank – that doesn't mean you can influence my decisions. Sorry, no offense intended, but that's a lesson I learned the hard way.

voices.title: Promotion 1

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Be it a famiglia, a society, or a country, people are often bound by mutual interest... I used to assume this was the way of the world, but Doctor, you showed me a different path. I hope we can share this mutual trust long into the future.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Sitting around in an office won't bring about justice. That's one thing I know for a fact.

voices.title: Added to Squad

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Whether or not you are burdened by a criminal record is unimportant to me. All I ask is that in this coming battle, our goals might be aligned.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Contempt for the law is a crime. The words of my codex will prove their own worth.

voices.text: This time, I will hand down a fair verdict.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I am fighting for more than just the law. Also the justice and virtue that extend beyond it.

voices.title: In Battle 2

voices.title: In Battle 3

voices.text: Even a crime-ridden swamp is not beyond salvation. Doctor, thank you for once again reminding me of this fact.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Back in my homeland, even New Year's Day comes with no guarantee of peace. The conflicts of interest do not stop for a holiday. That's why I cherish my time here at Rhodes Island, spending it with all of you. Buon Anno, Doctor.

voices.text: Doctor, I've categorized these documents according to their importance. Let me remind you that some of your operations land in a legal gray zone. I'm not opposed to them, but you need to think things through. I'll offer my advice as well.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, Rhodes Island has a grand vision, but we have to think carefully. After all the slogans, ideals, and aspirations have been stripped away, whether we still have pure hearts, that is far more important than any false order.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Yes, I'll protect the Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I can sit down? No... I'm a bodyguard. As a bodyguard, I have to stay vigilant and keep close to my principal... Am I... perhaps being a bother, standing here?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Spot? I've met him before... No, actually, when my unit passed through the city he was stationed in, he gave me a hand. He probably doesn't remember. It's fine.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: (I'm not sure what the Doctor is doing, but it looks incredible...) Eh? Uh... I-I didn't say anything. Must've been the wind, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, you mentioned these just a second ago, so I went and fetched them for you. Umm... I hope I didn't overstep?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, I'm so sorry. I rushed in alone again on that last mission... I saw someone was wounded, and it felt like the blood surged straight to my head. I forgot your orders and charged on in. I didn't do it on purpose. P-Please don't hate me..

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Umm, Doctor, were you looking for me...? No, I'm not avoiding you, and I definitely don't hate you... It's just that... Sorry, I'm not sure how to put it into words…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: When I was serving in the Sargonian army, everyone hated me, except for one woman. She was kind to me, and we became best friends. But... in the end... she betrayed me. Doctor, I'm lost. How can I bring myself to trust anyone ever again?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: (The Doctor is so kind, speaking so nicely to me, even though I'm such an unlikable whelp. I should be able to trust the Doctor, right?) Oh, Doctor, I'm listening. Yes, you're still my ever-dependable Doctor. The Doctor's enemies are my enemies!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: (I think I'd like to sneak a peek… at the Doctor's sleeping face.)

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: (This one looks kind enough, but will this Doctor be as easy to get along with as Amiya says...?) Ah, excuse me, I'm sorry, I-I was spacing out. Operator, codename Heavyrain, reporting in.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Yes, I should be able to reach this level too.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: (Amiya is here too. Am I getting fired...?) Eh? I'm getting promoted?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, is it okay if I don't get promoted...? No, everyone is being so kind... I'm a little scared...

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: By your command.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll do my best.

voices.title: Depart

voices.title: Deployment 2

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Out of the way!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You're in the way!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Hmph!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, did I do okay?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, I can still fight.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, let me go after them.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, I'll cover you from the rear!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Rhodes Island is so big...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ehhh?!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor?! Please don't scare me...!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, Happy New Year. Since I came to Rhodes Island, you have cared much for me, but you've never expressed gratitude to me. So today, at the very least, I want to sincerely thank you. (Th-There, I said it! I… I didn't mess up, did I?)

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, can I assist you in any way?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: (The Doctor is so popular. Would someone of such stature really need a gift from a girl like me…? But I really do want to give one…) Oh, what am I holding? Well, um, it's a gift. Please, accept it! Happy birthday!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: (They're all surrounding the Doctor. That is to be expected, considering the Doctor's popularity… Oh, the Doctor is waving at me. Is there something behind me? Huh, the Doctor is coming over…) Oh, should I join in the festivities…? Alright.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Your desk needs tidying up? It doesn't look messy at all. Much better than my study, hehe. Don't worry, no mess is too much for me. Truth is, I can't think straight in a tidy room.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Come on! It's just midnight, too early for bedtime. In Sargon, the days are super hot, so our 'day' only really starts when the sun goes down. Staying up messes with your circadian rhythm? Pfft, big deal. It's worth it when you see the lotuses blooming at sunrise.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My younger brother and I were born into a family of court historians, the Guardian of the King’s Secret. We grew up surrounded by stacks of scrolls handed down from our ancestors. As kids, we didn't get how valuable they were and just fought over the ones with more pictures. Thinking back, the pictures weren't half as fun as our fights.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: That's a figurine of the Shah on my desk. He's basically treated like a god in Sargon. I remember trawling across the entire desert just to dig up the relics he left behind... I came back empty-handed though... But, it's okay. I still felt good about getting to bring his figurine to visit the places he'd been.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The pattern on my hood? It's my family's emblem. As the Shahanshah's personally appointed historians, our duty is to see and faithfully record everything that happens. Although... there are times when they prefer us to be silent witnesses.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, there's a Juncus pen that has been passed down for generations in my family. It has documented many extraordinary lives and left its mark on treasured scrolls and manuscripts. I'm thinking, Doctor, if I were to be handed down that pen... How about I start with the stories of all its previous owners?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Hey, Doctor! I brought back a whole bunch of souvenirs for you. A few amulets, several volumes of supernatural tales, and a golden— Hey, don't swat it! The locals consider this bug a divine emissary that keeps travelers safe on their journeys, so promise you'll take good care of it!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, excavation work isn't as exciting as everyone thinks it is. It's mostly tedious and repetitive labor. If you really want to build a career on it, the best way is to either have a kindred spirit by your side, or a good rival to push you. That’s how you achieve more, and go further.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Hey, Doctor. Wanna look around the bottom of this pit? Give me your hand. Careful! Now, this dirt might seem unimpressive, only going up to your knees, but buried under it are traces of the people who lived here centuries ago. It's difficult to explain, but the land remembers all that humanity does, and all the choices we make.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Too relaxed to say anything? Hehe, of course you are! This is the soothing incense I brought from home. One whiff is enough to… Asleep already? Did I use too much? Oops... I did... now the Doctor's gonna be out for a whole day.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Greetings, Doctor. On behalf of my exalted Padishah, I am here to negotiate with you on a collaboration project within his dominion. My name is Djerwnapekhaper Saciut Hatshepsut, but... my friends all call me Pepe.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Um, could we just hire the warrior in the recording to teach me in person? I'm not used to learning like this…

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Now this is new, I was always the one giving out rewards.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: A promotion? Alright, then I'll bestow an honorary title in return. Don't underestimate its power! From now on, no one will be able to hinder you in my father's domain.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: With lightning and habūb, my hammer will rebuke the intruders and their greed.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Are you ready to join me on this journey to uncover history long-buried?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I have prayed to the gods, and They have revealed to me an auspicious omen! We'll find something good this time.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Whoa, you robbers actually dare show yourselves before me?!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Take note: you can never be too gentle when cleaning relics!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: If we run into tomb robbers, hehe... Hammer time!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Woah, woah! Let me down more slowly. There are fragile artifacts down there!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Don't rush me! Lemme get a nice, big stretch before I squeeze down this hole.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Too late to run now, nasty little thief!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Put that down. Your filthy hands desecrate it.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You've got guts, trying to steal this!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Rawr! I'm gonna stamp a lotus on your head!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, once these results are published, your name will sit alongside mine for all eternity.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Now this is a shocking discovery! Any ideas how we might celebrate this, Doctor?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: It's not much, but at least those thieves won't profane this sacred site so easily again.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: How should we piece together these fragments…? Ow, my head hurts...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: You better not leave me here on my own. I might get curious and go tapping around with my hammer, which could lead to me seeing stuff I shouldn't, you know.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hey! Do NOT undo the bow on my back!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I smell nice? But I don't usually wear perfume… Oh, it's probably just this lotus.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Ssh, no talking. Let the new year's first ray of sunlight bathe your face and body, feel its cozy warmth and gentle touch… Hmm... Doctor, the previous year is now history, all that suffering and joy—The sun just carried it away.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Greetings, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Careful what you wish for, though, Sargonian legends tell of crafty gods who will grant any wish, but at an unreasonable price! Better yet, just tell me your wish and I'll try to grant it!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, if the conditions are right, some traces of us will survive long into the future. When those who come after us find the vestiges we left behind, it'll be like we're smiling at them across time! So, Doctor, let's put on our best smiles! For now, and for our friends waiting in the eons to come.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Queching the flames of war demands prolonged suffering. To ignite them, however, it takes naught but a lapse of thought.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: The fall of Chernobog dealt a devastating blow to Azazel, our clinic. I must rebuild it for the children. As long as they can have a shelter to call home, any place will do. You don't need a reason to try for your family.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Rhodes Island is in a respectable position, but the Infected of Ursus face prospects far worse than anyone could imagine. They must be ready to resort to violence in order to survive. At the end of the day, virtue and dignity hold meaning only for those who live to see the next dawn.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: All Ursus should take pride in their nation and their Emperor.' I, too, fought for Ursus once, but I don't have the passion driving me anymore. Time has robbed me of too much.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Life in the military has taught me two things: First, have faith in your fellow soldiers; second, have faith in them, but do not trust them. This dilemma has always plagued our lands, and none can escape it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, a limitless future awaits you, just as it does for those children. Though I can neither let go of yesterday nor look forward to tomorrow, I shall fight for you till my last drop of blood, so you may be part of that future.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I am fine with Ursus as my enemy. Once I swore my utmost loyalty to it, but that was returned with endless disillusionment and shame. For the children's sake, I will never falter, much less surrender.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Once there was a long battle. When I finally broke into the enemy headquarters, I was too late... All I could do for my dying friend was take his pocket watch and sword. The enemy lost their commander, whose death brought us a brief victory. That day, Ursus enjoyed her momentary triumph, but I knew my war was over. A war where I lost everything.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The photograph inside my pocket watch? Hahahah, so you saw it... This is Neon from when she was little. Isn't she adorable? She's not so quiet anymore, but she loves herself now, and that's all that matters... Live free, Dr. {@nickname}, that's my wish, even if it is trite.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Don't lose focus. You must be alert at all times on Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hellagur, an infected mercenary. I will work with Rhodes Island in order to rebuild my Azazel Clinic and protect my family. But be advised, I have no medical skills.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Battlefields may change, but not the cruelty.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm used to it as a soldier, but I find it fascinating as an infected. Thank you for the ribbon, Dr. {@nickname}.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: War will never truly be over, but I believe even this land will end eventually. Maybe you can end our suffering one day, Dr. {@nickname}. Now, give me your order!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Only butchers thirst for blood. We are merely paying the price of survival.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll have them following orders to Ursus army standards!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I don't mind losing my life, if that is enough to end this all.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: You have never seen a real war, pathetic runts.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I was born to fight.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: A slip of the mind is the difference between life and death.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Killing is but the last resort.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I've never truly left the battlefield, I know.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: A lash of blade, the flesh to flay.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: A thrust of whip, the sword to rip.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: A cleave of spear, the armor to tear!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Decapitator'… Our sacrifices were not in vain.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: You leave the fight behind, and pay for it with yet more fighting.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Avert your eyes, I'm about to end their misery.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Keep your guard up. One flaw is all the enemy needs to turn the tables.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: There is no shame in failure. At least you had the chance to learn from it.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: If only I can find shelter for the children.

voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Trust Tap

voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It escapes me how many New Years I've spent in trenches, or under the blaze of artillery. War is no stickler for timekeeping, and the greater part of my life has been embroiled in it. This holiday won't turn new pages for me anymore. That being said, don't the children look happy? Hah.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You look well, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: As every child has a birthday, it gives me hope that maturity will come to them. Age will overtake me, like it or not, and I can only hope they'll still live safely after I am gone. You're still growing too, Doctor. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I must express my gratitude to Rhodes Island. The longer the war stretches on, the more I realize the importance of a place to rest. Has the technology Azazel brought to Rhodes Island been of help...? That is good. After all, I can do little else but wield my blade in your service.

voices.text: Relax, Doctor. I'll keep you safe.

I didn't drop it on the way, did I...? Ah, shoot. Doctor, how about I make up the present to you next time, and I'll treat you to some food for today?

voices.text: Ehehe~ Oh, Doctor, is your day going well?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: This is a floral tea that I made myself! Doctor, come try a cup, I promise you'll feel cozy all day!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The sunlight in the greenhouse is so comfortable. Even though I'm an operator, it sometimes makes me want to slack.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Use the fruits of your labor to make everyone forget about their sorrows and worries. That's probably the tenet of all gardeners, don't you think~?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I much rather prefer growing things to destroying them. But as long as I think about how I can help everyone, I can muster up my courage.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: These bottles? Inside are all the pollen and seeds that I've been collecting. I usually wear a gas mask and gloves before handling them, or I might get poisoned.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Umm, everyone seems to be a bit weary these days. But, I'm sure they'll cheer right back up when they see the flowers I've planted!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, Doctor! Are you coming to the greenhouse today? It seems like everyone's been really busy the last few days... If nobody comes by the greenhouse, the blooming season's going to pass right by. Wouldn't that be a darn shame?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Tending to the greenhouse is really hard. But, as long as I can make others smile with the flowers I grow, all my hard work will be worth it!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor? Oh, you're asleep... I hope the fragrance of these petals can drift over to your dreams.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor, this is Podenco, here to say hi! If you have time, I'd love if you could come by the greenhouse!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Aw, I thought this was a video about gardening techniques.

voices.title: Promotion 1
