voices.text: Phew, is it safe already? Good job, everyone!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Achieving a flawless victory is like cultivating a beautiful flower. Both require a lot of hard work.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, everyone is awaiting your next orders.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Ah... I never thought things could become like this...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Shall we plant some flowers over here?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh, Doctor?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor! Would you like to decorate your office with some flowers?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Back home, most flowers would already have withered by now. But just thinking about how spring will be here soon... fills my heart with hope. Doctor, let's find the first flower that blooms in the greenhouse together!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Please, try this floral tea! I made it the way Miss Lena taught me, and if you really savor it, you can taste a hint of cake flavor! Eh? You can't? Let me try... Oh... Sorry, Doctor. I... I think I forgot the honey…

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I've been all over with Rhodes Island. Does that mean I've spread flowery fragrance to just as many places? Hehe... I may still have lots of room for improvement, compared to Miss Lena, but I'll do my best to make Rhodes Island an even warmer place!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: No problem, I'll handle it. Filling forms and organizing data are complicated and dull procedures to be sure. But it's necessary work, if we want local governments to help out in assisting the Infected. I'm sure you've nurtured a patience for it, as I have.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: No, no, I didn't put these healthy living advisories up. Our organization aims to help people live better lives, but I don't believe that gives us the right to dictate what a better life is. Besides, I personally prefer energy bars to regular meals... Oh, heh, I'll consider your advice.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Operators have been coming to me for talks? True enough. Even HR Operators are asking me about it. The only thing I can tell you is that I'm not here to poach people for Pure Heart Medical. You know very well I must keep all work engagements confidential, whether they've killed a relative, or simply stolen a cookie.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Doctor, could you help me review this script for a business conference? There's a part about distributing Oripathy medicine on the frontier. I'm not used to such loud public speeches. Quiet talks are more my thing... But I'm so good at pushing for a dangerous mission? Th-That's a very different situation!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The discussion went smoothly, so I'm in no position to feel down, but... I got yet another 'If the Infected were as well-mannered as you, we would have donated much more'. Tolerance or humility, people can only afford it when their backs aren't up against the wall.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I once escorted some Infected out of that city, with a few Sarkaz in tow. It was a long journey. They had no staves, and their condition only worsened when casting Arts to protect themselves, while I use my own Arts to keep them safe, at no cost to myself... ah, the irony of it all.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Yes, the Infected are usually isolated from the masses, and physical contact can be an act of kindness. Though, hugs inherently make people happy. You don't have to be infected or have a particular reason to enjoy one. Would you like a hug, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Do we have to talk about Londinium...? I once attended an aristocratic ball where everyone covered their crystals as they danced; I helped workers move their lumber as I heard them hoping to build a home before they took their last breaths. They were all smiling, so I want to smile when I tell their stories.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Have a seat, Doctor. No, you aren't interrupting anything. The view isn't that special either. Just another sunrise in the barrens amidst dusky skies. I tell myself the sun rises the same every morning... just as it did that one time I didn't look back.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Ssh—Hello there, the Doctor's on break at the moment... No, no, the Doctor is being very responsible. No one can work 24/7—everyone has to recharge every once in a while, right?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, I'm here at Rhodes Island for an exchange study, representing the Maylander Foundation's Pure Heart Medical. Your Operators saw me before in Victoria...? I'd like to avoid discussing my experiences there for the time being, if I could.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Sorry, could I just take a short break? It's honestly a bit too loud for me...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you, Doctor. I'm glad Rhodes Island values me, but I'm afraid my suggestions won't be any better than what you're already doing.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I spent one afternoon in middle school reading a Maylander report on how the Infected live, and decided I had to do something for them. As my mind wanders back to that young boy's arrogant self-righteousness, I'm filled with shame. But I did the right thing. I have no regrets.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: All this noise... I've gotten used to it.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Just follow me, everyone. Our plan is set and we have plenty of supplies, so we'll get through this.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: If you get too cold, come over near me.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: We should try talking with the other side, if it's not too late.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Are you nervous?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Of course, ready anytime.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Phew… My ears might need a second to get used to this environment.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: This confrontation is inevitable.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Fire is only a boundary.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Please don't force your way through.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I won't surrender, so I suggest you take a detour.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: If only you had more choices in life…

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: It's no wonder so many see you as hope itself... ah, sorry. Does that put a lot of pressure on you?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Phew— you're really incredible! How about taking a break to celebrate?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, just say the word and I'll go have a talk with them.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: ...It's alright, we have a contingency plan and plenty of medical supplies. No need to worry.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's going to be hard, convincing other companies to follow this standard of treatment for Infected employees…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: If you want to scare me, you should try yelling 'boo!' or something next time.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Would you like to talk? I'll bring the beanbag chairs over... oh, you don't have to be so formal. I'm happy to hear whatever you have to say.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: ...Did you call me? Ah, sorry. I had my earplugs in. They only asked me to untangle these streamers, so at least it wouldn't bother anyone if I didn't hear you. Oh, Please don't get me wrong, I do love New Year's. When people make their resolutions, it means they still have hope in their hearts.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Please let me know if you need anything. Oh yes, you can also ask me to join you on your coffee break.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: You're an important partner of Pure Heart Medical, so of course we got you a birthday gift. Please, open it. Haha, I'm sorry. I just wanted to see the shocked look on your face when you opened it. This body pillow is a personal gift from me, I hope you enjoy it as much as I do.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: It's crucial we consolidate our achievements so far, but it's inevitable that we'll recall our many regrets and sorrows as well... We should find another day for it, but could I talk to you about a few things I've had on my mind? Yes, I hope you can be the one to hear me out.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Ummm... Nice to see you again, Doctor. It makes me happy... hehe...

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, do you need a break? I made you some tea, and Miss Orchid made cookies. Here, hope you like them… And, umm... Cheer up!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Why is everyone in Team A6 always fighting with each other...? If things keep going like this, we can't be a team anymore... Fighting is bad. I must make them understand!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The gear on my chainsaw is kinda loose, the one that makes the 'vrrrr' sound ... But I don't remember using it lately. Weird...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, is Team A6 getting along well...? That's really some good news. Peace is the best... As long as they don't fight, nothing will bother me while I stay with you…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I don't know why, but I sometimes get these gaps in my memory. Then when I ask my teammates in A6, they just smile and tell me nothing happened at all...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Um, Doc-Doctor, did I just pass out...? Um, why is everyone lying on the floor? Miss Catapult? Mr. Midnight? Mr. Spot? Why do you all have bruises on your face? And Miss Orchid too...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I'm actually super strong? You say I lost control over my power, when I wanted to stop my friends from fighting each other? That's why I don't remember anything...? Okay, I think I get it! Umm... right, I will put my power to good use!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Aaaah! The cup! I didn't control my grip... Errmm... I'm in trouble when the Doctor wakes up...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Popukar from Operation Reserve Team A6, reporting in. Um, my teammates in A6 are always arguing. I'm sure you worry about them, Doctor... But I know what to do...

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Umm, Doctor, is the girl in the video... me?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm so happy I don't even know what to say...! Thank you, Doctor...! Thank you so much!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: My name is Popukar... Nice to meet you...

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: B-But... I really don't know anything about tactics or strategies or anything…

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Miss Catapult, um, it's time to deploy!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Miss Orchid, don't worry... I'll be fine.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Errrmm...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'm right here.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I want to stop this fight.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Please stop arguiiing!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Be good and don't move.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Chainsaw got mad…

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Mr. Midnight, come back here... Miss Orchid is staring at you…

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Can everyone have a good peaceful talk, now...?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor… Doctor…? Here, I made some tea. You must be tired.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: **A painful groan** I'm… injured…? It hurts…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Please don't leave me here alone...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Aaaugh...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, headpats…

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I made some soft and chewy New Year's cakes at the cafeteria... They say my cakes are great. I'm strong, so I always pound the dough well! Hehe...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, are you getting along with everyone today...?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I never really celebrated birthdays before, but now that I'm at Rhodes Island, Orchid always lets me have extra snacks on them... Do you want any? I'll sneak some out for you. Others won't notice!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Will we all stay together if I'm a good kid, if I'm a little smarter? I want A6 to stay together like a family... Will you help me, Doctor?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Here, two Minoan Mists, freshly brewed... I'll have to behave myself, Doctor, since I'm your assistant now. The next time you choke on my strangling tail after getting me mad, I'll make sure you can at least find some solace in my feathers.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Immoral scientist, disloyal mercenary, double-crossing spy... Yes, that's all me. Rules are what bar you from working to your full efficiency, darling, and you must learn to break them. That being said, I'm sure you have more to share with me for what little time we have alone together, other than the rules of Rhodes Island, I suppose?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: As senior consultant to Rhodes Island, I'd love to have more time to study the archives and collections of this ship. Meet my coworkers? You see the flow of history and soundless order in those objects. Tell me, what's worth seeing in people?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: 'Reflect the truth and glimpse the future'? Most astrologers got started just to steal a peek at their own doom. But when Kristen tore open the skies over Trimounts, she debunked astrology as the silly fabrication it is. And that's more interesting than the practice itself.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The foolish build walls, the wise topple them... or vice versa. History is a database that holds more than it seems, full of hints about the future. After all, history itself was the future for countless generations... that's what really grips me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Our story? Feathers wet by dew from the trees, tails sweeping past decrepit pillars. Thus, knowledge was passed on through generations. We embrace the ever-expanding unknown, and walk toward madness... I don't want to lose my mind, of course. But if that's what it takes to change this ridiculous fate, then I'll do it gladly.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, were you… avoiding me? I just wanted to show you a newly-excavated ruin I found. What's that? Why do I keep bothering you? Oh my, shouldn't you do some soul-searching and ask why you are the only one I'm bothering?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I saw you with Muelsyse at the mall in Trimounts. That elf surely knows how to work her charm, doesn't she? I could use some assistance from you as well, but my 'approaches' are different. Look down now, my tail will gladly learn the way through your heart, unless you accept my offer.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Tell me, Doctor, how does it feel to lose your memory? I couldn't bear to see a great library reduced to ashes in a fire. But a librarian fool enough to only brush the dust off the shelves pains me even more. Who's sadder, you or me?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Your ears are red. Sensitive, aren't they? Puff... oh, they're getting redder! Now don't you move. You're still at work, you know.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm not here representing Maylander or Rhine Lab. I'm here because I, Ho'olheyak, want some further contact with Rhodes Island... Now, now, why are you trying to shake off my hand? I haven't finished introducing myself yet.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Are we done yet?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Congratulations. You've earned yourself a promotion from me too. This time, I brewed four Minoan Mists... do they really punch you that hard? Stay sober now, if you know what's good for you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Another promotion? Does that mean more permissions at Rhodes Island? There are secrets in this ship that even you don't know about, I can sense that. Just what fun we'll have!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: My job is to innovate on these missions. Your job is to be impressed.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: There's no plan. Plans change anyway. As long as it helps the mission, you can break the rules at any time.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I'd rather operate solo.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Oh? What a surprise.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I thought I was just here as a consultant.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: My, my... Are you sure you want to treat me as a mercenary?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Such ruthlessness! I said I don't like getting my feathers wet.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: How rude~ Didn't I tell you not to get dust on my tail?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Leaving so soon?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Could you even leave?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Oh, your Arts aren't working. How can that be?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Did I say I was going to have mercy? I lied.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, your performance reminds me of a bunch of unfounded legends. But now, I believe in them. Legends no more.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Are you… waiting for a compliment?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Nothing is 100% true. Similarly, nothing is 100% false. Doctor, what we've done is already enough to bring all kinds of change.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Leave the rest to me. I'm used to picking up other people's messes. Use the time to think about how you'll thank me.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Excuse me, are we accommodating a mercenary here, or is this how Rhodes Island welcomes their senior consultant...? Heh, Just kidding.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What, here to challenge Siestan Iced Tea? Or, Minoan Mist?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Careful! These are rare documents. How did I get them? Relax, not by following procedure, I assure you. What, you wanna interrogate me?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: A historical society awards ceremony? Annual divination association convention? Not interested. Don't you dare think about all that crap when you're with me. It's New Year's Day. Aren't you going to ask me to dance? Don't worry, I won't touch you with my tail this time.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Well, if it isn't the Doctor… What a coincidence, us bumping into each other.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Me? My people don't get many chances to celebrate birthdays, our lifespan being short as it is. I just didn't want to pass on this cursed knowledge. Do I still have time to change things? Ha, look at me, getting drunk on your birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The skies of Trimounts have been restored, Dr. {@nickname}, but no one will forget what they saw when they were torn open. What do you see in the future of this land? What can Rhodes Island do? What can I do for you, and for myself? That's what I want to ask you.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'll sort out your battlefield reports for you. My officialese isn't too shabby. I'll stand guard during your rest hours. Anything else required...? I'd prefer you don't keep me idle.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Has Bagpipe kept up her habit of humming around you? Me? I'm more the type to appreciate music in peace. The only thing a horn can play is the order to charge—I'm joking of course, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The name 'White Wolf' goes as far back in history as the Aslan monarchy. Why are you interested, though? ...Ah. You saw... my fangs? I'm sorry, I lost control of myself then. I won't let it happen again.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I have beautiful handwriting? Thank you. It just comes with the facade when you're raised noble, which I've never been keen on. But sometime these days, I'm grateful for it—whenever I pick up a pen, everything else leaves my mind, and my focus is only on how I write every letter in the proper way.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: As that city spat great black crystals from its gaping wounds, I thought there could be no hope left for it... Is this place familiar with those made Infected not by Catastrophe, but by human hands, Doctor of Rhodes Island?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Rhodes Island Operator Misery managed to rescue me twice, and I'm sincerely grateful for it. I won't ask why I was the one he rescued. Those who live on are to carry forth the wishes of those who didn't make it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I always feel stifled by gloomy indoor atmospheres. Do you want to go out and take a walk, Doctor? It might be overcast, but at least there'll be a breeze. There are times you can hear singing on the wind too, not just the echo of your own words.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I can vaguely remember the portraits of my ancestors decorated with medals in the hall. I also recall the épée carved with the Lion King's orders, and the maples my father planted in the front courtyard... but that's all that comes to me. I haven't returned home in a long, long while. In Her chaotic theater, Victoria's soldiers have no time to file for leave.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, does a commander as outstanding as you ever feel sorrow? Or anger? Or... hate? I try as hard as I can not to let personal emotions sway me, but I can't forget. I promised them I would never forget.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: How do you sleep, after having witnessed so much cruelty...? If I could do the same as you, with a simple shut of my eyes, would I feel any better?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Tempest Platoon Leader Horn reporting in, Doctor of Rhodes Island. I've already borne witness to your own tactics, and the fighting spirit of Rhodes Island's operators. Under our ensuing cooperation, I and my troops will heed your orders.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: No amount of training can ever suffice.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you. I'll regard this as a commendation of my performance, and not a reflection of my status.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Confer your emblems of rank on me. I'm willing... No. I must bear the hopes of more. Of those past, now, and to come.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Victoria's servicemen should take pride in their own discipline.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I trust in my platoonmates at any and all times. I'd like you to put that same trust in me.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: We have no time to hesitate. There are souls waiting for us, behind the firing line.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I'll put up my shield. Don't stand in front of me.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Allow me to study your command style in this battle, Doctor.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: At attention. Ready to fall in.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Orders received.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I will complete my assignment.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: The Tempest must wipe out all that blocks the way.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Come! Best me if you can!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I'll impart on you all the cries I've heard.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You want to topple me? By what?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: One victory may not be enough to impact a whole war, but it can at least give more people a chance to see the open sky.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Target has been suppressed.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Any mercy on the enemy is a potential disaster. Let me lead my troops to settle this.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Not a worry, Doctor. Until you've gotten everyone away, I will not fall.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It doesn't resemble Victoria here, but... it reminds me of when I studied at the Royal Guard Academy.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Sorry, I'm not used to setting down my weapons. Did I bruise you?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Hm...? I'm just reading an ordinary novel. I've gone an awfully long time without reading something new. All the written word went up in the fires of war.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: When Misery rescued me, he told me the New Year had already come and gone. That was the first one I ever missed. Ever since, I've begun to pay less attention to these holidays at all.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. Have you rested well?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: What rite should I be celebrating your birthday by? I don't believe you to be fond of drinking parties, so I'll sing for you, then. This is a small little ceremonial from back in the Tempest Platoon.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Periodic summations and celebrations both can't be dispensed with. When Amiya's speech wound up, the instant the people around me started laughing and bellowing, I relaxed. That surprised me. I see what's past is past now.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: The wind blew the documents all over the place… This can't be because of my luck, can it…?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: When I was a kid, Grandpa told me stories of how they built Siesta, but before he could see it to completion, he moved to Columbia with my parents. I went back to Siesta hoping to see what it had become in his place, only to find that it's all volcanic ash now.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: This is my grandpa's hammer. It's been with me all the way, from when I was a civil engineering student to my demolition work, and finally to what I always wanted to be——a builder. If Rhodes Island ever needs any demolition work done, just say the word! Uh, by that, I mean construction work! Anyway, for some reason, I find hammers more wieldy...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Everybody knows making bets with Rope is a good way to lose your stuff. And I know Glaucus's cocktails are a little different from the ones everyone else gets. And anything Savage's hammer touches is bound to blow up—Oh, um! I know all that, but not because I've got rotten luck!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: New Siesta has some unfinished city plates where you can see the volcano. Old workers like to gather there and chat about what the old Siesta looked like. I've heard most of their stories, but I still stay and listen, the same way I listened to Grandpa's stories... I still wonder what it was really like...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Back in school, my classmates always told me that Siesta is a tourist destination. It doesn't have its own architectural style. People just build whatever attracts the tourists. Look at Siesta today, though. We are her style.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Want some walnut jam? Freshly made. Uh, I didn't mean to make it. It just, you know, happened. What's that on my hammer, you ask? Oh, um... it's walnut husks... Okay, okay, I admit it. Vulcan said it's a good way to train my strength control, but I didn't get a single one right. So, do you want the walnut jam or not?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Look, the last time I came to the landship, the incomplete city plate was still empty, but now there are rows of houses there, and the lights of the high-tech district reach even the beaches nearby. I'm building our new homeland bit by bit, alongside many others. It's, how do you say, an interesting feeling, right?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: After I graduated, I could only find demolition work in Columbia, and I even caught Oripathy. I wanted to go back to Siesta to make a living, only to find a pile of volcanic ash waiting for me. It took a lot of work to find the new Siesta, so I was real happy that day. I even yelled out loud: Hey hey hey—That's it for my rotten luck! Everything's going to work out just fine from here on out!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I've got classmates still with the demolition teams, another who's a contractor, and yet another who's a Pioneer... I'm the only one who, after that roundabout path, came back to Siesta to work on what I actually studied... I guess it worked out pretty well for me?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: You're the Doctor that Ceylon talked about, right? I'm Poncirus. Thanks for agreeing to provide medical assistance to us workers. My codename? It's a kind of fruit that's very close to my hair in color. The workers like to squeeze its juices into wine.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Finding the structural support core in an instant and destroying it right away...  Alright, with a little practice, I'm sure I can do this, too.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotional medal... I'll take it. Thanks for your acknowledgment, Doctor. I'll work hard to make sure I'm worth it.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Senior Engineering Operator? Does that mean my pay goes up, too? That's great! I can send more money back home to my parents now, and I gotta write a letter to Grandpa, too. Yeah, everything's working out just fine!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'll check out our surroundings.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: What did those stubborn professors do back in college again... Hold a seminar first? Pff... Everyone would hate me so much...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Bring your site plans, everyone. Watch out for accident-prone areas.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Arrived at the most optimal combat location. Ready to move.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Request acknowledged.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'll give you the best plan possible.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: If you need me to, I'll wreck this place without hesitation.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: My hammer's not so weak!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Load capacity calculations complete!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Stress concentration point measured!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Enemy cover demolished.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: The structure's stable and sound. Nothing to worry about!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Like a building that'll never be destroyed.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Looks like luck's on my side instead of theirs this time!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: It's okay, Doctor. A city covered in volcanic ash is always pale, but beautiful flowers will eventually sprout on it.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: The road's been demolished. Enemy pursuit vehicles intercepted.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What a sophisticated design... I gotta find time to really look at it.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Got a new mission, Doctor?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Ah! Doctor, remember to stay clear of my hammer the next time you talk to me. It's dangerous!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. You'll be there at the ceremony tonight, right? I gave the operators in charge of the hall's design a few suggestions and divided it into a few zones based on the operators' homeland... Right, on a special day like this, a sense of belonging is important.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Why don't we head outside together for some fresh air, Doctor? Staying in one place can really slow your thinking.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. This is a 'mini hammer' that I designed myself. It works on the same principles as my weapon, and you can wield it with just one hand. I'll be heading back to Siesta tomorrow. While I'm gone, you can use it to crack nuts.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I just tidied up our design documents from the past year. I didn't expect there to be so many, and it really gives me a rare sense of fulfillment. Although there isn't much I myself can do for Siesta, I know that each and every stroke I draw represents the journey I've traveled.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: It's wise to care for your safety, Doctor. But you can work without worry now, I'll keep you protected.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I've met plenty who claim to practice martial arts. Most are posers who lack substance, but not Waai Fu. She's an interesting one... although her training is not yet complete. I look forward to sparring with her, once she's ready.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Rhodes Island doesn't have a cellar, you say? Hmm… Now that won't do. Alcohol is indispensable. It's meant to be savored, enjoyed, and sometimes used to numb the pain. Trust me, Doctor, build a cellar. I know exactly what you'll need to stock it.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I built a library back in Mansfield. Most of the books I could get my hands on were Columbian, and thus, my extensive reading eventually brought a sense of monotony. It is most pleasing that Rhodes Island has such a diverse collection of books.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Schemes and ploys meant nothing in the face of absolute power... Or so I thought, until I realized that no power is truly absolute, at least not mine. Now, I never underestimate anything or anyone, no matter how insignificant they seem.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I used to think that Rhodes Island was just another Mansfield, a 'free' prison. And you, just another me—a convict unchained, a king behind bars. But now I see that I was mistaken. This is not a prison, and you, Doctor, are a friend to all.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Are the ones over there from Rhine Lab? Don't worry. I bear no grudge against Rhine Lab itself, and I won't harm them in anyway. Farce like that will only complicate things for you, Doctor. However, one of these days, I might need to ask them about one thing.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, are you free later? Let me take you out for a drink. Nothing important. I merely have a few secrets that I'd like to get off my chest. You are the first new friend I've made in a long time.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You are a very good friend, Doctor. If I manage to survive after sorting everything out, do come visit me at Mansfield. That's my kingdom, and what is mine there is also yours.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Falling asleep so trustingly in the company of others... Is that really trust, or have you slipped up?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I owe Rhodes Island my life, and so my candor must befit the weight of my debt, Doctor. I am going after a certain department within Rhine Lab. If you don't want your relationship with them ruined, now is the time to turn me away.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Battlefield experience... Indeed, that's something that I lack. Much obliged, Doctor.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, do not be afraid. The fury of my fist will not fall upon the undeserving.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Look well, Doctor. My composure, politeness, and grace are but a mask. Peel that off, and you'll find me at my truest, bloodthirsty, violent, and destructive. See me, know me... only then be my friend.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Perfect time to get a pump.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Listen to your leader, me.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's go.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Never underestimate the enemy.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Where to?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'll remember to dial it back.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I won't let them go any further.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Face me!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Is that all? Strike me like your lives depend on it!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Come on, bring it on!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Warm-up's over!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: True grit must be tested in adversity, but we must be careful not to punch above our weight.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Good boxers never show all their tricks unless needed. Operations are the same, Doctor.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Violence without just cause is but mindless abuse. I've learnt to rein in my urges long ago.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: As long as we're still alive, we're not defeated.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Pardon me, but the ceiling in Rhodes Island is a little low…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, have you read any good books recently? I have a few to recommend.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: New Year's hasn't meant much to me for a long, long time. You see, prisoners don't usually hope much for tomorrow, or the future. But now that I'm a part of Rhodes Island, I suppose I should try to change that. Happy New Year, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Stay vigilant, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday. It shames me to admit that if I were still in Mansfield, or earlier in Columbia, I would have arranged a far grander celebration for you. Now, the best I can offer is a well-prepared drink. Would you do me the honor?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: What a lively day. You could say that Oripathy is like a shackle on life itself, depriving people of their freedom and their futures. Yet even in the confined space of Rhodes Island, I still see hope in the eyes of many. This has given me no small revelation on my own future.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'll stay with you until my next expedition, Doctor. Don't be afraid to send me out anywhere you need me.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I actually heard about you a long time ago, Doctor! Yeah, Mayer and MuMu told me all about you. I just had to come to Rhodes Island to see what you're like in person. Oh, I also got a little present for you! Here!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: This one? It's an Emperor strap! Who...? The Emperor of Penguin Logistics! I visited that company a whole bunch, so I've met him lots of times. He's so cute! I give him plenty of pets every time I go! You ever pet him before, Doctor? You don't dare? Why?!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Is Iffy doing better these days? Last time I left Rhine Lab, she was in pretty bad shape. I've been worried about her…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Has Mayer made anything new? I haven't worked on any new equipment for a long time, so I wanna do some research with her. Oh right, Doctor, I'll let you in on a little secret. If you bother Mayer while she's working... What? She already bit you?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Unlike Meeboo, Sisyphus or Kirkika, my drones are operated differently. There is a limit to how many I can run at once, and it's just the way it goes. But I have a new system in development. I think you'll be surprised before long.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The Polar North? The dreams that are buried there are cold and cruel, but... in order to make my dreams a reality, I am willing to do anything it takes.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: 'The tiny gardner, and the tiny flower, growing under the tile with no one to care for it...' It was Iffy's favorite storybook, maybe because it resonated with her. But, well... It seems like she doesn't remember it. Hmm… that's odd.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The North... it's both mysterious and beautiful. The towering cliffs, the lonely, snow-covered trees, the glowing, prismatic Originum crystals… And the vast snowland, stretching to the ends of the earth. Doctor, you should come see it with me. We'll go together, okay?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor? Stay awake Doctor! If you fall asleep, you'll freeze to death!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Rhine Lab Specialist Magallan just discovered a mysterous research vessel! And you are…? Oh my goodness, you're that doctor from Rhodes Island! Uh, W-Would you like to join my expedition!? Adventuring together would be really interesting!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Efficiency improved!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Update complete! Now my devices respond twice as fast.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, if you're curious about the results of my research, then I'll have to show you my stuff! Hehe, just so you know, I'll be showing you true power, so brace youself!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Leave the exploration and support to me.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Everyone, maintain communication, beep-beep!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Hold on, calibrating my equipment… Done!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Preflight testing complete. Drones standing by.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Sure!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I bet you need my skills.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Time to work!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: All my equipment's good to go!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Is the target marked? Ok, launching drone!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Now! Let 'em go snow blind!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Three… two… one! Take flight!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: 'Bloom, my flowers!'

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Watch out, there's a blind spot in my scan—What, it's already over? All thanks to you, Doctor, you're reliable as ever.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: No more hostiles detected!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: There's still some enemies around. Are we going after them?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: They're flanking us? My bad, sorry…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Hm...? You even have heated floors?! Ahh, this is bliss.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Mhm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Come on, Doctor. Ice skating isn't so scary. I'm here with you.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! My work's kept me too busy to take any time off to spend with my parents. But I sent them a letter, and a few samples I gathered in the North, heheh. Oh, Doctor, my parents know about you too. I told them about all the friends I made at work.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Um? Anything I can help with?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Phew! It took me a bit, but I finally made it in time! Happy birthday, Doctor! Here's a snowflake sample, it's from the furthest north anyone's ever been! I messed up a bit, but this one's the best sample I could get. It's my gift to you!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I lead an incredible life, Doctor. I've got the know-how to do my scientific research, I've got parents and friends who support me, and my dreams in the North to keep me going. But I still have one, tiny little wish. If somebody ever writes a history of the North, I want my name in it.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I've moved your belongings where you wanted. No worries, it wasn't heavy.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: The shield is a symbol of a steadfast guardian.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I've been responsible for protecting Young Master SilverAsh... I mean, Master SilverAsh... ever since he was young.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: It's not exactly polite to talk about Miss Enya behind her back, but... *sigh* I do pity Miss Enya for what she has suffered. She really deserves a better life.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: If my shield gets damaged, I should take it to the artisan called Vulcan for repairs. Is that correct?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: This is far beyond my expectation. That artisan is truly skilled. I need to thank her properly.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Life at Rhodes Island is fun. The Snow Realm is rather bland in comparison.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Master did send me to protect Ensia. But I honestly don't think she's the type who would sit there and ask to be protected.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I am slowly starting to understand why Master SilverAsh holds you in such high regard. Doctor, from this day, feel free to command me as your shield.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Sometimes, I suddenly start missing my life in the Snow Realm.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Ally, I salute you in true Snow Realm fashion. My codename is Matterhorn, and I am one of the guards dispatched here by Master SilverAsh.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: You have my gratitude.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you for the approval, Doctor. I am greatly flattered.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I will not step back, not even if this shield shatters the very next second. Not because of my loyalty, but because of my conviction.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: At your service.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I am honored.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I shall protect the team.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: All is ready.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I shall be your vanguard.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: My shield is ready.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Hm!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Hoo-yah!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Retribution!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I'm not here just for show!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: With my conviction, I shall bring any monster to its knees!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You don't have what it takes!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I wasn't even giving my all!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Their strikes can barely tickle me.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I'll pull off a perfect victory next time for you, I promise.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I should not have taken the enemies lightly. Now I pay the price.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Very nice room, this one. Furnished tastefully, with a peaceful atmosphere.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Mhmm.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: This is my signature dish. How do you like it?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It's only natural for a guardian to keep his eyes peeled on New Year's day. Troubles do not shy away from celebration days. Rather, they are more likely to jump on people when they let their guard down. Rhodes Island is a comparatively safe place, but you must not lower your defense, Doctor. Happy new year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good day, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: It's your birthday, Doctor, isn't it? No need to worry, for I dare not forget the date. It's just the gift I prepared... I'm really not sure if you are going to appreciate it... So please, Doctor, do me a favor and open it after I leave. Thank you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I'm actually not familiar with what lies outside the Snow Realm, since most of my job was to simply perform the duties my master has entrusted to me. I need to broaden my horizon. Even though I'm no more than a guardian, I need to learn more and see more.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, you gotta be hungry! Try some of my onigiri. They're great!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I've got a lotta hobbies: martial art sparring, soccer… Oh! And Ikebana! Some took me as a warrior with more brawn than brains, and I'd say they're the ones who's got a fat head!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My race eats other races? That's some old crap! Who told you that? Tch, those cowards, cooking up this nonsense behind my back. When I find'em, I'll give'em a lesson they'll never forget!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I'm born with this self-healing body. Even if I take a few cuts in the fight, the wounds will close back up in no time.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Hey, Doctor, Rhodes Island's got a soccer tournament! C'mon, let's sign up together! No need to think twice! Just put me in your team, and it's in the bag. You'd better work your brain elsewhere, like a cool victory pose!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: You don't even recognize me on the battlefield? I just start cutting through enemies with a face as cold as my blade? Wow! Sounds hella badass! Wish I could watch myself out there.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I got this problem where I kinda end up breaking stuff, so I'm working with my Ikebana teacher to control my strength. Besides, getting surrounded by all those pretty flowers makes me real happy!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Strategy? Ehh, not really my forte. That's why I keep hopping right into the enemy's plans. But you, Doctor, you always stop me right before I lose my mind. Real nice to have you by my side.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Actually, I've always been a gullible dummy. Got duped so bad in the past that I almost got myself killed a few times. But now I, Matoimaru, swear loyalty to you, Doctor! Because I know you'll never betray me.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Grr... Hey, no falling asleep, Doctor! I need a listener or I'm gonna die of boredom!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Matoimaru, here to join Rhodes Island! My blade is at your command, Doctor!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: More fancy skills to beat those bad guys with!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, put my strength to good work. That'll be the respect I deserve.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, please stand back a bit. I don't want to hurt you when swinging my naginata. But I, Matoimaru, will bring us every victory in your name.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Hah hah! You all look pretty tough. How about a warm-up with me?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Ugh, you want me to play captain? Then how am I suppose to throw myself into the battle!?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: You guys ready to rumble? Then what are we waiting for!?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, bad guys!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm over here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Just how long until it's my turn?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Love that battlefield smell.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Make 'em shake in their boots!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Standing up to me? Haha, Ballsy!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Ready to meet your demise?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: My blade shall rip you and your toy to ribbons!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You end here!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: A sea of fire and a mountain of blades... Now that's what I call a fight. This is the battlefield I've always dreamed of.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, I got 'em all! Huh? what happened here? Everything's busted… Um, wait a second, did I do it...?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I'll get 'em before they escape! Can't call the battle over unless we got every last of 'em!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Retreat! I'll cover your escape. Make sure you don't get hit!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Agh! Ow! My horn...!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: What's with that smile on your face? Anything to share with me?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Hey, Doctor, how does Rhodes Island celebrate the New Year? Oh, anything is welcome? Haha, alright then, I'll put together a soccer match with Matterhorn and the others! Make sure you come to watch!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Uh huh, I'm listening.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I wanted to fill your office with flowers, but my teacher said restraint is the first rule of Ikebana. So I made you this! And it should fit just fine on your desk!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: This blade brings nothing but trouble when I'm holding it. Good thing I can trust you to tell me where to swing it. That way, nothing can go wrong!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hm? Ah, this soil... it can murmur. It can dance. It is my friend.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hm? Ah, this soil... it can murmur. It can dance. It is my friend.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Miss Closure told me I shouldn't walk about Rhodes Island 'fully equipped'... but I'm not used to... revealing... myself. Sorry...

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Miss Closure told me I shouldn't walk about Rhodes Island 'fully equipped'... but I'm not used to... revealing... myself. Sorry...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Thank-you letters? Ah, from the Sarkaz workers yesterday? My equipment and type of Arts are a good match for physical work. Besides, their materials and fuel weren't featherweight. And they relied on the power of flesh and blood to ensure Rhodes Island sails smooth... it's incredible.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Thank-you letters? Ah, from the Sarkaz workers yesterday? My equipment and type of Arts are a good match for physical work. Besides, their materials and fuel weren't featherweight. And they relied on the power of flesh and blood to ensure Rhodes Island sails smooth... it's incredible.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: That elite operator... I thought I'd seen enough bizarre Originium Arts in Leithanien to write any wild fantasy. But the moment he pushed apart the fog with a wave of his hand, I understood, as a Sarkaz, he was young yet incredibly ancient.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: That elite operator... I thought I'd seen enough bizarre Originium Arts in Leithanien to write any wild fantasy. But the moment he pushed apart the fog with a wave of his hand, I understood, as a Sarkaz, he was young yet incredibly ancient.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I often think of the soldiers and companions that have left us. Sometimes, I have a sort of delusion that even now, I'm still fleeing... Doctor, have you been to Kazdel before? That was where my journey started, and once, where I'd thought it would end.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I often think of the soldiers and companions that have left us. Sometimes, I have a sort of delusion that even now, I'm still fleeing... Doctor, have you been to Kazdel before? That was where my journey started, and once, where I'd thought it would end.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2

voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I didn't expect to spend the New Year here at Rhodes Island. It feels...fresh. Actually, it's been a few years since I've been home for the New Years because of work. I really want to go back, even if I can only see my home from far away...

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Phew... I didn't expect to spend the New Year here at Rhodes Island this time. It feels kind of strange. Actually, because of work, it's been a few years since I've been home for the New Years. I really want to go back, even if I can only look at it from far away...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. Do you have work today too?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. Do you have work today too?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday... I'd like to ask, ever since I gave you that amulet, did any of your wishes happen to come true...? N—No? Then... do you have any wishes for your birthday, that I can make real?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: So many doctors aboard Rhodes Island are Infected themselves. Rescue workers who can't protect themselves properly... they're not a rare sight to see. But these rescuers still choose to walk towards disaster, realizing the risk and taking it in. Their conviction is most precious. I hope that our effort can help more people live in peace.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Umm, excuse me… I've been waiting here... for two hours…

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Sorry… I know people keep ignoring me... But... my Arts aren't to blame…

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My Arts... make me undetectable to people... in certain environments…

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I… I've never had any friends... S-surely no one wants a friend that…  they can't even notice… right?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: My tail... It curls up when I'm not fighting... So please, don't be afraid…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor... you can leave the dangerous work to me... After all... my Arts were made for that…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: These ID tags around my neck… I collected them... I like holding onto evidence... that someone once existed...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Don't let that 'Nightmare' girl near me!... She's dangerous... My Arts don't work on her... Why…?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I… I really want to cure my Oripathy. But if it's cured... what's going to happen to my Arts?... If they're gone, will I... still be of any use...?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor's ignoring me… I don't like it, hmph...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Manticore... My Arts can take out lives silently... Please don't be scared, you're not my target…

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Thank you... I-I'm looking forward to you teaching me... more...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Finally, I got a promotion... I always thought I wasn't good enough… so you didn't promote me…

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Did I... manage to help you? I don't have anywhere else to go... My home is here... at Rhodes Island... So please, let me protect it with you...

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Okay...

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Nobody will like me... as their captain...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Please don't leave me behind…

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Please choose tactics that make use of my Arts... even if it's something crafty and underhanded... I won't mind...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I-I'm ready...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'm…right here…

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Manticore… going dark…

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Ready... to ambush...

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: That must... really hurt…

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Please, Don't come close…

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I don't like this... either...

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Farewell…

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Even in such terrible battles… your judgement and decisions didn't seem to waver… You're incredible, Doctor…

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A victory by all means... Still...

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I can handle the runaways... if you wish...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'm sorry... It's all my fault...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I'll sit... in the corner...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Eeeeeek!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Thank you for paying attention to me... I know it's your job... but it still makes me happy…

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year... More people have  noticed me... in the last year... I'm a little scared, but... a lot of them are very warm, and kind... So, I'm going to try as hard as I can... to adapt...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello... Doctor...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I'll just put the present on the table and leave... Doctor, happy birthday... Eek! Did-did you notice me...? Um, Happy birthday to you... Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I don't want to go through the experience... of losing a friend again... I will defend everyone, with my own life. Even if it's somewhere none of them will see me...

operators.name: ミス・クリスティーン

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: It's fine enough in this office, but it's not much of a dalliance if we're stuck with work for days on end, you know... Unless, say, you'd let me lap at your emotions a bit?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I hear you calling for me, I'm just not obliged to heed. Oh, don't startle the little pink ones, I worked ever so hard to train them as cushions. They were cajoling me into lava surfing before that. So uncouth—you might as well subject me to rap or put me in one of those smoking mechs.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Listen to that. The little operators are rehearsing? I met Lucian when he was around their age. So vexed by all the emotions he had to portray—such a tasty little snack. I chose him. He sates my appetite. He's been fun to spend time with... Mm? Odd. When did he go and grow so big?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Of all the places to run into this menagerie. Mine? Don't lump me in with these debased louts—Zaaro, stay. You there, little silver wolf, are you their pack leader? Make Zaaro shush, and by the way, you have special permission to scritch my chin.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The femme fatale of Wrankwood? The Durin clockwork curiosity? The shadowy priest of Sargon? Those were little pastimes of mine. Put on a different look, and people shower you in fresh delights. Little games like that are never more fun than when they've just begun.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Why stop playing? Because after long enough, no one shows me anything I haven't seen before. Emotions and words on repeat, it bores me like nothing else, and I hate boredom. Hm? Insolence! You haven't earned the right to scratch my belly yet, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, over here one moment? I'm off to try that multimedia escape room. Tell me, which one looks better on me, the ruby lavallière, or the sapphire? —*HISS*!!! ...Excuse me, my true form was meant to frighten you just as it does everyone else. Typical, I didn't even get a taste...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: What a fine lavallière, this scrumptious mix of bashfulness and timidity... did your operators make this? I do quite love them... I'd love a taste of each of them. Pft, don't fret, only the special kind of emotion interests me. For example, that nervousness you just flashed in front of me, at long last. Oh, I like that.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Here, let me have a look under your hood—don't hide, do you think that stops me seeing? You know, you swallow up your operators' emotions too, don't you, Doctor? How your presence puts them at ease. *yawn* Move over, I'll have a catnap here myself.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: ...Mrm... prrr... mrrow...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Eyes down here, Doctor. Cat got your tongue? You can hear my voice now. Long time no see. You can pet me more than last time, I permit it.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: *yawn*

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, I can trouble you to set this in that red lavallière for me, yes? It'll look better on me that way.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Are you done with the photoshoot? Let me see... Hm? You'll have this framed and put up in the middle of the dormitories? Very well, I do like these shots. I'll allow it.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Let me see. Are you in trouble of some sort?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Be good. Stay put.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Any moods out here to pique my interest?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Let emotion engulf this place.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm here, in the shadows.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Petting a cat on the battlefield? That'll be one petting voucher.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: (The lady looks around, elegantly swishing her two tails.)

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: (The lady stretches out, seemingly very at ease.)

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Emotion-deprived puppets. Bland little spirits.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Despair, excitement, yearning... the emotions here are delectable.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: What other knotty emotions could there be?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Mrow?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Flavors fit for a gastronome. Thank you for entertaining me.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A fine snack. I'm satisfied. When's the next?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Oh my, there goes the afternoon tea.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Stay on my tail, Doctor, don't let emotion's whirl suck you in.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Do I get a room?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Insolence.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: ...Hrmm... prrr...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Ah-choo! Not even you're free of all these... sickly sweet emotions... oh, I almost feel dizzy... Doctor, come, we're finding Lucian. I want to see how these feelings look on his face.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I smell a note of delight, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: (The lady has left a dew-slicked rose on your desk. You look down, only to find that unbeknownst to you, a warm fuzzball with its four paws tucked in has nestled within your lap.)

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Your operators really want to see me do this, do they? ...Oh, fine, special permission just for today. You can rest me on your shoulder while you go round the landship.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Dr. Kal'tsit told me if you ever chose to place me at your side, it means you've decided to protect me. But maybe you're just as clueless as I am with her riddle, Doctor. Still, I'm sure she must've said it for a reason.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Tasty food, manga, and video games… I see them all as poetry scattered under the starry sky. I intend to relish them all on my journey... and eliminate anything that threatens their existence.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Ah, Doctor! Perfect timing! Please try this special sashimi I made. With my secret technique, the nutrients and vitality of the ingredients are best preserved.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Oh, this? It's a classic arcade game that used to be popular in Higashi. Want to have a go, Doctor? Here, just move that yellow mouth to eat and grow. However… until you've absorbed enough nutrients to grow strong, you'll only be prey to others.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: A sense of justice? No, You got me wrong, Doctor. I don't really care much about bad guys. It's just… for some reason, good people always let them get away with bad things. What if... someone came along and got rid of them? No one would feel bad for them, right? Everyone would just be happy.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Hmm… I still don't get your point, Doctor, but I just need to take out the ones you say are bad, yes? After all, I know the Doctor is a good person. What if you're the bad guy? Don't ask me that! I would be crushed. Even if you are, I really, really don't wanna…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: There's something on this ship that's both familiar and strange... gentle, yet hostile. It's making me uneasy, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, what does it feel like to hold the lives of others in your hands? If it were me, their warmth would make me tremble with excitement. Hm? Oh, I was talking about you as a commander, holding everyone's lifeline.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The food and nutrients we take in sustain and shape us. So sometimes I wonder... if we ate the same food and did the same things, would we gradually become the same? Doctor, would we?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: It's time to take a little break, Doctor. Come here, lie down. I'll go grab a blanket.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Ah, hello there, Doctor. Dr. Kal'tsit tells me you're my commander from today on! It's too bad I don't count as an official operator, but as long as you need my help, I'll do whatever I can.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I need to digest and absorb all this, right? I'll do my best.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I've earned your approval? Does that mean I can go to more places with you and get rid of more bad guys?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: On one rainy day, I received an unexpected gift that changed me, but I was not taught how to face the future… Doctor, if it were you, would you have shown me the path yourself?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I should stay hidden, even from my teammates? Understood, I'll do as you say, Doctor.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I will protect you from the shadows, Doctor, as well as everyone else in our squad.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The deployment plan and secret missions for this operation... Mhm, all confirmed.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Are they the enemies? They don't look half bad.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Your orders are my beacon.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Ready whenever.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: You always help me find my place.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Be bold, Doctor, trust what the mind says.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Looks like a piece of cake.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Thanks for the treat.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: These tentacles are illusions? Why delude yourself?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Evildoers need to be culled. They always will be culled.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: What a tough nut to crack. It'll take some time to digest this battle.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: There are fewer bad guys out there now, and it's all thanks to you, Doctor!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Huh? Doctor, why'd you let some bad guys through? I'll go clean them up for you.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: If it's only to cover everyone's retreat, I can do that… No, just saving everyone is not enough, the bad guys still need to be eliminated…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Shall I whip up something tasty to help everyone unwind?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hmm? What's up?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Achoo! Ugh... Why does it feel like someone's looking right through me...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! We've all grown by another year, and I've absorbed plenty of nutrients. I really hope everyone can keep evolving and become even better.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Did you miss me, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I dunno where it came from… But they say if you mix a little of yourself into a cake, then whoever eats it will go crazy for you. Sounds… sick, right? Wait, Doctor, don't run away! I didn't put anything weird in this birthday cake, I swear!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, when you look at me now, what do you see? Am I still just a kid, or have I grown strong enough… maybe even stronger than you? If that were true… Then shouldn't I protect you instead?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Thank you for choosing me, Darling. Now, what kind of secret are you going to share with me under this velvet of the night?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Fiend of the Night? Ah, I can't hide anything from you. But past glory is nothing to me. After all, I have an even brighter future waiting.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I may work in a different place now, but my job is still the same—to put a smile on everyone's face.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I bet Ms. Orchid must have been born with a negative number on her happiness scale. Why else would she always look so stern whenever I'm there to light her up? If you know anything about her, please tell me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: People say my swordsmanship is top notch. All due credit, I have to say. Practicing swordsmanship helps me maintain my figure and cultivate my elegance. It'd be a crime for me to slack off on the pratice. After all, you either keep the momentum and hold the lead or end up getting overwhelmed. Please keep that in mind.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: People used to say that I sold feelings as commodities, that I treated 'happiness' as a product. Fools, all of them. How can I expect my customers to open their hearts to me if I don't open mine to them first?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I believe happiness can be contagious. It's a tangible atmosphere that truly exists. I feel the joy when others treat me with sincerity, and I will make sure my happiness reaches right into their hearts.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My colleagues in team A6... they may be a bit weird, but they're truly kind souls. They're a gift from destiny, a gift that continues to remind me to cherish those important to me.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Now that I have some free time, I should read.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Show me your brightest smile, my esteemed customer! Happiness is at arm's reach when you're by my side. Midnight, at your service.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: It's important to never stop learning!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Whoa, so my hard work really paid off! Let's set up a champagne tower to celebrate. My treat.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: With me on your side, success is guaranteed!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Follow this handsome me!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Show me your spirit, everyone!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Behold, here comes my flamboyant moves!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: What's up?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I've arrived.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: OK.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: O sword, pierce the moonlight that veils the night!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Bathe in fresh blood!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Impressive, Dr. {@nickname}, truly impressive. Your blazing brilliance almost stole my show today.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: There's only one thing that's impossible for me: being imperfect.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Not too shabby. Such a heart-warming result calls for a little celebration.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: No need to look back. We'll greet each other with a smile next time.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: A wonderful place. Let's have a drinking party tonight.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: There now, would you please leave my collar as it is?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Thanks for taking care of me.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Sometimes, it doesn't take flowery tricks to capture a customer's heart. See the fireworks here? The sight of them going off, even just for an instant, will be enough to focus all the customers' attention solely on me, their souls scorched by my gaze... Orchid? Why are you dragging me away?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good evening, Dr. {@nickname}.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday. You should set your work aside for today. We can chat until dawn, and I'll stick by your side if you want to watch the sun rise. But {@nickname}, I trust that you know what to say if Orchid asks why I didn't work overtime tonight.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: What you see today is the fruit of all your hard work, {@nickname}. Nothing makes me happier than accompanying someone in admiring their own marvelous achievements. I do hope you'll still choose me to stay by your side this time next year.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Whaa? More work? But I came to Rhodes Island for a good holiday... Alright, if it's simply sorting files, I'm OK with that, I guess. But tell me, Doctor, what's my per diem?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: The report you wanted's on your desk. Yeah, just one page. Not like we get something new in Kazdel every day. I mean C'mon, What else do you wanna know? How to pick the gate of the Temple of Knowledge? Cut me some slack, will ya? I'm just a slum snitch. Oh, right, you people here prefer intelligence agent.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Our rules are different from the ones you have at Rhodes Island. Also, they're not spelled out in black and white. Cuz' paper's pricey, and only a few can read.
