Plus each neighbourhood's got their own rules, so no one outside those blocks calls me 'consultant'. You can if you want, just don't expect me to get all tangled up in your mess.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The bandages on my digits? Just for style. Funny story, a few days ago I taught a bunch of nitpicking punks a lesson at the market. A vendor saw these bandages and thought I got hurt in the scuffle, so he gave me a few more green onions as a thank-you gift. Hmm? There's blood seeping out? No worries, that's just beetroot juice.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: We call brown bread 'soft brick' and coats 'plaster'… What about sausages? What about 'em? Just sausages. Why? I mean, why give something you only get to eat once every few years a moniker? There's not much to the Kazdelian street slang, really. Just hang around a local construction site and you'll learn everything you need to know.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: With how crowded Rhodes Island is, I'm surprised you don't have full-on fights on your hands. In Kazdel, people trade blows over just about anything, like if a valve should be turned once or twice. Sounds stupid, right? But when I tried to calm them down, I had to defuse a fight with dozens of pitchforks and shovels in my face. By the time I did, my legs were so wobbly I could barely walk home.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Want a candy? I always bring a few when I go out in case I run into street brats. When they block you for stuff, just throw one out, and they'll try to beat up the kid who grabbed it, leaving me alone to go on my merry way. Is this strategy talk? Nah, just sharing an anecdote is all.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Yo, you still need those coupons? Let me have 'em if you're gonna throw them out, I'm so close to getting a free BBQ. Nope, I read the rules, what they say is 'Only one coupon per purchase'. So it's fine if I settle the bill after each free dish... Tell you what, I also have a 50% off coupon for two, so if you don't tell Closure my plan, I'll take you for some roast beast tonight.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Seems like there's more budget for next season's operation? I'm not a real intelligence dealer, but I agree with one of their rules: Valuable info for valuable clients. I never waste your time with worthless trivia, and it's not just on account of your good prices.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Keep up the good work, Doctor. I need a nap.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hey, wassup, here's my recommendation letter, HR already checked it. Wrong one? Give me a sec… uh, no… no… Oh, coupon... Ah, here it is. Sorry about that. Too many pockets on this plaster, hard to keep track of where I keep my things.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Way more entertaining than watching random street fights.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Your recognition is worth more than this medal, Doctor. By the by, is this pure gold? Kinda hard, to the bite.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Seems to me I've really sold my soul to Rhodes Island, but I'm sure you wouldn't want me to throw my life away so easily. If you ask me, we should live life to the fullest until we finish off everything we've gotta do.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: No… My sweet, sweet vacation… But seriously though, I got you. When have I ever dropped the ball before?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Now, ain't these big shoes to fill? Stay sharp everyone, and give me your a hundred and ten percent.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Here's the battle plan, if you got any questions... Figure them out yourself.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Don't warn 'em, just hit 'em. Don't give them a chance to react.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Alright, let's go.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: My turn now?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: What a mess, but the view's perfect.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Oww… this is tricky, gonna cost you more. How about double the pay?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I don't owe you an explanation.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Still feel like yapping?

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Oh I'm sorry, now you wanna surrender?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Seeing stars now are we? Sounds about right.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Man, that stuff was hairy. If all our missions are gonna be that rough, I'll need extra insurance.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: My hands are shaking? It's totally normal, and proof I gave it a hundred percent... Hey! I said it's normal, alright!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: No need for a blind chase. They won't get far, we should rest and refuel.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Stay cool, everyone. Fall back this way!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Big place. Wonder how the food tastes.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Careful now, you might prick your fingers.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Fruit's half off today, you can even buy it with points—ssh! Go get yours quick, and don't tell anyone.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I used to only see so many lanterns and decorations in Sauin parades. They don't carry the same significance, but it's breathtaking all the same. Go down for a closer look? Nah, here's a good spot. New Year's sale's starting soon, and I gotta be first in line.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, how was your break? Me, I'm still a little tired...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: You're a real mystery, you know? I asked around and nobody seemed to know what you like for your birthday. But from what I've seen, you probably won't hate this. Try it out, nothing like hot soup to wash away all your worries, so chug it down and celebrate!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, I've archived these reports as you requested. I even have a closing speech for you while you wipe my access clearances. The info you were most interested in last year was— I can stop? But you told me yesterday we have to keep looking back to stay on the right track.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You want me to do file collation work...? These documents of yours all look dusty. I don't want to touch them. And how was your office even planned in the first place? Did you genuinely not feel personally, utterly disgusted leaving this cabinet here?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I propose swapping for more corrosion-proof materials next time you do maintenance on the ship's core structure. Why? Because when all's said and done, it's not you or me that'll be left behind. It's this landship's skeleton. That's what's going to endure. That's what will stand for us.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You've got some planning work for me? I'll ask to review my partners' design styles first. As long as they aren't too complex about it, I might be able to accept—okay, okay, fine, I'll do it, I'll take it, it's not as if collaborations are some big deal. Besides, it's not that you have disastrous taste.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: What is it... Ah, darn it, the pencil smudged my belt again. I just got it replaced... Last time it was Gavial, saying she'd get me a new one of the same look. As if! The emblem on the clasp was straight from my designs, and obviously she didn't even give those an honest look!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I know, I'll go to the infirmary in a bit. I don't want to interrupt my thought process at the moment. And you know, Doctor, the moment is the exact thing I most value—you called Gavial in? Was she on duty at the Medical Department today? You can't fool—hello, Gavial, no no, I wasn't just working on any designs.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I used to appreicate a fan base of one, one who can truly see to the core of my designs, rather than having a crowd of followers with their superfacial admiration. For me, the latter holds absolutely no significance. But now… I suppose it's not all bad to let the masses see them. Discussion swirling around my work means I'm still alive.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Why do I tend not to greet anyone? Because once I do, I have to make small talk, and that forces me to crane my head up to speak with them, which makes me seem insignificant. We should be seeing eye-to-eye, on EQUAL footing... Are you asking if it weighs on me? As if! It just makes my neck ache.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I was genuinely full of anxiety back then. I always felt I didn't have enough time, though I'd never even accomplished a thing. But nowadays, I've gotten to the point where I can appreciate my own designs. The only thing is, it's been years since I last saw my teacher. I wonder if he'd be proud of me?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: A close look is all it takes to unearth the core sense of a man from his work. Just like how I used to disdain anything superfluous. I treated my own life in the same way. Doctor, an artwork is a microcosm of its creator's life. Yours, I can understand.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hmm. Such a counter-conventional sleeping posture, such a complex yet stable load-bearing structure... miraculous. Is this not going to give you neck arthritis?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Operator Minimalist, freshly dragged here by Gavial. So this is what a nomadic landship's like? You must have a much easier time avoiding Catastrophes than we do underground. Hmph, the only thing in those fools' heads is merrily drinking their lives away—ow, Gavial, what did you hit me for?!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: ...If it's not architecture-related, I don't want to see it.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A medal? Decently tasteful. You just give this to me, and that's it, right? I've absolutely no need for any sort of commendation ceremonies, and I imagine you don't like to waste time anyway. But I will—ahem—thank you for acknowledging me.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Everyone's experiences are different, and the significance lying behind my works will be out of sight to most... but there are some, like you, like my mentor, that I hope can understand.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: If Gavial's going, I'm not.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You want me for captain? What are you even... You're joking, aren't you? Hey!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Hm... alright, let me be clear, I don't have any prior combat experience. However, I am going to take this mission seriously.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Instrument debugging complete. I can begin any time.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I am aware. Don't push me.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: If you break anything, you're paying!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Instrument is operating fine. Now scanning terrain.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: So this... is war.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Keep away!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: We're not here to be courteous.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I just don't get you people...

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: What a waste of time.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Huh. You're mightier than you let on, aren't you?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: *cough* *cough* *cough*... There's so much dust—it's filthy. Gah.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: What are you looking at me for? You want me to chase them?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Snap out of it! Get running!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I don't want to open my eyes . I'm worried the interior design is going to scare the life out of me.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hold on, I'm busy.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Phew... what time is it? No, what day of the week? Er... did I eat anything yet? I don't think I did...?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Ah, this is the calendar you keep on the surface. I've heard of it. The significance in a holiday like this to commemorate a year's end—it's such an improvement over those days of pure idle indulgence... So another year's already passed. Be sure to cherish your time well, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, sitting for too long can leave you prone to neck arthritis. I suggest you watch out for yourself.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I've been straining my wrist muscles over the past few days. The Medic Operators told me it'd improve a little using these wrist braces, so I bought a few spares. I was at a loss for what to give you today, so take these two as a present. Just fix them to the table and they'll work.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: My life is doomed to be as short as it is. How could I ever reconcile with that? I find it genuinely difficult to keep calm... not that you—need to console me. If I was truly that weak, then I wouldn't be standing here right now.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: In a landward raindrop, in a humidifier's mist, whenever you need me, I'll hear your call.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: So you're saying I have the right to decide your schedule and itinerary?  Which means, whatever I write in this memo book, Doctor, you've gotta do. Wowie! Too late for regrets now, heehee.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: All trace of Her walking our land, all the names She was praised by… Everything is gone, evaporated like morning dew... Across our clan's recollections of Her, 'Muel' is the only thing that remains. A syllable now carried on in my name.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Ecology's about filling some dirt, putting some plants and animals on it, then making a profound study about the cyclic relationships between individuals, species, and biocommunities. With the help of innovative research, we can improve the ecosphere or even forge a brand-new... Well, someone clearly knows it all, because that's an unadorable look you're giving me. Alrighty, let's change topics.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: She's gone. She dispersed all Her Elves... then time carried Her far away, to a place farther still. But you know, just a hunch, I think She simply got sick of being a Feranmut. And just like some special Rhodesies we've got, now She's probably living up the human life, maybe? You think that sounds right, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I want you to come with me next time I go clothes shopping. The thing is, I don't really understand fashion stuff so much, and I wanna hear your ideas. What, you don't either? Sure! If you've got opinions, and I've got opinions, then we can do swapsies. Plus, I get to see you wearing something else for once.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: To get the information in this crystal, you have to 'communicate' with it. Yep, that's right, just like the kind we make when I hold your hand. Oh, actually, lemme borrow your hand a sec! How's that, can you sense Her feelings? No? Not one teeny tiny bit? Oh... Okay...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Are your lips kind of dry there...? Yeah, they look a little chapped. You need more water on the regular. Alright, you can have my chapstick, and then we're even again once you buy me a new stick. This is the only brand I use, and it's gotta be peppermint flavor. Don't get the wrong one. Okay?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Pfahhh! Water doesn't get cleaner than this! You can take a sip too, if you're thirsty. I know, you're probably scared it's Her blood or Her tears or whatever, but don't overthink it. If you drink from this spring, it'd make Her the happiest person of us all... well, not person, Feranmut.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Looking back on it, it's like Rhine was just founded yesterday. The stuff we fought over at that time is a total one-eighty compared to now. Heheh, good memories… Doctor, Do you still remember when Rhodes Island was new on its feet? No? That's fine, you'll remember with enough time.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The ever-wakeful spring wells from Her back, that its currents caress Her like silk cloth. And in sweet rains it waters the parched land, that it nourishes all life as it grows...' Your kin left that passage to Her in your recollections. It makes me think, I should draw Her. That way, others'll be able to see Her.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Here I am, dewdrop landed on a leaf, but we'll be baked away in the sun soon enough. Oh, don't let it end here. We could melt together, dew filling leaf's veins, and make our grand return to the land... um, that's about dew, okay? Like, it's just dew that wants to—um... Mmm...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You're right, no place suits me better than this. Problem is, I've been spoiled by modern life. If I seriously live here all on my own, the boredom is gonna shrivel me right up. Maybe the other Elves could deal, but... I can't... At the end of it all, I'm just a plain and ordinary girl.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Has Magallan been good recently? Oh, still out exploring? Hasn't said when she gets back yet? Aw, okay... I've still got the crystals she sent me last time, out in cold storage. Any interest in this stuff? Well, well, I see you have a good hobby. Come on, let's crack open your horizons.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The environment's changed so quickly here without Her, and it's not in my power to do what She did. It's like a lifelong dream suddenly landed in my lap, but the caveat was it could disappear at any time. So life will always be on edge, haunted by suspense and fear. I don't wanna live such a painful life, Doctor. I'd rather take the risk.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: If Kristen didn't have the talent and leadership, Rhine Lab would've never been founded. But maybe it was her power that got her to bare her true self to everyone in the end. People change. I wonder what I'll become?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Everything of Her, everything I could ever find, I've got it all by my side. Thank you, Doctor, for accompanying me so long. Whatever comes next, we can save thinking about it until we get back. Oh... it's raining. Maybe it's time for us to leave too.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My people have no future. We've only been able to pray for answers from the past. You're from the past, Doctor. You're the hope of my people, and me. But even if that wasn't the case, you're still the one who pulled me from the bubbles, and you're still gripping my hand. How could I ever let go now, right?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Time is still mourning Her, so it won't slip away that fast. If your legs need a break, we can sit and catch a breather.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Getting distracted on the job? Terrible habit.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: The birth, the existence, the dying, the everything of my blood's origin… They are all here, nothing left but pieces now... If you're interested, I'll tell you every story of them.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Muelsyse, Director of the Ecological Section at Rhine Lab. Not that I think we need any formal how-do-you-dos, Doctor. After all, we've been friends forever now.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This cramped cage we jail each other in.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: There really isn't a single fresh thing anywhere across the lands.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: We've known each other for so long, but you just keep giving the same gifts... Of course I love it, c'mon.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A present from you? I'll keep it nice and safe, that's a guarantee. How about in return, let's go to the movies?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Look, the sun's coming up. How warm it is... Cozying up like this, hiding away from all that the years do to catch us... May be a good life too.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Dew gets turned to vapor, and everything in it vanishes without a trace. Will I ever see showers of blessing? Will I ever meet my people again and know them anew?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: All the pains caused by 'right and wrong'… How I wish the water could wash them away.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Sunlight's a little spicy. Just let me take five.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: How do you understand them? And how do you make them... understand you?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Okay, maybe I should assign roles first?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Just look away one sec, okay? I want to let the waterflow relax for a bit... the way my people did so long ago.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The way seems kind of rough. Careful, you don't want to trip.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Lives head toward their demise. What can I do… before the end…

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Annoying people, annoying business. Let's deal with them ASAP.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm listening.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hiya.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Want me to help brainstorm?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Want a candy?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: This... is how my ancestors welcomed the rainclouds.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Okay, serious face.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Miss Waterdrop… where will you land?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Easy-peasy.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: In dreams resurrect.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Shape like water.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: In yearnings flow.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Now's not the time for hellos.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: In promises coalesce.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Let animosity be gone with the flow.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: But I can't go back. Back isn't the answer.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Oh wishes, I beg you coalesce.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Gimme your hand, Doctor! Uh, um... I just wanted to share my feelings with you. Don't worry, I'm not gonna get you wet.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Good work. Need to get under this umbrella?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The leaf trembles. The stream murmurs. I understand how they feel now much better than I used to… Oh, no, they're happy. Simply all delighted, trust me.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Job's done, be sure to rest up now.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: They're gone. Bet they know the way back home, right?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I told you to be careful... any ouchies?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Water will take us to safety. Hold my hand tight, and keep your eyes shut.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I got my mirages to lead them off. We'll go this way.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Same as it ever was, and honestly that's not bad.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Let's really decorate this place. It'll be cozy in no time, promise.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: At least I can still feel your touch.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: An exploration journey this endless isn't easy for me, no sirree. Did you really get used to it long ago? Don't work yourself too hard. C'mon, let's you and me take a little walk.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: If anything's bothering you, put it to one side for now. Here, try this out, 'Orange Storm'.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: There's no trace of time in our strata of crystals, just as our people in Sami don't leave calendars in their amber. That's that— we're a race who can't see what's ahead, embracing lives so long that we can't feel epochs flowing by. Give your terminal a break for now, Doc. Don't you want today to be a one-of-a-kind day?

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Office hours on a holiday, really? Even the most hardcore researchers at Rhine wouldn't be in the lab today. If you're so sure about going through that door, then I'm gonna... *sigh* I'll go get you some coffee...

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Oh, you all rested up...? Look after yourself, okay? No vanishing into bubbles on me.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hiya! How about a little chat before you get to work?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: You can stop guessing now. It's the real me standing before you, not a flowing shape. You know I make the trip here every year, so why would this year be an exception? Alrighty, I lugged half a ton of investigation files here for Rhodes Island. So c'mon now, let's just head to the restaurant first.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Hm? Mm... nothing, I'm just imagining what you might've been like when you were born. Speaking of which, you decided what you're eating tonight? It's not like the canteen instantly churns out your order, so can we hurry it up?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Beneath time's ashes, there lies the Elves' lost knowledge and forgotten tales... but even I can't really comprehend them. Digging through the past— it weighs down on you a lot more than healing a wound, or blessing a new life. Doctor, how do you manage to confront it all?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: If Kristen was here, she'd be far away from the crowd, out on that balcony staring up at the starry sky... Nobody understood her, just like nobody fully understands my own sorrows. You, Doctor? What kind of person are you, and what unspeakable aches live in your heart?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Pardon, but that report you submitted to Dr. Kal'tsit... we could barely read the last few lines as they are nearly indecipherable... Please don't stay up late so much...

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: So many things in here I've never seen before... Oh, sorry, I shouldn't be looking around... sorry...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I know herbs are rather bitter, but people could pay more attention to how effective they are…

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Um, Doctor... is Harmonia still not getting any better? ... I see... I'll attend to her as soon as I finish work.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I know my herbs aren't popular because they're bitter... Aww...but I don't know how to make them taste better... Oh, you mean I should ask around for tips? Bu-bu-but... I'm not that good at small talk... I guess I'll try my best…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Harmonia and I would explore all sorts of places together when we were kids. Yeah, we grew up in the city ruins, and were really hoping to see the world outside back then...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Harmonia is both my oldest and best friend... But I'm the one to blame for her Oripathy infection, and what she is right now... I will find the cure and make up for the life Oripathy has taken away from her. I promise.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Ms. Perfumer suggested that I add some spices into my herbs and now they taste much better! I'm so glad I managed to summon the courage to ask everybody for their advices...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Harmonia says I'm in higher spirits these days. Do you agree as well, Doctor? It's all thanks to your timely advice. I wouldn't know what to do without you…

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor... oh, are you asleep? Yay! Now I can look around the office to my heart's content.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, I'm Myrrh, an herbalist. Dr. Kal'tsit gave me this title... she said myrrh symbolizes the ephemerality of life and wanted me to keep this in mind.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Thank you so much! This way I'll be able to concoct even better medicine.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: This is called a... promotion? Is that it...? Um, I don't really know much about stuff like that…

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: This reminds me of childhood with Harmonia, when we explored secret places and abandoned buildings. The more dangerous the place was, the rarer the ingredients we could find.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Uh... I'll try my best not to drag everyone down...

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll start by doing my best to make eye contact...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Ah, Doctor, I'm ready to go.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I'll do my best to make sure no one gets hurt...!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm with you.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'm coming.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I need to be careful.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Does anyone need healing?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Gotta aim more carefully.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Here's the medicine!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Medicine here. Please, take it!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: It's okay, it's curable!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: We won? Really? Even against those really tough opponents? Wow... you're so cool, Doctor!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: How's the medicine this time, everyone? ...Um, I guess I'll ask when we get back...

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: So much to do in so little time... Thank goodness I didn't mess up too badly…

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: My vials... All shattered...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Uh... I can still smell herbs on my clothes...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Wahh!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Excuse me, Doctor. I made you some herb soup good for soothing the body and calming the mind. It's just... a bit bitter…

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I'm getting the seeds ready to plant my herbs once spring comes. I hope they'll grow strong and healthy, and that... that I won't even need them this year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Oh! Good morning, Doctor

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I've prepared you some pills, based on your health records. They'll help you relax and sleep better. And don't worry, I've coated each one in cake-flavored frosting. If you like them, I can make more for you whenever you want!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I came to Rhodes Island to treat my closest friend. But when I got here, I found even more people who needed my aid. I'm so glad my herbal medicine can be useful... I hope that, one day, my herbs will be the most bitter thing anyone in this land has to deal with.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Can I read any of the books here? I can read all of them?  Oh, thank you! I'll be careful! I won't mess them up!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Ah, sorry, please don't go touching my book. It might bite your hand if you do. No, really, I'm not joking, I'm serious. Look! I even have to tie it shut like this.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, do you know where the library is? I asked someone just now, but they were talking too fast. It was hard to understand.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Skyfire, um, Skyfire, wait for me! Uwwhh, please don't walk so fast... I promise I won't run off halfway this time, I promise!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I like reading, but I like hanging out with everyone too! It makes me so happy when I can be with the people I like. Also, don't be fooled. I'm really good at sporty stuff! Especially climbing trees. I can climb super high!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I got some new inspiration after talking to Miss Eyjafjalla today! She's very well-researched on environmental geology. Thank goodness my group's research wasn't stopped because of my accident. Heheh! If I get results this time, I can reapply to the Institution to resume my studies.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Skyfire is an alumna from my university. She graduated soon after I entered since she skipped a year, but even still, she did look after me... Oh, speaking of! She's also the one who introduced me to Rhodes Island! It's thanks to her I'm receiving treatment here.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Um, I suppose I've been following you around, haven't I? I mean, I feel really at ease when I'm around you, so I just unconsciously... A-Am I annoying you, Doctor? Do you want me to go away?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, this is for you. I found it on the way back, and so many more pretty-looking stones just like it! But, well... that was before I realized I'd gotten separated from the others. Mm? The ore chunk on your desk from before? I put that there too, yes. Did you like it, Doctor?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Nnh... mmmmnnh... there! Ah, Doctor! Sorry! Did I wake you up? There was a bug on your head, so I just, um—did it hurt? I can shush it better!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Thank you for helping me move all these books! Just leave them here, please. Oh, my codename is Mint. What's yours? Doctor? Wait, so you're the Doctor? Skyfire was telling me about you!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Wow... incredible! Everyone's so incredible!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Are there any rewards for promotion? Can I borrow even more books than before?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, come sit down here. How is it? The sun feels really nice, right? Eheheh. This is my secret base. I love it here more than anywhere. Don't tell anyone else about it, okay?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Got it. Are you coming with us, Doctor?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Wait! You want me as the leader?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: We're off.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Are those our enemies, then?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Mmmm… Whuh? What? Yes, I'm listening!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Yep! Leave it to me.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: One, two—whoopsie-daisy.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Please don't get in our way!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Take that!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Please calm down a little!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I've got you now.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Would you like to see some of my magic?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Everything went just like you said it would, Doctor! Amazing...!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Phew... it's over. We can finally head back now.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: It doesn't look like any more are coming for us... This is fine for now, right?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We can't, it's too dangerous... Doctor, you need to get away!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Um, to tell the truth, I'd be alright sleeping in the library too.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Yah!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Ah! Doctor, would you like to read with me? It's really comfortable sitting here.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Hm... I'm starting to miss my mum and dad. Skyfire has been away from home for so long. Maybe I should ask her how she manages... Oh, Doctor. Will a Messenger visit Rhodes Island today? I have a letter I'd like to post.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: So this is where you were, Doctor! Found you.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, here's a book as a present. Happy birthday! Look, I illustrated the cover myself. I'm always gathering minerals, and these ones have been recent favorites of mine. I looked for paints with lusters as close as I could get! And I have the actual rocks to give you too, of course. What do you think, Doctor? Go on, it's all for you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I wish I could participate in more research projects. My instructor and teammates always take such good care of me. They're worried my illness could get worse if I push myself too hard, so they don't let me join them on the surveys... I must get better at Rhodes Island so I can go back and focus on my research.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: We've got more kitties! Yeah…

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Laterano cakes are so delicious! But we operators have to pay attention to our diet, right?... aww...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Not my gloves... I'm sorry, I can't take my gloves off... I don't want you to see my hands. That's the one thing I ask... sorry…

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: A-Are we departing now? Al-Alright, let me just prepare one moment...!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Do you think it's odd that I have two tails? Do-do-do I look even stranger than I thought? Umm...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: When my symptoms aren't flaring up, my hand stays all normal... It feels so nice, just being able to hold the kitties like this...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, what kind of cake do you prefer? Mango, or matcha? I tried making a few, and... you already ate? Oh, umm, Okay...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: D-Doctor! Sora... sh-she's the super idol, Sora, isn't she?! I'd recognize her anywhere! I'm her biggest fan! Why is she here at Rhodes Island? And... and... can I ask her for an autograph?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, have you heard of the Avenue des Champs-Élysées? Yes, I happened to be born there. I really wish I could go back and visit one day... what? Oh, no, I appreciate it, but I'm not lonely. I have you, after all! You're my family.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Aw... Doctor... why are you ignoring me...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Good day... p-please call me Mousse. And... and please don't stare at my hand so much...

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This is a favor I'll never forget!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Huh? Pro...promotion?! I-I'm not prepared for this...

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, I know there's a limit to what I can accomplish, so I swear... I'll do all that I'm able, as well as I'm able! It's... It's the only way I could ever repay you, Doctor...

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Yes, I'll do my best!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: This is in my hands! You can do this, Mousse!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I essentially blend into the walls, so I'm a good choice for scouting...

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Scouting complete. Sending you enemy coordinates.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm ready!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Here!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'm not scared...!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: From now on, this is my battle...!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Yah!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: No, stay back!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I can fight too!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You-You'll regret this!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: It was a tough fight... but I stayed steady through it all...!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Yay... Oh, oh, sorry, it's not that I like battles that much, but...

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: D-Did I drag us all down?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I can... keep going...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: E-Excuse me... May I come in...?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Yah!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: D-Doctor... I really can't hold it in anymore... do we have a scratching post? Urghh...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy new year, Doctor… Help yourself with the pastries there! I personally made some of them, and they go well with the tea I prepared. With my gloves on me though... they may not look as great as what I used to make. B-But should still taste good, I think!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, could you accept this felt doll? I made it with the fur those kittens left behind. It was a lot of fur for a small doll, so I tried a few times to get it right. Do you recognize it, Doctor? It's you... N-No? Aw…

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Sora just gave me more of her albums, and they also came with her signature on them! How nice of her! She also gave me this little heart-shaped doodle on my gloves, saying these are the coolest gloves she's ever seen, and that I looked really special with them. Doctor, I'm thinking, maybe... I'm not as weird as I thought?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: If you've thought it through, I have no qualms with it. Please let me know when the documents are due.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Just another rainfall.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: ...Please, go ahead. It's okay. Reading the paper is just an unhelpful habit I picked up in the Grand Knight Territory, but one can learn much more from a day's trip outside the city than a hundred papers can teach... It's true that the Nearl name often shows up in the headlines, but there's no need to pay that any mind.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I've never guaranteed your survival for following me, Toland. If it was their lives that your hunters valued, they shouldn't have stepped onto the battlefield or had their recklessness take over them in the first place... Their deaths are not what you need to downplay for your mockery. You will always remember. As will I.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I'm afraid I can't advise Rhodes Island on its affairs in Kazimierz. I may have spent a decade in that tower, but only as an unambitious nobody. I'm in no position to express my views on the General Chamber of Commerce. The sword...? Yes, I know how to use one, and I've always used the same one.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The rivalries in the halls of power never ceased, they've merely become a part of the opportunistic pursuit of profit. The only constant is the innocent being dragged into the cesspool. As vassals of a treasonous knight, your parents were forced to take you into their involuntary flight ere the fabricated incrimination could arrive... Czcibor, why? Why didn't you... flee even further?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: No need to have Maria come see me. She's not a child anymore, and ought to make her own decisions, lest she embarrass her parents. A knight should temper themselves through travel, and no matter what she does under Rhodes Island's wing, she must always be responsible for her own actions.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Why are you still here? Our ideals have come to an end, and I witnessed their final moments... No, never mind. You wish to spar? Then pick up your spear. Entrust your future not to a failure, but to sacrifice, and the pain in your flesh. Come.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Leithanien's conspiracies... Nothing more than trifles that happened years ago. It doesn't change the fact that I'm an ordinary citizen, nor does it change anything else. To Kazimierzians, stars and heroes come and go. The success they enjoy is only that which they are permitted.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Father, you once told me that longswords are suitable only for valorous young knights. But the National Council's miscarriage of justice, the General Chamber of Commerce's rise to prominence—everything I've wanted to stop, my blade was useless to prevent. I couldn't remove your lesions, and with it by my side I watched as Schnitz left... I merely became accustomed to its prescence.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Seems Margaret kept the title she earned from that charade. Hmph, so she still sees her actions as a victory, after squandering the Nearls' glory in those cheap commercial performances... My Originium Arts? Alas, I can nary illuminate a thing.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Golden plains, a field of wheat, the path of a nomadic city, and the wake of a Catastrophe. The manor's garden, the arena, and those who hand over their last coin along with their last harvest... Father, I've always tried to walk a righteous path.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: No need to teach me how to get along with the Infected...You should be aware of my time spent living among the refugees…? The Infected, the disabled, the bankrupt, the famished and poor... they're all the same in the ways that matter. The most honorable thing they can hope to achieve is climbing out of their tent in the settlement before their final moments arrive.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Forget it, Schnitz. How am I to tutor Maria in your stead? I am no knight, and certainly no father. No one would call me 'gentle.' Besides... I never once imagined I would actually return to this place... Why, Schnitz? Why am I the one to remain?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You, too, encourage the others to throw themselves at a cause that will yield no results. Those who attempt to walk through fire in the dark night will only find themselves immolated. That said, you don't need my advice, given the path you so obstinately walk alone.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Margaret doesn't speak to me, but considering how she was back then... we had no need to. She is just like you were at that age, Yolanta, too much so. She will experience the same things you did, and she will never regret them. That I should tarry at her side more? Hmph, there's no point.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: In the first two years after they left the Grand Knight Territory, the campaign knights would often bring me their letters. By the time the last one arrived, Maria was already old enough to understand its gist... Whether the letters were written beforehand makes no difference to me, but given the weight of their lives and deaths, they wouldn't have disappeared without so much as a peep.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The Grand Knight Territory's appearance is ever-fluid. Today, the city exhibits no trace of what it was twenty years ago, its sunset-lit silhouette sunken and gone... Yet its nightscapes still spring up to my mind at times wanted and at times not. Often, I find myself thinking that I should at least... try to seek out and reclaim that past.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: A wilderness without light…

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: The sound of a rainstorm in the wilderness...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Młynar Nearl. Per our contract's provisions, I shall assist Rhodes Island with its operations in Kazimierz. ...You already knew my name. I'm neither a knight, nor do I have a title.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: 'Fear neither hardship nor darkness...' Hmph. A bygone time unworthy of remembering. A dream, far too lucid.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: A Kazimierzian is smart after the damage is done…

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Nearly the same struggles and sacrifices...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I appreciate your appraisal, if you consider such ordinary performance worthy of promotion.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Blank paperwork for promotion within the order, excerpts from the recon knights' reports on our movements... Schnitz often sent these things, as his way of saying hello.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Titles and positions are both meaningless. The knights of the Nearl family do not require recognition to walk their paths. Even in modern Kazimierz, where every path leads to darkness.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: How should I present myself...? As the one slandered by the papers and the groundless gossip in town? Or as the wanderer who once treated that vilification as a badge of honor?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Man has forgotten true struggle… as well as those who require it to survive.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: To think they all still believe that blood is not spilled in vain…

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: ...Follow me.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Follow me.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Sand, dust, and blood. Most fail to imagine the sight of their admixture.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The sound of the wind in the barrens... Far too familiar.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: To think they are unaware of their own shame...

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: It would seem they have yet to remember what to fear.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm fully prepared.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Yes?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Hm.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Blade whetted again… for but another battle…

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: These so-called foes… not even worth drawing my sword.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Do I need to repeat myself on the battle plan?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Just like the old days?… No.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: All those... I have yet to abandon.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: This won't hurt your eyes.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: It will be over before you feel the pain.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: How very tiring.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Face the tide? Hmph.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: It rains.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: The sunlight will have to wait.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: That sigh... still haunts my mind.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Even if there is but a sigh at the very end.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: You still have full confidence in everything... With these people's fate in your hand, you still believe there will be a happy ending.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: There is no one man who loftily sneers at the pointlessness of it all... Time speeds past us equally.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: If you have no other work for me, I shall take my leave.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: ...Wake me up.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Deserters… they always have somewhere to hide, among their like-minded brethren.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: From the windows of Kawalerielki's towers, my eyes have grown tired of those men and their unpunished misdeeds.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Mark my words, there will be battles you cannot win. Have you considered the consequences of those inevitable failures?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: 'Failure can be endured.' ... But the price is always dear.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: You... accommodate quite a few people here.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I have no promises to make.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: ...I believe I've made a suggestion regarding this matter?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: I can tell who you are. Speak freely.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Kazimierz's knight novels... Hmph... The Grand Knight Territory no longer has room for such fantasies.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Do not add any frivolous decorations to my sword, Toland... In the Grand Knight Territory, there are merchants eying the Nearl name. They will do as you do, and ridicule me in your place.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Margaret and Maria should be on board... No, no need to tell them. I find the commotions that come with the New Year unbearable. I'm just going to read the paper here.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Let us pretend that today was the New Year. Who could remember dates, after having trudged the wilderness for so long? ...But I am not wrong about the dates, I know. Everything that happens in Kawalerielki is measured by how many days it remains in the paper, no more and no less. No matter the story.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good day... 'Doktor.'

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Do I long for the old days? No. I simply cannot forget. That which I saw in the places untouched by light... and could do nothing about.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: If you have no time to deal with work today, then I'll take my leave. A present? I used to give Maria gifts when she was little. I even once chased after bandits who had ransacked a village, for the sake of a small child's birthday wish. That said, you are not a small child.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Once you stop making wishes, you naturally no longer look forward to birthdays. Whether that's because you can already fulfill them on your own, or out of crippling despair... I'm afraid it's been far too long since the last time I said 'Happy birthday' to anyone.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The future that Rhodes Island paints is impossible, but still, you attract supporters to chase it with no regard for their own safety. Your tottering ideals would never have come this far without the support of your followers. So spare me the civilities. I'm only walking this path alongside you for the time being.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: No matter when or where, there are always those shouting out their naive ideals. However, the idealists are not the only ones who can move forward.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, I may be in your employ, but every murderer is probably somebody's old friend—so if your conduct is even slightly suspect, I won't turn a blind eye!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: This Rhodes Island has no less of a suspicious smell about it…

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Careful observation is fundamental to all investigatory work! Elementary, true, but it always comes in handy!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: You there! Face this way, hands where I can see them! Ah, sorry, I thought you were someone else…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I've always had my misgivings about that penguin. I mean, it spends money like water, and it's a PENGUIN! It even has a gold necklace on! Do you know how LITTLE detectives like us make in a month?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Mmmgh... so frustrating! How do I get my investigation on that suspect logistics company started? Do I break in? Hrmm, not when those two guards look so dead fierce... No, no, I'm not scared... I'm just warming up the little grey cells!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: What are you giving me anpan for? I don't eat this sort of thing while I'm mid-investigation—you must be getting funny ideas from all those TV shows! When a real detective's on the case, it's doughnuts or nothing!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: You told me it was only for three months. But after three months came another three months, and another. I've been almost ten months undercover, guv! ...Hey! I see you there! Stop eavesdropping on my call!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, I fear that penguin has noticed I've been investigating it... I fear for my life, too...!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Wake up! Waaake uppp! No sleeping on the jooob!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Royal Detective May, and I ask you cooperate with me in my investigation! Eh? I've got the wrong address? Impossible! That penguin's holed up here, and I have the evidence!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Don't I look so dashing when I'm on the case?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you for the promotion, guv'nor! I'm so grateful you... Wait, forget that! You're not even my ACTUAL superior!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Elite team? Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait, I'm a Royal Detective! Why is some mercenary organization the one promoting me?!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: No letting any suspects sneak onto the team, okay?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Heheheh! Leader? Nay, call me DETECTIVE CHIEF INSPECTOR!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: All units move out! Mooove ooout!!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: You criminals! Behave and turn yourselves in!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What's happening? An incident?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Yes, guv, understood!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Crime scene investigation!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll need to see proof of identity!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: This is your one warning!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Stop right there, criminal scum!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I'll give you a taste of my taser!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: It won't hurt, you'll just get a little buzz!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: For a master detective, there is no case that can't be solved!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I want all these suspects taken away! Ohh, fine, I'll do it myself...

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Hmm... I feel like we've missed some clues, haven't we?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: R-requesting backupppp…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: My instinct tells me there'll be a case afoot here!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: You and your villainous hand! I'll remember this!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: D-don't think this is some express ticket to clearing your name...!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, Happy New Year! I solved plenty more cases last year as a Royal Detective! The only thing is, I'm still a little ways away from baring the truth of Penguin Logistics... Not that an inspector leaves any puzzle unsolved! I've got to give it my all this year too!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: There you are, Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Shh, shhh—not a word, hear me out first! I'll bet you anything it's your birthday today, isn't it? You see, I didn't seek ANY verbal testimony, not when I could simply let the available clues inform my mental deductions! By the way, I also happened to deduce this is a present you'll love—doughnuts!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Streamers stuck up, snacks laid out, balloons of every color. Yes, one truth prevails! Doctor, based on my deductions, today must be some holiday celebration! What? They sent an advance notice to every operator's terminal yesterday? It can't be!!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Structural design, industrial R&D, scientific research. You name it, and I can do it, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: The Engineering Department never approve my proposals. Do they have any bias toward me? What should I do... Oh! Actually, Doctor, would you please submit this suggestion on improvement for me? It's a deal then!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: There are many workshops like mine in Rhine Lab, but what takes others six weeks to finish, I can have it done in one. I'm not boasting!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: DO NOT interrupt me when I'm doing my research, or I'll have my Meeboos bite you! And I will bite you too!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: At night I'm always full of inspiration... and the… urgency to sleep! No, I can't bear it... Where's the pillow... I need to rest...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Hm? Why are these cuties called Meeboos? That's because they go 'meeee-boooo' when they boot up. So I named them after that. Fitting, don't you think? Just listen and you'll get it. You press this switch to... NONONONO, That's the self-destruct button! Ahhhhhh run！

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: That girl who just passed by... that was Silence, right? If only back then... Oh, sorry, the non-disclosure agreement is still in effect. I should keep my mouth shut.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I feel kinda empty when I've got nothing to do... I guess that's just how engineers are. I bet even you have to idle your time away on occasion, Doctor. Huh? You don't?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, may I request... No! Not 10 square meters! I asked for too much last time, so this time... all I need is 3! W-Wait! Don't leave yet! 1 square meter, just 1 more for my research will do! Please, Doctor, I'm begging you...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Geez... where's the coffeemaker... Oh, there it is... You want some too, Doctor?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Lutra Workshop of Rhine Lab, at your service. Yup, I run the workshop on my own. No assistance needed. Amazing, right?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This structure... Interesting. I'll look into it.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: This raise came just in time! I can afford to upgrade my equipment now.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I promised that you'd not be disappointed. Now look what I have! Surely kept my end of the bargain, didn't I?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Time to go, Meeboos!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Commanding both Operators and my Meeboos at the same time is a bit much even for me...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Hopefully we can get some useful experiment data!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Come on, Meeboo, show them what Rhine Lab's technology can do!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Whoa!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Careful! Be gentle with it!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Handle with care!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Precision equipment isn't cheap!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Get 'em, Meeboo #3!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Bite 'em, Meeboo!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: If anything breaks, just make another one!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: My Meeboos are more than just machines!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Come on, Meeboo! Show everyone your victory dance!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Nice! We practically rolled over them!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The device is slightly damaged. I'll fix it in no time.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Oh no! My Meeboo...! I'll need to make more...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Now I want a new workshop!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Whuah?! Hey, I'm working here!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, let me touch your head! Inspiration can strike, you know!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! I love New Year's, there's always so much to eat when you go out, even if you miss the canteen's dinner time! I wish every day could be like that... Ouch! Alright, fine Meeboo, I'll eat on time, you're hurting me!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Heya, Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Your birthday present? A literal piece of cake! Here's a cake sample, complete with blueprint, recipe, and a mass-production line ready for full rollout! How's that?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: What is research for, Doctor? My former coworkers say I can be surprisingly shallow, but if I were only in it for the money or fame, there are better ways. I just want to help advance technology, even by a little bit. And here, I can do that.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I sense something familiar in the wind. Where are we?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Do you feel the wind from Kazimierz?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Rhodes Island is very different from the places I used to live. There's nowhere to start a campfire here... too bad. Maybe on the deck? I'd like to create a space where everyone can talk and grow closer together.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Umm, how does this mission signup system actually work? I'm really bad at electronics…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: There have been lots of new faces at Rhodes Island. I'll gladly help them adjust to the environment.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: That Kazimierzian knight... Oh, it's her. I knew that girl years ago. She used to be a shy, bookish type. I wonder what made her change so much.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Shh... look what I found! A solitary Doctor... gotta catch this one! Oh, did I scare you? Haha…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I sometimes recall the time back home in the forest. We had lots of different competitions every year…ah, the good old days. I wonder what my hometown is like now.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I'll always have your back, Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: So you can fall asleep without a care, just like that? Heheh...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, I'm Meteor, the archer from the woods. Do you need an Operator who excels in long-distance support?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Archery requires constant practice. No one can afford to slack off for even one day.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm honored to receive this promotion.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thank you, Doctor, for recognizing my skill. I'll continue to do my best to serve you.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Leave the long-distance support to me.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll keep everyone safe.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Everybody, let's go.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Time to show them what we can do.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Awaiting your orders.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I've been waiting for a while.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: The wind is blowing in the right direction.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll stay vigilant.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Perfect chance!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Feel the wind.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: This is the shot!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Critical hit.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: No matter how difficult the battle, we can handle it, as long as we work together as one.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Perfect! You all did well.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: All injured personnel, please stay put, don't move. I'll be right there.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'm sorry... I didn't want it to end up like this...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's hard to get used to such a small room.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh? Need anything?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Being by your side feels like basking in the spring sunshine. So warm, so comfy.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Another year gone by. I wonder if the forests are as I left them? I'm still not too used to modern life, and people still fear Oripathy as much as ever, but the arrival of a new year means the land is once again shining with new life. There's still hope, for everything.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I found this plant a few days ago on a field mission. It's quite a miraculous one. Even when it's wilted, all it needs is to soak in water for a few nights, and it'll regrow all its leaves and stems—a method that lets it live for a very long time. Happy birthday, and may our fellowship be just like this plant.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Oh dear, these electronic appliances never make it easy. But I've been making progress, don't you think? Some of the things you call 'old-fashioned' just suit me better, like this bow. After using it for so many years, it has my total trust.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: It's time for my shift. If I'm interrupting your work, I can wait outside.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Have you gone through every new operator's personnel files and info?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Nowhere in the world is completely safe with a war going on. Not even Rhodes Island. Please remember that.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: To be frank, you're surrounded by people from all walks of life. That can be quite dangerous, don't you think?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm surprised that so many other Sarkaz have come to Rhodes Island. What's more surprising is that they actually get along…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My bowgun may not be easy to operate, but it's just as powerful as the Laterano guns. I use it to defend the glory of my people.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I see Firewatch is here. I can't believe she's using the name of our old guerrilla group as her codename. It's like time stopped for her the day her home was destroyed...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: As for what happened between Firewatch and I... she'll tell you when she's ready. All I can say is that I was not the one who led the rebels to her village... but no one would believe the words of a Sarkaz, right?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: She wants her revenge, and I have my duty. Even though we've met again at Rhodes Island, it probably won't affect anything. Our paths aren't likely to cross.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: What's that sound? Is someone monitoring this room? Or am I just… imagining things?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Codename Meteorite, a freelance mercenary. I'm Sarkaz, as you can see. Do you still want to hire me?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: My aim with my bowgun has improved.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: You want to promote me? I see that I made the right choice to work here.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thank you so much for this, really. I can't believe someone like me could work a stable job here at Rhodes Island. I'll do everything I can to repay your trust in me.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Reporting for duty.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Me, a leader? To be honest, I'm not that good at giving orders.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I'll do my best to take care of everyone.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Enemy status confirmed. All units, prepare to engage.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: All right.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: No problem.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I've got a clear shot.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Let's take them all out.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Fire!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Open fire!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Focus fire!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Get back!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I don't want to see anything laid to waste in the fires of war ever again. Let us put an end to this, once and for all.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Trying to escape after I laid you to siege? Don't be silly.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Someone's escaped. Not the time to let our guard down.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Retreat! Back to the stronghold and regroup.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: What's this place?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh? Huh? What?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Is this for me? Thanks.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: That's another year, come and gone. Getting to live one more year is certainly worth celebrating as a merc, but more than that, I don't want anyone else living with this kind of uncertainty... Doctor, I got some presents for the kids of Rhodes Island. Could you hand them out for me?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: How's it going, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I want to take this chance to express my gratitude, for you are always looking out for me. I wasn't sure what would be a suitable gift... but I will give you an oath, I'll give it all I've got to protect you. Um… is that okay?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Before this, I'd never stayed with an organization for such a long time, and I haven't figured out my plans for the future, but I really wavered when I heard Amiya say, 'I want to help the Sarkaz.' Maybe there are still lots of people out there, with hope for the future in their hearts.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You would like me to take care of your secretarial work? I can, but please do keep the amount of work under control. I used to write reports fairly often, but most don't find the contents of my reports very pleasant to read.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You can stop looking at my shoulder. This is not an Oripathy lesion. It's just a tattoo that resembles one. Why? To outwit anyone who thinks they've found a weakness. You won't bother me again after the first time you guess wrong.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: That's right. I became an Infected while I was testing this railgun. Why am I still using it? First, it's safe now that it has been fine-tuned. Secondly, while I don't want to admit it, this is the weapon that suits me the most. I don't want to or dare to abandon it.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The medicine in my earrings? It's not medicine. It's a perfume that I mixed myself. A highly concentrated perfume that can induce... emotions that run opposite to hostility. It comes in handy in dangerous situations. As for the lower concentrated one that I have here... Umm, it's for alleviating carsickness. I tend to get carsick pretty badly.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I'd say I was a mercenary, more than a weapons tester. As soon as the higher-ups gave the order, I would have to take to the battlefield with newly-issued equipment. It was nothing like the battles I've fought for Rhodes Island. No one knew or cared why I fought.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I was infected not because of an accident, but because of a transaction. For my infection, the client got their data, and the provided got a significant payment. Plus, they got to keep me on a leash with their insurance... If it wasn't for them treating me like a tuskbeast, why would I have run?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The first time I struck a dummy, I thought back to my parents, that bandit, and how powerless I was despite having a gun in my hand... Even after I was out of ammo, I was still mechanically pulling the trigger over and over, until the coach took away the launcher in my hand. That's right. A launcher, not a gun.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I once thought about opening a sundries shop like my parents did. Once, I even had an agreement with a landlord. Then, I had nightmares that entire night... Now? Much better. I'm even trying to help Instructor Dur-nar—Oh, please don't tell anyone about this.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My father used to tell me stories of how the great Blacksteel founder upgraded their firearms. But it wasn't until recently that I realized true greatness is not to popularize some kind of weapon. Instead, it's to make weapons useless forever. Right, it's very ironic. This is what I dream of achieving, and it is something that I can only dream of achieving.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Please rest at ease. I will ensure the office's safety during this period of time.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor. As a field operator, I will be in your service from here onwards. I hope that my firepower will not betray your expectations.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: That is excellent CQC, but perhaps a little too dangerous...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: The only way my former employer expresses approval is by raising wages—Don't get the wrong idea. For every wage increase, they make you do ten times the work afterwards. That's not how Rhodes Island works, right?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Thank you for your trust, Doctor. I used to think of Rhodes Island as a stopping point so beautiful that it's almost unreal, but it now seems I will have to extend my stay here for a little longer.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I'll provide fire support for everyone.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You are appointing me as the leader? It appears this will be a tough battle.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Everyone, so that we don't run into any unexpected issues on the field, check your weapons once again.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Maintain a safe distance. Avoid direct confrontation if possible.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Your command?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Adjusting firing trajectory... Complete.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Weapon's good. Ready for data collection.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Shh. Do you hear that? That's the sound of the reaper making her advent.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Laying suppressive fire.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Maximum output reached.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Don't huddle there. Hard for me to assess the blast area.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I... I'm suddenly a little terrified. If I were on the other side facing you and your command, how much of the firepower I'm so proud of would actually be effective?

voices.title: 3-star Result
