voices.text: A perfect performance, to the point that I want to write an evaluation report, voluntarily.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: A few of them got away. It seems we need some further adjustments.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Cover the retreat? No problem. It's important to evaluate performance during retreats, too.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Considering the weapon's size, this place might be a little cramped.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Doctor, don't touch. You could get hurt.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Would you like to head to Engineering together?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Would you like me to shoot up some fireworks with this launcher? That's not a metaphor. It really has a fireworks mode. It's had one ever since I first got it.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good morning. A dream-less night of sleep alleviates exhaustion the most, don't you think?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: My former coworkers celebrated each safe return from a mission like a birthday. I wasn't really into hanging out with them. The wild carousing like they lived through a disaster always made me feel sick—I'm sorry, Doctor. I shouldn't be saying this today. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island is a place you can talk about your dreams without feeling embarrassed, and I like that. If I could start over, I would've come straight here without spending that time as a weapons tester... Maybe that way, I would already have taken a step toward my dreams.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: H-Hello, Doctor... It's nice meeting you...

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Um... Sorry... I'm not a good talker...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Yes... My parents are Victorian merchants. But I haven't been able to contact them for a long time... I picked this code name because it reminds me of home.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Th-That masked Operator... makes me feel... nervous...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: It's not that... I'm trying to avoid people, it's just, I'm not sure... what I should do...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Sorry to make you worry again, Ansel... But you don't have to give me special treatment. Many more people need your help.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Oripathy granted me powerful senses, but they're slipping away, little by little... Even so, I will not crumble... There's so much more I want to talk about with everyone...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, could you take this bottle of perfume, please? I brought it from home... This type of perfume lifts spirits. I often take a sniff when I feel down.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Merry? Keep it down... The Doctor is very tired.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Melantha... From now on, my blade is yours.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Thank you... for your guidance.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you very much... Um, were the others promoted as well? I think they all deserve it just the same.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Understood... I'll follow your orders.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: The leader? But I'm not particularly good at giving orders...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's work to make the world a more peaceful place.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Ansel... I'm counting on you now.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Please give me instructions...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: What are your orders?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Understood.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll do my best.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: You will fall...!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Attack!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: No matter what difficulties are in store for me, I will keep on advancing.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We won? Thank goodness for that...

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I can still fight.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We failed... How did things end up this way?

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Is there... anyone else here?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Wh-Who's there?! Oh, Doctor...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, thank you for always taking care of me... Um, actually... I'd like to keep taking on the fight.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Um… Happy New Year, Doctor. My parents sent me a letter and a present. I'm also doing a little better today, in terms of perceptiveness. It's a happy day for me. I hope… it puts you in a good mood too.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, thank you for all the care and encouragement you've given me. This is a present from me... some refreshing fragrances. I've already tried them, they don't clash when mixed together. So you can blend them however you like…

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor… How have we been doing? Um… yes… Thank you. I hope I can do better, bit by bit! My squadmates have been supporting me all the way. I hope to repay them… with my strength.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You want to chat future op planning? You've come to the right person, Doctor, love. I'm the entire stuffing brains of Glasgow.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Eugh, this doesn't taste right. Is this can gone off...? Ay, get Hannah to try this for me, will you? Oh, and if she scoffs the whole thing in one go... well, waste not want not, yeah?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Why do I fight with such a naff-off big machete? Because I'm trying to be efficient here! If I scare some enemies off, that's enemies I don't need to do in. I mean obviously, I'm handy with me fists too. 'Cuz you spend as long as us on the streets, you learn how to scrap from every angle.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: When we left the Glasgow Gang behind, see, I thought we'd all be back in a jiffy. But here we are ages later, and still on the go. Everything's changed. Vina, Hannah, Baird, and especially me... yeah, I might have changed most out of us.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I had my grievances, I did. While Victoria was booming, I was living on scraps. Who said I should pay the price once the bloody place went arse-up? But look at me, I came back anyway. I mean, my life, everyone I care about... all of it's here still.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I guess me old Morgan's Memoirs is gone. Probably lost it in the Glasgow Gang base, if you'd even call it a base... and if the Glasgow Gang still exists. War's not some heroic fantasy. There's moments of deathly honest grief... just, instants you can't describe.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I got a good head on my shoulders, don't I? Not like I'm book-smart or anything here—the most I'm good at is scheming a thing or two in the street. Be honest, sometimes, there's this thought that plagues me, how maybe I'm no help to Vina at all... What, that's rubbish, you think...? Yeah, alright, fair dos, love! I can't be quitting now!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: It might be easy for us to follow the leader, but you know what? While we go after Vina—who's Vina got to go after? I don't want to be behind her anymore, Doctor. I want to go with her, or take her along. That way, when she gets tired, at least she'll have my shoulder to rest on.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Once we succeed with all this, I... hahah, the ffffirst thing I wanna do! Is go out and get smashed with the girls again... Doctor, promise me, you'll come crawling with us. We'll have a right hoot... forget all our troubles. Sound good, love?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Ay-yi-yi, someone's wide open. I could do some face painting on you, love?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Alright, Doctor? I'm Morgan. Vina said you'd like some assistance from me? I've got brains to pick and brawn with a machete—whatever you need, love, just ask.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Not bad, not bad, learned a thing or two. In exchange, why not have a copy of How to Fight with the Glasgow Gang?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Well, I'm honored! You've got a sharp eye, Doctor, just like Vina.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: There'll be plenty more trouble in future for the Glasgow Gang, but you won't catch me running. Whatever we can't handle, you bet I'll keep trying to figure it out. Whatever we can handle, you let my machete and Molotovs do the work!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Coming, love, coming. Not too late, am I?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: No prob. Minding you lot's a breeze compared to Glasgow.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Doctor, love, how'd you even come up with these plans?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Maybe let's try ambushing them?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Machete's all sharp.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Alright, who am I hacking up?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Watch. There's method to a brawl.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Can't just be all brawn.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Ay-up! Watch your left.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Nah, mate, I'm on your right.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Lessee, who's the next sap getting duffed up?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: You don't win until you beat us all.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: All that command was complex stuff... I'm having trouble keeping up now. Doctor, love, once we're back, can you break down today's battle for me? You'd do me a solid!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, want to celebrate the Glasgow way? First me and Hannah grab a leg each, then we shut our eyes, and then we hip-hip-hurray and send you flying... ay, no need to run, love, I'm just joking!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I know every bend around these parts. Give me one minute, and I'll root those bastards out.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'm not... I'm not falling here. The story of Vina and every one of us... is NOT over!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Dead quiet around here... hahah, makes me wish I could do it like Vina and kip somewhere.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Ooh, surprise Doctor attack!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Got some good news to share, Doctor? Because if you don't, let me tell you a joke.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It's a New Year, and I want to see Vina happy, Hannah mucking things up less, and I'd like Dagda to loosen up some. Right, and for you, Doctor... mmm, a bit less work, a bit more time to yourself. That way, I could take you around Londinium for a proper stroll.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Alright, Doctor! Fancy seeing you about.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, thank you for giving us a place we can call home. Here—I ordered in a whole box of Victorian-make lollipops, a YEAR'S worth, just for you, love. Come on, try try try, see how the... soap flavor tastes first, yeah?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Norport's a borough full of Infected. Them, and the mariners out of a job and the old workers and the thugs like us, we're all people Londinium doesn't want. And then here... everyone gets equal work opportunities. *sigh* Why can't it just be like Rhodes Island out there?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Heheh, aren't you the lucky one, Doctor? I don't have any work for the day, so I wouldn't mind keeping you company for a bit.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: The marketplaces of Lungmen, the suburbs of Ursus, the ancient ruins of Victoria... Doctor, these lands hold countless beautiful sights, but very few people ever slow down and take them all in.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, do you want to hear a story from my travels? In that case, I think we should get some fine tea cakes before we sit down. Otherwise, even the most captivating story will turn boring.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I've watched plenty of organizations rise and fall, but so far, Rhodes Island is the most interesting one I've seen. Will the epochs bend to your will, or finally swallow you whole...? I'm dying to find out.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, I have a few ideas where we can get some good food at our next destination. Interested?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, you seem to already know a thing or two about fallen angels. Unfortunately, I can't give you any more details than what you've got. Even if I shared everything else with you someday, that would stay my one secret.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, you don't need to worry about maintaining a good relationship with me. Friends, family, and love... I've got nothing against them, but I don't need them either. Heh, not like that's going to stop you from trying, right? Well, I don't really mind, so give it your best shot.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Hey, Doctor, I'm back from... Whoa, were you waiting for me here? You even prepared a whole table of snacks... Hehe, all right. How could I turn you down after a gesture like that? In return, I'll tell you about the fun I had on this last delivery run.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: ...I see now. The spark of joy I felt when I thought of having a friend like you wasn't fake after all. Scrap what I said before, Doctor. Maybe I do need a bit of warmth in my life.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hehe... Sweet dreams, Doctor.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hey there, Doctor. I'm Mostima. You might've heard from Emperor that I'm not bound by the contract between Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, and can therefore act independently. Having that said, I'll probably be staying here anyway when I'm not busy. Sooo, I'll see you around.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Well then, let's see how Rhodes Island fights.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: You know, Doctor, relying on me isn't a very wise decision.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: You really want to see me go all out, Doctor? Just for the record, I have to ask… Do I have to pay for the collateral damage I cause? No, right?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: OK.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Hmm... Sorry, but why don't we let everyone do their own thing?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Ah. I know this place. Let me lead the way.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Get in, get out.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Uh-huh?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Heh heh…

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Nice weather today.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Great view from here.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Seventy percent-ish should do the trick.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: It's about time to wrap things up.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I have nothing against you guys. It's just the story of our lives.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I wonder what we should eat after this?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Feels good. Guess I could use a thrill every now and then.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Hm? I thought I missed a few, but I guess that's a job well done.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The results of a battle don't really matter to a Messenger. Just surviving is enough of a victory.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Gotta admit, this 'teamwork' isn't really my thing.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Mind if I go wander around?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Let's have a chat, Doctor.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: This day used to be like any other for me. Wouldn't stop long at any one place, wouldn't form any serious friendships, wouldn't have fun like everyone else. I never imagined I'd enjoy the holiday atmosphere here. I gotta admit, it isn't half bad. Happy New Year, Doctor, hope we all enjoy it.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: How's your day going, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: So today's your birthday, Doctor. Happy birthday. Would you take an incredible story from my travels as a present? I guess not... alright, how about we take a trip together? I'll pick the scenery, you choose the time.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The more dangerous the place, the more enchanting the views get. Once you make it through every layer of danger, to finally stand in the eye of a Catastrophe, you're a part of the scenery yourself. In the end, where will you lead Rhodes Island, Doctor? I'm still dying to see.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hey, Doctor. Do me a favor and just tell me what you need done.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I'll be watching you even when I'm off duty.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Hm? Do you need something?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: My skin is sensitive to sunlight. So please assign me to nighttime missions, whenever you can.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: There's limits to what I'm capable of, but even so, I want to help ease the burden you carry, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I can't help but feel just a little envious when I see how the other Operators fight...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I need no particular reason to fight for you, Doctor. I hope to see an exciting frontline battle someday...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, let me be your guardian, now and forever...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Vanguard Yato here. Are you the one I'm protecting?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Thank you.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Yato has joined the team.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: We're ready to execute your plans, Doctor.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: All Operators, be on alert.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Targets spotted. Get ready for battle.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Here.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Go ahead.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Got it.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Understood!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: In a blink of eye!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Prepare yourself!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Haaaaghhh!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Slash you down!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: As long as we follow the Doctor's orders, we won't have any problems.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The Doctor's brilliant command was the key to victory.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Victory is the most welcome news.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I apologize... We failed to execute your plan, Doctor...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Please send me somewhere that sunlight can never touch.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: *Gasp*!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, thank you for always taking care of us.

voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy holidays, Doctor. Thank you for your work over the past year, and may you continue to guide us this year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, I will be your shield.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Please, accept this humble gift. Yes, of course I remember your birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: A blade needs a sheath. It is a shelter, and a place to return. For me, Rhodes Island is that sheath.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Ah, I see this is a fine location. Alright, then… 'Daily desserts, fresh out of the oven, in limited quantities.' Heehee, there we go! Oh, Doctor? Nothing special here. Don't let me keep you.

voices.text: Doctor, I don't know what Nian told you, but I must emphasize this: I. Don't. Cook. Without good reason. A chef must be particular in his prepara... Wai-wai-wai-wait, That bag of snacks is your lunch? Tch, aiya... stop eating that, I'll whip something up for you.

voices.text: I'm fairly confident in my culinary arts, but just as there are those who indulge in exotic delicacies, there are those who prefer bland flavors. You can't satisfy everyone, and it's also a matter of whether fate allows for a chef and a diner to cross paths. So, do you find this dish to your liking? If you want any special treatment in the future, you'd better nod right now.

People eat five grains, and then they have six desires and seven emotions. Nothing could be more natural. The work of this kitchen is, if you ask me, the most significant thing in this land.

Sour, salty, bitter, spicy... miss any one of them, you'll never master cookery. Likewise, joy, sorrow, separation, reunion... if you don't understand all of them, you'll never learn how to truly be a person. Yeah... Now, I've come to understand all the tastes.

The land is home to many flavors, but nothing compares to the taste of family reunion.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, why was my application to room with Lancet-2 rejected? Because she's a robot? You're mistaken. The two of us are sisters now. She's my big sister, and I'm her little sister.

voices.text: Doctor, are medics outside always like Gavial? When she gives me my Oripathy checkups, it always feels like she's just trying to beat me up... That's why we always end up fighting each other as soon as my tolerance runs out.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The Big Priest? Yeah, he didn't come with me, but he did say he'd come visit from time to time. Speaking of which, does he even know where Rhodes Island is...?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Before, my dream was to build a gigantic robot like the nomadic cities. Now, my dream is not only to build a gigantic robot like the nomadic cities, but one that can talk too. Master Closure has already promised to teach me the best of the best about machineries.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: ...Oh, I get it now. So, just like 'Great Chieftain', 'Doctor' is a title we use to honor people who are knowledgeable. So that means everyone will start calling me Dr. Zumama once I learn everything I can here, right? Oh, they won't?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, I was hoping you could accompany me back to Sargon when you have time to teach me how to go about all sorts of things there. But you look busy... In that case, may I ask Lancet-2 to accompany me? Otherwise, Master Closure is fine.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: People outside are always worried about things that don't matter and fighting over them. It's so strange. You too, Doctor. You always look like you're giving yourself a hard time over everything. Here, take this wrench. Let's build some machines together. I'm sure you'll enjoy seeing a machine in the works getting bigger and greater bit by bit.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I'm starting to get a bit tired myself, watching the Doctor sleeping... *yawn*...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I passed all the exams, so that means I can stay here, right? I want to learn how to build a talking robot like Lancet-2... Oh, codename? My name is Zumama. Can't I use that as my codename?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: To think there's someone who could go up against Gavial on an equal footing...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Is that something like going from a fighter to a warrior? ...In that case, we must celebrate. I think I'll have a barbeque with Lancet-2 on the bridge tonight.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: The High Priest told me before it's a vast, big world out here. He sounded kind of heartbroken when he said that. I didn't understand why at the time, but I'm starting to understand after having spent so much time here. The world being so vast, might not necessarily be a good thing.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Is it time to hunt?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: What are we hunting?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Are you coming too, Doctor?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I just need to take care of all of them, right?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Ready to go anytime.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'll go.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: It'll be even more efficient if someone who can work with me comes along.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Hold the fort? Easy.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: You people are no match for Gavial!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I'm not all that weak either!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I'll give it my all no matter the prey!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Got you!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: What a great haul!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Compared to Gavial, you've still got a ways to go.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I'll go after them.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Don't worry about it. I've lost to Gavial too many times myself. It's nothing to be ashamed of.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Where's Lancet-2?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Yeah?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: What do I need to do to become as educated as the Doctor?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, is there a holiday today…? New Year's? We welcome in the new year…? I don't understand, we don't have this holiday in my tribe. But everyone looks happy. Can I join in? Where is Lancet-2?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, good timing. There's something I wanted to ask you.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I think I've seen how you celebrate your birthdays. You make a wish and tell it to no one, in hopes that it will come true in the following year. Can I make a wish too? I can? Then, let's close our eyes… Hmmm… Oh, right, happy birthday, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I read in a book that today is a day to show my loyalty to my boss and prove my sincerity. Doctor, I'm struggling with the concept of loyalty. This is a heart-shaped badge I designed and built myself on the Engineering lathe. Why is it heart-shaped? Doesn't that represent loyalty?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Be your bodyguard? Okay.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I wonder how papa is doing nowadays... But, I trust the mayor to keep her word, so it should be fine.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Though Dossoles is noisy and filled with bad people, life there is still a lot better there than the rest of Bolívar... Mhm? You haven't been there yet, Doctor? Hehe, Let's go together next time then.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Phew… Staying inside all day is so stuffy. Doctor, let's go get some fresh air up on the deck, okay? I'm sure you must be tired from working for so long.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, do you enjoy all this fighting and killing? I don't, not really. But I guess I've been around it too long, and done too much myself... I'm kinda used to it…

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Getting stronger is nice, but I can't think of what to do once I'm stronger... Doctor, how do you decide what you want to do?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: For the longest time, Papa didn't want me to help him. You know, my personality isn't really suited for what he does. But still... I gave it my all, because he took me in as his daughter.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, doctor, can I scooch a little closer to you? Well, the office is so big, it feels a bit empty and lonely sitting so far from you… Can I?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, I don't think you can fight at all, but you're just as reliable as papa. It feels like I can just follow your orders, and I won't ever have to think for myself. Oh...? But for me, that's a good thing.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: What does the Doctor look like under that mask? Let's sneak a peek…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. I'm Rafaela, the one Miss Ch'en introduced. I'll be formally joining Rhodes Island today. Uh, code name? Mhmm... You can call me La Pluma.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hmm... Wonder if I can really do this.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, did you need me for something? Mm? A promotion? Hmm... did I do something special?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, I'm stronger than before? Really? Hmm… I'm not sure I feel anything different… But if you say so, then it must be true.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Mm? Time for a mission?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm kinda good at leading the way.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Where are we going this time?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Now then, I can't afford to get sidetracked.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Woah, Doctor... Don't scare me like that.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'll follow your instructions.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Okay.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: All I have to do is keep them from passing, right?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Haah!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I'll cut you in two!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: It's tricky.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Let's finish this.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Woah... I didn't think I could accomplish a mission like this…

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, you're incredible!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, leave the rest to me. I'll get them.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, this way. We need to run.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: The corridors in Rhodes Island are so wide…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Mm-hm?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: What's the Doctor doing now? Let's go take a look.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy new year, Doctor. Rhodes Island is so lively during New Year. Woo, look over there, the operators have prepared so many games. It looks like a lot of fun... Doctor, which one should I try? Can you choose for me?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Oh, Doctor. How did you end up right in front of me?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, a lot of Operators ask me to mix special drinks for their birthdays. Each one is custom-made based on their preferences and the weather that day. Would you like one too, Doctor? Hehe, but only after you've finished your work.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Here you are, Doctor! I was just helping the others with the decorations. I did a whole wall by myself. Celebrations like this are so much fun. Oh, do you have a moment? I'd love to show you my work.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Oh! This machine carries people's voices straight over, and l can talk back to them too! That 'photocopier' over there can produce exact replicas of anything painted on paper... Is my job to learn to use all of them? I'd love to know how they work!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Do you like the brined sandworm, Kay? How about this gloompincer mushroom pâté? Just as good? I've got garlic fin shiokara here, do you like that too? I'm so glad I meet you here! Come on, let's look for more new mon—whaaagh?! Vulcan? What are you doing? Where are you taking me?!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor! I'm behind this door! The little room next to you! I need your help, Mon3tr's sick... it's not eating anything I feed it. Do you have any ideas? What? But Dr. Kal'tsit saw how good friends we were and asked me to look after it for her. What do you mean she was keeping me shut in here? You're lying, right?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Orchid said a big flick on the forehead of whoever steps out of line is how you manage your party members, but Fang told me really earnestly that it should start with living up to your leadership responsibilities. Then they made me talk about what I think matters most in a leader. To tell the truth... I think what matters most is that everyone can trust each other.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Monsters have talons so they can hunt, and look cute so they can trick adventurers. By observing how monsters act, you get to know them. They always put themselves on full display, while humans are nothing like them... I'm more of a fan of monsters after all.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: When I was young, I once got possessed by a spirit. Falin was the one who banished it, but because of that, our neighbors shunned her, and our father even kicked her out of the village. Later on, she ran away from school and went to the dungeon with me, but I couldn't protect her like I should have... I'm going to rescue her. I will rescue her.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Be careful, Elysium gave me this Liberi egg to look after. He told me it'll hatch in a few days—oooh! It's doing it, it's hatching! A little damp chick just popped out! Is this what Liberi look like when they're young? What's so funny, Doctor... Elysium was playing a prank on me?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Marcille always hates eating monsters, and Chilchuck once got betrayed by his own party... I was fully resolved to save Falin all on my own, and yet they still decided to stick with me despite everything. I'm really grateful to them for that.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I never imagined there'd be anyone except Senshi, but so many operators are interested in monsters! Plus, they want to come with me and see what it's like in the dungeon. If we have the ability to teleport back and forth, I bet Falin will want to visit as well and make friends with you all, and then we'll go on a tour around Terra!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Huh, I think Kensuke's asleep as well... So adorable…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I noticed! You're interested in cooking monsters too, aren't you? I have sandworm & needlefly meatballs here, do you wanna try some?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: These monsters just get neater and neater...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Thank you for letting me on! Excuse me, Doctor, is there some reason I haven't met any operators lately? ...What? They filed complaints against me? For getting too much plumage and fur from them? They think I'm weird? I—I just wanted to make a collection of specimens—

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I totally grasp how to get along with the operators here now, and I'm confident I'll blend in with everyone soon. Here are some seven-headed, super-undefeatable monster figures made by myself, and I'll send them out later to make up for everything.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Weapons, armor, medicine, food, cookware, sleeping pads... We don't need the sleeping pads? Oh, alright.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Got it. I'll perform my duty.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Yup, my belly's nice and full. Everything's gonna be fine this time.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Whoa! Kensuke's shaking!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What are your monsters like here?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: It'd be great if we could encounter a new species.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Let me check for any carnivorous monster dung...

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: The terrain here is totally different to the dungeon...

voices.title: During Combat
voices.text: RAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!! RAAH! RAAAAGH!!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Ahh, I have to note down everything we learned today. Terra's got so many kinds of monsters...!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Senshi, are those monsters edible?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Cheer up, Doctor. Just watch, we'll succeed next time.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Fighting on an empty stomach is a recipe for party wipes...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Alright, let's ask Chilchuck to map out this place!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: ...Kensuke?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: This metal crab can't right itself. Look, it's sooo cute.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: When Marcille was taking our photograph just now, she left a spot next to her for Falin. I wonder what kind of souvenir I should get her... How about this needlefly pâté? Really, you don't think so? You don't understand. This is made from a monster from another world!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I have a shiny mouth...? Right, I just ate a fluorescent Originium Slug gummy.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I wasn't sure what kind of birthday cake I should buy you, but then the instant I saw it, I had to get it—it's a dragon cake! See? The strawberry jam on it is like its flame breath! Isn't that super cool?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: They say so long as you defeat the Lunatic Magician of the dungeon, all that lies within is yours. When I was in the depths before, I wasn't thinking at all about why I was down there, or what it was that I truly wanted... but meeting you all made me realize just what it's like to have a goal in life.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Need something? If you don't ,how about some divination?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Just tell me when there's work to do. But don't ever put her and me on the same team. I hate her guts. And don't get me started on all the weird food she makes me eat... Just thinking about it makes me... euurghh...

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: No one told me Hibiscus was at Rhodes Island before I got here... It's too late for me to quit now.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: If you grow up sheltered, you don't know how to taunt, how to destroy, and how to handle yourself in a real fight. Am I right, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Have you ever heard the saying 'little sisters are justice'? If that's true, then my big sis is evil by default... at least as far as I'm concerned.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Instruments? I can play the piano a little. My teacher in Leithanien said learning an instrument can improve your Arts affinity. It also apparently eases the impact that Oripathy has on your mind...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I'm starving... Huh, what's this? You keep sweets in here? Nom... I'm in the middle of training. Should I really be eating this?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: See, like, I don't have a big beef with Hibiscus... It's all water under the bridge. I'm fine with her as long as she doesn't force me to eat her medicine and food. After all, she was the one... who saved my life...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I almost envy your ability to sleep like a log...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Lava, a Caster, here to join you simply because I'm bored and want something to do… But I heard my sworn nemesis is here too, though... Can I just quit now?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Thanks.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Did you forget? I don't need a cause to work for, and I don't need a team... but... thanks, I guess...

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: As far as teamwork's concerned... I don't mind, as long as nobody messes up.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm not good at this sort of stuff, but if you insist...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's go. Keep an eye on my back.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I can see their souls. They're mine to reap.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What are you waiting for?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Hurry up.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Come on.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: That's it.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: It's game over for you.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Even the dead can't save you.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: The supreme form of Arts. I'm interested in seeing what it's like.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I foresaw this result earlier. A perfect victory.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Well… My fortune telling isn't always right. Sometimes there's a lot of external noise that affects the outcome.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Dammit... These evil spirits are too strong...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Oh, come on. I'd rather be alone.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Don't touch me! Uaghh!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Eh, you're not scoring any points with me like that!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I need your help, Doctor. Tell me, Just in what world do I fall under the category of 'Out of Shape?' I was feeding myself some fried-foulbeast, and that annoying Hibiscus took it away, before peeling the coat off and handing the rest back to me! The crispy, crunchy coat! She took it! Gone! There's *NO* way I can get my hands on what I want to eat with her around! There's gonna be a fight... Ugh! Never mind.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Oh, it's you, Doctor. Morning.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Here, I made you a pair of gloves. And take a look at these beautiful patterns on them! Cool, aren't they? I got them from my divination, which always comes true. You too will learn that in the future.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: My infection made my sister's life hell as well. It may not look like it, but deep inside my heart resonates with hers, because what we all want is to help those in need with our hands. Speaking of which, isn't she still on shift today? Huh, how can someone have the right to call me the one that worries when she pushes herself this hard?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Ehi, Doctor. Hope you don't mind if I bring my weapons inside. I'll plop myself right over here.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Ehi, Doctor. Hope you don't mind if I bring my weapons inside. I'll plop myself right over here.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Somebody out to get you, huh? Then have a long, hard think about who you might've wronged in the past.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Somebody out to get you, huh? Then have a long, hard think about who you might've wronged in the past.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: If someone's out for revenge on you, don't hesitate, just take them out. Once you decide to pick up a weapon, you don't need a reason to kill.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: If someone's out for revenge on you, don't hesitate, just take them out. Once you decide to pick up a weapon, you don't need a reason to kill.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: It's been a while... I see that Texas made some friends. Hehehe... Affascinante! Can't wait to get to know them!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: It's been a while... I see that Texas made some friends. Hehehe... Affascinante! Can't wait to get to know them!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: You think I'm an assassin, huh? Yeah, alright. Call me whatever you want. I can be anyone, do anything, kill anyone anytime. Just so long as I want to!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: You think I'm an assassin, huh? Yeah, alright. Call me whatever you want. I can be anyone, do anything, kill anyone anytime. Just so long as I want to!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I love power, Doctor. And you offered me a job where I can use my power to my heart's content... Love it. Honestly, the only joy I get out of this insane world is using my power to conquer it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I love power, Doctor. And you offered me a job where I can use my power to my heart's content... Love it. Honestly, the only joy I get out of this insane world is using my power to conquer it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Texas? Ha, she's afraid of me, but I don't wanna do anything to her, except maybe try to bring back the old Texas. The one we got here's a cucciolo impaurito.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Texas? Ha, she's afraid of me, but I don't wanna do anything to her, except maybe try to bring back the old Texas. The one we got here's a cucciolo impaurito.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: That red one... oh... Doctor, keep her away from me! She'd definitely kill me in a fight. But I have this feeling... this feeling... ugh, why do I want to fight her so badly?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: That red one... oh... Doctor, keep her away from me! She'd definitely kill me in a fight. But I have this feeling... this feeling... ugh, why do I want to fight her so badly?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You want to know what happened between me and Texas? Hehe, you don't have a single idea of what you are sticking your nose into. You'll find out the truth someday, but not from me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You want to know what happened between me and Texas? Hehe, you don't have a single idea of what you are sticking your nose into. You'll find out the truth someday, but not from me.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Sleep tight... enjoy your sweet dreams while you still can.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Sleep tight... enjoy your sweet dreams while you still can.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: A great evil stands in the way of justice. My master, in the name of hatred and revenge, lead the weak onward!

voices.title: Onboard

voices.text: Don't you just love how I keep getting more and more powerful?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Hahaha! Bene! I love how much you trust me. You can't say the same for Texas, right?

voices.text: Hahaha! Bene! I love how much you trust me. You can't say the same for Texas, right?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Molto bene! That's more like it! Strength, unfettered and unchained! That's what I'm talking about!

voices.text: Haha, you people... I don't think I'll even remember your faces after this one... Anyway, let's just get started.

voices.text: We're fighting you guys? Then please do your bestest job, or I'll be really bored.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, look outside the window. The night is quiet... and peaceful. Up until now, every night has been filled with the red light of fire, and the stench of burning. I only feel easier... on nights like tonight.

voices.text: There's been a—red-haired Vouivre girl, who never stops staring at me... Does she suspect my identity? But... she wouldn't have any evidence... Hm. I'm not going to let her find me out.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Is it time for my regular medical examination? Un... Understood. But... I don't trust those other doctors. If I have to be examined, I want... you to help me with it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: You all have a lot of questions, but I can't answer any of them. This is for your own sakes, and I encourage you ... not to overestimate yourselves.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: ...I am strong. I know the terrifying power I hold, though I... have no love for it. But if you desire it—then yes, I will fight...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: This spear... I am not able to fully use its power. Despite that, I've had it take so many lives. Guilt? ...No, I have no guilt. After all, our lives are all equally worthless

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I do not mind my Oripathy... Without it, I would never have spent my days here. It will take my life? I—still do not mind it... So many other things across this land could kill just the same, why then... would you fixated on this particular one?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I am a shadow, but I do not spurn that. I am only able to stay here, incognito, because I am a shadow... However... however... if someone with the same face as me ever finds you, do not fight her! You will die. I don't... I don't want you dead...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I will stand vigil for you, so... please rest at ease. Good night.

voices.text: What are Sonya and the girls going to do? You're asking the wrong one, Doctor. We're friends, yeah. But aside from Lada, the rest of them don't really talk to me about that kinda stuff. Especially Sonya—she'll go to Anna when she needs something, maybe Natalya, but she'd never come to me.

voices.text: Lada had a secret talk with me recently. Said she wants to open a little shop in Ursus, and we could all chip in and get our share. As for the shop, it'll be our headquarter. All the girls can have regular meetups there. And I can go over to hang out whenever I miss her, too. It's gonna be great!

voices.text: Has you-know-who been to Rhodes Island? Oh, so he spent a whole day sitting in the reception before you shooed him out...? Thanks for that. It's fine, I've got nothing to say to him anyway. Hmph, he wasn't there when I needed him, and now he feels bad enough to try to make up for it? Keep Dreaming!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: What do I think? Ummm... first of all, you should stop treating us like kids. Come on, Doctor, you don't need to worry about us so much. If you have time, why don't you teach me a few more formulas for Anna's Math lessons? We've counted you as a friend all this time, so if there's really something bugging us, you'll definitely know.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I know we'll have to go our separate ways someday. But so what? We trust each other with our lives. The USSG won't fall apart, and we'll never forget the days we spent together. The same goes for you, Doctor. Call me anytime you need my help, and I'll be there, no matter what.

voices.text: And I'm done writing. I won't go wrong following this plan—by this time next year, Rhodes Island and I will have made even more notable progress. Restricted? voices.text: I sometimes attend ceremonies like these just to make things go smoother. I don't remember how many titles I have. But in the end, I always have to return to the shadows.

voices.title: Promotion 1

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I know what I'm doing, and that's all that matters. At the end of the day, not all honors need to be made public, and not all roads need to be trod together.

voices.title: Promotion 2

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: You tell me your ends, just don't ask me my means.

voices.text: If any of you have any doubts about the target, this is your last chance to pull out.

voices.title: Depart

voices.text: It's time to make an example. They'll see what happens when they break the rules.

voices.text: Got it.

voices.text: Say no more.

voices.text: Watch the shadow behind you.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Let's put them six feet under.

voices.title: Deployment 2

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: You didn't think. So this is what happens when you cross the line.

voices.text: You didn't think. So this is what happens when you cross the line.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: You want to talk? Too late for that.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: You want to talk? Too late for that.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Give me a reason to let you go. Don't have one? What a pity.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Give me a reason to let you go. Don't have one? What a pity.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Shatter into pieces.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: It better remain a secret forever.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: It better remain a secret forever.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Clean, decent. No one will ever find their remains.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The situation is still salvageable. Leave the rest to me.

voices.text: I don't need too much room here, but this place could use some decoration.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Boh loh yau, fresh out of the oven, want one?

voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. My dad sends out greeting cards to his foreigner friends this time of year. I'm usually the one who writes them. Here, this is for you. You've been pretty busy this year. Good work.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. My dad sends out greeting cards to his foreigner friends this time of year. I'm usually the one who writes them. Here, this is for you. You've been pretty busy this year. Good work.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I hope you didn't run into any trouble, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I hope you didn't run into any trouble, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: You think this glass ornament is pretty...? As long as you like it. It's not that hard to make, actually... Anyway, Happy birthday. If you have time tonight, how about I take you out somewhere for dinner? I'll take you to get real Lungmen food, somewhere Swire's ilk would never know.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: You think this glass ornament is pretty...? As long as you like it. It's not that hard to make, actually... Anyway, Happy birthday. If you have time tonight, how about I take you out somewhere for dinner? I'll take you to get real Lungmen food, somewhere Swire's ilk would never know.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: It's been some time since Rhodes Island and Lungmen first made contact. It took a lot of effort for us to assuage the suspicion we had and build the trust we now share. Fortunately, time has proven that the effort was worth it. Right, I don't like talking about 'trust' per se, but Rhodes Island is an exception.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: It's been some time since Rhodes Island and Lungmen first made contact. It took a lot of effort for us to assuage the suspicion we had and build the trust we now share. Fortunately, time has proven that the effort was worth it. Right, I don't like talking about 'trust' per se, but Rhodes Island is an exception.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hm? Am I able to be of help to you? I can't contribute anything towards your meticulous plans or lofty ideals, but if you wish me to attend you... that happens to be my specialty.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Sitting for extended periods of time will cause muscular atrophy, and that's not going to help, Doctor. Come, I'll walk with you around the deck. I've also been wanting to hear about some of Rhodes Island's legends. No, sifting through the archives isn't as interesting as hearing it from you.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My grandfather was involved in the construction of that great lighthouse. But now, haha, all I do is stay behind in the church, tending to the sick and elderly... No, I'm not complaining about my job as a caregiver; seeing their smiles brings me great joy! It's just that...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Skadi, Gladiia, and Specter... I never thought a day would come when I would stand on the same side as those Ægir greats; I mean, I barely know anything about the Ægir... Huh? You're putting me on the same team as them? Please, have mercy on me...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: That Inquisitor fought to the last breath for our sake. When I saw the light of his lantern pierce the darkness, I suddenly realized: they are all fighting for our future. And though I might not be as strong as them, I don't wish to remain a bystander. I want to stand with them.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Achieving great things is not easy for me, but even facing life itself is not a trivial task. Doctor, don't worry, I won't give up. I will try my best to catch up with everybody on Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: For us Iberians, our relationship with the 'sea' is a complicated one. The sea symbolizes terror and danger, while also holding nostalgia for a bygone era. But even as the great vessels of Iberia sink before our eyes, we... we require a bit of change.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Caregivers have to respond to all sorts of different situations. Some people are difficult to deal with, but the gratitude we receive makes it worth it. Doctor, all that you do, day in and day out, must be for a very similar pursuit, right? You know the joy of being able to make a difference.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Working in the Inquisition is difficult, and not everyone is as fair as Lady Irene... But, had I not experienced it, I never would've gotten to work with amazing people like you, right?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, Doctor? You're going to catch a cold if you fall asleep like this... Let me fetch you a blanket. Is it alright if I dim the lights for you a bit?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: So you're... the Doctor? Pleased to meet you. My codename is 'Lumen,' and I will now be serving as a Rhodes Island Operator. Even if I can only bring you a thin filament of light, I will give all my strength.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Do we... really have to face such terrifying things?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: No, I can't accept this. I've just been doing my job, nothing worthy of a promotion. Please, you don't need to look so dejected. Fine, I'll take it!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I'm just an ordinary person, and it takes a huge amount of effort to even keep up with the others. However, if you really need what little I can offer... then I will be there for you at any time.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Don't worry, Doctor. I'll catch up to the others.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Me, squad leader? Umm... Can you give me a few minutes to sort things out in my head?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Looks like it's too late for second thoughts. Time to move out.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I'll do my best to keep everyone safe!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: At your disposal.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: As long as I can help.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I can handle this!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: It's fine, as long as I can muster up the courage!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Don't worry, I'm here with you.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: You can do this. Here, the first step is a deep breath.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Hang in there, the treatment will be done in no time!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Please stay calm. It's a bit tricky, but as long as you give me some time...

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, that you've shown me such a great project, let me become a part of it, and even had me stand by your side, means the world to me.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: We did it, Doctor! Even though this was a small victory, the day will come when these small rays of light will grow numerous enough to dispel the darkness.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Enough frowning, Doctor, it's bad for your health. If everything always went according to plan, what would motivate us to work harder and better ourselves?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, please evacuate! If I can hold the line and buy you a future, then I...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Rhodes Island is a beautiful ship, but sadly... I cannot feel the breath of the sea breeze.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Do you need a hand?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: The thing I enjoy most is looking out the window at the surrounding scenery, relaxing away my afternoon. Want to join me, Doctor?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Back when I was a caregiver, at the turn of every year, everyone would exchange presents and offer New Year's blessings. Even though I'm working in a different environment now, I hope to keep this little custom alive. Doctor, I wish you... a peaceful and prosperous new year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, need me to give you a shoulder massage? I'm pretty well-known for my PT skills.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Kal'tsit mentioned that today is your birthday, Doctor. I don't have the means to gift you anything precious... but please take this. It's an audio recording of the waves in my hometown. If you ever find yourself in a bad spot, please give it a listen. Of course, you're more than welcome to come to me directly.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Now that I'm saying it out loud, it's a bit embarrassing... Doctor, if I could become like you one day... Err, never mind. Just being allowed to join Rhodes Island, and stand by your side, is already like a dream come true.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Filing documents? I thought that was a job for Little Handy... Well, I can do it myself. I could do a lot worse than chatting with you.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Ten minutes until ocean current data inflow. I will take four minutes to prepare ink, five minutes to setup the equipment, forty-five seconds to doodle. The last fifteen seconds? Let you remove your hood, of course. Or, what's the difference between a faceless model and a lifeless rock?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The Ægir sleep cycle is not affected by time of day. When inspiration strikes, an artist usually stays up for 50 plus hours without a wink of sleep. As for me, I'm more like you people, except I go to bed when the sun rises. It's eight o'clock already? I'm getting sleepy... Hm, why are you yawning too?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Why do I enjoy chatting with the robot operators, when the Ægir frown upon emulating humanity with machinery? Hehe, because it's fascinating. Besides, my chats actually prompted Closure to upgrade their cognitive modules, ensuring they won't overload. I may take credit for any breakthroughs in that area.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Ever since the Waterway opened, swarms of unsightly seaborns have appeared outside the dome. Truly annoying, to say the least. In all seriousness, though, it's my job to observe, record, and accumulate the data needed to eliminate seaborns once and for all. The more brazen they are, the closer an eye I must keep on them.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: When the city was evacuated and the darkness crept in, my fear gripped me so tightly that I scribbled something on the dome without even realizing it. Recently, I went back and found that it was a smiling face. It suddenly dawned on me that I should have faced the darkness with a smile way earlier.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: There used to be a bunch of seaweed outside the dome, swaying leisurely to its own pace, no matter how fierce the currents. I've long wanted to grow some myself, stirring the water and watching it linger like nothing happened... kind of like you, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I modified this communal umbrella using dome technology. Now it can adjust its shape and opacity, and also detect temperature and humidity. But the Engineering Department didn't feel there was any need for it, and wanted me to change it back, because the tentacle-shaped monitoring unit was too scary... Hmm. Say, do you have an umbrella? Do you want to trade?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: 'Eventide of the Depths', a volcanic power station that once lit the deep in a red glow... Once the war is over, how about we go see it together? Even if it has been overgrown by Seaborn creep, I'm sure you'd come with me to reawaken it without batting an eyelid, wouldn't you?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Friendly reminder! Your face will become my canvas if you doze off at work... Wait, you're really asleep? Turn the temperature up two degrees, Little Handy. It wouldn't be any fun if the Doctor caught a cold.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Nice to meet you. I'm from Ægir and my name is... Hmm... Why are you staring at the bottle on my belt? Did you want a sip? Certainly, but I take no responsibility for what happens after you drink this ink.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Pause, please, Doctor. Turn the image so I can see this one's back... What? This 'video' of yours only allows watching from a fixed angle?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion? Have I really done so well? Or do you just really enjoy working with me?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Another promotion? What's the reason this time...? Extremely precise recommendations based on current movement... Uh-huh. What else? Leveraged her skills in maintenance and repair. Yeah yeah, I agree. C'mon, don't stop the praise, I'm all ears.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Need me for data collection, or dome repair? Neither? You're always so full of surprises.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You want me to be the captain? You'd better give me some interesting teammates.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Come with me, everyone. You'll always know me by the ink bottle I carry.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Here comes a wave!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Take it easy. Haste makes waste.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Go on, I'm listening.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'm on the scene. The flow of the currents... Ah… it's a mess.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: It's time to teach these rascals a lesson.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Who's disturbing the currents?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Close your eyes, feel the undulating waves... Too bad, you've fallen into my trap.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Aww, look at you, you've got ink all over you again.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Say something. It would be sad if you sank into the depths without a sound.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Defeating a strong foe is satisfying, but don't forget to look up once in a while. See, the sights above… aren't they beautiful?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: You carried out the plan without the slightest fumble. Not bad. The Institute of Facility Management would appreciate people like you.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: A little deviation won't cause any serious issues. I'll stay behind to check for problems.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I know trial-and-error is a painful process. But if you keep knocking yourself like this, I may have to deal with the next job alone, imagine how dull it would be.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Turn on the lights, Little Handy. Hey Little Handy? Hello? Alright, where's the switch...?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Well, well, are you asking for a poke in the head?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You can use the ink as you wish, but the mapper? Nah-uh.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: My schedule today? Let me check... Huh? You don't work on the first day of the year? Hm, landlubbers do have some strange customs. Alright, let me plan out the day... first, help the Doctor pick a New Year's present.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You look cheerful. Up to no good?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I've recently come to appreciate the unique beauty of the patterns found on paper currency, and I've drawn a copy of this bill for you. Is it a good imitation? Don't let people see it? Counterfeit money? What does that mean?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Look who I found. While there's a vibrant party going on, we've got a lonely soul here reading... Oh, foreign languge, I can't understand it. Hmm.. how about this, Doctor? You tell me what the book is about. I'll tell you the patterns and meanings I've garnered. They're hidden in these lines and spaces between those words. Interested?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'd appreciate it if you let me keep a bit of distance... There's a smell on me I can't get off, no matter how hard I try.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I got this coat from a certain sergeant. Death had already come for her at the time. Her expression was softening, her breathing getting shallower and shallower. I held her hand, and waited... Waited until her head nodded a bit. I helped her close her eyes, and then completed our trade.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Excuse me, Doctor, could you check if this is the right way to record birth and death dates? Oh, don't worry, nobody died. This is for me, in case something happens to me one day. If someone manages to find this, then I'll at least have a decent tombstone or marker... A lot better than an unmarked brick at least.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: There was another girl with me getting treatment in Medical. She had a familiar scent on her. Her flame of life burned even dimmer than mine... But she didn't seem to mind at all, just humming happily to herself. What gave her the strength? I envy her.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Rhodes Island is always rushing from one conflict to another. I used to be like that too. The difference is, you do it to save people... I was doing it just to save myself.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, the operators who made the ultimate sacrifice... their dorms are just as they left them, as if their owners had just stepped out for a minute. This huge ship carries so much that has already passed on... How are you able to hold such a clear course...? As if none of you doubt anything?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Cantabile taught me to read some of the words in the book today. 'The warm soil uplifts the mist, the branches trace light's brows, and fowlbeasts sing in the dawnlight.' I wanted to know where I could find a place like this, so I asked her... But she went quiet on me. Maybe... it's just someone's imagination.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: There's this one particularly ugly type of fowlbeast, big as a human child, with a scary cry. Flocks of them storm onto battlefields, looking for food. When I was a kid, I'd get into fights with them and end up with bruises all over. But, once I grew up, I lost the guts to face them, let alone look them in the eye.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The longer you live in a war, the more you end up forgetting. I can't remember the faces of a lot of those who've died, but new faces appear in front of me every day... If the war ever ends, then I'll finally be able to remember them all. That's why I'm prepared to follow you and your ideals.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I don't like watching people sleep, but... your heartbeat is steady, and that puts me at ease… Rest, Doctor.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm just a girl who cleans up war zones. If you need me for anything, please call me by the name… Lutonada.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: So, this is one way to prevent people from dying...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I've got a vague idea of what a 'promotion' is. A sergeant wears sturdier clothes than a footman, and carries more valuables... I appreciate it a lot, Doctor…

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Tell me, does this mean I get to keep on walking this path with you?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Your faith in me... I'll etch it into my heart...

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: No more lives will be lost in vain…

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Before the flames of war can spread…

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: No more tears...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'll go.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I can do this.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'm here.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: As you say.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Your lives are safe in my hands.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I'll be your fortress.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I'll handle this on my own.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Until my last breath…

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: This place is not for any of you to clean up. Go home, and enjoy a good night's sleep.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: 'Preventing conflict provides more solace than mourning.' ...These words only made sense after living through them firsthand.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: They might've gotten away, but they won't want to bleed again. Not a bad end to things.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I vow to lead everyone off the battlefield.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's nice, clean, and quiet here... just like the inside of a coffin.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Did you need me? I'm here, as always.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Ah, I'm sorry... I won't sleep under the bed again.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Did something happen today? Everyone looks so happy… New Year's? A once-a-year occasion? Alright. I used to have to live every day as if it was my last. Never could've imagined that I'd be celebrating a special one.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Stay healthy, Doctor. Live a life.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Life is the opposite of death. It means infinite possibility... In that sense, one's day of birth is very much worth celebrating. I'd like to ask... can today also be my birthday? I would like to share in this joy with you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The medic says my condition has stabilized, and that I've been approved to travel outside. Doctor, do you think... I should try looking for other kinds of work? Not for the dead, but for the living.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Assistant? File Work? Not sure I followed. Anyway, I found a nice-looking mountain with a great view the other day. Want to see it?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: This makes no sense. Why did you build so many walls and corridors? They block your vision. A mad burdenbeast could crash into this little room without any warning, and you don't seem to be a bit conerned. Danger can be prowling at any corner and you must stay on your guard. That's what Agnese taught me.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You call the outside 'the wilds', but you can find everything out there. Put in a little effort and you'll find food and water just fine. But in the city, there are no places to hunt. How do you even survive?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Um, Doctor, have you ever been to one of those 'parties' Exusiai talks about? They're scary! Those little balls of exploded plant seeds, those sweet, smooth milk puffs! Listen, this is not how you should live... What? They're having another party today? I wanna go.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Agnese told about a dangerous scent on Rhodes Island, but she and the pack would stay with me. Hmm? You can't see her? But she was just here a moment ago... Maybe she went to go get food?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The man named Bernardo died, and Zaaro ran back to his territory with his tail between his legs... Seems like the hunt Agnese told us about is in the bag. But still she doesn't look happy. Why? The pack has more than enough food.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Can I get a couple extra sets of Rhodes Island clothes? They're well-made, very warm, make good tents, and you can tear them up for bandages. No? Awww… Then how about the storage depot? I'd like to go and... uhh, take a look around.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, Agnese spoke highly of you, and told me to learn from your 'cunning.' What does cunning mean? Oh! Is it cunning when you hide here by yourself, eating in secret, not sharing with anyone else? I don't think that's hard to do.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Recently, I've started thinking that maybe life under a roof isn't so bad. Here, you are not a pack, you don't group up and subject yourself to one another. You're, well, something strange... Ugh! It doesn't make any sense! Anyways, I'll stay here a few more days! So get me something good to eat!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Asleep? That means nothing for me to do? Agnese, let's go play outside.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Agnese called me Lunacub, so you can call me that too. I heard there's a 'canteen' place here, where you can eat whatever you want. Is that true? Where is it? Can I go there right now?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Too much trouble! Hunting really isn't that complicated.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Does that mean you'll listen to me? How many of these shiny... 'medals' does it take for you to obey me?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Agnese always tells me that humans are dangerous and cunning, their bellies full and hearts wicked, but you've proved you are different. You are allowed to join my pack.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I still prefer hunting with my pack. They are much more open than humans.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Since I'm the luna wolf, you all must listen to me. I'll make it clear first: if I don't see your fangs bared in the hunt, you won't get a share of the kill.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: How much will we bring back today?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The hunt begins.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: My fangs are sharp.
