voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Where are the idiots who came to die?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Hurry, the pack and I are waiting.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Patience is key.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Pipe down already! I'm not going to miss!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Take down their packleader!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Drive them into a corner!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Stupid burdenbeast, you're not getting away!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Good hunt. If you lived in the wild, I'm sure you would survive for long.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Tired. Already did what you asked me. Can I go eat now? What's on the menu today?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Hey! Some of them just got away! Do you even know how to keep the prey surrounded? I'm gonna teach you next time!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Grr... Agnese, the hunt failed. Come help us! Don't let this idiot die here!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I don't like roofs.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Don't scare me like that! You wanna die?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Hey, Doctor, don't you get tired of staying in these little cubes every day?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Hmm? Is today special? A new year? Don't get it. I think every day is brand new. Any day's worth celebrating as long as you get to fill your stomach. Anyway... Do you want to try the meat I roasted? It's very yummy.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: What took you so long? Next time you make me wait for you in a stuffy little box, don't blame me if I get a little rude.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: A birthday is the day you were born onto this land, right? That much I know. I found a meadow full of flowers yesterday. It smells very nice. I haven't told anyone else, so let's go. I've already planned out the route.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: To be honest, I still don't get what you people are trying to do. But I can see you're working to keep that rock-disease away from everyone, so that they can eat and drink all they want. I suppose it's probably a good thing. Another good thing, is I don't having to sleep with one eye open like I do outside. Here, I can sleep soundly.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: This animal almanac's a beauty. Right, from the bookshelves. I've washed my hands, so the pages'll be fine... Yeah, this is your office. Something wrong?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I hear explosions. One min, I'll head down to check. Exhaust fans sound normal, then next is... No, right. Forgot I'm riding with Rhodes Island now. You don't get Originium slugs in the pipes here. Um... Must be Engineering running weapon tests. Sorry about that, breaking your door down.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You can tell how the air's doing from a sandbeast's back, so that's why you see pitsinkers bring one down. If there's poison and it keels over... you buy a new one. But this one wasn't from the shop. I don't even own it, so I don't keep it on a leash.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Tales of the supernatural, these tapes said. Didn't really like watching them, but I do feel... Chills, from these? No. It's hot in the dark. The deeper down the pit, the hotter, harder to breathe. Always took yonks for the lift to bring us back up. I'd just stare at the lights in the ceiling, waiting.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Got shooed out of the workshop by Lanns. She wasn't pissed though, just hauled me along to a doctor, then had me on Potlid-watching duty. And watching I love my own body more... That day she asked me what life was like catching Oripathy. But all that came to mind was being down in the pit, staring at the Infected creatures and thinking, 'we're more alike now.'

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Proactive? Is this about me applying to rescue Infected...? Remember when you had me treat my wounds? So I have my cotton wads, and they're getting covered in bloodstains, and dust, and Originium shards, and sandbeast fur, and it struck me then: the pit's behind me, a million miles behind, and it's like I'm still being stabbed. Do you think I'm... still carrying the fear?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Ninety-seven, ninety-eight... Oh, first time seeing you at the training grounds. You always train at four in the morning too? That's not it? An op said I scared them target practicing here all night...?  But the light went kaput in my accommodation. I wanted to be somewhere lit-up.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I think Amiya's being nice to me. Hiding something and she won't tell me what. But it does occur to me, you know. The giant shadow I saw in a sandstorm as a kid. I might've mistook it. But it's always occurred to me... Doctor, give her these carrot pies for me, would you? She's always so busy and all, I want to be nice back, and care for her.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I've given it some thought. Hijacking Rhodes Island sounds unideal, but dragging you off might leave the whole ship out of order... Hm? Oh, it's just there's some great tales in your database. A few I wanna see with my own eyes, and it'd be nice if you come with. That's the new goal I found. What's wrong?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: No scratching, you'll wake the Doctor. C'mon, let's go walkies on the deck.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I passed the Operator tests, Doctor, so thanks for all of you inviting me. That whole chase is over with, but I'm thinking I'll find my new goal on this ship.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: That's not danger I can cope with yet.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: You know, they wanted to certify me for my professional skills before. Gloompincer made off with the paper that time. Lost to the mineshaft depths... Anyway, there's a few extra things I can do. What's this ship need?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: If that tiny patch of sky opened wide... wouldn't people want to chase the sun and the moons?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Here, Sandbeast, we need to get going.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll take the very front, as always.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Sound of muddy air, tracks of animal... I'll keep a watch that way.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Fine visibility. I can see more than just danger.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Got my bolts kitted.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Point where I'm cleaning up?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Yeah, you'll hear from me as needed.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: You lot stay up there if it gets risky.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Threat at my position—yeah, not anymore soon.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I'm hearing movement.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: And that's as far as you go.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I'm done rambling in the dark.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Sun's out. What a beauty… Sandbeast, let's get home.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: This area's clear of danger for now. Doctor, you always been like this? Any problem, you'll solve it?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: We'll have to expand the mine out... Hold the treatment for now. Got a lurking threat to handle.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: You all leg it. Comms might cut out. If things get grim, I'll leave the most discernible signs I can.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Ship's sailing on sandstone… That's strange. Like I've heard it somewhere before?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Was I not meant to dodge that? Okay, I'll stay put. You tap me again.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Sandbeasts with arcing backs like this should be living in the desert... Wonder why this bugger came with me? Here, got you new food to try.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Short-term disembarkment application. Rhodes stopping over here's perfect to hunt some sandbeast food. I'll be gone half a day. Offices are deserted—lucky I ran into you... Yeah, it is New Year's today, Happy New Year. So?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Weather's fine outside. No dust cloud, and not a Catastrophe billow in sight.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday to you, Doctor. Made you this cake—it's that giant sandbeast print I photoed... Why didn't you think I'd come? I'm your friend. I'd make you sad forgetting your birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: A 'pipe dream'—that's how I hear some people describe Rhodes. My destination's nothing like this ship's—apples to oranges, really—but I've gotten up close and personal with my own dream thanks to you all, and I'm sure you can make yours come true. I know it.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Look carefully. The files are sorted by type, then time limit prioritization, then finally, by distance from nearest to farthest. This is the most efficient organization method! ...Wait, I seem to have done all the paperwork on accident. This... is supposed to be your job, right?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I've checked all files related to the elite Operator, Blaze, and there are no records of her real name, or place and date of birth. Don't tell me you don't know; aren't you supposed to be one of the leaders here? You really don't know? Then... nevermind. Sorry, I shouldn't have accused you.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You don't need to be so cautious around me. Other than the case at hand, I'll treat everything else on the ship as if it never happened. But if there's another explosion in the hallway outside my room, I'll make the perpetrator's hair stand on end for two weeks!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: 'Assume the responsibilities for the post to which you are assigned.' As one of the leaders of Rhodes Island, is it not your duty to... Huh? My hair's standing up again? Hold on! G-give me a moment to fix my look first! Weird, I thought I had discharged all the static electricity this morning...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Even today, I can vaguely recall the first time I saw you in Lungmen. You, Blaze, and Ch'en... are all holding onto countless secrets... and I will uncover them one by one. You're willing to exchange secrets? Wait, y-you... it's t-too early for that...!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Ask me anything. Only when you speak up can I decide what is just and unjust, and whether I wish to take action. I need to take my identity into consideration? This has nothing to do with that! The Censorate, Central Judicial Office, and the Department of Discipline and Supervision... are only institutions. Laws can only be proven just when enforced by someone.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Rhodes Island's ideals conflict with my beliefs. However, I do recognize the necessity of seeking common ground while understanding our differences... The same is true when providing assistance in exchange for information.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: No matter where I am, the electricity flowing through my body never ceases. The thunderbolt is the symbol of justice; it drives me forward and sometimes even wakes me up at night... Someone is complaining that I broke the AC unit? ...How rude! How is that possible?! I don't even need to use a remote for the AC, let alone touch it!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Blaze was implicated in a major incident. All the clues have purposely been eliminated, but I have my doubts about the way the facts of the case are connected based upon a few coincidences between certain persons and times. This has nothing to do with you, but you should take adequate precautions. All I can do is offer you a fair warning.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You can't even properly manage your physical condition... how slovenly! Look at you sprawled out like this... Were you waiting for me to put a blanket over you or something? ...There won't be a next time.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I've signed obtained an investigation authorization with your company. Don't worry about it, this is purely over personal matters. If you so wish, you may call me Leizi. Who am I? Have we met before? Are you serious?!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I see, this is a completely different principle from military training.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Elite status? Is this... a promotion? The promotion process at Rhodes Island seems to differ from that of ordinary private companies...

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I, Leizi, am the bearer of the thunder and the law, the vision and reach of Great Yan. My philosophy does not align with that of Rhodes Island, and I have no intention on bridging the gap between the Infected and non-Infected. However, we can now fight side by side against our enemies!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: With my own eyes, I shall judge what power Rhodes Island possesses.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I can do that, yes, albeit at a price.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Heed my orders!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I have no interest in the identity of my enemies.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: In place.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: It may be done.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Very well, understood.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Harken! The thunder rumbles!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Rise, thunder of the five elements!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: No forgiveness unto sinners! Retribution of thunder!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Through the three thunders is justice governed!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: The essence of Lei Fa... is my will becoming one with Terra.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Well done. As my standards are quite high, you should be proud of yourself.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Unacceptable. You can do even better! Do not rest upon your laurels - you have the ability to strive for greater heights!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Impossible, what happened? How can this be?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Shameful...! Begone, you! Go back and reflect! I will hold back the enemies, so just go!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Where's the power outlet?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: How rude!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Oh... did that hurt? Please be careful of the static electricity around me.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: A year's planning is done in the spring—and though it may not be spring yet, do you simply plan to idly loaf around at a new year's outset? You should still sharpen yourself on holiday. As the saying goes, the man who catches fins for one day then rests for two, will find himself slothful with dust on his shoe. Heeey! If you keep slacking I'll have finished annotating these documents myself!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Don't slack off, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Ahem. Judicial Review Office Censor Leizi expresses good wishes on Dr.{@nickname}'s birthday. May your life be ever warm as spring, and of peace and prosperity... Hey, I'm being deadly serious! Don't laugh!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: With the mystery I'm investigating still an open question, I cannot unreservedly trust Rhodes Island. However, in my days lodging here, I've witnessed physicians benevolent and adroit, warriors heroic and unyielding. Even if our beliefs differ, I still have considerable respect for your investments and efforts.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Alright, I'm here to help! Chill, I'm all good with this gear now. Bumping into everything? That's the old me!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Out in the field, it's pretty important to watch what you and your teammates eat. Just a while ago, I learned how to use this simple BBQ spit to treat raw meat. Here, lemme demo for you right now!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I've hauled butt all across Terra, and I've never seen gear both as sturdy and as comfortable as this. Feels like when I wear it, my attack power gets boosted, plus I can hit enemy weaknesses way better, and my fire attacks are stronger too! Yeah, uh, I figure that might just be me? Haha.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The Felynes say the more experienced the hunter, the more thorough the pre-mission prep. Packing all your potions and tools is just as key to the hunt. Still, Yato loves to chew me out, saying I'm always bringing too much stuff on missions. Rock and a hard place, y'know?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Feels weird, honestly, not having my ol' reliable shield on hand. Still, the Felynes say if I get good enough with this long sword, I can basically fend off every attack under the sun. Guess my training's got a long way to go.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: You only really master combat technique after taking on enough enemies. I guess no shortcut to getting promoted after all, huh? Especially for dummies like me, haha.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I get that whetstones aren't thrilling, but they're a tool you can't go without. Even a blade with sharpness this fine is gonna need nonstop polishing its whole life.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I just wanna do my job as a guy in the background, even now. Us nobodies, we've got our own duties, our own worries, and our own things we wanna protect.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Ditching the shield, using a long sword like this, it keeps reminding me of the old days. Bad times I hate to remember. But without our past, I guess Yato and me wouldn't be who we are today.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Get your rest on, Doctor. Leave the place to me.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Operator Noir Corne, back under your command with all-new gear! Alright, Doctor, don't care if it's bandits or nightmare bizarro creatures, you leave it all to me!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Lemme scrub back a sec, I want a closer look. Yeah, mm-hm...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I've gotta give thanks to my kickass gear for carrying me this far. But obviously, the biggest props go out to you and everyone around me for all your help!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: This is Operator Noir Corne, everyone's shield through hell and high water! And hey, I guess I can handle being everyone's sword too!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: No prob. I'm all readied up.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You want me to lead, without Yato? You sure? I think it'd be better if you got her on.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Everybody done eating? Alright, go time!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Mission start! Target position is a lock!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Which area am I heading to?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Primed and ready!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Draw!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Nice, right here!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Haah! Hey!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: I'm going in!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I see through you!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: That's my window!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Now THAT was a good battle. Take pride, everyone, and good work!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission complete, perfect job! We gotta get back to Rhodes Island, because I'm looking forward to celebrating!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Good work, Doctor. We'll do better next time, don't you worry.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor! Got your Farcaster from the Felynes? You need to ditch, fast. I'll come right after you, no worries!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Whoa, whoa, steady. Lemme put my sword away first.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What's up, Doctor? Need me to head somewhere?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Haha, what do you say, Doctor? How about a round of drinks?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: UNUSED

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: It's another fine day. Take care of yourself, Doctor!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I hauled everyone in to wrap up as much of your work for you as we could. No drinks on the agenda today, either, we want you to get some major rest. Call that my present to you, haha.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: UNUSED

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hey Doctor, what can I help you with today? Have a chat to stave off the boredom? Or, did you have something interesting to tell me?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Was that Savage who just passed by in the hallway? Back when the autonomous county was established, and later when it reached a cooperation agreement with Rim Billiton, her exploits were no less impressive than mine, you know?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You know, some places have really problematic stereotypes about us Cautus. Why do they call me timid when I'm just good at avoiding danger? As a matter of fact, isn't it more accurate to say that only those who've delved deep into danger can become masters of avoiding it?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: C'mon, I've been a good boy. I'm getting all my regular checkups, taking my medicine, doing everything I'm supposed to. It's just the Medical lass is so uptight when she's recording my details. I can't help but play a prank or two, just so she'll loosen up a bit. Hehe. Oh, but don't tell that to the other medics.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, my buddy, Rhodes Island doesn't have a mandatory dress code, so there's no need for you to wear the same old rags all the time. Look at what I'm wearing - this store's got some pretty tasteful stuff, so how about I help you pick out a new look?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I'm actually pretty fond of Rhodes Island. Unlike those bigwigs who can't stop preaching about their greatness, everyone here's just trying to achieve their goals and working together to keep this ship sailing. Just like the folks in Rim Billiton.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The one in my hand? It's a standard-issue Billy blaster that I modified. Before I got my hands on it, it also used to be an Originium-powered focus for Casters. Hmm... Doctor, you're not thinking that smashing rocks with brute force would be efficient, are you?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Ah, so you're also interested in the Eureka Incident, Doctor? It's not like there's any secrets left untold, since any of the books or documentaries worth their salt tell pretty much the whole story. But... I wish they had some more details on how I rescued those hostages. Nah yeah, I dismantled a lot of those cages after all.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: It's common for mining teams to hire Catastrophe Messengers. Since I was born on a mining ship and was always interested in technical books, being a Catastrophe Messenger means basically applying what I already knew. But Doctor, where'd you get your knowledge from? I don't see any relevant literature here...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Wanted to take a little nap? No worries, I'll wake you up unceremoniously in the event of emergency!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Leonhardt, Catastrophe Messenger. Doctor, you may have heard of me... No? Ah well~ it's better that way. Seems I won't have to tell the whole story again, like I did when that HR lady cornered me.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Looks like my skills are better suited for positional warfare.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Promotion? Haha, great! Wait a second. It doesn't come with some sort of exclusive, blinged-out elite uniform? C'mon, even a small ornament would be nice. No? Aww…

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: The road that Rhodes Island's chosen is much bumpier than that of us Catastrophe Messengers, but you don't seem to have any intent on stopping. Well, I suppose I'll have to sacrifice some of my leisure time to help you clear the road then?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Mission time~! Let's see… Oh, it's a fight today!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You want me to lead the team? Mmmm… Alright. Leave it to me.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: So this is the route to the objective... Can I take a shortcut?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Let's see if our enemies have anything to offer besides numbers.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hm? Which direction? Where?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Doctor, you'll save a nice spot for me right?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Woo~ It's finally my turn!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Lure some more enemies into the ring, then leave the rest to me!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Who says a spear is only good for stabbing people?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Relying on your armor will only leave you vulnerable.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Strength in numbers, huh? Is that what you were banking on?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Let's see whether you're gold or manure!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Bam! Another mighty enemy laid low. Alright, Doctor, let's have you treat yourself like we agreed before. You and me, we're gonna visit a market at our next stop.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Enemies of this caliber pose no threat to us, right?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Cleaning up stragglers isn't really my strong suit. You oughta find someone to send after them right away, before you lose points off your combat evaluation.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Whoops, looks like we messed up. Doctor, go ahead and withdraw first. Don't worry, as long as I'm here, there's no chance of the enemy catching up.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Maybe I should go to Procurement to check out the new outfits? Or maybe not?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hm? Need me for something?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: What's the matter, you wanna take me out for a walk?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It's New Year's again. When I was a boy, this day meant one thing: the adults on the ship were coming to pat the heads of the children and ask 'Have you grown taller?' I didn't much care for… Hey! Stop it! Doctor, no patting my head!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Yo, Doctor, done with work for the day?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Look! I chose this outfit just for you. Trust me, you'll turn heads all around Rhodes Island in this getup! The top is too short? The pants are too flashy? Hey, c'mon, that's fashion!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The old miners on the ship used to say, 'Every ship hides a story,' and so does Rhodes Island... Haha, just kidding, I'm not here for corporate espionage! But even if you have some secrets, I'm willing to trust you, Doctor. When the time comes for me to know, I'm sure you'll trust me too, right?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Certainly. I'll stay by your side... At the very least, you don't curse loudly while kicking books all around the room.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: We Leithanians do fuss over our horns a lot. Some visit specialized salons to trim any excess cutin, and to keep their horns in shape... Me? I just use this sword. What's that look on your face...? It's up to you to believe me, but there's no way I could demonstrate it for you right now.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I'm just an auditing student at Ludwigs-Universität. The old man needs my help for a lot of things, and I'm the only one who can stand his temperament. It's no matter, he's like a mobile library, so I've learned a lot from him.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The bindings on this sword? There are some on my body as well. They tighten my joints and keep my muscles taut, preventing my mind from slacking off. They are not just for show.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: It doesn't matter if a weapon is easy to wield or not, I'd find a way to wield this sword even if it were twice as big. A Leithanian noble can have multiple violin bows made to order, but commoners might only have sticks to use... and we can't depend on others to protect us.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Looks, background, titles, Arts aptitude... everything that we passively inherit is specific only to ourselves. What use they have is for us to determine on our own, not up to abstract concepts like 'fate'.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You don't have to switch it off. Everyone has their own peculiar habits after all. You can work only when there's music in the room, I get it... Don't worry about it, I'll listen to whatever you pick. I don't know much about music, but your taste... shouldn't be that bad, right?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The more engrossed you get reading up on things, the stranger your mood becomes... If you're feeling moody, a little throwing or smashing might help you vent it out. I'll take care of the clean up afterward... You're saying that, you were restless because I was staring at you as your mind wandered...? I'll go check if dinner's ready.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, if you're truly altruistically advocating for the masses—then please believe me, that even if you take away my sword, cover my eyes, and bind my hands, I, Lessing Maeyer, am still willing to fight for you to the very end.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Get some sleep. I'll keep watch from a spot where I won't disturb you.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Franz... oh, Ebenholz, as you might know him, he told me about this place. I come from Leithanien, I have a sword, I know some Arts... I can help you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: If you say this is useful, then it will be. I'll make sure to watch it... eleven times a day.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, there's no need to make such a big fuss, and don't you give me a reward either. I already made it clear then, that I agree with your ideals and am willing to work for your sake.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: There are many spires in Leithanien, but there are even more people below them. It's natural for one of my background to make such a choice, but what's difficult is to actually shake up the ways of things. We still have a long way to go.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: You're responsible for the plan, and I'll be responsible for you. Give me the order.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I accept this job as a valuable training opportunity.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Stay close to me, and don't fall behind.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Hmm?!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I've long been ready.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: You can call me earlier next time.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I've experienced more chaotic scenes than this.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'll go someplace else that needs more help.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: You shall not pass, while I'm here.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: You can run, but I'll keep chasing.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: The only thing to hold a sword back is the cowardice of its wielder.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Answer for your own sins!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: You've made me believe in something: no opponent is undefeatable, and no goal unachievable.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Sometimes I put you and the old man together to compare... and the difference is obvious. He would be excitedly hurling curses everywhere if he were in your shoes now. Yes, that's how he acts when he's happy.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission complete, oder?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Every time I fail, I tighten my bindings so that the pain leaves them to weigh on my mind. No, you don't have to, I'll bear yours along with mine.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's nice and neat here. I'm going to change my bindings... I was referring to my sword, you don't have to look away.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Is this how you supervise others? That's not good.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: And what will you do if I overreact?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The days go by fast. You should come back with me to Leithanien if you get the chance. We'll go to the countryside, where patches of wild spruce trees grow straight and tall... When I was young, I thought they could grow even taller than the spires.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello. I'm not nervous, I've always been like this... what else can I even say instead....? Heya?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: You can't leave yet. Other things will have to wait till later, no matter how urgent they might be. Anyway, just stay here for a bit longer... Seems like you've guessed it. Yes, we're preparing a birthday celebration for you, and I've been tasked to make sure you stay here... It's an arduous mission, but I must complete it.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, there is no one who can guarantee they're always headed in the right direction. You need only make a choice, and I'll follow you to verify. I'll correct your path if its askew, and we'll simply continue further on if it holds true .

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: This place smells… dangerous.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I prefer to work alone, by myself.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Name, bounty, kill. Simple. That's the agreement with Kal'tsit.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Wolves have fangs, I have my blade. Wolves do not rest, neither do I.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Granny's calling... I can hear her.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Bleak wind, corpses on the ground, screams under the stars... I smell them all, the scent of wolves. I join the hunt.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Family? I have no family. I am always alone. Do you need a family, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: They avoid me... I just want to touch their tails. Provence, and Texas... I like their scent.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, sometimes I wonder... if I weren't a wolf hunter, would my life be different? Oh, you mean… I should answer the question... myself?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor... no, nothing. I thought you fell asleep. Don't sleep, not now.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Projekt Red, wolf hunter, smells wolves.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: As long as it helps me hunt.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: As you like it.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: A promotion? This will disguise me. I accept.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Infiltration successful.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: What should I do?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The hunt begins.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The scent... it's thick.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Hurry up.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Simple and clear.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Speed.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Skill.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: From shadows!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Distract them.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: No way out, for you.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Your death... is in my eyes.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Targets, all down

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The one way a hunt can end.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: This kill... too small.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Sorry... My blade... not sharp enough.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I prefer to be outside. But… it's okay.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Watch your hand. I might cut you.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: *sleepy noises*

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: A new year? That means a new hunt? Not yet? Understood. Then I rest… Doctor, you rest too.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Tired, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I've seen people. Many people. They went to the Doctor's room, and left things. That spells danger… it doesn't? Birthday presents? Oh, well… I'll lend you this fluffy ball to touch. But you have to give it back.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island has many walls. But I can feel the wind on the deck. Kal'tsit and the Doctor are here. I... like this place.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, when you chose your office, did you realize there's a spot on the landship, perfect for a cozy little sniper nest overlooking it? Where, you ask? If I told you, would you allow me personal use of the space?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Please reconsider these patient placement clauses, but first, kindly sign these cooperative pharmaceutical R&D forms. Also, may I trouble you to look over my proposal on the mobile plate transfer once again... I'm scary when I smile, you say? Then do your best to get all this sorted quickly, alright?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Yes, this is your office. I took the liberty of revamping it and adding a few confetti guns and a scripture disco-ball here and there. You say El caused an explosion here, while trying to cook some popcorn with her gun...? Yes, I knew that, but as they say back in Laterano, 'an explosion unseen is an explosion clean'.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: My signature? Ah, I did contribute a little to 'Botanical Review', yes. It wasn't anything I had to do for work. Rather, I simply had too many types of flowers around my sickbed. One time, Mostima was in such a rush, all she could offer me was a potato that had started to bloom. With that many flowers on hand, how could I not learn a thing or two about them?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: This scrape on my hand? Just from getting a little physical. During fieldwork, you sometimes run into the types who simply have no respect for the ill. Fiammetta was just about boiling over, so I saw fit to educate them in a... fitting manner. I may not mind, personally, but that doesn't mean I have to force my friends to ignore it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The rulebook for cardinals may be as thick as a stack of three apple pies, but it's nothing that complicated. Checking on new arrivals to see how they're settling in, seeing if people are doing alright at the monasteries... After all, without them, what would even be left of Laterano today?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Here, some cold cystymilk, apple-scented smelling salts, an eyemask, and some earplugs. Hold onto them tight, they're about to start seating people. You were wondering what sort of films I liked to watch, and, well, I think every entry in the 'Edict Terminator' series is brilliant, but it's good to be prepared if you can't handle all the blood, right?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: No need to avert your eyes, Doctor. Sure, I'm not quite able to leave this wheelchair just yet. Some wounds simply don't heal quickly... If you feel like assuaging your guilt, how about granting me authorization to use your autonomous operation platforms? 'For transport or for racing?' Oh, don't worry yourself over that.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Are you always so quick to notice when someone is watching you? Oh, forgive me, it's a habit of mine to observe others. It's how I weigh the reasons I might need to take care of someone, against the reasons to... 'take care' of them. Which one do I mean for you? Work in peace, Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hmm? Oh, I was just looking at a shadow across your window. A habit from my days in the hospital. What does that shadow look like to you?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Pleasure to meet you, Doctor. Just Lemuen is fine, thanks. Would you rather discuss work with a cardinal of the Seventh Tribunal, or show El's big sister around her workplace? The choice is yours.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Right there. You edited out one of the gorier scenes, didn't you?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: After having worked together all this time, why are you only getting around to this ceremony now? If you were too busy, you should have asked me to help.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Ah, you laughed. Giving trust and receiving it are one and the same. Both acts that put people at ease, no? Then, would you like to receive this medal from the Seventh Tribunal for outstanding cooperation, to put me at ease? You can have two, if you'd like. You could even pin them on your eyemask, one for each eye.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: No need for introductions, I'm already familiar with everyone here.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: No need for reports, I can see what everyone does from here.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Please, this is no time for excuses.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Please, this is no time for pity.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm in position... No need to guess which position.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Go ahead.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Whoever said a wheelchair couldn't get up onto a steel beam?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Oh, I should try adding a jet engine next time~

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Target disarmed.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Target crippled.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Target eliminated.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Who would bear the news of your death? Ever crossed your mind?

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, can you come help me out? My wheel's stuck on a tile... Alright, hold out your hand. High five! Oh, the wheel? I pulled it out myself.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission accomplished. There is one more thing, though. Logistics gave me far too much tea and cake. Would everyone like to help me lighten the load?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I'll go handle them.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'll keep watch behind. No one will give chase.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Surely there's no speed limit in Rhodes Island's corridors?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: That finger of yours would be more suited to tickling the ivories, I think.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Would you like to push me along for a walk?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I'm giving some gifts to operators I went on missions with. I still have three boxes to go, and it would be terribly inconvenient if I don't deliver them all before work. Could you help me out? The sooner we get these delivered, the sooner you can have a present from me. Sound good? Let's get going, then. Hold on tight, now.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Where are you headed today, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Now that you mention it, have you ever thought of making up for past birthdays? I understand you spent several years asleep due to some unfortunate accident as well, correct? I know you might not mind, but the time we lose is never only lost by ourselves. Come, there's still plenty of time today to hold a few parties.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: To fight against disease and injustice... What a noble message. We have a similar speech at our annual meetings at the Seventh Tribunal, but it's a lot shorter than the celebratory gunfire segment... Hmm? I'm just getting a piece of candy. I know you're not simply going through the motions when you speak, so I'll be listening to the very end.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, I greatly admire your genius. It's my honor to be your guard.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: A man of my experience can tell you'll be a great leader one day, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I have an unusual skin tone, you say? Hah. Just a souvenir from back when I snuck into a biolab, and... Please, I'm joking around.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I need to wear this scarf, even when I sleep, or else my neck will get cold.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: This face of mine might be a little too exotic for your typical townsfolk. Heh, I tend to draw a curious crowd when I wander.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I'm surprised how polite you are to this old man! Not many besides Durin ask after my health.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: When I go barefoot, I can sense enemies through their vibrations on the ground.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hmm... Snoring is a bad habit. The other rangers will hear you.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I'm Rangers, the Sniper. Call whenever you need me.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Not bad.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: My turn, is it?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Good. Let me show you what an old man can do.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's get going.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Prey spotted. Commence operation.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm waiting for orders.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: What are your orders?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Alright.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Got it.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Found you!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Taste my arrow!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Challenge after challenge. Exactly what we wanted. Right, Noir Corne?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: What a satisfying battle!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: A few of them got through. I'd call that decent.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Oh no, I'm out of breath...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: If you need anything, just say the word.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Urgh! Please, leave my tail be...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You like me that much, huh? Weird taste, I gotta say.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, it's been three hours, and the kiddos still clamoring for more of my stories. Talk to them, will ya...? The New Year always makes the young'uns so astonishingly lively. I can't compete with that…

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, how can I help you?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I'm kinda too old to follow what you young'uns may want. But here's a little something I like. This scarf's made out of my favorite material, lightweight but warm. It will keep you cozy when it's cold, Doctor. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Retirement? Too soon for that. Not while I still eat five buns for breakfast. Once my appetite declines, then—and only then, will I find some place to bask in the sun. But for now, don't you worry.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Come on, Doctor, I just got back from fieldwork. My arms ache, my legs are sore… Can't we leave this stuff for tomorrow? Pretty please? No? Tsk, stupid hood-head… My Rhodes Island pass is ready...? Ahaha! Just kidding. Right away, boss!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Hey, you awake? C'mon, c'mon, snap out of it! And what's with that dopey look on your face? You said you were dead tired and didn't wanna work, so I told HR you passed out and got you some sick leave. Oh, that smell in the air? Dizzyleaf smoke. Isidro tried some before, and he slept like a log.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Who made this finshit class schedule?! Why do I have to sit in an etiquette class with those stupid little brats? And what in the saltdamned seas is this supposed to be? 'List of banned profanity: salty bastard, inquisition gilipollas…' Hmph, honestly, how is—Ow! Why'd you hit me...?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Doctor! It's been two weeks since I applied for field missions. I was wondering if—What the hell? Three years with a clean record at Rhodes Island first?! Ahem, I mean, come on, can't you bend the rules just a little. Doing bad things in Rhodes Island's name? I would never! So... Please, my most esteemed boss. Help me, O Supreme and Invincible Commander. Oh, I beg you, the Great Doctor!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: So much stuff in my room? Not really. Only a bunch of pretty dresses, yummy snacks, and shiny gems. Hey, don't look at me like that! I paid for all this! I just wanna be surrounded by the things I've always wanted. Snuggling up to them helps me sleep at night.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I've slept on beds softer than this one, as well as out in the Salt Flat, and on a ship's deck. I'll never forget how it feels, just like I'll never return to a life on the run. You know what, Doctor? One day, I'll have a nice, big, comfy bed all my own, and that's how I'll know I'm living the good life.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Listen, Doctor. Those Bastards at the Inquisition are nothing more than a school of starving saltfins. The moment they smell blood, they'll lock their dead finny eyes on you and mark you for death. Disgusting! Vermin! Stay clear at all costs! Wait, what...? The little bird I was just dancing with was an Inquisitor?!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Any towns in Iberia I don't know? Pfft! I could show you where all their mayors hide their doblones. So what's this about? Ohh... You need intel but can't dig it up yourselves? And now you're... begging me for help? Hee hee hee hee. Well then, first of all… Address me properly, as Señora Pascuala.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Oye, Doctor, you think I could earn more in Columbia or Kazimierz? I hear those two places have loads of people who'll throw money at anything. The streets are a treasure trove of opportunity! Oh, don't worry, if I do get a big haul, I'll need you there to help reel it in.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: *Sigh* Imagine having a whole office to yourself… I wish I had one too…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hola, everyone, pleased to meet you! I'm your newest operator! Señores Elysium and Weedy recommended this place to me. I hope we can all get along—Hey, Pelirrojito! What's with the pretend puking? You got a problem with me?!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: See? Didn't I say I'm pretty good at this sort of thing?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A raise? Excellent! Oh Doctor, you are truly my guiding light, and Rhodes Island is the best company ever. I'll work here until the day I die! So, when's the next raise?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: This is just one small step. I'll take another, then another, till one day, everything I ever wanted will be within reach.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Yahoo, I'm here and ready for another day's work!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Hello everyone, I'm your captain for today, so please listen up and listen well!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Careful out there—I'm not that good a medic.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Uwaah! My gosh… Please keep me safe, everyone!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What? Worried I'm not healing them right?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Relax, your operators have been good to me. I still have a conscience, you know.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: This here is a good spot. They can't see me.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Check again, it's dizzyleaf smoke. If we can't take 'em down, this'll take 'em out…

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Remember to stand inside the smoke, okay?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: The smoke won't chase you like a hungry saltfin, so stay put already!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: If anyone's severely injured, just let me know and I'll add more herbs to the censer!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Is my smoke toxic?! More herbs won't kill you, so stop whining already!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Wow, it's a privilege to be working with you all!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Not bad. If I hired one of you as a bodyguard, I'd never have to worry about danger again… What? I'm showing my true colors? Oh, you must've misunderstood. What I meant is, I couldn't bear to be apart from you all.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Frigging heartless bastards… You better remember this! I'll be back for my pound of flesh one day!

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Didn't expect you to be so loyal, waiting for me like that! Now move it, or we're dying together!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Hmm, this place isn't half bad.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hey hey hey, ever heard of personal space?!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Oh, it's you, Doctor. Want some water? A snack? Just call me whenever and I'll be there to help.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I don't really get what this holiday's about. What's there to celebrate about time simply passing by? If you ask me, people should celebrate when they get what they want. For me, I'll look back at all the hardships I went through, and cherish how they've become precious things I can hold in my hand.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor! If you need any help, just give me a shout!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Of course I remembered your birthday! Though I gotta admit, I only memorized it to get on your good side at first, but then... You turned out to be a real great boss, and a true friend too. Here, some rum I nabbed from the salt ship. For you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, I hope you and all the friends I made aboard the landship can live the lives you truly want. Heehee, who knows? Next time we meet, I might be rich and famous, coming to sponsor Rhodes Island!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doc~tor~, you didn't forget anything, did you?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Picking pockets to feed myself? Yeah, that was how I grew up. I didn't exactly have a choice. I woulda starved to death otherwise.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: If you want sturdy grappling hooks, the key thing's a good rope. Hm? Why do I like my hook so much? Well, go scale a building with your bare hands and you'll see.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Fine, fine, your word's the word, Doctor. Can I go back to my room now? I've got stuff coming up. What? Still no? C'mooon, cut me some slack! Pleasie please?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: If it wasn't you Rhodes Island, I'd probably still be rotting in jail. Say, how'd you find me anyway? Hmm… Maybe you heard about my skill through the grapevine?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: There's lots of ways if you wanna survive in the slums, though more people simply die without a way at all. Never had much of a choice myself. Hope you can understand, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: My parents kicked me out, and I had to fend for myself on the streets. Compared to my days in the gutter, life at Rhodes Island is a massive improvement.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Saw a lot of people get same disease as mine who didn't end well. I kinda gave up on myself too, until I got lucky enough to be found by you guys… Tell me straight, Doctor. You can cure me, right? You...you can't? *Sigh*, I can live with that, I guess.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Before, I was always looking for the next meal. Now I can really eat my fill. Gotta hand it to you, Rhodes Island's alright in my book. Huh? You wanna hear me say 'thank you'? Nah-ah, in, your, dreams. *Gasp*, I just said it...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Ugh, this chair... ahhh….dangit... so comfy...!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: The name's Rope, nice to meet ya. Oh, here's your ID card, don't forget it. Huh? Why do I have it? That's a se-cret!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Does watching this stuff actually help?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: C'mon, lets talk about payment. Promotions are cool, but my salary is what really matters.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Fine, fine. Now that I've got my due, I guess I should give my best.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: All right, coming!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm doing captain biz? I would've asked for a bonus usually, but I can let this slide since it's you.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Look at the map and figure out your route before we get in there. This is experience talking.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: So, what kind of good stuff will our enemies be carrying today?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I don't really do straight-up fights.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Put me to good use, ooo-kaaay?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Sneaky sneaky…

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Hmm, is this a good spot?

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Aha!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Good, good, a little closer!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Huuugh!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Once I hook you, you're not getting away.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: A lot more excitement on that one than usual! A lot more profit too... whoo-hoo~!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: It'd be a waste to leave all that good stuff here. The enemies don't need them anyway, right?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Some of 'em got away? Just leave them be. They might turn over a new leaf, who knows.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Hey! Let's just bug out now, Doctor! We must save ourselves first!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Is there an air vent in this room? Nothing, just curious.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Aaaagh! Am I under arrest?!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I mean, I'd like to figure out how a normal girl lives sometime... but, you know... I mean, maybe that's not really me?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Piping hot food, big wide smiles, piles and piles of presents... It's the kind of scene I would only be able to steal glances at through windows. Thank you, Doctor... Aw, c'mon, I was being serious there! Anyway... happy New Year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hiiii, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday. Got your present here. Go ahead. Yep, it was your wallet, until the moment I took it from your pocket. No harm in giving it to you here as my present, right? Okay, okay, jokes are over, now look inside. I spent forever hand-drawing the card, y'know?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Yeah, yeah, I know. I've been at Rhodes Island so long, I oughta get used to my new life already. I'm gonna stop crawling through the vents, and I'm really gonna cut down on stealing stuff as a prank... Doctor, do you think, that after so many field missions—I've learned to use my skills for the better?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: The encrypted incantations on these files have been dispelled, you can now read them at your leisure. Except for one register, on which the curse is too cumbersome to remove. May I inquire, Doctor, why you suddenly went silent a moment ago?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Perplexed? Not quite, I'm just trying to think of a faster way to solve the puzzle program that Mechanist left. However, his ingenious design is providing me with fresh inspiration for my own incantation-weaving. Would you like to join the contest as well, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Mist kisses the travelers' lips, while water ripples caress the soul.' Such is life in the Convallis. Do you still have any other unanswered questions? Uh, what is a 'Hostess'...? Ahem, by the looks of things, you've already met those enthusiastic sisters of mine. Regarding that traditional title of Lord of the Banshees, it is not something I reject altogether.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The power of 'language' comes from rules and restraints, not from arbitrary imagination. Only by imposing constraints upon yourself can you make progress in the incantation Arts. Master this, and overnight, your knowledge of incantations will surpass the innate talent afforded to our kind.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: The myriad souls have long departed, but our souls still must find rest. If the deceased require guidance on their journey to the other side, then I am willing to become the ferryman of the Sarkaz, of my countrymen on this great land... Indeed, I'm far from capable of singing an elegy for every departed compatriot, but I will not give up.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: The prophecy that frightened the King of Sarkaz? Now that Amiya and Rhodes Island have overcome the past, the flame of hope to conquer fate still burns. Doctor, I hereby swear that as long as I am here, we shall never be slaves to that prophecy.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Did you notice, Doctor? Indeed, the decorations on my uniform are incantations engraved by my own two hands. It is difficult for normal fabrics to contain such power, so I could only seek help from my colleagues in the Logistics Department, who painstakingly modified the textiles of the Convallis. The nightcap I intend to give you is also made through similar methods. I additionally engraved it with an incantation to help you sleep.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: After learning the truth of what happened back then, you've sought out many of our colleagues, so I figured it was only a matter of time until you'd come looking for me. What do I think? I harbor no hatred for you, Doctor. Amiya mentioned to me that you're being haunted by nightmares. I can dispel them for you.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The same incantation can be interpreted as desired, manifesting its effect in a thousand different ways. If words have countless interpretations, so do names. Dr. {@nickname}, were you to add your name to this incantation, what do you think it would invoke? I'm eager to find out.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: A blindfold? No need. This 'Banshee's Crown' is enough to cover my eyes and help me sleep, as it contains an incantation forbidding those who would touch— You lost consciousness? Oof... do sleep well, Doctor.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Rhodes Island elite operator, Logos, reporting in. I think this procedure calls for some formality, cumbersome as it may be— Doctor, you're not thinking of leaving early again, are you?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This battle once offered much inspiration for choreographing my cadence.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Sorry to arrive late to such an important occasion. What part are we at now? My face is flushed? Hmm, looks like there are still some hiccups in the 'hangover removal' incantation I was working on with Mechanist.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Cross beyond death, and usher in a more just vision...' Elite operators have never been in the business of signing blood oaths, but they invariably dedicate their lives in service to their ideals. The fact that we still stand together after all this time, Doctor, is rare indeed.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Questions are destined to be answered; rules, bound to be analyzed.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm willing to lead.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Never mind the use of force. Death has its own resting place.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Just as incantations must be restrained, so too must the enemy.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Waiting for your call.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I hear the elegy.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Thus I speak.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: For them the bell tolls.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Veil, the Curtain of Destiny.'

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Morningstar, the Illumination of Wisdom.'

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Soulriver, the Ferry of the Other Side.'

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Period, the Reversal of Finality.'

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Join in our celebration, Doctor. Your joy in this moment is enough to embellish my incantations.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Every incantation I wrote was utilized by you, with not a single word wasted. We make for an excellent team, Doctor.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I can still hear their cries in the distance. The wrathful, unable to find peaceful slumber... There will come a day when the dead will know rest. I'm sure of it, Doctor.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Retreat. The curtain will cover your tracks.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: May I use my own office chair?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: How does this tune sound?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Um… You're stepping on my cloth…

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: My mother brought me reeds from the Convallis. I intertwined them with song and incantation, connecting them end-to-end, and formed them into a necklace. It will wither in the night of the old year and sprout in the dawn of the new year. This piece, bearing blessings of new life, is my gift for you, Doctor. Happy New Year.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, did I bother you with my whistling? No? That's a relief to hear. What is the name of this piece? It's untitled; just an improv piece I came up with in my spare time.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. How many years have I been offering my blessings to you now? You don't remember either...? It's fine. Sometimes, forgetting is a blessing in its own right, letting the past be put to rest. Just remember that I'll still be here for you next year.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I first came here as a wanderer in search of knowledge. Though the fragments of Rhodes Island's past are lost to time, hope remains. We have overcome the nightmares of the bygone days. As for where we ought to go in the future, I believe you already know.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: It is an honor to serve you, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I was once naive enough to think I could have anything I wanted. Now I know, while that may be true for most things, it is not for others. Those I can never get. Not on my own.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Any work you might have, please feel free to let me try. Don't worry, after what I've have been through, the dignity of a noblewoman is the least of my concerns. Now I am just like Zima and the girls, an ordinary student under protection.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Doctor, if you would like to know more about Chernobog, I may be able to provide a unique perspective. I was only a student, but you know, the Student Council President does interact with society at large, in some ways.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: People like Istina, who forgo the opiate that is entertainment in pursuit of greater knowledge, are quite rare. Even at a noble school like I attended. If she had been my classmate back then... No, it's no use thinking about that now.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: To hate the world on account of a tragedy is as shortsighted as loving the world over a comedy——Is it? Doctor, have you already decided how to handle all that you will soon face? And how should I? I'm still unsure.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, I have a favor to ask of you. Would you please look after Zima and the girls... specifically their mental health? They look like they're adjusting well, but I know they're not. Even I, occasionally, think back to those times...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Doctor, I wonder if you could ever understand? I was a victim, at times, I know. But at some point, I found myself an unconscious victimizer. And I even… 'indulged' in it... I... I can never forgive myself for that.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, is it easier to forget, when you're fully grown? When I come of age, will I be able to forgive myself? Will becoming as mature as you allow me to finally deal with the misery in my heart?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: The Doctor is asleep...  Looks kind of cute.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Greetings, Doctor. Allow me to once again express my gratitude to Rhodes Island for taking in me and my friends. I've had enough of a break working in Logistics, and I'd like to do as Zima and the girls do.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I too must prepare for the battlefield…

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: It seems my experience in student government is paying dividends in my work life. How delightful.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: There is still much I don't understand about what I am doing, about my future, about myself, and about so much more. But I am young. I still have time to think. Don't I, Doctor?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Let us put my training to the test.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I will do all I can.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Comrades, let us move out.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Comrades, let us keep to the plan.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Leave it to me.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Is it my turn?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Stay calm, relax…

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: First, remember the combat manual…

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Ready, aim... FIRE!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Huh? A misfire? Eek!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Rosa, believe in yourself. You can do it!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: This is nothing personal...

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, we did it...! Oh, um, ahem, truly a delightful victory!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I hope I've met Doctor's expectations.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: My apologies, Doctor. If only I had tried harder...

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We must review this carefully after we get back…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I wonder if there's anywhere quite like the salon?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Another lovely day today.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy new year, Doctor. This is a busy day, but I'm glad that I can contribute towards the party. I hope everyone likes my floral arrangements and desserts. Oh, I just remembered something. The USSG and I will be hosting a small private gathering this evening. You're more than welcome to join us, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, it's great to see you.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: We had to be extremely careful with our gifts at school. A slight mistake may just trigger a sizable scandal. But that's something I no longer need to worry about, and I can express myself however I wish. Happy birthday, Doctor. Gummy taught me how to bake these cookies. Thank you for taking care of us.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I may never be able to free myself from the nightmare. But since my arrival at Rhodes Island, I gradually found the courage to face it. It's all thanks to you and my friends at the USSG. You always stand by my side and lead the way... I believe one day, I will finally be able to start my life anew.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Umm, Doctor... I'm not very good at filing and writing reports. Do you think you can assign me to another position? Eh? I don't need to do anything. All I need to do is hang out here? Doctor... You're a weirdo.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Everyone at Rhodes Island is my friend. The elite operators and my squad mates are my family. Ms. Kal'tsit doesn't want me to treat them as family. I didn't get it at first, but I do now. They're like flowers in a vase. If you don't pay attention to them, they'll wither. But they're all I have.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: What am I reading? Oh, it's an entry from two days ago. Closure spilled her coffee that morning and stained a couple scrolls in the library. And she got cursed, I think. For every five words she says, she ends up spitting on someone's face. Scary, isn't it?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Painful things, sad things, and scary things all go away when you least expect them to. But it's not okay to forget them. I need to remember them, because those emotions are still there inside me. I don't want to end up crying without knowing why. Memories are a burden, and I have to carry my own burden.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I can't use a shield, I can't use a bow, I can't make guns glow, and I can't turn those iron rods into weapons very well. More importantly, the other elite operators are much warmer than me. This warmth is what helps them fight for everyone else and for what's right. I will do my best.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Ms. Kal'tsit has lost lots of family, right? I see it in her eyes. How does she keep it to herself and manage to live with it? Just thinking about how everyone will disappear eventually one after another is enough to make my heart ache. Like it's going to explode. Is it because she's a grown-up? Then I want to grow up soon.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, could you tell me what this word means? I asked Blaze about it, and she just kept giggling, and Amiya just kept hitting her. Oh, it means kissing? I know what that is, then. Doctor, bend down a little, okay? Can I kiss you on the cheek? Thanks for always taking care of us. Meow.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I won't forget about those people. They created me and those monsters. They wanted to use us to do bad things. Before the world finally stops hurting us all... I'll punish these people. I will make it really, really hurt, so they never, ever forget.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Oh... You're the Doctor, right? I went over the records on the terminal just yesterday. Yep, I remember now, Doctor. You can give me orders. Let's go on a mission? Make sure to use my powers well.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hmm... the Doctor is taking a nap. Looks restless, too. Must be tired. If I give the Doctor a hug, it should feel a little better, right? Just relax and sleep well. I know how it feels... It hurts even in your dreams, right? I can tell.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. I am Elite Operator Rosmontis. Ms. Kal'tsit has given her permission. You can give me and my team orders now. Use my power where it matters, Doctor. I also tend to forget about things pretty easily. Be sure to remind me if it looks like I might forget something.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Yeah... I got that down now. I can use this in battle.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I asked Ms. Kal'tsit why I'm an elite operator. Lots of people talk behind my back. They say I'm not right for the job. Ms. Kal'tsit said that if I become an elite operator, I'll remember more, and I'll become a better person. Yep, I'm doing my best.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: This world isn't going to get better so easily, but humans tend to get worse because of their surroundings. Doctor, we can't turn into bad people. If you do, I am sure you'll be really, really bad. I won't let you turn out like that.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Time for a mission? Yeah, I know. I will protect all of Rhodes Island's operators. I promise.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I am the leader? Don't worry. They may not be from my team, but I'll make sure their support doesn't go to waste.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Don't worry. I know how to control my Arts.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I don't want to see my family get hurt. I will destroy everything that could hurt my family.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I won't remember you.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Give me your order. I will see it through.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: It's starting.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Stand back. If you don't want to see what's about to happen, don't look.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: If it hurts, just cry out. It'll feel better.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: If you surrender now, I won't hurt you.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: You won't die... I'll make sure you don't die.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: There are things that have to be done by someone. There are things that only I can do.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: If there comes a day when I can't use these Arts again... Hmm. What will that day be like? I can't imagine.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: That was very nice, Doctor. There, there. Thanks.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I will take care of the rest. It won't take long.

voices.title: Operation Failure
