voices.text: No... I won't retreat. I can't disappoint the others. I still have my sword... Even without my sword, I can still fight! I won't leave!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: P-Please don't lock me in a small room. They're scary... I... I don't really like those kinda rooms.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: D-Don't touch me! ...You'll get hurt.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Um... I-I'll try to bear with it... and not break your hand...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I don't remember how I used to spend New Year's very well. I think I had brothers, and we would set off fireworks in the yard, but I also wonder... Were they real? The people on Rhodes Island… are the only ones I have left. Please don't leave me. Not ever.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Oh, you're the Doctor, right?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, I remember your birthday now. It's always been on my terminal. This is a really, really good day, right? I don't know why we celebrate the days we were born... But just hearing the word, make me feel life and warmth. Doctor, do you want to blow out the candles? Candles are warm, too.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Should I wear blue shoes or white shoes to the party tonight? Doctor, I don't remember what I've done this past year, but all the people I hurt were bad, right? If I haven't done anything wrong, I want to wear this new pair of white shoes.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: You want me to be your assistant? I can't, I barely know how to read. It'll just be a waste of your time. But if you need something fixed, then I can help.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I'm too frugal? I don't think so, I just live the way I want. Machinery is good, but I don't need it to do anything fancy. Same goes for my clothes, only the stuff I make myself suits me best. If you have fewer needs, then of course you spend less money.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: When my dad was killed, I honestly thought there wasn't a single good man among the Sarkaz. But now that I think about it, I was too naive at the time. How can stuff like race or appearance decide if someone's good or bad? No matter what your race is, as long as you look out for one another, you're family.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: This outfit? Made it myself—it's gotta be as cool as possible since it gets really hot in the boiler room. It... doesn't look like work attire? What d'ya mean? There's all sorts of different workers, and each has her own needs.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Neighbors who take care of each other, simple but comfortable furniture, an ever-growin' pile of spare parts, and machinery that clanks together like the growl of thunder. Now, that's the good life. I thought my dad'd grow old with his factory, and I'd grow old with the next-generation factory, but...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doesn't matter what it is - as long as you make it yourself, it feels like home. Same goes for Londinium. Every brick and tile was laid down by Londiniers. We know what Londinium is thinkin', and we're gonna take it back with our own hands.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Sometimes the commander reads books that are really hard to understand... I remember a line went somethin' like this, 'People built cities, but refused to adapt to them.' Not sure I agree with that though. As long as you find your own way to live, it doesn't make a difference whether you're in the city or in the middle o' nowhere.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My dad and my old friends always used to say I was stubborn, stroppy, and foul-tempered. Don't think there's anything wrong with being stubborn, you need a bit of that to protect people around you. But, I failed... Cause... Where are they now...?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Here, Dr. {@nickname}. Why am I givin' money to you? 'Cause I can't spend it all, there's no point keepin' it around, and you happened to pass by. No need to be polite, I always used to give money to my friends, so they all got used to it. Huh, you don't need it? Damn it, gotta find someone else then...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, Dr. {@nickname}... Oh, havin' a sleep? Let me find a blanket for ya... Hmm, if I made a new blanket, the Doctor would probably find that helpful…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps Caster, Rockrock, reporting in. Dr. {@nickname}, we've had a few misunderstandings in the past, but I'm not blinded by those old prejudices anymore. I hope we can have a good working relationship.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: That's crazy... I gotta ask again, are you sure you're a drug company?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I don't care about my rank. As long as I'm with friends... I'm always ready for the next battle.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I fight to reclaim my home, and to put an end to the war. I hope that one day, we'll be able to put down our weapons and pick up the tools to rebuild Londinium. Just like... in the past.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Of course, it's my job to protect my family.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Be careful. Your safety is more important than victory.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: My drones are ready, Doctor. Should I scout ahead?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Found 'em. They're not gettin' away!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'm here, Doctor. I can see the enemy's tracks.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Standing by. Doctor, where do you need me?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Ready to deploy my drones.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Activating Rock-18 attack module.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Rock-18, track the enemy!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: It's up to us to protect our homes!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I'm not watching my friends die again!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Rock-18, maximum power!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I know my drone better than anyone else. It can't do that on its own. The fact that you've used it so effectively just shows how great a commander you are, Dr. {@nickname}.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: A total victory with no casualties. Dr. {@nickname}, if you were around back then, would things have... turned out differently?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The enemies are gettin' away, after them... Wait, no, scrap that. They might be leadin' us into a trap... Safety's gotta come first.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Run, Doctor, I'll hold them off! ...It's alright, there's no need to worry... When I joined the Self-Salvation Corps, I was prepared for this moment.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This place... isn't the same as my home, but it's just as warm. I really like it here.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Aw!... Is something wrong? I'm just lookin' at this exhaust fan. Closure said this model's five years old, but it's the first time I've seen it... So ingenious.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Oh, Dr. {@nickname}? I'm makin' a wooden carving for you. The things I make are usually only good for me, but it should be fine givin' away simple stuff like decorations, right?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Dr. {@nickname}. Do you have any wishes? Mine? Umm... I wish that we'll be able to spend every New Year in peace, up until the day we die.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Good mornin', Dr. {@nickname}. Time for another day of hard work.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I heard it's your birthday today, so happy birthday! Here's a present from me to you. Um, that's you and Amiya carved on there. It's my first go with this sort of ornamental thing, so it didn't turn out too well... You like it? Oh, that's brilliant, then!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, enjoying yourself? Me? Mm-hm, of course I'm happy. Everyone's having a proper lively get-together, there's nothing better than that. Oh, that reminds me, I just drew this prize and I'm not really in need of it. You want it?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, anything I should help with?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, you're always so busy with work. Don't you have any hobbies? Me, I like watching obscure old movies.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Truth is, I learned how to fight because of this movie I saw when I was little. Main character fought with knives and homemade traps. I thought it was really cool, so I started learning myself. My knives here, they're actually the same kind as the ones in that movie.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: In Columbia, anything can be bought with money. It sounds great, until you turn it around: Without money, nothing's yours at all.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Rhodes Island feels like a company out of a movie. Medical corp on the outside, actually a private army underneath. Operating to save more and more people… feels pretty cool.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, do you think I come off gloomy? Dammit… I didn't used to be like this. It was ever since my pop got the way he did, and I had to start worrying about keeping the family afloat. Hmm…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I don't hate Anthony. If we have to talk about the past, I think my pop's to blame too. And honestly, I thank Anthony. If he wasn't in the right place at the right time, I might've done something... I could never take back.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Pop never understood. Mom didn't leave because we had no money. It was 'cause his temper got worse every day. I've thought about if I went with Mom instead, but Pop used to be... so nice to me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, there's times I'm with you and I ease up so much I forget my own issues. I have the money to treat my pop's illness now, but I don't have a cure for his emotional troubles… Doctor, could you help me?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: So you get tired and drop right where you are, just like me…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor. I'm a new Operator. Robin's the name. I've got money troubles, so if it's all the same to you, just send me to do whatever.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Intense. Feels just like I'm watching an action movie...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: What? I got a raise so quick...? That's great. Thank you, Doctor!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I never stuck with my old jobs for very long. The company itself had problems, or it was something with my pop... This time, it feels like I'll be able to stick with Rhodes Island for a long time.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Leave it to me.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm not too good at teamwork…

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Wonder what kind of place we're going to this time.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Let's take a look around first…

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Am I up?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Ready. Just say the word.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I see the enemy.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Mm.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I've got a temper too!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Hmph.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Where are you looking?

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I've got more than just knives!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, can we cut this sort of mission down a little? Bad for the heart…

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I bet everybody dreams of having a boss like you, Doctor.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Doctor, need me to chase them?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, you go! I'll cover you!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I better get to know this place…

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Um?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor. Taking a walk?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: 'The happiest thing about today is we say goodbye to the past; the hardest thing about today is we say goodbye to the memories.' It's, uh, a line from a movie... Umm, Happy New Year, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor. Need me to guard you today?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday. I got a necklace for you. It's from my movie tie-in collection. Comes from a real classic romance flick. But now I'm, uh, remembering what happens to the ship and the lead couple, and it sends kind of a crappy message... Umm, please forget what I said. Just treat it like a normal necklace, okay?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: My pop's sickness eased up a little. I'm thankful—really, truly, I am... I gotta be honest though, I know with my abilities I don't deserve this contract. The most I can do is repay Rhodes Island for helping us, however I can. Just, I can start by protecting you, Doctor. That's experience I've got under my belt, as a bodyguard.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. Have you figured out the style you wanna go with today? Huh...? You didn't call me here for that? I really, really hope you can give it at least a little more thought. Please?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Watch out! I've got tons of stuff in my pocket here. If this negative ion hair softener bumps into the horn growth stimulant and spills... Well... I could end up getting hanged on the deck! It's no joke!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You've probably heard how assassins who know their stuff in anatomy work more efficiently, no? Of course, my goal's not to take anyone's hope to survive away. Instead, I want to turn that hope into something more vivid and brilliant! Styling is an art, but it's also a science!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: She looks familiar... Is that the girl who shows up in all those kung fu movies? Whoa, don't ever tell her I'm here! Nah, it's not her that I'm afraid of, but I really don't wanna run into her stylist, Lauder! The last thing I need is anybody calling me 'Bobbi'...

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm a researcher, not a modeler, and I definitely don't want to be the kind of girl who works her mindless brush on monotonous faces under spot light day in and day out! Coming on the ship's been kind of like a vacation to me, I guess? If I had to stare at those lifeless faces all day, my brain would get completely fried sooner or later. I'm not doing that no matter how much I get paid.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: If I got no money, I can't buy any new tools or materials. That's why even I got to work sometimes. Hm... I think the girl who came to me last time just got an academy award? She'd be fine to spot me, right?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, I asked Dr. Warfarin for some info about your body... and modified my brush texture based around that. I promise you it won't trigger any allergies this time!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: If you want to touch my hair, go right ahead. It's pretty messy already anyway. Is that weird? When you do styling work for as many people as I do, you definitely won't find yourself in the mood to work on yourself even if you have the time.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Interesting faces are like stories in their own right. Dr. {@nickname}, you are like... a kinda damaged videotape, waiting for someone to dust you off. If the day ever comes that you get repaired, what kind of story will you reveal?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Did you really fall asleep? In that case, I guess I can get to work? Your bone structure, your skin... Whoa, this is even more spectacular than I thought!

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, I'm Roberta! We meet again! Once I sign here, I'll be your personal stylist, right? Huh... 'You'll be an operator?' Doesn't matter as long as I get to stay!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Beat up all the annoying guys, right? No more difficult than swinging ten brushes around while taking a sip of coffee. I'm from Siracusa, after all.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I've got an entire room full of medals like this one back in my studio in Wrankwood... Hey, Doctor, can't you give me something a little more interesting for my reward?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Since you're giving me another promotion, I want a bigger studio. You'll approve it, right?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Should I go with eyeshadow palette #3001... or perhaps #3002?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Doesn't look like we have a color base that works for all of us...

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's go, everyone! I'll do the re-touch in case your makeup slides off.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I know exactly which part of the face is the most fragile!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: You gotta put on the most suitable style even when you're giving out commands in the frontlines.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: These real battlefields give me so much more inspiration than any film set I've been to.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Bring your face closer this way, okay? Thanks. I'll pay attention to how much force I use.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Even the biggest stars out there gotta book me in advance, you know? You should count yourselves lucky!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Surface electrode tracking auto-filling concealer!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Infused Originium Slug acid styling spray!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Facial bone full structured self-image shading highlighter!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Wet/Dry ambient color adapted lipstick and blusher!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Whoa... Not even I can replicate that look on your face right now.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: What a perfect operation. Makes me want to add a few more touches to bring out that joy on your face.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: There's nothing as boring as watching the cowards run. They always stiffen up like Rock Spiders that've spent a bit too much time in antiseptics.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, need me to give your face a little blush? If you go back like this, the others might worry when they look at you.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Can I do my experiments here? Relax, I won't blow the walls out. At most... I guess the doors and windows might bend a little?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Didn't I say I'm not seeing anyone...? Oh, it's you.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, can I come over to your room this evening? Your face could really use a massage.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: New Year, new scenery! Doctor, this stack of paper... Oh, no, actually, all these papers are brand new looks I've been thinking up just for you... Hey! Why are you running away, Doctor?!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey, Doctor, want to try this new look I designed just for you?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Tons of celebrities in Wrankwood would ask me to do their makeup for their birthday parties. Cover every trace of time on their faces, no matter the cost. But is that really beauty? Doctor, this mirror's my gift to you. I hope you'll find a true and beautiful you staring back.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I've noticed a lot of operators and patients covering up their Originium crystals. That's not gonna cut it! I've got a plan: I'm going to design a whole set of patterns for decorating your crystals. That's the most meaningful thing I can do for Rhodes Island as a makeup artist!

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, where are you going? Shouldn't you be working? Lunch? Well then, I'm coming along. There's a few things I want to buy, and I can also keep a lookout for you.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, where are you going? Shouldn't you be working? Lunch? Well then, I'm coming along. There's a few things I want to buy, and I can also keep a lookout for you.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Sorry, Doctor, Rhodes Island is just a part-time job for me. I have to study hard to make sure I have a nice, normal future ahead of me. If you plan to have me aboard and on 24-hour call… Well, I'll have to ask you reconsider that.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Sorry, Doctor, Rhodes Island is just a part-time job for me. I have to study hard to make sure I have a nice, normal future ahead of me. If you plan to have me aboard and on 24-hour call… Well, I'll have to ask you reconsider that.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I color coded all the documents to be sent out, the backups have already been delivered, your schedule is right here. I bought your late night snack and put it in the refrigerator. Don't forget to heat it up. And last, oh, do you need me to change the light bulb in your office for you?

voices.title: Talk 2

Don't forget to heat it up. And last, oh, do you need me to change the light bulb in your office for you?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Did I ever tell you about my other job? No? Well, I won't. Don't look at me like that, Doctor. There's just not much to say. If my other office worked a tenth as hard as Rhodes Island does, they'd probably have become the only detective agency in Lungmen.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Did I ever tell you about my other job? No? Well, I won't. Don't look at me like that, Doctor. There's just not much to say. If my other office worked a tenth as hard as Rhodes Island does, they'd probably have become the only detective agency in Lungmen.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: You wonder where I learned martial arts? Well, I have my old codger and his weird education to thank for that. Not that I resent kung fu. Martial arts should always be a part of me if I hope to uphold justice.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: You wonder where I learned martial arts? Well, I have my nasty old dad and his weird education to thank for that. Not that I resent kung fu. A hero must uphold justice. Martial arts are a part of me.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Just like how people value morality, martial arts have yin and yang, right and wrong. To right those wrongs, to defeat evil, to counter bad kung fu, these are all second nature to me. The world is dark, and someone must stand for justice.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Just like how people value morality, martial arts have yin and yang, right and wrong. To right those wrongs, to defeat evil, to counter bad kung fu, these are all second nature to me. The world is dark, and someone must stand for justice.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You think you just saw me? In downtown Lungmen? That may have been me. I just finished class. Hm? You saw me beat down some thugs who were harassing a passerby? And then slipped away before the police arrived? Must have been someone else. Heh heh. Definitely. You were just seeing things, that's it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You think you just saw me? In downtown Lungmen? That may have been me. I just finished class. Hm? You saw me beat down some thugs who were harassing a passerby? And then slipped away before the police arrived? Must have been someone else. Heh heh. Definitely. You were just seeing things, that's it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: My rotten dad said he had to go find the true meaning of kung fu before he went off, and I still don't know where he is. Please! What year does he think it is? Find some common sense and learn some responsibility before you get yourself killed. But at least I haven't forgotten what he taught me: 'Martial arts have martial virtue, humans have human kindness.'

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, did any mail come for me? It did? Great. These are my grades... my very important grades! It's been straight A's for me, so far. If I don't work hard enough, I'll end up regretting all the things I wasn't strong enough to do.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, did any mail come for me? It did? Great. They included my grade report inside... I need them for a lot of things. It's been straight A's for me, so far. If I don't work hard enough, I'll end up regretting all the things I wasn't strong enough to do.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Falling asleep at a time like this... Oh well, I'll just finish your work for you.

voices.text: Is this Rhodes Island? Nice to meet you. I'm Waai Fu, your new part-timer. Please don't go easy on me. I can handle anything you ask of me. Yes, just give me the word.

voices.text: Thank you very much, Doctor. You placed your trust in me, and I won't let you down.
