voices.text: An ambush...?! ...Doctor, don't you ever sneak up on me like that again. Now let's get you to Medical first.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: An ambush...?! ...Doctor, don't you ever sneak up on me like that again. Now let's get you to Medical first.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You want to go for a walk? Sure, let's get going. It's safer to have me with you.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You want to go for a walk? Sure, let's get going. It's safer to have me with you.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, happy holidays. I—I was just taking a walk. I haven't had Hung's food in forever, so the moment I slip up... It really does take a strong will to resist temptation, I still need more training... Doctor, it's not too late yet. Let's go train together!

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, happy holidays. I—I was just taking a walk. I haven't had Hung's food in forever, so the moment I slip up... It really does take a strong will to resist temptation, I still need more training... Doctor, it's not too late yet. Let's go train together!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Care for some tea, Doctor?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Care for some tea, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday to you! Please, take this present. It's a wooden dummy. 'When seeking the way, the greatest fear is to have no master nor opponent,' so to us who wish to be martial artists, it's both an opponent and a master. Alright, let me teach you how to train with it!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, happy birthday to you! Please, take this present. It's a wooden dummy. 'When seeking the way, the greatest fear is to have no master nor opponent,' so to us who wish to be martial artists, it's both an opponent and a master. Alright, let me teach you how to train with it!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Working for Rhodes Island has been valuable practical experience for me. I've learned a great deal. But I think I need more experience still, before I can decide whether or not I should stay. Whatever the future brings, I believe you and I are fighting for justice.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Working for Rhodes Island has been valuable practical experience for me. I've learned a great deal. But I think I need more experience still, before I can decide whether or not I should stay. Whatever the future brings, I believe you and I are fighting for justice.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Nah-ah, keep those documents away from me... I go all vertigo when I see too much text. Don't even think of making me help you on the paper work, Doctor, I'm just gonna stand here nice and good.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Armor paint? It's gotta be gold. I love gold. It's the color of lightning, and when they say things are fast as lightning, that's fast!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: For combat, I got my own way of doing things. If you want 'em to respect you, just beat 'em down. If you want 'em to listen to you, go for a round, and let 'em know they could never ever win.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Armorless Union assassins, Nearl family knights, the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub... how's Rhodes Island hold all of them together? Your recruiting standards are mad out of sight.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I‘ve been honing myself into a campaign knight since childhood. That's how I've learnt all my combat skills. But after I got infected…pssh, I still wanna be a 'knight.' If winning fights is the way to prove myself, then I'll win every fight to show'em all.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Sometimes I don't really get what Sona says, yet I still believe she'll lead us to do right and proper. She's changing and improving herself to adapt, so maybe I'll try working on my own faults too. But, that doesn't mean I'm gonna take up everything she says, haha.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: When Justyna says things, her first sentence is the most important part! But if you don't listen to what comes after, you don't get what the first sentence was about. Good thing I'm already used to that, so I can grasp her point nice and clear.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Justice Knight's my pet. I got people to give her a bunch of functions, so she's got the chops to do it all at least a little. Yeah, she's a real doer!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I made the title 'Wild Mane' renowned through my own hard work. It's the symbol of a Knight as strong as hell, and an Infected Knight even. However, the General Chamber of Commerce takes our lives and our glory no more than products and consumables. Tch. Sucks I can't pound their masks to pieces right damned now.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Man, I'm so bored... hey, let's go for a drink. It's always Ashley who drinks with me, and that's just dull.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Wild Mane' Iwona, I'm a Knight from Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub. Sona says this place does good by the Infected? Sounds cool.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Ooh... that's a sick surprise attack to make! Can we rewind that and watch it again?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A promotion? Then you can tell I've gotten stronger? Haha, fine by me, gimme a few more!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Those hypocrites, wearing hollow masks and treading on the Infected as they want. Screw them, my lance is gonna run them all through!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Who's got the guts to spar with me?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Phalanx formation suits me most. If I'm the captain, then let's go with my kind of tactics!

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Let's roooooll!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Haha, I got you sighted.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Leave the brawling to me.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I've been waiting forever!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: You guys think you're worth my full strength?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Don't you dare go down in one!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Slow! Slow! Way too slow!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Haha, you're not dodging this!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Lance charge!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Piercing through!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Keep on winning, and you'll never be forgotten. It's that simple.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Cheers, Doctor. You're a solid commander.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: My Major Lance... *sigh* Gotta get repairs again.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Leave any regrets for later! Go, I'll cover the rear!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Any rooms in all gold around here? Just a little dream of mine.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: What, you wanna have a race with me?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Skirts? Nuh-uh. I don't wear 'em 'cept for special days.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Haha, just bought some confetti cannons from the stand over there. Sparking Golden ones, of course, to suit the day best! The instructions here... Gah, never mind, I'm not reading through this wordy crap. Here, Doctor, hold this one in your hand and I'll count to three. Three! Two! One— What the...? Where's the BOOM?  Production date, you say? ... EIGHT YEARS AGO?! Where's that stand owner? He'd better be gone for REAL!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Ready for the day, Doctor? Wanna try some breakfast from the Justice Knight?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here, your birthday present, you're gonna love it for sure! Last time when Sona and the rest unpacked my gifts, I could tell they were trying hard to keep a calm face just because they could barely contain their excitement inside! C'mon now, this time I wanna see YOUR reaction— Surprise! Did you guess it? A pair of lightning-patterned socks! Cool, isn't it?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I only agreed to move with the others to Rhodes Island at first because it was Sona's idea. I may not have her perception and capability, but one day people will come to realize I'm doing more than just proving my strength, that I'm giving my all so that people can look at us infected with unbiased eyes.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, Dr. Kal'tsit sent me to take a blood sample from you. We can chat as I'm getting the needle ready.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Can I control the urge to feed, you ask? How dare you underestimate me! I'm a trained professional. Of course I can tell patients from food!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: It's my job to track blood indicators for all our operators, even if they aren't exactly happy about it—huh...? These blood bags? They're samples, of course! What were you thinking!?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: There's another one of my kind here. And she's an... engineer? Hm…maybe she likes the smell of machine oil more than blood?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Why I chose to become a doctor? I can't say it was any sort of lofty calling. It's just that, you know, OUR kind... we don't exactly have the brightest prospects. But it turned out my skills were actually in surprisingly high demand, so... I just went with the flow.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: How do we fight the urge to feed? We actually have a course that helps us control our desires. And we've invented artificial blood, so we drink that if we need. We can be very resourceful, you know.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: This is the standard procedure. It's the same for everyone getting blood drawn. Don't move, Doctor. Ah... blood... your blood... it smells delicious... It's just… it's just… captivating...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Replenishing saline solution! Changing filters! Sterilizing sand and charcoal canisters... all done! Doctor, you'd better keep your medical supplies well-maintained. As Dr. Kal'tsit said, when your kidneys give out, these machines are going to save your life... aw, come on, just kidding.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Fine, fine, I'll come clean... I have tasted lots of blood of many different types from all different races. And I do enjoy the subtle differences in flavor, okay? In fact, the only type of blood I've never tasted is... yours, Doctor. Heheh...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Hm? So you still have time to sleep? I'm jealous.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I am Warfarin, the blood-scientist-slash-doctor. Besides typical healing Arts, I also bring you specialized medical treatments, courtesy of my remarkable expertise in hematology and plentiful experience. Anyway, look forward to working with you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Hm, my work efficiency seems to have improved.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Are you even listening? We're having trouble collecting rare blood types for the emergency blood bank. So—what? What did you say? A promotion? Now?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: This only means more work for me, right? Ha, I saw that a mile away! I'm an expert in this field after all. Don't worry, I am well prepared!

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Wait, I need to prepare my equipment first.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: A leader reports only to you, right?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: My equipment is ready. We can start any time.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I don't have the leisure for enemy intel at the moment. Taking care of our operators has already occupied my whole schedule...

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Go ahead.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Medical equipment set.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Call for help immediately if you're injured!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Commence treatment.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Ready for blood transfusion!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Get the hemostat!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: First aid here, take it!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I'll be right there!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: It's really nerve-wracking being in the medic squad. Support troops are really under lots of pressure! Good thing I'm already used to it.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: The battlefield is a place of tragedy. I hope they come to understand this one day.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Forget about those fleeing enemies at the moment, our priority now is to help the injured.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I am sorry, we've even ran out reserve medicine…

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I guess I'm more accustomed to figuring things out myself...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Huh? What are you doing?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, isn't it almost time for your annual checkup?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: New Year's? My, the moment I turn around, another year passes. Time really does fly fast... Anyway, did you come on your own, Doctor? All alone? Good. And did you run into any other operators on the way...? That makes this easy, Doctor, let's test your blood. Oh, settle down, I'm just joking.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Apparently this confection is popular in Higashi. You get strawberry juice in a plasma bag with an IV drip as a straw, and the sensation of drinking it is macabre but completely novel! Want one, Doctor? What are you sniffing it so hard for? It's just strawberry, of course it is! There's no weird additives in it at all!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Look at how spry and active they all are. If only they could come back from field missions just as lively. It's a doctor's lot to worry, but some operators really don't know to cherish themselves. They don't fear me, so they don't listen. Maybe this calls for me to be a little more fearsome, like, Kal'tsit-style?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I've arranged the incoming documents just the way you like them, and added a few labels for categorization. Feel free to use them to find what you need. If only my master was so organized... Oh, it's nothing, just an idle musing.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Wait, there's a bug on your collar. Don't worry, it's a green lacewing, a helpful sort. They hunt the pests that eat our crops. Look at the wings on this cute little guy, the color of jade. Really beautiful... My master always jokes that if I didn't become a farmer, I could've been an entomologist.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Low clouds bring rain, high clouds bring fair skies.' See that cloud down by the horizon? That's a cumulus... The proverbs may not always be right, but they do have reference value. Using that one, you predict that tomorrow will be clear, but with strong winds and lightning? You might be a Catastrophologist, but just how did you come to that conclusion?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I've read that 'Tianshi' means 'to be a role model for the generations to come, and to search for perpetual truth.' I used to think I could never live up to that, but after seeing some of my seniors befuddled from time to time... Maybe I've been overthinking it. There may be a saying more suitable for me: 'Focus on your search, and learn for the sake of the people'.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I once challenged myself to a fast, but I ended up fainting on the fourth day. Still, my master said this was not true hunger. I didn't know what it was like to go hungry for years on end, so I could not possibly understand. I hope there comes a time when no one has to know that feeling.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I've gotten tanned again, you say? No big deal, every farmer worth his salt ends up dark as a chestnut. So long as we accomplish our goal, so long as we see our  crops prosper in the contaminated soil, and the hard work of so many bears fruit, then it's all good. Me? I don't need to be there to see it. If the people keep walking the right path, that's enough for me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Oh, did you need me for something? Just a second, I need to braid my hair again. When I was younger, I grew out this 'rice stalk braid' as a prayer for peace. Now I spend a lot of time managing it every day. Back then, Grain Buds always thought I was a girl thanks to this braid...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The crops grown in Dahuang have a much better texture and taste than others. If you get a chance, I'd love to show you about the city. You wonder if they could supply Rhodes Island with food? Um, that's a little... I-I'm afraid that you'll need to discuss that with the proper authorities. It's not up to me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: These seeds occasionally fall onto the ship. Oftentimes I gather them up and wait like this on the solid ground, closing my eyes and feeling which way the wind is blowing. There, once the breeze rises, I let them go, and those seeds find someplace to take root all on their own.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: The wind rises...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Why am I called 'Wanqing'? It's one of the breeds of rice that my master cultivated in Dahuang. Others include Fanglao #3, the waterlogging-resilient one, Zaoyou #8, the quick-ripening one, and Kangdong #11, the frost-resistant one... 'Wanqing' means wide, and it sounds the most like a proper name.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Everyone looks so well-mannered around here, it's hard to imagine that they're so fierce in battle...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: The rating standards of the Tianshi Bureaus seem to stipulate that you can use evaluations from exchange visits in their assessments... Excuse me Doctor, is Rhodes Island able to provide an officially-stamped study visit certificate?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I've consulted with my master. As long as Rhodes Island agrees to sign a contract of cooperation with the Tianshi Bureaus, I'll get to offer my assistance as an advisor on experimental crop fields. We both do what we can for the sake of the many, and we'd be delighted to support your goals.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Initial environmental survey completed. Nothing abnormal. We're good to go.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I hope everyone takes my commands seriously. Let’s get this done right.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: If we cross any farmland, watch where you step.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I'm a student of the Tianshi Bureaus. I won't hold you back.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Here! Er, I mean I'm in position.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Tell me what you require, and I will deliver.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I've finished construction of the refinement system. Deployment point confirmed.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: We're in a complex environment. Don't go off on your own or you might get disoriented.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: With the aid of the wind, we too can soar through the skies.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Watch your step, don't hurt the crops.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: The landscape here is tricky. Only step where I step.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Until we can confirm that this area is safe, I will hold this position.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Ensuring the harvest isn't easy. I hope to pass on the torch of our ideals.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Just as the farms never rest, there will always be new growth from the ground, and there will always be those who wish to follow in our footsteps.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Let's try that one again. The tiniest oversight leads to different experimental outcomes, and you can't let an error cloud your conclusions.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Success is the fruit of a thousand failures. Experiments under the Tianshi Bureaus are the same. Don't be discouraged, Doctor.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Ever since I got here, there haven't been any leftovers? Of course. Waste not, want not.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Who—Ah, my braid hit you? I am truly sorry...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I reassemble my Tianshi apparatus while I wait for my experiments to finish. My record is twelve seconds. Would you like to try?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: The poems I read when I was little always compared winter snow to a thick blanket. The seedlings sleep beneath the snows, ready to welcome the spring days with new life. Dahuang is always busy this time of year. People my age go to the frozen rivers and throw firecrackers at the frost while covering their ears. Grain Buds always shouts the loudest. Would you like to give it a try?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, I'm pretty sure I heard this cactus say 'I was already watered yesterday—'.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Well, since it's your birthday, I have no choice. I'll stand to the side and watch. You'll want to keep your lower body firmly planted. If you're unfamiliar with a Tianshi apparatus, you could very easily get pulled into the air by the kite, so keep your center of gravity low... Oh, you've flown off already...

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: At first I didn't really understand why my master wanted me to go on a study visit to a pharmaceutical company. But after spending all this time here, I've come to realize that you're all just like the people of Dahuang. They are fighting to provide for the countless people of this land who cannot provide for themselves. We walk the same path.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, since you've decided to join our voyage, you'll need to contribute. Think you can handle steering the ship? Here's the wheel: turn right to go right, turn left to go left. Clear? Very good. Let's set sail. Joking? No, I'm dead serious.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Here's your hammock, Doctor. The seas have been gentle these past two days, rocking like a cradle. But when the wind rises and waves swell, sleep won't come so easily. So I've brought you this bucket, use it if seasickness strikes. Just be sure to aim well; our cleaning crew won't take kindly to a messy deck.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, I'll be occupied with my alchemical research. Can you helm the ship in my absence? No, not a word to the crew. My last experiment, while successful in improving engine efficiency, left our hull compromised. The crew wasn't pleased. At the celebration banquet that followed... They voted to hang me from the mast the entire night.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: These silvery liquid orbs, 'Corazonix', now form my right arm. They convey to me the movement of all things: the wind, the waves, fin-schools... and even the subtle currents of blood within the human body. That sensation... is as if I am merging with the very pulse of all existence.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: People forge connections by accepting fragments of others into themselves. That's what my maestro once said. He came from the Church of the Deep, so I initially misinterpreted his words. But in truth, his meaning was profound: we enter life as hollow vessels; we are incomplete until shaped by communication and shared understanding.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: In the past, I could only answer your questions about Iberia through second-hand stories. The glory of its past and the desolation of its present have never stirred any sense of belonging in me—Rather, its future is what I yearn to shape. With this ship as my lodestar, I shall forge my own narrative for Iberia.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: We're about to run out of provisions, so I'm taking the dinghy out to go fincatching. Care to join me, Doctor? Use a fishing rod? No, too inefficient. It's better to dive straight into the ocean, and hurl fins aboard with Destreza. Not a swing wasted.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The ship's now entering the eye of the storm! Hard to port! Steady, sailors! Don't panic, Doctor. I hold these raging tides in the palm of my hand. I promise you won't be swept overboard. Oh, sorry. Didn't expect you to get all soaked…

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Oh, Doctor. How did you find this sanctuary? Me...? When the crew gets too rowdy, I retreat here for some peace and quiet. Isn't it strange? Out here, where the only sound is the wind and the waves, I somehow hear the echoes of voices from Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Asleep already? I never expected you to adapt to the rocking waves so quickly... Though, I've heard that people find rest where they feel secure.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor, welcome to la Cuna de Nene. I... am her captain. Ahem... The name wasn't my idea. We let the First Mate's pet draw the name stripes.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Is this footage from my previous missions? You actually brought it aboard... That move was full of openings. It clearly wasn't properly calculated.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: A gift to celebrate my promotion to captain? That happened a long time ago, though. Why bring it up now, Doctor?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Congratulations, Doctor. In recognition of your exceptional service aboard, and the profound bond you've forged with the First Mate's pet, the crew and I have voted unanimously to promote you to the distinguished rank of Senior Groomer.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Doctor, take the helm for now. This will be a tough battle, and my crew needs me to fight shoulder-to-shoulder with them.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Give me your orders like before, Doctor. I will follow them.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Hoist the flag, sailors! Tell the enemies, we are here.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Starboard stern, batteries ready! All hands, prepare to fire!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I can hold here myself. I know what to do.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Please help me, Doctor.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Once the wind fills our sails, it's time to act.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I hear the waves drumming against the hull. They herald our victory.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Probes, functional. Corazonix... Good to go.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Clear images... Hmph, check the data.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Not bad... Reasonable data. Try processing it.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Is it correct? Or not quite... Whatever, let's have a go.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: A truly resounding victory. Let us bask in the cheers of this moment.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: What we just encountered is but a minor hiccup before lengthy voyage. Cheer up, Doctor. Far greater trials await us ahead.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: There's no need to pursue a spent force. Let's return to the ship.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Turn downwind and set full sail! We must get clear of this region immediately!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Why the surprised look? Even a captain isn't exempt from cleaning duties. Could you pass me the mop? I need to finish before dark. Thanks, Doctor.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: They sense you coming, Doctor.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: My braid's come undone, will you help me?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Seeing how ecstatic the crew is tonight, I doubt the rum in our hold will last through the night. Oh, I must remind you, Doctor. When the revelry begins, keep clear of the railings. We can't risk a tipsy Doctor going overboard. Ah, why am I even concerned...? Ahem, just, uh, trust me on this one.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. We are sailing towards the rising sun.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Today's your birthday, Doctor? After drifting on the seas for so long, my chronometer might be a bit fuzzy, despite my best efforts to keep it calibrated. Ah, look, migrating fins swimming beneath our hull... Fascinating, isn't it? Individually distinct, yet moving in such sublime harmony.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Back then, Doctor, I was still aboard YOUR ship... I once considered dropping the anchor, ending my life of wandering, to settle on Rhodes Island. But no one can stay in one place forever, and every journey has its end. What truly matters is that we have each other in this moment.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I have some free time, so I guess I could help you out... What's this? This has got nothing to do with disasters and Arts, just some normal paperwork? Hey!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You wanna try some fortune-telling? Well, that brings me back. I haven't done it for a while. I could take a look at your fortune to kill some time, I guess. Hmm, if your luck isn't beyond words as always... Well, you're gonna have to prove my results wrong.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I do research on Arts because it's part of my responsibilities as a Caster. If I can't even do that, how am I supposed to protect those who... Huh? You got sweets? For me? Uh, thanks...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Hibiscus... My sister always helps people whenever they need, even if it's not part of her mission. It's like she's not a Sarkaz at all, what with how kind she is. She treats this world with kindness, but how many people know to repay it?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Why I'm not into fortune telling anymore? 'cause the fear and curiosity that people have about the future usually has to do with natural phenomena. That, and I've realized the results you get with fortune telling don't really mean much, having come face to face with so many cruelties.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: In terms of performance, books and staffs are just about the same as Arts conductors. If you ask me, I think knives are much more practical. When you run short of your Arts and have to throw yourself into a melee, or you're out in the wilderness, just trying to survive, all those words in the books aren't going to do you much good.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: It's a pain to fight as a team, but when I look back on those times I fought side by side with my Reserve Ops teammates now... It brings back memories, I guess. If I get the chance to fight alongside them again... No, never mind.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I wasn't that grumpy and curt now, was I? How come Hibiscus still treats me like a kid who hasn't grown up yet? It's like she's doing it to pick on me! We finally managed to make up, but it just ticks me off when I see her act so calm about it!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The times we live in are so messed up, there's just way too much malevolence going around in this world. We have to change that. I can't stand all those rotten hypocrites acting all kindhearted treating my fellow Sarkaz like that... just because of who we are.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Sheesh... You always look so peaceful in your sleep.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hey, what's the big idea? Who let you come in without knock—Oh, it's you, Doctor. Why am I wearing this? Well... I'm hitting the training grounds to test my limits once more. Wanna come watch, Doctor?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I got it all down.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: There are lots of talented Casters out there, but I'm not so lucky. That's why I have to get stronger if I want to be able to save the world. Thanks for helping me out, Doctor.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I've got the hang of fire Arts now. If I keep working on this, I might just make it to the boundaries of modern Arts theory... I might even be able to manipulate space and matter.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I've got a good idea of the enemy's weaknesses. Let's go.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm not good at this kinda stuff... Just gotta get this over with quickly, right?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: I'm counting on you to have my back while I take care of the enemies.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: You've strayed from the path of righteousness. Your sinful souls deserve no mercy.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: No time to hesitate.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: It's time!

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Let's get this started.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Prepare to cast.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Hah!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Tear them apart!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Too weak. There's no point in hiding!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Your tricks won't work here!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: It's only by overcoming challenges that we manage to accomplish something.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Hmph... Accept your defeat in pain and fear. Evil will always be defeated.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: This shows how powerful we are now. It's far from enough, though. I know I can do better than this. I have to do better.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Gah... I gotta... eradicate all evil...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I still have lots to do. Let me stay here.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: D-Don't pat my head!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: I'm reading. There's still a lot I need to learn... It's time for tea already? Let's get going, then.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Helped yourself with the desserts there, Doctor? You can't run for the hills on an empty belly, and we need sugar to replenish ourselves. Why run for the hills, you ask? See that ominous red tint looking over here from the corridor? If you don't want to get caught and tortured with crap movies, you need to move your legs fast!

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Morning, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: You've already been waiting here? Tch, you got me this time. Anyway, you can thank me for the present later, for I have something to show you, so quiet now. Just to let you know, we fortunetellers have found a way to boost one's luck. And look no further for its inventor because she's standing right before you. I see... I see... See that? My divination says you'll get even cooler in the future. Also, Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Where are we making our next stop? Seems the truth of this world always extends far beyond the catastrophes we've learned from papers, just as this dagger in my hand turns out to be more helpful than those words in the books. One day, after I've turned the last page of them, I'll be out there, finding out the truth myself.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: There's a lot more I can do for you now—more than secretarial work. I won't be opposed to fighting anymore. But still, to be here, writing for you, is... a great honor of mine.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: What would you like to ask? Maybe you want to know—how much power Dublinn has... no? Oh, just how I'm personally doing? I'm still no more than a shadow, but—not my sister's. Dublinn's flame is lit by so many people, so many ideals, and the shadow cast by that firelight—that is what I am now.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: It's getting dark. Around this hour, there'd be people walking leisurely along the grey pavements, perhaps fowlbeasts gathering by the ponds—that is the Tara I remember. It's no special thing, but neither has it truly existed before. Doctor, I believe everyone should have a home to welcome them back.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I can't make myself out to be a comrade of yours—there are some by your side that surely hate me. But—once Dublinn no longer needs these raging, burning flames, then I'll come back here... I want to come back here.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: In my spare time? I still like prose, and poetry, both reading and writing... and I like to hear others sing. I know a few folk songs—very pretty ones, but no record has been made of them. Doctor, Have you ever heard, how the stems of reeds can be used as whistles? Yes, the reeds that would burn away at the brush of a flame.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Once you've caught Oripathy, living can become very painful... Do I resent it? No, I just used to not understand... life is so fragile, so much is ready to steal it away, yet we were meant to withstand that—to resist each and every trouble? But now... I can see you fight not just to resist—you fight to give people back their lives.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Do not fear, but do not disregard. Be light, be gentle... that is how you touch another. I remember learning this from you, Doctor, and it ensures my flames won't turn others to ash. Don't worry, I can bear the pain that accompanies. My fire won't die out.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Many prophecies say similar things—'it is the Draco's nature to fight.' I won't stand for that. But—if my sister stays blind to what will become of the land, once blanketed by the fires of death... then I will stop her. I know what kind of Leader the people put their hopes in—and that's not what she is.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: My mind's not at peace, Doctor. Is my every choice truly right? Their lives stoke our flames in the night. Yet in the end, if they fail to burn through the darkness... No, why should their lives even be mine to dictate...? But still, I will walk on. Now I bear a duty, and I will walk on.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Not a word needed... It's always so tranquil, by your side.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I know—you'll have many new questions for me, about my identity, about my goals... but—I am still the same Reed.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: No matter how many times, you'll still choose to fight like this...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: What is it you seek, from those who earn this medal? Tell me more about your dreams.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Upon the damp soil, there struggles life after life. While my flame does not yet die, I will reach them—I will.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I understand the objective you've set.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You fight not by my will, but yours. You choose to be warriors. So I will stand with you, shoulder to shoulder.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: What blocks the way, I will burn through.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: It is your tyrannies that fuel this flame.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Where do you wish to go?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: I'm prepared to fight.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Please, trust in me.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Your lives are mine to protect.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Your lives, now ignited.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: This endless burn, you needn't bear.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Fear not the firelight.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I am Dublinn.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: In honesty, it's hard to even tell whether your battles are victories, given your dreams still lie so far, far away. But at times like these, it strikes me—perhaps we may all see the day, when peace comes.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: To drive them away with fire is easily done. But—if we're to ensure they'll never come back to hurt us, then a fire is not enough.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Did they flee? I have no hate for those who do—but here on the battlefield, I will pursue them.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: The pain of burning, I can bear much more of. Just—don't let anyone else—disappear to the flames again...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: I remember how I hid away in the ship's cabins. I miss those days.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: ...I still burn hot, don't I?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: The poems I've transcribed? I can read them to you, if you're interested. It's okay if you don't understand Taran—perhaps you'll still feel the emotions' touch.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Can I sit here, and watch the flames? Mm, I'm not here to celebrate this day, not at all... but—hearing the bells echo through the wilds, it makes me glad for the firelight, on this night.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Ah, Doctor. Yes, some things never change.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: You read the poem I left in your gift...? To tell the truth, it wasn't written for this day. It's just—last night, while wrapping your present, the perfect rhyme suddenly came to me.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: You and I are different. Dublinn is a dream that took shape long ago, long before it found itself in me. But Rhodes Island—you take something so hard to envision, and convince people to believe in it. You are what saved me, and I will always remember that.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: We'll be alright without sorting these files, won't we? Then you can lie down and sleep for a bit longer. It's good for your health. At least you can get rid of those bags under your eyes.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Got a heap of useful info from our mission in Yan this time. It's all written up in a report, submitted and filed. Come on, Doctor, I'm not a reserve op anymore. I can pull up my socks and write a report start to finish, easy enough.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: At the end of the day, the best thing to do with apples is munch them outright, or bake them into pies so you can share with everyone—it's too wasteful using them as targets. And if you just want to split one in two, you're better off with a kitchen knife.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I've got a bucketload of magic tricks to bring friends closer. The 'marathon alarms,' the 'invisible warning tape,' the 'hollow cake,' they're all brilliant. Which ones do you fancy learning, Doctor?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm awake, Doctor. I'm not like I was then—it's not that easy to sleep even if I want to. So where do you need me? Any field missions? Maybe instructing the reserve ops?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Accidents always happen too quickly. Quicker than a bolt flies, even. And I can never react in time. And then I just watch things happen one after another, and... Sigh, it'd be nice if I could see things coming a mile away like you, Doctor. At least, when it comes to preparing, I've got confidence I don't botch anything.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor, don't tiptoe behind me again! I know when you're close up most times, but on the off-chance you sneak a bit too well, I might just give you a bad scare out of reflex.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: We all came out of that fight in Rim Billiton a bit more grown up, but... *exhale*... It'd be nice if getting better didn't come with a cost, you know...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: There's no place you can escape to, and no dreams you don't wake up from. When we face something terrible, we can only choose to give it our all, hard as we can. Might leave a sting or an ache, but at the very least, you won't carry that regret all your life.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You know, it's a happy thing to fall asleep like that.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hi-hiii~! Doctor! I'm back! Haven't got caught up in hassle lately, have you? Haha, that's good. Right, I'm heading back to my room to rest up. If there's anything you want dealing with, remember to give me a shout.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Some still fight the same as ever. It's nice to see.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I've gotten these badges how many times now? But whenever hand me one, Doctor, I'm as happy as could be.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Once you raise your crossbow, the only things left swimming in your eyes are your sight and your target. But before you pull the trigger, there's so much you've got to think about... I won't be careless or neglectful ever again.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Hi, everyone! I'm here to slack off~

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Alright, time to assign the tasks.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: We're heading out. Remember, mind your cover.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Relax, the targets aren't that bad.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Go ahead, I'm all ready and set.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Oh? Is it my turn?

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Shh, don't make any more noise.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: On alert.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Where d'you think you're going?

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Here I am.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Stand still.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Bye byeeee~

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: That's spot-on work. Have a rest, Doctor, I'll keep a watch on the follow-up.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: So long as it turns out well, a little pain's no big problem.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: They won't be much threat. Do you want me to catch up with them?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Orderly retreat! Don't panic!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This place is nice! Maybe I can find some beauty sleep in here.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Heheh.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Not that way, Doctor. I've left an extra-special 'surprise' for my friends over there!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year! Mmh, that's my greeting in. I'm going back to rest now. You too as soon as you can, Doctor. You have to unwind on your days off~

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Yaaawn... good morning~

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I've left your prezzie in your bag. What, been forever since my last prank? I suppose it has been. We've known each other for so long, you've seen practically every trick I have in the book. Or perhaps you're saying you miss that sometimes? Well, I can indulge you.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I'd say the meat roll Lava brought out for this year's dinner party was extra tasty! But the caramel pudding wasn't sweet as last year's. Come to mention, still nothing's beating that light show Closure put on three years ago. You bet, Doctor, I remember them all.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, if you want me to talk to you, then at leaaast give me some topics I can show interest in.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, don't blame me for having no interest in your grand endeavors. To be honest, the reason I became an Abyssal Hunter is hardly as lofty as you imagine. Abyssal Hunters bear a grave mission, but me? I just think the life suits me more, that's all.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: You want to know about my life in Ægir...? After so much time, my childhood memories are a bit of a blur. Maybe I'll remember a thing or two by telling you about it. Originally, I was meant to be a sculptor...

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: My combat style shows no restraint compared to the past? Doctor, I think you might be misunderstanding me. If you call me mad, I'll take it as an insult. But if you call my combat style mad... I'll take that as a commendation.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Hark... to the boundless master of all creation, embraced by darkness, murmuring soliloquy... Let me take a stab, Doctor. Maybe you like the old me rather more than the present me? I'll be honest, I've got a soft spot for that me too. It's nice to be so pure, isn't it?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, you always worry so much. Do something for me, tear this sheet up, yes, just like that. Sometimes, things aren't so complicated. Survival is splitting everything in your way in two. It's just that simple.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: *Sigh* Doctor, I'm dying to get you visiting our city. That's the only way you can understand how tender my comment is on the life quality of Rhodes Island. It's a shame your body'd be too delicate for it. All the more shame I don't even know whether our city still exists.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Even if I've got a list of gripes about Rhodes Island, you people haven't abandoned the collection and preservation of art. I can retract all my criticisms just for that. Doctor, forget your job for a moment. This, is a work you shouldn't miss, not in a lifetime.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You want to hear me sing? Of course I can indulge you. But I'm so sorry, singing has a special significance to us that you just can't share, not being one of us. Doctor, Doctor, it vexes me that I have so many things I want to share with you. Just how could I convey them to you?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: May you too stay lucid in your dreams.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: I recognize you, and you recognize me. We don't need all those boring introductions. But you still don't know me, and I still don't know you. If I recall correctly, dry-landers use simple enough means to get to know each other, so let's get communicating.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Are you trying to tell me… my combat style should be more 'fit-in?'

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: For politeness's sake, I accept your commendation. But, to us Abyssal Hunters, combat is the means we have to master to survive. We don't need applause or flowers for it.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: You chose a dangerous way to learn of the Abyssal Hunters and our enemies, Doctor. With nothing but your delicate body, the tides will drown you. But at the same time, you can count your lucky stars, because I invite you to hide behind me.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Shall the hunt begin?

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Just let me think, whether you are here to help, or to trouble me like a whelp.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: It's high tide.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The time for fun has now begun.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: My patience is limited, Doctor.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Waiting is its own art, too.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Every battle deserves to be enjoyed.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I'm in a... gorgeous mood right now!

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Good morning.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Good night.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I'm not yet satisfied.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Come, more, more!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: We might not define danger the same way, but I'm willing to respect the genuine joy of others.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Do we have a ballad of victory? Yes, but not now. We're still a long way from true victory, aren't we?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Incompletion has its own beauty. That's how you're comforting yourself, isn't it?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I'm to blame too for placing my trust in you. But don't worry, I'll bear the responsibility together with you.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: You want to hear my opinion of this landship? You'll be disappointed.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh? I knew it was you.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You've got a strong hunger for knowledge, but it lacks direction at times, Doctor.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: A New Year's feast? Your desire for seeking joy in suffering is truly admirable... Of course I'll join. When on land, do as the landwalkers do, no? I'll see you then, Doctor. Happy New Year, and here's to death come closer to us still.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: I hope you have a meaningful day today, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I heard today was your birthday. I support chasing all sense of ceremony, even if it's not going to mean anything. So, happy birthday, Doctor, and congratulations on notching up another year of suffering.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I can sense that the madness which used to bind me is slightly different to the Oripathy you're attempting to overcome... and what's interesting is, even having the knowledge I do, I can't give a clear solution. On that exploratory note, at least, I'm prepared to work with you all.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: The files that needed sorting have all been put away. I hope it'll help reduce some of your pressure, Doctor.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: The atmosphere in here is duly soothing, much like my mountain forest. Doctor, you're free to come play when you're not busy.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I've talked a lot with the Medical Department's operators, and now I can understand what everyone's goal is. Doctor, allow me to rescue this land together with you.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: This herbal pill... it's fine work. Myrrh's combined the properties of the medicinals and processed them in a special way. Hmm... I've never attempted such a manner of processing myself. In a little while, I'll see about learning from Myrrh.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Aid and sanctuary are unalike. The former cures the body, the latter saves the soul.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: To live is an endless cycle, reaping what one sows, all beings beholden to this. I imagine you can understand, having been through so much. Leaving your own memories behind in a different incarnation, constructing your own view of the outside world; that is the purpose of this life.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: These pills have not just the aroma of tea, but all sorts of flowers too. Many patients consider herbal pills bitter, so I've put my mind to diminishing that bitterness. I hope... the people of Rhodes Island won't dislike this flavor.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I very much agree with the tea here, its aroma calm, its true flavor apparent. As with tea, so with man. In this dwelling, those irrelevant rumors can be kept away; it's a rare place of respite.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, the operators can have the dishes labelled with my name to eat, as well as some bottles of drinks I made myself. Everyone's been to truly tiresome lengths as of recent, and I wanted to do a thing or two to help alleviate their fatigue...

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Are you tired? Rest well for a while. Don't worry; I'll protect you.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: It's nice to meet you; I'm Nine-Colored Deer. Hm? Are these motifs so beautiful? Th-Thank you... please, observe them as you like.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: May I go with you next time? I want to ensure everyone's safety.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: You've endorsed me? So I have been of help to you, then. Wonderful...

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: The things I've learned may save many, but there remain yet more in need of aid. Doctor, can I still be more powerful than I am now?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Worry not, I won't betray your trust.
