If you wanted a springboard for your ideas, I suggest referencing these two papers. I've added some of my own commentary, so feel free to look it over.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Mmm~I smell whipped cream. Look, the lambs have started their picnic over there. Care to join them with me, Professor?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: The little lamb didn't go away even after the volcano erupted. It's actually been staying with me the whole time, and sometimes gets into trouble. H-Hey, you can't go standing on the Doctor's head! That's terribly rude! Sorry, Professor. Um, Can you see the little lamb? It's right here, hand to the right, and then down a little. Yeah, you're petting it right now.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Professor, would you like to try this cupcake I made? It's got a small piece of berry, some cream I scooped from a bigger cake, and the plate is a vine leaf… Why is there a lamb hiding in your hood...? This must be one of Dolly's pranks.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: This coat was Mom's old protective gear. Professor Keller once told me, this mark came from a sudden burst of magma. It almost left a scar on her, but Mom just laughed, saying she had good luck. If I were to go on an expedition with her, I'd probably need to be the one to lead.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: What do you think of my dress, Professor? Is the ribbon tied right? The lambs invited me to a party, but all they gave me to wear was a big ball of wool! Rather naughty of them, don't you think? It's been so long since I danced in a dress. I'm worried I might have some trouble. Would you mind practicing with me?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Shh. Here, Professor, I snuck these over! I saw it all – you were muttering about how badly you wanted some snacks earlier, right? I've actually gotten pretty good at reading lips. Not to brag, but I might be better than Rhodes Island's intelligence agents by now. But, just maybe.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Hm? What was that, Professor? Sorry, I didn't quite catch that, please wait a second... My, how did this wool get in my ear? It must have slipped when I was playing hide-and-seek with the lambs! Go ahead, Professor, I can hear you now.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm getting ready to head out, Professor. Another volcano is about to become active. While luck is still on my side, I need to go a bit farther, a bit deeper. I want to wear the brightly-colored ornaments, and get to the truth in the hot magma, just like Mom and Dad did.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: We've come pretty far, haven't we, Professor? A little fowlbeast brought me a rock from an acid lake. A little musbeast led me across an ocean of pink. And I even went aboard a great ship made of love and warmth. With these treasures, I don't feel at all lonely.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Professor, in a few days, I'll be going to Leithanien to attend a press conference and the premiere of my documentary. Our research is too obscure for the ordinary people who want to learn about volcanoes. But I still hope that one day, I can use this method to show everyone the beauty of volcanoes.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Do you like this cake, Professor? It's not just a regular cake. The base is made of love and dedication. The cream is distilled from our adventures. Various emotions are sprinkled as a finishing touch. And I've placed it in a box made of memories. It took me a long time to learn to bake a cake like this, Professor. I hope you'll remember the taste forever.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Frostleaf has been going to Mousse's book club a lot these days. Earthspirit and Provence have been trekking far and wide. I've been exploring more volcanoes... Professor, I still remember those early days, when Mousse was so nervous she couldn't even talk, and Frostleaf was always alone. But look at them now... they're getting better.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The little lambs can't wait to take us out to play again. What did you think of the chocolate lava in that volcano earlier? I much prefer the crystal candy from the thermal lake myself.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Hehe, Mr. Kahn's letter just arrived. He says he's really mad that Professor Keller and I went rowing on a sulfuric acid lake without protective gear. Mom and Dad did crazy things just like that before they had me, and they didn't bring Professor Keller along. So this time, so I took her with me!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Phew. Looks like the sun's about to set. If only we could catch up with it, then the picnic could go on a little longer. How nice it would be if we could dance in a circle and sing. Pretty sun, warm sun, why you set so soon? Please stay, please wait, for time is such a boon♪

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: One moment, Professor, I'm changing out my hearing aid battery. Hmm? You're... Did you forget, Professor? I can read lips now. Besides, the sign you want should be like this, then this. What you just did was 'I have been suppressed by the volcano.'

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Cotton drifting on♪ We fly like clouds and chase the sun♪ Over the lava spout♪ We can't stop while the sun is out♪ Slow down if you please♪ You need to grant our wishes three♪ North Wind, make us rain♪ Bloom hot flowers from pebble grains♪

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Phew... Even without my hearing aid, I can still pick up the little sounds of Professor's breathing…

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Shh... Listen carefully, Professor. That's the sound of flowers blooming... So soft and gentle. I'm glad I can hear it.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Professor, I'm back, and I brought some souvenirs for you. I'll send them over to Dr. Kal'tsit and Amiya in a bit. I also managed to get a good amount of new data and specimens from Siesta's volcanic eruption. Would you like to come and take a look with me?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Is this a dream? A cozy, cloud-white dream?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: A volcano's every change and movement is fleeting. Only by capturing them on camera are we able to preserve every last detail.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I wonder if anyone recorded the picnics, too?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Our documentaries are being taken seriously? That's great! During my inspections in recent years, I've seen a lot of governments that don't trust our judgment and won't allocate resources to evacuate the residents. I hope I'll be able to make a difference.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: The flowers will not wither, and the sunlight will be forever warm. If only we could stay in this moment…

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I know what you want to say, Professor, but I've never made my expeditions hard for myself. Starting from the smallest example, I bet you've never fried a fowlbeast egg over lava before, but I have!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Look, professor! The hills are covered with Volcano Watchers! It's beautiful! Ah, mom and dad are there, too! Hm? You don't see them?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: How about a slice of lava cake before we head out? It was one of Mom's traditions.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: The picnic's about to begin.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Volcano field investigations are extremely dangerous. Everyone, please follow my instructions.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Yes? You're putting me in charge of the picnic?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Please double check your protective gear. Also, remember to keep a safe distance from the lava, and give regular status reports.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Come quick, Professor! There's still a ripe berry on that vine!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Relax, volcano. We're just here to collect a few precious samples. Please don't get mad.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: The little lambs say it's fun to roll around on the clouds. Do you think we can go for a picnic up there?

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: This time, we can make up for the missing data in the last report.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I hear fowlbeasts flapping their wings.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Don't worry about me, Professor. I've scaled a lot more volcanoes than you can imagine.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: The rainbow bridge rises between the clouds.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Volcanic soot contains lots of Originium particles. Let's not stay too long.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: The lava surges on, never turning back.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Magma will dredge up Originium veins. Keep your distance.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: A pebble returns to her hometown.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Melt away, life-depriving stone...

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: A cotton candy cloud, drizzled in azure sky syrup.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Ashes from volcanoes, they consume and erase, then nourish and propagate.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: A sweet-and-sour rainbow, dipped in golden sunshine.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Those particles have no place here. I'll send them away.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: A refreshing breeze, mixed into bubbling soda.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Oh, flowing magma, please slow your steps.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Sleep now, and fall into a sweet dream.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: We are one step closer to the truth of this land, Professor.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Hand in hand we stride, singing atop the gentle clouds.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Perhaps there will still be people gazing across this volcano a century from now. Their footprints will cover ours, and the seeds buried beneath the ash will bloom into even more beautiful flowers...

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Ring-a-ding-ding, when the flowers gently fall, the berries you can haul.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Why…? I'm not seeing any errors in the formula or the data... Um? I think I see something surfing through the lava...?

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Oops, be careful now. Sudden shrinking takes some getting used to. Try not to trip and fall, okay?

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Phew... Thankfully, the volcano didn't want to keep me that badly.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Oh my, who knocked over the cake stand? The lambs' faces are covered in cream!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Professor, I brought the documents you asked me about.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Can I bring the cake in?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: I heard you coming, Professor. I recognized your footsteps.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hey, quit it, little lamb. Oh, it's you, professor.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Professor, I know how good you are at learning. I can tell you're doing the wrong sign on purpose just to make me laugh!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: The lambs and I have matching bow ties. Aren't they pretty?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: A pebble encounters countless other pebbles during its life. They will collide with each other, become magma, erupt when they reach critical temperature, and then finally turn into the ash that nourishes new life. We're just like these little pebbles, Professor– Huh? Why didn't you tell me the fireworks already started?!

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I think it's snowing on those hills in the distance… Are you cold, Professor? The fairy tales say you can spin snow into nice, soft robes. Those who wear them will sleep the gentlest of sleeps. I hope you too will have sweet dreams tonight.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Professor, the fault lines of mountain ranges and trenches are quietly moving beneath our feet. Little by little, they inch us closer to the volcanoes we hope to visit.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Professor, since we've shrunk and the desserts haven't... Maybe we can keep eating as much as we want?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: The obsidian in this brooch comes from a volcano you haven't climbed yet. When you're not busy, we can go volcano-climbing, one by one. You'll know exactly which volcano I'm talking about once you get to the top. The scenery up there is magnificent, and the other half of your present is waiting up there.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: You've finally reached the top of the volcano, Professor. This is the view I've always wanted to show you... Why are you dreaming of me? Hehe, it's my way of telling you what I want to say. Happy birthday, Professor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Professor, I read in a book that after thousands of years, we will all re-enter this land's cycle. Maybe I'll become a little plume of magma, reshaping the land along its rock formations. When that time comes, I'll be able to forever look out across the land, with those I nourished nestled up against me.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Mhmm... It's so quiet here. The sun is as warm as ever, and the breeze is always gentle. Professor, we may go on separate journeys from here, but don't worry. Even if we part ways for now, there will come a day when we meet again.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: There's a limit to the types of documents I can help you with, Doctor. But I'll try to learn. I'm hoping to lead my own major engineering project someday, so I gotta accumulate knowledge from different domains.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Just spending some time reading. No, I'm not pushing myself too hard. Oripathy doesn't leave me too much time, so I must... Oh, sorry, I didn't mean to make things awkward.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I've gotten quite a bit taller in the last couple of years? Hehe, I'm still growing, after all. My ears have gotten perkier? Er, I guess it's also because I'm still growing...?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: No, Doctor, I haven't gotten more talkative... but Engineering veterans say we have to sound certain of ourselves, in order for our skills and designs to feel certain... I'll keep working at it.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Looks like the upcoming courses are even more complicated, and Engineering's idea of an internship is a little… *sigh*… never mind, I can handle it. Yes, I'll be sure to get enough rest. Rest is important to studying efficiently.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Mankind may have learned to overcome the darkness of night, but there are always shadows that even the brightest lights cannot breach. If I can continue to improve this technology, and bring warmth and light to those who shiver in the cold night...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Though I now fully leave the line patrol work to my drones, it doesn't mean my early intership years are worthless. Look at my physique now, even Medical doesn't have to worry about me anymore... um, Doctor? Why are you crying?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Volvort Kochinski... I've seen their mark on Mamá's equipment. Not even Rhodes Island intelligence has been able to track down Mamá since the incident. Is she covering her tracks, running from something?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Doctor, I'm going to visit a client to help with PLC testing. It won't take too long. You can use Rhodes Island Messengers to contact me if you need something... but I'm sure you can handle anything that comes up.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor... Doctor? Asleep already?... I see... This next segment is prone to bugs. I should set alerts to silent...

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hello, Doctor. This equipment was my graduation project. My initial plan was to... huh? Putting it into service? Dios mío(My goodness), so this is the 'Doctor's Thesis Defense' that Closure talked about?

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: No matter how much I watch, I just can't help but feel… everyone's style is so individualized, it's hard to summarize anything for general application…

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: It's an honor to earn your recognition, and that of Engineering. I know this is just the starting point, and I'll keep working to make sure that I don't let you down.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Countless frontiers remain uncharted on this land named science, waiting to be mapped and discovered. Though our latest technologies help get their views from afar, we have yet to set our foot on them. My dream, Doctor, is to be the pioneer that explores these realms with engineering.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: A practical field study... in combat?  Sure, no problem.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Understood. I'll compile a deployment report with suggestions for improvement.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: We're into an assault mission. Before we breakthrough the enemy defenses, I'm counting on you to hold the line.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Battlefield is where soldiers and war machines witness their own prime… and their own end.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Output stable.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: On your call.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Environ parameters set.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: EM trajectory calibrated.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: I'll create an opening.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Hit them in the face!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: This will be the breakthrough!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: I choose you!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Things were worse than expected, Doctor. Even our contingency plan was pushed to its limit... but we still did it!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Phew… Everything went according to plan. All equipment in good condition. We're ready for the next phase.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Effect on target below expectations, risk of potential failure… The re-simulation of both Doctor and PRTS  are required for next steps.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: No obstacles on the evacuation path. It's time to retreat, Doctor!

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: These facilities could use an upgrade...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: One moment, I'm almost done here... just a few lines more...

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Here so early, Doctor? Give me a moment, I'm almost done...

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Want to watch the light show together tonight? I designed this year's New Year show featuring my latest eco-lights, and they're sure to impress. After I'm done with their modification with Engineering, I'll donate them to offices in remote regions as disaster relief supplies.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Everything going well, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Here's a gift I designed for you. Why don't you take a look inside? See? There's a button on the side of the base. Just press it... and there we go! 'A town lit by home lights under a starry sky' in this little crystal ball, lovely isn't it?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I never thought I would have the opportunity to learn so much and do so much... with determination and hard work, even one little spark can light up the night sky. This is the most important lesson that I learned from Rhodes Island.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Leader, I left a package at your door, so remember to scan and sign for it when you manage to pull your head out of that stack of documents! Huh, weird... didn't you delegate a whole bunch of work already? How are you even busier than before?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: A—Achoo! Wut? Sheesh, my sister just texted to check if I'm good. Nah, overempathy's a pain sometimes, you know? It feels like you've been living in my head, sis. I need some personal space, you know!

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Would I be sad if everyone couldn't stay together? Leader, you're overthinking it. Look at it this way: if we went our separate ways all across the lands, then I'd get to meet up with a friend anywhere I went, right? Keeps me on that logistics grind! And it's the perfect chance to throw a party!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: How come the shop's still shuttered? Ahh... the disaster repairs will take too long, and everyone's going to need time to get used to the new empathy now that the Law's changed... who knows what the future's gonna be like? Ey, is that an ice cream truck I see? Leader, quick! After it! The future? It's right there, in the new flavor we're about to try!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I always try to stay upbeat in a crowd, no matter the vibes. All the pain and sorrow stop right here with me, while I'll give out all the joy I have... Don't I get tired? Course not, I love hanging out.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Yep, I saw the Sankta 'Lord'. The Lord was talking about stuff like genesis, crisis, future... But eh, it's a whole thing, you know. Who's supposed to keep track of all that? I think the Lord's better off staying put in 'The Saints' Travels', and leaving the future for us to decide!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: You found my diploma?! Yeah, I could've become an intercity network expert for the Notarial Hall, or maybe a mobile confessional designer, if I hadn't run off. Do I have any regrets? Duh! But dwelling on them is pointless. If I hadn't joined Penguin Logistics or met you—Nope, not thinking about it!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I didn't expect the halo to light up again after all that. Does it mean our Law and faith had nothing to do with it the whole time? I don't really get it, and we're stuck with it either way. There're no streetlights on our little path, so without the halo, we'd be smacking right into utility poles.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: You're asking what's so fun about sitting alone in a confessional? There's oodles of fun to be had, like a maple bar in my hand, the breeze blowing in from outside, the sun shining from on high, it's perfect! Of course, there's you popping up all of a sudden. Even if you're barging in on my private moment, turns out I'm still glad you came to say hi.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Lord, please bless the Leader with a long and wonderful dream, and let that dream... come true some day.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Long time no see, Leader! Radiant as ever, aren't you? If you've got anything that needs delivering in Laterano, you come straight to me!

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Relax, Leader. I'm going to one-up my lame old performances in these battle records.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Giving me such a long list? Hmm... I'm not worried about finishing it, of course. I'm worried I might do such a good job that you'll drop all your delivery work on me next time, you know?

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Leader, I can tell how important this thing is to you, so I swear on this gun in my hand, it'll reach its destination safely.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Relax, Leader. I'll make sure your package gets there intact. That's not what you're worried about? Oh... I get it now. Whatever you want blown up, I'll wipe it off the face of this land.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Don't worry, just follow me and you'll never get lost, there's no place in Laterano I haven't blown up at least once... Why the face, Leader? It's easier to understand something once you crack it open for a look-see, right?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Need some lighting? All good, this light on my head will illuminate the path ahead... long as it doesn't die out. I don't think it will. Probably.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Get in line for my bullet buffet—!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I knew you'd come straight to me, Leader!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Uh... maybe you didn't come straight to me, but don't forget to pay my fee straight away.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Real estate question: this wonderful realm or a panoramic view of hell—which did you want again?

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Okaaay... this is awkward, but I'm the only one who knows how to handle the chaos I created, haha.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Divine judgment, traditional!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Rock n' gospel!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Barrage sky-shattering!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Apple pie, with char siu!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Yes! No place is beyond reach.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Leader, don't forget to invite me out for drinks on your tab, okay!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: No biggie. Out of bullets? Get a new mag. Gun jammed? Just use another.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Ahem, I'll compensate any losses suffered during delivery, so just relax.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: It's a little messy here... we're prepping packages to deliver—oh yeah! Leader, my hands are all full, so could you cut me some tape?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Oh!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: An apple a day means seven apples a week, yay!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Hey, I'm always the one making you laugh, so why don't we switch it up for New Year's? You're awfully quiet, Leader. We've fought side-by-side so many times, I'm sure you know my weak spots. Don't tell me... you don't have a clue what gets me laughing?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Express delivery for you, Leader!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Phew... I drove for two weeks plus straight, and fi... finally made it to your birthday party! Good, good, hah, this means I get to shove your face into a cake before the clock strikes twelve! So don't you hide, Leader! It's an expensive custom job, so it's not going to waste!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Going somewhere new and meeting new friends is fun and all, but going back to your usual turf to hang out with old friends is even better. Going somewhere new with old friends? Now that's the best. So, Leader, wanna go on a trip with me?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Yes, I have received the notification that fragmentation mines are forbidden in the corridors. But rest assured, Doctor, the high voltage fencing installed on your door violates no ordinances.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: 'Calamity'. Deploying simulation sequence. Activating emergency response protocols. Queueing worst-case scenario simulation.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Indeed, I was the one who introduced recent Lateran Operators to Rhodes Island. If you have no objections, I will continue to introduce functionaries with special circumstances to you. I hope to study how Sankta live outside Lateran, and how it compares to their life within.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: From the Tower of Revelations to the Notarial Hall in Pagus Michaelion, then on to the Sunset Chapel in Pagus Saint Marcel, then the chapel square—the city is alight. I sense the existence of each individual, and their disappearance as well. We are one—as 'Laterano'.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: This mission may call for a piano performance? Do not worry. I have memorized the complete scores of over a hundred classical pieces, and I can play every note in accurate order. Any properly trained executor should be capable of this. That does not count as playing the piano? I do not understand.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The entity known as The Lord of Fiends is locked on, and I will help her shed the Black Crown. Civlight Eterna is too heavy a burden for a single fledgling. Laterano will share in this aura, and 'empathy' shall unite Sankta and Sarkaz as one.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The title 'Saint' can neither enhance my abilities nor reveal any precise mission to me. Though it has added difficulties to my work, I cannot fathom why I was chosen. Its objective and demands are something I must seek myself.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: The Many share similarities with present-day Laterano, but extreme approach behavior does not conform to the laws of evolution. Does this mean, however, that they are no longer sentient? And can such a life form come to a natural end? The nomadic monastery has arrived on the coast; You Many, your answers shall be used as reference for the conclusion.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Doctor, this is my medical examination report, please confirm. Currently, no horns have grown on my head, and my halo has seen no changes in shape or form. Indeed, my violation of the law has not had a physical effect on me, but it's nothing worthy of celebration. Abnormalities have been on the rise. This is an omen of disaster.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Owing to 'empathy', Laterano remains pure and efficient, even in the face of 'calamity'. When night falls, this place is the first to illuminate. Laterano will reconvene the Summit of Nations, and rally all forces when necessary.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, during my recent missions, my limbs have been acting before I complete my thought processes. This phenomenon can impede successful completion of my missions. I am troubled. Could you tell me whether it's a kind of disease? Will my condition worsen? Is there (a) medicine that can heal it?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: It possesses no personality yet maintains the capability to modulate and influence human emotions. Why did it ultimately choose to develop a mechanism as complex as 'empathy' for the Sankta...? What brought about such a question? I am thinking—Error, exception detected.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Most confuse Arturia's Arts as tampering with cognition and mental faculty, but I know the fact is just the opposite. Arturia is interested only in the truest emotions, and cares not for where these emotions lead. The influence she can command is far worse than anyone can possibly imagine.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Emotional fluctuation detected; the six-year-old heir to the decedent does not possess the requisite psychological resilience. Processing; she demonstrates capacity to accept the decedent's status... 'Death'. Federico, you, too, stood in the rain at that cemetery. Did you come to understand it?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: What are you doing, Doctor? Bodily contact is no replacement for spoken language. I cannot decipher your thoughts through your limbs. You think that I need comfort? If that is your judgement, then I have no reason to refuse. Infact, I am merely thinking back to my recent mission. What leaves a man no other choice(,) but death?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Yulia, Clément—error; above names should not appear in the list of victims... Do you still remember? Federico, when your mother taught you to read and write, to play music. She whispered to you as you slept—you would come understand that you were just as useful as any patron firearm.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: As you can see, this is a burnt flower. I have, to the best of my abilities, maintained its condition in order to bring it to you. It is not a gift, because it does not meet the criteria for one. It's a question in my mind. I am still pondering the things behind this flower.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Arturia, cease your seduction of the Doctor. I am awake. I will share the possibilities I saw, as well as the limitations within. My head is still too foggy to begin the description, please allow me a look at the sky—it is a blue most familiar to me, Doctor.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You lack sleep, Doctor. You need more rest.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Program running normally. Status: stable.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: You seem surprised, Doctor. Please rest assured that the change in my equipment won't affect my ability to complete my missions. If you find yourself ill at ease because of my attire, I can change into my previous garments before I enter Rhodes Island. No need? Understood.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Pathway locked. Framework stable. Connection established. This is Laterano.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I have attempted a few combat techniques, and they have yielded excellent results.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Archive complete.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: You put together an all new profile. Is this a false identity for my next mission? If the need arises, I know where to prepare identification that can pass checks. No need? This, too, is a normal promotion?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: True. Our partnership agreement requires renewal—you represent Rhodes Island, and I, Laterano.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I am trying to understand the law. Is Laterano's foundation truly these words alone? Is that applicable to lands other than Laterano? I must admit I have indeed been affected by it, to a certain degree. I will attempt to find the answer posthaste.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I see a certain future. Of Laterano, and of myself. The events that transpire within are far from inscrutable, but the question I find myself pondering is: why do they come to pass?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: The law itself has no power. It calls for enforcers.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I am Laterano. I calculate every possibility, and remove every obstacle.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I require those who can act on their own judgment.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Request received. Processing.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Move out.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: In which zone did the crisis occur?

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Commencing operation. Please confirm the mission objective.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Assessing crisis danger level…

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Understood.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Laterano has reached a conclusive assessment of the situation.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Your request is reasonable.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Emergency response protocols initializing.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Prayers are unnecessary.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Laterano responds.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I shall ensure the integrity of the law.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Laterano intervenes.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Target confirmed.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Fire, as the Commandments apply.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Destruction is the most naive behavior.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Purge, as the protocols require.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Annihilation is the most common result.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: All principles are breakable.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Violated taboos hold no power.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: All taboos are null.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: No casualties, no commotions. All good.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: Annihilation shall not manifest.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Mission complete.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Operation complete. Laterano will now return to the landship.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The result is acceptable.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: The Commandments contain deficiencies. I will implement corrections.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: We need to reformulate our battle plans.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, I have awoken.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Maintaining a dedicated room is a show of respect? I see.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: All is normal.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: I have heard there are certain hobbies that are not easily understood by others. Perhaps this is one such hobby?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: I did not notice your presence, Doctor. I am still processing this information.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Speak the word if you need anything, Doctor.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Thank you, my condition is now stable.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Changes in numbers and symbolistic objects are how man reminds himself of the flow of time. Yes, I said I can understand, in spite of the fact that I need no such reminders. However, if this day brings you joy, then it is indeed very meaningful. Happy New Year, Doctor.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Even under such conditions, rituals of similar types persist. Wandering executors return to the nearest monastery to spend the day with their compatriots. I sense the existence and disappearance of each individual. I recollect that feeling, and know that it is not 'empathy'.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: You have changed greatly, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor, please hold here. These possibilities require immediate disclosure and discussion. With YOU.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Gifts need to be packaged in such a way that you cannot immediately see the contents on a single glance? Is this a compulsory requirement? My apologies, I am not well-versed in such matters. Well, then, Doctor. I will prepare an unscannable safe and a new gift. Please wait for just a moment.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I am about to return to Laterano. The Notarial Hall's directives take precedence over your birthday celebration. I have, however, acquired this party hat for you... Is this inappropriate? If my understanding is correct, blue is a suitable color for such an occasion.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I have been looking for you, Doctor. The cleaning agreement that I have entered into with your company is nearing its end. If you desire a new agreement, you may refer to these items I brought with me for reference. The Notarial Hall has never entered into a long term agreement with a foreign corporation. Our partnership with Rhodes Island will be a new challenge.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: The possibilities that Arturia and I perceive are uniformly extreme; nevertheless, Rhodes Island, and you, as its commander, remain a constant variable. Therefore, Doctor, your assessment is required before 'calamity' arrives.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor—oh, no need to panic, I'm not dragging you into a checkup, I'd just like to sit down in here for a moment... Out of all of Rhodes Island, it feels like your office is the one place that hasn't changed.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, we're about to partially renovate Rhodes Island's wards to better meet patient aftercare needs. I've written down all the supplies we need here. Would you like to check over it quickly? Yes, I am in charge of this work now.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, I've adjusted the flavor of my healthy meals based on everyone's input. I came to realize that blindly insisting on my own views might not actually be best—you can only resolve conflicts better once you listen to the other side, and stand in their shoes... It would've been nice if I'd realized that sooner.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I've always been so hard on everyone, keeping them to healthy schedules, never letting them do anything bad for their illness. It turns out I was the one failing at all of that, heheh... But don't worry, there's still a lot I've got to do. I'm not giving in yet.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Diseases don't just torment the body—they impact the mind too. 'How will others see me? Can I ever live how I used to?' Everyone has worries like that... If I can't help my patients put them to rest, then my treatment isn't done yet.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I once saved a child in Leithanien. When she came to and saw me, she screamed for her life and ran away. Before that, I never thought there was much of a difference between Caprinae horns and Sarkaz horns. We can't change how everyone sees things, but at the very least, I don't want my patients to fear me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: I think Lava's really changed lately. She gets up and sleeps early without needing me to remind her, and she barely ever talks back when I nag her, but it's all the more worrying for some reason... Doctor, if you ever feel tired or depressed, you can come vent to me! I'd be perfectly happy!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: This flute? It's actually an Arts staff. It's from when I went to Vyseheim. It was there I used Arts to harm someone for the first time, and it was the first I saw a friend leave us forever, just out of reach. Every time I hold this staff, all my feelings in that moment come back to me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: We happily see off recovered patients, and say goodbye to former companions with a smile. People come and leave. Our varied dreams may lead us to different paths, but we'll always mean something to  each other... Doctor, would you be open for food with me today? I'll go and ask Lava along.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Doctor, you might be reliable with work, but you act just like a child when you're off. Now you're sleeping on desk again. I've told you so many times, it's bad for your spine, and you might catch a cold just like that... *sigh* If I'm not there one day, could you really take care of yourself?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor, I'm back—Umm, Doctor, I know my last field assignment took longer than usual, but don't look at me like you don't recognize me... Medic Operator Hibiscus, reporting in.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Everyone's taking charge of themselves, now—that's nice to see.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm suddenly reminded of my time in A1, training with everybody... Everyone's matured so much now. I'll keep up the effort, for all we've been through.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Bodily trauma can be treated through medicine and surgery, but how do we cure the pain from hostility and prejudice? Healing people's hearts, Doctor, that's what I will devote myself to.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I won't fail you—this time, I'll be sure to protect everyone.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'm leading? I wasn't usually the one doing that before... No, I won't shirk responsibility.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Don't be afraid. I've got your backs.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: I'm not going to let you harm my friends.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: I'll make sure everyone's safe.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Doctor, I'm here.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: First aid ready. Medical support standying by.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: I wish this to be the last time, if possible…

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: If we can prevent more harm this way, I'll stand my ground.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Please tell me if this hurts.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: I can do more than just heal.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Hold it. There's no sense in getting any more hurt.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: It's always easier to harm than heal. But... is it really something to be proud of...?

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: I'm so glad everyone could come back safe...

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Prioritize treating the wounded. I'll guard against counterattacks.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: I still couldn't... protect everyone...

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Some beds have emptied.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: You need me, Doctor?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, here's your healthy recipe for today. Make sure you eat on time.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Let's relax—we don't get holidays often. But still, you have to watch your junk food intake, and don't stay up until sunrise. I'll be keeping an eye on you. Mmhm, I'll watch out for my own health too, I promise.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Staying healthy is just as important as working hard, Doctor. Don't let either slip.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doctor, I—made you a birthday cake, actually. I used low-fat butter and dark chocolate, and I cut back the sugar as much as possible, but still, the calories are flooring me. How should I even... okay, just for today, I'm making an exception! Thank you for the good work, Doctor. Happy birthday.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island didn't just grant me knowledge, but a dream worth fighting my whole life for. As a Sarkaz, as an Infected, as a doctor, and as a sister, I've found my home here. Honestly, I need to say just how fortunate I am. Right now, I want nothing more than to protect all this.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: As I am now, will my presence inconvenience you? Will I remind you of past miseries? I... long for being with you. When the time comes, we will leave this place together, okay?

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I understand. Some thoughts lose meaning when expressed with words. It's fine. So long as those thoughts echo in your mind, so long as you still need me, I will be here by your side, and nowhere else.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: You thought we could not survive if away from the sea? A myth, it is. My kin and I will soon be able to swim through the air. In the end, even those places devoid of anything will be our ocean. We simply need to evolve, and we only need to adapt.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: No more rolling around in the frosting. You're an example to the fairies, the guardian of the garden. I won't clean you scale by scale, or wrap you in silk and put you in the clouds anymore... Of course, you can do anything you like. This may be my own wishful thinking, but I imagine you'd be willing to hear out my suggestions.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: My former friends tried to grant me my eternal rest with their hands. They refused to confront their true selves, but I do not resent them, and I could not hurt them, even if they rejected and attacked me so vehemently... Perhaps everything I did was bringing them harm. My regrets died along with them.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: The soil on the plains contain all souls' desires. Those thoughts, regrettable yet magnificent, despicable yet delicious. They are your food to enjoy. Are they sweet? Are they Sour? You must've figured out how to share them with me, right?

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: This box? My past lies within it...the fragments of my past. Fractured as they are, they still suffice to tell that I am not an empty puppet... that I am not a phantom. Gradually, I was reborn into what I am now, bit by bit.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Singing's not so hard. You only need to let your voice out of your throat. Your desires will shape sound itself, and I will write it into a score. Come, have a try. Sing the way you want. It'll be fun.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, was a future like this also in your past vision? You may have nothing but hatred for me now, but I do not fear it. Hate me as your heart desires... while you are still able to.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Once in the past, you loved to entwine yourself among my fingers. You breathed like a great dragon, but let out only faint squeaks. Just when did it all change...? Now you only hover above my head, looking at me from afar... I want to see you, without having to look up all the time. That's very tiring.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Your companions, Kal'tsit and Amiya, said that you are worthy of my trust until the very end. But one can never save the others. I failed to save my friends, and you failed to save yours. We both have lost everything, but I was granted a rebirth, and following that, a new future. This... is just unfair to you.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Amidst the sea of impulses and desires, I opened my eyes. You did, too. That's why I'm bringing you with me: to unleash our desires and break these shackles. But it looks like you have other ideas... I'm scolding you? Not at all. This is what makes you different, and I like it.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Long ago, my family was murdered when I was still in Ægir. I always assumed the sea monsters did it, but I never expected to learn that it was all the handiwork of the Ægir. My blood kin and my songs are scary, they all say, but they are wrong. It is the people who are scary.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: The fairies swallowed dreams, and so were shaped like those dreams. Plates roll and tumble across the ground; puppets chase one another;  seaflowers raise their instruments... Dreams become reality itself. If I were to become a little fairy myself, do you think... the distance between us might lessen?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I did struggle, I did resist. But to what avail? When the tide rises, no traces of lesser lifeforms will remain undrowned. You are my very last friend. Will you also be like them, rejecting the ocean for a futile end, even if it costs you everything? Do you wish to be what I used to be?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I found a scale in the nest. Are you starting to shed again? I will sing to you lullabies, take off your gown, and rinse that filth with warm water. Will you... refuse me? I promise you everything... so please, just this once, listen to what I demand.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Am I sick? Or am I still dreaming? I dreamt that the black sky was our ocean. When the others and I swam up, we did not feel ourselves sinking at all. Strange, so strange. Is this our future? Their faces are so blurry, they... They... No, no.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: The fairies are talking amongst themselves. They whisper: the guardian of the garden is lingering in the borderlands, trying to leave the plains. Then go. Go where you like and follow your nature. Bring your dream and my heart with you. Only then, will the you I well-acquainted return to my fingertips.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Dream... What kind of dream will you have? Where are you now? Will you find it there... just another dream?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Sleep soundly. I will be the residual melody in your sweet dreams.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I have been waiting for you. It's been so long, far too long that... I have forgotten why I am waiting for you here... But none of this is important anymore. It's not that important anymore.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Spread your wings and squall to your heart's content. Everything is permitted in these red plains. Spread your joy and excitement to the fairies. Let them sing and frolic with them. I'll be waiting for you here.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: These things... I have seen them too many times. Nobody needs things like these anymore.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: This screen is cold and dull. Why don't we instead relish some fresh, living memories?

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Formalities of the past... what good are they now? Nothing has survived, except you and me. We will cast those aside, and all we need is to be a step closer... Join me, Dr. {@nickname}, and be my blood kin.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: There are no tasks or duties here. Our own satisfaction is the greatest reward. Indeed, I'm very satisfied now.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Nevermore shall my eroded sword cleave, Nevermore shall my former friends breathe, and nevermore shall I feel the warm blood flow inside me. Still, I am satisfied. I have become one with the ocean. Doctor, come with me — your true form is still waiting for you beneath the waves.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Fighting is the most primal of instincts, and there's no point in resisting it. If you're frightened, I can guide you forward.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Fight alongside the others? Against whom?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: I will follow your words, and drift along the currents…

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: No more lives should be lost.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You already have the answer in your mind. Why follow the commands of others?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: What will it feel like... when their arms penetrate this body?

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: Watch your shadow. Don't let it be stolen.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Treat me not as a calamity, for death is not my wish.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Listen. The sound of a banquet.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: What do you wish to do? I shall obey.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: Flowers wither, and petals dye the land red.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: No longer do I walk alone. My blood kin are with me.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Let instinct stain my name.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Now, harken to the song of the distant sea...

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Don't send a thread into a knife's edge.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Rest at ease. The tide also rises.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Let me stir it.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: The sky and the land... both a drought to relieve.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: This song will never stop, not until the melody is written…

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: May the song seep into your souls.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: The red velvet of life props up this dead diamond.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: With me, to our eternal home we will return.

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: The moment you leave, I will take these lost dreams away.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Fear not, my kin… The time is nigh.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: It was your determination that dyed my dress red.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: They will become our blood kin. They no longer need to feel the suffering of aridity. Their prior existence was already too painful.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: When you trust your instincts, victory is never far off. You use them well.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Will you treat me the same way? Is this also the ending you designed for me? If that is what you wished for, I will not deny it.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: Fighting isn't complicated. You did well. You may have whatever reward you desire.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Why must you flee? This futile struggle will only bring about more senseless terror.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: You missed them? They must not be important.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Run, Doctor... Run away, from here, from me... Leave.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Come with me. We will live on, together.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Sooner or later, this place too will return to its primordial form.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Let the fairies redecorate. We'll come back later.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: ...Why am I still wearing this hat?

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Hehe…

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: We failed to protect everything. The harmonious future is our only hope.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Look into my eyes, and tell me the first word that comes to mind.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: I still remember this day... but time has no more significance at this point. The sea and sky, and all life, will never change anymore...

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: This is a holiday where humans celebrate their calendar cycle starting anew. You should go enjoy yourself. It must be very fun to swim among fireworks. Oh, and remember to save me a spark. I'll plant it in the garden.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Doctor... Come, with me.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Where are you flying off to today?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: I can feel the joy of a life being born... but, how should I share this joy with you...? Dr.{@nickname}, don't stray too far from me. We can embrace this new life, together...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Normal cakes and pastries can't satisfy your hunger, can they? Maybe we could go with some new ideas. Hmm... A frosted galaxy? A chocolate mountain? Maybe a candied fruit forest? You still want human pastries...? Alright...

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Doctor, leave. There's nothing left in these ruins. Everything familiar has vanished. The memories still sting us... Doctor, do you hate what I say? But we've both lost our families, all of them... Would you become family with me, as I am now?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Your wings have gotten stronger, and your scales are tougher now. I wonder how you'll look once you shed that robe. If only I could bend time to my will, the new, reborn you would be back at my side so much sooner.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Doctor, got any trouble for me to handle? What? Just haul these files for you?

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I gotta hand it to her, Doctor, this axe Zumama made for me turned out great, but I've already got this muscle memory from whacking enemies with my staff. See, still carrying it with me. I'm here to save people, after all, not beat 'em up. Gotta work that out.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Doctor, check it out. Getting extra weapons' kind a juggling act, so I found a solution. Trained my tail a little, and now, I can use it to hold my staff. Only downside is—I think my tail got thicker after all that exercise.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: How's that, Doctor? Shoulders feel much better, right? I told you, controlling my strength's a piece of cake, it's just none of you wanna believe me. I've been practicing medicine as a pro for years now. It's about time you recognized the fact, don’t you think?

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Oh, right, Doctor, it’s been a while since your last trip to Acahualla, right? Join me next time I visit my home, if you can spare the time. They told me it's a party there now. Even I'm wondering what my home's gonna be like when I visit again.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, you know there's times you can trust your intuition. You've got all these Operators who trust you, see. Even with your eyes closed, your fists are still real strong—What? Compared to mine? Hey... I could K.O. you before you even made it out of this office, so I'm the stronger one there!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Zumama can build machines, Tomimi can manage people, and Inam's a damn-good lord ameer... Man, my friends rule! But my medical skills aren't bad either! Huh? What do you mean that's the one thing they’d argue?

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Y'know, Doctor, I never understood why you made everything so complicated all the time. But now, I kinda get it, in a small sorta way. To put it in plaintalk, you're just finding ways to get bigger fists. So let me get real here, Doc. It's time you worked out with me.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Zumama was right. All I gotta do is think about how to get stronger, and how to throw my fists. So I've got an extremely serious question to ask you, Doctor... If I get Zumama to build us a two-seater Raging Ironhide, do you wanna ride driver-side or passenger?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Alright, how should I wake the Doc up...?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Hold on, Doctor, I know what you wanna ask, and my files are still up in Medical. But, y'know, Dr. Kal'tsit's got a point. Doesn't reflect well on Medical to have a physician steamrolling around the front lines, so from now on, this is how I'm heading out.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: There... wouldn't a quick axe chop do the job?!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: *sigh* Just doesn't give me the same kick I get being endorsed for my medical skills...

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, doesn't matter if I've got an axe or staff in hand, I'm just hoping to accomplish a little something, make everyone's lives a little bit happier. I've managed to do a bunch so far, and before my body gives out on me here, I'm gonna do more.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Leave the front to me. The rear's all yours!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: You get to follow me under one condition—you all stay alive and well. Got it?

voices.title: Depart

voices.title: Greeting

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: So it's your birthday again, Doctor. Craziest day of the year aboard Rhodes Island, apart from New Year's. Seriously, Rhodes Islanders are taking some hell of a shine to you. Here, a present from me. Also, I'm watching you, same as always. You're not doing a second of work today.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: I'm gladdened to be by your side once again, Doctor... Yes, may the light be with you as always.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Being in Kazimierz was no easy thing. The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi and the General Chamber of Commerce are still constantly at each other's throats, and the day when glory once again shines on Kazimierz seems very far away still. Only at Rhodes Island can I let my guard down, and regather myself with peace of mind.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Are they still well? How is Liz's health? Has Shining been pushing herself too far in combat? In my time back home, my mind's eye often wandered to the scenery I saw by their sides. Once, they journeyed home with me, but next shall be the time when for the sake of their ideal, the Radiant Knight devotes her light.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: I was absent from Kazimierz for too long. It's as if I'm all too used to life at Rhodes Island now. Whenever a Knight of kindred spirit wished to travel with me, it cast my mind back to my days here. That said, processing multitudes of paperwork is more tiring than I remembered. I still have much to learn from you.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: A victory nodded in by capital bears no glory. Yet it was thus I first came to meet those souls who harbored faith, and was able to light that flame. I pray that this flame can show the way forward, that it may inspire those who crawl to stand back on thier feet and forge ahead, that it sheds the darkness, that it reveals the true light of hope. Doctor, I have always firmly believed so.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: This weapon? Heheh, there are only a few who know. My grandfather wielded in his youth a swordspear alike, which my father inherited, teaching me swordsmanship with it in turn... When I returned to my home, the scenes of my younger years came back to me. That's what led me to this weapon.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Maria has realized her own truly beloved undertaking. She's gifted, highly assiduous, and with Zofia beside her, I couldn't be more reassured. It seems now that the forge's hammer suits her better than the longsword. I truly hope that this honest, sincere passion of hers may forever last.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Kazimierz's struggles are unlike those of other lands. Without the constant conflict in light and shadow, we know only swollen greed and twisted regulations. That Maria and her cohort could stay aboard Rhodes Island is a good thing indeed. Though people of like minds aren't few in number, we still find ourselves barren, barren of virtue.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: In this age on the verge of collapse, I once... felt alone. But Shining and Liz shone upon my fate, and Rhodes Island became my home to return to. I once was shone upon by others, Doctor, so I know profoundly, a beautiful vision and a faith identified, are enough to change the world.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: Tiredness has not called on me yet. May you first rest.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Oaths and trust both are unchanging in the passage of time. Isn't that so, Doctor? The Radiant Knight, Margaret Nearl, rejoins you here.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: The particulars of tactics have seen some adjustment. Hm...

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: That I could once again experience this gladdens me greatly. 'Fear neither hardship nor darkness.' Doctor, I shall go together with you.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: So long as I hold radiance in my hands, so long as my heart beats with faith, the hardships of our world will not fetter my step.

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Upon changing armaments, my combat style will also be obliged to adapt. Take due note when deploying me.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I will keep in mind your instruction.

voices.text: Sin is to be punished.

voices.title: In Battle 4

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I have never held the slightest hesitance to entrust my life to your hands.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: There will come a day when we clear the mist of hardship and darkness, awaiting first light's rays, awaiting... an even better tomorrow.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: The time has not yet come to give up, Doctor. Please allow me to defend the rear alone. I leave the regrouping to you.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Is my previous dormitory still left for me? Thank you, for going to the trouble.

voices.title: Tap

voices.title: Trust Tap

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Does it surprise you that I'm here? Yes, the deskwork piles up without end. But as the clock strikes the new year, I find myself yearning to be sat here on Rhodes Island's deck, gazing over the barren land that light has yet to reach. Happy New Year, Doctor.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Have you been doing well lately, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Today is your birthday—naturally I'd remember. Please, accept this handcrafted trinket. Kazimierz's products may aim to dazzle, but in all truth, it's never anything more than new packaging... You'd like a Radiant Knight souvenir figure? Please, spare me your jokes, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Since returning home, I've come across more and more knights who support me. While I was once steadfast in piercing through Kazimierz's long night alone, it's now my greatest honor to stand with kindred spirits. What about you, Doctor?  To what corner of the land has Rhodes Island delievered its brilliance this past year?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: What do I do with my time off? Hmm... Well, last time, I went to see the Red Hand Gang and the survivors of that incident. Their perseverance helped me understand, on a deeper level, why Rhodes Island helps people.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Please don't avoid necessary training, Doctor. You see, I never missed a single training session. I wouldn't say it makes you totally untouchable in battle, but it can keep you alive. My two scars are proof of that.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I often think back to when Ace encouraged me to join Rhodes Island. He said I'd become a great operator. That's been my motivation to keep me going through my training. But... it was only when I officially became an operator, that I understood the weight of his expectations.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: What has war revealed to you, Doctor? When I finally stood on the battlefield myself, I came to understand that many commanders see their troops as sacrificial pawns for victory. Ever since, I've always been reviewing and reassessing how I lead my squad. I'm not going to let myself become that kind of commander.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Once back in Londinium, some soldiers from the coalition of dukes laughed at us, calling us fools. But if Rhodes Island's operations really are foolish, then I doubt any action on this land could be called wise.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: I sometimes go to the training grounds to guide the recruits. Most times, I'm more worried than they are about any mistakes. I always feel like I should be doing something to help push them along faster. But as Instructor Dobermann always says, I need to relax and give them more time. It looks like I still have a lot to learn.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Oripathy and the Infected are two very big and complex topics. The only thing I can worry about is protecting the people in front of me. But I'd like to believe that, someday, we'll find a solution to those problems. I'll be supporting you the whole way, Doctor.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: Rhodes Island's another year older... Time sure flies, and all the former members of Reserve Op Team A1 have joined different departments... Ah, look at me. This is no time to get nostalgic. There's still plenty of new problems for us to tackle.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Let's commence work, Doctor. We have a mountain of issues to face.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Doctor, can you pass a message onto Ifrit for me? I'm returning to Trimounts—there's some urgent business that requires me in person. So she'll have to eat dinner with Saria tonight. I... I'll make it up to her next time, I promise.

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: Do you need coffee? This is a special bean Joyce prepared for me that keeps me up even in the daytime. After all, I can't coop up alone in the lab day and night like I once did. I have lots of meetings that I'd rather not take, and lots of reports to read that I'd also rather not.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: My thoughts on returning to Rhine Lab...? I'd rather not reflect on it like that, if I could. All I can say is, I used to perennially expect someone would come to my aid, but now I understand—I can only rely on myself if I am to achieve anything.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: Guess what this stack of papers is? They're whistleblower reports. Some labs think they can protect themselves by airing other labs' dirty laundry to me. The more they do this, the more anger I feel welling up inside.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: Return those gifts to senders, and have them convey to whoever's behind them, that I'll be making a personal visit, and they'd better be prepared... Sorry, Doctor, am I bothering you at work? I'll excuse myself for now. Yes, alright, I'll be back in Trimounts later today...

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: This contract pertains to the ensuing direction of our partnership with Rhodes Island, Doctor. You'd better take a look. I don't want us to blindly accept Rhodes Island's aid. Of course, I do hope that outside of work, we'll remain good friends.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Yes, Doctor? No, I'm no longer restricting Ifrit from seeing Saria. Honestly, on the contrary, I hope they see more of each other now. Ifrit is grown up, after all. And more importantly, her presence will remind Saria that,  not all prices are numbers, and reports do not remove scars.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: To be honest, being domineering is an awful sensation. When people come to my desk, the way they look at me makes me uncomfortable. But that's something I'll gradually adapt to. I'm going to rest for a short while, Doctor. I'd like to hear your thoughts after I wake up.

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: I'll deal with some minor affairs for you, Doctor. Rest well.

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Doctor, my time aboard Rhodes Island will be inevitably diminished in the future. There is one thing, however, that I can guarantee: my relationship with Rhodes Island will only grow closer, because I trust Rhodes Island, and I trust you.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Some battles are unavoidable, I know.

voices.title: Promotion 1

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: I know what you want to ask. The path I'm about to walk is a thorny one. Am I really prepared for it…? I don't know whether future me will come to regret this, but at least right now, I will firmly walk on.
