voices.text: The samples in this area... We've taken these before. Let's move on.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I'll organize aid for wounded personnel. Everyone else, please assist in maintaining the perimeter.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor... it looks like we should reformulate our tactics.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: This place still feels like home.

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: ...Huh?

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: Doctor, I happen to have some issues I'd like to discuss with you. Are you available right now?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, I imagine Ifrit sent you, didn't she? She tries everything she can to get me to put down my work—she's always making trouble for me—she even threatened to burn my lab reports. You're the third one she's sent... Alright, we'll break here for today. Let's go.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Coffee, Doctor?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Here's your cake, your card, a small gift, and... I seem very practiced, do I? Oh, I'm sure; I've definitely grown somewhat used to celebrating birthdays. Days like this lift your spirits, don't they?

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: When I first joined Rhine, research was my everything. Following the Diαbolic Crisis, Ifrit and her Oripathy were my everything. But now, as I come to know more and more, the things I want to do grow in volume too. Still, Doctor, we'll reunite at the same destination, when all's said and done.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: While you were out, I tried to sort the documents on your desk for you... It shames me to admit it, but... I haven't made much progress when it comes to desk work.

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: I ran into Franka and Liskarm on my way to the dorms. Even though I hadn't seen them in so long, we talked like we were never apart... Um, Doctor, do you think, maybe, I c-could apply to serve on missions with them?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: I don't have as much money on hand these days. I argued with my father a lot about pioneering in the barrenlands. And so... I stopped drawing from the family trust fund. But I can still earn some money out there pioneering, at least enough to maintain my equipment.

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: When I was little, everyone always had so much on their plates. Only my retired grandfather could stay at home with me. He would tell me stories about his time in the army, so that he can cheer me up this way. Even though his past never stopped tormenting him, he was still willing to fluff it into tidy little stories, just to make me smile.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: There was a soirée a while ago where someone brought up the war in Victoria. I chimed in with my own experiences. Only a few words, but enough to ruin everyone's time. You know, Doctor, that was the moment I finally realized why Blacksteel mercenaries rarely talk about themselves.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: I'm nominally still employed by Blacksteel, but it's been a while since I've done any mercenary work. No, it's not that I regret the decision I made back then; I'm just tired of responding to disaster, always one step behind. This time, I want to be there to protect something from the beginning.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Doctor... Would you mind coming to the training room with me? I don't need a spotter, it's just... new operators keep coming to me for advice, and facing them alone makes me feel a— a little nervous.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: Oh... You want to know about the flower on my chest? Actually... it wasn't an accessory to begin with. It was a shard of metal that got lodged in my leg. After it was surgically removed, I... decided to turn it into a buttonhole flower instead of throwing it away. Y-Yeah, I guess it is kinda weird. I'm not sure what I was thinking.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: I know now that there's no shame in crying... or having a soft heart. If you're sad about something you can't put into words, why not express your feelings with tears? It's part of being human, so there's nothing to be ashamed of.  Um... Am I right, Doctor?

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: You look a little worse for wear every time I see you... Are you doing alright these days, Doctor?

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: It's been a while since we last met, Doctor. I'm glad there's still something I can do for you. That's right, I have changed a lot. If you could find the time, I'd love to sit down with you and catch up...

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: I just dug up my old combat records, which proved to be pretty useful. Comparing my before-and-after, I at least know what mistakes I shouldn't be making again. Ugh, I really looked like a... bumbling idiot back then.

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: I'm just glad to receive your acknowledgement, Doctor. The rewards are secondary.

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Doctor, are you giving me a promotion? Then, can I... make a teensy tiny extra request? It's nothing big, just... Can I... have a hug?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: Come in, Commander, this is Jessica. On the line and ready to roll.

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: Rally on me.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: ETA six mikes.

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Hostiles sighted, over.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: In position.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: Roger, wilco.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: I'm headed into the thick of it.

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: With all of you behind me, I won't take a single step back.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Drawing a bead on the target.

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Don't come any closer…

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Requesting permission to fire.

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Be adviced. Target… eliminated.

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: No resting on your laurels now... We've got more fighting ahead of us.

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: That was close, I almost... A-Anyway, good thing I managed to pull through in the end... Sorry, Doctor. Please, give me a minute. I need to get my emotions under control.

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: I think... a minor setback is no big deal. It's already enough that none of our people got hurt.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: Doctor, an apology doesn't even begin to cut it... I'll try to make up for this failure on subsequent operations.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: How I miss the time I spent on this landship... If only I could've stayed longer...

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Go ahead, Doctor.

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: You looked a little surprised shaking my hand just now... D-Did my calluses scare you, Doctor?

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: Doctor, getting to sit here with you exchanging New Year's wishes is already pretty nice. I remember that time in Bolívar, the only thing I had to share the New Year with was a gun thiiiiiiiis big. Yeah, bigger than me.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Glad to see you again, Doctor.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I brought you a gift from the frontier... A jar of all-natural maple syrup. Though it's not as fancy as the stuff I used to get you, it's a rare treat where I live. It's can't even buy it with money; you have to head out to the forest to collect it yourself.

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I used to be so preoccupied with what goals and achievements I would score in the future. But my experiences in recent years have shattered those fantasies. Just getting to grant some happiness and dignity to the people in your life is already good enough.

voices.title: Appointed as Assistant
voices.text: Here. I've sorted these files according to how important or urgent they are, and whatever's left, I'll—Why do you look like you don't recognize me? C'monnn... Get these done so you can send me back out there already!

voices.title: Talk 1
voices.text: Ahhh... why did the little bunny run off when she saw me? Not like I'm gonna give her an airlift hug during work hours! I've been acting weird? Hah. After everything I went through, I get so excited to see everybody, it makes me wanna—Uh? You're not going anywhere? Then... a-one-and-a-two, up you go too?

voices.title: Talk 2
voices.text: How did you know I was researching this in my dorm? I'm trying to see how big my Arts can make the flames in this furnace, but I just can't believe—You got a tip about a fire hazard? Ahem, here's a bag of Cystymilk toffees, so *ssh* keep this a secret from Amiya, alright—Y-YOU WANT FIVE PACKS?! That's brutal! DEAL!

voices.title: Talk 3
voices.text: Let me do it, you rinse the bowls like this. It's not about making them squeaky clean, Yanese dining culture's just funny like that. Oh, there's something I really love about it, though—doesn't matter if you know your dinner mates or not, everyone sitting at one table shares the same dishes. So yap away while enjoying the same stuff, and bam! We're all friends now.

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 1
voices.text: I made a few new friends on my trip to Baizao, went to a bunch of feasts, and tied up some loose ends. There's so much on this land that's unfair or unavoidable, and my work as an Elite Operator remains the same. It's got my blood boiling a little too—Oh, did I burn you? My bad!

voices.title: Talk after Promotion 2
voices.text: My life's been pretty fantastical, huh? All those twists and turns and yet I survived, even ended up here at Rhodes Island—Is this what they call fate? If those accidents hadn't happened, I wouldn't be here right now—Oh, no, no, no! I prefer my life as it is, with the little bunny and you, Doctor!

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
voices.text: Right, let's go back and visit your mom. Wait, I mean visit my mom? Agh, that's even worse! Uh, Doctor? You heard all that? It's less trouble than it sounds, I'm happy to take my sister back. I just wanted to sort this out first—my messy family. I guess I'll just have to get used to it, haha.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
voices.text: The image I have of my dad is a silly guy around my age—subsisting on crumbs, and saving his lunch money to get some treats for his baby girl. Huh? Sounds like something I'd do? Mm...I guess, but he could be such a coward, I feel like I just wanna punch him. I'm more like my mom there.

voices.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
voices.text: Yeah, you're the contact listed on my ID. When the day comes, I hope you're the first to hear the news, hehe. You know every single thing I haven't said, all my unfinished business. With this, I can throw myself into battle with no regrets. Wait, how did you know—I said I dropped it somewhere!

voices.title: Idle
voices.text: These sleeves are so tight, I can't stand it! Phew… Much better. *Ssh* Don't tell Leizi, or she's going to nag my ears off about disrespecting her clothes again…

voices.title: Onboard
voices.text: Ta-da, I'm back! Yep, signing with my real name this time—Gu Zhuhuang. After stashing it away for so many years, I can finally write this name out in public. I'm still the same old me though, so just call me Blaze like you used to, Doctor.

voices.title: Watching Battle Record
voices.text: Doctor, you know I've pored over these battle records, studying them inside and out, so you don't have to drag me into a watch session, you know? Wait, these are—No! Not the one where my tail caught fire! That's when I was totally green, I learned quick after that!

voices.title: Promotion 1
voices.text: Phew—Gave me a fright, I thought you were gonna talk about work. So, this means you think I'd make a good Caster? Yay! That's an extra six hours of training for me now!

voices.title: Promotion 2
voices.text: Yes, I accept. I know what you're up to with this whole setup. We've got an unspoken understanding, right? Uh, you're really just giving me the medal without a word?

voices.title: Added to Squad
voices.text: There's something I want to try. Send me out on a mission, Doctor!

voices.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
voices.text: I'll BLAZE the trail for you.

voices.title: Depart
voices.text: The flames in the furnace are jumping for joy!

voices.title: Begin Operation
voices.text: Surrender now, and I can still turn down the heat.

voices.title: Selecting Operator 1
voices.text: You know, it wasn't easy learning Originium Arts Automation either!

voices.title: Selecting Operator 2
voices.text: My blood is boiling.

voices.title: Deployment 1
voices.text: Got the situation down crystal clear!

voices.title: Deployment 2
voices.text: Air's burning my lungs. Temp's just right.

voices.title: In Battle 1
voices.text: Step right up and taste my fireballs' power!

voices.title: In Battle 2
voices.text: Triple flames, scorch the heavens! The furnace... how did the rest go? Who cares, won't affect my flames!

voices.title: In Battle 3
voices.text: Daybreak? That's my boiling blood turning the horizon red!

voices.title: In Battle 4
voices.text: Better run faster, before my fire swallows you whole!

voices.title: 4-star Result
voices.text: I got your back, Doctor. Doesn't matter who's picking fights with who. Even bigwigs have to own up to their mistakes!

voices.title: 3-star Result
voices.text: My furnace flame will burn as long as I'm still standing!

voices.title: Sub 3-star Result
voices.text: Let's go eat! There's nothing a good meal can't resolve—my favorite Yanese saying, haha.

voices.title: Operation Failure
voices.text: If you're unsatisfied with the results, I'm ready to move out anytime.

voices.title: Assigned to Facility
voices.text: Where did my drinks in the fridge go? I was only gone a few days!

voices.title: Tap
voices.text: Yikes! That's cold! My skin's too hot? Your hands are practically ice!

voices.title: Trust Tap
voices.text: This furnace even has medical uses. They say it heals any illness if you smoke yourself over it every morning and night, with... what did they call it again—Aizhi? Aijiu? What is that smell?!

voices.title: Title
voices.text: Arknights.

voices.title: New Year's blessing
voices.text: It's just fire, wh-what's got you all so into it—Uh... Amiya, Doctor, and you guys... Fine, just don't stand too close to me, or you might get burned. One, two! Wait, I did it? So peacetime flames can look as pretty as fireworks…

voices.title: Greeting
voices.text: Hey. Gotta go train, see you later!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Doc—tor—C'mon! Put more oomph into it! I'm at my limit, it's over for me—Doctor, I didn't think you were this good at arm wrestling... Huh? I let you win? No, you beat me for real, I—Yeesh, just wanted to make you happy on your birthday is all, why not just play along!

voices.title: Anniversary Celebration
voices.text: I'm only third on this year's Training Room user rankings? Who's number one—DOCTOR?! Oh, so newbies use admin login before they get their own passes. Scared me for a sec there. Wait, then who's number two? C'mon! Tell me, no way I'm losing this year too!
